Some Important Hints :- 


II_ Bhava:- ability to express his thoughts; vision or power of observation; money matters; 
bank balance; possessions of extrinsic value; protects others, family members; face; soft- 
ness of speech; efforts in acquisition of wealth; oratorical ability; 


III _Bhava:- correspondence; letter; papers; writings; communication; telephone; tele- 
communication; radio-reports; signal; airmail; mediator; messenger; publicity officer; re- 
porter; editor; information officer; journalist; 3™ and 274 connection denotes the concerned 
to appear on the T.V. screen. 


V_Bhava:- pleasures; artistic talents and gains; recreation; entertainment; sports; amuse- 
ments; romance and similar interests, games; cinema; opera; drama; music; dance; merri- 
ment and amusements; betting; shares; love affairs; rape; good morals; discrimination be- 
tween virtue and sin; religious mindedness; chanting of vedic hymns; profound learning and 
wisdom; festive occasions; 3-5-10 connection makes the native as a T. V. reporter/T. V. 
Journalist. 


X Bhava:- honour, dignity and public esteem; name and fame; power and prestige; credit 
and conduct; success and status; rank and renown; respect and reputation; ambition and 
authority; worldly activities; responsibilities; profession; occupation; or business; Kar- 
masthana; employer; Master;honour from Government; service; sacrifice and the like. 


VI Bhava:- services; employees; subordinates or servants; 


XI Bhava:- wishes and aspirations and their realizations; success in all undertakings; 
pleasures and prosperity; progress in attempts; peace after achievement of aspirations; 


e If the sublords of the two cusps are the same, then they are deemed to be connect- 
ed. 

e The cuspal sublord of a certain bhava qualifies itself as a significator of that bhaa- 
va in the absence of planets in its stars, even if the sublord negates the bhaava. 

e The sublord of a particular cusp regrets the matter and at the same time as a sub- 
lord of a particular cusp, he qualifies himself as one of the significators of that cusp 
in the absence of planets in his stars. 

e When a planet holds the constellation on certain cusps without being sublord of 
any cusp, that planet can be decided to be a strong significator for the cusp con- 
cerned. 

e When a planet holds the sublordship on certain cusps, having no planets in its 
stars, that planet can be deemed to be a strong significator for the cusp concerned. 

&

Question of the Querent: When | will have an ownership of flat? 

Horary Number: 95 (out of 249). 

Time of Judgment: 26-09-2014, 16:40:52 Hrs. (IST). 

Place of Judgment: Park Street (Long/Lat: 22N33, 88E21), Kolkata, West Bengal 


Moon reveals the nature of query. 

Moon (Libra 04-18-23) is in the star of Mars and sub of Venus. Planet Moon is the occu- 
pant of 2, owner of 12. Moon is having stellar (positional) strength i.e. untenanted (there is 
no planet in stars of Moon) and CSL of 1-5. Starlord Mars is the occupant of 3, owner of 4 
and 9. Sublord Venus is the occupant of 1, owner of 3 and 10. Venus is having stellar 
(positional) strength i.e. untenanted (there is no planet in stars of Venus) and CSL of 7-9-11. 
Moon signifies and is in connection with relevant houses (4-9-11-12), hence query or urge is 
genuine. 


Land and Building 

Consider the houses 4, 11 and 12 for purchase of land or building or construction of build- 
ing (4th is the prime house of land and building; 11 for gain, success, fulfillment of desire 
and 12th for payment to seller of the land or building or investment of money in property). 

6th house indicates tenant. The 4th and 11t8 counted from 6t (i.e. 9 and 4), denotes the oc- 
cupation of house. Thus, the 9t house indicates ownership flat wherein we have to pay 
maintenance charges to our Building’s Society or Association which may treat also a type of 
tenancy charges. 

Mars is the natural significator of Building and Saturn is that of Land, Mines and Estates. 


Hints: 

If the cuspal sub lord of 4 be the significator of 4 (Land & Building), 9 (Ownership Flat), 11 
(Gain, Success, Fulfillment of desire) or 12 (Investment), one will have his own flat owner- 
ship during the joint period (DBA) of significators 4, 9, 11 and 12. 


Cuspal analysis 

4th Cusp (Scorpio 16-08-07): The sublord of the 4 cusp Jupiter is in star of Mercury and 
sub of Venus. Planet Jupiter is the occupant of 12, owner of 5 and 8. Star lord Mercury is 
the occupant of 2, owner of 2 and 11. Sublord Venus is the occupant of 1, owner of 3 and 
10. Venus is having stellar (positional) strength i.e. untenanted (there is no planet in stars 
of Venus) and CSL of 7-9-11. 4 CSL Jupiter signifies 11-12 and is in connection with 9-11. 
4th cusp falls in sign of Mars (Scorpio) and in star of Saturn (Anuradha-4). 


Planets signifying the houses 4, 9, 11 and 12 in respect to A. B, C, D, E 


A = Planets in Occupant’s Stars 

B = Occupant of Houses 

C = Planets in Owner’s Stars 

D = House Owner 

E = Planets Conjoined or Aspected (Hindu Aspects) by Significators (A), (B), (C), (D)

Learning astrology is very much like learning a new language. First basic factors should be 
understood systematically and with consistent practice one will become fluent in the subject 
of learning. But Astrology is not a simple subject to deal. Most of the KP followers know 
what is KP System and most importantly Ruling Planets which is the master piece in KP As- 
trology. The moment we think of Ruling Planets means it is only 5 components and this 
becomes the primary ruling planets and they are: 


Lord of the day 
Moon Sing Lord 
Moon Star Lord 
Lagna Lord 
Lagna Star Lord. 


Nodes Rahu/Ketu acts as an agent. If any planet in close conjunction becomes a second- 
ary Ruling Planet. 


Note : The aspect of another planet on ruling planets is not considered. 
Regarding Moon Sub and Lagna Sub as ruling planets: 


They are considered as a option only and they come under Secondary Ruling Planets. If we 
consider these two ruling planets, then there will be several planets appearing as_ ruling 
planets and selection of fruitful significators will become a difficult task. So more emphasis 
has to be given to 5 ruling planets only. Also we have to apply the ruling planets properly 
while judging and fixing final selection of the ruling planets. So I will not deal elaborately on 
this subject and our subject matter is how ruling planets play a very important rule in se- 
lecting the favourable Dasa, Bhukthi and Antara for the materialization of the life event un- 
der consideration. Here I am taking a marriage case to see how ruling planets help in fix- 
ing the favourabe Dasa, Bhukthi and Antara for the marriage timing.

Principle: If the 7th cuspal sublord signifies either house 2-7-11, then marriage is prom- 
ised. Some KP followers has also considered house 5 and 8 but in my opinion 5 and 8 alone 
will not give marriage without support of either 2 or 7 or 11. 

We shall analysis the following chart step by step and come to a conclusion whether mar- 
riage is promised or not. If so then we can see which are favourable Dasa/Bhukthi/Antara 


to be considered for timing of marriage.

Here we have to consider the principle 7th cusp and most required houses for marriage and 
we should see how the cuspal sublord of the 7th house plays a very important role.

In this article I shall analyze below a chart of very short longevity by KP system. The native 
was born on 05 March 1975 at 10:43 AM at Guntur. 


The native was born in Vrishabha Lagna in a fixed sign. So the 9t house will be Bada- 
kasthana and 2, 7‘ houses will be Markasthanas. 


Hence if the Lagna cusp sublord is linked with houses 2,7 and 9, then there will be short 
longevity. The Lagna cusp sublord is Mercury, where Mercury is lord of 2,3 houses. Mercury 
is posited in the star and sub of of Mars. Mars is the lord of houses 7 (Marakadhipathi), 12 
(Moksha, end of life) and is posited in the 9tt house (Badakasthana). 


From the above it is very clear that the Lagna cusp sublord is a strong significator of houses 
2, 7 and 9, denoting a short longevity. 


In addition the 34 and 8 cuspal sublord is Venus. Venus is posited in 11 house and is 
lord of houses 1, 6, in the star of Mercury, lord of 2, 3 houses. Venus is in thr sub of Ketu 
where Ketu is agent of Venus (1, 6). Having no planet in its stars, Venus is the cuspal sub 
lord (CSL) of houses 2,3,8,12. Hence Venus is well connected to houses 2 (Marakasthana), 6 
(sickness), 8 (Serious disease, danger to life), 12 (Moksha). 


The native was infected with jaundice at the age of 1 year 6 months and it had continued. 
The running Dasa- Bhukti- Antra was Mer-Jup-Jup. 


The Dasa lord Mercury is the significator of houses 2, 7, 9 and 8, 12. 


Bhukti lord Jupiter, which is natural significator of lever, is lord of 8 and 9 posited in 
11th house in the star of own. Jupiter’s sub lord Rahu is in 7, conjoined with Moon in 7. 


Since the 6% CSL is Mercury and posited in the star of Mars in Badakasthana, the native 
died on O9 Feb 1979 due to disease and complications. The DBA was Mer-Sat-Sat. 


As mentioned above the Dasa lord is a strong significator of houses 2, 7, 9. 

The Bhukti and Antara lord Saturn is posited in 24 house and lord of 10, 11 houses. Sat-

Question - 1: Death House (8*) 
plz discuss about death house{( 8th)..... 


Answer - 1: 

Double Role of the 8 House in Judgment of Longevity 

The 8 house plays the confusing double role as the ‘house of longevity’ in judgment of lon- 
gevity or life span and as the ‘house of death’ by its signification. The houses 1, 3, 8 are ex- 
amined as the houses of longevity in judging one’s longevity. However the significators of 
the 8» and 3¢ houses by the 1st and 8» cusp sub lords or the running DBAS lords or 
transit are undesirable malefics for one’s health and longevity due to chronic diseases, 
serious accidents, suicide, murders, assassinations etc., as presented below: 


1) In the judgment of longevity, the Ascendant sub lord is mainly examined as the Ascend- 
ant sub lord shows one’s health, vitality, immunity and longevity. Among the significators 
of the Ascendant sub lord, the houses 1,5,9,10 support the longer longevity and the houses 
6,8,12 cut the longevity short. (KP Reader III, pages 159, 165/ 1971 edition Practical part, pp 
12,18; KP Reader VI, pp 155-159); C.R. Bhatt’s Nakshatra Chintamani, p 30; Further Lights 
on Nakshatra Chintamani pp, 24-25; P.V.K. Punneswara Rao’s Theory and Practice of Stellar 
Astrology, p 45) 


2) To the longevity of father, the houses 2 and 3 counted from the 9th house is evil. (KP 
Reader VI, p 85) The marakasthanas and bhadakasthanas and the planets signifying them 
according to the method taught in “Krishnamurti Padhdhati Readers” are the strongest 
death influences, followed by houses 12 (mokshasthana or libration), 8 and 3. (K. Ganapa- 
thi: Your Doubt Resolved, Astrology & Athrishta, July 1976 issue, p 43) 


3) The 8th house denotes longevity or span of life, ‘house of death’, suicide, danger, inci- 
dents. (KP Reader VI, pp 118, 155, 258, 308; KP Reader III, p 165/ 1971 edition, Practical 
part, p 12, KP Reader II, p 20; KP Reader IV, p 249) 


4) The 86 house is known as the house of death in the Western astrology. (Rulership Book 
by Rex Bills, p 33; Encyclopedia of Medical Astrology, by H. L. Cornell, p 142; A Student’s 
Text-Book of Astrology by Vivian E Robson, 2010, p 16) 


5) The 8th house is called the house of "longevity". Therefore planets in the constellation of 
evil planets in the 8th house, except Saturn, occupants of the 8th house, planets in the 
constellation or in the sub of lord of 8, lord of the 8th cusp and planets in any manner con- 
nected with them indicate "(a) danger to one's life", (b) the cause of death and (c) the place 
of death. (KP Reader III, pp 160-161) 


6) The 4,8,12 houses are called trigonal houses causing fatal incidents (Astrosecrets & KP 
Part II, pp 94-97 /4-8-12 and Accidents by Kundanthai Nathan/, and K.M. Subramanian’s 
Sublord Speaks- 3 by p 66) In the Western astrology the 4,8,12 triangle houses are called 
terminal houses which concern the end of life and death of physical body. (Encyclopedia of 
Medical Astrology, by H. L. Cornell, p 857; Explore the Power Of Astrology by A. P. Parashar, 
V.K. Parashar, p 52)

Question -2: Vimshottari Dasa: 365 vs 360 days/year 

I have a question about the 360-vs-365-day year for the Vimshottari calculation. What do 
most Hindu astrologers feel? I know that in the West, the 365 day/ year has taken over. 
First of all I want to ask which has been the traditional year used for Vimshottari? 


Answer -— 2: 

As far as my study goes, the 365 days/year Vimshottari dasa starting from Moon has been 
used by all well known astrologers, like Dr. B V Raman, Prof. K S Krishnamurti, Prof. P. S. 
sSastri, J.N. Basin, Bepin Behari, K N Rao, Sajay Rath, V. K. Choudhry, Dr. K.S. Charak, 
P.V.R. Rayudu. 

https: //groups.yahoo.com/neo/groups/k p system/conversations/messages/37522 


The reasons for prefering 365 days/year are as follows: 

1) The 360 day year doesn't refer to the length of a Solar year (865.25 days) or Lunar 
year (360 tithis, about 354.36 solar days) and is called a Savan year or the civil 
year. Nowadays it is not in use in any part of the world except for sacrificial purpos- 
es particularly for the Soma-yajna. 

2) In Surya Siddhanta, the Solar month is said to have 30.4382266 days (30. gh 
26.17.37) and the Lunar month has 29.5305833 days (29. gh 31.50.6). The differ- 
ence of 0.907643 days (gh 54.27.31) gets corrected by one intercalary month after 
every 32 months and 15.246 days. For the pure Lunar year of about 340 days, the 
panchangs in India are corrected to be in line with the solar year by adding one ad- 
hika masa every 3 years or So. 

3) By taking a month of 30 days and a year of 360 days, one cannot go by the univer- 
sally used Gregorian calendar. If the 360 day year rather than the 365 day year is 
used for the mahadasa calculation, the gap between them would become more di- 
vergent with the dasa period, i.e. 6.25 days (865.25-360) after 1 year, 31.5 days 
(6.25x6) after 5 years, about 6 months after 35 years, a whole year after 70 years, 
and a native may have to celebrate his 72 birthday even while he has yet to com- 
plete his 71st year under Vimshottari dasa of the 365 day year. 

4) The simplicity of calculation by dividing the year into months by multiplying by 12 
and further converting into days by multiplying of 30 in the calculation of the dasa 
balance at birth and sub sub (Dasa-Bhukti-Antra-Sookshma) dasa periods (in Bri- 
hat Parasara Hora Sastra, Phala Deepika, Tables of Bhukti and Anthara etc) cannot 
be understood as taking a 360 day year - 12 months x 30 days per month. The year 
is taken as 365.25 days. The actual dates computed by rigorous calculations by tak- 
ing actual days of the months and by this simple method differ only by a few days; 
accurate practically for all astrological purposes. 

5) By taking a month of 30 days and a year of 360 days, one cannot go by the univer- 
sally used Gregorian calendar. If the 360 day year rather than the 365 day year is 
used for the mahadasa calculation, the gap between them would become more di- 
vergent with the dasa period, i.e. 6.25 days (3865.25-360) after 1 year, 31.5 days 
(6.25x6) after 5 years, about 6 months after 35 years, a whole year after 70 years, 
and a native may have to celebrate his 72 birthday even while he has yet to com- 


plete his 71st year under Vimshottari dasa of the 365 day/year.

Question -3: Mean or True Rahu/Ketu 

Mean motion of nodes mean their daily average retrograde motion. Hence normally we take 
mean motion of NODES if their speed is not stationary like what is delineated from the 
chart of Guruji KSK. Sir your opinion for clarity on this point is solicited. 


Answer -3: 
Mean Rahu/Ketu is used in KP particular and Vedic in general with some exceptions like 
Cuspal Interlinks and System Analysis. 


The main reason is that “True” position is somewhat illusory, since the “True” Rahu/Ketu is 
true “ only twice” a month when the Moon crosses the ecliptic. Other positions provided for 
the times in between those two points are just a hypothesis.

Question: Will Ex-president Mahinda Rajapakse face any legal inquiry regarding his mis- 
use of power, State property, War Crimes & Crimes against Humanity if so what will be the 
outcome? 

Number: 123 (out of 249); 

Date of Judgment: 17-01-2015, Saturday; Time of Judgment: 15:28:39 PM IST 

Place of Judgment: Kankariya- Anmedabad Long/Lat: 23° N 00', 72° E 36’; 

Aynamsha 23°.58'.37" 








Reference: 
:-//www.channel4.com/news/mia-maya-arulpragasam-sri-lanka-president-tamil- 





TUESDAY 13 JANUARY 2015 
M.I.A.: Sri Lanka has 'same government with different face’ 


Rapper M.I.A. tells Channel 4 News that though she still wants former Sri Lankan 
president Mahinda Rajapaksa to face a war crimes trial, the priority is getting the 
country's Tamils their basic needs. 

Maya Arulpragasam, the Sri Lankan Tamil recording artist, spoke to Channel 4 News 
following the defeat of Rajapaksa, a man accused of presiding over war crimes at the end 
of Sri Lanka's civil war, in Sri Lanka's election. 

Mahinda Rajapaksa was in charge of Sri Lanka at the end of the war against terror group 
the Tamil Tigers. In the closing weeks of the war in May 2009 the Sri Lankan army is 
accused of deliberately shelling civilians, and the UN estimates that around 40,000 died. 
For their part, the Tamil Tigers were a brutal organisation also accused of war crimes - 
including the use of child soldiers, human shields and suicide bombings. 

The UN is currently investigating alleged war crimes committed at the end of Sri Lankan 
civil war and in the years following, but it is an inquiry that Rajapaksa had refused to 
cooperate with. 

Rajapaksa has been replaced as Sri Lankan president by Maithripala Sirisena Rajapaksa's 
one-time ally and also the acting defence minister at the end of the civil war. 

‘Basic needs' 

Sirisena has also refused to cooperate with the international inquiry, and Arulpragasam 
told Channel 4 News that Sri Lanka's new government has the "same face" as it includes 
politicians who have been involved in government for the last 30 years. 

She said the Tamil community had embraced democracy and peace - the Tamil vote was 
largely responsible for Sirisena's election - and that now the government had to restore 
basic needs" to the community. 

She told Channel 4 News that reconciliation can only come if the Sri Lankan government 
undoes some of the Rajapaksa regime's actions, such as his militarisation of Tamil areas 
in the country's north. 

On the UN inquiry, Arulpragasam said "we still want Rajapaksa to go to the Hague", but 
that peace in Sri Lanka's post-war period was a priority for Tamils. In the years since the 
war there have been continued allegations of ongoing abuses such as "enforced 
disappe arances" of Tamils and government opponents. 

Channel 4 News has been banned from Sri lanka since 2009 except for a brief trip there

Hint: Criminal Proceedings 

If the sub lord of the 10 cusp (status) be the significator (in the star of the occupant or 
owner) of 7 (court proceedings), 8 (infamy) or 12 (crimes), the native will be involved in 
court proceedings relating to crimes, will be ill-reputed and will be inflicted with 
punishment, during the joint period of the significators of 7, 8 and 12. 


Cuspal Sub lord (Criminal Proceedings): 

10% Cusp (Gemini 26°.16'.23"): The sub lord of the 10 cusp is Ketu. Ketu is in the star 
of Mercury and sub of Venus. Ketu is occupant of 6. No planet in the star of Ketu and Ketu 
is CSL of 4-10. Ketu is aspected by Jupiter. Jupiter is occupant of 11, owner of 4-7. No 
planet in the star of Jupiter and Jupiter is CSL of 1-5-7-11. Star lord Mercury is occupant 
of 4, owner 1-10. Sub lord Venus is occupant of 4, owner 2-9. No planet in the star of 
Venus and Venus is CSL of 6. Thus 10% cusp sub lord Ketu is significator of 1-4-10 and 
connected with 6-4-10-11-7-1-5-2-9. Hence will be involved in court proceedings relating 
to crimes, will be ill-reputed and will be inflicted with punishment is sure. 


Joint period: 
At the time of horary, Mercury dasa continue up to 24-11-2026. Joint period at the time of 
horary is Mercury-Venus-Jupiter is up to 11-02-2015. 


Dasa lord Mercury is in the star of Moon and sub of Venus. Mercury is occupant of 4, 
owner of 1-10. Star lord Moon is occupant of 2, owner 11. Sub lord Venus is occupant of 
4, owner 2-9. No planet in the star of Venus and Venus is CSL of 6. Thus 10 cusp sub 
lord Mercury is significator of 2-11 and connected with 4-1-10-2-9-6. 


My opinion: 10% sub lord indicate court proceedings but dasa lord Mercury does not 
signifies 7 or 8 or 12 at all, hence he will not face any court proceedings.

Kiram Bedi’s Entry into Delhi Politics 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 


(£3 a\ 
| Ezine }} 





Political power grows out of the barrel of a gun.- Mao Zedong 
Political power grows out of the 10th house.- Astrology 


Short Background 

1. Ahead of 7 February 2015 Delhi Assembly elections, 65-year-old Kiran Bedi, former 
Indian Police Service top officer, a social activist and close aide of anti-graft crusader Anna 
Hazare, joined Delhi Politics on 15 January 2015, by formally joining the Bharatiya Janata 
Party (BJP) dialing a toll-free number established for the party’s nationwide membership 
drive and declaring at a press conference in New Delhi in the presence of party chief Amit 
Shah. 


2. During the press conference Shah downplayed media queries whether she would be the 
BJP's chief ministerial candidate in Delhi. He said that a decision in this regard would be 
taken by the BJP parliamentary board. On 19 January 2015 the BJP named new entrant 
Kiran Bedi as its chief ministerial candidate for the February 7 Delhi assembly elections. 
She will contest from the Krishna Nagar seat in East Delhi, considered a BJP stronghold.

urge is genuine.

> 11% CSL Jupiter is not connected with 7 or 10.

TUESDAY 13 JANUARY 2015 
M.I.A.: Sri Lanka has 'same government with different face’ 


Rapper M.I.A. tells Channel 4 News that though she still wants former Sri Lankan president 
Mahinda Rajapaksa to face a war crimes trial, the priority is getting the country's Tamils 
their basic needs. 

Maya Arulpragasam, the Sri Lankan Tamil recording artist, spoke to Channel 4 News 
following the defeat of Rajapaksa, a man accused of presiding over war crimes at the end of 
Sri Lanka's civil war, in Sri Lanka's election. 

Mahinda Rajapaksa was in charge of Sri Lanka at the end of the war against terror group 
the Tamil Tigers. In the closing weeks of the war in May 2009 the Sri Lankan army is 
accused of deliberately shelling civilians, and the UN estimates that around 40,000 died. 

For their part, the Tamil Tigers were a brutal organisation also accused of war crimes - 
including the use of child soldiers, human shields and suicide bombings. 

The UN is currently investigating alleged war crimes committed at the end of Sri Lankan 
civil war and in the years following, but it is an inquiry that Rajapaksa had refused to 
cooperate with. 

Rajapaksa has been replaced as Sri Lankan president by Maithripala Sirisena - Rajapaksa's 
one-time ally and also the acting defence minister at the end of the civil war. 

‘Basic needs' 

Sirisena has also refused to cooperate with the international inquiry, and Arulpragasam told 
Channel 4 News that Sri Lanka's new government has the "same face" as it includes 
politicians who have been involved in government for the last 30 years. 

She said the Tamil community had embraced democracy and peace - the Tamil vote was 
largely responsible for Sirisena's election - and that now the government had to restore 
basic needs" to the community. 

She told Channel 4 News that reconciliation can only come if the Sri Lankan government 
undoes some of the Rajapaksa regime's actions, such as his militarisation of Tamil areas in 
the country's north. 

On the UN inquiry, Arulpragasam said "we still want Rajapaksa to go to the Hague", but 
that peace in Sri Lanka's post-war period was a priority for Tamils. In the years since the 
war there have been continued allegations of ongoing abuses such as _ "enforced 
disappearances" of Tamils and government opponents. 

Channel 4 News has been banned from Sri lanka since 2009 except for a brief trip there 
when the Prime Minister, David Cameron, visited last year for the CHOGM meeting. The PM

The KP Horary Astrology, also called Prashna Sastra, is the very potent tool of the KP 
system, invented by our great Guruji Sothida Mannan JyothishMarthanad late Sri K. S. 
Krishnamurti ji. It is a unique system applicable any where of the globe by any individual 
for any type of question at any time. 


As an evidence for the perfectness and incredibility of this goldentechnique of Horary, 
I would like to draw esteemed readers attention to recent incident of astrological predictions 
done by two astrologers from two countries in two separate dates and times. As 
readers are aware, the residential Election of Sri Lanka held on 8th Jan. 2015 was a very 
hard and keen competition between the former president and a member of his owned 
government, who left the government and his post as a cabinet minister, and it was 
unthinkable for the opponent to win, as the former president was credited by most of 
the country men for ending the 30 years of ethnic war of Tamil Tigers. It is my personal 
notice that no famous astrologer in Sri Lanka forward to forecast the winning of the 
opponent. But three astrologers including myself had forecasted the victory of the opponent, 
where other two come from traditional astrology. 


In the meantime Kanak Kumar Bosmia ji, the editor of KPEzine, who has given advance 
election predictions with successful rate of around 75%, had given his verdict through 
Horary in this magazine, and it is an eye opener foremost astrologers not only in Sri Lanka 
but also all over the world. My horary prediction which also revealed the victory of 
Mr. Maithripala Sirisena was refused to publish in local Sinhalese astrological tabloids as 
they all were under the threat of the past government. Finally I had decided to issue the 
same to a Sinhalese Web site only for information of Sri Lankan Sinhalese readers. 


What I want to bring the notice of esteemed readers of KPEZine and KP enthusiasts is the 
unique format of the Horary astrology in getting the same verdict for the same question 
predicted by two different astrologers at different places and times, as follows: 

Question: (same as for both astrologers) 


Will Maithripala Sirisena win Sri Lankan Presidential Election 2015? 


KP rule applied: (same as for both astrologers) If 10th (one’s position in politics) cusp 
sub lord (CSL) signifies house10 (one’s reputation), 3 (one’s ability), 11 (one’s reputa- 
tion as a winner) in the DBA of the significators of houses 3, 10, 11, then success is 


assured. | ———

The mother of the native approached me in the month of Nov 2011, with an enquiry about 
the possibilities of second marriage for the native. On seeing Dasha period running at that

to me. 

Name: Miss Anamika. DOB: 6 April 1980; TOB: 08.35.02 PM; POB: Ambattur (TN). 


What are the K.P. rules for second marriage: 

For second marriage, K.P. rules say: 

Second marriage is indicated in the following cases - 

1. Rule- Note the 7 cusp sub lord 

(A) If it is deposited in dual sign (Gemini, Sagittarius and Pisces) or 

(B) In a star of a planet in or owning a dual sign or 

(C) If 7th cusp sub lord is Mercury 

(D) If the 7th cusp sub lord is also significator of houses 2 or11, 

2. Rule- If 2nd cusp sub lord is connected to house 7‘, second marriage is promised. 
3. Rule- If 9th cusp sub lord signifies 2, 9, 11 houses, second marriage will take place. 
(as per Sri Kanak Bosmia). 


Analysis of the chart: 

As per rule no.1—(A) Seventh cusp sub lord is Ketu. Ketu is deposited in 4 cusp Aquarius 
sign. This sign is not a dual sign. 

(B) Ketu is the star of Mars owning Aries and Scorpio, is deposited in Leo. Neither Mars is 
a dual planet nor are the signs dual signs. 

(C) The seventh cusp sub lord Ketu signifies 2 and 7. 

Apart from this the 7 cusp sub lord Ketu is conjoined with Mercury. Mercury owns 9 and 
12 (Gemini and Virgo) and as such Mercury is the dual planet which owns dual signs 
which are relevant factors for second marriage. 

The first rule is partly satisfied. 


As per rule no. 2--- second cusp sub lord is Rahu + which is conjoined with Mars-Jupiter 
and Saturn. Mars is lord of 7. The second rule is satisfied. 


As per rule no. 3--- 9 cusp sub lord is Mercury. Mercury is the owner of 9 and 12 placed 
in 5th bhava. Mercury is in Jupiter star and Ketu sub. The star lord Jupiter is the owner of 
3 and 6 is placed in 10th bhava. The sub lord Ketu is deposited in 4 bhava in conjunction 
with Mercury. Thus the 96 cusp sub lord signifies 12 (bed comforts), 5 (love and romance) 
and 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11 and 12 at its sub lord Ketu level. Thus the third rule is 
satisfied. 


So we can say second marriage is assured for this native. 
Now we have to see when it will get materialized. 

The significators of the relevant houses (2, 9 and 11) are - 
2nd house- Moon, Ketu, Mars and Rahu +. 

9th house- Sun and Mercury

Longevity Analysis 

The Lagna of the swearing-in chart is Gemini 28° 47' 10", and the lst cuspal sub lord 
(CSL) is Sun, owner of house 3, placed in house 6, and also the CSL of houses 1, 3 having 
no planets in its stars. The Sun is in the star of Venus, the lord of house 11 located in 
house 7 (Maraka & Badhaka), and in the sub of Mercury, the lord of 1, 12 & 4. Hence the 
main longevity indicator lst CSL Sun signifies inauspicious houses 7 (Maraka & Badha- 
ka), 6 (Sickness), 12 (renunciation, misfortune) and 4(end of life/ office term), along with 
the favorable houses 1 & 11 as a most detrimental indicator for the longevity of the term 
in office. 


For confirmation the supporting longevity indicators of 3rd and 8th CSLs are further ana- 
lyzed. 


The 3rd CSL is Sun, the same as the 1st CSL, as discussed above. 


The 8th cusp for longevity is under the co-rulers of Saturn - Mars - Jupiter. The 8 CSL 
Jupiter+ is lord of 6, 7 & 10 placed in 2 (Maraka), the CSL of 2,8 having no planet in its 
stars. This Jupiter is in the star of Mercury, a significator for 7, 1, 4, 12, and in the sub of 
own Jupiter. So 8th CSL Jupiter signifies unfavorable 2 (Maraka),7 (Maraka & Badhaka), 
12 (Moksha), 6 (sickness), 8 (danger to life/ term of office), 4 (end of everything), along 
with favorable 1 only. 


According to the above analysis of the lst, 3rd and 8th CSLs, it doesn't indicate a long 
and good term of presidency. 


Authority 

The authority of the President is denoted by the 10th house of swearing - in chart. The 
sub lord of 10th cusp Saturn is the lord of 8, 9, located in 5, in the star of own Saturn, 
and in the sub of Ketu in 9, in Pisces sign representing Jupiter lord of 6,7,10, placed in 2, 
being the CSL of 2,8 having no planet in its stars. So for strong authority, positive houses 
2, 6, 10 are indicated with some failure by signification of 5, 8, including government 
changes.

Dealing with Partners and Public 

In the President's swearing-in chart, the 7th house of the chart indicates the matters of 
alliances of the government or political partners and general public. The sub lord of 7th 
cusp is Mars lord of 5 and tenanted in the 8(disharmony), in its owned star Mars and in 
the sub of Venus lord of 11 located in 7, indicating favorable houses 5,7,11, along with 
problematic 8. 


The 11th cusp sub lord Rahut is in the 3rd,in the sign of Virgo representing Mercury lord 
of 12, 1, 4, placed in 7, aspected by Ma (8, 5). It is in the star of Mo (2, 2) and in the Sub 
of Ve (2, 7, 11). Thus Rahu+ indicates favorable 2, 5, 7, 11, along with unfavorable 8 
(disharmony) & 12. 


Here 2 and 7 are favorable houes, and they are bad for health and longevity only. 


Budget condition 

The 2nd house of the swearing-in chart has special relation to the financial condition of 
the government. In this chart the sub lord of 2nd house is money planet Jupiter+ with its 
signification of 2, 6 -7 -10& 8 by its CSL-ship, in the star of Mercury (7,1 -4 -12) and in 
the owned sub, indicating favorable houses 2, 6, 10 for good financial position of the gov- 
ernment, along with some waste and troubles by signification of houses 8 & 12. 


Dealing with religious affairs 

Mr. Maithirpala Sirisena the newly elected President came to the battle of election as a 
common opposition candidate through an alliance composed with the members of multi 
national and multi religions. So his liability towards all the religions cannot be considered 
as a Simple matter. He has to win the good will of his owned followers, where the majority 
of them are Buddhist and minority of other religions like Catholic, Muslim and Hindu. 


The ruling house of the religious affairs of the swearing-in chart is 9th house. The sub 
lord of the 9th cusp is Venus the lord of 11 placed in 7, in the star of Moon lord of 2 locat- 
ed in 2. Venus is in the sub of Rahut in the 3rd,in the sign of Virgo representing Mercury 
lord of 12, 1, 4, placed in 7, aspected by Mars lord of 5 placed 8, indicating a bit mixed 
results. 


At the same time the 9th CSL also indicates not so smooth foreign relations. 


Dasa Analysis 

Opening 6 years compressed Vimshottari Dasa balance of Kethu for 4 days had already 
expired. The current running 6 years compressed Vimshottari Dasa from 14 January 
2015 up to 14 January 2016 is Venus. Current running Dasa lord Venus is the lord of 11 
placed in 7, in the star of Moon lord of 2 located in 2. Venus is in the sub of Rahut+ in the 
3rd, in the sign of Virgo representing Mercury lord of 12, 1, 4, placed in 7, aspected by 
Mars lord of 5 placed in 8, indicating a bit mixed results. 


Since Dasa lord Venus signifies all life saving houses of 1, 5, 11, the new President is ex- 
pected to survive this Venus Dasa with difficulties as a result of signification of unfavora- 
ble houses 2 & 7 (Maraka and Badhaka for longevity), 8 (danger to life/ office term, sud- 
den troubles, disappointments), 12 (end of life/ office term), renunciation). 


The next Dasa periods from Sun to Rahu up to O1 February 2018 appear to be survived 
with their significations of both favorable and unfavorable houses that may not so end of 
presidential term. 


But Jupiter Dasa from O1 February 2018 to 20 November 2018 would be critical for sur- 


vival of presidency because Dasa lord Jupiter signifies all deadly houses 2 (Maraka), 7 
(Maraka & Badhaka), 12 (Moksha), 6 (sickness), 8 (danger to life/ term of office), 4 (end

of everything), 10 (retirement from this world/ end of life), along with life saving house 1

Question- 1: Difference between Umang Taneja’s Nadi Astrology and KP 
Sir,what is the difference between nadi astrology thought by mr umanj taneja and kp 
system? Pl explain sir if possible for the benefit of students. 


Answer- 1: 
The so-called nadi astrology by Umang Taneja is in fact all about KP astrology. 


The main difference is Umang Taneja’s nadi astrology does not look at the cuspal sub lord 
of the respective house for a given event in order to check firstly whether the event is 
promised or not. It checks whether the Dasa- Bhukti- Antra lords signify the required 
houses, for marriage 2,7,11, at the planet, its star lord and sub lord levels. 


The reason of not taking into consideration of the cuspal sub lord is that it is difficult to 
handle the cuspal degree of houses in natal horoscope because it is practically very difficult 
to correct the degree of Ascendant of a native to minutes. In other words, the cuspal sub 
lords of houses keep changing in every few minutes and they are not reliable as most people 
do not have accurate birth times. 


In KP, firstly the cuspal sub lord of a house should be checked whether the matter of that 
house is promised or not. Promise is not a guarantee for materialization event. Only if the 
matter is promised, it will happen during the joint dasa period DBA of the significators of 
required houses. 

https: roups.yahoo.com/neo/groups/k p system/conversations/messages/30707 


For example of marriage, first we have to check whether the 7th cuspal sub lord (CSL) 
signifies any of marriage houses 2,7 and 11. If so, marriage is promised; on the other hand 
if not so, marriage is not promised. If the 7th CSL signifies 2,7 or 11, marriage is promised 
to take place during the joint dasa period (DBA) of significators of 2,7 and 11. The promise 
of marriage is not a guarantee to get married, and marriage will take place only during the 
joint dasa period that signifies 2,7 and 11. If the 7th CSL does not signify 2,7 or 11 or 
negates marriage, it does not need further analysis of the joint dasa period as the marriage 
cannot take place even during the joint dasa period signifying 2,7 and 11. 


The bottom line is to use the cuspal sub lord of concerned houses in KP analysis. How the 
birth time is accurate, no body knows since astrology is divine science. 


Only if the birth time is doubtful, especially by the consultant himself or herself, the birth 
time rectification is to be done by the help of “ruling planets”, only then mysteriously God 
will help the astrologer. It should also be verified with major life events.. 

https: //groups.yahoo.com/neo/groups/k _ p system/conversations/messages/28698

Dear Sir, it is said that KP astrology is based on the cuspal chart which is casted according 
to Raphael's ephemeris. In that book cuspal degrees are given only to cities located up to 60

located above GON latitude. We can't cast charts manually with Raphael's ephemeris for 
those people born in locations above 6ON, but all these softwares do it without any 
hesitation. I have lot of friends and relatives born at locations above GON. Can we rely on 
charts given by those softwares? I would like to seek your advice on this. Thank you. 


Answer- 3: 
Yes, we can rely on charts given by accurate softwares using the Swiss ephemeris, as 
explained below: 


Raphael’s Ephemeris and Table of Houses ruled the astrological world during the period 
when Guruji KSK was doing research and writing KP. Nowadays the highly accurate Swiss 
ephemeris dominates the current astrological SWs like KPAstro 3.5, Jagannatha Hora, 
Astro-Kundli, Jyotishya Deepika, Astracadabra, KPStarOne. 


# Raphael's Table of Houses for Northern Latitudes 

from the Equator to 50 Degrees N.O' Also for Leningrad 59 Degrees N. 56' 
W. Foulsham & Co., LTD. 104 pages 

# Raphael's Astronomical Ephemeris of the Planets' Places for 2010 

W. Foulsham & Co., LTD. 49 pages 


The drawback of the Raphael’s Tables of Houses (first published in 1821) is that only 
ascendant position is given to the degree and minute and other cuspal positions to the 
nearest degree only. The current Universal Table of Houses, Michelsen Tables of Houses 
and AFA Tables of Houses give the cuspal positions up to the degree and minute and 
Krishman KP Tables of Houses up to the second. The manual calculation by using these 
Tables of Houses provides the cuspal positions very close to the SW results. In the new era 
of high precision drive by SWs like Astrodienst/KPAstro 4.1, the Raphael’s Table of Houses 
looks like a historical record only without any more practical publication.

Longevity 

This is Arvind Kejriwal’s swearing-in chart as Delhi Chief Minister, and Consequently 
Arvind Kejriwal’s longevity as Delhi CM is indicated by mainly the 1st cuspal sub lord (CSL) 
of this chart. The representation of 1st house here is not the same like in other mundane 
charts in general. 


1st CSL Rahu signifies positive houses 1,5 and negative houses 2,7,9 (Badhaka), indicating 
medium life up to 4 years. 


It is supported by 3" CSL Mars’ signification of positive houses 1,5,11 and negative houses 
2,7,8,9 (Badhaka),12, and 8h CSL Jupiter’s signification of only negative houses 2,7,8,9 
(Badhaka). 


Critical Period 
Rahu Dasa (11-May-2017 to 11-Feb-2018) would be critical for survival by signification of 
negative houses 2,4,7,9 (Badhaka), along with positive houses 1,5. 


Authority 
10th CSL Jupiter signifies positive houses 3 and negative houses 4,8, not indicating strong 
authority in governance. 


Finance Position 

2nd CSL Rahu signifies positive house 2 (out of relevant 2,6,10,11) and negative house 5 
(out of unfavorable 5,8,12), not indicating to be sufficient finance position for full imple- 
mentation of welfare programs as promised in election campaign. 


Communal and Religious Harmony 
7th & 9th CSL Rahu signifies positive houses 2,5,7,9 and negative houses 1,4, indicating to 
have good communal and religious harmony. 


Conclusion 

This swearing-in chart is interesting to see how Arvind Kejriwal can survive the 5-yearr 
compressed Rahu Dasa (11-May-2017 to 11-Feb-2018) with a comfortable majority, win- 
ning 67 out of 70 assembly seats.

Hints: Foreign Travel 

12*h cuspal sub lord (CSL) is the guide. 

Moon is the chief karaka of journey and Rahu is the chief karaka of foreign / foreign

Moon reveals the nature of query.

ry. Venus is the occupant of 1st, owner of 1-8». No planet is in the star of Venus and

with Mercury. Mercury is occupant 12‘h, owner of 9-12‘®. Sub load Mercury is occu- 
pant 12th, owner of 9-12. Thus 12th CSL Venus signifies and is in connection with 
9, 12, hence foreign travel is promised. But connection with 8'* house indicates de- 
lay. 


Cross verification 

9th Cusp: The sub lord of 9 cusp Venus is in the star of Rahu and sub of Mercury. 
As explained above, Venus signifies houses 9t and 12th, hence foreign travel is 
promised.

Moon reveals the nature of query 


Moon (Scorpio 05-33-17) is in star of Saturn and sub of Mercury. Planet Moon is the 
occupant of 10, owner of 7. Star lord Saturn is the occupant of 10, owner of 1. Sublord 
Mercury is the occupant of 12, owner of 6 and 8. 


Moon clearly indicates what the querent carries herself in its mind. Here the significance of 
1-10 negates the houses 2-11 which are required for a child birth and the significance of 
6-8-12 is not good for a normal delivery. As Moon is connected with 2 by Jupiter’s aspect 
the querent herself possesses a feeble chance towards the birth of a child. 


Cuspal analysis 


5th Cusp (Taurus 29-35-59): The 5 CSL Saturn is in star of Self (Saturn) and sub of 
Venus. Planet Saturn is the occupant of 10, owner of 1. Starlord Saturn is the occupant of 
10, owner of 1. Sublord Venus is the occupant of 12, owner of 4-5-9. 


Thus, 5th CSL Saturn is posited in sub of a planet i.e. Venus that feebly signifies 5. It 
indicates child birth is promised. But in fact only a feeble chance is indicated due to the 
following reasons: 


¢ 5th CSL and its starlord — both is Saturn. Saturn is a termed as delayed & restricted 
planet as well as a natural malefic planet for child birth. Saturn signifies the houses 
1-10 and therefore negates the houses 2-11 which is required for a child birth. 


¢ 5th CSL Saturn is in sub of Venus. Venus is in Capricorn — neither fruitful nor barren. 
Venus signifies the houses 12 which is not good for a safe and normal delivery. Venus is 
untenanted and the owner of 5 cusp. Venus is aspected by Jupiter (Karaka for child 
birth) who is the lord of 24 cusp. A feeble chance of child birth is indicated but it should 
turns to be negative as Jupiter is retrograde in chart. Moreover Venus is aspected by 
Saturn who signifies the houses 1-10 and therefore negates the houses 2-11 which is 
required for a child birth. 


¢ 5th CSL Saturn is in sub of Venus. Venus is aspected by Saturn and signifies the houses 
12. It indicates there may be complication in case of a child birth. There may a chance of 
abortion or miscarriage. 


The Dasha Lord is Saturn (up to 16-11-2030). As discussed, Saturn is not favorable for a 
child birth. Bhukti Lord is Mercury (up to 29-07-2017). Mercury signifies the houses 6-8-10 
-4 and not favorable for child birth. Moreover due to 6-8 in Mercury Bhukti, no chance is 
indicated for a normal and safe delivery. 


My Opinion: There is a feeble chance of caesarean child birth without a normal delivery but 
also a chance of abortion or miscarriage. 


Actual Fact: Prediction comes true. On 27-01-2014, miscarriage happened.

Rule - 1: 

Note down sub sub lord of Asc sub sub lord. (Horary sub sub lord A is in the sub sub of 
planet B, in this case B is deciding factor). Now tally Planet B with Moon star lord or sub 
sub lord. If tallies (in other words, if B is star lord or sub sub lord of the MOON) the answer 
is YES. If not, check with Asc star lord and sub sub lord, if tallies (in other words, if B is 
star lord or sub sub lord of Asc.) the answer is YES. 


Analysis: 

Sub Sub lord of Ascendant Sub Sub lord is Mercury. 
Mercury is ASC star lord. 

Rule SATISFIED. 


Rule - 2: 

Note down F-1, star lord if Asc sub sub lord. (Planet A is in the star of B, Please read 
detailed article by the same author in Feb-Mar 2007 KP Ezine issue). Now tally planet B 
with the Moon star lord or sub sub lord. If tallies (in other words, if B is star lord or sub sub 
lord of the MOON) the answer is in YES. If not, check with Asc star lord and sub sub lord. If 
tallies (in other words, if B is star lord or sub sub lord of Asc.) the answer is in YES. 


Analysis: 

Star lord of Ascendant Sub Sub lord is Mercury. 
Mercury is ASC star lord. 

Rule SATISFIED. 


Rule - 3: 

Lastly check with F-3, (Planet A—sub sub lord of Asc—is in the sub sub of planet B. Planet 
B is in the star of Planet C. In this case, Planet C is the deciding factor). Now tally Planet C 
with Moon star lord or sub sub lord. If tallies (in other words, if C is star lord or sub sub 
lord of MOON) the answer is YES. If not, tally with Asc star lord and sub sub lord. If tallies 
(in other words, if C is star lord or sub sub lord of Asc.) the answer is YES. 


Analysis: 
Star lord of Sub Sub lord of Ascendant Sub Sub lord is Moon. 
Rule NOT Satisfied.

2 out of 3 rules satisfied. Hence according to TSP, the answer is YES what I have read on

Timeline 

1. 13th February 1935: born at Natmauk, a township in Magwe district, central Myanmar; 
2. 1932 (Ra-Ju/ Dasa-Bhukti): matriculated in “A” category with distinctions in Myanmar 
and Pali, and went to study at Rangoon University; 

3. 1935 (Ra-Sa) - 1936 (Ra-Me): elected to the executive committee of the Rangoon Univer- 
sity Students’ Union and became the editor of the Student Union Magazine; 

4. February 1936 (Ra-Me-Me/ Dasa-Bhukti-Antra): expelled from the university for publi- 
cation of the article “Hell Hound at Large” in the student union magazine . Expulsion of Ko 
Aung San and Ko Nu from the university led to the university strike. Later the government 
conceded strikers’ demands and retracted expulsion orders; 

5. 1938 (Ra-Me): elected as the president of the Rangoon University Students’ Union as 
well as the All Burma Students’ Union; appointed as a student representative in Rangoon 
University Act Amendment Committee by the government. His honesty, single-mindedness 
and capacity for work earned him much respect. Yet he was a difficult personality, being 
criticized for his untidiness, devastating fits of silence, and his angular behavior. 

6. October 1938 (Ra-Ke-Su/ Dasa-Bhukti-Antra): joined Dohbama Asi-ayone (“We- 
Burmese” Organization) after he had left university; 

7. 1938 (Ra-Ke)- August 1940 (Ra-Ve-Ma): acted as general secretary of Dohbama Asi- 
ayone; 

8. 1938-39 (Ra-Ke): countrywide strikes known as Revolution of Year 1300 (Myanmar cal- 
endar year)

Marriage Denial in KP System 


=> 
| Ezine 


By: Gunti Nagaraju KP astrologer 
M.com CAIIB, Retired Bank officer 
12-13-668/5/2, Second floor, Nagarjuna Nagar,

Whenever any individual referring to the natal chart asks about his or her marriage, we will 
be checking the 7th cusp sub lord and its connection with 2, 7 and 11th houses. 

2nd house speaks about one’s family, 7th house denotes marriage bonding and 11th house 
indicates permanent friendship between the couple. And in this regard K.P. rule says that if 
the 7th cusp sub lord is the significator of houses of 2 or 7 or 11, we say that the marriage 
is promised for the said individual. 

Sometimes one may be denied of marriage in spite of the one’s willingness. In such cases we 
may have to check the connections to the negative houses of the event marriage that is 1, 6 
and 10. And the K.P. rule for denial of marriage says that- 


(1) If a planet is the significator of the 7th house and happens to be the strong and sole sig- 
nificator of 6th house, it will not give marriage. Even if marriage takes place in such condi- 
tions, the couple will not stay together. 

(2)if the 7th cusp sub lord is not at all connected with 2,7 or 11 houses either directly or 
through the stars of the significator and is connected with 1 or 6 or 10 houses- then the 
marriage may not take place at all and it is considered as marriage denial. 

With these above rules of K.P on marriage denial, I would like to discuss the chart of an in- 
dividual who is denied of marriage in spite of the native’s interest. 


Name — Miss Denial. DOB- 15 NOV 1969. TOB-9.46.40 P.M. 
POB-SALUR. (A.P). 


Analysis of the chart: 

7‘ cusp sub lord is Saturn+. No planet is deposited in Saturn’s stars and so Saturn signi- 
fies 7 house. 

Saturn is the lord of 7-8 and 9 placed in 10. It is in the star of Ketu and sub of Saturn. 

The star lord Ketu is placed in house 2. Ketu represents Sun and Mars. Sun is the lord of 3 
placed in 4, and Mars is the lord of 5 and 10 placed in 7. So the 7 cusp sub lord Saturn 
signifies 2, 7, 8, 9 and 10 at both levels. 


Hence as per K.P. rule the 7 cusp sub lord Saturn+ signifies 2-7 the relevant houses for 
marriage and we will be tempted to conclude that the native will be promised of the mar- 
riage. 

But the actual fact is that the native remained unmarried till date and also took to the path 
of spirituality. 

Then a doubt will arise in our mind as to why it is so and what are the factors that lead to 
negation of the fructification of the event marriage. 

The best and suitable answer for this could be found in the careful study of the K.P. system 
and its rules. 

Basically K.P. system is the K.P. Sub lord theory. 

In the words of Sri K.S.K. —....... therefore constellation lord shows whom or which matter 
it refers. But the deciding factor — good or bad and success or failure is shown by the SUB- 
LORD occupied by the significator”.( see K.P Reader III of 1971 edition- page 144 and page 
81 of K.P Reader VI) (See K.P ezine Sept 2014 issue).

References for consideration of the SUB—“when the majority of the planets are connected 
with the houses 2, 7 & 11- select the useful significator who agree with the ruling planets at 
the time of judgment. If a planet is in such a position that its sub lord is connected with the 
houses 2, 7 & 11, then the planet is useful. But if the SUBLORD is the lord of the negative 
houses 1, 6 & 10 and is the significator of 12 houses, then the marriage can not take 
place.” (K.P Reader IV page 118). 

“Hence the planet is the SOURCE, constellation indicates the nature of the result and SUB 
LORD is the deciding factor whether the matter is favorable or not.”- This is the ultimate 
rule of the K.P SUB LORD theory. 


Further it is said by Sri TIN WIN in his article on “DOUBLE ROLE OF THE SUB AS THE DE- 
CIDER AS WELL AS INDICATOR’ in our K.P E zine (Sep 2014 — page 10)-“as mentioned in 
the above points 8, 9, the star lord significator of 2, 7, or 11 does not mean favorable out- 
come of the marriage matter depending on the positive or negative significator of the SUB.” 
As a conclusive proof He said “ it is to consider the significator of a planet, whether a cusp 
sub lord or a D/B/A/S lord ata three step of a planet, its star and sub cautiously keeping 
in mind that the sub lord plays the double role of a decider in choosing fruit full significator 
as well as_ event indicator, which can make the event happen without the signification of 
the required houses by the planet and star lord.” 


Keeping in mind of the above rules, now let me look afresh at the significator of the 7 cusp 
sub lord Saturn in the given chart. 

The sub lord of the 7 cusp who is also Saturn+ strongly signifies 1 and 10 - negative hous- 
es for 2 and 11 and also signifies 12 another negative house by its 3rd aspect. From this 
negative signification of the sub lord, it has become clear as to why the event did not mate- 
rialize. Apart from this, Saturn+ is also the sub lord of the 2nd, 11th and 1st cusps (other 
relevant houses for marriage) and added their support to the negation of the individual’s 
matriage. 


When we look at the Dasa analysis the Dasa lords also did not cooperate. 

Dasa lord Rahu extends from Aug 1981 to Aug 1999(prime period for marriage). Rahu a 
separative planet is placed in 8 house. Rahu is in Saturn sign, Jupiter star and Mercury 
sub. The STL Jupiter signifies 6 and 4 and the SBL Mercury signifies 12 and 4. As such the 
Dasa lord Rahu at all levels did not cooperate to give the event and denied the marriage to 
the native. 


The next Dasa lord Jupiter extending from Aug1999 to Aug 2015 also will not cooperate. 
Jupiter is in the sign of Venus, Star of Mars and Sub of Mercury. STL Mars is the lord of 5 
and 10 in 7» and SBL Mercury is the lord of 12 in 4th. Hence the Dasa lord Jupiter even 
though at its star level (Mars) signifies 7 and 5, as its sub lord Mercury+ (decider of the 
event) signifies 4 and 12 and thus negates the marriage. Apart from this, the final Bukthi 
lord of Rahu in Jupiter Dasa which extends from March 2013 to August 2015 also strongly 
signifies negative houses only and thus it will not cooperate. 


How nice is the sub lord theory of K.P system which helps to unearth the secrets of the as- 
trological chart, when an important issue like marriage poses a problem of dilemma for an 
astrologer in answering it to an individual who comes with a fond hope. My head bows with 
all the regard at the feet of an astrology king Sri K. S. Krishnamurthy who propounded such 
a wonderful theory of K.P sub lord. My thanks to Sri Kanak ji for his unstinted support by 
publishing my articles in our esteemed magazine K.P E zine.

travel as follows: 


A. The houses which indicate Foreign Travel are 12, 3, 9. 12th house indicates foreign travel 
or living in a foreign country. 3™ house indicates change of place ie,12 to 4th house. 9th 
house indicates long journey and far off place.

settle down there permanently; he will not come back to his native country. 


E. If the 12: Cusp Sublord or its star lord is posited in dual or common sign, he will go 
there, stay there for some time and comes back to his native country and settles down 
finally.

Question - 1: Planet near the House Cusp 

Sir, In your series on KP For Beginners it is written that ORB for planet conjunction with a 
cusp is 3degrees 20 min and it was also said if the planet is behind the Cusp by lor 2de- 
grees and if in the next cusp if there is no planet(Vacant) then this planet will give the next 
Cusp results. What I understand is the ORB duration is taken as 3degrees 20min and in KP 
Reader-1,Guruji KSK has mentioned the ORB for conjunction of any planet with the cusp is 
8 degrees .Can you please explain this ? Can we take 8degrees as ORB? 


Answer -— 1: 

Regarding a planet near the house cusp, the KP had experienced the results of the next 
house when a planet is located very close to the next cusp, as given by the following two ex- 
amples: 


e As Moon @ 21° 30” Gemini is very near the 12th cusp, it indicates life in a foreign place, 
and Moon is considered as posited in the 12th house, although it is physically posited in 
11th house. (Krishnamurti Padhdhati Vol. 2, 1965, Sagar Publications, p 281) 

e Rahu @ Libra 13° 09” posited in 10th house physically but very near the 11th cusp @ 
15° 39” Libra within 2° 30”orb gives marriage, which is the result of 11th house, alt- 
hough Rahu is physically located in 10th house. (KP Reader IV, 1971 Edition, page 108) 

@ 

“If a planet within 1° or 2° behind the cusp of a house and no other planet in the following 

house, gains the significance of the following house, e.g. Jupiter gains significance of the 

6th house and loses signification of the 5th house where Jupiter actually located since 
there is no planet in the 6th house.” This is T. Rajendra Kumar’s experience found in “KP & 

Astrology Year Book 2000 & 2003 and The Times of Astrology”. 

The closer an orb is, the stronger the result will be. For instance, “a planet within 5° or 6° of 

the next cusp may signify the previous cusp. If the planet within 1° or 2°, having the same 

sub-lord of the next cusp, may signify the next cusp”. (K. Subramanium; Astrology for Be- 

ginner, Vol. 3) 

Please see different views compiled at the link below; 

https://groups.yahoo.com/neo/groups/k p_ system/conversations/messages/35987 


“For conjunction of Sun, Moon and other planets with the cusp of a house, an orb of 8 de- 
grees is to be uniformly applied.” (KP Reader I, page 116). This is a general statement of orb 
in explaining the Western aspects. 

According to Claudius Ptolemy (Tetrabiblos) and William Lilly (Christian Astrology), when a 
planet is within 5 degrees of the next cusp, the planet is supposed already in the next 
house. 

The 3° 20” is mostly applied orb in conjunction of a planet with the next house cusp.

The lord of a cusp is the lord of rasi where the cusp falls. In the above example chart, both 
the 5th and 6% cusps fall in Sagittarius rasi whose lord is Jupiter. So the lord of both the 5th 
and 6th cusps is Jupiter. The 7 cusp’s lord is Moon as this cusp falls in Cancer rasi. No 
cusp falls in Leo rasi, and so its lord Sun is not the lord of any cusp. The blank Leo sign 
without any cusp falling is called the intercepted sign. 

If a cusp starts in Aries @ 29° 30’ and ends in Taurus, the lord of the cusp is Mars. Because 
the cusp falls in Aries whose lord is Mars. Venus does not have lordship of the cusp as the 
cusp does not fall in Taurus whose lord is Venus. This is the result of applying the unequal 
Placidus house system. 

Three pillars of KP system are the Hindu zodiac, Western Placidus house system and 
Vimshottari dasa. Placidus house system had been applied because it was the most popular 
Western house system at the time when KP was invented as Placidus works. 

According to "Recent Advances in Natal Astrology", compiled by Geoffrey Dean, p 168, in the 
USA about 80% of individuals who seek help from astrologers show a preference for the sys- 
tem of Placidus. . .In addition, 90% of individuals who refer to online horoscopes prefer the 
system of Placidus. 

Regarding the polar charts, there are two views. As the system be applicable anywhere on 
Earth, Placidus is unsatisfactory, for example, at 70 N it is possible to have some houses 
spread across 3 or 4 signs while others are only 2-3 degree wide. The other accepts the 
shortcomings, as Davison has said, you can play many good tunes on a piano whose top is 
defective; hence Placidus is satisfactory. If one has a client out of about one million people 
living in polar regions, the Topocentric house system seems to provide a solution.

Question - 3: 

Sir, Please clarify my doubt. 

1. For example, in a horoscope of Makara lagna, the XIth & XJIth bhavas fallen in Dhanu 
rasi and Xth bhava fallen in Vrischika rasi. For a Chara lagna (Movable asc), XIth stana & 
its lord become badhaka stana & badhaka lord. In this example which is badhaka stana — 
XI th rasi or XIth bhava (Mars or Jupiter)? 

2. Ina horary chart, for a particular question to be fulfilled, the conditions are- the Sub 
Lord of the related house & its Star Lords are not to be in retrograde motion and the Sub 
Lord should be significator of at least any one of the concerned houses. Is this rule is appli- 
cable to Natal charts? If a particular question related Sub Lord or its Star Lord is retrograde 
in natal chart, what is the result? 


Answer - 3: 

The lord of a cusp is the lord of rasi where the cusp falls. Since the XIth & XIIth cusps fall 
in Dhanu rasi and Xth cusp falls in Vrischika rasi, the lord of both the XIth & XIIth cusps is 
Jupiter and Xth cusp’s lord is Mars. 


KP Ezine March 2015 52 


In a horoscope of Makara lagna, the XIth bhava and XIth lord Jupiter are Badhaka sthana. 
Retrogression rule is not applicable in natal charts. “In a Natal chart, do not worry whether 
a planet is in direct motion or retrograde. There is no difference.” (KP Reader VI, page 145)

Answer -— 4: 

KP goes with rationale. The planet is the source, the star nature of the result, and sub a de- 
ciding factor, according to the KP fundamental rule: 

"The planet is the source, constellation indicates nature of the result and the sub is a decid- 
ing factor whether the matter is favourable or not." 

(Krishnamurti Padhdhati, Vol. 2, 1966, Sagar Publications, p 41/ KP Reader III, p 136 / 
1971 Edition, p 129/ KP Reader V p 136, 1971 Edition p 129/ KP Reader VI p 91), 


The rationale of sub sub cannot be exapalined. However, if a cuspal sub lord is the same in 
the twin birth, the sub sub can be taken into consideration for differentiation of the nature 
of a matter.

Answer -— 6: 

The Hindu aspects (Drishtis) are counted ‘from rasi to rasi’, irrespective of the positions of 
the planets in the rasis and the relative distance between the two planets i.e. not ‘from de- 
gree to degree’ like in the Western aspects. Planets aspect the entire rasis with or without 
any planet or cusp there, and the closer an aspect on any located planet or cusp is, the 
stronger the result would be. All planets, Sun to Saturn, aspect the 7th (180°) from the rasi 
occupied by them. In addition, Saturn aspects the 3rd (60°) and 10th (270°) from the rasi 
occupied by it. 


The Western aspects are counted ‘from degree to degree’, not from rasi to rasi as in the 
Hindus aspects. There are five basic, most important aspects, used by Ptolemy: 

1) Conjunction, O° 

2) Sextile, 60° 

3) Square, 90° 

4) Trine, 120° 

5) Opposition, 180° 


In the given chart, from Aries rasi @ 23° 28’ 10” Saturn aspects Gemini rasi (also 46 cusp 
located there) by 3™4 Hindu aspect, Libra rasi (also 8 cusp and Jupiter located there) by 7‘ 
Hindu aspect, and Capricorn rasi (also 11 cusp located there) by 10% Hindu aspect. But 
Saturn does not aspect 4 cusp, 8 cusp and Jupiter, and 11 cusp by 3° 20' orb. 

Saturn does not aspect Aquarius rasi (also Moon located there @ O° 48’ 35”) at all. In other 
words, Saturn does not throw Hindu aspect on Moon without orb or by 3° 20' orb. 

That is why KPAstro 4.1 does not show Saturn’s aspect on Moon by 3° 20’ orb. 


In providing the 4-step primary significators, KPAstro 4.1 applies the Hindu aspect with orb 
as done in the book of 4-step lecture notes. 


It is to note that there are two kinds of aspects only, namely Hindu aspects without orb and 


Western aspect with orb. The 4-step method applies Hindu aspects with orb, generally 3° 
20’ orb.

Answer -8: 
7h (Wife or Husband, Legal Tie) CSL for Marriage, Separation, Divorce and Second 
Marriage 


According to KP Reader IV: Marriage, Married Life & Children, marriage, separation, di- 
vorce (pages 191-198) and second marriage are to be judged by 7 cuspal sub lord. If the 
sub-lord of the 7 cusp is a significator of house 7 or 2 or 11, marriage is promised. 

(KP Reader IV, 1971 Edition, page 121) “If the significators of 2,7,11 houses happen to be 
the significators of 1,6 or 10, then separation will surely happen and it may lead to di- 
vorce. (page 192). Divorce is to be seen from one, six and ten... If the sub-lord of 7‘ is in 
any manner connected with a dual sign or a, second marriage is shown. (page 153) 
Separation: Judge houses 1,6,10 and 12. (page 146) 


For married life, planets connected with 6, i.e. significators of 6 house, bring about sep- 
aration due to partner’s walking out or desertion. 124 house significators denote that the 
native will seek separation. (page 154) 

If one wants to marry, judge the significators of 2,7 and 11; if he wants a divorce, then the 
significators of the houses 6,10,12,8 will finalize the divorce. (KP Reader V, page 178/ 
1971 Edition page 168) 


“Husband to return home and to join the wife one is to judge the houses 11, 7 and 6. For 
separation 12,7 and 6.” (KP Reader VI, page 250) 


If the sub-lord of the 7“ cusp be connected with 2,7 or 11 and 1,6 or 10, the marriage

takes place during the joint period of the significators of 2,7 and 11... If the native be mar- 
ried already, then during the joint period of the significators of 1,6 and 10, there is possi- 
bility of separation in married life; it also denotes divorce. (Chandrakant R. Bhatt: Further 
Lights on Nakshatra Chintamani, pages 147-150 with a solved practical example) 


If the 7 cuspal sub lord is connected with houses 2,7,6,12, it indicates separation after 
marriage. (M.P. Shanmugam: Astrosecrets & K.P. Part 1, Krishman & Co., 2003, page 179) 


Divorce: If the sublord of the 7 cusp is connected with house 1 or 6 or 10 and it happens 
to be Jupiter, there will be legal secretion. (PVK Punneswara Rao: Theory and Practice of 
Stellar Astrology (K.P. System), Universal Astrological Book Trust, 2008, page 69) 


If 7» cuspal sub lord is connected with 6,10,12 houses, then divorce is indicated. (Sharad 
C. Joshi: Krishnamurti Padhdhati, 2000, page 73) 


11th (Permanent Tie of Friendship) CSL for Happy or Unhappy Married Life

This Upanakshatra Jyothisha is one more book from the collection series of refreshing old 
articles compiled by K. Hariharan, which contains 40 articles, as shown in the contents. 


In most of the articles, the ruling planets have been used extensively, and it is said, 
‘According to KP, the ruling planets at birth rule again at the time of death and also at each 
and every event of life.' (page 155) 


Proper consideration of a planet (cuspal sub lord or dasa period lord), it's star and sub is 
found in some articles as follow: 

‘Summing up, it is advisable to predict after analyzing the star and sub positions etc. of the 
planets as well as of the cusps of the horoscope.' (page 88) 

‘Sub lord of 10th cusp is Mercury. (Mercury's) star lord is Moon and sub lord is 
Jupiter.’ (page 137) 

‘Venus Dasa, star lord is Kethu and sub lord is Jupiter which is analyzed in above.' (page 
138) 


However, the sub lord of planet is not considered. 'Here the sub lord of the 6th cusp is 
Jupiter... Now Jupiter is posited in Venus star.' (page 254) The cuspal sub lord Jupiter's 
sub is not taken into consideration. 


KP Ezine March 2015 60 


Moreover, in checking whether the concerned matter is promised or not, the cusp co-rulers, 
star and sub lords of the cusp are considered but the cuspal sub lord, its star and sub are 
not considered. 

'The 11th cusp is governed by Jupiter and Mercury as star lord and sub lord of the 
cusp.’ (page 71) Only the cusp co-rulers Jupiter and Mercury are considered. In order to 
check whether the concerned matter is promised or not, the 11th cuspal sub lord Mercury 
as a planet, it's star and sub are to be considered. Similarly 'Interview is governed by the 
3rd cusp. 3rd cusp is governed by Jupiter and Mercury as star and sub lords.' (page 72) The 
3™d cuspal sub lord Mercury, its star and sub are to be considered in order to check whether 
success in interview is promised or not. 


The sub’s star is considered like in 4-step theory. ‘Sub lord of Lagna is Venus in the star 
and sub of Saturn, occupant of Bhadhaka sthana. Sub lord Saturn in the star of Ketu 
placed in 6%...’ (page 208) 

For married life the 11t* cuspal sub lord is checked. ‘No doubt, the 7 house represents 
marital relationship; yet for permanence of relationship and harmony one has to examine 
the sub lord of 11 cusp, as it is the 11 house that represents permanent relationship and 
harmony. (Vide page 151 of May 1971 edition of K.P. Reader IV) (page 225). “In horary 
astrology, if the sub lord of the 11 cusp is a significator of houses 1,5,7 or 11, perfect 
hamony and happy life is indicated. (page 266) 


The following points are food for thought and for your information: 


‘In the male chart under discussion, we have to confirm that the sub lord of 5 cusp isa 
significator of 2,5 and 11 and that the sub lord of the 11 cusp is a significator of 8,11 and 
5. (page 217) 8,11 and 5 are 2,5 and 11 for wife. 


‘In my opinion the Ascendant is the house which brings all-round success to the querent 
and as such the Ascendant should not be considered as a house of negation to the 24 
house.’ (page 143) 


‘There is a provision whereby an astrologer can entertain a question from a person whos 
has a strong urge to know even about anyone, person or organization not directly connected 
with the questioner. The question in such a case is, as it were, that from the concerned 
person himself for the purpose of assigning Lagna.In this case I had the urge. I took out the 
number 181. The resultant Lagna Sagittarius 20-06-40, represented NTR.’ 


'A planet in a constellation gives the result indicated by the lord of the constellation in its 
Dasa (i.e. tenant planet’s Dasa) in the Bhukti of lord of constellation. Conversely, when the 
Dasa of a planet is on; planets in the constellation or on the sub of the Dsa lord can give the 
result.’ As such , Rahu in the constellation of Venus will give the result in Venus Dasa and 
Rahu Bhukti.’ (page 279) 


Grade 'E' significator: ‘planets associated with and aspected by the above (grade A,B,C & D) 
significators, especially the star lords of the cusps.’ (page 237) 


In Western astrology, the square aspect has been considered as unfavorable by most of the 
authorities... The square aspect has been found to excite the events in almost all cases.

cusp of a boy at birth and vice-versa also, then only the marriage will take place 
among them.

lord).

as the Day lord of the girl’s Ruling Planets. Venus holds the constellation lordship of the 7 
cusp of the boy. It’s co-rulers are Jupiter/Mercury/Saturn. These three Planets are 
reflecting in the Ruling Planets of the girl as Moon Sign lord (Jupiter), Moon star lord

lord respectively. The Ruling Planets of the boy at birth are Rahu (Lagna Star lord), Mercury 
(Lagna Sign lord), Sun (Moon Star lord), Saturn (Moon Sign lord) and Saturn as Day lord.

Sign lord/Star lord/Sub lord in the girl’s chart. The girl’s Moon star lord (Mercury) is reflect- 
ing as the Sign lord of the Lagna of the boy i.e. Gemini is the Ascendant of the boy. 


These two were married.

Child birth 


2nd house denotes increase in the number of the members of family due to birth of a child. 
5th house considered for child birth. It indicates first conception or pregnancy, progeny or 
child. 

8th house signify sexual urge. 10ts house indicates achievement of any undertakings. Being 
10 from 8 js 5t house which indicates result of sex. Thus 5th house stands for child or 
child birth. 

11t house indicates fulfillment of desire. 

11th js 5th from 7. The 5th for female and 11 for male is important. Thus, in a female chart 
5th cuspal sublord is the guide and in a male chart 11 cuspal sublord is the guide for child 
birth. 


Hints: 

Consider the houses 2, 5 and 11 for child birth. Cancer, Scorpio and Pieces are the fruitful 
signs and important for assessment for child birth matters. Jupiter is the natural significa- 
tor (Karaka) of child birth. 


Considerer the houses 1, 4 and 10 for absence of children or for separation from children 
(being 12th from 2, 5 and 11 respectively). Aries, Gemini, Leo and Virgo are the barren 
signs. Saturn and Ketu are the natural malefic planets for child birth. 


In a female chart, 


e If the cuspal sublord (CSL) of 5 signifies 2, 5 or 11 and/or in connection with 2, 5 or 11 
& fruitful sign; 

e If the cuspal sublord of 5 is posited in 7 house without any connection with 2 or 5 or 
11, the no child birth is promised at all; 

e If the cuspal sublord of 5th be signifies 1 or 4 or 10 without any connection with 2 or 5 or 
11, the no child birth is promised at all. 

e If the 5t cuspal sublord as a planet and through its starlord does not signify 2 or 5 or 
11, then for child birth, 5+ cuspal sublord must be posited in sub of that planet who is the 
significator of 2 or 5 or 11 and in connection with fruitful sign.

Behavior of Nodes as described in KP literature 


1. Astrology for Beginners, Vol 5, page 668 (Sri K. Subramanium) 
"The role played by Rahu and Kethu has to be carefully assessed." 


2.1. Ibid - page 669 


"In the event of there being a planet in the star of the sign Lord of Rahu or Kethu, please see 
who is the star lord of the sign lord and in that case, Rahu/Kethu will signify the house oc- 
cupied by the sign lord, the house occupied by the star lord of the sign lord and the houses 
owned by the star lord of the sign (provided there are no planets in the houses owned by the 
star lord of the sign lord. That is how you have to proceed when Nodes are concerned.)" 


2.2 Ibid - page 669 


"Nodes also will give the effects of the planets with whom they are conjoined or by whom 
they are aspected. This should also be taken into account, assessing the roles of the nodes." 


. KP Reader III, 1984, Part I, page 123 


3 
1. Rahu & Kethu indicates the results of planet which they are conjoined. 
2. If no planet in conjunction, the results of planets aspecting them. 

3. If neither conjoined nor aspected, the results of the Star lord. 
4. Lastly the result of the sign. 


4. Nakshatra Chintamani, Sri C.R. Bhatt, pages 18 & 19 


" Rahu or Kethu is not allotted the ownership of any sign. It only occupies the sign in a 
house. So Rahu or Kethu works as an agent or representative of; 

(a) The planet with whom it is in conj. or aspected 

(b) The owner of the sign in which it is placed." 

And also Sri Bhatt has elaborated the same as in above No. 3. 


5. Sub Lord Speaks - 1, by K.M. Subramanian, page 23 
"As node is in own star or sub, Rahu attains the full significaton of its Rasi Lord" 


General Rule 


Ffor Rahu/Ketu, the results of the followings are taken in the KP Readers depending 
on relevance to the matter under consideration regardless of their sequence of order: 


1) House occupied, 

2) Planet in conjunction, 
3) Planet in aspect and 
4) Star lord, 

5) Sign lord.
