Question- 1: Logic Behind Sequence and Allotted Years of Planets in Vimshottari Dasa 
In Vimshottari dasa system applied in astrology, different time periods are assigned to 
planets, like Venus 20 years, Sun 6 years etc. 

What is the logic in this allotment? 


Answer - 1: 

Sage Parashara’s Saying 

Regarding Vimshottari dasa system, Maharishi Parashara said in his Brihat Parashara Hora 
Shastra, Vol. II, trans. R. Santhanam, Ranjan Publications, 1984, Ch 46 v12-15, p 507: 


"In Kali Yuga the natural life span of a human being is generally taken as 120 years. 
Therefore, Vimshottari Dasa is considered to be the most appropriate and the best of all. " 


"Beginning from Krittika the lords of Dasas (periods) are the Sun, the Moon, Mars, Rahu, 
Jupiter. Saturn, Mercury, Ketu and Venus in that order." 


"The periods of Dasas of the Sun, the Moon, Mars, Rahu, Jupiter, Saturn, Mercury. Ketu 
and Venus are 6, 10, 7, 18, 16, 19, 11, 7 and 20 in that order." 


Earlier Attempts to Solve Mysteries 

The sequence and allotted years for planets in the Vimshottari dasa system are so 
mysterious that in earlier attempts of Dr. Kar of the Sub Sub theory and Krushna of KAS 
system, the approach in explaining the years allotted to planets is not consistently the same 
for all planets. 


References: 

1)Dr. Keshub Ranjan Kar's last research article on “Years allocated to each planet in 
Vimshottari Dasha” in the “KP & Astrology Year Book 2004” before he passed away: 

http: roups.yahoo.com rou k system/files/Articles 


vimshottari_dasha_period_dr_Kar.zip 


1) Krushna’s article: Article no 194. Vimshottari Dasa — Logic, Krushna, India 
http: //www.saptarishisastrology.com/articles archive vol9.php (link to article) 


One More Attempt 


Mysteries Not Yet Solved 

1. The rationale of sequence and allotted years of planets in Vimshottari dasa are not found 
explained clearly in the following article: 

“Vimshottari Maha Dasa Secret Code Revealed” 

http: //www.starteller.com/article4.html 

http: //www.kpastrologeronline.com/published-articles 


KP Ezine April 2015 50 


Not First Attempt 

2. This is not the first time attempt to solve the mysteries of sequence and years allotted of 
planets in the Vimshottari dasa system since there are at least two earlier attempts as 
mentioned above. 


Total 120 Years of Vimshotarri Dasa 
3. The total 120 years of Vimshotarri dasa is the natural life span of a human being as 
clearly said by Sage Prashara. 


4. So the 120 year Vimshottari dasa may not be applicable for the nation charts whose life 
can be more than one circle of 120 years like USA. 


5. In the case of event charts like oath taking charts of presidents, prime ministers, chief 
ministers for 4 or 5 year term, launching space mission for a particular period, annual 
chart or Hindu new year chart for one year, the relevant 4 or 5 year, particular period or 
one year compressed Vimshottari dasa is to be applied. 


Years Alloted to Planets 

6. The years allotted to planets [in the order of Sun (6 yrs) - Moon(10 yrs) - Mars (7 yrs) - 
Rahu (18 yrs) - Jupiter (16 yrs)- Saturn (19 yrs) - Mercury (17 yrs) — Ketu (7 yrs) - Venus 
(2Oyrs)] equal to 4 times of “Angulamsha” figures assigned to planets in Singhalese (Sri 
Lankan) “Samudrik Shastra and Angalakshana” vs 1/4 of planetary years in Vimshottari 
dasa system equal to “Angulamsha” figures in Singhalese “Samudrik Shastra and 
Angalakshana” don't explain the rationale of years allotted to planets in both this 
Singhalese Shastra and Vimshottari dasa. And Singhalese Shastra is without evidence of 
original manuscript to believe to be the foundation of Sage Prashara's Vimshottari dasa. 


Sequence of Dasa Planets 


Solar System 
7. Moving along the Zodiac, beginning with Sun, next is Mercury, next Venus, then Earth 
along with Moon, Rahu and Ketu; next to Earth is Mars, next is Jupiter, then Saturn. 


8. Such taking Rahu (18 years), Mars (7 years), Saturn (19 years) and Jupiter (16 years) to 
make a total of 60 years - one half of Vimshottari dasa - in the outer zone of the Earth and 
similarly, the other group headed by Ketu (7 years), Venus (20 years), Sun (6 years), Moon 
(10 years) and Mercury (17 years) to make a total of 60 years - the other half of 
Vimshottari dasa- in the inner zone of Earth, and two groups together making the 120 
years of Vimshottari dasa, doesn’t explain the rationale of sequence of dasa planets Mars, 
Rahu, Jupiter and Saturn in the outer zone and also Mercury, Ketu, Venus, Sun and Moon 
in the inner zone according to: 


1) distance from Sun, i.e. Sun, Mercury, Venus, Moon and Ketu in the inner zone, and 
then Rahu, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn in the outer zone; or 


1) speeds of planets from the fastest graha to the slowest graham, i.e. Sun (59.1 m 
per day), Moon (13 d 10.6 m per day), Mercury (59.1 m per day, Ketu (3.1 m per day) 


and Venus (59.1 m per day) in the inner zone, and then Mars (31.4 m per day), Jupiter 
(5 m per day), Ketu (3.1 m per day) and Saturn (2 m per day) in the outer zone.

10. So the sequence of dasa planets, Sun (59.1 m per day)- Moon (13 d 10.6 m per day)- 
Mars (31.4 m per day) — Rahu (3.1 m per day)- Jupiter (5 m per day)- Saturn (2 m per day)- 
Mercury (59.1 m per day)- Ketu (3.1 m per day) - Venus (59.1 m per day) in the Vimshot- 
tari dasa system is not according to the natural flow of the planetary sequence from 


the fastest planet to the slowest planet. 


11. No rationale can be found to put Ketu - which is along Moon- before Venus stationed 
before Moon, and to put Rahu - which is also along Moon - after Mars stationed after Moon 


KP Ezine April 2015 52 


in the solar system in order to make two groups of inner and outer planets of 60 years each. 


Quantitative Values of Dasa Periods 

12. Whether the rationale of sequence and allotted years of planets in the Vimshottari dasa 
is known or unknown, the timing of the dasa periods is changing quantitatively depending 
on: 

1) starting dasa from Moon or Ascendant, 

2) 360 days per year or 365 days per year applied, and 

3) ayanamsa used. 


13. Results of prediction are not related to known or unknown knowledge of sequence and 
allotted years of planets in the Vimshottari dasa. The interpretation of dasa period lords 
may be different depending on the system used, Vedic, KP, KB, KCIL, Sub sub theory, SA, 
KAS etc. 


Time Tested Vimshottari Dasa 

14. Without knowing the rationale of sequence and allotted years of planets, the Vimshotta- 
ri dasa is the most commonly used dasa for timing of events as foreseen by Sage Parashara 
because it is time tested really working dasa. 


Question- 2: Rasi Chart and House Cusp Chart 

In the “Astrology and Athrishta” 1964 Oct. issue, Guruji KSK has given very valuable 
information and made it easy to know the strength of the horoscope at a glance. 

Here he has referred “Occupation” of planet for many results. 


My confusion is “ Should we take Sign for occupation of planet or Cusp-House for 
occupation °?” 


Example : 

If Jupiter as lord of 12 occupies lagna , Jupiter will not help Lagna results. 

Though Jupiter is in lagna sign, all possibility is there of his occupation of 12th-H. 
Similarly lagna lord’s occupation of 6, or 8 or 12 means 6,8,12 signs or Cusp-Houses (in KP 
system , for many results we consider Cusp-House ) 


Please help me in this regard. 


Answer -— 2: 

Rasi Chart and House Cusp Chart 

As shown in the attached example chart of horary no. 237, the South Indian ‘rasi chart’ 
gives the relative rasi positions with boundary lines of ‘rasi after rasi’ of Hindu zodiac for 
correct use of rasi-based Hindu aspects. By inserting the Placidus cusps and placing the 
planets in the Placidus houses, the house-based chart denotes the correct occupation and 
lordship of planets in finding significators. 


For “occupation” of a planet, Placidus cusp house should be taken: 

In this example chart, the 12 house starts from 12th cusp @Aquarius 4:59:26 and ends at 
1st cusp @Pisces 11:00; 1st house starts from 1st cusp @Pisces 11:00 and ends at 254 cusp 
@Aries 

15:49:56; 2™¢ house is from 2™4 cusp @Aries 15:49:56 to 34 cusp @ Taurus 14:20:17 and so 
on. 


Fortuna @Pisces 00:39:55 is in the Lagna rasi but in the 12 house between 12‘ cusp and 


1st cusp. Rahu @Pisces 16:10:38 is also in the Lagna rasi, but in the 1st house between 1st 
cusp and 2™ cusp. 


KP Ezine April 2015 53 


For “lordship” of a house, the lord of the rasi where the cusp falls should be taken: 
In this example chart, 1st cusp falls in Pisces rasi and so this rasi lord Jupiter is Lagna lord, 
which occupies 8 house; similarly 24 lord is Mars and 34 lord Venus. 


6th cusp falls in Leo rasi, and so this rasi lord Sun is the lord of 6 house; similarly 8 lord 
is Venus and 12‘ lord Saturn.

In KP Take always Lagna alone! 

“Is Lagna strong or Moon sign strong?” article in “Astrology and Athrishta” 1964 Oct. issue 
pages 36-39 was written at the early stage of KP evolution. This approach is no more in 
practice of KP. 


In the “Krishnamurti Padhdhati, Vol. 2, 1966, Sagar Publications”, in some examples like in 
pp 82, 118, 255, 261-2, 264, 313, 316, it was ascertained “whether Lagna is strong or the 
Moon sign”, and the Moon sign was taken as the first house in the two examples of pp 118 
and 264. 


But the further research reveals the correct approach is “to take always Lagna alone”, 
and the correction was made by Guruji KSK in the KP Reader III as quoted below: 


KP Reader III, pp 243-4/ 1971 Edition, Practical Part, p 85 

Disposal of a House A building is indicated by the 4th house counted from Lagna. Always 
count from the Lagna. Never consider whether Moon sign is strong or Lagna is strong. In 
the research after 1967 it was found that we have to take always Lagna alone. We 
should never Judge which is stronger whether Moon sign or Lagna. The main reason is that 
in a twin birth, only the cusps of the house including the ascendant change whereas Moon 
is in the same position. What we had been following in KP printed in 1966, is to be give 


up. 


KP Reader III, pp 432-3/ 1971 Edition, Practical Part, p 259 
Why Lagna alone is considered? 


Dear Sir, 


I find in your Magazine, that since a couple of years, you are not suggesting that the Moon 
sign should be taken in case the lagna is afflicted and Moon sign is not. Why? 


KP Ezine April 2015 54 


Answer: Sir, I had been following the above method of taking the unafflicted ascendant or 
Moon sign, in case the lagna is afflicted and Moon sign is not. But in my research only in 
1965 end, I understood that when twins are born, Moon does not move a single minute, 
whereas the lagna alone moves and when the research on the sub-lord, came out 
successful to read out the diametrically opposite results among the twins, I have given up 
the idea of taking Moon sign, in case lagna is afflicted. It needed reconsideration. So, we 
must, whether lagna is afflicted or not, take only the exact position of lagna. If the lagna is 
afflicted, then the horoscope has certain defect, and simply because there is that defect, we 
should not jump to Moon sign which is auspicious. After having found out this, I have 
stopped writing in the above manner, mentioned by you. Therefore, I request all the 


readers to take only the lagna and never the Moon sign, whether the lagna is afflicted 
or not.

This is one more mundane astrology book wotien by Incian astrologer, after other already 
reviewed mundane astrology books in this magazine, i.e. Practical Mundane Astrology, by J 
C Luthra, Sagar Publications, 1990; Time Tested Techniques of Mundane Astrology, by M.S. 
Mehta, A. Radhika, guide KN Rao, Vani Publications, 2009; and Mundane Astrology (A Book 
For Astrologers), by K.B. Gopalakrishnan, Sagar Publications, 2009. 


The first part of this book covers the theoretical aspect of methods of mundane astrology in 
general and the signification of mundane houses and the nature and signification of planets 
in details. It also includes case studies of seven leading nations, China, Germany, India, 
Japan, Russia, United Kingdom and United States of America. 


In the case studies, the past events like the 1962 Sino-India war, the 1971 Indo-Pakistan 
war and 1991 economic liberalization are discussed on the basis of India Independence 
chart, India Republic chart and P.V. Narasimha Rao's chart in the case of India by using 
transit charts on the day of events. The Book of World Horoscopes by Nicholas Campion 
with its exhaustive work regarding the birth time and dates of nations helped the author to 
perform astrological interpretations and observe whether a nation's date of birth alone was 
enough to make accurate predictions or to enhance the understanding of past events. 
(Preface, p 7) According to the author, a study of P.V. Narasimha Rao's chart shows that the 
country’s chart has an overpowering effect on the ruler’s chart. (p 146) 


The second part of this book covers calculated birth charts of all 202 nations of the world in 


KP Ezine April 2015 59 


three formats - South Indian, North Indian and Western to make prediction for any country 
of the world. The chart details, birth date, birth time and birth place are also provided for 
own calculation and study. 


Although the author has studied past events to test the methodology, future predictions are 
beyond the scope of this book. He leaves that task to the many able astrologers who could 
use the Inclusive Methodology to arrive at predictions in the modern world. (Preface, p 7) 
However any effective methodology for mundane prediction other than analysis of planetary 
transits cannot be found clearly demonstrated in this book.

This is the 1004 issue of KP-Ezine! How time flies! Since the publication of the first 
issue in February 2007, the magazine has been steadily growing in terms of the 
number of subscribers. As of last count, there are over 4000 readers in 63 
countries! That is an amazing figure for an Ezine dedicated solely to the 
Krishnamurti Padhdhati system of astrology. The credit goes to Shri. Kanak 
Bosmia, Shri. Tin Win and the article contributors. 


Astrology is part science and part art. Since the time of our Guruji Shri. KSK, 
many stalwarts have put in their best to elucidate and elaborate on the KP system 
to make it easier to understand and follow. Many books and articles have been 
published. KP Ezine continues this tradition by publishing quality and 
thought-provoking articles on various dimensions of KP. It is a great platform for 
beginner as well as experienced astrologers to share their ideas. 


The most remarkable aspect of the KP Ezine is that it is free! Even though it is not 
printed on paper (and hence printing and distribution costs are eliminated), it 
nevertheless requires several person-hours to edit, format and render in the final 
PDF form. This is possible only when the editorial team is highly motivated. To say 
that both Shri. Kanak Bosmia and Shri. Tin Win are quite passionate and highly 
dedicated in carrying on this work is stating the obvious. 


I have a humble suggestion. If it is possible to re-publish some of the articles by 
eminent students of Shri. KSK from the back issues of Astrology & Athrishta, that 
would be an eye opener for people starting in KP. Some names that I recall are 
N.Krishnamurty, S.Balasundaram and M.G.G. Nayar. Of course, this must be 
done without violating any copyright laws. 


My hearty congratulations to the entire team — both editorial and contributors — for 
their excellent service to KP system! I pray to the Almighty to give them the 
strength and energy to continue this work for another 100 issues!! 


With warm regards, 


K.Rangarajan 
May 1, 2015

The power of musical vibrations connects in some manner all things and all beings and all 
beings in the universe on all plants of existence. The human body has 72,000 astral nerves 
(Nadis) which incessantly vibrate in a specific rhythmic pattern. Disturbance in their rhythmic 
vibration is the root cause of disease. The musical notes restore their normal rhythm, there by 
bringing about good health. 


Now coming to the Sapta swarms of Sa Re Ga Ma Pa Dha (Suddha) Ni (Kaisika) plus 5 addi- 
tional second swaras of Re (Chatusruthi) Ga (Antara) Ma (Prati) Dha (Chatusruthi) Ni (Kakali) 
are added which comes to total 12 signs. Wherein Sun and Moon have got each one swara 
and one sign in the zodiac and other 5 planets Budha, Sukra, Kuja, Gujru & Sani have got 
two Swarms each has created the total swarms which forms part of different Ragas in the 
Classical Music. Hence as per Vedic texts there is a nexus between the Music and Zodiacal 
signs as depicted hereunder. Thus we can correlate music to astrology. In Astrology each 
Ascendant has got certain planets are helping and some are detrimental hence by identifying 
these swarms we can identify which classical Raga would help each Ascendant in getting 
good health and moods. 

In this connection a great stalwart in Carnatic Veena Music Sri Ayyagari Syamasunder who 
retired as Principal of Ghantasal Musical & Dance College Vijayawada has kindly consented 
to share his knowledge of Carnatic Classical Music for our Medical Astrology write ups. Cen- 
tral Sangeet Natak Akademi awardee 2011, "Mahathi Kalanidhi” Sri Ayyagari Syama 
Sundaram, is an exponent and highly reputed professional Veena Vidwan of Andhra Pradesh, 
learnt Vocal from "Sangeetha Kalanidhi’ Sri Nedunuri Krishna Murthy garu. Best Veena per- 
formance award from the prestigious Madras Music Academy & Krishna Gana Sabha 1978 
& 79, Ugadi Puraskaram conferred by the Government of Andhra Pradesh 2011, and The 
Visishta Prathibha Puraskar bestowed by the Telugu University of Andhra Pradesh 2011. He 
is an Asthana Vidwan of Kanchi Kamakoti Peetham of Tamilnadu. Sri Ayyagari Sya- 
masundaram received The Prestigious Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2011 for his contribu- 
tion to Carnatic Instrumental Music.

"Music is extremely therapeutic. It has a direct positive relationship with the mind. Any 
ailment connected with the mind like, dementia, depression, insomnia, mania, negative 
emotions, neurosis, pain, restlessness, stress and neurosis can be managed with music. It 
is the perfect therapy for the sick mind," says T.V.Sairam.IRS (T.V.Sairam, Mumbai’s 
Commissioner of Central Excise) 

Sairam’s 10-Point Music Therapy 

Listen with your heart and not just your mind. 

Enjoy music. Don’t analyze it. 

Listen to good music for about 15 minutes four times a day. 

Make driving, eating, bathing or cooking more enjoyable with music. 

Never listen to music on an empty stomach. 

Actual singing or playing a raga is preferable to passive listening. 

Learn to play a musical instrument. 

Get children into the habit of listening to music. 

Always have gentle, soothing music playing around a sick person. 

Have a good music library at home. 


Music can play an effective role in helping us lead better, fruitful lives. Listening to specific 
kinds of music at specific times of the day has been shown to be helpful in maintaining 
good health. Indian music, with its many Ragas, is known to be particularly therapeutic 
value. The curative power of music emanates from the resonance of certain ragas on hormo- 
nal and glandular functions which produce secretions that keep the body balanced and in- 
fection free. (Sairam T V 2007 Self- Music Therapy, Chennai: Nada Centre for Music Therapy.) 
Music therapy is a scientific method of effective cures of disease through the power of mu- 
sic. It restores, maintains and improves emotional, physiological and psychological well be- 
ing. The articulation, pitch, tone and specific arrangement of swars (notes) in a particular 
raga stimulates, alleviates and cures various ailments inducing electro magnetic change 
in the body. 

Music therapy has long history dating back to ancient Orphic school in Greece. Pythag- 
orus, Plato and Aristotle, all were aware of the prophylactic and therapeutic powers of mu- 
sic. Even the old testament mentions music therapy where King David is said to have 
cured an illness by playing on the harp. Hippocrates, the father of modern medicine, 
used music to cure human diseases. In ancient Egypt music was used to lessen the 
pain of women during childbirth. Sina, a famous Arabic writer, has written in detail on this 
subject. In India legend has it that Thyagaraja, the famous musician of South India, 


KP Ezine May 2015 13 


brought a dead person back to life by singing the composition Naa Jeevan Dhara_in 
Raga _ Bihari. 

In 1729 Richard Browne, a physician wrote the famous text Medicina Musica which 
describes the use of music as medicine.

‘HE DEVELOPMENT OF CONTEMPORARY USES FOR MUSIC in therapy is gen- 
erally attributed to the twentieth century or even the late ninteenth 
century; however, a text on the subject was published in 1729. The book, 
Medicina Musica, or, a Mechanical Essay on the Effects of Singing, Musick, and 
Dancing on Human Bodies (London: Printed for John Cooke, Bookseller in 
Uppingham; and Sold by J- and J. Knapton, at the Crown in St. Paul's 
Church, 1729), was written by Richard Browne, an apothecary in Oakham 
in the County of Rutland. When the book was printed, London was a city 
of slightly fewer than one million people, King George II was in his sec- 
ond year of reign, and the first performance of John Gay’s Beggar's Opera 
was only one year old. Handel, who had arrived in London seventeen 
years earlier, was in mid-career and had not yet written his monumental 
Messiah (1'741—42). 


Dr. Burnell has mentioned a manuscript named Raga Chikistsa in the collections of 
Saraswati Mahal Library in Tanjore which deals with the various ragas that can be 
used for curing various ailments. Whatis music ? "Music is a kind of inarticulate, 
unfathomable speech which leads us to the edge of the infinite and lets us for a 


moment gaze in that" observed Carlyle. Music is basically a sound or nada generating 


particular vibrations which moves through the medium of ether present in the atmos- 
phere and effects the human body. Sarangdev mentions in his Sangeet Ratnakar that 


ahata nada or music is always produced by striking or aghata by a living being on 
an instrument of any kind So music is a power or universal energy in the form of 
ragas. 

Matanga (9-10th centurey AD) was the earliest writer to define raga. According to him 
"raga is that kind of sound composition consisting of melodic movements which has the 
effect of coloring the hearts of men." "There are four sources of raga: folk songs, poet- 
ry, devotional songs of mystics and compositions of classical musicians. While harmony is 
the characteristic of Western music, Indian music is pure melody. The general term for 
melody in india is raga or ragini." 

Symphonies of raga have a definite soothing effect on the mind as well as on the 
body. Repeated listening to the particular raga being chosen for a particular disease 
produces _a_network of sound vibration. The muscles, nerves and the chakras of the 
affected part are contracted when one impulse is given and relaxed during the in- 


terval between two impulses. 
Thus, during contraction of the tissue, musical notes make the blood flow out from 


that particular area and inthe interval there is relaxation and a state of reduced 
pressure is produced in these areas. Thus the blood from the adjacent area will 
flow there. This process is repeated again and again and the blood flow and energy 
flow in that part is enhanced. This makes quick, fast healing. Energy from URF 
(universal energy field) to HEF (human energy field) transmitted by the strokes of the 
different tones of raga affects the CNS (Central nervous system) because the roots of the 
auditory nerves are more widely distributed and have more connections than any 


KP Ezine May 2015 14 


other nerves in the body. Music beats have a very close relationship with heart 
beats. Music having 70-75 beats per minute equivalent to the normal heart beat of 
72 has a very soothing effect. Likewise rhythms which are slower than 72 beats per 
minute create a positive suspense on the mind and body since the mind body com- 
plex anticipates that the music will speed up and this restored vital energy gives a deep 
relaxation to the body. Rhythms which are faster than the heart rate excite and reju- 
venate the body. Hindustani/Classical musical considers ragas as depicting specific 
moods. An appropriate mood is to be evoked in the listener's mind before initiating the mu- 
sical treatment. 


Kafi Raga evokes a humid, cool, soothing and deep mood while Raga Pooriya Dhansari 
evokes sweet, deep, heavy, cloudy and stable state of mind. Raga Mishra Mand has a 
very pleasing refreshing light and sweet touch while Bagashwri arouses a feeling of 
darkness, stability, depths and calmness. 

Music is considered the best tranquillizer in modern days of anxiety, tension and 
high blood pressure. Raga Darbari is considered very effective in easing tension. itis 
a late night raga composed by Tansen for Akbar to relieve his tension after hectic 
schedule of the daily court life. This raga belongs to Asavari That and is a complete 
raga containing all the seven notes. The seven notes are taken from various natural 
sounds of birds and animals. Raga Bhupali and Todi give tremendous relief to patients 
of high blood pressure. Raga Ahir-Bhairav is supposed to sustain chords which auto- 
matically brings down blood pressure. Raga Malkauns and Raga Asawari helps to 
cure low blood pressure, For heart aliments Raga Chandrakauns is considered very 


helpful. Raga Tilak-Kamod, Hansdhwani, Kalvati, Durga evoke a very pleasing effect on the 
nerves. For patients suffering from insomnia and need a peaceful sonorous sleep, Raga 


Bihag and Bahar have wonderful effects. Ragas are closely related to different parts 
of the day according to changes in nature and development of a particular emo- 
tion, mood or sentiment in the human mind. 

Music therapy treatment is conducted either early morning, evening or night. One should 
avoid long music session on an empty stomach. Music sessions should be of one 
hour duration with two or three short sessions with breaks.

RAGA & THERAPY 

One of the unique characteristics of Indian music is the assignment of definite times of 
the day and night for performing Raga melodies. It is believed that only in this period 
tha Raga appears to be at the height of its melodic beauty and majestic splendor. 

There are some Ragas which are very attractive in the early hours of the mornings, 
others which appeal in the evenings, yet others which spread their fragrance only 
near the midnight hour. 

This connections of time of the day or night, with the Raga or Raginis is based on 
daily cycle of changes that occur in our own body and mind which are con- 
stantly undergoing subtle changes in that different moments of the day arouse and stim- 
ulate different moods and emotions. 

Each Raga or Ragini is associated with a definite mood or sentiment that nature 
arouses in human beings. The ancient musicologists were particularly interested in 
the effects of musical notes, how it affected and enhanced human behaviour. Music had 
the power to cure, to make you feel happy, sad, disgusted and so on. Extensive re- 
search was carried out to find out these effects. This formed the basis of time theo- 
ry as we know it today. 


It is believed that the human body is dominated by the three Doshas - Kaph, Pitta and 
Vata. These elements work in acyclic order of rise and fall during the 24 hour peri- 
od. Also, the reaction of these three elements differ with the seasons. Hence it is 
said that performing or listening to a raga at the proper allotted time can affect 
the health of human beings. 
.Raga Chikista: 
Raga Chikitsa, an extinct sanskrit treatise, as its name implies dealt with curative ragas 
and suggested specific ragas with specific therapeutic and mood enhancing characteristics 
suggested to be used in clinical settings are still more to be tested and validated. 
(Varadalakshmi, 1948), (Sairam, 2005). (Sairam, 2006) in his study on designing training 
methods for the mentally retarded (MR) children prescribed baseline rules for treating MR 
children as — (1) Beta music with rapid fire orchestral rhythms to activate participation and 


KP Ezine May 2015 19 


anger management, to gear up physiological activities and alertness in mind, (2) Alpha mu- 
sic without rhythms to induce relaxation and (3) repeated rhythmic experience to regulate 
the wavering emotions and to bring regularity by his experimental observations during mu- 
sic therapy sessions with mentally retarded children 

A modified version of the earlier documented raga chikitsa approach evolved by the author 
using karnatik ragas for music therapy intervention could be used in clinical set ups 
(Sumathy Sundar, 2006) catering to the individual needs of the clients, taking into consid- 
eration, factors like music preferences, the listening pattern, the socio-economic back- 
ground and the level of exposure to classical music. The raga-based approach broadly in- 
volves application of musical pieces with a specific emphasis on swara patterns, embellish- 
ments and appropriate rhythms. This approach being both melodic and rhythm depends 
on the intended music function and the therapeutic objective identified. Raga-s with swara- 
s having short or long intervals and different embellishments, could be chosen with the ap- 
propriate slow, medium or fast tempo, with or without technical virtuosity. 

The applications would vary for different music functions identified a) audio analgesic, anxi- 
olytic or sedative b) to be stimulating and energizing) to be an active focus of attention etc. 
Indian music therapy is an integration of ancient healing practices and musical traditions 
coupled with the recent modifications derived based on the modern day practice and the 
knowledge gained by current clinical studies undertaken. Indian music therapy is based on 
long empirical traditions not proven in the western sense of empiricism but it is unique and 
is cultural and throws open great scope for further prove and studies.

Progressed Dasa Chart Study 


Based on the article "Deeper Implications of KP Revealed through Progression under 
Vimshothari Dasa System" by K. M. Subramaniam and V. Mohan, in KP.

lord to see longevity. 


Ascendant Analysis: 

As per his natal chart the Ascendant cusp sub lord is Venus, the lord of houses 6 and 11, 
posted in 7 house; Venus is in the star of Jupiter, posted in 7+ and owner of lst and 4th

12h House: CSL is also Venus and we have discussed above.

The Amazing Power of Ruling Planets 


By: Kaavassery S. Naaraayanan

The summe Sun has been, up and high, quite early, by first March, and mercilessly heating 
up the surroundings....it is like having got trapped inside an oven... 

On the 2»¢ March,2015, a Monday, at 17:18 hours, I had an urge to know when will the 
Rain-God send His blessings on us, the hapless humans , as rains, to quell the heat...I 
decided to invoke the Ruling Planets to guide me . 


The lagna was passing at 119 degrees, 59 minutes, 08 seconds in Kataka rasi, Aslesha star, 
in the sub-portion ruled by Saturn. 


The Moon was at 102 degrees, 08 minutes, 44 seconds: in Kataka rasi, Pushya star and in 
the sub of Mars. 


The ascendant star lord Mercury is aspecting the lagna; it owns the 11 cusp and is a fast 
moving planet. 


The star lord of Moon is Saturn and is casting its aspect on Mercury. The star lord of Moon, 
Saturn happens to hold the sub portion of lagna as well. Transit Moon will conjunct the 
lagna point soon. This planetary configuration convinced me that the Rain-God will surely 
smile very soon and I felt quite happy. 


How soon will this very soon be? 


The ruling planets were: Lagna: Moon- Mercury — Saturn 
Moon: Moon- Saturn — Mars 
Day lord: Moon. 


The very next day is Tuesday, ruled by Mars and star is that of Mercury: Aslesha. Both are 
in the list of ruling planets. 


Will it rain on this day? 


Doubtful: Since Saturn holds the sub portion of lagna and the star position of the Moon. 
The next day will be ruled by the combination of Mercury and Ketu. On the day, at the time 
of, analysis Ketu was in Pisces ‘in the star of Mercury’...... Since Mercury is a strong ruling 
planet, Ketu standing as a representative for this planet, may precipitate the event. Will it 
happen on this day? 


Doubtful: Since Ketu stands for Jupiter as well for its sign lord, who is in retro motion! 
Then comes the day ruled by Jupiter and Venus: Jupiter is retrograde while Venus has not 
appeared in the list of ruling planets. This will not be helpful. 


Next comes the day of Venus with Sun for the star lord. Both these planets are not found in 
the ruling planet’s list. Hence rain cannot come, on this day too.

Wnravelling the secrets in the charts of Twin births 
: - An analysis through KP system 


By: Gunti Nagaraju KP astrologer 


M.com CAIIB, Retired Bank officer 
12-13-668/5/2, Second floor, Nagarjuna Nagar, 
Tarnaka,Secunderabad- 500 017; 

Tel: 040-27 172206; 9490752371 


Email: gunti.nagaraju@gmail.com 
-_—EE EEE eee BHREEBEE EH 


It is always a puzzling question for the astrologers to read the charts of the Twin births. 
Many of us will have this question in our minds that children born at the same time, same 
date, and same place may be similar in physical appearance but when we notice that their 
lives are quite different, it will become an enigmatic question. This riddle has been 
addressed by Vedic astrology and K.P system with equal callidity. 








Two different individuals do not usually take birth from the same womb at the same time in 
exactly the same way except the twins. A mere fractional difference in time will alter the 
lives of the natives. In Vedic astrology this is addressed by Divisional charts which play an 
important and deciding role of the variations in the fulfillment of desires, relationships, 
spiritual enlightenment, past life karma and its effects, next life, the carrying forward , the 
inner power and purity of soul, name, fame, progeny etc. May be the dexterity of studying 
and unearthing the secrets depend on the individual astrologer’s intuitive and analytical 
capabilities of their brains. 


The K.P system has a different approach and is unique in its applications. Here I would like 
to quote the famous words of Sri K.S Krishnamurthy garu.... “Again a problem arose to find 
out why one of the twins get married and the other remain unmarried, in spite of the 
planets remaining in the same degree and minute and in the same Bhava, same Navanmsa, 
same Astakavarga, having the same Shadbalaa and everything remaining the same. Then I 
found that it is the cusp of the 12 houses which vary in twin births and therefore it is the 
cusp which should indicate whether that house matter will suffer. Every chart has 
significators.significators can indicate the time. If the cusp denies, the significators cannot 
give. The cusp sub lord is very vital... thus I found out that the only correct Sookshma 
method is, judging the cusp in each bhava by considering the lord of the Sub in which it 
has fallen. “So though a particular matter is indicated by the constellation of the cusp, 
it is the cusp sub lord that decides the fructification of that particular matter and that is the 
specialty of the cusp sub lord in K.P system. Hence the Planet represents the SOURCE, that 
Planet's Star-Lord represents the EFFECTS and RESULTS and that Planet's Sub-lord gives 
an idea of the FINAL DIRECTION of that results. 


To have a clear understanding about the efficacy of this technique, I would like to discuss 
the charts of twin sisters, whose particulars are furnished here under. 


TWINS- ELDER- DOB- 23 AUGUST1970: TOB-12:41:50 A.M: POB- HOSPET (KARNATAKA). 


T'WINS- YOUNGER-DOB-23 AUGUST 1970: TOB-12:44:20: POB- HOSPET (KARNATAKA).

New theory for longevity with KP astrology 
By: Basilioli Sandro ( Vediko) 


Via Nicolo’33 Isola Del Gransasso (Te), ITALY 
E-mail: Vediko@libero.it 











I am presenting an improvised methad of a new theory for langevity calculation only for 
natal charts . It was written and published in another journal but it is new for KPEzine 
readers , so I hope it will be useful if the longevity with traditional method will not be so 
clear. 


INTRODUCTION 

KP LONGEVITY RULES 

FOR LONG LIFE: Combinations of 1, 5,9,10,11 (9,11 if not Badhaka): over 66 years 
FOR MEDIUM LIFE: Combinations of 1,3,5,9,10,11+ 6,8,12 : up to 65 years 

FOR SHORT LIFE: Combinations of = Badhaka , Maraka+6,8,12: up to 32 years 


NEW THEORY 

I have tested more than 100 A-A notable horoscopes and in many cases where the lifespan 
was long life , it indicated medium life combinations. So I decided a new systematic way in 
the three level system :Planet-Star & Sub signification of Asc sub lord with a specific table 
of ages (CODES, Saptarishis Magazine Vol 9 ), to pinpoint the right period of death. This 
table is adapted from the original table & modified for KP. It should be used for natal 
horoscopes only and not for horary. It can give clue for right longevity period in those cases 
which you think longevity is not so clear . The table below is modified by new research. 


TABLE -A 


Short life Middle life Long life 
S-S-S = 12y to 32y S-M-M = 32,4y to 66y 


93y M-S-S = 12y to 36y M -M-M= 34y to 72y 


L-M-M = 40y to 82y 
L-L-L = 72y to 100y L-S-M = 33y to 70y 
S-M-L = 60y to 91y 





KP Ezine May 2015 56 


RULES 

1): Comb= 1,3,5,10,9,11 (9,11 if not badhaka) = good 

2):Comb=6,8,12,4 = neutral ( 6,8,12 are bad, but 6 disease, 8 incident & 12 hospital you 
can survive) . 

3):Comb= maraka & badhaka = BAD 

4): Only signs significations are used . 

5): Cuspal of cups significations should not be used. 

6): Aspects of Saturn 3rd & 10th, aspects of Jupiter 5th & 9th , aspects of Mars 4th & 8th 
should be considered, rest of the planets 7 asp accepted & for nodes no aspect is 
considered. 

*7): Aspects are considered, by two fast planets orb up to 5°degree and by two slow planets 
orb up to 3°20 degree. If a slow planet conjoin or aspect a fast planet considered orb up to 
5°degree , if a fast planet conjoin or aspects a slow planet considered orb up to 3°20 degree. 
Nodes are always in aspect even if orb is not up to 5°degrees. Aspects on cups are 
considered only as last signification with orb up to 3°20 degree. 


If there is combination of rule 2 and 3 it gives short life, if combination of 2 and 1 it gives 
long life , if combination of 1 and 3 it gives medium life , if combination of only 2 it gives 
medium life, only 1 it gives long life and only 3 it gives short life. 


The analysis alone of planet, star and sub should be done , then look at the formula of 
table A for longevity and if all different ,take the sub as final . 
*Note: Depends if the analysis is for a slow or a fast planet in that moment.

Promo on in service — KP rules 


By: G.Subramanian 


13,Second Cross St., 
Chennai-35 


Email: gurusubra@yahoo.com 








\HERHEEEREE & 
Everyone who enters service at a young age is keenly desirous of going up higher and higher 
in the official hierarchy. There is an intense urge to earn as many promotions as possible 
during the entire period of service subject of course to suitability on the basis of work and 
academic qualifications. 





This is one area where the astrologers are frequently asked by the clients about the 
prospect of promotion and the period in which it can be expected. All K.P. Astrologers 
should feel immensely thankful to our Guruji Shri KSK who has formulated certain easy, 
unambiguous and unfailing rules for predicting promotion in service. 


We summarize in a nutshell. The basic rules laid down in KP on this subject: 


1. 10 house signifies employment- it may be service or business/independent profession. 
It is therefore the primary house to be looked into while predicting promotion. 

2. If the 10 cusp prominently signifies sixth, it is a clear indication that the native will be 
destined to be in service-serving other for a paid salary; 

3. 11th house is the house of fructification or fulfillment of oneq's desires, ambitions and 
achieving the cherished goals. Naturally this house plays a vital role in this issue; 

4. It logically follows that if the 10% cusp sub lord signifies house 2, 6, 10, 11, then one is 
surely assured of promotion; 

5. When the promotion will take place? For determining the timing, we have to arrive at the 
conjoined period of the significators of these relevant houses; 


Based on the above guidelines, I am discussing in this article the horoscope of a senior 
citizen to demonstrate the sound applicability of these principles. The horoscope is annexed 
to this article and the name is withheld for obvious reasons. 


Readers may note that the sublord of the 10 cusp is Venus in Lagna, lord of 6 and 11. Itis 
in its own star and is therefore a strong significator of 1, 6 and 11. Interestingly the sixth 
cusp sublord also happens to be Venus. This gives the clue that this person will be in 
service only- under a paid job. The sub of Venus is Saturn, lord of 2 and 3 placed in 3. The 
significations of 2,6,10 and 11 also foretell the chances of promotion to the native during 
the course of his service. 

The next vital step is to extract the significators of the houses 2,6,10 and 11.

Double Role of Delayed and Early Marriage

P as 
It happened very recently when I was surfing through the internet and was searching 
different astrological sites I came across to know the details of two persons posted in the 
internet. One of the people was Mr. Damodar Goyal of Jaipur, Rajasthan, he had given his 
birth details and had written that Saturn and Moon both are conjointly posited in his 4th 
house and instead of “PUNARPHOO DOSHA” why did his marriage took place at an early 
age of 20 years? 





The other person who had not mentioned his name but had referred his name in short as 
D.G.P. a male native from Chandigarh who had also posted his birth details had informed 
that his love relations have failed three times consecutively. His matrimonial alliance has 
broken after negotiations from matrimonial column of newspaper and another time his 
negotiations for marriage broke which was referred from the newspaper advertisement. He 
is around 35 years of age and till date he is not married as yet and why is it happening so? 


He does not know that he is having a strong Punarphoo Dosha. I have created his birth 
chart and found the fact that it had the PUNARPHOO DOSHA. 


Therefore I found this as a very interesting fact of study for analysis that both of them are 
having PUNARPHOO DOSHA but why one had an early marriage and in case of another it 
has been a fact that his marriage has not been finalised till date. 


Punarphoo Dosha 


Punarphoo Dosha is a concept under the KP system of astrology. Our revered Gurji Late 
Prof. K. S. Krishnamurti dealt with Punarphoo considering mainly from marriage 
perspective and talked about Punarphoo in KP fourth reader, page no. 74 (Marriage, 
Married Life & Children). Whenever Moon has got any connection with Saturn, there will be 
delays and difficulties, not only during negotiations but also at the time of fixation of 
marriage (engagement will get cancelled at the last moment) and even at the time of 
celebration of the marriage (cancellation of marriage for no _ reason). 


Delay, dejection, disappointments, denial, etc. are caused by Saturn and if Saturn and 
Moon connection exists in the birth chart these effects will be more prominent and would 
certainly cause anxiety. This is a unique combination that affects psyche and domestic 
peace of native. Moon is the significator of mind and reveals the desires or emotions of 
human mind and Saturn is a planet of sorrow giving loneliness, delay and dejection. This 
connection impact on the mind of the native causes sorrow and pessimism. 


I have seen many charts where there is influence of Saturn on Moon either by aspect or 
exchange of houses the native remains a bachelor for long period resulting in late marriage 
or no marriage or early marriage with an elderly person with unsatisfied marriage life, at 
least one break of relationship mostly found with the birth charts having this combination. I 
have found that not only in marriage, but in each and every aspect of human life gets 
affected by this combination.

If Saturn is deposited in the constellation of Moon and sub of Saturn, or if Moon is 
deposited in Saturn’s star and Moon sub, or if Moon is in the 3rd sign or in the 10th sign 
from Saturn to Saturn’s 3rd and 10th aspect over Moon, or if Saturn is deposited in the 
houses 1, 3, 5, 7 or 10 or If Saturn occupies the 5th house wherefrom it will aspect 7th, 
11th and 2nd houses by its third, seventh and tenth aspects respectively then such 
difficulties would arise. 


Whenever Saturn happens to be a significator of a particular matter (not necessarily of 
marriage alone but even for education, employment etc), it will not only deny but will also 
cause delay. If Saturn is connected with the houses 2, 7 and 11 occupying the house or 
owning it or situated in the star of the planet posited in any of these houses it will cause 
delay at every time in fixation of marriage etc. but it will not deny marital happiness. But if 
Saturn has no connection with houses 2,7 and 11 but only throws its aspect, this portends 
denial and even disappointment. 


According to K.P. whenever Saturn occupies the houses 1, 3, 5, 7 or 10 without 
significations to 2, 7 & 11, it will delay and also deny ones marriage. So while judging a 
horoscope, delaying tendency of Saturn should be judged not only with reference to the 
position of Saturn in the houses 1, 3, 5, 7 or 10 from the lagna but also to the aspect of 
Saturn to respective cusps 2, 7 and 11 where this dosha is present and also conjunction of 
Moon & Saturn in the same house. So if Saturn forms favourable aspects to the cusps 2, 7 
and 11 delaying tendency of Saturn is indicated. But if Saturn forms evil aspects to the 
cusps 2, 7 and 11, delaying tendency of Saturn will become weak. 


Cancellation of Punarphoo Dosha 

Cancellation of Punarphoo had been discussed by the late Pt. K.R. Kar in the 1996 Annual 

Book of KP & Astrology, (pages 69-72). Cancellation takes place briefly when: 

1. Saturn or Moon are found in association with Sun, in one sign. (It could be divided into 
two Bhavas). 

2. Sun is in the star of either of them. 

3. Sun is in a star, lord of which is near either Moon or _ Saturn. 

4, When there is any planet closer to the Moon or Saturn, if the third planet is in the star of 

the Sun. 

5. And lastly if Saturn or Moon is in the sub-sub of the Sun. 

It is hoped that the above "Cancellation of Punarphoo" theory will help readers to do more 

research on this interesting subject - which is full of pitfalls for the average follower of KP. 

Here are two examples, one had an early marriage and in case of another the marriage of 

the native had not been finalised till date. Let’s see how do we analyse both the charts as 

per K.P. rules. 

This is the Horoscope of a male native. The birth chart of the native shows delayed marriage 

and the birth details are given below: 

Name: Mr. DGP 

Date of Birth: 12.10.1981 

Time of Birth: 14:30 Hrs. (IST) 

Place of Birth: Chandigarh (Lat/ Long: 30N42, 76E48) 


Now let us see the chart no. 1. Native of this chart still remains unmarried, why? Saturn, 
lord of 2 (Kutumba sthana) is in Moon star and in the sub of Ketu. Ketu also deposited in 
Saturn sign, thus represents Saturn. Again Moon is in the star of Saturn and sub of Venus. 
Venus (Kalatra karaka) is aspected by Saturn in its 3rd aspect (Vedic aspect) and is also 
Saturn’s 7th aspect over Moon. So the Punarphoo Dosha is very strong. 

In this chart under discussion the 7th cusp sub lord is Jupiter with positional strength i.e. 
there is no planet in the stars of Jupiter, hence Jupiter is a strong significator of 7th house. 
Jupiter is in the star of Mars and sub of self (Jupiter). Jupiter signifies 7 & 11, so marriage 
is promised to the native but after long delay because of Saturn and Jupiter betrothal being 
in close conjunction. Planets connected with Saturn will tend to delay matters, as he is 


KP Ezine May 2015 66 


karaka for delay and obstruction. See how the Saturn causing Punarphoo Dosha is in 
sextile (Western) aspect (Good aspect) of 11th house (house of fructification). Hence the 
Saturn-Moon combination of Punarphoo Dosha is the main cause for the abnormal delay 
for the marriage of the native. 


The 3rd house indicates the engagements, betrothal and mutual meetings talks etc. The 3rd 
cusp sub lord is Sun. Sun signifies 3, 7, 8, 10 & 11, which are the favourable houses for 
engagements, Betrothal and mutual meetings talks etc. But Saturn's very close conjunction 
to Sun in 8th house is not good and all the engagement and mutual meetings talks are not 
favouring to the native and the marriage fails at the engagement level. This is because of the 
Punarphoo Dosha. 


At present the Ketu dasa and Mercury bhukti are operating. But both the dasa and bhukti 
lord are not favouring for marriage of the native. So the marriage of the native may be in 
Venus dasa. So there is an abnormal delay in getting the marriage finalised due to the 
presence of strong Punarphoo Dosha. 

This is another horoscope of a male native. The native of this horoscope got married at an 
early age of 20 years and his birth details are given below: 


Name: Mr. Damodar Goyal 

Date of Birth: 17.05.1951 

Time of Birth: 09:30 Hrs. (IST) 

Place of Birth: Jaipur (Lat/ Long: 26N55, 75E49) 


Now let us see the chart no. 2. In this chart under discussion the 7th cusp sub lord is Sun. 
Sun is in self (Sun) star in 11 and in Jupiter sub, Jupiter is the lord of 7th and there is no 
planet in 7th house, Jupiter also aspects 2nd house by its 5th (Vedic aspect) aspect . Thus 
7th CSL Sun signifies 11 and is connected to 2 & 7th houses. So marriage is promised to 
the native. 

Now I am discussing how the Punarphoo Dosha is cancelled in this horoscope. I have solved 
the said horoscope in the guidelines of Cuspal Method theory advocated by Pt. K.R. Kar and 
tested his theory of Cancellation of ill effect of Punarphoo Dosha. Here Saturn is in close 
(Platic) conjunction with Moon in the 3rd house, both the planets are deposited in the 
constellation of Sun. Saturn’s longitude is 02°9-34’-24” and Moon’s longitude is 079-25’-41”, 
this conjunction is adverse in nature and so the Punarphoo Dosha is nullified. The native of 
this horoscope therefore got married at an early age of 20 years. 

So before one ventures to offer any predictions on marriages etc., one has to carefully scan 
the horoscope for the existence or otherwise of the Punarphoo Dosha and then only finalise 
the prediction. Sometimes this Dosha may not be apparently seen, that is to say Saturn 
may not be in Moon star or Moon sub or Saturn sub or Moon may not be in Saturn star 
Saturn sub or Moon sub. In that case that the sub-sub position of both Saturn and Moon 
has to be worked out. If either of the two is in the sub-sub of the other then the Punarphoo 
Dosha will be present. 

Again when the Punarphoo Dosha is present, the event will not be materialised till such 
time when Saturn’s Bhukti or Anthara period is over. The event will only be materialised in 
the succeeding planets period provided that the planet is the significator for that event. 

It has been observed that the Punarphoo Dosha is not always being the reason for the delay 
in marriage negotiations but instead sometimes it helps in the settlement of an early 
marriage. Here I would like to advise all my astrological friends and readers that they may 
try and testify the above rules which has been discussed by me in my article about the 
“Punarphoo Dosha”.

COPD stands for Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease and refers to two long-term 
lung diseases, chronic Bronchitis and Emphysema (distention of the tissues with air). 
Bronchitis is an inflammation of the mucous membrane in the bronchial tubes. It typically 
causes bronchospasm or bronchial smooth muscle, producing narrowing of the bronchi. 
Emphysema is a condition in which the air sacs of the lungs are damaged and enlarged, 
causing breathlessness. Bronchitis is a common respiratory disease come with common 
cold. It comes in two forms: 

1. Acute - lasting from one to three weeks which general medication can be applied for cure. 
2. Chronic - lasting at least 3 months to 2, 3 years or more. But if the case is worst it runs 
with no cure and becomes serious long term disorder and causes for COPD. 

As per the medical science, the causes for this disease are smoking, chemicals, dust, air 
pollution and in some rare cases genes may play a roll and lack of protein called Alpha -1. 
The main organ of this disease is lungs and it is incurable. 


1. According to the KP literatures the main ruling house of lungs is Gemini. It governs pul- 
monary diseases, eosonophillia, dry Cough, pneumonia, bronchitis, pleurisy, asthma, and 
inflammation of pericardium, affections of the hands and tuberculosis. (Medical Astrology 
for all, page 21, 4th Edition 2005) 


2. The lungs are ruled principally by Mercury and the Gemini sign, 3rd and 4th houses and 
are influenced or afflicted by all the common signs (Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius and Pisces) 
and by the four cadent houses, when such are occupied by the planets at birth. The 
planetary causes for pulmonary affections are Sun, Moon, Saturn, Jupiter or Mercury in 
Pisces and afflicted. The Sun or Moon in the 6th house in common signs and afflicted by 
malefics; The Sun afflicted in Gemini or Sagittarius or in Virgo afflicted by Jupiter. 
(Encyclopedia of Medical Astrology by H.L.Cornell - MD, DA. page 472) 


3. Karaka Planets of Lungs and Chest in general 

Mercury - The principle ruler of lungs by lordship of Gemini and Virgo a common sign. 
Jupiter - Lord of cadent houses Sagittarius and Pisces who rules lower lobes of lungs and 
karaka for morbid growth. 

Saturn - Governor of breath & planet of contraction and obstructive in general, affecting the 
planets concerned. 

Sun - Being the lord of Leo that rules heart including lungs 

Moon - Lord of Cancer who produce phlegm (mucus) & Karaka for cold and pneumonia 


4. Planets for lungs, Lung diseases and associate ailments of COPD 
Source - Medical Astrology for All by K. Subramaniam, pp 22-23 

Moon - Disease of heart and lungs 

Mercury - Disease of chest 

Jupiter - Lung dseases 

Venus - Throat troubles 

Rahu - Lung troubles

6. Role of Uranus 

As per "Medical Astrology for all” by K. Subramaniam, Uranus in Gemini produces 
pneumonia, bronchial affections, asthma and cough. (p 24). As well when Uranus locates 
any sign from Aries to Pisces, it gives bad health to the part of the body denoted by the sign 
as per the same literature. Hence I have drawn a special attention to Uranus in connection 
with 

COPD. 

Uranus rules Respiratory action - "Encyclopedia of Medical Astrology” by Dr. H. L. Cornell, p 
892 

Uranus diseases - spasmodic breathing, respiratory disorders, emphysema - Ibid, pg 198, 
892, 893 

Emphysema is under the rule of Uranus and Gemini sign - "The Ruler ship” by Rex E. Bills 


7. Rule for Bronchitis 

In Medical astrology natural Zodiac (Kalapursha), 3rd House Gemini sign (breathing), its 
lord Mercury (karaka), ruling lungs, Saturn, Jupiter (karaka) indicate respiratory system & 
pneumonia disease. Cancer sign is for lower lung, 4th Cusp (Lungs) and Moon (depositing of 
fluids in lower lobes of the lungs) & Sun also indicate lung infection; Rahu is also a significa- 
tor of lung problems. Star Punurvasu indicates lungs, respiratory system & pneumonia. (Bill 
Rex's Rulership Book/ Umang Taneja'’s Dictionary of Significators; Dr. J. Lee Lehman's 
Rulerships, Judith Hill’s Medical Astrology, Dr. Jagannath Rao’ Medical Astrology; K. 
Subramaniam’s Medical Astrology for All. - KPEZ - March 2010

Hints: 

2nd house denotes increase in the number of the members of family due to birth of a child. 
5th house considered for child birth. It indicates first conception or pregnancy, progeny or 
child. 

8th house signify sexual urge. 10 house indicates achievement of any undertakings. Being

Consider the houses 2, 5 and 11 for child birth. Cancer, Scorpio and Pieces are the fruitful 
signs and important for assessment for child birth matters. Jupiter is the natural 
significator (Karaka) of child birth.

(being 1th from 2, 5 and 11 respectively). Aries, Gemini, Leo and Virgo are the barren signs.

Sun, Mars and Jupiter are male planets. Moon, Venus and Rahu are female planets. 
Mercury and Ketu are neutral gender. Odd number signs (1, 3, 5, 9, and 11) indicate male 
and even number signs (2, 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12) indicate female. However it is most difficult to

\HHEHRHEEHEEEE & & 
Introduction 

I always thought it might be fitting to contribute to a magazine that provides so much 
dedication and patience to the science of KP. Kanak’s astrological Ezine is a publication I 
have always wanted to do just that; contribute. In looking at the authors, despite their 
English language barriers, including mine for their native languages, they each make 








sincere and solid attempts to communicate their findings in a science they so much love. 
Even though my background extends to other sciences such as numerology, tarot and 
classical Vedic astrology, I am still a novice by far when it comes to KP Astrology; and 
nothing could be better than to learn this science from such great teachers; thus I created 
the Novice Nook. This is a section for both the beginners and those that need a refresher of 
the basics. 

Taking this science seriously, means working with it actively and not passively. What do I 
mean by that? Remember, first things first. Learn the fundamentals and then learn the 
steps to casting a horary map and practice! Practice! Practice! Practice! I cannot say it 
enough. 

Sage Advice: 


When studying each KP, a great approach that you may find helpful is taking one topic ata 
time and reading as many examples regarding that topic as possible. If you study too many 
different topics at one time, you will surely become an individual with some knowledge of all 
the topics, but a master of none. 


At the end of your studies, you will need to ask yourself, have you found value for yourself 
or for others? For example, if you start studying longevity, then go through the many years 
of longevity discussions found in so many KP newsletters that Kanak Bosmia and his 
authors have blessed us with. Don’t study wealth one minute, then longevity another day, 
then health another hour. Until you get the basic fundamentals down, all you will end up is 
confused. I can tell you from experience. 


An Analogy 

The same goes for when I am teaching the martial arts, many people approach me and tell 
me they want a black belt and ask me how long does it take to get one? I just shake my 
head and tell them we always start and end the class with the basics. Then they retort and 
tell me that they don’t want the basics, but only the advanced techniques. Here they miss 
the whole point of what I am teaching. The same is for math. In order to become good at 
say Calculus HI, you need to know basic math; then Calculus I and Calculus II, then you 
can learn Calculus III. 

Same for KP Astrology. Advanced techniques, or what appears to be advanced techniques 
are nothing more than a combination of the basics. Like the example above, Calculus III is 
a mixture of basic math, Calculus I & II. Calculus III then appears to be advanced. So it 
goes martial arts, astrology, or any subject of study. Thus, don’t miss this point - ever in 


KP Ezine May 2015 76 


your studies! Upon this understanding, then you will advance in your studies. 

What determines a master astrologer? Master is nothing more than a name or title some 
times so proven by a certificate; a piece of paper. Many people buy into the granting of a 
certificate or some other form of recognition, when in fact, when you are really proficient at 
what you do, there is no need to be recognized by anyone but yourself or the people you 
service. As we say in the martial arts, “skill is rank”. Demonstrate your skill via constant 
contributions to what you have learned in the science or art, and you to will become a 
master of the craft; still with an entire journey ahead of you. Don’t let a piece of paper 
dictate whether or not you’re a master; the paper is for those not sure of themselves until 
they have it documented and signed by some instructor who calls themselves a guru. 
Study these brilliant articles in KP Ezine with love, attention and intention and you too will 
become a skilled practitioner with thanks to all those who came before you in this 
publication. 

All that said: between all of the authors of this publication, if you go back to 2007 and 
begin to study each author’s process on the same topic as you begin your journey, you will 
have enough information before you to become a master astrologer if that is what you desire 
to be. And remember, becoming a master astrologer does not mean you stop your journey 
there. It is a continuous journey that has no bounds and you must treat the science as you 
would like the science to treat you; with respect and honor. There are too many false 
practitioners out there that make claim of being a master. Really? Be great at what you 
have learned and give back. 

I am creating this section of KP Ezine, calling it the Novice Nook, to be the cornerstone for 
novices that would like to understand the many basics, nuances and questions presented 
by many beginners. If you have questions, send them to me and I will do my best to also 
collaborate with many of the authors of this wonderful magazine and address some of the 
questions in future additions. This should be one of your first stops when reading this 
magazine if you would like to pick up some ideas, tips and theory for the beginner. Good 
luck on your journey and may you attain the success you deserve.

considered listed below in the form of a chart. Go over the chart a number of times to get a 
feel of what you should always be looking for and then next month I will create a step by 
step breakdown of this chart. Here, this chart under the casted horoscope gives you room 
to analyze and see what you should be looking for and analyzing. Good luck and we will 
see you next month. Send any of your questions to smith.davidjr@yahoo.com with the

BESS eee 
A querent who has applied for P.R. for foreign country about two years back was eagerly 
waiting visa papers asked me to check when he will get visa papers. 








Horary number provided by the querent is 96. 
Date of query: 16-11-2014; 

Time of query: 07:14 PM; 

Place of query: Chandigarh 


Moon reveals the nature of query. 

Moon is lord of 12 in 1 and it is in the star of Venus in 3 lord of 3 and 10. Further it is in 
the sub of Jupiter in 12 lord of 5 and 8. Hence Moon is linked with 3 (all correspondence, 
letter, papers, means of communication ticket, visa, work permit). 3rd house (12 to 4) also 
indicates change of residence. Further 12th house shows new environment and 
surrounding and 8 means tension. So Moon clearly shows that querent is having tension for 
getting the visa papers for foreign country. 


Gulberga Theory 

If sub lord of horary number furnished happens to be either Moon star lord or lagan star 
lord among the ruling planets, then query is to be answered in the affirmative otherwise not. 
In the case under reference sub lord of horary number is Mars and lagna star lord is also 
Mars Accordingly I informed the querent that answer to his query is affirmative and he will 
surely get visa papers. 


Confirmation through Asc sublord 

In the case Asc sub lord is Mars, deposited in 5 lord of 4 and 9. It is in the star of Venus in 
3 lord of 3 and 10. It is in the sub of Jupiter in 12 lord of 5 and 8. Hence Asc sub lord is 
significator of 3, 9, 12, which shows effort of querent for getting visa papers. 


Ruling Planets on dated 16-11-2014 

Asc sign lord: Venus; Asc star lord: Mars 
Moon star lord: Venus; Moon sign lord: Sun 
Day lord: Sun 


General Aspect 
Matter regarding visa papers, all kinds of correspondence, letters, means of 
communications, ticket, certificate, work permit etc relate to 3rd house. 


Rule for Visa Papers 
e If the sub lord of 3rd house signifies 3 and 11, one gets desired result 
e Also if the 11th cusp sub lord signifies 3 or 11, one gets positive result 


e Further 3rd and 11th cusp should have linkage with house 3 or 9 or 12 for getting visa 
for foreign country

3rd Cusp Sub lord 

3rd cusp sub lord is Mercury in 3 and lord of 2 and 11. Further it is in the star of Rahu in 
2. Rahu is in the sign of Mercury in 3 lord of 2-11. It is in the sub of Sun in 3. Hence 3rd 
cusp sub lord signifies 3 and 11 which is conducive for getting visa papers. 


11th Cusp Sub Lord 

11th cusp sub lord is Moon in 1 lord of 12. It is in star of Venus in 3 lord of 3 and 10. It is 
in the sub of Sun in 3 lord of 1. Hence 11th cusp sub lord signifies 3 and 12 which is 
conducive for getting visa papers for foreign country. 


Verifications of Mahadasha, Bhukti, Antra and Sookshma 
On dated 16-11-2014 Mahadasha of Venus and Bhukti of Jupiter was running from 25-02- 
2013 to 27-12-2015. 


Mahadasha Venus 

Venus is in 3 lord of 3 and 10. It is in the star of Saturn in 3 lord of 6 and 7. It is in the sub 
of Mercury in 3 lord of 2 and 11. Hence Venus Mahadasha signifies 3 and 11 which is 
conducive for getting visa papers. 


Bhukti Jupiter 

Jupiter is in 12 lord of 5 and 8. It is in the Star of Mercury in 3 lord of 11 and 2. It is in the 
sub of Jupiter in 12 lord of 5 and 8. Hence Jupiter bhukti signifies 3,11 and 12 which is 
conducive for getting visa papers. 


Antra Venus [19-08-2014 to 28-01-2015] 
On the day of judgment dated 16-11-2014 antra Venus was running. As discussed above in 
the Mahadasha Venus it is also conducive for getting visa papers. 


Sookshma 

On the day of judgment sookshma Jupiter was running from 10-11-2014 to 1-12-2014. 
Next sookshma was Saturn from 1-12-2014 to 27-12-2014. Jupiter was already taken as 
bhukti lord. Saturn is in 3 lord of 6 and 7, and it is in the star of Jupiter in 12 lord of 5 and 
8, further in sub of Rahu in sign of Mercury in 3 lord of 2 and 11. Hence Saturn 
sookshama signifies 3 and 12 which is conducive for getting visa papers. Moreover 3 and 11 
are signified at sub level of Rahu. So I informed the querent that he will get his visa papers 
for P.R. of foreign country between 1-12-2014 to 27-12-2014 that is before the expiry of 
Saturn sookshma, 


Fact of case 

It was intimated by the querent that he received visa papers for Permanent Residency on 
dated 5-12-2014 which falls on FRIDAY and he has booked his seat for SUNDAY. It is 
pointed out that VENUS [Friday] and SUN [Sunday] come twice each in the R.P. which 
clearly shows that RULING PLANETS play important role in Krishnamurti Padhadhti . 


My parnam to our Guru ji Sh K.S.Krishnamurti for his wonderful Padhdhati.

HBHRHEEEEEHEEE HEH H 
In timing events according to the birth chart, we need to select the significators we are 
interested in and then their activating periods according to the dasha system. In the 
western system of astrology, there is no dasha system as ours. However, in our eastern 
system, we have this method to find the time of any event according to the significators of a 
life event of the native. 

According to Krishnamurthi Padhdhathi, the steller method propounded by our late Guruji, 
the Vimsoththari dasha system is utilized in timing of events. This is a timing method of 
total of 120 years allocated for each of the nine planets in unequal periods. This method of 
division for allocation of sub periods for each planet is similar to this. 

















The dasha of a native at the time of birth is selected according to the position of Moon in the 
27 constellations of the zodiac. Moreover, according to the distance travelled by Moon in a 
particular constellation, the balance period of the dahsa at the time of birth is calculated. 


In this birth chart, Moon is deposited in the sign Sagittarius 19.51.17. When the zodiac is 
divided into 27 constellations, the constellation from Sagittarius 00.00.00 to Sagittarius 
13.20.00 is ruled by Kethu and the next constellation from Sagittarius 13.20.00 to 
Sagittarius 26.40.00 is ruled by Venus. Therefore, the native had the major dasha ruled by 
Venus. The Moon has travelled a distance of 06.31.17 in the constellation ruled by Venus. 
This distance in the constellation is equivalent to a period of Dasha balance for Venus - 10 
year, O2 month and 18 days at birth. 

The Krishnamurthi Padhdhathi rule for marriage is that, if the sub lord of the 7 cusp (for 
marriage) is a significator for 7 bhava or 24 bhava (increase of family members) or the 1] 1th 
bhava (fulfillment of expectation), the native is fortunate to get married. 

This is an analysis of a birth chart to find the significators of marriage, marriage period 
according to dasha and sub dashas and the transit of the significators during the time of 
marriage. 


At the time of his birth, the dasha balance for Venus is 10 years, 02 months and 18 days. 
From January 1992 to January 1999, he was under the influence of Mars as dasha lord. 
This dasha lord Mars is deposited in a star of Mercury, a significator for the 7 and 11th 
bhavas, in addition to other bhavas. Therefore this native will enjoy the results connected to 
7 and 11th bhavas during the periods and sub periods of Mars. 

From December 1996 to February 1998, he was under the influence of Venus as bukthi 
lord. 

Venus is also deposited in a star of Mercury, a significator for the 7“ and 11 bhavas, in 
addition to other bhavas. Therefore this native will enjoy the results connected to 7 and 
11th bhavas during the periods and sub periods of Venus. 

From 18th April to 12th May 1997, he was under the influence of Mars as antara lord. 

As discussed above this native will enjoy the results connected to 7+ and 11 bhavas 
during the periods and sub periods of Mars. 

This selection of significators and timing of marriage for Mars dasha- Venus buthi- Mars 
anatara is done according to the rules laid in the infallible system, Krishnamurthi 
Padhdhathi.

Rule - 1: 

Note down sub sub lord of Asc. (Horary sub sub lord A is in the sub sub of planet B, in this 
case B is deciding factor). Now tally planet B with Moon star lord or sub sub lord. If it tallies 
(in other words, if B is star lord or sub sub lord of the MOON) the answer is YES. If not, 
check with Asc star lord and sub sub lord, if tallies (in other words, if B is star lord or sub 
sub lord of Asc.) the answer is YES. 


Analysis:

Saturn is MOON's SS lord. 

Rule SATISFIED. 


Rule - 2: 

Note down F-1, star lord of Asc sub sub lord. (Planet A is in the star of B, Please read 
detailed article by the same author in Feb-Mar 2007 KP Ezine issues). Now tally planet B 
with the Moon star lord or sub sub lord. If it tallies (in other words, if B is star lord or sub 
sub lord of the MOON) the answer is YES. If not, check with Asc star lord and sub sub lord. 
If it tallies (in other words, if B is star lord or sub sub lord of Asc.) the answer is YES. 


Analysis: 

Star lord of Asc SS lord is Mars. 
Mars is MOON's star lord. 

Rule SATISFIED. 


Rule - 3: 

Lastly check with F-3, (Planet A—sub sub lord of Asc—is in the sub sub of planet B. Planet 
B is in the star of Planet C. In this case, Planet C is the deciding factor). Now tally Planet C 
with Moon star lord or sub sub lord. If it tallies (in other words, if C is star lord or sub sub 
lord of MOON) the answer is YES. If not, tally with Asc star lord and sub sub lord. If tallies 
(in other words, if C is star lord or sub sub lord of Asc.) the answer is YES. 


Analysis: 

Star lord of SS lord of Asc is Saturn. 
Saturn is MOON's SS lord. 

Rule SATISFIED. 


My opinion: 3 out of 3 rules are satisfied. Hence according to TSP, the answer is YES, 
rumor is true.

K.P system and Kidney Transplant (Post Analysis) 
By: Gunti Nagaraju 


M.com CAIIB, Retired Bank officer 
12-13-668/5/2, Second floor, Nagarjuna Nagar, 
Tarnaka,Secunderabad- 500 017; 

Tel: 040-27 172206; 9490752371 


Email: gunti.nagaraju@gmail.com 





‘BEER ERERRHRHRHEHEEREERHEEHEEHEEEHEEEEHEHEHEEHEEEEEEEEE & 


Under medical astrology kidney problem is one of the major problems of health and K.P 
system has dealt in depth with all aspects of it conclusively. Now I would like to analyze, 
with the help of K.P system and its rules, the chart of an individual who had undergone 
kidney transplantation. A kidney transplant is a surgical procedure to place a functioning 
kidney from a donor into a person whose kidneys no longer function properly. Our kidneys 
remove excess fluid and waste from the blood. When kidneys lose their filtering ability, 
dangerous levels of fluid and waste accumulate in the body — a condition known as kidney 
failure. A kidney transplant is often the best treatment for kidney failure. 





The disease related to kidneys and its allied problems fall mainly under the purview of Libra 
- the 74 house in natural zodiac. The three main planets connected with this are Venus, 
Jupiter and Moon. Mars governs the urinary system and Venus in specific kidneys. If Mars 
and Venus are adversely effected by unfavorable planets in watery signs viz., Cancer, 
Scorpio and Pisces, one may suffer from kidney troubles and urinary disorders. If Moon 
falls in 6th bhava, a watery sign and connected with Mercury which again is placed in 
watery sign, it will surely indicate urinary problems.

11th house indicates treatment and cure.

N Gel 2:

Longevity Vs Fatal diseases 


By: Sumanadasa Namarathna 


(Sunaparantha Kalyan) 
Ex-Accountant, Justice of Peace 
No.22/1, Udugampola Road, 
Marapola, Veyangoda, 

SRI LANKA 


Email: sunaparantha@gmail.com 











According to the Universal Law, all of us have to meet with death as decided by the fate. As 
well, it is difficult to find any one who has not suffered from any ailment through out the 
life stream. Some diseases are fatal and some are curable. Most of incurable diseases cause 
to death. The modern medical science has concluded more than 10 diseases as incurable 
such as HIV, Diabetic, Cancer, Ebola, Polio, Lupus Erythematosus (skin disease), Asthma, 
Leprosy, Leukemia, Psoriasis etc. All these incurable diseases are not fatal and if the 
longevity is promised an ill fated person can live for his full life span brought by his fate. 
But some diseases like HIV, Ebola, and Cancer are beyond control or cure and the death is 
surely promised if one is attacked by such a disease according to the medical science. 

But astrologically this is not always true. Whether the disease is incurable or curable, if the 
longevity is promised up to some extent, the native will live up to the end of the life span so 
promised. It may be with sufferings from the illness or with regained good health after 
recovery from any disease. If a native is suffering from any incurable disease listed by the 
medical science, and also if the native is destined to have karmic effects to be free from 
disease acquiring his full life span as given by his previous karma, the native will enjoy the 
life with good health. 

The reason for giving such an explanation of diseases, recovery and possessing of Aayush 
with normal good health is to discuss of a native who recovered from the Cancer, a dreaded 
and condemnable disease. 

In the previous issue of KPEZine, Apr. 2015, I have contributed an article based on a case 
study of dual role of Kethu. Now I am taking our esteemed readers to the next node Rahu, 
who too has played a dual role by giving a dreaded disease Carcinoma/ Cancer to a native 
during its main period and at the same time, Rahu have offered the native a happy life with 
good health. 


History of the case 

One day in 2011 August, an officemate of mine rang up me and informed that a close lady 
friend of my office was badly sick with Cancer disease and suggested me to pay visit to her. 
On our visit to her, we understood that she was suffering from lung Cancer and was under 
medical treatments and all the family members including her husband and only daughter 
were frightened with this dreaded disease. There I did some remedies by chanting some 
parts of Pariththa (Pirith) delivered by Lord Buddha for the protection and tied a holy thread 
on her hand, blessed for her early recovery and collected her birth detail as given below to 
see her future life. 


Birth detail 

Mrs. Asoka, Female, 15 Oct. 1962, 04.46 am, Mirigama Hospital, Western Province, 
Sri Lanka, 07N15, 8OE08, Asc. Virgo, 08:58:17, Venus Vimshottari Mahadasa Balance 
12Y, O3M, 14D, KP New Ayanamsa 23° 14' 50" , calculated by KPAstro 4.1

occupant of 6. Sub Lord Rahu is an occupant of 11 with signification for 5 & 6. Rahu 
represents Moon(8-11), Mars (11-3,8) and Saturn (5,6).

Yew Delhi: Former Prime Minister Manmohan Singh said on 
Wednesday he was "upset" by a court here summoning him 
in a case relating to the allocation of coal blocks, but was 
"sure truth will prevail." 

"Of course, I am upset but this is part of life. I have respect 
for the judicial process. I have stated my position before the 
CBI. I have issued statements also justifying what we did," he 
told reporters when asked about the summons issued to him 
by a special court here. 

"| have always said I am open for legal scrutiny. I am sure the 
truth will prevail and I will get a chance to put forward my 
case with all the facts,” Manmohan Singh said, adding he will discuss with his legal counsel 
on contesting the summons. 


Special Judge Bharat Parashar, after taking cognizance of the Central Bureau of 
Investigation (CBI) final report in the coal block allocation case, summoned the former 
prime minister, industrialist Kumar Mangalam Birla and former coal secretary P.C. Parakh. 

The court also summoned Hindalco officials Shubendu Amitabh and D. Bhattacharya on 
April 8. 

The court summoned them under various sections of the Indian Penal Code dealing with 
criminal conspiracy, criminal breach of trust and provisions under the Prevention of 
Corruption Act.

Overseas Travel- 
through sub-lord theory of K.P. 


By: Kaavassery S. Naaraayanan 
“Sopaanam”, IInd floor, # 7, Sabari Cottages, 
1/783(2) : Kalchatty St., Kalpathy
