Ousted Sri Lankan Leader Angles for a Comeback 
Ex-President Rajapaksa leads ethnically charged campaign, vows closer ties to China 


Former Sri Lankan president and parliamentary candidate Mahinda Rajapaksa greeted supporters during the launch of his party 
election manifesto in Colombo on Tuesday. Photo: lakruwan wanniarachchi/Agence France-Presse/Getty Images 

By Gordon Fairclough July 28, 2015 5:27 p.m. ET O COMMENTS 

NAULA, Sri Lanka—Flanked by saffron-robed Buddhist monks, former Sri Lankan President Mahinda Rajapaksa exhorted a 
crowd of more than a thousand supporters at a weekend election rally, saying: “We saved this country. Don't let it be divided 
again.” 

The 69-year-old politician, ousted by voters earlier this year, is seeking a return to office—this time as prime minister—in an eth- 
nically charged campaign mixing economic promises with warnings of resurgent terror by minority Tamils, defeated six years ago 
after a long civil war. 


If Mr. Rajapaksa and his allies win next month’s parliamentary elections, he has vowed to tighten internal security and restore 
strong ties with China, which wants to boost its influence in the Indian Ocean region and was a major funder of development 
projects undertaken by the ex-president. 

Lionized by the Sinhalese Buddhist majority for his government’s crushing 2009 defeat of the Tamil insurgency, Mr. Rajapaksa 
saw his support erode in recent years after what his critics painted as a turn toward authoritarianism, corruption and family 
rule. 

A broad opposition coalition, led by people who used to be some of Mr. Rajapaksa’s closest associates, defeated him in a Janu- 
ary presidential election, after pledging to probe human-rights abuses and graft, restore rule of law and promote reconciliation. 
‘We saved this country. Don’t let it be divided again.’ 

—Mahinda Rajapaksa, former president of Sri Lanka 


The new government under President Maithripala Sirisena has also moved to reset the foreign policy of the island nation, which 
occupies a strategically important spot south of India, strengthening ties with the U.S. and other Western powers as well as In- 
dia. 

That is a sharp shift from Mr. Rajapaksa’s embrace of China, which extended billions of dollars in loans for Sri Lankan infra- 
structure projects and reaped geopolitical benefits: Last year, Chinese submarines made two port calls in the Sri Lankan capital, 
Colombo—a move that raised concerns in New Delhi and Washington. 


KP Ezine August 2015 7 


Mr. Sirisena’s government has cast doubt on the wisdom of some of the projects, such as a port and airport in Mr. Rajapaksa’s 
hometown in the country’s south. It has suspended a Chinese-backed development project that involves creating a massive land- 
fill in the ocean off Colombo. 


There is little independent public-opinion polling in Sri Lanka, making it hard to predict who will win. 

A Rajapaksa victory would be a political irony. 

After his ouster, the new government, seeking to trim the powers of what they had come to see as an imperial presidency, 
amended the constitution to weaken it and strengthen the hand of the prime minister, now Ranil Wickremesinghe. 

For the ex-president, the election battle “is a fight_for political survival,” said Paikiasothy Saravanamuttu, executive director of the 
nonprofit Centre for Policy Alternatives in Colombo. “Rajapaksa Inc., the dynastic project, can’t stay out of power too long or it 
risks destruction.” 


When Mr. Rajapaksa was president, a younger brother, Gotabaya, served as defense secretary; another, Basil, was minister of 
economic development. Mr. Rajapaksa’s older brother was speaker of Parliament and a son was a national lawmaker. Both are 
seeking re-election. 


Gotabaya Rajapaksa is under investigation by anticorruption authorities. Prosecutors have charged Basil Rajapaksa with corrup- 
tion-related offenses. He was jailed for weeks before being released on bail. 

Both men have denied any wrongdoing. “What they have done was take political revenge,” said Gotabaya Rajapaksa. “There are 
so many investigations” of allegations against the Rajapaksa family, he said. “All are baseless.” 

Sri Lankan Foreign Minister Mangala Samaraweera said Colombo is working with World Bank investigators and other nations to 
trace “billions” of dollars that he said had been “siphoned off’ during Mr. Rajapaksa’s term. He said the process is time consum- 
ing and arduous. 


“It’s a lot of money, especially for a small country like ours,” Mr. Samaraweera said. But, he added: “We have to make sure due 
process takes place.” 

Results of another investigation into the conduct of Mr. Rajapaksa’s government, by the office of the United Nations High Commis- 
sioner for Human Rights, which probed alleged war crimes and rights abuses during the last phase of the civil war and its after- 
math, are due to be released in September. 


Mr. Samaraweera said Sri Lanka is working out the details for a domestic mechanism to weigh the U.N.’s findings and “take 
action accordingly.” He added: “Those who suffered in the war also expect justice.” 

Gotabaya Rajapaksa, the former defense secretary who oversaw the final campaigns of the war, said the U.N. investigation pro- 
cess is “very, very unfair” and relied on evidence from biased parties. “How can you say they are credible when we can’t cross- 
examine them,” he said. 

“There may have been certain instances,” involving troops, the ex-defense secretary said. But “you can’t generalize and say the 
whole military is involved in war crimes.” People need to realize “what kind of enemy we were facing,” he said. 

Among other things, Tamil militants used suicide bombers to assassinate Sri Lankan leaders. Thousands of government soldiers 
died in the war. A U.N. report estimates that up to 40,000 Tamil civilians were killed as the conflict ended, a figure the Rajapaksa 
government said was significantly exaggerated. 


Gotabaya Rajapaksa said he and his brother, the former president, support postconflict reconciliation and worked toward it while 
in office. But he said it would be a mistake to ease up on precautions. “You can’t say, ‘our emphasis is on reconciliation, not secu- 
rity.’ That is wrong.” 

“Within a five-year period, you can’t expect everyone to be de-radicalized,” he said. He said some Tamil politicians, many of 
whom are seeking greater autonomy for the Tamil community in Sri Lanka’s north, were saying things that could “encourage 
radical elements.” 

“If you relax these things, you are asking for trouble. You open up a window for people who want to create trouble,” he said. 
“Intelligence agencies, the police, the military must be given freedom, with a legal framework, to do their work,” he said. 


In the central Sri Lankan city of Kurunegala, the war remains fresh in voters’ minds. “A lot of people will vote for” former Presi- 
dent Rajapaksa, said G.M. Siriyalatha, 35. “He did many great things. He ended the war,” she said. One of her brothers was a 
soldier killed when his post was overrun by Tamil guerrillas in 1998. Another was seriously injured in a different attack. 


Others are more focused on what came after. “People were scared. They were scared of the white vans”—vehicles human-rights 
groups say were used by security forces to abduct opponents of the government, said Abeysiri Pallemalla, 62. “It was like a dic- 
tatorship. Now there is law and order.” 

—Uditha Jayasinghe contributed to this article.

Now a days heart failures, heart attacks, heart enlargements, cardiac arrests and other 
related heart problems are on the increase and reasons for them are innumerous. If 
diagnosed and addressed at the appropriate time, many precious lives could be saved. 
Apart from healthy living, medical advices, timely treatment, right and correct astrological 
advices on these lines will also go a long way in guiding the native to take appropriate 
action to avoid any calamities. 








It is said in the "medical astrology" that the natural zodiac signs- Cancer-4th house ruled 
by Moon, Leo- ruled by Sun indicate the heart, and 4th cusp from the lagna in the native's 
chart governs heart and its related problems. When the rasi Leo, Aquarius and the 4th 
cusp in the natal chart is afflicted by the placement of or by any connection through 
Saturn & Rahu (restrictive planets), and Mars —- another malefic indicates heart problems. 
Any sort of affliction to Cancer and Leo apart from fourth cusp from lagna would invaria- 
bly lead to heart problems. 


As per the "Medical astrology for All" by Sri K. Subramaniam- the sub divisions of Leo-- (1) 
Kethu star- sub of Kethu; Moon, Mars, Saturn and Mercury, (2) Venus star- sub of Sun, 
and (3) Sun's star- sub of Rahu are sensitive areas for heart diseases and the related 
problems. 


THE PLANETS-- Moon- lord of Cancer governs chest, breast, heart, lungs, blood 
circulation and karaka for mind which can create tensions and in turn B.P. Mars - 
governs blood circulation, and if afflicted Sun, Moon in Leo / Cancer / Aquarius and 
connected to evil house-6, 8,& 12 would lead to heart complaints. 


Sun rules over heart, lungs, stomach, blood and general vitality. 


THE STARS--- Makha rules heart and spinal cord. 

-- Poorva phalguni rules heart and spinal cord, B.P, swelling of heart, affected valves. 

-- Uttara- pada-1(26.40 to 30.00)--B.P, clotting of blood in capillaries in the brain. 

-- Uttara shada in capricorn (three padas)--palpitation of the heart and cardiac 
thrombosis. 

-- Dhanishta-blood poisoning, heart failures, cardiac thrombosis, high B.P, palpitation. 

-- Satabhisha--rheumatic heart, palpitation, and high B.P. 

-- Poorvabhadra--1,2,3 padas-irregularity in the heart-beat, palpitation, dilated heart and 
low B.P.

WHAT K.P RULES SAY -- Houses to be judged- Ascendant, 6th, 8th and 12th cusps. 

-- Ascendant and its significators will indicate whether the native will maintain good health 
or suffer from any health problems. 

-- 6th cusp indicates disease, its nature and duration of the disease. 

-- 12th cusp indicates hospitalization or treatment elsewhere. 


RULES— 

(1) if Ascendant cusp or 6th cusp sub lord is the signifiactor of 6 or 8 or 12 or the lord of 

the constellation in which the 6th cusp sub lord is posited is in any way connected to 6 or 8 

or 12, then the disease is caused and the native will suffer from such disease. 

(2) the nature of the disease will be indicated by the 6th house. 

(3) if the 6th cusp lord or the star lord in which the 6th cusp sub lord is posited happens to 
be--- 

4) (a) SATURN- it will be chronic, 

b) MARS- it will be acute, 

c) MERCURY- it will be complicated, 

d) RAHU- complication in the diagnosis and in the process of the treatment. 

e) JUPITER- quick and direct. 

4) the disease will arise during the conjoined period of 1 & 6or 1 & 8 or 1 & 12 houses. 

(5)the cure will be indicated during the conjoined period of the signifiactors of 5,7 and 11 

houses.

MAGICIANS/ CONJURORS 

I am extremely happy to express that I have utilized the source and the link of 
www.astrodatabank.com for obtaining the birth data and biography of the magicians/ 
conjurors. 
Magic is (sometimes referred to as stage magic to distinguish it from paranormal or ritu- 
al magic) is a performing art that entertains audiences by staging tricks or creating illusions 
of seemingly impossiblehttps://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Magic (illusion) - cite note- 
1 or supernatural feats using natural means. These feats are called magic tricks, effects or 
illusions. A professional who performs such illusions is called a stage magician or 
an illusionist. Some performers may also be referred to by names reflecting the type of 
magical effects they present, such as prestidigitators, conjurors, Hypnotists, mentalists, 
or escapologists. 





Many different types of effects there are. Some of these are listed below. 


Production: The magician produces something from nothing—a rabbit from an empty hat, 
a fan of cards from thin air, a shower of coins from an empty bucket, a dove from a pan, or 
the magician himself or herself, appearing in a puff of smoke on an empty stage—all of 
these effects are productions. 


Vanish: The magician makes something disappear—a coin, a cage of doves, milk from a 
newspaper, an assistant from a cabinet, or even the Statue of Liberty. A Vanish, being the 
reverse of a production, may use a similar technique, in reverse. 


Transformation: The magician transforms something from one state into another—a silk 
handkerchief changes color, a lady turns into a tiger, an indifferent card changes to the 
spectator's chosen card. 


Restoration: The magician destroys an object, then restores it to its original state—a rope 
is cut, a newspaper is torn, a woman is cut in half, a borrowed watch is smashed to 
pieces—then they are all restored to their original state. 





Transportation: The magician causes something to move from one place to another—a 
borrowed ring is found inside a ball of wool, a canary inside a light bulb, an assistant from 
a cabinet to the back of the theater, a coin from one hand to the other. When two objects 
exchange places, it is called a transposition: a simultaneous, double transportation. A 
transportation can be seen as a combination of a vanish and a production. When performed 
by a Mentalist might be called teleportation. 


Escape: The magician (an assistant may participate, but the magician himself is by far the 
most common) is placed in a restraining device (i.e., handcuffs or a straitjacket) or a death 
trap, and escapes to safety. Examples include being put in a straitjacket and into an over- 
flowing tank of water, and being tied up and placed in a car being sent through a car 
crusher. 


KP Ezine August 2015 29 


Levitation: The magician defies gravity, either by making something float in the air, or with 
the aid of another object (suspension)—a silver ball floats around a cloth, an assistant floats 
in mid-air, another is suspended from a broom, a scarf dances in a sealed bottle, the magi- 
cian hovers a few inches off the floor. There are many popular ways to create this illusion, 
including Asrah levitation, Baldacci, and King levitation. The flying illusion is often per- 
formed by David Copperfield and more recently by Peter Marvey. Harry Blackstone floated a 
light bulb over the heads of the public. 

Penetration: The magician makes a solid object pass through another—a set of steel rings 
link and unlink, a candle penetrates an arm, swords pass through an assistant in a basket, 
a saltshaker penetrates the table-top, a man walks through a mirror. Sometimes referred to 
as "solid-through-solid." 


Prediction: The magician predicts the choice of a spectator, or the outcome of an event un- 
der seemingly impossible circumstances—a newspaper headline is predicted, the total 
amount of loose change in the spectator's pocket, a picture drawn on a slate. 

Many magical routines use combinations of effects. For example, in "cups and balls" a magi- 
cian may use vanishes, productions, penetrations, teleportation and transformations as 
part of the one presentation. 

The methodology behind magic is often referred to as a science (often a branch of physics) 
whilst the performance aspect is more of an art form. 

Membership in professional magicians’ organizations often requires a solemn commitment 
to the Magician's Oath never to reveal the secrets of magic to non-magicians. The Magi- 
cian's Oath may vary, but typically takes the following or similar form: 


"As a magician I promise never to reveal the secret of any illusion to a non-magician, unless 
that one swears to uphold the Magician's Oath in turn. I promise never to perform any illu- 
sion for any non-magician without first practicing the effect until I can perform it well 
enough to maintain the illusion of magic." 

Once sworn to the Oath, one is considered a magician, and is expected to live up to this 
promise. Magicians who reveal secrets, either purposely or through insufficient practice, 
may find that other magicians are unwilling to teach them any more secrets. They are then 
no longer eligible to join IBM (International Brotherhood of Magicians) and are banned from 
magic society.

While judging the horoscopes of the Magicians, the following houses and the planets are to 
be considered:- 


2.4 house:- Wealth, food & drink, right eye, face, speech(Vak), Jugglery of speech; family, 
oratorical ability, clothes, The second house indicates the outcome of one’s labour in 
monetary advantage; self-acquisition. 


34 house:- courage, firmness, skill, ear especially right ear, prowess, parakram, sahodara 
(brother or sister)-younger one, heroism, Mental inclination, One’s ability, memory, inclina- 
tion to study, neighbor, short-travel, communication, roumors, hands, hand trick 
(hastalaghavam);shoulder blade, collarbone, arms and nervous system. Roadside places. 


5th house:- entertainment, recreations, creativity, merriment and amusement, sports, 
artistic talents and gains, progeny, inclinations, pleasure, romance, cinema, drama, opera, 
music, magic, dance, Love-affairs, mechanical art, chanting of mantras and spiritual 
practice, religious-mindedness, profound learning and wisdom, festive occasion, Generally 
all sorts of arts will come under the sway of the 5 house. 


6th house:- It is the house of phenomenal magic and superstition, also matters likely to 
bring worry and annoyance. Loss to the opposite person (automatically gains to the native), 
It shows service, routine monotonous work and drudgery carried on by one under force of 
circumstances whether he likes or not. Rina(debt), asthra, rogasthana(house of sick- 
ness),Satru(foes), fear, humiliation, nursing, over-draft facilities, 


9th house:- Guru or preceptor, father, as pious, previous luck, pooja, tapas, virtues, 
grand-sons, spiritual inclination, all religious institutions such as temples, churches, 
mosques, etc. occult and metaphysical mind, communications with spirits and ghosts, 3r4 
and 9th indicate change or journey away from the permanent residence. 3™4 denotes short- 
travels and 9th denotes long journey, sea voyage, air travel. It is the house of faith, wisdom 
and divine worship. It also denotes the strangers and foreigners. 


10+ house:- Livelihood, Kingdom, Sat-kriya(good deed), commerce, trade, business, one’s 
name, fame, honor and recognition, dignity and public esteem, apex of the horoscope, 
power and prestige, credit and conduct, success and status, rank and renown, respect and 
reputation, ambition and authority, one’s public life and popularity, Worldly activities and 
moral responsibilities are determined with reference to this house only. The chief influence 
of this house is profession, occupation or business. 2-6-10 houses are called the material 
trinity of houses. 

11s house:- Labha-sthana(profit or gain), income from all kinds of receipts, accumulation 
of incoming wealth, acquisition, gain, fulfilment of one’s desire, friends, This house governs 
success in all undertakings, whether it be in profession or business, higher studies, or 
foreign collaboration, election, litigation, speculation, writings, health etc. 


12» house: - loss, negation, bed-comforts, sin, penury, poverty, tale bearer, backbiter, 
decline, misery, legs, final emancipation, drudgery and deception, repayment of loans, the 
limitations and restrictions in one’s way and the unseen or unexpected troubles, secret 
working of the mind; psychic research and occult investigations. Life in a foreign country; 
Life in new environment and separation from family. 


Neptune,( God of the Sea), is the ruler of Pisces; It is the octave of Mercury whereas Uranus 
is that of Venus. It denotes inspiration, dreams, psychic receptivity, illusion, and confusion, 
spirituality, and all things subtle; a youthful, and sometimes naive, rules all visual commu- 
nication such as photography, film, ballet and other dance arts, music, painting and poetry; 
it rules the sea and all other bodies of water. It governs rain, ice, and all kinds of liquids 
such as beverages, alcohol and drugs; Spirituality, dreams, illusions, imagination, idealism

Mercury’s important signification as per Uttara Kalamrita are: - Education; Treasury; 
Mathematics; Knowledge; Speech; Infantry; writing; Green color; astrology and astronomy; 
Commerce; Eunuch; Skin; Worship of Vishnu; Atharvana Vedas; Fond of north -— west 
direction; Well versed in Puranas or major epic; Grammar; Maternal uncle; Yantras; Very 
powerful Tantrik; Self-control; Devotion; Navel; Child ; Humility; strong at sunrise. Lord of 
Mithuna and Kanya Rashis; deeply exalted at 15 degree Virgo and deeply debilitated at 15 
degree Pisces. Mooltrikona sign is Kanya. 

It is the significator of speech. Its complexion is grass colour. The presiding deity being 
Vishnu and it is neuter (it is impotent or neutral) in gender. It represents Earth as an 
element of Panchbhootas (five elements). It represents Vaishya Varna or Commercial 
Community. It has the predominance of Rajsik Gunas. 

Mercury possesses an ability to make fun or to speak words having double meaning, sense 
of humour. He represents the skin and can be found in playground. It is an intellectual 
planet; good in calculations, engineering, accounts, correspondence and computers; It is a 
talkative planet.

performing short -travels (3), long-travel and also meeting with strangers (9) and to 
a new environment even some times to abroad also(12) to earn his livelihood (2-6-10) 
in a successful and satisfactory manner (11).

Back to the Basics in KP Astrology 
By: David Smith Jr. 


PO Box 1168 Davidson, NC 28036 USA 





Email : smith.davidjr@ yahoo.com 





HEE E EEE EE 
Thank you for all the wonderful emails I have been receiving. I do hear your requests that 
you would like to learn more about some of the basics before trying to understand the many 
different charts you are reading in the KPEzine. As you can see, the KPEzine is very power- 
ful and contains a many diverse talents sharing with you their expertise. Thus, I am going 
to scale back for a moment and try to present to you some of the basics so you can get 
yourself on track to understanding the many different charts that are presented in each is- 
sue. Trust me, we all had to start with training wheels on our journey to casting horo- 
scopes. 

The first question I needed to ask myself was, what should I incorporate in my work to get 
you started? I have been very concerned about explaining concepts that were too basic, but 
we all must start somewhere; particularly at the beginning. I could just create a chart and 
have you work from there, but let’s peel the onion of KP Astrology back just a little first. 








Signs, Elements, Planets and More 
There are 12 signs in the zodiac totaling 360 degrees. These signs are divided between 4 
elements. Each element consists of 90 degrees and they are: 


Fire — The three signs under this element are: Aries, Leo and Sagittarius 
Earth - The three signs under this element are: Taurus, Virgo and Capricorn 
Air - The three signs under this element are: Gemini, Libra and Aquarius 
Water - The three signs under this element are: Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces 


e¢e © @ 


Zodiac is of 360 degrees. In this zodiac there are 12 signs. The 12 signs are further divid- 
ed into 4 elements. Every element is made up of 900. First element is fire. In Fire ele- 
ment, there are three signs :- Aries, Leo and Sagittarius. Second element is Earth Ele- 
ment. In Earth element, there are signs named Taurus, Virgo and Capricorn. Third ele- 
ment is Air Element. In it there are three signs named Gemini, Libra and Aquarius. 
Fourth and the last element is Water element. There are three signs named Cancer, 
Scorpio and Pisces. 


Why is it important to know this? Because the elements and signs above represent all eso- 
teric sciences such as tarot, eastern and western astrology, numerology etc.. You see, 
when you cast a chart, you can certainly understand where the planets are positioned 
and what cusps they fall in, but to make even greater predictions, you should understand 
the significance of each. 


For instance, say the Moon is in the third house of a chart, any chart. Well, you may be 
able to determine a plausible result, but what if you find yourself unclear as to why an 
event happened a particular way, and not just happened? Or, you found that the horo- 
scope of the native resulted in more turmoil and unrest than you even thought about? Re- 
member, the Moon represents water, an emotional aspect that creates change in an event 
or change in mind —- the so-called Royal Planet. Water is forever changing, just like the 
fast moving planet, the Moon. Therefore, just saying that Moon is here in this house or 
that house is not enough if you casted a horoscope for someone. What you need to do is 
explain some of the granular details to a client if necessary. 


KP Ezine August 2015 71 


Yes, this is more information for you to know, but understanding the nature or behavior 
of planets, elements or signs can create that subtle result or explain that tremendous out- 
come; separating you from astrologers that just say an event is just going to happen, just 
because that is all they know about planets. When I cast a chart, I want to know why, and 
the knowing certainly helps me understand outcomes much better when it comes to fu- 
ture horoscopes that are cast, or horoscopes I read about. 


Speaking of the Moon, what else could you say the planet represents for the sign? 
What about the fact that it is the mother-like planet that influences a sign or house 
with domestic comforts, milk, all things connected with the sea, clothing, textiles, 
hotel and food industry, all with a cold and calm aura. Furthermore, its direction 
represents north-east. 


Now, let’s pause here for a moment. When you look at any chart, split the chart in 
half and you will see that in conducting a chart about yourself, you will also realize 
that the first six houses can represent your masculine half and the second six 
houses can represent your feminine half. As for the direction of north-east, in a 
northern Indian chart, you will see that this directional territory represents houses 
10, 11, 12 and 1st houses. Thus the influence of the planet actually represents 
whatever the houses represent in that region of a chart at the time you cast the 
horoscope. 


Now, I don’t want to confuse you, so I will not go too deeply into it at the moment, 
but the point is, study the basic elements of the chart, the Northern Indian chart 
and the elements that the chart is made up of, which includes, planets, signs, di- 
rections, elements and so forth, and you will then begin to make really accurate 
predictions, separating yourself from many other astrologers who just say “I don’t 
know”. Peace be with you. Until next time.

Question- 1: Signification at Three Levels of Planet, Star Lord and Sub Lord 


|e 





FOR YOUR OPINION 

I ama learner in KP System. 

IN KP SYSTEM ,THE PLANET IS THE SOURSE OF THE MATTER. 
THE STAR LORD IS REVEALING THE NATURE OF RESULT OF THE MATTER. THE SUB 
LORD IS THE DECIDING FACTOR WHETHER THE MATTER IS FAVARABLE OR NOT. 
When I am reading the books of KP/KPEZINE MAGAZINE/ASTROVISION/JASA ETC the 
above rule is not followed strictly. 

For example: 

In the books of SUB LORD SPEAKS-VOLS 1-3, edited by By Mr K subramanyam, second son of 
KSK. In some of the articles , it was observed that signification of SUB LORD only is taken 
for  frutification of the result , even though the _ star lord does not signify. 


In some articles, it is observed that a planet is a significator of "D” categery, out of ABCD, and 
it is not considered as a significator saying that it is only sign lord and not a significator for a 
particular house. 

IN KPE ZINE SEPTEMBER 2014, HERE MARRIAGE IS PROMISED EVEN THOUGH THE STAR 
LORD DOES NOT SIGNIFY EITHER OF THE HOUSES 2 OR 7 OR 11. ONLY SUB LORD MARS 
SIGNIFY 11. 


There is a contradictory statement by MR TIN WIN in his lessons- KP for beginners Part-9. 

“In order to get the better prediction results all the houses signified by the planet level, star 
level and sub level are to be jointly considered, keeping in mind that the houses signified in 
the two levels opposed by the sub lord signification cannot give the desired results and the 
houses strongly signified at the sub level, even though not signified in the first two levels can 
give the desired results “ 

Mr TIN WIN in some other part in his lessons for beginners stated that even though star lord 
does not signify the matter, if signified by sub lord, the matter will be fructified with difficulty. 


IN THE BOOK “THEORY AND PRACTISE OF STELLAR ASTROLOGY” by PVK Punneswararao 
On page 34, it is clearly stated that star lord signification is required along with sub lord. 
Again on page 40, under note:2, the statement is different. “ if the sub lord or star lord is not 
connected to the relevant houses....... ” 

In view of the above, I am totally confused. 


What I have observed is that Predictions are given in books/magazines: 
When both sub lord and star lord are connected. 
When only when star lord is connected and not sub lord. 
When only sub lord is connected and not star lord. 

WHICH IS CORRECT? 


Answer- 1: 

1. In the books of SUB LORD SPEAKS- Vols 1-3, written by K.M. Subramaniam, compiled 
by K. Subramaniam, second son of KSK, the author takes importance of the sub lord and 
he goes up to the star of sub (now called 4-step method) for better understanding of sub’s 


KP Ezine August 2015 83 


indication. KP is 3-step up to sub only. Among the grade A to E KP significators grade D sig- 
nificator is house(s) owned by a planet. 


2. There is no contradiction in my statements. For better understanding of sub as a decider 
as well as a significator, please read again my article “Double Role of the Sub as a Decider 
as well as an Event Indicator” in the KPE-zine Sept 2014 issue. 


3. In the book “THEORY AND PRACTISE OF STELLAR ASTROLOGY “ by PVK Punneswara 
Rao, 2008 enlarged Edition, on page 34, the KP fundamental rule is mentioned like this “A 
planet transiting in a sign is the source of the event, the lord of the star in which the planet 
is transiting signifies the nature of the event according to its nature, occupation and lord- 
ship, while at the same time the sub lord decides whether the event is favorable or not ac- 
cording to its lordship.” It doesn’t mean that star lord signification is required along with 
sub lord. Here the double role of sub as a decider as well as a significator is to be taken into 
consideration. In following the KP fundamental rule, in order to avoid confusion it does not 
need to consider what is said on page 40, under note: 2, “If the sub lord or star lord is not 
connected to the relevant houses, the Rahu and Ketu representations (as explained in 
Chapter 11 [Note 1] can be taken”. 


4. All the below are correct: 
When both sub lord and star lord are connected. 
When only when star lord is connected and not sub lord. 
When only sub lord is connected and not star lord. 


The bottom line is “In order to get the better prediction results all the houses signified by the 
planet level, star level and sub level are to be jointly considered, keeping in mind the double 
role of sub as a decider as well as a significator”.

Question - 3: Counting the Issue of Children 

I am a learner in K P System. 
I am going through through the ” GUIDE LINES FOR PREPARING AND JUDGING A HORARY 
CHART AS PER KP SYSTEM OR KP PRINCIPLES” By Kuppu Ganapathy in KPEzine Feb-2007. 
Again - KP FOR BEGINNERS PART 11- READING KP HORARY CHART- By TIN WIN in 
KPEZINE-APRIL -2009. 

Kuppu ganapathy article says,” For the sons and daughters of the querist take 5th” Here 
there is no restriction like first child OR second child etc. Tin Win article says ” for first child 
take 5th, second child take 7th”. My doubt is ” WHICH IS CORRECT?” For example, if the que- 
rist refers his first issue daughter- for which house to be rotated?. refers his second issue son 
- for which house to be rotated?. 

The funniest part is, Mr Tin WIN , in his above article referred Kuppu Ganapathy”s above 
mentioned article as reference. 


Answer -— 3: 

The general rule in astrology, both KP and Vedic, is that for a female 5th house is consid- 
ered for 1st child, 7th house for 2™4 child, 9th house for 3rd child and so on, also counting 
the miscarriage(s) over three months of pregnancy. For a male it is to take 11th house for 
1st child, 1st house for 2nd child and 3rd house for 3rd child and so on, and the rationale 
is that the 5th from 7th (Spouse) house is 11th house for lst child. (KP Reader IV, page 224) 


If the querent asks a question about the matter related to somebody else, the chart is rotat- 
ed according to the relation between the querent and the person in question in the solved 
examples of KP Readers. 


Question - 4: Retrogression 

Sir, I request you to give your opinion /compiled notes on retro-gradation of planets in its 
effects& how to apply, in horary as well as in transit....Many times I am not getting correct 
answer because of it...plz sir 


Answer -— 4: 

Not Moving Backward At All: Retrogression means moving backward. The Sun and Moon 
never retrograde. Rahu and Ketu always move backward and so they are not considered as 
retrograde planets. In fact, “other planets, Mars to Saturn, also never really move back- 


KP Ezine August 2015 85 


ward”, and these planets, when retrograde, appear to be moving backward to us here on 
Earth from Geocentric position, i.e. taking Earth as center. This reverse motion is only a 
visual illusion as the slower planet coming backward due to the own motion of the Earth's 
orbit. Like a train passing a moving car, passengers in the train experience the illusion that 
the slower car is moving backward due to the speed at which the train is moving. 


However, this virtual (not actual) retrogression has been stated in Western astrology and 
the Jyotish classic texts, Bhavatha Ratnakara, Brihat Parashara Hora Shatra, Horasara, 
Jataka Parijata, Jataka Tattwa, Phaladeepika, Sanketanidhi, Saravali, Uttarakalamarita 
and also the articles in the special issue on the role of "Retrograde Planets in Astrology" in 
the Dr. BV Raman’s Astrological Magazine, September 1974, by Vedic astrologers, Bepin 
Behari, V.A.K. Iyer, Ajanta Jain, S.K. Kapoor, R. Lakshmanan, Y. Keshava Menon, , S. Jag- 
annatha Rao, L. Narain Rao, R. Santhanam, P.S. Sastri, V.K. Sinha, B. Suryanarayan Rao, 
N. Wiswanathan. The editorial note on that special issue was written by Agastya, not by Dr. 
BV Raman as usual. 


“Dr. BV Raman has been totally silent on the subject of retrogression in his writings” i.e. he 
doesn’t apply retrogression in his way of astrological analysis. 


Among divergent views one thing common is that “retrogression has been mainly considered 
as an indication of strength (chestabal)” because a planet, when retrograde, is nearer to 
Earth and can have its greater impact. 


In both KP and Western astrology, there are two different views i.e. retrogression does mat- 
ter in horary astrology vis retro retrogression doesn’t matter at all based on study of practi- 
cal charts. 


As it is not yet conclusive, follow whichever gives YOU the better results based on experi- 
ence or faith. I do not take into consideration of retrogression.

Book Review-Mundane Astrology 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 





(Binh & 





Mundane Astrology 
by Michael Baigent, Nicholas Campion and Charles Harvey 
HarperCollinsPublishers, 1995, 2™4 Revised Edition, 523 pages 


REL 
ET 





Mundane Astrology is a vummpreliensive amd critical survey of mundane astrology past and 
present. It tackles the problems of formulating a practical and systematic approach to this 
much neglected area of astrology. It covers the history, principles, techniques and applica- 
tion of astrology to analyzing and forecasting trends in national, political, economic and 
world affairs. It shows how to work with the major and minor planetary cycles and As- 
tro*Carto*Graphy to understand the pattern of unfolding ideas in the Collective and where 
they are likely to come to the fore. The authors give a comprehensive study of all known 
techniques for forecasting and a comprehensive bibliography and references for further 
study. A detailed analysis of the astrological background to World War II is used to illus- 
trate the range of techniques. A study is given of the relationship to the charts of countries 
and their leaders and includes an analysis of the charts of some of the world's leading na- 
tions. 

The authors start with Forward to use mundane astrology, which is presented as a valuable 
instrument in successfully predicting major events like the death of Brezhnev from Novem- 
ber 1982, the dissolution of the Soviet Union from 1989, the Pakistan military coup from 6 
August 1990 etc. 


Part 1 —- The Background 

In Chapter 1 —- The Development of Mundane Astrology from the Babylonians to the Arabs is 
a well documented essay about the early history of astrology starting from Mesopotamia 
through Greece, Egypt, Persia, Italy, until the Arabic world. 


In Chapter 2 —- The History of Mundane Astrology in Europe presents the evolution of astrol- 
ogy wit the conclusion is that astrology played an important role being used by the most im- 
portant people in almost every period. 


In Chapter 3 — Mundane Astrology and the Collective, the Jungian terms collective uncon- 


KP Ezine August 2015 87 


scious and archetype (pattern of emotional and mental behaviour) are used to explain the 
psychology of masses and to give some advices about how a mundane chart can work. His 
conclusions are: "1. The mass can act as an individual. 2. The mass is more fated than an 
individual. 3. Natal and mundane astrology bear the same relationship to each other as do 
the individual and the mass - they are at the opposite ends of the same spectrum. 4. A state 
is a expression of the mass, usually centered about a leadership. 5. The birth time of a state 
is that point when the new leadership takes power." 


In Chapter 4 — The National Horoscope: Mundane Astrology and Political Theory, the au- 
thor presents different theories used to determine the appropriate time when a state is cre- 
ated and the natal chart can be erected. 


Part 2 — The Material 
In Chapter 5 — The Great Year the author shows how different cultures computed the Great 
Year which is the Year of the Universe by different cultures, different techniques. 


In Chapter 6 — Cycles in Practice, In the first part the author explains why cycles hold such 
an important place in philosophy and astrology. In the second part one can find the inter- 
pretations for the major astrological cycles of planets, and also a detailed example of cycles 
in mundane astrology in an analysis of the assassination of J. F. Kennedy. 


In Chapter 7 — The Planets and Chapter 8 — The Houses and Signs, the authors presents 
shortly the signification of planets, houses and signs in mundane astrology. 


Part 3 — The Techniques 

In Chapter 9 — Ingresses, Lunations, Eclipses, Charles Harvey states very clear that ingress- 
es and lunations give weak results in mundane astrology. He quotes Charles Carter and An- 
dre Barbault, two of the most important mundane astrologers, which have the same opin- 
ion. On the other side, eclipses and the natal charts are instruments much more reliable for 
predictions and seem to give better results. 


In Chapter 10 — Where on Earth: Astrocartography, the author presents some techniques 
used in mundane astrology to find the place where the events will happen. The first one, As- 
trocartography (ACG), shows the places where a planet is on angles (ASC, MC, DESC, IC) 
and is pretty easy to use with a computer software. Like with ingresses and lunations, the 
author warns us not to expect very good results, because it is not so simple as it seems. 
The second method (Chapter 11) proposed by the author is to find the earth areas which 
correspond to every zodiacal sign. The third method (Chapter 12) is to use the charts of 
towns, but there is one big problem: for the most of cities we don’t know the time of crea- 
tion, the natal chart. 


In Chapter 13 -— Other Techniques, "Charles Carter considered that the chart of national 
leaders, together with the chart of the nation itself, where the times of these are accurately 
known, constitute by far the most reliable basis for mundane forecasting. They certainly 
represent the whole "inner" aspect of forecasting and must therefore constitute one half of 
the process of preparing a forecast." This is the idea accepted by the author who presents 
some examples for the charts of national leaders and their countries: Hitler and Germany, 
Kennedy and U.S.A., Margaret Thatcher and U.K. Then, are presented other techniques, not 
so often used, like: declination cycles, degree areas, degree symbols, fixed stars, the galactic 
centre, the supper galactic center, the solar apex, heliocentric astrology, asteroids, new year 
charts, horoscopes of centuries etc. 


It is well said, "The ex post facto explanation of world events probably employs more differ- 
ent techniques than any other area of astrology. Retrospective analyzes of earthquakes, 
sudden national upheavels, and the latest eye-catching headline call out methods which are 
rarely heard of when forecasts are being made."

Tribute to Leading KP Stalwart 


Sri Vaikari Ramamurthy 
By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 





(BiH 


Sri Vikari Ramamurthy was born on December 3, 1942 at 9:30 AM IST at a place, 13n30, 
80e18, near Chennai, India, KP New Ayanamsa 22:58:12, Asc. Sagittarius 16:54:10, Moon 
Dasa balance 8Y,11M,3D, calculated by KPAstro 4.1. 





For his interest in astrology, the 1st (native oneself) cuspal sub lord (CSL) Moon (mind, men- 
tal inclination) indicates house 5 (intelligence, intuition, past life credit), 8 (mysterious arts), 
9 (astrology in general), 11 (Success and Siddhi) and 12 (occult knowledge) by being in the 
star of own and sub of Mars. Moon is almost exactly conjoined with Neptune (intuition) at 
Virgo 8:48:24. 


Regarding success in astrology in general, his 9th CSL Saturn+ (spiritual concentration) in- 
dicates house 2 (Speaking ability, prediction), 3 (mental inclination), 5 (intelligence, intui- 
tion, past life credit), 8 (mysterious arts), 9 (astrology in general) and 10 (profession for 
counseling, name, honor) by being in the star of Mercury (chief karaka for astrology, intel- 
lectual thought-cells of a studious astrologer), and sub of own. Saturn is conjoined with 
Uranus (astrology) at Taurus 9:16:35. Star lord Mercury is also supported by aspect of Ura- 
nus (astrology) and Jupiter (chief karaka for higher learning and knowledge, intuition, abil- 
ity to attract patronage). 


In order to take profession of astrological counseling, the 10th CSL Rahu+ indicates house 2 
(speaking ability, prediction), 3 (mental inclination), 5 (intelligence, intuition, past life cred- 
it), 8 (mysterious arts), 9 (astrology in general) and 10 (profession for counseling, name, 
honor) by being in the star of Ketu (occult knowledge, Enlightener) and sub of own. Star 
lord Ketu is in Aquarius (astrological sign). Fortuna is also in house 10 making this house 
fortunate. He entered into service on November 28, 1962 in Dasa of Rahu Dasa- Bhukti of 
Jupiter, significators of houses 2,10. Rahut+t in Leo represents Sun which is conjoined with 
Venust+ (significator of service 6,10). 


For success in practicing astrology, the 11th CSL Mercury (chief karaka for astrology, intel- 
lectual thought-cells of a studious astrologer) indicates house 7 (public relations in counsel- 
ing), 10 (profession for counseling, name, honor) and 11 (success and Siddhi) by being in 
the star and sub of own. Mercury is also strengthened by aspect of Uranus (astrology) at 
Taurus 9:16:35, Saturn+ (spiritual concentration) and Jupiter (chief karaka for higher 
learning and knowledge, intuition, ability to attract patronage). 


As per the above analysis, Sri Vikari Ramamurthy can be seen as a renowned KP astrologer, 
author, lecturer and teacher of our time to enjoy good esteem in his life. Apart from this, he 
had good income from consultation from astrology. He had decent good pension. He owned 
a house out of his own earnings to live in although his 4» CSL is Rahu without having own 
house but signifying houses 2,4 and 11. 


Regarding longevity, the 1st CSL’s signification of favorable houses 5, 9, 11 along with unde- 
sirable house 8,12 without Maraka, Badhaka indicates long life over 66 years. He passed 


away on August 21, 2015 in Chennai at the age of 72 years. 


On the day of death the running dasa sequence is Mercury-Venus-Venus-Mercury DBAS.

When my missing pet Punky return? 


By: Kanakkumar B. Bosmia

Question. Is my cat, Punky Brewster, well and will he return to me or has something hap- 
pened to him? 

Number; 213 (out of 249). 

Date of Judgment; 15-11-2014, Saturday; Time of Judgment; 14-22-24 PM IST 

Place of Judgment. Kankariya-Ahmedabad Lat/Long; 23° N 00', 72° E 36’, 

Aynamsha: 23°.58'.28" Dasa days: 365.25 


Hints 
Consider the house 3, 9 and 12 for the missing person counting from his Ascendant and the 
houses 2, 8 and 11 (being 12 to 3, 9 and 12) for returning home. 


If the cuspal sublord of 12 be the significator of 3(away from home), 9(Unknown place) or 12 
a person runs away during the joint period of the significators of 3, 9 and 12. 


If the cuspal sublord of 11 be the significator of 2, 8 or 11(reunion) a person returns home 
during the joint period of the significators of 2, 8 and 11. 


Hints 

3rd house indicates news and 11th house indicates fulfillment of desire. 

If the cuspal sub lord of 3rd house (news) is the significator (i.e. in the star of the occupant 
or owner) of 3 and 11, the querent will hear the news. 


The querent will hear the news when the transiting Moon passes over the same degrees as 
that of the significators of 3 and 11; also when Moon transits the same degrees as that of 
the significator of the 3rd house of the missing person. 


Note: In this case question ask for Pet, thus I will check 4 Cusp Sub Lord (6 is Pet and 
11 from 6th is 4th) 


Cuspal Sub lord 


1st cusp (Aquarius 06°.40’.00’’): The cuspal sub lord of the 1st is Rahu. Rahu is in the star 
and sub of Mars. Rahu is occupant of 8. Rahu is in Virgo sign, hence represents Mercury. 
Mercury is occupant of 9, owner of 5-8. Star and sub lord Mars is occupant of 11, owner of 
3-10. So 1st cusp sub lord Rahu is significator of 11-3-10 and connected with 8-9-5. Hence 
there is no danger to life of missing pet. 


11 cusp (Sagittarius 09°.42’.35’): The cuspal sub lord of the 11 is Saturn. Saturn is in 
the star of Jupiter and sub of Rahu. Saturn is occupant of 9, owner of 1-12. Star lord Jupi- 
ter is occupant of 6, owner of 2-11. Sub lord Rahu is occupant of 8. Rahu is in Virgo sign, 
hence represents Mercury. Mercury is occupant of 9, owner of 5-8. So 11 cusp sub lord 
Saturn is significator of 6-2-11 and connected with 9-1-12-8-5. So it is sure cat will come 
back. 


4th cusp (Taurus 15°.15’.13’’): The cuspal sub lord of the 44 is Jupiter. Jupiter is in the 
star of Mercury and sub of own. Saturn is occupant of 9, owner of 1-12. Star lord Mercury

Marriage promised - But denied! 
What a paradox 


K.P, Unveils the secrets 
By: Gunti Nagaraju KP astrologer 
M.com CAIIB, Retired Bank officer 
12-13-668/5/2, Second floor, Nagarjuna Nagar, 
Tarnaka,Secunderabad- 500 017; 
Tel: 040-27 172206; 9490752371 


Email: gunti.nagaraju@gmail.com

As per the ancient culture, there are three objectives of the samskara of marriage. The first 
is to unite a man with a helpmate after he completes the study of Vedas. This helpmate is 
expected not only to run his household but assist him in the practice of the Vedic dharma. 
The second is to bring forth into this world children of noble outlook and character who are 
to be heirs to the great Vedic tradition, citizens of the future who will be the source of hap- 
piness in this world. The third is to create a means for women to be freed from worldly exist- 
ence. A man who is not yet fully mature inwardly is assisted in his karma by his wife. By 
doing so, by being totally devoted to her husband, she achieves maturity to a degree greater 
than he does. Then there is a fourth objective which is the subordination of sensual gratifi- 
cation to the other three. 








Such are the high ideals of the institution of marriage, which help the individual to grow as 
a full-fledged human being and in turn to realize the very purpose of the birth viz., self 
emancipation. But now a days the institution of marriage is not being properly appreciated 
and has become a puzzling question for many; more so for the youth. Questions like 
whether to marry or not and whether it would be happy experience or otherwise seem to be 
haunting the youth. The science of astrology, if properly analyzed and the secrets are re- 
vealed, helps to understand these subtleties to some extent. 


With this background I would like to dwell upon ten cases of marriage denial for the benefit 
of the readers. 

I have taken ten charts of individuals for my analysis whose marriage is promised but de- 
nied( in most of the cases), with the help of K.P system and their rules on it. The table of the 
individual charts with their birth details is furnished here under and the charts are at- 
tached.

K.P rules for Marriage—if the sub lord of the 7 cusp is a significator of or 7or11 marriage 
is promised and it will take place during the conjoined period of the significators of 2, 7 & 
11 in their Dasa, Bhukthi and Anthara periods. 


K.P rules for Denial of Marriage—Rule no.1- According to K.P. a person is denied of mar- 
riage when the sub lord of the 7 cusp is in constellation of the significator of 1, 6, and 10 
houses — negative houses for marriage (2, 7 &11). (Page 105 — Reader No. 4 by Sri KSK). 


RULE.NO. 1-As per KP system marriage is denied if the 7 CSL signifies negative 
houses 1,6 & 10 along with 2,7 & 11 houses. (Page 105- Reader 4)

Apart from these rules, there is one important factor for marriage which the individual has 
to have is ‘desire for getting married’. This aspect is to be invariably verified by looking into 
the individual’s chart before proceeding further. Saturn, Sun, Rahu and Kethu are the four 
main planets and their impact on the four important houses 2-5-7 & 8 is to be studied 
from this angle. 





In any astrological chart 2°24 house speaks of one’s family, 5+ house speaks of love and 
romance apart from progeny, 7+ house speaks of marriage , and 8th house for sexual desire 
and desire for intimacy with the opposite sex. 


Sir David Frawley in his book "Astrology for seers” says, “Sun, Saturn, Rahu and Kethu 
are the separative planets. They serve to separate or remove us from the things in life that 
they influence.” 

Sun creates independence or burns things up. 

Saturn creates loss, alienation or detachment. 

Rahu is depressing in action and gives an attraction to what is foreign or distant. 

Kethu makes us contract and causes negativity. 

Any of these planets if individually or collectively throw their influence on the — 

--2nd house- it will not allow the individual’s mind to have his or her own family; 

-- on 5t house- will develop a sort of negativity on the very aspect of love and romance in 
the individual’s mind by creating a feeling of taboo on it, there by dissuading the mind from 
interaction with the opposite sex; 

--On the 7th house-will create an aversion for marriage; and 

--on the 8th house—will develop a feeling of frigidity and keep them to be away from the op- 
posite sex. 


Now let us see how far this aspect has an influence on the above charts.

ma_// Ranil Wickremesinghe was sworn in on Friday as Sri Lanka's prime minister after win- 
ning a general election, and agreed with President Maithripala Sirisena's party to form a na- 
tional unity government to push ahead with reforms.// http: //www.reuters.com 


Mr. Wickremasinghe, whose party won the majority of the seats in the parliament at the 
elections, held on 17 August, and secured his victory polling 500,506 votes. It is the ever 
recorded highest number of votes polled by a candidate in Sri Lanka's elections history. 


He is a lawyer by profession, became as the prime minister for the fourth time since enter- 
ing the parliament in 1977. He has also set a record of holding a MP position continuously 
without losing his seat in parliament for 38 years and he was first appointed as the Prime 
Minister from 1993 - 1994 after the assassination of former President Ranasinghe Pre- 
madasa. Also he was elected as the Prime Minister from 2001 - 2004 when the United Na- 
tional Front Government won the parliamentary elections in 2001. President Mr. Maithripa- 
la Sirisena appointed him as the Prime Minister in January this year for the third time in 
previous government.

Longevity 

The Lagna of Swearing-in chart of Hon. PM is Libra (Thula) Libra 06° 25' 28", and the cus- 
pal sub lord (CSL) of Lagna is Moon+, the owner of 10, tenanted in Asc. house (Lagna Bha- 
wa) and also the CSL of house 11, having no planet in its stars. The Moon is in the star of 
Rahu and in the sub of Venus. Star lord Rahu is located in the 12th cusp (Renunciation, 
Misfortune, and End of Office Term). As per the rules of nodes, Rahu represents only Mer- 
cury as no other planet is in conjunction or aspect. Mercury the lord of 9 and 12 is posi- 
tioned in the 11 Badhakasthana and Mercury is aspecting 2 (Maraka) 5 (Poorva Punya) and 
6 (Avajna - humiliation/Enemy/Disease). Hence Moon the main longevity indicator of this 
swearing-in chart is a significator for inauspicious houses 11, 2, 6 & 12 along with 5, 9. 

The supporting longevity indicators of 3rd and 8th cuspal sub lords are further analyzed as 
below. 

The cuspal sub lord of 3rd is Mars, the lord of 2 & 7 (Marakasthana) and deposited in the 
10th house. It is in the star of Saturn the lord of 4 & 5 in 1 but very close to 2™4 cusp 
(Maraka). The sub lord of Mars is Rahu as discussed above. Thus 3rd CSL indicates some 
weak significations of houses 1, 5 & 10 for saving the term of PM. 

The 8th cuspal Sub lord is Mercury (11-9-12) in and in the star of Sun (6-11-11) and in the 
sub of Moon (12-1-10). 

As per the KP rules of longevity, 1, 5, 9 & 10 are benifics and 6, 8, & 12 are malefics. Plan- 
ets in the constellations or in the sub lord of 8, lord of the 8th cusp and planets in any 
manner connected with them are detrimental for the longevity. (KP Reader iii- pp 160 - 161/

Authority 

The sub lord of 10th house for the authority is Saturn. Saturn is the lord of 4 & 5 and 
placed in 1 but in the close proximity to the house 2, in its own star and sub. The PM will 
not be able to keep his authority at its high grade. 


Dealing with Partners 

United National Party lead by Prime Minister Mr. Ranil Wickremasinghe, won the most 
seats in parliament election, but fell seven seats short of an outright majority to form his 
own government and so invited all elected political parties to join with his administration to 
establish a 'government of consensuses'. Meanwhile United National Party and Sri Lanka 
Freedom Party have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to form a coalition govern- 
ment. How ever it has not been fulfilled up to the date of this write up.

political sentiments and should have his own merits to do so. Astrologically the 7th house 
of the swearing-in chart indicates the matters of alliances of the government or any partner 
of the government as well as general public.

acts as agent of Mercury the lord of 9 and 12 and located in the 11th house.

Venus respectively. Thus the 7th and 11th CSLs are not clearly indicating a smooth and 
peaceful association with the partners.

Conclusion as a whole for remaining unmarried of a native: 

Rahu or Ketu is connected to Jupiter i.e. Karkatva of marriage. This connection may be ei- 
ther being situated in Sagittarius or Pisces, aspected or conjoined with Jupiter. 

Rule “D” is most reliable formula to identify case of a native for remaining unmarried. 

Rest of the rules may differ but this is also very common in such cases that the sole signifi- 
cator planets of negating houses i.e. 1, 6 and 10 also become strong significators (by the 
position of being in star of occupant planet in the cusp) of 2,7 and 11, then too there is a 
remote chance of marriage.

The United States of America will host elections for the Presidency in the year 2016. It is 
interesting to see the campaigning that has commenced and the variety of candidates that 
are coming forward in the running for the Presidency. Of particular interest is the possibil- 
ity of Mr. Donald Trump being elected to that high office. Mr. Trump has sparked considera- 
bly controversy in the public with his very unconventional style, brash mannerism and re- 
marks that have caused many some irritation including within the Republicans. Most re- 
cently, his remarks about a lady journalist have seen an outcry about his ill treatment of 
women generally. Does Mr. Trump stand a chance to occupy the powerful Oval Office? 











I have taken details of Mr. Trump’s birth from the Astro Databank and they have included a 
Rodden Rating of AA for his birth details. Which implies that his birth details, as given on 
that database, are as accurate as can be. 


The Wikipedia article on Mr. Trump makes for an interesting reading, especially in relation 
to his foray into politics at different times: 


“Donald John Trump (born June 14, 1946) is an American real estate magnate, television per- 
sonality, politician, and author. He is the chairman and president of The Trump Organization 
and the founder of Trump Entertainment Resorts. Trump's branding efforts, business career, 
outspoken manner, media appearances, as well as his books, have made him an American 
celebrity. He hosted The Apprentice, a U.S. television program on NBC. 


Trump is a son of Fred Trump, a New York City real estate developer. Donald Trump worked 
for his father’s firm, Elizabeth Trump & Son, while attending the Wharton School of the Univer- 
sity of Pennsylvania, and, in 1968, officially joined the company. He was given control of the 
company in 1971, renaming it The Trump Organization. Trump remains a major figure in the 
real estate industry in the United States and a media celebrity. 


In 2010, Trump expressed an interest in becoming a Republican candidate for President in the 
2012 election, but in May 2011, he announced he would not run. On June 16, 2015, Trump 
formally announced his candidacy for President of the United States in the 2016 election, 
seeking the nomination of the Republican Party. Trump's early campaigning has seen him cat- 
apult to high levels of popular support to the consternation of the Republican party leadership. 
Since late July 2015, he has been at the top in the public opinion polls for the Republican Par- 
ty nomination. 

Political involvement 


A 2011 report by the Center for Responsive Politics showed that over two decades of US elec- 
tions, Donald Trump made contributions to campaigns of both Republican Party and Demo- 
cratic Party candidates. In February 2012, Trump endorsed Mitt Romney for president of the 
United States. Trump was an early supporter of Ronald Reagan for president of the United 
States. 

In April 2011, he questioned President Barack Obama's proof of citizenship. Trump also ques- 
tioned whether Obama had good enough grades to warrant entry to Harvard Law School. On

of his birth certificate. Two days later, Obama made a formal statement in efforts by the White

Donald Trump has spoken before Tea Party supporters. In December 2008, Trump emerged as 
an early supporter of the 2009 government backed rescue plan for the US auto industry which 
by 2012 was supported by 56% of Americans (63% support in Michigan), according a Pew Re- 
search Center poll. Statements of Trump's hinting that vaccination would cause autism were 
subject to criticism in various media by the scientific community. He has also been criticized 
for climate change-denying statements, because they are discordant with the opinion of the 
scientific community. 

Trump floated the idea of running for president in 1988, 2004, and 2012, and for governor of 
New York in 2006 and 2014, but did not enter those races. He ran for the presidential nomi- 
nation of the Reform Party in 2000, winning the party’s California primary. As Trump publicly 
speculated about seeking the 2012 Republican presidential nomination, a Wall Street Jour- 
nal/NBC News poll released in March 2011 found Trump leading among potential contenders, 
one point ahead of former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney. A Newsweek poll conducted 
in February 2011 showed Trump within a few points of Barack Obama, with many voters un- 
decided in the November 2012 general election for president of the United States. A poll re- 
leased in April 2011 by Public Policy Polling showed Trump having a nine-point lead in a po- 
tential contest for the Republican nomination for President of the United States while he was 
still actively considering a run. His moves were interpreted by some media as possible promo- 
tional tools for his reality show The Apprentice. On May 16, 2011, Trump announced he 
would not run _for president. Public Policy Polling described the events of May 2011 as "one of 
the quickest rises and falls in the history of presidential politics.” In December 2011, Donald 
Trump was named among the top six of the ten most admired men and women living, accord- 
ing toa USA Today/Gallup poll. 


In January 2013, Trump (who is a notably popular figure in Israel, where his name is at- 
tached to products sometimes without his permission) released a video endorsing Israeli Prime 
Minister Benjamin Netanyahu during the 2013 Israeli elections, stating that "A strong prime 
minister is a strong Israel.” In 2015, Trump was awarded the ‘Liberty Award’ at the 
‘Algemeiner Jewish 100 Gala’ in honor of his positive contributions to US—Israel relations. 
Trump stated: "I have so many friends in Israel.” 

In 2013, Trump was a featured speaker at the Conservative Political Action Conference 
(CPAC). The speech was not well-attended. He spent over $1 million to research a possible run 
for president of the United States. In October 2013, New York Republicans had circulated a 
memo suggesting Trump should run for governor of the state in 2014 against Andrew Cuomo. 
Trump said that while New York had problems and taxes were too high, running for governor 
was not of great interest to him. In February 2015, Trump opted not to renew his television 
contract for The Apprentice, generating speculation that he might run for President of the Unit- 
ed States in 2016. 


Presidential campaign, 2016 

Trump formally announced his candidacy for president of the United States in the 2016 elec- 
tions on June 16, 2015, from his headquarters in Trump Tower in New York City. Trump 
launched his campaign declaring the official slogan, "We are going to make our country great 
again” with a commitment to become the "greatest jobs president that God ever created.” A 
survey conducted by The Economist/YouGov released July 9, 2015 became significant as the 
first major nationwide poll to show Trump as the 2016 Republican presidential frontrunner. A 
Suffolk/USA Today poll released on July 14, 2015 showed a 17% support for Trump among 
Republican voters, with runner-up Jeb Bush picking up 14%. A Washington Post-ABC News 
poll taken on July 16-19 showed Trump had 24% Republican support, over Scott Walker at 
13%. A CNN/ORC poll showed Trump in the lead at 18% support among Republican voters, 
over Jeb Bush at 15%. In CBS news poll from August 4, Trump was again first with 24% of 
support, Bush was second at 13% and Walker was third at 10%.”

In this edition of the Novice Nook, I would like to share with you the components that make 
up an ascendant. Many of us seek the quest of becoming competent astrologers. Whether 
you study KP, Classical, Western or any kind of astrology, this understanding applies to 
them all. In order to be competent, one must understand the combination of attributes that 
create an ascendant. If you fail to know some or many of these attributes, then you will 
eventually find yourself stumbling in creating sound predictions for yourself or your clients. 
Below is a list of questions you need to ask yourself in developing a sound comprehension. 
These questions do not just apply to the sign of Aries, the example ascendant that I used to 
demonstrate the attributes, but to all twelve of the rising signs. 

Your task, if you choose to accept it, is to ask these questions for each rising sign and then 
put them into comprehensive paragraphs. Of course this will not be a quick overnight pro- 
cess, but through time, you will get through all the signs. When you do, you will see many 
more doors of the beautiful science of astrology open up to you; more than words can de- 
scribe by anyone. 

If you would like, send me results, and demonstrate your comprehension of the signs, feel 
free to send me an email at smith.davidjr@yahoo.com. Good luck! 


Questions to be asked when considering the sign of the Aries Ascendant 
1. What element does this sign represent? 
Aries represents the element of fire (representing action, creativity). 
2. What is the modality of the ascendant? 
Cardinal is the modality for Aries 
3. What animal/species does the sign represent? 
Aries represents the Ram 
4. What are the characteristics of the animal/species? 
Moveable, positive, rajasic (bitter, sour, salty vegetation), male, violent, barren and 
quadruped - strong in nature, independent, adventurous, skillful, leaders of packs with 
forceful initiative, industrious, ambitious, quick — acting without care, fighters, authori- 
tative, brave, courageous, heroic, competitive, energetic, enterprising, mental clarity, vi- 
sionary, strong-willed, headstrong, argumentative, offensive, impatient, irritable, impul- 
sive and self-centered. 
5. What is the significance of the animal/species? 
The ram uses its head protected by his horns and driven by its strength. 
6. What body part will this ascending sign represent? 
Aries represents the head/cranium/forehead. (brain, wounds, mental peace, mental ten- 
sion, fevers, short-temperedness, insomnia, diseases of impure blood, bilious diseases, in- 
flammatory disorders, constipation, stammering) 
7. What planet rules the sign of the ascendant? 
Aries is ruled by Mars 
8. What does the ruling planet of the ascendant signify? 
Mars signifies energy 
9. What planet is exalted in ascendant? 
The Sun 
10. What does the exalted planet signify? 
The Sun signifies vitality. 
11. What planet is debilitated in this sign?

Saturn is debilitated in Aries. 
12. What does the planet of debilitation signify? 
Saturn is the planet of sorrow, lethargy and cruelty. 
13. What can now be positively summarized about the ascendant? 
Arians through their energy are most active, strong, aggressive and healthy along witha 
strong Mars. 
14. What can now be negatively summarized about the ascendant? 
When Mars is debilitated, an Arian will experience lack of energy, weakness, sickly constitu- 


tion (particularly if Mercury is strong) and possibly depression

Ruling planets are the planets that rule the moment of an event. Sri K.S. Krishnamurthy the founder 
of the K.P sub lord theory gave more importance to the use of Ruling Planets. To emphasize the im- 
portance of the ruling planets in K.P system it is said by many experienced astrologers “without RP 
there is no K.P”. Highlighting the importance of the Ruling Planets, Sri C.R. Bhatt- the author of fa- 
mous book “Prashna Jyotish” in his book( page no.65) says” if any question about an event may re- 
late to a minor or major event, to happen within a short time can be answered by R.Ps. when there 
is strong desire, keenness, anxiousness, eagerness or urge from within to know the result about any 
matter, then and there only you may predict with the help of ‘Ruling Planets’ alone, and you may 
prove correct”. In his famous book Reader No.6 (page 128) Sri KSK himself writes “as, invariably in 
all cases, without any single failure, using ruling planets one can decide correctly the nature of the 
event, and predict precisely the moment, what one can understand.” 





Drawing inspiration from the decisive statement of Sri K S K, I tried to solve one small question on 
horary basis using only Ruling Planets and using Sun transit only. 


(This is worked out on 31 January 2015) 

On 31 January 2015 evening suddenly I felt curious to find out an answer to my question “when my 
brother in law, who went to his son's place Bangalore for a short stay, will come home back". Immedi- 
ately I arrived at ruling planets at 17:41:29 hours at Secunderabad and tried to solve the query only 
through Sun’'s transit. 


The ruling planets on 31-1-2015 at 17:41:29 hours @ Secunderabad, Telangna state are: 


Day lord: Sign Lord StarLord Sub Lord 


Day: Saturnday Saturn 
Ase: Cancer 11°.35’.57” Moon Saturn Moon 
Moon: Gemini 08°.38’.52” Mercury Rahu Rahu 


Ketu represents Mercury who was in retrograde motion as on date. 
Since Saturn was appearing twice in R.Ps I thought that there would be some delay in his arrival and 
since he has gone only for a short stay it may not exceed a month's time. 


The sub lord of Moon who is Rahu and is powerful as a node representing Mercury is in retrograde 
Mercury sub, I thought the event will not materialize until Mercury becomes direct in its motion. 
Mercury becomes direct on 12 Feb 2015. 


On 12-2-2015 Sun will be transiting in Capricorn and Aquarius on Mars star up to 19-2-2015. Sat- 
urn the sign lord is in R.P but the star lord Mars is not in R.P and so I could not consider Mars to 
give the result. 


From 19-2-2015 Sun will be transiting on Rahu star. 

Rahu is a powerful R.P which is reflected twice in the list. So I thought that Rahu should give the 
result. Now we are left with Mercury and Moon in R.Ps. After considering Saturn (SGL) and Rahu (as 
STL) from the list of R.Ps, I am left with the next fast moving planet Mercury. So I have selected Mer- 
cury as sub lord to fructify the event. Sun comes on to Mercury sub in Rahu star on 13.04.00 to 
14.26.00 longitude on 26-2-2015 at 5.30.00 AM on Wednesday. 


Hence I have come to a conclusion that my brother in law will come home in the early hours of 26-2- 
2015 by train.

Question - 1: Six Fold Signification 
Don't you think your bellow statement is nothing but six fold signification? 





The bottom line is “In order to get the better prediction results all the houses signified by the 
planet level, star level and sub level are to be jointly considered, keeping in mind the double 
role of sub as a decider as well as an event indicator’. 


Answer - 1: 

According to the KP fundamental rule: "The planet is the source, constellation indicates na- 
ture of the result and the sub is a deciding factor whether the matter is favorable or not.", 
when the required house(s) for a matter under study, e.g. house 2,7,11 for marriage, are in- 
dicated by the planet or/and its star, the indication of its sub is to be considered as favora- 
ble decider if it is 2,7,11, or unfavorable decider if it is 1,6,10, in selection of fruitful signfi- 
cators. If the required house(s), 2,7,11, are not indicated by the planet and its star, the indi- 
cation of required house(s), 2,7,11, by sub is to be taken as an event indicator. 


In the six fold signification, as sub is taken as the outright significator it cannot play the 
role of decider as mentioned in the KP fundamental rule, and consequently sub can not be 
used as a tool in selection of fruitful significators without using the ruling planets. So the 
six fold signification is excluded in the six KP readers of 1970-71 although it appears in a 
few places of “Krishnamurti Padhdhati Vol. 2” of Sagar Publications in 1966.

Question - 5: Aspect of Rahu and Ketu 

The nodes te. Rahu and Ketu has aspects as per traditional system, just like Jupiter 5,7 & 9 
houses aspects from its occupation. Is it applicable in KP as some of the KP astrologers are 
not applying as they are mathematically calculated points and not planets? 


Answer -— 5: 

The Moon's nodes, Rahu and Ketu, are not physical planetary bodies which can be seen 
through a telescope as we can see all the other planets. They are the imaginary points of in- 
tersection between the Sun's apparent orbital path around the earth, the ecliptic, and the 
Moon's orbital path around the earth. So logically these imaginary points of intersection, the 
nodes, cannot aspect any planet or house, and they are called shadowy planets. 

Maharshi Parasara did not mention the nodes’ aspects in his classic Brihat Parasara Hora 
Sastra. In the BPHS translated by R. Santhanam, Rajan Publications, page 255, chapter 26: 
"Evaluation of Planetary Aspects", verses 2-5: “All planets aspect the 7th fully. Saturn, Jupi- 
ter and Mars have special aspects respectively on 3rd and 10th, 5th and 9th , and 4th and 
Sth “. Sage Varahamihira also did not exclusively touch Rahu/Ketu in his classic Brihat Ja- 
taka.

Election Day Chart 

The election day chart is the transit chart calculated at the beginning of the day, ie. Sun- 
rise time (6:05:53 am, hr 6:30 east) of election day (8 November 2015) in the capital Yan- 
gon by its geographical coordinates. 


In this chart the common practice is to take Lagna for the favorite party, NLD, and 7 
house for the opponent USDP. Five planets Moon, Mars, Jupiter, Venus, Rahu and also 
Fortuna are all in the 11 house of gain and success for the NLD. Planet of change Ura- 
nus (Pisces 23:23:36) is also opposing these four planets Moon, Mars, Venus, Rahu and 
also Fortuna. No planet is in the 7‘ house for the ruling party USPD. Thus the election 
day chart is indicating a better chance for NLD to win. 


Myanmar Independence Chart 
The Vimshottari dasa of 120 years intended for human life is not logical to apply for the 
nation charts, and such charts can be longer than a cycle of 120 years, for instance USA. 


Election day transit Neptune (Aquarius 12:58:57) is in the 4th house of the opposition par- 
ty NLD. Transit 4t lord Saturn is in the 12th house of independence chart, i.e. 9+ house 
from the 4th house of the opposition party NLD. Transit Jupiter is in the 10 house of the 
ruling party USDP; Jupiter is lord of 2™4 and 5th house of independence chart, i.e. unfavor- 
able 5t and 8th house from the 10 house of the ruling party USDP. So the Myanmar in- 
dependence chart indicates a better chance for the NLD to win. 


Lunar New Year Chart 

The lunar or Hindu new year chart 2015 is when Sun and Moon are in exact conjunction 
in Pisces 5° 28' 34" on 20 March 2015 at 4:06:04 am, hrs 6:30 east, at the location of cap- 
ital Yangon. 


Saturn in the 4 house of the opposition party NLD; Saturn is lord of 6 and 7 house of

is in 8‘, lord of lord of 4 and 9t house, i.e. 5t, 1st and 6 house from the 4th house of

10% house of the ruling party USDP. Here also 3", 6th and 7 indication for the NLD 
shows a better chance to win than 6t indication for the USDP. 


NLD or USDP

Concern for Danger to DASSK’ s Life 

DASSK’s Lagna lord Jupiter's aspect on her Lagna from 9th house in her birth chart had 
saved her from danger to her life on 5 April 1989 when she courageously walked toward ri- 
fles aimed at her by soldier during election campaign in Danuphyu, and on 30 May 2003

Assassination 

Generally the word "Assassination" is used to express the idea of "Murder" or violent death 
or the action of killing someone, where "Kill" stands for dispose or get rid of life. But tradi- 
tionally, the term "Assassination" means to kill for political or religious motives, as pene- 
trated in the general public even today. According to my personal point of view, we should 
not adhere to this standardization of the usage of the term, because the KP rules for any 
type of murder or violent death could be satisfactorily applied even in the assassination as 
well. 

Application of Assassination rules for the death of Bobby Kristina 

The latest rule enunciated by Sri Kanak Kumar Bosmia, the editor of this treasured E- 
Magazine KPEZ, is as below. 

"If 8 or 12th sub lord signifies 8, 12 then one can be assassinated in the Dasha, 
Bhukti and Anthra of the significators of 8th and 12tt houses." 

As explained above, both 8th and 12th sub lords are signifying 8 & 12 houses in her natal 
chart. At the time of the death i.e. 26th July 2015, the native was running Saturn Maha 
Dasa (12), Bukthi and Anthar of Jupiter (8) and Mercury (8) Sookshama. 

Also on the day of her fatal accident, falling into bath tub, she was under Saturn (12), Rahu 
(12 by way of Mars), Moon (8) and Jupiter (8) as DBAS. Thus the above rule can be found 
satisfied in both incidents under discussion, evidencing that the death is a murder. 
Furthermore, I have found some similar linkages of probability of this type of brutal mur- 
ders when tabulating the outcome of my research in assassination, done in 2009. Among 
them, the following reasons are found important to note. 

1. Saturn played a detrimental role in all the natal charts and majority of the incidents have
