Every now and then a particular question comes up that is out of the ordinary, leading one 
to ponder over both its unusual significance and the manner in which such a question 
may be astrologically analysed. 








Procreation is a prime function of life. Life gives rise to life. The species propogates itself. 
Child birth is a natural phenomenon and, as Hindu philosophy suggests, the moment of 
birth is pre-ordained by the almighty. The Soul takes its human body depending upon its 
past karmas, and the moment of birth shows, to the trained eye of an astrologer, the 
course of life that this Soul must take in order to fulfill its destiny before the cycle of birth 
repeats itself. 


Can the moment of birth be pre-selected by the parents of the child? Can we as 
human beings “select” the exact moment for the birth our children, thereby 
influencing their destinies into a course that is optimum for their lives? Can human 
beings “interfere” with the cosmic scheme of things that, according to our beliefs, 
are unalterable? Can our knowledge of astrology lead us to select the “perfect 
moment” to “allow the perfect birth” to occur? 


Indeed, if we could “choose” the right moment for all events in our life, would we not be 
capable of ensuring that our lives are filled with success and happiness and that we 
minimize, if not avoid altogether, problems and sorrows in our lives? Are we, truly, 
masters of our own destiny? 


As KP astrologers, we have been able to predict in many instances the exact moment of 
birth of children. In many instances, maestros of KP Astrology have been able to cast birth 
charts (Nativities) based on their predicted times of birth in advance of the actual birth of 
the person. Masters of the Padhdhati are able to make such accurate and precise 
predictions because the stellar maps bear a clear relationship with the divine plan. KP is 
predicated on the fact that whatever is destined will happen with or without our human 
intervention in trying to alter it. If that was not the case, there would be no certainty of 
events and astrology would be futile. 


This article, however, is not about the philosophy of astrology, or of karma or God’s 
scheme for life. It is about human intervention versus God’s will showing that the latter 
clearly overrides any effort on our part and brings about the event as per divine dictates. 


Very recently, I was invited to attend a ceremony to mark the maturing of a lady’s 
pregnancy. What would have been a normal event roused my curiosity as a KP student. I 
was informed by my wife that the lady in question (the sister-in-law of my wife’s friend) 
had PLANNED TO HAVE HER DELIVERY AT THE HOSPITAL BY CAESARIAN PROCE- 
DURES ON A PARTICULAR DAY. 


What makes this case interesting is that the lady is herself a doctor. She has planned the 
delivery for a particular day. As of date (16 August 2015) she has about two weeks to go 
before that planned delivery. In the normal course, the delivery was due at a later date by 
natural means. However, she had had her first child delivered by Caesarian procedures.

Guatemalan former comedian leads field in presidential election first round 


A former television comic is heading for a runoff with either a wealthy businessman or a 
former first lady in voting for Guatemala’s next president, days after the Central American 
country’s leader resigned over a corruption scandal. 

Guatemala’s president spends night in jail after resignation. With more than 96% of polling 
stations reporting, comedian Jimmy Morales, who has never held elective office, was leading 
with 24% of the vote. 

Businessman and longtime politician Manuel Baldiz6n and former first lady Sandra Torres 
were in a tie, each with about 19.4%. Baldizén led Torres by less than SOO votes among 
nearly five million votes cast. The top two finishers in the field of 14 will advance to a runoff 
to be held on 25 October. 

Analyst Christians Castillo said Morales’s surprising performance was a sign of voter 
discontent, “a vote of punishment” against more traditional candidates. Electoral officials 
estimated a nearly 80% turnout. 

The candidates in Sunday’s election faced an uncomfortable challenge: trying to win votes in 
a nation where the former president Otto Pérez Molina remains in court custody awaiting a 
decision on whether he will be tried on graft charges. 

Most of the candidates were old-guard figures picked to run before energised prosecutors 
backed by a mass anti-corruption movement toppled Pérez Molina’s administration. Many 
voters were so sceptical that they campaigned for the election itself to be postponed to give 
them a new crop of choices. 

Morales boasted of his outsider status and said he is part of the uprising against corruption. 
He has promised greater transparency, including media review of government contracts. 
Baldizén had led most polls with roughly 30% backing. His running mate is accused by 
prosecutors of influence trafficking, but as a candidate enjoys immunity from prosecution. 
Baldizén has acknowledged Guatemalans’ disgust with crime, corruption and impunity. His 
campaign website vows a “modernisation of the democratic state” to reform government and 
combat poverty and social inequality. 

Torres divorced former president Alvaro Colom ahead of the last presidential race to try to 
get around rules barring presidential relatives from running, but was still ruled ineligible. A 
businesswoman and longtime political party figure, she is proposing a coalition government 
to respond to the concerns of outraged citizens. 

A key question going into the election was the level of protest vote in the face of the customs 
corruption scandal, which also forced Pérez Molina’s previous vice-president, Roxana 
Baldetti, to resign. She, too, is accused in the scheme. But the number of null or blank votes 
was minimal. 

Guatemalans were also voting for vice-president, members of congress and the Central 
American Parliament, and local authorities for municipalities nationwide. 


Election will be on 25-10-2015

MOON: 
Moon is in 2 and rules the 7, It is in the Star of Jupiter in 8, and it rules 3-12. Moon is in 
the Sub of Venus in 7 and it rules 5-10. 


Moon signifies and is connected with all the relevant houses. It is connected with 2,3,7,8, 
and 12 as well as 10 for profession, name, fame and honour. Thus, the horary chart accu- 
rately reflects the question. 


Let us now see how these rules apply one-by-one: 
1) For inimical action against any person, the 12th must strongly signify itself. 


12th CSL is Jupiter in 8 and rules 3-12. Star is Venus in 7 and rules 5-10. Sub is Sun in 8 
and rules 8. The 12th strongly signifies 2,3,8 and 12 (there are no planets in the 12th. 
Therefore, the owner strongly signifies the house of its ownership). Additionally, at the sub 
level, Sun is in the 8 along with Jupiter who rules the 12. 


From this perspective, the 12‘ house significator strongly signifies the 12th house and has 
led to the inimical action against Mr. Blatter. The investigation is on-going. 


2) For authorities to take action against a person, the 10th must signify 7,8 and 12. 

10th CSL is Saturn in 10 and rules 1-2. Starlord is Saturn itself. It is in the Sub of Mercury 
in 9 and rules 6-9. The 10th does not directly signify 7 or 8 or 12. However, please note that 
Saturn is aspected by Mars in 7 having positional status with no planet in its stars asa 


grade E significator. Thus, 10th CSL is connected with 7 through Mars. 


Action against Mr. Blatter will include legal proceedings as well (apart from just the investi- 
gation) due to the involvement of the 7 bhava that stands for legal processes. 


3) For a person to be jailed the 12th must signify 2,3,8 and 12. 
12th CSL is Jupiter in 8 and rules 3-12. Its Starlord is Venus in 7 and rules 5-10. Its Sub is 
Sun in 8 and rules 8. The 12th strongly signifies 2,3,8 and 12 (there are no planets in the 


12th. Therefore, the owner strongly signifies the house of its ownership). 


The 12th CSL, therefore, signifies all the bhavas necessary for imprisonment i.e. 2,3,8 and 
12. While the Sub lord of the 12th is not Rahu, Sublord Sun conjoins Rahu. 


Now the question is when he could be subjected to incarceration or other penalty? 
Significators are: 

2 = Mercury, Moon, Ketu, Saturn 

3 = Moon, Jupiter, Mars, Ketu 

8 = Sun, Rahu, Moon, Jupiter 

12 = Moon, Jupiter 


All in all, the significators are = Mercury, Mars, Moon, Ketu, Saturn, Jupiter, Sun, Rahu. 
(Venus is the only planet that does not appear).

Question - 1: Not KP’ without consideration of the CSL's’~ sub 
In judging the cuspal sub lord (CSL) whether the matter concerned is promised or not, is it 
sufficient to consider up to only the star level of the CSL as said by K. Hariharan in his KP 
training workshops/seminars? or is it required to considered up to the sub _ level? 





Answer - 1: 

Only 3-step consideration of the planet, its star and sub is KP as KP is the sub lord theory 
only, nothing else. Without consideration of sub of the CSL, it is not KP at all. 

The reasons to consider up to the sub of the CSL are _ as _§ follows: 


1. Judge Each planet. The planet signifies a matter. Whether it votes for the progress and 
prosperity or due to the "sub lord” it is not capable doing good, further it does harm to that 
bhava signified by the planet, is to be studied.”This discovery (of sub) has crowned me with 
success.” (KP Reader III page 144/ Original 1971 Edition, Theory Part pages 137-138; KP 
Reader V page 144/ Original 1971 Edition pages 137-138; KP Reader VI page 81) 


2. In considering the sub of the CSL, Venus is the sub lord of the 7th house. Venus in 12 in 
the star of Jupiter in 2 and “sub” of Saturn in 9. Saturn rules houses 7 and 8. So, according to 
Krishnamurti Padhdhati, we should hastily declare that Venus in 12 is bad. Actually, he sig- 
nifies houses 2, 9, 7, 6, 8 in order of strength. Also Venus owns house 11 and is posited in 12. 
Hence even though matters appear unfavourable still Venus brings out success. (KP Reader IV 
page 173) 


3. Whether it is a planet or CUSPAL SUB LORD (also a planet) these are ‘controlled’ by the 
relevant sub lord and its signification only. As regards to a planet, the matter is seen through 
the star lord of that planet and the SUB LORD of that planet ‘decides’ the result & how the 
matter is altered & enjoyed and suffered by the native.(K.M. Subramaniam: last 60 article 
of 'Sublord Speaks' LX in the “K.P. & Astrology Year Book 1998” page 69/ reprinted in 
“SUBLORD SPEAKS” book -— part 3, page 141) 


4. Such consideration of sub is practiced by almost all KP article contributors in the K.P. & 
Astrology Year Books, whenever it is relevant. 

https: //groups.yahoo.com/neo/groups/k p system/conversations/topics/37032°? 
threaded=1&l=1 


5. It is therefore required to CONSISTENTLY consider the signification of a planet, 
whether it is a CSL (which is also a planet) or a Dasa/Bhukti/Antra/Sookshma lord, at 
three levels of planet, its star and up to its SUB, as consistently done in all solved 
examples of the best narrated KP books by Sri Chandrakant R. Bhatt, particularly 
Nakshatra Chintamani, Further Light on Nakshatra Chintamani and Prashna Jyotish. 


6. Otherwise without consideration of the sub of CSL, wrong conclusion of no 
marriage would be taken in the following ‘AA’- rated married charts (AstroDatabank 
4.1, now at www.astro.com) which show that the significance of 2,7 or 11 only at the sub 
level of the CSL is the sole event indicator for giving the promise of marriage, without 
signification of 2,7 or 11 in the planet and its star level of the CSL because the star is more

Question —- 2: 
In Prashna Jyothish (even in Sri.Kanak Bosmia’s narrations) it is broadly used for 
significations of events as - 


Ex- If 10th CSL be the significator (in the star of the occupant or owner) of houses 2,6 or 10, 
service or earning is promised during ----. Here the KP 2 step theory is applied ie. upto star 
level only. Whether it still holds good as it is now clear that KP is sub lord theory (3 step) and 
not the stellar (2 step theory). 


Would it not be sufficient to mention as CUSPAL SUB LORD BE THE IGNIFICATOR OF 
REQUIRED HOUSES ......... 
Kindly clarify. 


Answer - 2: 
Example 10. Employment — When shall I get a job? (Chandrakant R. Bhatt: Prashna Jyotish, 
pp 100-101) 


Hint: - If 10th cuspal sub lord (CSL) be the significator (in the star of the occupant or owner) of 
houses 2,6 or 10, service or earning is promised during the joint period of significators of 2, 6 
and 10. 


The sub lord of 6% and 10 is Mercury. Mercury is in the star of Venus and sub of Rahu. Its 


star lord owns 2 and sub lord Rahu occupies 11. So Mercury is the significator of 2 and 
connected with 11. Hence service is promised to the querent. 


KP Ezine October 2015 52 


AS we're aware and shown above, in all Shri Bhatt’s KP books, 3-step consideration of 
planet, its star and sub is consistently applied in judging the signification of a planet 
whether it is a DBAS lord or CSL (also a planet) although emphasis is given to the star 
lord’s signification by saying “...be the significator (in the star of the occupant or owner) of 
houses ..” . 


It is sufficient and practical to mention as CUSPAL SUB LORD BE THE SIGNIFICATOR 
OF REQUIRED HOUSES .........

Answer —- 3: In subtracting KP ayanamsa from the ADB Western sayana chart, to get the 
KP Eastern nirayana chart, KP Lagna sign will change one sign backward if the sayana La- 
gna degree is less than KP ayanamsa; Lagna sign will be the same if the sayana Lagna de- 
gree is less than KP ayanamsa. 


In example 1, in the ADB Western sayana chart, Lagna is Cancer 08°52', by substrating KP 
ayanamsa 23:10:47, we get the KP Eastern nirayana chart, Lagna Gemini 14:41:13. 


In example 2, in the ADB Western sayana chart, Lagna is Scorpio 12°02’, by substrating 
KP ayanamsa 23:26:36, we get the KP Eastern nirayana chart, Lagna Libral18:41:24.

OF CRITICAL ILLNESS 





This book is a study of early-warming patterns of serimis illness in the horoscopes of

municate the indications of the horoscope to the client in a sensitive manner. The author 
explains how aspect patterns in natal/transit charts relate to the onset and development of 
specific body weaknesses and critical illness of congenital problems, cancer, lifestyle-related 
troubles like heart attack, and even suicide. The author creates acceptance for an aspect he 
terms the "quindecile" an aspect whose degree some other astrologers do not agree with. 
The history of medical astrology, and the predisposition to pathologies as indicated by the 
chart, are also explored. Case studies of 70 horoscopes, including those of Arnold 
Schwarzenegger, Ernest Hemingway, Marilyn Monroe, Betty Ford and Carl Sagan are pre- 
sented with guidelines for assessing one’s potential health risks. The author suggests a 
partnership with modern medicine, and a tactic to ward off disaster before it happens.

that he resign for the good of FIFA.

days while investigations into payments made to Michel Platini were conducted. FIFA’s 
president since 1998, he has appealed the suspension but has been prohibited from all 
activities related to soccer — including visits to his office at FIFA headquarters — until he is 
cleared.

The famous quote by David Tredinnick - "Astrology is a useful diagnostic tool which 
enables us to see the strengths & weaknesses in a birth chart" truly sums up the 
significance of medical astrology in helping mankind stay forewarned of the imminent 
diseases. 

Dr. David Frawley, a famous western astrologer consistent with his specialization in 
oriental medicine that includes Ayurveda, goes on to medical astrology -humors, diseases, 
constitution and psychology, and writes in detail in his book "Astrology of the seers". 


In this regard Sri K S Krishnamurthy- astrology wizard of our times , has gone a step 
further and propounded his theory of sub lord through his famous K.P. system to help the 
astrologers to arrive at correct and accurate results through his set of rules. And medical 
astrology forms a part of it also. As a student and practicing astrologer, I venture to discuss 
on an unusual and critical topic called "Lung/Pulmonary Fibrosis" under medical astrology. 
Lung/Pulmonary fibrosis (literally "scarring of the lungs") is a respiratory disease in which 
scars are formed in the lung tissues, leading to serious breathing problems. Scar formation, 
the accumulation of excess fibrous connective tissue (the process called fibrosis), leads to 
thickening of the walls, and causes reduced oxygen supply in the blood. As a consequence 
patients suffer from perpetual shortness of breath. 

In some patients the specific cause of the disease can be diagnosed, but in most of others 
the probable cause cannot be determined, a condition called idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. 
There is no known cure for the scars and damage in the lung due to pulmonary fibrosis. 
Some people get worse quickly, while others live 10 years or more after they are diagnosed. 
There are therapies to help you breathe easier. In some cases you may be able to have 
a lung transplant. 

Some people get pulmonary fibrosis when they're exposed to something in their 
environment, like pollution, certain medicines, or an infection. But most of the time, doctors 
don't know what causes IPF. That's what "idiopathic" means. 

The effect of planets on each sign, house and on each other plays an important role on the 
health in general and on specific organs in particular. This effect will be felt during 
particular Dasa Bhukthi and Anthara periods of concerned planets. Some chronic or 
permanent disabilities occur in accordance with the placement of malefic planets in certain 
positions. Occasional physical disabilities and disturbances occur due to the astrological 
factors in time and space. The signs in the zodiac, the planets and the houses considered 
from the native's lagna and moon sign also have their own peculiarities pertaining to certain 
organs. To study the health aspect the significance of sign, house and the planets should be 
super imposed and synchronized.

possibility of ‘child birth’ mainly through ‘5% houses analysis with other houses and 
planetary impacts. There were neither scientific techniques to assess the potential of child 
birth in married couples nor In Vitro Fertility (I.V.F) technique. Time has changed now. 
Today, research in fields, Medical science as well as astrology, is going on. Shri B.V Raman, 
a learned astrologer has explained in his book ‘Jatak Nirnaya’ about how to assess the 
capacity of male and female to reproduce through Vedic birth chart. We see in K.P despite 
5th cusp connection with 2, 5 and 11 some married couples are not blessed with children. 
Thus, there is a need to assess potency too with analysis of 5t4 cusp. I observed in a few 
cases and found that rule is beneficial for correction while predicting child-birth and also 
suggesting the best period for I.V.F. I suggest that the following procedure can be adopted 
while predicting the possibility of the birth of a child. 


Step 1: Assess potency of male and female 
Step 2: Analysis of 5th house or cusp. 
Step 3: Prediction of child-birth or successful IVF 


Potency Test Formula 
In male, ‘seeds’ are known as deciding factor to reproduce. In females, a ‘Region’ is the 


place as deciding factor to reproduce. While calculating the place of seeds and region in 
birth chart, either if one falls in weak position, then despite connection of 5 house with 2, 
5 and 11, there will be difficulty in birth of child. If position of seeds and region are both 
weak then there may be infertility. In that case, during D.B.A. of 2, 5 and 11, astrologers 
can suggest I.V.F. 


Way of conclusion 
If seeds are placed in odd sign and region falls in even sign then potency is said to be 


normal. There'll be no problem in child birth if 5 cusp signifies 2, 5 and 11. If either of 
seeds and region fall in opposite sign or either of them is conjoined with Rahu the there'll 
be a great difficulty in child birth. But in that case if 5 cusp signifies 2, 5 and 11 then 
during D.B.A of 2, 5 and 11 I.V.F may be helpful in birth of child of that married couple. In 
that case, the concern, male or female that has weak potency has to be advised for medical 
treatment before I.V.F. If both seeds and region fall in negative position then there is no 
possibility of child birth despite connection of 5 cusp of 2, 5 and 11. From Vedic 
perspective, we can see the position of 5t+ house with a way of its lord position, house 
surroundings, aspects etc. and position of seeds and region in navansh table with the help 
of remaining degrees left in step two as stated already while finding the sign in which seeds 
and region fall. 


Step 1: For Male, find the total of cumulative degrees of planet Sun, Venus and Jupiter in 
birth chart. In case of Female, Jupiter, Mars and Moon will be considered. 

Step 2: Deduct 360 degree if total is more than 360 degree.

Breast Cancer - A case study 


By: Sriyani Ranathunga 
Asgiriya (West) 
Gampaha (WP) 
Sri Lanka 
EMail - ranatunga_ s@yahoo.com 








INTRODUCTION 

According to the medical news, breast cancer is the second most common cancer for 
women after skin cancer. But so far the medical science has neither revealed the particular 
reason for this dreaded disease nor any fixed preventive treatment. The breast is made up 
of glands called lobules that can make milk and thin tubes called ducts that carry the milk 
from the lobules to the nipple. Breast tissue also contains fat and connective tissue, lymph 
nodes, and blood vessels. 





The most common type of breast cancer is ductal carcinoma, which begins in the cells of 
the ducts. Breast cancer can also begin in the cells of the lobules and in other tissues in the 
breast. Invasive breast cancer is breast cancer that has spread from where it began in the 
ducts or lobules to surrounding tissue. 


The first sign of breast cancer often is a breast lump or an abnormal mammogram and so it 
can be easy to diagnose by a lab test. But it will be too late to enter into a way to cure. Not 
only in the case of breast cancer, but in any abnormal condition of the bodily health also, 
astrology, especially KP astrology comes as the first and foremost tool to reveal the facts. 
BIRTH DETAILS OF A BREAST CANCER NATIVE 

Senani, Female, 13/Oct/1983, 07:56:00 AM, De Soyza Maternity Hospital, Colombo,

DISEASE ANALYSIS 

Disease indicator 6th cuspal sub lord is Rahu (cancer causing planet), in house 8 (chronic 
disease, surgery); aspected by Jupiter (Karaka for cancer) in house 1, owner of houses 3 
(breast), 6 (disease), the CSL of house 3 (breast) having no planet in its stars; and in Taurus 
representing Venus in house 10, owner of houses 1,8 (Serious disease, surgery). Rahu is in 
the star of Mars (blood, surgery) in house 10 (treatment not effective), owner of houses 2 & 
7 (Maraka), and sub of own. 

Further, Rahu in the star Mrigasira (Muwasirasa) denotes corrupted blood. Rahu is 
astrologically associated with morbid and erratic growth and swellings causing pain and 
discomfort which is despised. Rahu is therefore the key symbol in interpretation of 
horoscope to signify cancer disease. Rahu is astrologically associated with morbid and 
erratic growth and swellings causing pain and discomfort which is despised. Rahu therefore

The above points indicate the disease of breast cancer.

Questions & Answers 
By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 





(Bin 





Question- 1: Retrogression in KP Natal Analysis 

What is your personal experience about the retrograde plane’s behavior in natal charts? 
Especially when the current running Mahadasa or bukthi or antara lords become retrograde 
during transit. Prof. Hariharan did a workshop here in Sri Lanka and I got that his experience 
about this matter is bit different than Prof. KSK. So please share your PERSONAL EXPERI- 
ENCE about this not about what KSK has said. 


He and his son has invented another theory that when you are judging a natal chart for some 
question if the relevant cusp’s sub (natal sub) is retrograded at the moment of judgment then 
the matter will not come through. For an example if you are judging a natal chart for marriage 
and the 7th sub (natal ) is retrograded at the moment of judgment then the native will not get 
married until the current running dasa is over. 


Answer- 1: 
Retrogression doesn’t matter in analysis of natal charts whether DBAS lords are in retro or 
not. Consideration of DBAS lords in retro is against Prof. KSK’s findings. 


Retro controversy is in KP horary analysis only. As the result of horary analysis depends on 
the number given by the querent according to his urge and the time of judgment as per 
astrologer’s urge, it doesn't matter in horary analysis if you don't believe it. “Dr BV Raman 
has been totally silent on the subject of retrogression in his writings” i.e. he doesn’t apply 
retrogression in his way of astrological analysis. Follow whichever gives YOU the better 
results based on experience or faith. 


In my personal experience, retrogression doesn’t matter in analysis of natal as well as 
horary chart. This reverse motion is only a visual illusion, not moving backward at all, 

as the slower planet coming backward due to the own motion of the Earth's orbit. Like a 
train passing a moving car, passengers in the train experience the illusion that the slower 
car is moving backward due to the speed at which the train is moving. Among divergent 
views, “retrogression has been mainly considered as an indication of strength (chestabal)” 
because a planet, when retrograde, is nearer to Earth and can have its greater impact. 


Question-2: True or Mean Nodes in KP 

Do you use true or mean Rahu in KP? Please explain. 

Mean Rahu is used in KP because the True Rahu is True only twice” a month when the 
Moon crosses the ecliptic and other positions provided for the times in between those two 
points are just a hypothesis. The Mean Rahu is always retrograde as said in the scriptures 
of Parasara and Jaimini's teaching. The True Rahu may occasionally be direct and are 
stationary for several days at a time, as if they are wobbling. The True Rahu can differ from 
the Mean Rahu by up to 1 % degrees. 


Question- 3: Ruling Planets in KP 
Could you explain about the use of Ruling Planets in KP. 


Answer- 3: 
1. The ruling planets are the planets which rule the moment at the time of judgment of any 


KP Ezine November 2015 84 


query. 
2. The original 5 ruling planets are listed below in their order of preference: 


1) Ascendant star lord 

2) Ascendant sign lord 

3) Moon star lord 

4) Moon sign lord 

5) Day Lord (Hindu Day from sunrise to next sunrise) 

(It is also to include the Nodes tenanting the signs of the RPs.) 


3. The emerging trend is inclusion of more planets as ruling planets, mostly the sub lords of 
Ascendant and Moon. 


4. The ruling planets in retrograde do not prevent the event to take place but will only give 
the result when they become direct in motion. Generally reject the ruling planets which are 
posited in the star or sub of retrograde planets if one has faith in retrogression. 

5. The RPs are generally used for: 


A. selecting the fruitful significators assuming that “the ruling planets at the time of 
judgment of query would be the same ruling planets at the time of fructification of the 
event in question”; 

B. birth time rectification assuming that “the ruling planets of the time of judgment would 
agree with the ruling planets at birth time”; and 

C. fast or short term predictions 


6. There has been a lot of discussion on the Ruling Planets, and there are very divergent 
views on the RPs usage among the KP followers. 


7. It is to note that everything can not be predicted by using the RPs because they are 
supposed to be only the selective tool but not predicting tool. The success of RPs may 
depend on the urge of both the consultant and astrologers. 


Question- 4: Failure of many predictions of BJP win in Bihar Election 2015 
sir if u don’t mind may i request you to elaborate why most prediction abt bihar failed. 


Answer- 4: 

Horary prediction can give different results for the same event depending on astrologer, 
time, place and rule applied. And it can also give different results by applying the same rule 
depending on astrologer, time and place. Another possibility is astrologers’ over confidence 
on Modi’s wave.

Life is nothing but the process of completing our accumulated give-and-take accounts 
that are a direct result of our deeds and actions. The accounts may be positive or negative 
depending on the positive or negative nature of our actions. To put in Banking parlance, the 
accounts may be ‘Deposit’ accounts or ‘Loan’ accounts. As a rule of thumb, in the current 
era some portion of our lives are destined (not within our control) and other portion of lives 
are governed by our own freewill. All major events in our life are by and large destined. 
These events include our birth, the family we are born into, the person (or persons) we 
marry, the children we have, serious illnesses and the time of our death. The happiness and 
pain that we give and receive from loved ones and acquaintances are by and large simply a 
case of past “Deposit? and ‘Loan’ (give-and-take accounts) directing the way relationships 
unravel and play out. 











All of us are very curious to know about our life. It means that everybody wants to know 
how long one may live. To solve out this puzzle we consult astrologers. The determination of 
longevity is a difficult task and it is dependent upon a large number of factors. Astrology 
distinguishes between three aspects of the problem that is the duration of one's life span, 
the actual cessation of the life- force and the manner in which one leaves the mortal coil. 

An accident or mishap is an unforeseen, unplanned, unexpected and undesirable event, 
especially one resulting in damage or harm or even death. The first thing that comes to the 
individual's mind is that he/ she is having a bad time and/or the planetary positions are 
not favorable. Everything that happens in the life of an individual is influenced by Planets. 
Road accidents are no exception and have become quite common these days due to increase 
in traffic on the roads. A good astrologer can advice better how to avoid these high risks 
moments of life. 


With this background I would like to discuss on the subject -" Death of a young couple by 
an accident" with the help of their natal charts. The details of the natives are furnished 
below.

tem", has clearly explained following rules for longevity-- 

Assessment of longevity---span of life as K P system----

From 33years to 63 years------ Medium Life. 

From 63 years to 73 years ------ Long Life.

will be Badhaka sthana. 

If the ascendant falls in Fixed sign (TAURUS, LEO, SCORPIO, AQUARIOUS)-9th houses will 
be Badhaka sthana. 

If the ascendant falls in common sign (GEMINI, VIRGO, SAGITTARIOUS, AND PTSCES)--7th 
will be the Badhaka sthana. 


MARAKA STHANAS- 

Whatever be the sign in which the ascendant falls - 2 and 7 houses are the Maraka 
sthanas. 

Therefore it becomes imperative to judge all these three houses-ASCENDANT- BADHAKA 
AND MARAKA and find out the significations for assessment of one’s longevity. 


K.P RULES- 

1)IF THE SUB LORD OF THE ASCENDANT OR THE STAR LORD , IN WHICH STAR, THE 
ASCENDANT SUB LORD IS POSITED.,--- 

A) Is the significator of 6 or 8 or 12--SHORT LIFE IS INDIACTED (Up to 33years of life) 

B) Is the signifdicator of 1 or 5 or 9-- LONG LIFE IS INDICATED (63years to 73) (except 
when it is a badhaka sthana 10th house is considered for long life instead of 9th house i.e., 
10th not connected with Maraka and Badhaka sthanas). 

C) is the signifucator of the above A and B groups-- MEDIUM LIFE IS INDICATED. (33years 
to 63 years) 

D) THE DEATH MAY OCCUR DURING THE CONJOINED PERIOD OF THE SIGNIFICATORS 
OF BOTH BADHAKA AND MARAKA STHANAS. 

E) If the ascendant is aspected by Jupiter or Saturn, the life span may be increased. If the 
Saturn is posited in the 8th house and is in exalted position, then also the Life span may be 
increased. 

F) The date of death should never-repeat- never be predicted. We can say that she / he will 
live for So many years. 


2) ACCIDENTAL DEATH--- Sri K.S.Krishnamurthy in his book "Horary Astrology"(page 
nos.158-159) explains it in his terms as "In astrology, there is nothing like ‘Accident’. 
Astrological dictionary does not have this word because, for every result there is a cause. 
Therefore, even that which is termed by people as ‘Accident’ is something which happens 
when least expected but not without a cause. Anything that is a surprise and an 
unexpected alone is called as an accident, whether the result is favorable or not." 

Therefore, the sub- lord of the 8th house is to be deposited in the constellation of the planet 
which is the significator of the 8th house. 

If the sub lord of either the Ascendant or the 8th house cusp is posited in the star of the 
occupant or the owner of the 8th or 12th house, there will be an ‘accident’. 

1) If the significator happens to be also the significator of the 6th house as dusthana, which 
also signifies ‘accident’, then he will have fever, etc., following the accident. 

2) If the same sub lord is in the star of a planet who is also is the significator of the 12th, he 
will be admitted in a hospital. 

3). The danger of the individual’s life becoming fatal is likely if the sub lord is in the star of 
either the occupant or the owner of the 8th, 7th, or 2nd. 

4). The individual will survive the accident if the sub lord is in the star of either the 
occupant or owner of the 2nd, 7th, and 11th. 

5) If the sub lord happens to be the significator of Badhaka sthana and Maraka sthana, he 
will succumb to death by accident, provided his longevity is not further more promised. 

6) Accident will occur during the conjoined periods of dasa - bukthi- antara of 4-8-12 sub 
lords. 

All the three, that is Star, sub and sub sub lord have to signify the relevant houses of 2,7,12 
for death and also 8th for accidental death. 


OTHER RELEVENT HOUSES CONNECTED WITH DEATH--- 
1) Rising sign at birth time also play an important role. People born in Aries ascendant are 


KP Ezine December 2015 17 


the most prone to accidents, than Virgo born natives. Aries lagna born natives have excess 
of energy which they can’t control. Aries is impulsive and fast. Pisces ascendant born 
natives are also prone to accidents as they can’t take decisions quickly due to their weak 
reflex action. Libra ascendant born natives are well balanced and hence they are not 
generally prone to accidents. The signs most prone to accidents are in fact the mutable 
signs; these are Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius and Pisces. The Jupiter ruled signs Sagittarius 
and Pisces, commonly indicate careless accidents, and the Mercury ruled signs Gemini and 
Virgo are prone to diseases of the mind. In short, natives born with Ascendants in the fixed 
signs (Taurus, Leo, and Aquarius) are less prone to accidents. They do not like changes, 
experimentation and hence they follow a fixed routine which probably is the reason. 

2) Planets in the chart Mars and Saturn Rahu Ketu are associated with Accidents. 

Mars is the symbol of getting hurt. Mars is the lord of blood and violence, firearms, 
explosives, weapons. 

Rahu gives sudden events in life. So it represents suddenness/sudden accidents in life. 
Venus signifies vehicles and so it is important when it comes to accidents by vehicle. 

Saturn is responsible for the accidents occurred by iron or machines and animals. 

Moon is responsible for the accidents happened by water. Ketu in the 8thth house causes 
accidents. 

Mercury rules transport in our immediate environment including bikes, scooters, cars, etc. 
For any immediate transport accident we look to Mercury, Gemini, or the 3rd house. For 
long distance travel we look to Sagittarius, Jupiter or the 9th house. 

The position of Uranus and Neptune is also said to be vital when it comes to 

accidents. Uranus is the planet of surgery and sudden accidents. Usually accidents are of a 
freak or unusual nature. Uranus in the first house seems to attract accidents. Neptune 
indicates drowning accidents 
3) Terminal houses-We know that the 8th, 12th and 4th houses are most important in a 
lacerating the secrets of death. Because they are the Terminal Houses or karmic houses, the 
Fourth, Eighth and Twelfth, corresponding to the Emotional Triplicity of Signs, are 
concerned with the three most mysterious phases of life; the Fourth- the end of physical 
man; the Eighth- the liberation of his soul; the Twelfth- his secret aspirations and his 
disposition in the after-world. 

The ‘terminal houses’ of the 4, 8 and 12 houses emerge as vital to our growth as human 
beings. They are the houses of Cancer (4th), Scorpio (8th) and Pisces (12th). They are 

“terminal” only in the fact that you will be working consciously daily, on whatever emotional 
wounding (provoking emotions) you have in this lifetime. It is a house of water and 
therefore, symbolizes our emotions. 

4) Western Aspects play a vital role in this aspect also. Saturn and Pluto, along with Mars, 
Uranus, Rahu and Kethu are the universal significators and the Opposite (180 degrees), 
Quincunx (150 degrees distance), Square (90 degrees distance), Semi Square (45 
degrees) and Sesquiquadrate(135 degrees) aspects between these two(SAT & PLUTO) 
planets and other malefics play a vital role in the case of the accidental death.

Shiv Sena Threatens To Pull Out Of Alliance With 'Arrogant' BJP In Maharashtra 
A municipal corporation poll may be the undoing of the Shiv Sena-BJP alliance in Maharash- 
tra. The strained relationship between the two parties ran into more trouble yesterday after 
Sena chief Uddhav Thackeray threatened to pull out of the alliance and Maharashtra CM 
Devendra Fadnavis retorted, saying BJP will not be intimidated by threats. 





Differences between the parties spiked ahead of the Kalyan Dombivali Municipal Corporation 
(KDMC) elections. The Indian Express reports: "It was set in motion after senior Shiv Sena 
minister Eknath Shinde submitted his resignation as guardian minister of Kalyan and 
Dombivali to Thackeray on Friday. However, Thackeray rejected the resignation and publicly 
warned the BJP to shed its political arrogance. In turn, Fadnavis, who addressed a party ral- 
ly in Kalyan Friday, told the Sena not to undermine the BJP and that his party was not 
“wearing bangles”. 


Trouble started brewing when BJP began campaigning aggressively for the civic elections in 
Mumbai's suburbs, where the Sena is contesting in 122 seats. Anxious about not letting BJP 
take over the local bodies in Maharashtra - traditionally Sena strongholds - the party started 
pointing an accusing finger at BJP'’s failures in governance. The latter hit back at Sena too, 
accusing them of misconduct. They also traded accusations of their respective cadres attack- 
ing the other.

Signs and Symptoms of the defect 

Imperforate anus is a birth defect that occurs in about one of every 5,000 newborns. It is 

somewhat more common in boys than girls and may include a single abnormality or a 

combination of abnormalities of the rectum and anus. The rectum is the end of intestine 

that connects with the anus and the anus is the body's opening to dispel solid waste. 

Although there is no known cause for this condition, there are many forms of this birth 

defect, including: 

e The absence of an anal opening. 

e An anal opening in the wrong position, usually a very small opening. 

e An abnormal connection or opening, called a fistula, between the rectum and the 
urethra, bladder or vagina. 

e In girls, the rectum, urethra and vagina can join together to form a single opening. 
This is called a cloaca and is very rare.

Question 1: Rule for Second Marriage 

I ama learner in KP astrology. The native is a deversee. (may be male or female). The native 
comes for prediction for his/her second marriage. How we will proceed to answer his/her 
question? Is it the similar way as if it is FIRST marriage? OR any special procedure. 


Answer 1: KP rules for checking for more than one marriage 

Rule 1: More than one marriage is indicated if BOTH the following two conditions are 

simultaneously satisfied: 

1) The sub-lord of the 7 cusp OR its star lord is deposited in a dual sign (Gemini, 
Sagittarius, Pisces) OR if the sub lord of the 7 cusp is a dual planet Mercury; and 

2) The sub lord of the 7 cusp is also a significator of either of the houses 2 or 11 or 
both. 

If any of the above two conditions is not satisfied, then second marriage is denied. 


Rule 2: Second marriage is indicated if the sub lord of the 2nd cusp is also a significator of 
either of the houses 7 or 11. (considering 24 house for 2™4 marriage). 


Rule 3: Second marriage is indicated if the sub-lord of the 9th cusp is a significator of 
either of the houses 2 or 9 or 11. (considering 9" house for 2™¢ marriage) 


Check by ALL three rules, and then GIVE the prediction on more than one marriage. 


Question 2: Grade E Significator by Conjunction/ Aspect 

I want to ask for horary analysis do we have to consider the aspects of planets also other 
than nodes. If sub and star lord are against an event then whether conjunction or aspects of 
planets works? Plz help me solving the query. 


Answer 2: 
The planet is the source, constellation indicates nature of the result and the sub is a de- 
ciding factor whether the matter is favorable or not. 


Grade A significator is planets in occupant’s stars; grade B significator is occupant of 
house; grade C significator is planets in owner’s stars; and grade D significator is house 
owner. Weak grade E significator is planets conjoined with/ aspected by the above grade 
A, B, C and D significator planets, and this grade E significator is used as a last resort 
when signification is not found at grade A to D level by planet’s occupation and owner- 
ship. 


Star lord is stronger than planet and sub lord is the decider. So if sub and star lord are 
against an event, then conjunction or aspects of planets (grade E significator) can not 
work.

Teaching profession and analysis 


through KP system 


By: Gunti Nagaraju KP astrologer 
M.com CAIIB, Retired Bank officer 
12-13-668/5/2, Second floor, Nagarjuna Nagar, 
Tarnaka,Secunderabad- 500 017; 

Tel: 040-27 172206; 9490752371 


Email: gunti.nagaraju@gmail.com 
BER ERHRHRHRHRHRHRHERHRHRHRHRHRHERHERHRHRHRHERHERHEHERHERHRHRHEHEHEHEHEEEHE EB 


Education in India started many years before 5000 B.C (many years before Sri Rama age) or 
one can say that Vedic knowledge came along with human civilization. 

The following objectives were ascribed to education 

*]. Self control 

* 2. Development of character. 

*3. Generation of sociability or social awareness. 

*4 Integral development of personality. 

*5.Propogation of purity. 

*6.Preservation of knowledge and culture. 

Education during those days was free. No outside agencies could interfere in the matters of 
education. There was perfect autonomy. No external authorities, no external beneficiaries, 
no politics were permitted to enter the school or college system. A student had nothing to 
pay in return for his education he received in Gurukul or Ashram. Access to education was 
dependent not in wealth but on talent only. 

GURU in Sanskrit means--GU- invisible darkness and RU- dispelling it. 

Teacher will sow the seeds of education and grows in us the tree of knowledge which in later 
ages bears the fruits of wisdom. That was the sacred duty of our respected teachers in our 
life. 

In Olden days there were “Gurukuls” where children were joined for their educational pur- 
suit till their teenage. But now, the picture is completely changed and we have schools and 
colleges (also universities) to pursue our education. We join our children in schools at their 
tender age till they develop into an adult. This is a very important phase in our life, and 
what we learn during this time will become our character or personality in later age. And 
the real sculptor who chisels our character is our “Teacher”. 

With this background I would like to discuss on teaching profession with reference to K.P 
System with the help of a chart of a teacher (native) who has been working as a teacher for 
the past 28 years in Central School. 











Details of the native 

Smt LEELA G.M. HYDERABAD. 

DOB-04 FEB 1960/ TOB-08:30:55 A.M 
POB-PEDAPROLU (A.P) (LAT-16N0O5 AND LONG-80E55) 


Teaching as profession and K.P system 

1) K.P Rule—10th house speaks of one's' profession and if the 10 cusp sub lord signifies 2- 
for earnings, for expression and teaching capacities, 6- service/ job,11- fulfillment of one's' 
desire along with supporting house ,4- for primary education and 9-higher education, one 
will get in to teaching profession. 

For good progress in ones' teaching profession- strong Jupiter, Saturn and Mercury are 
needed as Saturn shows patient effort, Mercury shows grasp and intelligence and Jupiter 
indicate the wisdom of that soul. Also the strength of Asc. 5th house, 9th house and 11th 
house need not be emphasized Though 3rd shows tendency to study and 4th shows the ac- 
ademic education 5th and 9th are more important than them. Jupiter and Saturn are the 
chief significations and if they are strongly connected with 4, 5, 9 and 11 houses one will 
definitely have sound knowledge in their subject, says our astrology legend Sri 
K.S.Krishnamurthy.

A client of mine approached me to know astrologically whether an amount of Rs. 50,000/- 
(fifty thousand only) which is given to his neighbor as hand-loan will be returned or not? If 
so, when? 





He gave me Horary No.5/249. DOJ=28-10-2015; TOJ=01-06-00 PM; POJ=Kurnool 
(A.P).The horary chart is enclosed at the end of my analysis for the benefit of the readers 
of this magazine. 


Moon indicates the nature of the mind of the querent. In this horary chart, Moon(1-5) is in 
the star of Venus(5-2,7) and in the sub of Saturn(8-11,12). Moon holds the sub- lordship 
of 6 and 10% cusps and does not having any planets in her stars. So the question raised 
by my client is correct. 


Lagna CSL Mars(6-1,8) is in the star of Venus(5-2,7) and in the sub of Ketu(12). Ketu is 
aspected by Mars(6-1,8) and Mercury(6-3,4). Thus Lagna CSL Mars signifies 6 and 2. 


11t CSL Rahu(6) is in the star of Sun(7-6) and in the sub of Saturn(8-11,12). So fulfil- 
ment of the desire (recovery of money which is given as hand-loan to his neighbor) is 
clearly visible. 


RULE:- If the 6 cusp sub lord signifies 2, 6 or 11 then only one can get back his dues. If 
the Sublord is Saturn, then there will be delay and some obstacles to recover. If it is Mer- 
cury, One will correspond, give notice, send agents and One will recover in instalments. If 
it is Jupiter and ill deposited, one gets easily through court or by lawful means all the le- 
gitimate amount. If Saturn aspects Jupiter, One recovers only a part of it, or part by part. 
If Mars is the sublord, one threatens the other and recovers. Even goondas may be of real 
use. If Moon is the sublord, very quickly money is regained._ If Venus is the sublord then 
by compromise and sweet words, one fulfils his desire. If Sun is the sub lord, through the 
help of the government officials or by litigations one gains. 


In this horary chart, the 6 CSL Moon(1-5) is in the star of Venus(5-2,7) and in the sub of 
Saturn(8-11,12). Moon holds the sub- lordship of 6% and 10 cusps and does not having 
any planets in her stars. So I told my client that his amount will be returned to him. Im- 
mediately he asked me -When?

Question 1: Aspects on Rasi in KP 

I amin need of some clarification on ASPECTS in KP. 

I am following the contents of http: roups.yahoo.com/group/k_p system/files "Hindu 
Aspects with Orb” (14.06.2012), which is similar to Vedic as used in my basic education of 
Vedic and no question at all. 

But in the Placidus Bahawa chart, when a planet aspects a sign, where there is not any cusp 
in that sign, what are the results of aspecting planet? 

I have attached a chart appearing such a condition. 

In the chart, 9 house is running from 9th cusp (28.31.21 Cancer) to 10th cusp (01.01.51 Vir- 
go). It means that 9 house is spreading from 28.31.21 area of Cancer sign, throughout whole 
area of Leo, up to 01.01.51 of Virgo. 

In case of planets within the above said area of longitude are usually considered as 
the planets in the 9th cusp. As of Ur in the chart, it is considered in the whole area 
of the 9th house. 

Now my question is, 

In the attached chart Ve, Sa, Me in 3rd house aspect Leo sign by their 7th aspect, 
where there is no cusp appearing but amalgamated with 9tr house. In this case, 
there may be effects of aspecting planets to that sign Leo or matters or diseases of 
Leo or its lord Sun. 

Can you please shower your kindness in solving this?

Rasi Chart and Cusp Chart 
The above South Indian style ‘rasi chart’ gives the relative rasi positions with boundary lines 
of ‘rasi after rasi’ of Hindu zodiac for correct use of rasi-based Hindu aspects. By inserting 


KP Ezine January 2016 38 


the Placidus cusps and placing the planets in the houses, the house-based chart denotes 
the correct occupation and lordship of planets in finding KP significators. (Example chart in 
KP Reader I, page 144). 


Hindu Aspects 

In the solved examples of the KP six Readers, only the Hindu aspects are used without con- 
sidering the orb, although it is encouraged to study the Western aspects. The Hindu aspects 
(Drishtis) are counted ‘from rasi to rasi’, irrespective of the positions of the planets in the 
rasis and the relative distance between the two planets i.e. not ‘from degree to degree’ like in 
the Western aspects. Planets aspect the entire rasis with or without any planet or cusp 
there, and the closer an aspect on any located planet or cusp is, the stronger the result 
would be. 


Area of a House 

It is true that the area of 9 house is from 9th cusp in Cancer, through Leo sign, up to next 
10th cusp in Virgo. Whatever planet(s), here Uranus, located in this area is considered in 
the 9th house. Leo sign without any cusp appearing is called the intercepted sign. 


Aspect on Rasi 

In the attached chart Ve, Sa, Me in 3rd house aspect Leo sign where there is no cusp but 
amalgamated with 9 house. In that case, generally some may consider the effects of as- 
pecting planets on that sign Leo. 


KP Grade E significator 

But remember that whatever aspt or conj. is not a significator, and grade E significators by 
aspt/conj. are those planets aspt/conj. by grade A,B,C,D significators. Even grade E signifi- 
cators are very weak and used as the last resort only.

Question 2: Aspect of Rahu/Ketu 


I do agree with many astrologers that Rahu and Ketu are not planets, therefore no aspect or 
Dhrsti is available for them. What is your opinion and why . It will enrich our knowledge. 


Answer 2: 

In KP the shadowy planets Rahu and Ketu (Nodes) do not aspect any planet or any house 
since they are only the sensitive and powerful intersecting points in the pathway of Sun and 
Moon and they are not having any physical body which can be seen through a telescope as 
we can see all the other planets. 

The significators of Rahu/ Ketu are the house occupied, conj. planets, aspecting planets, 


KP Ezine January 2016 39 


star lord and lord of the sign where located. 

Those who do consider Rahu and Ketu to have aspects, generally consider them to aspect 
the 5th, 7th and 9th, similar to Jupiter's aspect. 

However, none of the astrological treatises ascribed to any of the rishis gives aspects to Ra- 
hu and Ketu. Trying to use planetary aspects for Rahu and Ketu would be misleading anda 
source of confusion when making predictions. (Vault of the Heavens: Treatise on Vedic As- 
trology by Ernst Wilhelm, page 196) 


Question 3: How can astrologer’s Moon reflect querent’s mind? 

Dear Sir, 

I fail to understand as to how the position of the Moon in a chart drawn according to astrolo- 
gers place and astrologers time will reflect the mind of the questioner. 


Answer 3: 


Such a common practice is not logical, in other words the position of the Moon in a chart 
drawn according to astrologer’s place and astrologer’s convenient time will not reflect the 


mind of the questioner.

Jimmy Carter-Cancer diagnosis i a= 


Ezine 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 








In August 2015, at age 90, Carter was diagnosed with melanoma which had metastasized to 
his liver and brain, and he began treatment which included surgery, immunotherapy, and 
radiation therapy. On December 6, 2015, Carter, now 91, announced that he was 
cancer-free. 


Cancer diagnosis 


On August 3, 2015, Carter underwent elective surgery to remove "a small mass" on his liver, 
and his prognosis for a full recovery was initially said to be "excellent". On August 12, 
however, Carter announced he had been diagnosed with cancer that had spread elsewhere 
in his body, without specifying where the cancer had originated.[188] On August 20, he 
disclosed that melanoma had been found in his brain and liver, and that he had begun 
treatment with the immunotherapy drug pembrolizumab and was about to start radiation 
therapy. His healthcare is being managed by Emory Healthcare of Atlanta. The former

London: British Prime Minister David Cameron has discovered a new electoral language: 
Hindi. With the May 7 election too close to call, British Asian votes have become an im- 
portant factor, which is why both he and rival Ed Milliband, have been wooing British 
Asians with sharper focus than any previous election. That strategy involves learning a few 
Hindi phrases. 

When asked by NDTV's Rahul Joglekar what he'd say to Hindi-speaking voters in the UK, he 
responded with, "Phir Ek Bar Cameron Sarkaar (another term for a Cameron government)." 
This came a day after his party, the Conservative party, released a song in Hindi - Aasman 
Neela Hai (the sky is blue). 

All opinion polls for the May 7 election are predicting a hung parliament, with the two main 
parties, the Conservatives and Labour led by Ed Milliband, neck and neck. Both know that 
the Indian vote could swing the election in many important seats. Historically, most immi- 
grant communities have backed Labour, currently in opposition...

Recently I had a chance to read the natal chart of one of my relations, who has been 
diagnosed as a PLEURISY effected as evidenced by the CT scan report with the remarks of 
"There is Pleural Effusion in the left lower hemithorax associated with collapse consolidation 
of adjacent lung (segmental consolidation).” (Hemithorax is a type of pleural effusion in 
which blood accumulates in the pleural cavity.) The native has undergone a surgical 
procedure called DECORTICATION to remove restrictive layer of fibrous tissue overlaying 
the lungs, chest wall and diaphragm, allowing the lung to re-expand. 


Ruling Planets of Lungs: 
As per the Medical Astrology the lungs are ruled principally by Mercury and Gemini Sign. 
(Medical Astrology for all by K. Subramaniam). 


The upper lobes of the lungs are ruled by the sign Gemini and the lower lobes are ruled by 
the Cancer sign. Jupiter also rules Lungs and in the Astral Body Jupiter has direct 
relation to the Lungs.* 


Rules for Inflammation of the Pleura (Pleurisy) * 

Jupiter afflicted at birth and especially Jupiter be in Leo or Aquarius. 

Sun Square or opposite to Jupiter 

Moon in Sagittarius and Jupiter in Gemini 

Moon Square or opposite to Jupiter 

A Jupiter disease 

Jupiter afflicted in Taurus, Gemini or Cancer tends especially to effect the pleura 
*Encylopaedia of Medical Astrology by Dr. H.L.Cornell

Controversy of Retrogression 

KPEZine April 2008 

© Retrogression means moving backward. The Sun and Moon never retrograde. Rahu and 
Ketu always move backward and so they are not considered as retrograde planets. Only the 
remaining 5 planets, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn, move direct but sometimes 
they are found moving backward and considered as retrograde planets. (KP Reader VI pp 
146, 221) 


© However, this virtual (not actual) retrogression has been stated in the classic texts, Bha- 
vatha Ratnakara, Brihat Parashara Hora Shatra, Horasara, Jataka Parijata, Jataka Tattwa, 
Phaladeepika, Sanketanidhi, Saravali, Uttarakalamarita and the articles on the role of 
"Retrograde Planets in Astrology" in the Astrological Magazine (AM) of Bangalore, March 
1967 to November 1974, by Vedic astrologers, Bepin Behari, V.A.K. Iyer, Ajanta Jain, R. 
Lakshmanan, R. Santhanam, P.S. Sastri, V.K. Sinha, B. Suryanarayan Rao etc. And among 
divergent views retrogression has been mainly considered as an indication of strength 
(chestabal) because a planet, when retrograde, is nearer to Earth and can have its greater 
impact. 


Astrology & Athrishta - September 1978 page 33 

KP suggests that retrogression in natal Chart is nothing.(See Reader vi, page 145) but in 
Horary, retrogression is to be tackled carefully. Any planet direct or retrograde in Horary is 
nothing, but if it is in the star of another retrograde planet it become inactive, hence it 
brings only a failure. Such planets were not considered as significators earlier, but were 
dropped. 

For retrogression plea, planet should not be haphazardly dropped. Next result can also be

due to various reasons and this needs to be addressed before erecting the native’s chart.

in this direction, the latest being Sri Kanak Bosmia’s book “EASY WAY TO LEARN KP-

in this book in a most lucid fashion with many examples with lot of variations of time 
differences.

dasa lord. Even if the bhukti indicates favourable matters in respect of a particular event, 
and if the dasa lord does not permit the event, then that event cannot take place during that 
bhukti period.

ing various bhuktis have been dealt with, even though the significations of a particular event

Answer 1: 

“The cuspal sub lord of a house indicates whether the matter of the house is favorable 
(promised) or not. The significators point the time of event. Both dasa, bhukti and go- 
chara (transit) must agree.” 

-KP Reader V page 224 (Original Edition p 211), KP Reader III pp 226, 362 (Original Edition, 
Practical Part pp 68, 194) 


In KP Bhukti lord can't offer what the Dasa lord doesn't permit.

nificator of the result which Bhukti lord is to give , Dasa lord, the final authority will 
not give the ultimate result. Planets from a cabinet. The Prime minister is the Da-

5,10.

of 5,10.

star Mercury in 2, lord of 3, 12, and considering Mars signifying 2 is the 4-step meth-

In VOL-4, page:200/201 of KP says: 
For reunion with husband/wife and perfect domestic facility consider houses 2, 7, 11. 


In VOL-6, page-250 of kp says: 
Husband to return home and join the wife one is to judge the houses 11, 7 and 6. 


Which is to follow’?. 
Both are kp volumes and written by KSK. 


Answer 3: 

KP Reader IV, page 200/ KP Reader VI, page 246: 

For reunion with husband and perfect domestic facility, consider houses 2, 7 and 
11. 

7'h house indicates husband, martial happiness and life with legal husband; 

2nd house indicates family and domestic facility; 

11th house indicates reunion, cordial relation and permanent tie with married partner. 


KP Reader IV, page 145 

The sixth house is separation from wife, if already married. 

KP Reader IV, page 191 

Houses 2,7 and 11 are to be judged for union (marriage)...the 12‘ house to houses 2,7 and 
11 are all detrimental for smooth, pleasant family life with wife. 


It is therefore logical to consider houses 2, 7 and 11 for reunion with husband/wife.

The book by the Swedish author starts with a general introduction to astrology and the 
horoscope chart, their components and how they are used in astrological forecasting. This 
introduction actually suffices for the beginner to start exploring the horoscope chart and all 
its ingredients, not just on health issues. 

Next is a thorough explanation of medical astrology, the way to use the horoscope chart in 
making predictions about health, by method of analyzing a birth chart as well as transits, 
the continued movement through time of the planets. 

Learn how your health is described by the Zodiac signs, the movements of the planets, their 
aspects, and the astrological Houses. This book contains all the basics you need to get 
started on that exploration. Please, do not trust this book more than your doctor! The an- 
cient tradition of astrology is another way of looking at ourselves than the methods devel- 
oped by modern natural science. It cannot substitute science any more than science can 
incorporate astrology. The best use you can have of this introduction to medical astrology is 
as an alternative perspective on your health. By examining your horoscope you shed light 
on the complexity of living your life in ways that agree with you the most. 

Most diseases have particular traits that connect them to certain planets, Zodiac signs and 
Houses of the horoscopes. Still, astrology is complex. So, the given traits are suggestions 
only, examples to give you better understanding of medical astrology at work, regarding a 
few well-known diseases and health problems. And please trust your doctor more than your

Short Background

achieve international fame with epic romance Titanic (1997), which became the highest-

for acting and one for producing - and at February 28, 2016, Sunday night's Academy 
Awards, he finally won the first Academy Award for Best Actor for The Revenant. The entire 
audience rose to its feet to celebrate him.

Query: Whether my cousin will recover from sickness and comes back safely from the hospital. 











This was the question which was pestering my family very much on the day, especially at the 
particular time, when my cousin was admitted in the hospital for treatment of her chronic lung 
problem. Here I thought I would get relieved from tensions by peeping in to astrological Time chart 
and its analysis on the matter of our concern. Hence I would like to discuss and share my 
experiences only about the outcome of the purpose of her admission in to the hospital and not about 
the details of her disease. She was admitted in the AICU of Yashoda Hospital on 24 Dec 2014 at OO- 
36-46 A.M, Secundrabad. I have erected a time chart for the same time and date for my analysis of 
the case. 


What K.P. Rules say in Medical astrology: 

Regarding Sickness-- 

6th house indicates disease. 

8th house indicates danger or seriousness of the disease. 
12th house speaks of hospitalization or treatment elsewhere. 


Regarding the Cure and the final result- 

If 5th house signifies that the disease will be well under control and 7tor11tt house denotes cure 
after treatment. 

If the 6 cusp sub lord by chance signifies Badhakasthana and Marakasthana, the native succumbs 
to the disease, provided his / her longevity is not further promised. 

Note-The disease will arise during the conjoined period of 1 & 6 or 1&8 or 1 & 12 significators. 

The cure is available during the conjoined period of the significator of 5 or 7 or 11. 


Longevity and Death— (TIN WIN)- 

(1)The double role of the 8th house is like that while it represents longevity or life span of the native, 
it denotes death as well, and it is so confusing or confused that it is to show the adverse effect of the 
8th house signification in the analysis of both longevity and running DBAS. 

(2) Regarding the role of longevity, houses 1, 8 and 3 are the houses of longevity. 


Analysis of the time chart--- 
The Time chart lagna falls in Virgo and badhaka sthana for Virgo (a dual sign) is 7‘ house (Pisces). A 
possibility for recovery: 


(1)5th cusp sub lord is Rahu. Rahu is in the 1st house. It represents Mercury. Mercury is the lord of 
1 and 10 placed in 4th, negative to 5th cusp (for recovery), end of everything in life and one of the 
terminal houses, 10th -karma sthana and retirement from the world of materialistic life, shows that 
the recovery possibilities are bleak. Rahu also co rules 11th house- another house for cure after 
treatment. 


Now let me analyze another important group of houses which speak of the position of the life of the 
native and they are 2-7 and 12 and badhaka house. 2 and 7 are maraka houses and 12 is the house 
death/moksha/end of life. 


The significator of 2-7 and12 houses are as follows: 
(A) 2nd house significations are-MERCURY-VENUS- SATURN.

Ath, It is in Moon sub lord of 11 in 4“ again.

Questions and Answers 03 2016 

Question 1: Planet Near the Next House Cusp 

I ama learner in KP astrology. 

I am reading your KP Beginners Lessons from Navaratnamala-2. 

ON PAGE 46, Location of planets in Houses is described. 

If the orb theory is taken into consideration..............++ and to give the result of 1st house. 

IS IT NECESSARY TO CONSIDER THE ORB THEOTY’?. 

The significators of houses will change it we consider. 

Then predictions also will change. 

ON PAGE 52/53: 

AN experience Of Ob theOT,.........sccscescscsccecscsececscecsees of the next house will be. 

If planet/planets are available in the next house, what will be the strength of the signification 
of planet which is undergoing orb theory. 

If a planet iS SUPPOSEA.............cceceeesceceececsceees or negative to the matters of next house. 

In this case, how the strength of signification of planet is considered for both the houses. 
Answer l1: 

Planet Near the Next House Cusp 

1. A planet near to the next house cusp within 3 deg: 20 min orb has been generally sup- 
posed to give the results of the next house. It has been experienced by the KP (Reader IV, 
page 108) and KP astrologers like K.M. Subramaniam, K. Subramanium, T. Rajendra Ku- 
mar,) C.V. Tyagaraja Iyer, and also Claudius Ptolemy, Claudius Ptolemy, Liz Greene, Mi- 
chael McClain and Astrodienst staff writers. 

2. In giving the results of the next house, it will be stronger if there is no planet in the next 
house than if there is a planet in the next house because a planet in the next house is 
stronger than the planet near to the next house cusp. 

3. Another view of giving the results of both the previous and next houses has been experi- 
enced by astrologers like Chandrakant R. Bhatt, Anant Raichur, Sunil Gondhalekar, Jean 
Baptiste Morin, Robert Hand , Kevin B. Burk and Stephen Arroyo. 

4. Ifa planet is supposed to be a significator of both houses, as said above, the result of 
the next house may not be effective or strong like the result of the previous house as the 
previous house is detrimental or Vyaya or negative to the matters of the next house. (KP 
Reader II, KP Reader IV, Bhatt's Nakshatra Chintamani). 


Question 2: Retrogression for Natal Chart 

In a KP workshop in Sri Lanka, a theory has been invented that when you are judging a natal 
chart for some question if the relevant cusp’s sub (natal sub) is retrograded at the moment of 
judgment, then the matter will not come through. For an example, if you are judging a natal 
chart for marriage and the 7th sub (natal) is retrograded at the moment of judgment, then the 
native will not get married until the current running dasa is over. 

Please give your view. 

Answer 2: 

It is not a proper KP practice at all since it is very clearly said that retrogression doesn’t 
matter for natal chart analysis.

Vijay Mallya says he didn't flee from India 

Liquor baron Vijay Mallya, who owes crores of rupees to more than a dozen banks and is 
wanted by the Enforecement Directorate for money laundering, today said that he is not an 
absconder and he did not flee India. 


"I am an international businessman. I travel to and from India frequently. I did not flee from 
India and neither am I an absconder. Rubbish," Mallya tweeted. 


In a series of tweets, business tycoon Mallya defended his actions by saying that as a busi- 
nessman he need to travel frequently.

Joint period for BJP: 
On the day of election, (4 April 2016) the running joint period dasa is Saturn-Saturn-Rahu 
-Moon. 


Dasa-Bhukti lord Saturn is in the star of Mercury and sub of Moon. Saturn is occupant of 1 
owner of 3-4. Star lord Mercury is occupant of 4 owner of 8-11. Sub lord Moon is occupant 
of 8 owner of 9. No planet in the star of Moon and Moon is CSL of 3. Thus dasa-bhukti lord 
Saturn is the significator of 4-8-11 and connected with 1-3-4-8-9. Hence, the wining in 
election is sure. 


Antra lord Rahu is in the star of Sun and sub of Moon. Rahu is occupant of 10. Rahu is 
conjoined with Jupiter. Jupiter is occupant of 10 owner of 2-5. Star lord Sun is occupant of 
4 owner of 10. Sub lord Moon is occupant of 8 owner of 9. No planet in the star of Moon and 
Moon is CSL of 3. Thus antra lord Rahu is the significator of 4-10 and connected with 10-2- 
5-8-9-3. Hence, the wining in election is sure. 


Sookshma lord Moon is in the star and sub of Saturn. Moon is occupant of 8 owner of 9. No 
planet in the star of Moon and Moon is CSL of 3. Star and sub lord Saturn is occupant of 1 
owner of 3-4. Thus Sookshma lord Moon is the significator of 1-3-4 and connected with 8-9- 
3-1-4. Hence, the wining in election is sure. 


Joint period for opponent: 


On the day of election, (4 April 2016) the running joint period dasa is Saturn-Saturn-Rahu 
-Moon. 


Dasa-Bhukti lord Saturn is in the star of Mercury and sub of Moon. Saturn is occupant of 7 
owner of 9-10. Star lord Mercury is occupant of 10 owner of 2-5. Sub lord Moon is occupant 
of 2 owner of 3. No planet in the star of Moon and Moon is CSL of 9. Thus dasa-bhukti lord 
Saturn is the significator of 10-2-5 and connected with 7-9-10-2-3. Hence, the wining in 
election is sure. 


Antra lord Rahu is in the star of Sun and sub of Moon. Rahu is occupant of 4. Rahu is 
conjoined with Jupiter. Jupiter is occupant of 4 owner of 8-11. Star lord Sun is occupant of 
10 owner of 4. Sub lord Moon is occupant of 2 owner of 3. No planet in the star of Moon and 
Moon is CSL of 9. Thus antra lord Rahu is the significator of 4-10 and connected with 4-8- 
11-2-3-9. Hence, the wining in election is sure. 


Sookshma lord Moon is in the star and sub of Saturn. Moon is occupant of 2 owner of 3. No 
planet in the star of Moon and Moon is CSL of 9. Star and sub lord Saturn is occupant of 7 
owner of 9-10. Thus Sookshma lord Moon is the significator of 7-9-10 and connected with 2 
-3-9-7-10. Hence, the wining in election is sure. 


My opinion: 10 sub lord for BJP indicate 10 and for opponent it is 3-10. In Antra dasa 


BJP indicate 3-10 and for opponent 3-10-11. In Sookshma dasa BJP indicate 3 and for 
opponent 3-10, thus this is close fight but BJP will not win this election.

Question 2: Aspects in KP 

Can you please clear my confusion about aspects in kp system? Any source which can teach 
me aspects is welcome. My studies have halted at aspects. 

Answer 2: 

In KP only the Hindu aspects are used without considering the orb as done in the solved 
examples of the KP six Readers, although it is encouraged to study the Western aspects. 

The Hindu aspects (Drishtis) are counted ‘from rasi to rasi’, irrespective of the positions of 
the planets in the rasis and the relative distance between the two planets i.e. not ‘from de- 
gree to degree’ like in the Western aspects. Planets aspect the entire rasis with or without 
any planet or cusp there, and the closer an aspect on any located planet or cusp is, the 


KP Ezine April 2016 40 


stronger the result would be. 


All planets, Sun to Saturn, aspect the 7th (180°) from the rasi occupied by them. 
In addition Mars, Jupiter, and Saturn have_ special aspects as_ below: 


Mars aspects the 4th (90°) and 8th (210°) from the rasi occupied by it. 
Jupiter aspects the 5th (120°) and 9th (240°) from the rasi occupied by it. 
Saturn aspects the 3rd (60°) and 10th (270°) from the rasi occupied by it. 


No Aspects of Rahu/Ketu: The Moon's nodes, Rahu and Ketu, are not physical planetary 
bodies which can be seen through a telescope as we can see all the other planets. They are 
the imaginary points of intersection between the Sun's apparent orbital path around the 
earth, the ecliptic, and the Moon's orbital path around the earth. So logically these imagi- 
nary points of intersection, the nodes, cannot aspect any planet or house, and so they are 
called shadowy planets. 


Maharshi Parasara did not mention the nodes’ aspects in his classic Brihat Parasara Hora 
Sastra. In the BPHS translated by R. Santhanam, Rajan Publications, page 255, chapter 26: 
"Evaluation of Planetary Aspects", verses 2-5: “All planets aspect the 7th fully. Saturn, Jupi- 
ter and Mars have special aspects respectively on 3rd and 10th, 5th and 9th , and 4th and 
Sth “. Sage Varahamihira also did not exclusively touch Rahu/Ketu in his classic Brihat Ja- 
taka. 


None of the astrological treatises ascribed aspects to Rahu and Ketu. Using the planetary 
aspects for Rahu and Ketu would be misleading and a source of confusion in making pre- 
dictions. (Vault of the Heavens: Treatise on Vedic Astrology by Ernst Wilhelm, page 196)

This ‘Essentials of Meciitcal Astrology’ book is written by the medical doctor K. S. Charak 
mainly based on Vedic principles. In this book a triology on medical astrology has been pro- 
duced, viz. 


A. Elements of medical astrology with major stress on the timing of an illness as presented 
in this book. 

B. The actual disease and diagnosis, which has been hinted at in the present book but 
which requires a lot of further research since it involves a very vast and intricate area. 

C. The final outcome strictly according to the principles of astrology. This area has been 
hinted at in the present work, but greater details demand methods of calculation of lon- 
gevity which is has not been the aim of this book. 


The best and the most popular method of timing the events consists of using the Vimshotta- 
ri dasha on the birth chart as well as the divisional charts. The Yogini dasha has been ap- 
plied in this book along with the Vimshttari dasha in order, primarily, to confirm the indica- 
tions available from the Vimshottari dasha and, secondarily to stress the fact that Yogini is 
capable of independent application. 


The planetary combinations for several diseases and the astrological principles underlying 


KP Ezine April 2016 43 


them, have been described. Their own researches have been included in these chapters with 
solved examples. However, birth time and place of birth are not provided to study these ex- 
ample charts by other systems of astrology. 

In the chapter XV of “Miscellaneous Diseases’, diabetes, appendicitis, proneness to injury, 
tuberculosis, epilepsy, leprosy, dental disease, hydrocoele, haemorrhoids and importance 
are included.

I have found the technique of composite charts, as mention in this article, to be a more 
reliable new astrological technique in KP system. Generally this system used in western 
system. New astrological methods are constantly being developed and promoted by their 
discoverers, but no other method of relation checking like marriage matching, father-son 
relation, business partner relations, two country's relations etc by composite chart system. 
By using composite charts, we can predict very imaging result about relations, then any 
other system now used by KP community. 


The composite chart gives accurate indication with relationships in a new way. This method 
takes into account the fact that a relationship of any kind like marriage matching, father- 
son relation, business partner relations, and two country's relations is not simply two or 
more people or country or organization together. If two people or countries or organizations, 
involved with each other in some way, we can judge its relations by composite chart. 


When I first try with composite charts I was not satisfied and having many doubts. My main 
doubt is why two chart composite gives result, when there is no much sense to get midpoint 
of two charts. Later when I check many charts with various kind of relations I was 
wondering how this composite chart as per KP System developed by me, gives me accurate 
and amazing result. I have introduced this technique of creating multiple composites, as 
per KP first time to the KP community. The KP relationship method of composite chart is 
some complex, but I will try to introduce it in this article in a simplified way. 


People who are familiar with mathematics will understand what I am mention in this article. 
Before someone start criticism on this article let me say, the only test is to try out a KP 
relationship method of composite chart (KPCC) and then criticize with valid proof of tested 
examples not copy of old pages. 


This article is in two parts. In first part, a complete details of the math's aspects of creating 
a composite horoscope. The second part of the article is how to read the composite chart. 
More experienced KP astrologers will find it very easy to follow KP relationship method of 
composite chart (KPCC). 


Part 1: Casting the Chart 

The composite horoscope is created by calculating the midpoint between pairs of planets 
and twelve bhava of the two natal horoscopes, Sun of one and the Sun of the other, Moon of 
one and the Moon of the other, like this all nine planets and twelve bhavas. The composite 
Sun is the midpoint of the two Suns; the composite Moon is the midpoint of the two Moons; 
and so on for all the other planets. 


In all horoscope, Sun, Venus and Mercury are generally together, and are always in 
approximately the same bhava or one bhava before and after. In the composite chart, we 
found some wonder as a Sun-Mercury opposition or a Venus-Mercury opposition, which are 
clearly impossible in an ordinary chart. 


Part 2: Checking the Chart 
After calculating the midpoints of cusps and planets, find out relevant sub lord and check

occupants and ownership in individual chart; if it is positive then matching good. 


Part 3: Checking the Dasa 

After calculating the midpoints of cusps and planets, and checking of relevant sub lord we 
have to find out the midpoint date of both. Details are given in the practical part. 

Now let me give one math's example practically.

3-10. Thus Dasa lord indicate 4.

in India chart. Mercury is occupant of 3, owner of 2-3-6. Star lord Saturn is occupant of 4,

Venus. Venus is occupant of 4, and owner of 1. No planet is in the star of Venus and Venus 
is the CSL of 1-2-3-10. Thus Mercury signifies 4-10-11 and is connected with 2-3-6-1-4-10. 
Thus bhukti lord indicates 4. This bhukti run up to 04-05-2017.
