What is Ayanamsa? 

In astrology, Ayanamsa is the longitudinal difference between the moving Western Tropical 
(Sayana) and fixed Hindu Sidereal (Nirayana) astrology zodiacs. The Nirayana values of 
planetary longitudes can be obtained by subtracting the ayanamsa value for a given date 
from the Sayana longitudes. 


Main Differences Among Ayanamsas 

But unfortunately it is not known at which point of time in the past these two zodiacs were 

exactly coinciding. Due to this uncertainty there are many ayanamsas being used by differ- 

ent practitioners of Nirayana astrology. The main differences among the ayanamsas are: 

1) The year of zero ayanamsa or the year of coincidence of both Sayana and Nirayana 
zodiacs, for instance 285 AD for Lahiri ayanamsa, 291 AD for KP ayanamsa and 397 AD 
for Raman ayanamsa, and 

2) The annual precession rate, for instance 50.2564 sec. per year for Lahiri ayanamsa, 
50.23884475 sec. for KP ayanamsa and 50 1/3 sec. for Raman ayanamsa. 


The newly introduced Pushya-Paksha (PP) ayanamsa is not based on a "Zero year" and an 
"annual rate" of precession. It is based on fixing a star at a sidereal longitude. The method 
of calculation is as follows: 

1) Take the tropical longitude of Delta Cancri star at the desired date/time. 

2) Subtract 106 deg (16Cn0O) from it. 

3) The result is the ayanamsa of the date/time. 

The longitudes of fixed stars can be calculated from the modern ephemeris (e.g. Swiss 
ephemeris). 

http: //www.vedicastrologer.org/articles ayanamsa.pdf 


Over Forty Ayanamsas 

There are over forty ayanamsas such as’ Aldebaran, Babylonian (Huber), Babylonian 
(Kugler 1), Babylonian (Kugler 2), Babylonian (Kugler 3), Babylonian (Mercia), J N Bhasin, 
Chandra-Hiri, Tarun Chopra, DeLuce, Deva-datta, Dhira, Djwhal Khoo (Khul), Drik (Thiru 
Ganithan), Fagan-Bradley (Fagan), Galactic Center, Hipparchos, Jagannatha, Krushna, KP 
(Krishnamurti), KP Straight Line, KP Straight Line (Adjusted), KP New Ayanamsa, Khullar, 
Krushna, Lahiri (Chitrapaksha), True Lahiri ( Chitrapaksha), Larry Ely, zeta Pisces, Pushya- 
paksha, Raman , Rosicrucian, Savana, Sassanian, , Suya Siddanta, Takra I, Takra II, 
Usha-Shashi, Vakya, Wilhelm Ardra, Yuketswar, Mod. Yuketswar ... which one to accept, 
and which one to reject, has been a matter of considerable debate. No definite proof is avail- 
able in favor of any one of the ayanamsas given ... No amount of mere speculation would be 
of any use. 


Which Ayanamsa is to Choose? 

Ultimately it is not a question which ayanamsa is correct, but which ayanamsa gives us the 
more accurate predictions is more practical. The choice of ayanamsa (out of over forty avail- 
able) is up to the preference of an astrologer finding best for him, and there is no need to 
discuss the correctness of ayanamsa which depends on the rules applied by different astrol- 
ogy schools of thought. 


KP Ezine May 2016 13 


For instance the Lahiri ayanamsa is used by majority of traditional Vedic astrologers. The 
Raman followers have continued using the Raman ayanamsa. But the Raman ayanamsa 
does not give all the same Jaimini’s Karakas, Navamsha, Saptamsha, Dwadashamsha and 
especially finer divisions of Chaturvimshamsha (1/24), Shashtyamsha (1/60) like the Lahiri 
and KP ayanamsas because the Raman ayanamsa value is significantly lower than the 
Lahiri ayanamsa up to “ldeg: 26 min”. So the Raman ayanamsa is found not appropriate 
for users of the divisional charts, especially at the detailed levels of 1/24) or 1/60. 
Nevertheless the Raman ayanamsa is fine for the Raman way of chart analysis which does 
not rely on divisional charts at all. The newly introduced Pushya-Paksha (PP) ayanamsa 
values in Jagnnatha Hora 8.0 are only “18 deg. 35 min.” higher than the Raman ayanamsa. 
Most KP astrologers are now using the KP new ayanamsa, and some are still using old or 
straight line KP ayanamsas. Baskara KB and Khullar KCIL cuspal interlink astrologers are 
using the KP straight line ayanamsa. The difference between the old KP ayanamsa and new 
KP ayanamsa is not significant with less than “25 sec.” difference. The old or new KP 
ayanamsa value is lower than the Lahiri ayanamsa value around “5 to 6 min,” only. The KP 
straight line ayanamsa is very close to Lahiri ayanamsa with the lower value of around “30- 
40 sec.” only. The Fagan-Bradley ayanamsa is mainly used by the Western siderealists. 


Most Commonly Used Ayanamsas 
Lahiri Ayanamsa 
Lahiri = B + [T* P + (T*T * A)]/ 3600 


where 
B = Base = 80890.1535 sec = 22d:28m:10s @ 1 Apr 1900 
T = Y-1900, 


Y= Calendar year for which ayanamsa is required 

P = 50.2564 (Annual precession rate as per modern astronomy for 1900) 

A = 0.000222 sec per year (Annual precession rate adjustment) 

Here 285 A.D. is taken as the year of zero ayanamsa or the year of coincidence of both 
Sayana and Nirayana zodiacs. 


While the controversy of the correct Ayanamsa was going on, the Lahiri Ayanamsa was 
adopted in the first KP Placidus house tables of the “Universal Table of Houses (UTOH)”, 
though not so stated. 


The Lahiri ayanamsa with a 5-6 min. difference from the KP ayanamsa generally gives the 
same star and sub lords like all the KP ayanamsas, except in borderline cases. 


However, a “1 min.” difference in ayanamsa value will make a difference in the dasa balance 
at birth from 2.70 days for Sun Dasa, 3.15 days for Mars and Ketu Dasas... up to 8.55 
days for Saturn Dasa, 9.00 days for Venus dasa through the Moon position at birth. Such 
difference can affect the timing of event at the 4 Sookshma level of Vimshottari dasa 
analysis. 


KP Old Ayanamsa 

KPOA = B + [T* P + (T*T * A)]/ 3600 

where, 

B = Base = 22 + 1320 / 3600 (22d:22m:00s for 1 Jan 1900, @00:00 UT) 

T = Y-1900, Y= Calendar year for which ayanamsa is required 

P = Newcomb’s annual precession rate of 50.2388475 sec per year 

A = Annual precession rate adjustment of 0.000111 sec per year for proper "fit" to the 
originally given ayanamsa values 


The KP old ayanamsa was presumed to be constant for the full calendar year, as given 
originally in “deg, min” only in the K.P. Reader I, pp 56-57, Ayanamsa Table. But it is a 
common practice in the astrological SWs to use the KPOA values in “deg, min, sec” for any 
date in the calendar year by applying the above formula. 


KP Ezine May 2016 14 


KP Straight Line Ayanamsa 

KP St Ln = T*P/3600 

where, 

T = Y- 291 (Year of zero ayanamsa) 

Y= Calendar year for which ayanamsa is required 

P = Newcomb’s annual precession rate of 50.2388475 sec per year 


While a lot of discussion was going on the KP old ayanamsa, a straight line simple formula 
was assumed by MC Khare in the Astrology & Arthrishta Oct. 1978 issue pp 6-8, using two 
figures as given by Prof. K.S. Krishnamurti, i.e. year 291 A.D. of zero ayanamsa and New- 
comb’s annual precession rate of 50.2388475 sec. The KP Straight Line ayanamsa values 
are very close to the Lahiri ayanamsa within 30-40 sec. 


KP New Ayanamsa 

KPNA = B + [T* P + (T*T * A)]/ 3600 

where 

B = 22+1350/3600 = 22-22-30 @ 15 Apr 1900 

P = Newcomb’s annual precession rate of 50.2388475 

A = (Annual precession rate adjustment of 0.000111 sec per year 

Note: 23 March, 291 A.D. is assumed as date of zero ayanamsa. 

http: //groups.yahoo.com/group/k_ p_system/message/1530?threaded=1 


There is not any significant difference between the KP old and new ayanamsas. The KP new 
ayanamsa gives a formula for calculating the ayanamsa correct to the value of seconds and 
for any date in the calendar year. 


The small difference in ayanamsa used by various KP astrologers need not bother a 
new comer unduly. Generally a slight change in the ayanamsa value does not change 
the important elements of the ‘star lord and the sub lord’. A new comer should go to 
the essentials, rather than worry about the technicalities of ayanamsa. 


Raman Ayanamsa Formula 

Raman = T*P/3600 

where 

T = Y- 937 (Year of zero ayanamsa) 

Y= Calendar year; 

P = Annual precession rate of 50 1/3 sec per year 


http: //www.astrologie.cz/zacek/ayanamsa/ayanamsa.htm 


Online Ayanamsa Calculator 

http: //www.astrosage.com/astrology/ayanamsa-calculator.as 

Here the KP Straight Line Ayanamsa is called as Khullar Ayanamsa and calculated by the 
following formula given by SP Khullar: 

AyanKP = (50.2388475/3600)*((YR-292)+(261/365)+(((MN- 1)*30+DY) /365)) 

YR stands for year 

MN stands for Month 

DY stands for Day 


The ayanamsa value calculated by the above Khullar formula is exactly the same as given 
by the KP Straight Line Ayanamsa formula.

A Tribute to Music Icon Prince KP 
Ezine | 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 





(Binh 





“Today, the world lost a creative icon. Michelle and I join millions of fans from around the 
world in mourning the sudden death of Prince. Few artists have influenced the sound and 
trajectory of popular music more distinctly, or touched quite so many people with their talent. 
As one of the most gifted and prolific musicians of our time, Prince did it all. Funk. R&B. Rock 
and roll. He was a virtuoso instrumentalist, a brilliant bandleader, and an electrifying 
performer.” - President Barack Obama 


The 57-year-old music creative icon Prince was pronounced dead at 10:07 a.m. on April 21, 
2016 at his Paisley Park recording studio and home in Chanhassen, Minnesota, after 
suffering flu like symptoms for several weeks. 


Prince has sold over 100 million records worldwide, making him one of the best-selling 
artists of all time. He has won seven Grammy Awards, a Golden Globe, and an Academy 
Award. He was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 2004, the first year of his 
eligibility. 


A Few Comments on the Prince's Horoscope 


The 24 (singing) cuspal sub lord (CSL) Moon is in house 4, in the star of Rahu in house 12, 
aspected by Mars on the 5% cusp (a creator/creative force for artist, entertainment), lord of 
houses 2,6 (gain, service), 7 (relationship), and in sub of Jupiter in house 11 (gain, 
fulfillment of desire), lord of houses 3 (ability, communication), 5 (artist, entertainment), 
indicating favorable houses 2,3,6,11 . 

Restrictive Saturn’s position in the 274 house of finance and self-worth may seem to be an 
anomaly but many billionaires and millionaires have Saturn in this house as money comes

Question 1: Is Dasa good or bad? 

how do we understand that mahadasa of a planet is good? 
please explain. 


Answer 1: 

No planet is wholly benefic or malefic. Similarly no Dasa lord is fully good or bad. For 
instance, the Dasa of 2™4 house significator can be good for money matters but may be bad 
for spouse’s health. The 10 house signifying Dasa can be good for the native’s promotion 
but it may be bad for parents’ health. 

Generally there are two groups of houses -- 1,2,3,6,10 and 11--- as "gain, victory, etc." and 
4,5,7,8,9 and 12 — as "loss, disappointment" (KP Reader III,1971 original edition, Practical 
Part, pp. 41-42) 


Question 2: To get a green card while staying in US? 

I have recently started learning KP system of prediction and has already gone through all the 
issues of KP E-zine including your permanent article ‘question and answer’ in particular. Few 
days ago I Have an opportunity to read an article ‘foreign going rule: framework for study’ 
where there was a mention of getting a green card. 


In fact this article made me little bit confused regarding which houses are to be considered for 
judging when one can get a green card while staying in united states. 


The reason behind it is that one view in the said article suggests to consider houses I, III.IX 
and XII. Your good self has suggested that the cuspal sub lord of XII should signifies houses 
Ill, IX & XII and during the period of III, IX and XII. One another view suggests to consider 
houses I, VI and XI. Similarly Shri Kanak Bosmia suggests to consider xX, V, IX and XI hous- 
es. One more view is that the houses I, VI and XI are relevant. 


All these different and self-contradictory suggestions may confuse a learner like me to reach 
up to the correct conclusion. If permitted please consider these details for example horoscope. 
ABC, 24th of January, 1988 at Jaipur (Rajasthan) at 02:36:45 AM. Kindly guide and 
enlighten. 


Answer 2: 

The basic foreign going rule is to consider the houses 3 (leaving the native country), 9 
(making long journey) and 12 (landing in new environment). The nature of rule is the same 
to get a green card from the native country although the green card is issued after the 
arrival to United States. 


But the rule is different to get a green card while staying in United States. In this case the 
native had already left the native country (3), made a long journey and landed in new 
environment (12). The green card is permanent residence permit, i.e. to stay on in US for 
first time 10 years and then renewable, and here the main thing is house 4 for the 
continued stay in the same country, US. Another required house is 11 (gain, fulfillment of 
desire), also negation to going to new environment (12th to 12). A supporting house is 6th 
house (gain in legal process).

Question 6: Fortuna 
what is fortuna point in kp? please explain. 


Answer 6: 

Importance was given to the Fortuna at early stage of KP in the original "Krishnamurti 
Padhdhati Vol 1", Sagar Publications, 1966, pp 472-474, in a “separate chapter” but not in 
the six KP Readers where it is mentioned here and there a little bit only. 


Fortuna = Moon + Lagna - Sun (in longitude) (KP Reader I, p 98) 

It is only a mathematical point in the chart. Generally fortuna is supposed to improve the 
matters indicated by the house occupied by it. Fortuna gives fortune to one in the conjoined 
period and sub period of the star lord and sub lord in which it is posited. (KP Reader III, pp 
78. eo OF edition, practical part, pp 24, 36) 


As per the original Krishnamurti Padhdhati Vol 1, pp 472-474, Sagar Publications, 1966, 
the results of Fortuna in the various houses are as shown below: 


e 1st house: gain in enterprises, lead a happy life, come up by own efforts 

e 2nd; gain through property, make profit by business, lead a happy domestic life, enjoy 
satisfactory bank position 

e 3d; — gain through brother, make profitable short journey, enjoy the good relationship 
with neighbours. 

e 4th; gain through landed property, some hidden treasure and products of earth, 
minerals, metals, etc., 

e 5th; gain through fortunate investments and children, young people and ambassodors 

e 6th; helpful, lucky uncle and aunty, gain through servants , small animals and doing 
banking business 

e 7th; — gain through partners or other sex, contracts and dealings with others; victory over 
enemies 

e 8th; gain by inheritance, insurance business, gratuity, bonus etc. 

e 9th: higher studies, long journeys, gain through dealing with foreigners, foreign trade, 
publication etc. 

e 10th: name, fame, reputation, promotion. 

e 11th; beneficial friends, helpful brother, profitable business, realization of hopes, 
fulfillment of desire 

12th; lucky in purchases and sales, fortunate in investments, gains from unknown sources 
In the horary chart with a KP horary number, since the house occupied by Fortuna itself 
and the houses occupied and owned by the planets are counted from the horary Lagna, it is 
more reasonable to calculate Fortuna from the "horary" Lagna. It doesn't make sense to cal- 
culate Fortuna from the "natal or time" Lagna at the time of judgment. So please check 
whether Fortuna is appropriately calculated from the "horary" Lagna by the software 
used, as Fortuna is found calculated from the "natal or time" chart Lagna by some 
softwares.

A Death of KP follower by 


Sudden Leukemia 


By: Sumanadasa Namarathna 


(Sunaparantha Kalyan) 
Ex-Accountant, Justice of Peace 
Yo,22/1, Udugampola Road, Marapola, Veyangoda, 
SRI LANKA 


Email: sunaparantha@gmail.com

A Sri Lankan KP follower and a regular reader of KPEZine, Mr. Wimal Siri Wijesuriya was a 
retired executive of Sri Lanka Petroleum Corporation. He passed away suddenly although 
he had not shown any symptoms of being afflicted with any fatal disease. He was of robust 
health of course; a vegetarian and a keen follower of Lord Buddha. No one could have imag- 
ined that this gentlemen would ever meet with such a tragic end . According to his wife, he 
had lost sensation in both his legs and had been unable to stand or walk, and also had in- 
continence of urine in the morning hours of the 10 of May 2016. He was soon admitted to 
hospital, where he passed away the next morning at about 12.24 a.m. The post mortem ver- 
dict said that he was suffering from Sudden Leukemia. 

In honor of this KP follower, I have tried to analyse his natal chart for the benefit of KP 
members. The main object of this study is to delineate the planetary reasons for his longevi- 
ty and reasons for the said ailment that caused his death. 


Birth details 

Name: Wimalsri Wijesuriya, Male, Date: Sunday, 22/Jul/1956, Time: 04:05:00 AM 
SID: 23:53:11, Place: Castle Hospital, Colombo, Western, Sri Lanka, Lat: 06:54:00 N 
Lon: 79:53:00 E, Ayanamsa: 23° 09' 37", Lagna: Gemini, Star: P.Ashada (Puwasala), Pa- 
da 4, Bal. Dasa: Venus O1 Y,08 M, 05 D, (SW used KPAstro 4.1) 


Longevity 

The Ascendant falls in Gemini 08:02:04 co-ruled by Mercury — Rahu+ - Rahut+ as sign, star 
and sub lords. The Lagna Lord Mercury is deposited in the 224 cusp (Maraka) in the star of 
Saturn(R), the lord of 8, in the 5 cusp, and Rahut+ in 6. The sub division of Mercury is 
owned by Venus the lord of 12 located in the 12%, 

Lagna Star and Sub Rahut is stationed in the 6 (Disease), and in the sub of Mars, the lord 
of 6 (Disease) and 11 posited in the 9t* cusp. Rahu is neither conjunct with other planets 
nor is it aspected by any. Hence it acts for its sign lord Mars and associating planet Saturn. 
Thus Rahu alone is a significator for 5, 9 together with 6, 8 and, indicating a middle life 
Span up to 66 years. The native died at the age of 59 years. 


Disease 

According to the post mortem verdict he had been suffering from Sudden Leukemia. It is 
generally called "Blood Cancer", because it is a cancer of the blood cells. 

There are several broad categories of blood cells, including red blood cells (RBCs), white 
blood cells (WBCs), and platelets. Generally, leukemia refers to cancers of the WBCs. WBCs 
are a vital part of the immune system. They protect the body from invasion by bacteria, vi- 
ruses, and fungi, as well as from abnormal cells and other foreign substances. In leukemia, 
the WBCs don’t function like normal WBCs. They can also divide too quickly and eventually 
crowd out normal cells. WBCs are mostly produced in the bone marrow, but certain types of 
WBCs are also made in the lymph nodes, spleen, and thymus gland. Once formed, WBCs 
circulate throughout the body in the blood and lymph, concentrating in the lymph nodes 
and spleen.

There are two main types of Leukemia. When the onset of Leukemia is acute, it is called

Sudden Leukemia (Sudden onset). The other type is chronic (slow onset), where the disease 
progresses slowly and early symptoms may be seen. There are further two types of Leuke- 
mia within the category of Sudden Onset. One is Acute Myelogenous Leukemia (AML) that 
occurs in children and adults. The other is Acute Lymphocytic Leukemia (ALL) that occurs 
mostly in children. Depending on the age of the native under discussion, this can be Acute 
Myelogenous Leukemia (AML) alias "Adult Acute Myeloid Leukemia". This is a type of 
cancer in which the bone marrow makes abnormal myeloblasts (a type of white blood cell), 
red blood cells, or platelets. 

In Pathology, Leukemia is a disease characterized by an abnormal increase in the number 
of White Cells in the bones and marrows. 


Astrological aspects of Leukemia 

White Blood Corpuscles- These are said to be destroyers of the body and to form a nu- 
cleus for mineral deposits. They are manufactured in the Spleen and are principally 
the work of Saturn. During anger and also during diseases and various afflictions, 
they pass through the wall of the blood vessels and deposit themselves in weakened 
or diseased tissues and form a nucleus for the increased deposit of mineral wastes of 
the body, forming tumors, ulcers. (Encyclopaedia of Medical Astrology by Dr. H. L. 
Cornell, M. D., D. A.) 

Governing stellar bodies for the main elements of Leukemia

I have found the technique of composite charts, as mentioned in this article, to be a very 
reliable new astrological technique in KP system. Generally, this technique is used in the 
western system. New astrological methods are constantly being developed and promoted 
by their discoverers, but there is yet no other method of checking relations like between 
marriage partners, relations between father-son, relations among business partners, rela- 
tions between two countries etc. as may be checked by using the composite chart system. 
By using composite charts, we can predict very clear results about these relations, com- 
pared with any other system now used by the KP community. 


The composite chart gives accurate indications about relationships in a new way. This 
method takes into account the fact that a relationship of any kind like in a marriage, be- 
tween father-son, between business partners, and between two countries is not simply two 
or more people or countries or organizations together. If two people or countries or organi- 
zations are involved with each other in some way, we can judge their relations by using a 
composite chart. 


When I first experimented with composite charts I was not satisfied and had many doubts. 
My main doubt was as to why the composite of two charts gives results, when there is not 
much sense in getting midpoints of two charts. Later, when I had checked many charts 
involving various kinds of relationships I wondered as to how these composite charts as 
per KP System and developed by me, gave me accurate and amazing results. I have intro- 
duced this technique of creating multiple composites, as per KP, for the first time to the 
KP community. The KP relationship method of composite chart is somewhat complex, but 
I will try to introduce it in this article in a simplified way. 


People who are familiar with mathematics will understand what I have demonstrated in 
this article. Before someone starts to criticise this article, let me say, the only test is to try 
out the KP relationship method of composite chart (KPCC) and then critique with valid 
proof of tested examples, and not by reproducing copies of old pages. 


This article is in two parts. In the first part, complete details of the math's aspects of cre- 
ating a composite horoscope are provided. The second part of the article shows how to 
read the composite chart. 


More experienced KP astrologers will find it very easy to follow the KP relationship method 
of Composite Chart (KPCC). 


Part 1: Casting the Chart 

The composite horoscope is created by calculating the midpoint between pairs of planets 
and between the twelve bhavas of the two natal horoscopes. Thus, we calculate the mid- 
point between the Sun of one and the Sun of the other, Moon of one and the Moon of the 
other. In a like manner, this is calculated for all nine planets and the twelve bhavas. The 
composite Sun is the midpoint of the two Suns; the composite Moon is the midpoint of the 
two Moons; and so on for all the other planets. 


KP Ezine June 2016 17 


In all horoscopes, Sun, Venus and Mercury are generally found together, and are always, 
approximately, in the same bhava or one bhava before and after. In the composite chart, we 
have seen some astonishing configurations such as a Sun-Mercury opposition or a Venus- 
Mercury opposition, which are clearly impossible in an ordinary chart. 


Part 2: Checking the Chart 

After calculating the midpoints of cusps and planets, find out the relevant sub lord and 
check its occupation and ownership in the individual charts. If it is positive then the match- 
ing is good. 


Part 3: Checking the Dasa 

After calculating the midpoints of cusps and planets, and checking the relevant sub lords 
we have to find out the midpoint date of both the charts. Details are given in the practical 
part.

Hint: 


If the cuspal sub lord of the Asc. be the significator of the house 6 or 8 or 12 the life is short 
(about 33 years). If the cuspal sub lord of the Asc. be the significator of the house 1 or 5 or 
9 or 10 the life is long (about more than 66 years). If the cuspal sub lord of the Asc. be the 
significator of the house 6 or 8 or 12 and 1 or 5 or 9 or 10, the life is medium (about 66 
years). But if the cuspal sub lord of the Asc. be the significator of Badhaka and Maraka 
houses with the above mentioned houses, it is not good for the life. If the cuspal joint rulers 
(the sign lord, star lord and sub lord) of the Asc. or the 8th cusp be the significator of the 
Badhaka and Maraka houses, their joint period is very critical for life. In the short life case 
within 33 years, in the medium life case within 66 years and in the long life case above 66 
years. 


Badhaka bhava is more dangerous than Maraka bhava. So when we are checking longevity 
first check the Badhaka bhava and then the Maraka bhava. 


Cuspal sub lord of composite chart: 

Ascendant cusp sub lord of composite chart is Venus. Venus is in the star of Rahu and sub 
of own in the composite chart. Venus is occupant of 9, and owner of 2-9. Star lord Rahu is 
occupant of 9. Rahu is conjoined with Sun, Mars, Venus and Saturn. Sun is occupant of 9, 
owner of 12. No planet is in the star of Sun and Sun is CSL of 9. Mars is occupant of 3, 
owner of 8. Venus is occupant of 9, owner of 2-9. Saturn is occupant of 10, owner of 5-6. 
Thus Ascendant cusp sub lord Venus indicates long life. 


Cuspal sub lord of composite chart in Suu Kyi chart: 

Ascendant sub lord of composite chart is Venus. Venus is in its own star and sub of Rahu 
in Suu Kyi’s chart. Venus is occupant of 4, and owner of 6-11. Sub lord Rahu is occupant of 
7. Rahu is conjoined with Sun, Mercury and Saturn. Sun is occupant of 6, owner of 9. Mer- 
cury is occupant of 6, owner of 7-10. No planet in the star of Mercury and Mercury is CSL of 
8. Saturn is occupant of 7, owner of 2-3. No planet is in the star of Saturn and Saturn is 
CSL of 2-5-11. Thus Venus signifies 4-6-11 and is connected with 4-6-11-9-7-10-8-2-3-5. 
Thus Ascendant cusp sub lord indicates 5-11 with 2(Maraka)-7(Badhaka).

with 9-1-2-5. Thus Ascendant cusp sub lord indicates 1-5-9-11 with 2(Maraka)-7(Badhaka).

years.

Definition 

Autism (or ASD) is a wide-spectrum and complex development disorder. This means that no two 
people with autism will have exactly the same symptoms. Autism was first described as a disease 
by a Swiss psychiatrist BLEULER in 1990. At that time Saturn was in ARIES sign and it was exact- 
ly back square to URANUS in CAPRICORN. 

Below is a list of the most commonly found characteristics identified among people with an A S D.: 
Symptoms of Autism-- 

Symptoms of autism typically appear before a child reaches the age of 3 years, and they last 
throughout life. Children with autism can display a wide range of symptoms, which can vary in se- 
verity from mild to disabling. General symptoms that may be present to some degree in a child with 
autism include: 
Difficulty with verbal communication, including problems using and understanding lan- 














guage, 





Inability to participate in a conversation, even when the child has the ability to speak, 
Difficulty with non-verbal communication, such as gestures and facial expressions, 
Difficulty with social interaction, including relating to people and to his or her surround- 























ings, 





Difficulty making friends and preferring to play alone, 
Unusual ways of playing with toys and other objects, such as only lining them up a certain 

















way, 














Difficulty adjusting to changes in routine or familiar surroundings, or an unreasonable in- 
sistence on following routines in detail, 

Repetitive body movements, or patterns of behavior, such as hand flapping, spinning, and 
head banging, 

Preoccupation with unusual objects or parts of objects, 


























In a nutshell it could be said that autism is a purely lunar, and a semi-genetic disease. Thus, ef- 
forts could be made to combat autism with the help of medical astrology. 

People with a form of autism have exceptional skills in specific areas such as music, art, and num- 
bers. People with ‘autism’ who are called as savants are able to perform these skills without lessons 
or practice. 


Astrological indications— 

1. The Ascendant lord and Mars-- represent the body or physical constitutional nature and temper- 
ament, structure and appearance, and weak points or susceptibilities. They also represent the na-

Bhukti of Saturn: Saturn is also a significator of 11. So marriage is certain during Bhukti of Saturn 
i.e. between 16.5.2014 and 15.7.2017. 


Selection of Antara: At the time of judgement, Antara of Venus was going on i.e. from 4.7.2015 to 
13.1.2016. However, Venus was already taken as Mahadashanath and also the 7» Cusp is indicating 
8. So, I preferred to take the next Antara of Sun i.e. from 13.1.2016 to 11.3.2016. Because Sun is 
significator of 2 and 7 Remaining Antaras of Mars and Rahu are also significators of marriage but not 
that of Moon. But, looking at the quality of the significator planet, Sun, presents the best option 
(better than Mars and Rahu), as it is not connected with any negating significations for marriage. I 
did not take the help of RPs in this case, which I generally prefer in cases where all planets become 
significators of an event for which prediction is desired. 


Prediction: Marriage was predicted during the Antara of Sun between 13.1.2016 to 11.3.2016. 


Actual Outcome: Actual date of marriage was 24.4.2016 during Antara of Moon which was not at all 
a significator of marriage in this case. 


Justification of why prediction went wrong: 


Generally we try to justify the difference between the actual outcome and the prediction by criticising 
the practices of prediction which are normally used by others. The scientific application of KP does 
not lend itself to such justifications. So, I also reviewed the case. I was of the view that there was no 
point in solemnising marriage in the Bhukti of Moon if we do not consider 6 fold signification table 
instead of 4 fold signification table.

Hrithik Roshan- Kangana Ranaut row is quickly becoming one of the biggest Bollywood le- 
gal feud of all times. The case is taking new turn everyday and both the actors are doing 
everything they can, to explain their side of the story. Now this curious case of hacking has 
taking a new route with Kangana Ranaut's lawyer accusing Hrithik of "Pressurizing his cli- 
ents through media" 


It is to be noted that leaked mails from Kangana to Hrithik's imposter has been doing 
rounds in media. The mails clearly show Ranaut's 'one sided interest’ and ‘desperate at- 
tempt for attention’. 

Now, Rananut's lawyer Rizwan Siddhiqui has claimed those mails to be fabricated and has 
questioned why Hrithik never filed a police case against the alleged email imposter despite 
Kangana's sister Rangoli's insistence in her mail to him on May 25, 2014 on filing a joint 
complaint. "Rangoli had accused him back then of hacking Kangana's email account and of 
having a relationship with her — through the email.com ID (which Hrithik says belongs to 
an imposter)— neither of which he specifically denied," Siddique has been quoted saying. 
Rizwan Siddique has responded to the mails being circulated in media about Kangana Ra- 
naut's one sided attraction to Hrithik Roshan. According to Siddiqui the mails are just one 
sided fabricated material Roshan collected after 25th May 2014. 

"Mr. Hrithik Roshan knew that my client's id was hacked prior to 25 May 2014 and there- 
fore logically and reasonably, no mails received from her at least after 25 May 2014 should 
be treated as authentic and genuine, unless verified by my client personally." 

Kangana's lawyer has also subtly accused Hrithik of hacking Kangana's id as he never de- 
nied his hand or his relationship with her, in reply to Rangoli's mail. 

Well, everything happening between the two A-listers is confusing and getting murkier by 
the day. The questions that needs answers and clarification are increasing. Who is the im- 
poster? Whose email ids were actually hacked? Did both of them have a hand in hacking 
each other's id? Who is right and who is wrong? 

Looks like the answers will take some time to arrive.

Answer 1: 

Here Saturn and Rahu are placed in 9th house, and so it is said that 9t house is inflicted 
by Saturn and Rahu, i.e. they make 9 house bad. It's from Vedic and Western astrology 
that a house or planet is inflicted when it is connected with so-called malefic planets, Mars, 
Saturn, Rahu, Ketu. The emerging trend is not outright considering Mars, Saturn, Rahu, 
Ketu as malefic planets. 


In KP no planet is wholly malefic or benefic, and so there is no such consideration that a 
house or planet is inflicted by malefic planets Mars, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu .

planetary combination for her carrier.

Planet Having No Planet in its Stars & Plan- 
et in its Own Star 

They are not the same and only a planet having 
no planet in its star, but not a planet in its own 
star, is considered as a strong significator of the 
houses for whose cusps the planet is a sub lord. 


Rahu/Ketu Significators 

1) Whether Rahu/Ketu is a planet or star lord 
or sub lord, the followings e been found taken 
in KP Readers depending on relevance to the 
event under consideration regardless of their 
sequence of order (“Rahu/Ketu Rules in 

KP” ,KPE-Zine, May 2007 issue): 

i) House occupied by Rahu/Ketu, 

ii) Planet in conjun. with Rahu/Ketu, 

iii) Planet in aspect to Rahu/Ketu and 

iv) Star lord of Rahu/Ketu, 

v) Sign lord of rasi sign occupied by Rahu/Ketu. 
2) Conjunction in the same rasi sign and Hindu 
aspect without orb are used. 

3) No planet, including Rahu/ketu, is wholly 
benefic or malefic depending on the signification 
at 3 levels of planet, star and sub by occupation 
and lordship. 


Planet Close to Next Cusp 

Guruji KSK has taken the result of the Next 
house ONLY by closeness to the next cusp. 
(Krishnamurti Padhdhati, Vol. 2, Sagar Publica- 
tions, 1966, p 281, 5 para; KP Reader IV, page 
108 3rd para) 


June 2016 


Rahu/Ketu Significators 

1) The same rules of primary sig- 
nificators in point 2.2. apply to Ra- 
hu/Ketu. 

2) Only if Rahu/Ketu is itself the 
primary significator, then the 
house occupied, the planets in 
conjunction or aspecting within the 
orb of 3° 20' (extendable to 5° esp. 
for fast moving planets, if needed), 
its star lord and sign lord also will 
become the primary significators. 

3) When Rahu/Ketu is the star lord 
of another planet, i.e. it is in the 
step 2 or 4, the house occupied 
and the houses owned by its star 
lord are considered. 

4) Rahu is a blemish planet, which 
creates problems and does not give 
the results effectively to the native 
when it is in the DBA, unless Rahu 
is a strong significator of the im- 
proving houses in all 4 steps. 


Planet Close to Next Cusp 

A planet is supposed to be a sig- 
nificator of both the previous house 
in which that planet is posited and 
the next house to whose cusp the 
planet is very close. In this case, 
the result of the next house may 
not be effective as the previous 


house is detrimental or Vyaya or 
Vrava or negative to the matters of 
next house. (KP Reader III, KP 
Reader IV, Chandrakant R. Bhatt: 
Nakshatra Chintamani).

KP Grade E to Grade A Significators 

1) They are considered as weak significator 
after grade A,B,C & D and used as a last re- 
sort. 

2) Conjunction in the same rasi sign and 
Hindu aspect are considered without using 
orb. 

3) Grade E significators are planets which 
are conj. and aspected “by” significators 
A,B,C,D but not planets “aspecting” 
A,B,C,D. 

4) No planet is wholly benefic or malefic de- 
pending on its signification at planet, star 
and sub levels by occupation and lordship. 
5) Rahu/Ketu does not aspect any planet or 
house since it is not a planet having physi- 
cal body but it is only a sensitive intersect- 
ing point in the pathway of Sun and Moon. 


Ruling Planets 
1) The RPs in order of preference are: 
i) Lagna’s star lord 


ii) Lagna’s sign lord 

iii) Moon’s star lord 

iv) Moon’s sign lord 

v) Day lord, 

2) Moon’s sub lord and Lagna’s sub lord are 
added by some KP followers.

the RP; or if it occupies the sign owned by 
the RP, Rahu/Ketu should be included as 
the RP. 

4) The RP in the star or sub of retrograde 
planet should be omitted. 


Retrogression 

1) It does not matter in the natal chart anal- 
ysis but it does not give results in Horary, if 
it comes as star/sub lords to the significa-

2) A convincing proof is still needed for a 
claim that retrogression has no effect in Ho- 
rary.

malefic.

KP Grade E to Grade A Significators 
1) If a planet is in conjunction with a 
cusp within the prescribed orb, behind 
or ahead the cusp, the planet automat- 
ically becomes a primary (KP grade A) 
significator of this cusp in any of 4 
steps. 

2) Only if the original planet itself is a 
primary significator, i) if a planet is 
conjoined with another planet within 
the prescribed orb, the planet is a pri- 
mary significator of another planet, ii) 
if a planet aspects on the cusps within 
the prescribed orb, the planet becomes 
a primary significator of these houses 
whose cusps are aspected; iii) if a plan- 
et has the Hindu aspect (throwing or 
receiving) with another planet within 
the prescribed orb, the planet is a pri- 
mary significator of another planet. 

3) Ketu’s 7th aspect on the cusp is tak- 
en: 

4) A well known practitioner does not 
use the 7th aspect of planets. 


Ruling Planets 

1) The RPs are in the order of: i) Lagna 
lord, ii) Moon’s star lord, iii) Moon’s 
sign lord, and iv) Day lord only. 

2) Rahu/Ketu is considered as RP, on- 
ly if it directly appears in the RPs. 

3) The alleged advancement of 4 step is 
fixing the DBA without using the RPs. 
4) But RPs are used to confirm or cor- 
rect the sub lord of the cusp under 
judgment. But it is not to recast the 
horoscope again and to correct only 
the required sub lord because when 
one judges the other matter of the 
same native then again one will con- 
firm the related cuspal sub lord. 


Retrogression 

1) Retrogression is not working in the 
Horary as well as natal prediction. 

2) But retrogression is used in check- 
ing the transits of DBA lords, which 
should not be in the concerned star 
and sub of retrograde planets for the 
materialization of an event. 


Uranus, Neptune & Pluto 
Pluto gives adverse results. Negative 
effect of Neptune is not yet sure on the 


basis of insufficient cases.

Admission through Option Theory 


; 


By: Shalini Dwivedi 


Editor: KP Astro Science 
(First Hindi Monthly based on KP System) 
6/31, Radhapuram Estate, Mathura (UP)-281004 
Mob-9410004486 E-Mail: ssp313@gmail.com 





Query : My daughter has just passed out from convent school, now she has to be admitted 
in 6th standard. My husband and I want her to get admitted in one of the four renowned 
school of the city. We are trying for ST. Dominic's, Sacred Heart, Ratan lal Phool Katori and 
Army Public School. Problem is that most of the Schools have closed their admissions. Now 


we are trying that any one of these schools may take her entrance test and she gets the ad- 
mission. Can you please guide us to where we should try for her admission? 








Note : In such type of queries where a querier gives you options about his query, KP Gul- 
burga Theory, Ruling Planets, TSP , etc. are useful. Analysis can be done through Horary 
Numbers. Taken for each of these Schools. I find Habse Guru ji’s option Theory best suited 
for this query. Let us find out the result through this option theory. 


Hints :- At the time of analysis of chart through Option Theory, we will add the signs to the 
Ruling Planets of that time. For Example, Sagittarius and Pisces belong to Jupiter, So 
we will add no 9 and 12 allotted to them. Sun and Moon have single sign so we will 
take their sign numbers. Signs to which Rahu and Ketu belong to will be added too. If the 
options are 9 or less, then we would convert the sign numbers into single digits. If the op- 
tions are more than 9 then we won’t convert them to single digits rather we would directly 
subtract it .If after summing up all digits and then subtracting it from the options gives O, 
then we will choose the last option. Planets involved with the retro gate planets will not 
be included. In this case we have 4 options in hand- 

1- ST. Dominic's 

2- Sacred Heart 

3- Ratan lal Phool Katori 

4- Army Public School 


Date of Judgement: 20/3/2016; 
Time of Judgement: 12:04 PM 
Place of Judgement: Mathura (U.P.); 
Asc Lord: Mercury; 

Moon Star Lord: Ketu 

Moon sign Lord: Sun; 

Day Lord: Sun 


Here, Ketu and Mercury are in retro Jupiter's star, Hence will not be taken. Thus our ruling 
planets would be Rahu and Sun. 


We will sum up their digits. Sun sign number is 5=Rahu posited in Sun sign, so this sign 
number is 5 after added 5+5=10 then make a signal digit number =1. so we have 4 options 
in hand and Ruling Planet number is 1. In this list of schools' name, on first place is ST. 
Dominics. 


My Opinion: The child should be admitted in St. Dominic's. 


Actual facts: The native told me that in the final phase St. Dominic's school 
took entrance exam of 75 students, including their daughter, in which she passed the exam 


KP Ezine July 2016 238 


and got the admission in the school. The native also told me that her husband was trying 
for A.P.S.(Army public School) and Sacred Heart School. M.L.A. too influenced the student's 
application. The child was called with her parents to Sacred Heart School on 2nd April, 
probably for entrance exam.

Ravindra Nath Chaturvedi Ji.

Question 1: Signification of Rahu 

I'm putting here very basic question that how does 12CSL RAHU signify either of 
2nd,3rd,8th, 12th house in case relating to imprisonment whereas in case of imprisonment 
merely its STAR lord who is not retrograde is considered to test applicability of sub Rule 2nd 
ignoring aspect or conjunction of planet(s) on it or effect of sign in which it is placed. 


Should we consider merely effect of STAR LORD of RAHU to judge its signification & all other 
rules should be kept aside what we have learned till date to judge signification of NODES? 


What do rationale of case studies suggest in this regard? 
Please kindly enlighten me. 


Answer 1: Signification of Rahu 
1. It’s the same for natal or horary analysis except whether to consider retrogression in ho- 
rary or not is up to one’s belief and practice. 


2. The cuspal sub lord (CSL) is also a planet and so it is to be considered at planet, its star 
and sub levels. 


3. KP is the sub lord theory and without considering sub it is not KP. Considering the sub's 
star lord or sub sub is not KP, which is written and consistently practiced in the six KP 
Readers I to VI. 


4. The signification of Rahu is 1) its occupation, 2) conj. planet(s), 3) aspecting planet(s) 
without taking opposite aspect (since Ketu is conj. there) and 4) sign lord where Rahu is lo- 
cated.

Question 2: Service or Business in Profession 

How to decide Service or profession /business of any genuine consultant? Often it is hard to 
decide one’s source of earnings in modern time & it needs great research work done by sin- 
cere Astrologers like you & some others if he/she/they have already done research work in 
this regard. I request you sir to enlighten your sincere followers with thumb K P Rules found 
by you. 


Answer 2: 

If the 104 (profession) cusp sub lord signifies house 6 (service, paid job) predominantly, 
one will earn by service mainly and if it signifies house 7 (business with others) or 10 
(independence business), one will earn by independent business. 


If the 10 cusp sub lord is connected with a dual planet Mercury or dual sign Gemini, Sag- 
ittarius or Pisces, and signifies both houses 6 and 7 or 10, one will earn by service as well 
as business depending on the running dasa period of significators of 2, 6, 7, 10, 11. 


If the 34 (courage) cusp sub lord signifies 2 (self earning), 10 (independent business) or 11 
(gain, fulfillment of desire) one will have boldness to undertake business and come put 
successful during the joint dasa period of significators of houses 2,10,11.

Hints

If the cuspal sub lord of 7th be the significator (in the star of the occupant orowner) of 2, 10

11. 


Moon 

In this horary map Moon occupies 7th (business) and owns 10th (profession). It 
is in the star of Venus which owns the Asc, 2 and occupies 11. So it is the 
significator of the Asc. (self), 2 (self-earning) and 11 (gain and fulfillment of 
desire). Thus Moon clearly shows that the query refers to self-earning, profession 
or business dealings with others and gains there from to fulfill his desire. 


Cuspal Sub Lord 

10th Cusp. (Cancer 00°.18'): The sub lord of the 10th cusp is Moon. Moon is in the star of

11th Cusp. (Leo 01°.14): The sub lord of the 11th cusp is Venus. Venus is in the star of

has to have patience for a long time. But Moon is the significator of 2 and 1land Saturn is

12th house is most important to study in such suicidal death, since 12th house speaks of 
secret working and hidden things especially the mental working on unseen matters. The 
sub lord of 12th is Venus, lord of 2, 7, the house of conjugal life with married partner and 
is an indicator of marriage. The Moon, the controller of mind is the sub lord of the 3rd 
house, which speaks of mentality, courage, bad thoughts. Moon is tenanted in the rotated 
Lagna cusp, Aries owned by Mars that is in the 7th, house of marriage and aspect each 
other by their 7th aspects. Now we can see some mysterious connections among the houses 
12, 3,2 & 7 indicating some mental suffering or imbalance in the married life. 


The boy doesn't know the exact reason for the death of his mother, but he had come to 
know that there had been some family problems among the parents. If the cause for suicidal 
death is a family problem and also if the revelation of the above paragraph are truth, 
annulment of the marriage should be indicated by the 2, 7 & 11 even in this rotated chart. 


Significations of subs of 2, 7, 11 

7th Cusp Sub lord Jupiter 7,10,1,8,9,12 

11th Cusp Sub lord Sun 10, 5 

2nd Cusp Sub lord Venus 10, 5, 2,7 

All these three sub lords are occupying in the 10th house, aspected by 10th lord Saturn 
from 8th cusp and by Mars 1, 8 lord from 7, resulting any misfortune in the married life is 
indicated. 


Now let's see KP rules for suicidal death. 

1. If the sub Lord of the 8th cusp deposited in the constellation of a planet, who is a 
significator of Maraka Or Badhaka and also the 8th house, and further if the lord of the 
constellation is connected with Mars, then suicide is indicated. - AA Dec 1978 p38 

2. When the 8th house is occupied by the lord of Lagna, or the planet in 8 happens to be 
posited in the star of the lord of Lagna, OR the lord of 8 is in conjunction with the lord of 
Lagna, the indication is that the native himself will be the cause of his own death. - Read- 
er 2 pg 299 (12th Edition Sept 2009) 

3. The sub lord of the 8th cusp should have some kind of connection with Mars and Ketu. 
(KP EZine 2011 Dec) 

4. Moon should also be afflicted with airy sign connection with Saturn and Mars aspect or 
conjunction as this combination produce negative thoughts to a native. (Ibid) 

5. If there is any kind of relationship or connection between/among the co-rulers of the 
Ascendant and the 8th cusp, then the native only will be the cause of his/her own end. 
(Ibid) 

6. The assassin is represented by the 7th house of the native. It is a well-known fact to all of 
us that the 7th house represents all the persons who have dealing with the native. When 
the sub lord of the 7th cusp is deposited in the constellation of a planet signifying Maraka 
or Badhakasthanas and also the 8th house of the native, then the native will be 
assassinated in the hands of assassin. (Ibid) 

Applying the above rules with the rotated chart (attched) 


Rule 1 - Sub lord of the 8th cusp is Venus in the constellation of Sun, which is not a direct 
significator of Maraka or Badhaka. But Sun is the sub lord of 11 Badhakasthana, while 
connecting with Saturn being the sign lord and sub lord of Sun. Further Sun is aspected by 
Mars the lord of 8 and Lagna and also aspected by Badhaka lord Saturn from 8th house. 


Rule 2 - The 8th house is occupied by Saturn. It is not the lord of Lagna, but Saturn is the 
sub lord of Lagna instead. And the lord of 8 (Mars) is the lord of Lagna. 


Rule 3 - Sub lord of the 8th cusp, Venus is aspected by Mars and Kethu and both of them 


are tenanting in the house of Venus. (Some kind of connection as in the given rule is 
completely satisffied.)

Rule 4- The Moon in Lagna is opposite to Mars and Kethu, both are in sign Libra an Airy 
sign and is afflicted. 


Rule 5 - The co-rulers of the Ascendant are Mars, Kethu and Saturn and the 8th cusp 
co-rulers are Mars, Saturn and Venus. Mars and Saturn are matched as per the rule. Kethu 
and Venus both are in the sub of Saturn that is the sub lord of Lagna and hence the rule is 
completely satisfied. 


Rule 6 - The 7th cusp sub lord (Assassin) is Jupiter. It is in the star of Mars the lord of

Assassin is the self or death by own hands (suicide) 


In summing up all the rules are directly or indirectly or whole or partially satisfied with the

On 29 September 2015, my land lady telephoned and asked me a question, when her serv- 
ant maid gets her pension sanctioned by the government for which she has applied (under 
Govt. schemes for Physically Disabled people), in Dec 2014. And she gave a horary number 
55/249 at 13:45:38 hours. Immediately I erected a horary chart for the given number at my 
residence (Secundrabad). 


Since the query pertains to the servant maid of the querist, and so the chart is to be rotated 
to 6th house of the lagna of the querist (Gemini). 

Before proceeding with the analysis of the chart, I thought I should check whether the que- 
rist mind speaks of the issue she has raised. To check this aspect, I have to look the posi- 
tion of the Moon in the original chart which I have rotated for the servant maid. 

The Moon in the original chart is the lord of second (money income) placed in the 10th 
(government organization). Moon is in the star of Mercury lord of 1&4 in 4th. Moon is in Sat- 
urn sub (lord of 7&8) in 6th (servant) and 8th (sudden gains by way of pension to her serv- 
ant and worry about it). 

So I am satisfied that the querist Moon speaks of her mind about the issue she has raised.

6-servant, 8- sudden gains by way of sanction of pension by government, 2-monetoray in- 
come, 3-receiving govt.order of sanction, 10-governament exchequer, 11-fulfillment of desire 
to obtain pension.

ry. Ketu represents Moon lord of 9th in 5th expenditure to government exchequer (8th to 
10th). It also represents Mercury lord of 8th and 11th in 11th. 

The sub lord Jupiter is lord of 2 and 5 in 10th. Thus the sub lord of 8th Ketu signifies 1- 
native, 3- fulfillment of receiving the govt., sanction order, 8- sudden gains by way of pen- 
sion and 11th- fulfillment her desire. 

The 11th cusp sub lord is Rahu+ strongly signifies relevant houses of the event-8, 10, &11 - 
promises the event.

Arrest Zakir Naik the moment he returns to India: Sena 


Mumbai: Shiv Sena on Monday demanded that controversial Islamic preacher Zakir Naik be 
arrested the moment he returns to India from Saudi Arabia and his "Peace TV" network dis- 
mantled. 

The NDA ally also likened Zakir Naik's "social work" to the activities of Jaish-e-Mohammed 
chief Masood Azhar. 

Mumbai-based Naik, who is expected to be back in the city this afternoon, has been facing 
the heat following reports that his alleged "provocative" speeches had inspired some of the 
militants who carried out Bangladesh's worst terror attack in a cafe in capital Dhaka. 

The preacher has dismissed the allegations against him. 

"The way fanatics like Pakistan-based Azhar Masood openly spew venom, people like Zakir 
Naik carry out through their social work in the name of peace by covert means...Naik has 
been nurturing anti-nationals for the last several years and the lessons in peace preached 
by him have been unmasked after the Dhaka carnage," the Sena said in a stinging editorial 
in its moutpiece "Saamana". 

Taking a dig at the state and central governments for allowing the preacher to carry on with 
his activities, Sena said Naik should have been thrown into the same cell as Mumbai attack 
convict Ajmal Kasab long back. 

"Peace TV is in reality Preach TV. The Narendra Modi government at the Centre and the 
Devendra Fadnavis government in Maharashtra should show some courage and destroy all 
machinery of this channel," it said. 

"The government can bring back black money when it wants to, but for now, the govern- 
ment should immediately destroy the financiers of Naik because the game he is playing will 
destroy our nation. Arrest him as soon as he returns to the country," the Sena demanded. 
Notably, the Bangladesh government yesterday banned the broadcast of Naik's Peace TV 
after reports that his "provocative" speeches inspired some of the Bangladeshi militants, 
who killed 22 people, mostly foreigners, at an upscale restaurant in Dhaka on July 1.

has settled in a different place from the original birth place for a long time has not yet been 
significantly proved, except two example charts in the above mentioned research article 
and Sonia Gandhi's Relocated Chart. Moreover this idea of relocated chart doesn’t work for 
the relocated charts of Indira Gandhi and Tony Blair.

nally born is always used in Eastern astrology, but the place where a native is on his cur- 
rent birthday is used in Western astrology. But the idea of Western astrology of traveling to 
a most favorable location from place of residence around the time of the next Solar Return 
in order produce the most beneficial attainment of a native's desires is not commonly ac- 
ceptable even by Western astrologers like David Frawley, Noel Tyl as per experience.

Question 3: Autism 
What are the important astrological combinations for Autism in detail way? 


Answer 3: 

The autism is a chronic and incurable disease, so 8th house, 10 (12% to 11) house and 
12th (12th to 1) house would have to be involved. But its period of ups and downs is predict- 
able from the horoscope of a patient. 


The autism disease is controlled by the Moon by stimulating mind to hyper-stimulation, 
which is more than normal and has passive adverse-effect on the body. Other planets to be 
involved are Mercury (learning and speech), Saturn (restrictions of thinking), Ketu (excess 
inertia) and Uranus (unusual ways of thinking, no concern over emotion). Jupiter-Ketu 
combination is also found in many autism charts. 


If the 6 cuspal sub lord signifies house 8, 10 or 12 and is in connection with inter-related 


Moon, Mercury, Saturn, Ketu or Uranus, a native may be diagnosed for autism disease dur- 
ing the joint dasa period of significators of houses 8,10 or 12.

prepared to give correctness of values to the nearest seconds by the use of appropriate Trig- 
onometrical formulae on a computer. 

These Tables have been prepared in Sayana (tropical) degrees to facilitate easy adoption by 
astrologers following different systems. The longitudinal degrees for all these House Cusps 
are in Sayana and their Nirayana (sidereal) equivalents can be easily obtained by deducting 
the appropriate K.P. Ayanamsa. While practitioners of other Systems are free to deduct the 
ayanamsa of their choice.

results in the art of prognostication. To facilitate this, A Table of K.P Ayanamsa is included 
in this book. An illustration of how the longitudinal positions in respect of the six and the 
other remaining cusps are to be obtained is also worked out in this book.

Question: Will Mrs. Hillary Clinton win the presidential election on 08-11-2016? 
Number: 205 (out of 249) 

Date of Judgment: 02-08-2016, Tuesday; Time of Judgment: 14:31:32 PM; IST 
Place of Judgment: Kankariya- Ahmedabad Long/Lat: 23° N 00', 72° E 36’ 
Aynamsha: 23°.59'.54" Dasa day: 365.25 


I have predicted 94 election outcomes in advance using my rule given below, and I 
have been correct in 66 cases. This means my rule provides an accurate outcome of 
up to 70.21% at least and not just a 50-50 outcome for election predictions as some 
KP astrologers argue. They have a clear bias against this rule. This is the first time in 
the history of KP astrology that someone has provided 94 advance predictions by 
using the same rule. 


Hint: 

If 10 (one’s position in politics) cusp sub lord signifies 10 (one’s reputation), 3 (one’s 
ability), 11 (one’s reputation as a winner) then success is assured in the DBA of the 
significators of 3, 10, 11.,. 


Cuspal Sub lord for Hillary Clinton: 

10% Cusp (Sagittarius 09°.26’.13”): The sub lord of the 10 cusp is Saturn. Saturn (R) is 
in its own star and sub of Jupiter. Saturn (R) is occupant of 9 owner of 11-12. Sub lord 
Jupiter is occupant of 6, owner of 1-10. Thus 10% cusp sub lord Saturn (R) is the 
significator of 9-11-12 and connected with 9-11-12-6-1-10. Hence, winning in this election 
is assured. 


Cuspal Sub lord for opponent: 

10% Cusp (Gemini 09°.26’.13”): The sub lord of the 10 cusp is Jupiter who is in the star 
of Sun and sub of Moon. Jupiter is occupant of 12 owner of 4-7. Star lord Sun is occupant 
of 11, owner of 12. Sub lord Moon is occupant and owner of 11. No planet is in the star of 
Moon and Moon is CSL of 1-7-8-12. Thus 10 cusp sub lord Jupiter is the significator of 11 
-12 and is connected with 12-4-7-11-1-8-12. Hence, winning in this election is assured. 


Joint dasa period for Hillary Clinton: 
On the day of election, (08 November 2016) the running joint dasa period is Saturn-Sun- 
Jupiter-Venus. 


Dasa lord Saturn (R) is in its own star and sub of Jupiter. Saturn (R) is occupant of 9 owner 
of 11-12. Sub lord Jupiter is occupant of 6, owner of 1-10. Thus, Dasa lord Saturn (R) is 
the significator of 9-11-12 and is connected with 9-11-12-6-1-10. Hence, winning in this 
election is assured. 


Bhukti lord Sun is in the star of Saturn(R) and sub of Jupiter. Sun is occupant of 5, owner 
of 6. Star lord Saturn (R) is occupant of 9 owner of 11-12. Sub lord Jupiter is occupant of 
6, owner of 1-10. Thus, bhukti lord Sun is the significator of 9-11-12 and connected with 
9-6-1-10. Hence, winning in this election is assured.

Kethu and Abortion 


By: Sumanadasa Namarathna | 


(Sunaparantha Kalyan) 
Ex-Accountant, Justice of Peace 
4o.22/1, Udugampola Road, Marapola, Veyangoda, | 


SRI LANKA Email: sunaparantha@gmail.com 











Some time ago a lady came to me with the horoscope of her daughter who had had eight 
miscarriages, wishing to see whether there was any fertility in the future. According to her, 
six miscarriages out of eight occurred after more than 90 days of pregnancy, and the rest 
occurred before completion of 90 days of pregnancy. Since the incident is merits a most 
important discussion for KP enthusiasts and beginners, a deep analysis has been 
undertaken for the benefit of KPEZine readers. 

Before commencing the analysis of the natal chart, I wish to give some hints relating to 
progeny as well as sterility. 


KP rules for Progeny 
(a) "Whether, one is promised children or not is to be judged from the 5th cusp. One will be 
able to produce children, if the following three conditions are simultaneously satisfied:" 


1) The sub-lord of the 5th cusp is not retrograde. 
2) It is not posited in the constellation of a retrograde planet. 
3) It is a significator of either 2nd, or 5th or 11th cusp. 


If any one of these conditions is not satisfied, one will not be able to produce a child at all. 
- KP Reader 6, Page 192 
Note: Retrogression is applied to horary analysis only. 


(b) 1. 2nd house denotes increase in the number of the members of family as a result of the 
birth of a child. 

2. 5th house is considered for child birth. It indicates the first conception or pregnancy, 
progeny or child. 

3. 8th house signifies sexual urge. 10th house indicates achievement of any undertakings. 
4. Being 10th from 8th the 5th house indicates the result of sex. Thus 5th house stands for 
child or child birth. 

5. 11th house indicates fulfillment of desire. 

6. 11th is 5th from 7th. The 5th for female and 11th for male is important. 

Thus, in a female chart 5th cuspal sublord is the guide, and in a male chart 11th cuspal 
sublord is the guide for child birth. 


(c) Consider the houses 2, 5 and 11 for child birth. Cancer, Scorpio and Pieces are fruitful 
signs and important for assessment of child birth matters. Jupiter is the natural 
significator (Karaka) of child birth. 


KP Rule for Sterility 

e If the sub lord of the 5th cusp (in females) or 11th cusp (in Males), be the significator (in 
the star of the occupant or owner ) of 1, 4 or 10 (being 12th from 2, 5 & 11 respective;y) 
or connected with 1, 4 or 10 and also connected with barren signs (Aries, Gemini, Leo, 
Virgo or Capricorn); Saturn (Delaying), Rahu (Restricting), and Kethu (Abortive), child 
birth is not promised. 


KP Ezine September 2016 7 


Jupiter is the natural significator of child birth. In females, Moon is fertility and Mars is 
menstruation. In males, Venus is fertility and Sun is vitality. All these along with both the 
oth and 11th may be examined. 


KP Rules for Abortion 

A common planetary pattern has not yet been found in KP. But interference of Mars and Ke- 
thu with relevant planets and cusps is a well-known factor in KP. However, that, too, has 
not yet been found to be working satisfactorily in all such cases. 


Below are some rules in Medical Astrology. 
Mars and Uranus for Abortion — The Rulership Book by Rex E. Bills 
1. Scorpio sign rules the womb and afflictions in this sign, and especially by malefics 
Uranus and Mars in Scorpio at birth. 
2. The affliction of Saturn in Scorpio also tends to abortion and to hinder and retard the 
growth of the foetus. 
3 .Moon in the 4th or 7th house at birth and afflicted by Mars. 
4. Saturn’s influence tends to abortive births and especially when in Scorpio at birth or 
afflicting the Scorpio sign by aspecting or planets in Scorpio. 
5. Mars in an angle at birth, occidental of the Sun and oriental of the Moon. 


Encyclopedia of Medical Astrology by Dr. H.L.Cornell (M.D., LL.D.) 
1. Kethu in Cancer Sign — Paranoia of pregnancy, Miscarriage, Weak Uterine Walls 
2. Kethu in Scorpio — Miscarriage 
3. Kethu conjunct Moon -— Infertility 
4. Rahu in Scorpio — Tendency to miscarry 


- Medical Astrology by Judith Hill 


Points to ponder:- 
Abortive Planets: Rahu, Kethu, Mars, Saturn 
Barren Signs: Aries, Leo, Virgo, Capricorn

On 23 MARCH 2015, one of my friends came to me and told me that he was finding it very 
difficult to solve the problem of his daughter’s marriage due to various issues created by 
her like love affair, inter caste, delay in consultations etc., and sought my astrological help 
by furnishing the birth details of his daughter. 


The birth details furnished are— 

DOB- 22/12/1988 / TOB- 2- 26-5 A.M / POB- Secundrabad -Telanagana State. 

The chart was erected on the same day (23-3-2015) which is attached here with. 

Before proceeding with the marriage and its related issues let me furnish below what the 
K.P. rules say: 


K.P. Rules on marriage and its related matters-- 


Rule no.1- Marriage: if the 7 cusp sub lord signifies 2 or 7 or 11, marriage is promised 
during the conjoined period of the significators of 2,7 and 11 houses and when the transits 
also are in harmony. (Page No.124 of K.P Reader no.4) 


Rule no.2- Love marriage: If the sub lord of the 5 cusp is deposited in the constellation of 
a planet who is the significator of houses 7 and 11, then materialization of love affair is 
promised. If it signifies 6 or 12, it will never materialize. If it signifies the 6 the other party 
falls out and if it signifies the 12t then the native himself/herself will drop the idea. (Page 
191- K.P.READER NO. 6) 


Rule no.3- Inter caste / Community marriage: If the 7 / 5 cusp sub lord is tenanted 
in the constellation of a planet /sub of Rahu or Kethu or Saturn who signifies 7 or 2 or 11 or 
9 (inter religion), then it may end up in inter caste / community / unconventional marriage. 
(K.P. Ezine-July 2007 —page no.12 to 13 by Sri Tin Win). 


As per the “Principles of cuspal interlinks “ by K. Bhaskaran-(page no.138-point no 81), 
“supposing that the sub lord of the 7 cusp is a resident of any of the following stars- 
Krithika, Mrigasira, Arudra, Punarvasu, Uthara, Chithra, Swathi, Vishaka, Utharashada, 
Sathabhisham, Poorvabhadra, then the partner may belong to different caste and commu- 
nity or to a different sect of the same caste or community. 


Analysis of the Chart--- 
Seventh cusp sub lord is Jupiter+. Jupiter+ is the lord of 3 and 6 placed in 8% cusp. No 


planet is in the star of Jupiter and Jupiter is the CSL of 5-7-11. It is in the star of Sun who 
is the lord of 11 in 24 house. It is within one degree orb to 3 cusp also. Jupiter is in sub 
of Saturn who is the lord of 4 and 5 placed in 3 house. 

Thus 76 cusp sub lord Jupiter+ strongly signifies 2, 5, 7 and 11 promising the marriage. 

2. Love affair and love marriage--- 7™ cusp sub lord Jupiter+ signifies 5 and 11 as co ruler 
indicating fruitful love marriage. 54 cusp sub lord also co rules the 7 cusp as sub lord 
promising the love affair and marriage also. 

3. Unconventional marriage and inter caste marriage—7 cusp sub lord Jupiter is in the star 
of Sun and sub of Saturn, which indicates unconventional and inter caste marriage.

Who’s the New CM of Gujarat? Vijay Rupani or Nitin Patel? 
TINA is an important term in politics. Many leaders continue to occupy positions simply be- 


cause “There Is No Alternative’. But in Gujarat, that’s clearly not the case. As Anandiben Pa- 
tel steps down, there are at least three strong contenders, who are in the race to succeed 
her. In her Facebook post, the outgoing Chief Minister has written that she wants to create 
space for a “young” leader. BJP national president Amit Shah has said that the final deci- 
sion will be made by the party’s Parliamentary Board meeting. Let’s look at the profile of the 
top three (politically) young contenders for the Chief Minister’s post. 


Vijay Rupani 





This 60-year-old state BJP chief ts the top contender for the €M’s post. His conciliatory ap- 
proach got him the state presidency and administrative skills got him several key portfolios 
in the Anandiben cabinet. Given the volatile situation in the state, amid agitations by Pati- 
dars and Dalits, these skills may help him get the top job as well. The party leadership feels 
that the new leader should be able to reach out to the protesting communities and an amia- 
ble Rupani can do that. To maintain law and order, his administrative skills will be helpful. 
Rupani, who is a law graduate, enjoys support of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and is a 
known confidant of BJP president Amit Shah. And he’s an RSS loyalist too. He belongs to 
the Jain community and hails from Rajkot, the heartland of Saurashtra. While OBCs and 
Dalits are up in arms, making a Chief Minister from a non-OBC community can help in 
avoiding a tricky situation. 

While Anandiben was about to announce her resignation, a media savvy Rupani tweeted 
this, in a way hinting at his ambition as a pan-Gujarat leader: 


Today, August 2, happens to be Rupani’s birthday. Will Amit Shah gift him the CM’s post?

As per the chart, the native’s 7+ cusp sub lord is Jupiter. Jupiter signifies 1,3,6 and is in 
the star and sub of Rahu signifying 1,3,6,8,9,10,12. 

From the above it is clear that the 7 cusp sub lord Jupiter does not signify any one of the 
three relevant (2 or 7 or 11) houses for marriage, and so it is construed that there is no 
possibility of marriage for this native. 

Somehow, I could not venture to inform the same to his parents and kept silent on the is- 
sue. Suddenly, when I received an invitation for his marriage, I was surprised and checked 
the grade E level significator by conjunction and aspect of grade A to D significator. 

It is found that the 7th CSL Jupiter is closely conjoined with Mars, lord of houses 2,7, 
which is the grade C and D significator. Thus the 7th CSL signifies 2,7, and marriage is 
promised. So when the grade A to D significators do not I signify the required houses, it is 
essential to check the grade E significators as the last resort. 

In addition, with all curiosity, I thought of re-examining his chart for marriage prospects 
through the rules of Sri K. Subramaniam (which are furnished below). Prof. Vaikari Rama- 
murthy in his article” sub sub lord also speaks” (K. P year book 2003) stressed the im- 
portance of the role played by the sub sub lord in divulging secrets of the events. Hence 
post analysis is as given under. 


Idea of Sub Sub Lord 

Sri K. M. Subramaniam in his book “ASTRO SECRETS PART VIII” ( SEE PAGES 50-57) 
states (quote)”of late, the sub sub lord is being probed and thought of, in addition to the 
sign, star, sub, and now it is understood that the sub sub lord is also playing an important 
role in giving the result of the cusp.” He made a categorical statement (quote) “when sub 
lord fails , sub sub lord comes to our rescue”. He further states that the sub sub lord 
indicates and stressed its role in deciding and discharging the results of a particular cusp, 
in an example given in his article on Marriage on page no.53. 


He has formulated the following modified rules on the matter of “Marriage”— 
1. If the 7 cusp sub lord is in the constellation of the significators 2, 3,5,7,9 and 11th 


houses the marriage will take place. Though the sub lord shows the above indication, if the 
sub sub lord of the same 7‘ cusp signifies 1.6,4,10 and 12 houses the marriage will take 
place but not in a proper time or will occur in an unsatisfactory manner. 

Sub sub of a cusp plays a vital role in giving the result of the Cusp or refusing the result of 
the Cusp. 

2- A. if the 7 sub is in the constellation of a planet signifying 2,3,5,7,9 and 11 houses the 
marriage will take place and if the sub sub lord of the 7 Cusp also signifies 2 or 7 or 5 or 3 
or 11 the marriage will be celebrated pleasantly and married life will also be harmonious. 

B. if both 7 sub lord and sub sub lord signify the house 6,4,10 and 12 houses without 
connection to 2, 7,118 house the marriage will not take place in one’s life.
