Question 1: Sub Lord in KP 

Dear Sir, Have you received any mail from Viswanath ji in connection with his lecture, where he spoke 
about the Star Lord and Sub Lord? In his view the Star Lord is much more preferable than the Sub 
Lord, referring to Punneswara Rao ji. 


Speech of MK Viswanath as Chief Guest at Universal College of Astrology, Hyderabad, on 28... 
https: //drive.google.com/open?id=OBwWKNE6enMKOYTXFTQ0g2WWFaclU 


In connection with the KP Sub Lord Theory, you have written about the consideration of Sub Lord many 
times in the Yahoo KP discussion group and also in the KP-Ezine. But some KP astrologers, including K. 
Hariharan, are propagating the star lord emphasized 2-step (planet and its star lord) idea although 
many are following the 3-step up to sub theory as invented by Guruji KS Krishnamurti. 


So could you comment on the REALITY of the Sri KSK’s sub lord theory in the Q & A section of the KP- 
Ezine, for the benefit of new comers to the KP. 


Answer 1: It isn’t KP without considering the signification of sub lord! Because KP is the sub 
lord theory, nothing else! 


1. Considering planet and its star (2 steps) is stellar method, considering up to its sub (3 steps) 
is KP method and considering up to sub’s star (4 steps) is 4-step method. 


2. Considering the sub lord of a planet as a decider for good or bad result is the KP sub lord 
theory. 


"Planet is the source, constellation indicates nature of the results, and the SUB is deciding factor 
whether the matter is favourable or not.” (Krishnamurti Padhdhati, Volume 2, Sugar Publication, Jan 
1966, p 41; KP Reader III, V, VI) "This discovery has crowned me with success.” (KP Reader III , pp 136- 
137/ 1971ledition, theory part pp 129-130, KP Reader V, pp 136-137/ 1971 edition 129-130 & KP 
Reader VI, pp 41, pp 81-82) 


Then judge each planet. The planet signifies a matter. Whether it votes for the progress and properity or 
due to the "sub lord” it is not capable doing good, further it does harm to that bhava signified by the 
planet, is to be studied. 


"This discovery has crowned me with success.” 


(KP Reader III pp 143-145 (Original Edition, Theory Part pp 137-139); KP Reader V pp 143-145 (Original 
Edition pp 137-139; KP Reader VI pp 80-82) 


The planets deposited in a particular constellation can indicate only the nature of the event i.e. which 
house matter the planets indicate due to the lord of constellation by its occupation. It does not mean 
that a planet deposited in a constellation should necessarily be favourable and contribute for the bene- 
fit of the matters signified by a bhava occupied by the lord of constellation. For example, Guru and Sani 
were in the same constellation. Guru is in the "beneficial sub”, whereas Sani is in an "adverse sub”. So 
during Guru period one enjoys the results of the bhava occupied by the lord of constellation whereas 
during the period of Sani he faces just diametrically opposite results in the same matter. If in the Guru 
sub period, a child is born, during Sani the same child dies. It means Guru and Sani are in one constel- 
lation and the lord of constellation is in 5. Guru was in a favourable sub and Sani was in an unfavour- 
able one. (Krishnamurti Padhdhati or Guruji’s self written biography dated June 30, 1969 in R. 


KP Ezine September 2016 39 


Eshwara Manus "Astrological Tables for All”) 


‘In order to know what each planet can _ contribute always consider its sub _ lord.” 
(KP Reader TIT page 362 (1971 Edition, Practical Part page 194) 


As regards to a planet, the matter is seen through the star lord of that planet and thee SUB LORD of 
that planet ‘decides’ the results and how the matter is altered and enjoyed and suffered by the native. 
While we take the sublord of the CUSP (all know the SUB Lord is a PLANET), we must be more careful, 
while dealing with the subject. 

Finally, I like to bring to the knowledge of the students of K.P. that the Sublord of a planet tells the fruc- 
tification of certain matters, shown by the Sublord and the result either good or bad in terms of the sig- 
nification of the sublord. The quality and quantity of the result is simply assessed through the signifi- 
cation attained by the SUBLORD of the planet ruling the relevant CUSP. This is final in the KRISHNA- 
MURTHY PADDHATI. (K.M. Subramaniam: THE SUBLORD SPEAKS LX, K.P. & Astrology Year Book 
1998, pp 69-71, SubLord Speaks Volume 3, pp 141-148) 


The sub lord of the significator is the deciding factor regarding the matters of star lord. If the sub lord is 
harmonious to the matters indicated by the star lord, the significator gives favorable results. If the sub 
lord is detrimental to the matters indicated by the star lord, the significator gives unfavorable results. 
(Chandrakant R. Bhatt: Nakshatra Chintamani, p 23-24) 


Can we call Vedic astrologer like Dr. B V Raman who uses two steps of planet and its star in the 
“How to Judge a Horoscope' and "Notable Horoscope'as KP astrologers? 


3. Choice of fruitful significators is done by using the sub’s signification. 


When majority of planets are connected with the houses 2, 7 and 11, select the useful ones which 
agree with ruling planets at the time of judgment. If a planet is in such a position that its sub lord is 
connected with the houses 2, 7 and 11, then this planet is useful. But if the sub is lord of 1, 6, 10 and 
is the significator of 12 house, marriage cannot take place. (KP Reader IV, p 118) 


In choosing fruitful significators for marriage, reject those planets which are in the sub of planets in 1, 6 
and 10, as these are the 12" houses to the houses 2, 7 and 11, and select the planets that are on the 
sub of the planets signifying 2, 7 and 11. (KP Reader IV, p 150) To select the strongest significators, 
reject the planets that are not in the sub of lords of 2, 5 and 11. (ibid p 235) 


If a planet is in such a position that its “sub” lord is connected with the houses 2, 7 and 11, then this 
planet is useful (for marriage). But if the “sub” lord is the significator of 1, 6, 10 and 12 houses, mar- 
riage cannot take place. (KP Reader IV Pp 118) 


Venus is the sub lord of the 7th house. Venus in 12 in the star of Jupiter in 2 and “sub” of Saturn in 9. 
Saturn rules houses 7 and 8. 
So, according to Krishnamurti Padhdhati, we should hastily declare that Venus in 12 is bad. Actually, 
he signifies houses 2, 9, 7, 6, 8 in order of strength. Also Venus owns house 11 and is posited in 12. 
Hence even though matters appear unfavourable still Venus brings out _ success. 
(KP Reader IV Pp 173) 


Moon in the constellation of Jupiter in 11 indicates that Moon is connected with 11th house matters. But 
whether Moon will be favourable or not is to be decided by only the “sub” lord. Here Moon connected 
with 11th house, being deposited in the “sub” of Mercury in 6 is evil for marriage and married life. But, 
as regards profession it is good as houses 6 and 11 denote promotion, success in competition, etc. (KP 
Reader IV Pp 183) 


Now reject those planets which are in the "sub” of the planets in 1, 6 and 10, as these are the 12th 
house to the houses 2, 7 and 11, and select the planets that are on the sub of the planets signifying 2, 
7 and 11. (KP Reader IV p 150) 


4. Many cases have been found that the matter is promised or materialized by the signification 
of sub lord only without’ signification oof the planet and _  £=its_ star lord. 


5. Punneswara Rao ji has considered the sub lord of planets in analyzing a chart in his book 
"Theory and Practice of Stellar Astrology (K.P. System), New and Enlarged Edition 2008, Uni- 


KP Ezine September 2016 40 


versal Astrological Book Trust. 


In Stellar astrology, a planet deposited in a particular star gives the results of the lord of star and 
acts an agent of the star lord. A planet transiting in a sign is the source of the event, the lord of the 
star in which the planet is transiting signifies the nature of the event according to its nature, occupa- 
tion and lordship, while at the same time the sublord decides whether the event is favourable or 
not according to its lordship. (p 34) 

1) If a planet is connected with relevant houses and becomes the significator of the house(s) con- 
cerned and if also posited in the subs of any of significators of the concerned houses, then the 
planet gives more dependable results. (p 36) 

According to KP system, ,,, planet is the source, the constellation indicates the nature of result 
and the sub is a deciding factor whether the matter or event is favourable or not. (p 42) 

We have to find out which subs are good and which subs are bad. Then we have to apply the 
same to Dasa Bhukti system. Whenever any planet transits through these subs, either good or bad 
as indicated by the subs must happen through the sources indicated by the transiting planet accord- 
ing to its nature. (p 44) 

2. 9th house indicates higher education. 9» house sublord Ketu is directly connected with 9th. Ketu is 
in the star of Rahu and in the sub of Jupiter. Rahu is connected with 9 house. Jupiter is con- 
nected with 4 and 11. Therefore the native is assured of higher education. (p 55) 

etc. etc. 

5. Horary can't give what is not promised in the birth chart according to past karma, and it is 
one reason of horary's failure sometimes.

Short History: 

As we know since last month, we are continuously hearing media news about the Baluchi- 
stan Issue. I realized that we need to check this issue in a different way. Hence, I tried with 
my new rule for examining separation (break up) within a state or country. 


Hint: 

Partition of a country or state 

If 74 (undergoing separation) CSL signifies 8 (being apart), 6 (separation, division), 11 
(gain to supporter/fan), then alone we can see any separation/division during DBAS of the 
significators of 6-8-11. 


Birth Date: 14/08/1947; Thursday Birth Time: 00:00:00 AM 
Birth Place: Karachi; Long/Lat: 24° N 52’, 679 E 03’ 
Aynamsha: 23°.02'.08" Dasa days: 365.25 


Cuspal Sub lord 

7 cusp (Libra 23°.20’.40’’): The cuspal sub lord of the 7+ house is Saturn. Saturn is in 
the star of Mercury and sub of Venus. Saturn is occupant of 4, owner of 10-11. Star lord 
Mercury is occupant of 4, owner of 3-6. Sub lord Venus is occupant of 4, owner of 2-7. No 
planet is in the star of Venus, and Venus is the CSL of 2-3. Thus 7 cusp sub lord Saturn is 
the significator of 4-3-6 and is connected with 4-10-11-2-7-3. Saturn indicates 6-11, hence 
Partition is sure. 


Joint Period 
At the time of judgment, balance dasa is Venus up to 15-11-2027. At this time the joint pe- 
riod of Venus-Rahu is running up to 15-01-2018. 


Dasa lord Venus is in the star of Mercury and in its own sub. Venus is occupant of 4, owner 
of 2-7. No planet is in the stars of Venus, and Venus is the CSL of 2-3. Star lord Mercury is 
occupant of 4, owner of 3-6. Thus, dasa lord Venus signifies 4-3-6, and is connected with 4- 
2-7-3. Dasa lord indicates 6, so partition is sure during this dasa. 


Bhukti lord Rahu is in the star of Sun and sub of Mercury. Rahu is occupant of 1. Rahu is 
in Taurus sign, hence represents Venus. Venus is occupant of 4, owner of 2-7. No planet is 
in the stars of Venus, and Venus is the CSL of 2-3. Star lord Sun is occupant of 4, owner of 
5. Sub lord Mercury is occupant of 4, owner of 3-6. Thus, dasa lord Venus signifies 4-5, and 
is connected with 1-4-2-7-3-6. Bhukti lord indicates 6, so partition is sure during this 
bhukti. 


My opinion: There can be a separation (break up) in Pakistan, and Baluchistan would be- 
come an independent country before 15-01-2018.

A neighboring lady wanted me to make a natal chart for her daughter, since the original 
Palm Leave Horoscope has been misplaced. She is, however, not sure of the exact birth 
time and she could only remember that the Lagna was Leo (Simha). Further, she told me 
that the birth occured about 11.50 am on the particular day. When the chart for the given 
time is erected, the Lagna falls in Virgo (Kanya). Due to her unwavering insistence that Leo 
was the Lagna, she sought the assistance of the record room of the hospital, where all the 
births and deaths are recorded, and according to the record room the birth occured at 
11.13 am. She is not willing to accept this as the correct time of birth. As per my observa- 
tion, the Lagna appeared as Leo for 11.13 am and I told her that it is not difficult to check 
the correctness of the time by applying the ruling planets theory of Krishnamurti Padhdhati. 
Also if the time is correct, it should disclose any life event of the daughter using Leo Lagna 
that appears at 11.13 am. The most recent life event affecting her was the death of her fa- 
ther by heart failure. This happened on the 14th of April 2016. 

The chart erected for the time given by the hospital has reflected the said sorrowful event 
faced by the daughter. I further fine-tuned the time to 11. 13. 43 am with the help of the 
ruling planets. Below are the birth details. 


Name: Daughter, Female, Date: Friday, 28/Jun/1991, Time: 11:13:43 AM SID: 
05:26:22, Place: Negombo, Western, Sri Lanka, Lat: 07:13:00 N, Lon: 79:50:00 E, Aya- 
namsa: 23° 38' 53", Lagna: Leo, Star: Poorva Ashada, Pada 4, Bal. Dasa: Venus 03 Y, 
O03 M, O1 D, (SW used KPAstro 4.1) 


To check the correctness of the birth time, using the most recent life event as reference, the 
9th cusp (Bhava) should be scrutinized. If separation from father is indicated from the natal 
chart of the daughter, in accordance with KP rules, the birth time could be considered as 
correct. 


Why 9th Bhava? 

"Hindus attribute the 9th house to father because the ninth house of the Zodiac Dhanus 
(Sagittarius) is ruled by Guru, the preceptor and spiritual teacher. In ancient times, the father 
was invariably the spiritual preceptor or "Guru" of the children to whom he did initiate Brah- 
ma Upadesam and transmit his siddhis or physic powers. Counting the 9th house as the Ist, 
we find that the fifth therefrom indicate the native. Some persons advocate the 4th house and 
the 10th house for father. It is incorrect. Always take the 9th house for father.” — KP Reader 2, 
page 304 


KP Rule for separation from father 
If the 9th cuspal sub lord is a significator of 8, 12, separation from father is indicated. — KP 
House Grouping — Part 1, by Sri Tin Win ji, KPE-Zine Oct. 2007 


KP Rule for short life of father 

If the 9th cuspal sub lord is a significator of 8, 10, 3, Badhaka, short life of father is indicat- 
ed. — Ibid 

The 9th cuspal sub lord is Rahu who is in 5 conjoined with Moon the lord of 12. Rahu is in 
Sagittarius sign representing Jupiter the lord of 5,8. Rahu is in the star of Venus and in the

General Rules for Health 

a. If the Sub Lord of the Lagna be the significator of 1 or 11 health is normal; 

b. If the Sub Lord of the Ascendant be the significator of 6, 8, 12, it is ill-health; 

c. If the Sub Lord of the 6th, be the significator of 6, 8, 12 and connected with 1, native 
may suffer from disease; 

d. If the sub lord of the 8th or 12th cusp be the significator of 6, 8, 12 and connected with 
1, the native suffers from serious illness or chronic disease. (Horoscope and diseases, by 
SriC. R. Bhatt, page 82) 


Heart Disease 

a. In Medical Astrology, the 4th house rules over the heart and breasts. The 5th sign of the 
natural zodiac, Leo, governs heart in general. The Moon rules over the heart. Sun rules 
diseases of the heart. Mars controls the blood circulation. The Watery signs Cancer, 
Scorpio and Pisces rule over the blood. If Mars and 4th (Heart) house are connected with 
the 8th house or Saturn, karaka for longevity, in any manner, they may inflict death 
upon the person due to heart disease. Planet of Expansion is Jupiter. (Condensed 
from Medical Astrology for All by Sri K.subramaniam) 

b. All the FIXED signs Taurus, Leo, Scorpio & Aquarius tend to affect and influence heart 
and its action for good or ill. Abnormal increase in the size or part of an organ (Swelling/ 
Enlarge/Expansion/Hypertrophy) is a Mars disease due to the tonic or plus action of 
Mars. 

c. Also, Jupiter presides over the Hypertrophic processes. Its influence tends to an en- 
larged heart by the formation of fat and adipose tissue. 

(Encyclopedia of Medical Astrology by Dr. H.L.Cornell MD, DA)

Saturn (24.11.97 to 24.11.16). Dasa nath is a common effective significator. Reinstatement 
is promised before 24.11.16. 


Bhukti nath is Jupiter (running between 13.5.14 and 24.11.16). Jupiter is also a common 
effective significator. 


Running Antara is Moon (running between 27.2.16 and 15.5.16) which is left out because of 
Punarphoo effect in the RPs despite Moon being a common significator. Next antara is that 
of Mars (which runs between 15.5.16 and 8.7.16). This, too, is left out because it is nota 
common significator. The Next antra is that of Rahu (from 8.7.16 until 24.11.16). Rahuisa 
common effective significator. We can conclude that reinstatement is promised during Rahu 
Antara. 


Prediction came true. I learnt from the native that her reinstatement order had been re- 
ceived today on 23rd September 2016.

tried to find the effective Sookshma. Rahu antara consists of the following 

Sookshmas:

and Antara lords. Next is Mercury which is not a common significator. However, her rein- 
statement order was issued on 23.9.16. If I follow the same procedure and method, as I fol- 
low in other cases, then Ketu Sookshma was appropriate and it is next in the list commenc- 
ing after 3 days. But after practicing, I realised that finding Sookshma is still a subject of 
research. Most astrologers seek the help of transits in arriving at this. But there are no hard 
and fast rules for this in the “divine” science, so continuing to practice is the only way, and 
sharing true experiences, that will help us to uncover the secret for finding the exact date of 
any event and the use of Sun’s transit.

Question 1: Rotation of the Horary Chart 
I am regularly going through your KPEzine. 
I am continuously and interestingly following your QUESTION AND ANSWERS. 


Iam sorry to comment that your answers are some times confusing me as 
different answers are given to the for the same question discussed at different times. 


For Example: 

Question No:3 in KPEzine, February 2011, your answer is: 

"In such a case with strong urge of querent and astrologer, it is reasonable to proceed the 
analysis by just considering the 5th house as the lagna of the child ”. 


Question No:1 in KPEzine March 2012. Your answer is: 
” No rotation of the KP horary could be tried, if the querent is very keen to know the result of 
the closed relatives like daughter or son. 


One of my client came to me and asked for the marriage of his son (first issue) and daughter 
(second issue) and given two different horary nos. 


IN view of above, which option should I consider? 

1. straight away take the nos. and draw the charts for analysis, 

OR 

2. Take 5th house as lagna for eldest one (in this case-son) for the no. given and 
take 7th house as lagna for second issue(in this case-daughter)for the no. given 
I request your advise. 


Answer 1: 
The answers depend on the specific questions. In your case it is advisable to take the second 
option. 


Rotation of Horary Chart 

In general as written in the article “Rotation of the KP Horary Chart” in KP-Ezine Nov. 2012 
issue, a KP horary chart is for the person who gives the hoary number. (KP Reader VI, pp 
89, 253, 269-270). If the query is for someone else other than the horary number giver, the 
KP horary chart is rotated in the KP Reader VI (pp 160, 174, 213, 257, 259-260, 309), 
based on the relation between the querent and the person in question. 


This practice of chart rotation is followed by , Chandrakant R. Bhatt (Prashna Jyotish, 
Chart no. 1, 2, 3, 39, 52, 53, 54, 55 and 56), M.P. Shanmugam (Astro secrets and Krishna- 
murti Padhdhati, Part I, p 260), K.P. Kuppu Ganapathi (KPE-zine Feb 2007 issue), Astro 
secrets & Krishnamurti Padhdhati, Part II, p 215), K. Subramaniam (Medical Astrology for 
All, p 224), K. Hariharan (How to Judge Longevity, pp 35, 97), Dr. Arastu Prabhakar (New 
Dimensions of K.P. Astrology - Horary, example 29), T. Rajendra Kumar (KP & Astrology 
Year Book 2010, pp 59, 60, 61; 2012, p 58) etc. 

The same chart rotation is done in the Western horary by William Lilly (Christian Astrology 
p 127), Ivy Goldstein-Jacobson (Simplified Horary Astrology, p 75), Anthony Louis (Horary 


KP Ezine October 2016 31 


Astrology Plain & Simple, pp 15, 41, 124), Deborah Houlding (Learning Horary Astrology) 
etc. 


No Rotation of Horary Chart 

There is a view of no rotation of the KP horary chart in the circumstances below: 

1) The astrologer would like to know the result for his own interest. For example, “Will PM 
Indira Gandhi win the parliamentary elections?” (Chandrakant. R. Bhatt: Prashna 
Jyotish, Chart 42) 

2) There is no need to rotate the chart as the horary number is meant for the person about 
whom query is put for, reflecting the anxiety of the querent for his near-dear (like daugh- 
ter or son). (Dr. K.R. Kar: K.P. & Astrology Year Book 2008, p 66) 


Bottom Line 

Generally it is to rotate the horary chart if the query is for someone else other than the ho- 
rary number giver. In the case of astrologer’s own interest or if the querent is very keen to 
know the result of the closed relatives like daughter or son, no rotation of chart may be 
tried up to the preference or experience of astrologer. 


Question 2: Field of Horary 

I ama learner of KP System. 

Some astrologers is of the opinion that HORARY is to be used for temporary issues like, school 
admission, train coming etc and not for permanent issues like marriage etc., 

I request for your opinion in this regard. 


Answer 2: 

Generally horary is resorted for those who have no horoscope or who doubt the correctness 
of their horoscopes. Horary can answer all questions and clear all doubts. (KP Reader VI, p 
15) But horary is not the substitute of natal horoscope. Horary cannot give what is not 
promised in the natal chart.

"Once you posted a question about the planet in it’s own star and no planet in its star, planet 
in it’s own star and other planets in it’s star’ . 


I could not find this. If you have this post on your Timeline then please reshare that post. Will

Answer 3: 
Important Rule: If there is no planet in the stars of a planet, that planet is the strong sig- 
nificator of houses for which it is the cuspal sub lord. 


A planet with no planet in its stars has not only positional status but also is the strong sig- 
nificator of the houses under its sub lordship because there is no planet in the star level to 
give its result. 


The validity of this useful rule is tested by practicing KP astrologers like PS Rao, Vikari 
Ramamurthi, Kuppu Ganapathi, R. Mukunda Rajan, Kanak Bosmia etc. 


This rule is the same as the Golden Rule in KP: If a planet is a cuspal sublord of any house 
and is untenanted, it becomes the strong significator of that house. ." X cusp sublord is Ra- 
hu. No planet is in the star of Rau. Therefore Rahu is a strong significator of the X house, 
even though he occupies the IX ... (Astro secrets & KP Part II, p 197) 


KP Ezine October 2016 32 


Other possibilities related to this rule: 

a. If the planet is not the cuspal sub lord of any house, it will have only positional status, 
i.e. it will be the strong significator of the house occupied by that planet. 

b. A planet in its own stars having no planet in its stars can have positional status but 
cannot be the strong significator of the houses under its sub lordship because that plan- 
et has to give the result of own in the star level. 

c. A planet in its own stars also having any other planet(s) in its stars can have neither po- 
sitional status nor the role of strong significator of the house(s) under its cuspal sub 
lordship because that planet has to give the results of own and other planet(s) in the star 
level. 
https://groups.yahoo.com/neo/groups/k p_ system/conversations/topics/38547

8.0.

Lat & Lon.

Transfer of job - A developing story ie = 
Ezine | 


By: Sumanadasa Namarathna 


(Sunaparantha Kalyan) 
Ex-Accountant, Justice of Peace 
No.22/1, Udugampola Road, Marapola, Veyangoda, 
SRI LANKA Email: sumanal946@gmail.com 











A married lady, known to me, attached to working on a respectable post in the government 
sector, asked me to check her horoscope to see whether there was any planetary chance to 
have a transfer from her present service station in the near future as she had applied for a 
transfer. Her birth details are as below. 


Name: Female, Date: Tuesday, 29/Jan/1974, Time: 08:08:00 AM SID: 16:31:17, Place: 
Kurunegala Teaching Hospital, North Western, Sri Lanka, Lat: 07:28:00 N, Lon: 
80:21:00 E, Ayanamsa: 23° 24' 18", Lagna: Aquaries , Star: Rewathie, Pada 1, Bal. Da- 
sa: Mercury 14 Y, 03 M, 27 D, (SW used KPAstro 4.1) 


The following KP rules have been examined and it was concluded that she does have a 
chance for a transfer of service station. 


1. For transfer judge houses 3, 9 & 12, this includes change of residence also. (KP 
Reader- 2005 Edition, Page 378) 

2. Profession - 3, 9, 12 indicate changes. (Ibid Page 347) 

3. 10th cuspal sub lord’s signification of 3, 9, 12 or 3, 10, 12; during the DBAS sig- 
nifying 3, 9, 12 or 3, 10, 12. (KP House Grouping Part O1 by Sri Tin Win ji) 

4, If the cuspal sub lord of 3 or 12 be the significator of 3 or 12 and connected with 
10, the native, if in service, will get transferred from the present place to another 
place, during the joint period of the significators of 3, 10 & 12. (Nakshatra Chin- 
tamani, Sri C.R.Bhatt, page 79) 


3rd Cusp - Sub lord of the 3rd cusp is Mars. It owns 3 & 10 and occupies the 3rd cusp 
which falls in its own sign, Aries. Mars is in the star of Venus and in the sub of Jupiter. 
Venus is the lord of 4 & 9, and in extremely close to the 12th cusp. Sub lord Jupiter is the 
lord of 2 & 11, and is posited in the 12th house. So the 3 cuspal sub lord Mars is a 
significator of 3,9, 10 & 12. 


12th Cusp - Sub Lord of 12th is Moon, and it owns 6 (Service). It is in the star of Mercury 
lord of 5 & 8 placed in 12. Moon is in the sub of Kethu conjoined with Saturn, the lord of 
12. Also, Kethu represents Mercury in 12. So the 12th cusp sub lord Moon is a significator 
of 12. 


10th Cusp - Jupiter is the sub lord of the 10, and is the lord of 2 & 11 posited in the 
12th. It is in the star of Mars and in its own sub. Star lord Mars is the lord of 3 & 10 and is 
tenanted in the 3rd cusp. Thus, 10th cuspal sub lord is a significator of 3, 10 & 12. 


Since all the KP rules for transfer of service agree with the relevant indicators of the natal 
chart, I informed the lady accordingly. 


Now let's see the meaning of TRANSFER. It is moving from one place to another place. That 


is why, Sri KSK ji has opined and stated that the "transfer" is "which include change of 
residence" in his KP Reader 3.

What is RESIDENCE? It is the place where a family lives, and the family may comprise of 
the husband, wife, children, and sometimes parents too. So, my logic is that "Transfer" of a 
job is not only a change of place of work or residence, but includes vast meanings contained 
within the word ‘transfer’. Being an Astrologer attached to KP, with an astrological angle, I 
narrate the definition for the word "transfer" with categorize as follows: 


When a person is getting a job transfer:- 

1. If the person is already far away from home for the job, transfer is only a change of 
place. 

2. If the person is getting transferred from outstation to his/her residential area, the trans- 
fer causes reunion with the family. 

3. If the person is married, and has children and a spouse who is also working there, itis a 
separation from the family. 

4. If the person and his/her children have to change the previous living place as a result of 
the transfer, it is a separation from partner, and separation from father or mother 
for children. 

5. If the person has no children, and spouse is still working there, the transfer is separa- 
tion from the spouse. 

6. If the person is single and living with father and mother, it is a separation from father 
and mother. 

7. If the whole family is moving as a result of the transfer, it is a change of residence. 


Any of the above reasons, should be indicated in the chart under study, as well as in the 
charts of family members regarding the matter of TRANSFER. 


In my case, discussed above, only the lady concerned is to get transferred, while her spouse 
is working in their residential area, and also her two children are attending school there. 
Hence, this transfer should go under category "3" above. 


As per the rule given by Sri Tin Win ji in his House Grouping Part 1, the sub lord of the 2nd 
cusp should be a significator of 1 & 12 for separation from the family. In the chart under 
discussion, the 2nd cuspal sub lord is Jupiter+ the lord of 2 & 11 and posited in the 12‘, in 
its own sub. Its star lord, Mars, signifies neither 1 nor 12. Hence, I decided that this is nota 
separation from family. While I was studying this chart and the incident, the lady on hear- 
ing her positive results regarding transfer, called and asked me a question like this. Sir, I 
want to my children to get admission into a high level college in the town where I have ex- 
pectations to be. So, can I take my two children, too, to my new place if I get the transfer? 
Then I asked " what about your husband?” She said, "He is working here and not willing to 
get a transfer". Then I checked her chart again for separation from children. For separation 
from children, the 5th cuspal sub lord should be a significator of 4 & 12. If this rule is not 
indicated in the chart, she can take her children. The 5th sub lord of the chart is Mercury. 
It is the lord of 5 & 9 in 12, in the star of Mars, and in the sub of Saturn. Mars is the lord 
of 3 & 9 and positioned in the 9th. Sub lord Saturn is the lord of 12 & 1, and is in the 4th 
cusp. Hence, Mercury is a significator of 4 & 12, and separation from children is indicated. 
Thus, she will not be able to take her children with her to the new place. But, fructification 
of the rule for the matter depends only on the agreement of the Dasa lord as per KP. At the 
time of this discussion, Sun Maha Dasa is in force and running from May 26, 2015 to May 
26, 2021. Sun is not, in any way, connected with house 4. Hence, what the rule has indi- 
cated, is negated, and she should be able to take her children with her. So, I had to say 
"Yes" for the second question. 


Meanwhile, the first child's results of the Scholarship Examination for a Higher School were 
released, and he gained a very high place in the examination. He qualified to enter into a 
high school for higher education. At the same time, she got the letter of transfer w.e.f. Feb. 
O7, 2016 to the place which she wanted to go to. She took her elder son to the new place,

(a) Separation of husband and wife 

(b) Separation from father of children 

(c) Separation from the children of the father.

What do the K.P rules say in this regard? 


1. If the sub lord of the 4th cusp is the significator of 4, 9 and 11, then success in examina- 
tions is promised. 

2. Sub lord of the 11 cusp, when connected with the houses under consideration — 4th 
and 9th houses - the results will be positive. 

3. Mars, Mercury and Jupiter promise success when they are connected with 4, 9 and 11 
houses. 

4. For failure in examinations —connections of 4 / 11 with negative houses 34 and 8th 
are to be considered.

11th cusp sub lord is Sun. It is the lord of 4- relevant house for education- posited in 11. 
Sun is in Venus star -lord of 5 and 12 placed in 11. Sun is in Mercury sub, lord of Lagna 
placed in the 11 cusp.

sub lord level. This assures success. But, since the star lord of the sub lord- Venus is also 
connected with the 12‘, it indicates partly failure too. 

Since Sun is placed in Mercury sub, it indicates duality. Therefore, the loss of papers may 
be restricted to two in number. 

Accordingly, I informed the same to my friend the same day.

Will Hillary Clinton Win the US election i 
that will be held on 8 November 2016? arte 


By: Arvind Gupta 
Australia 


5 Hf EMail: guptaa@unhcr.org 
BEES eee ee 
Background: 









I had written an analysis of Donald Trump’s natal chart in the September 2015 issue of the 
KP Ezine and had concluded that he would not be able to win the elections in 2016. A 
number of KP stalwarts have also written analyses through both natal charts or through 
horary charts taking the question from all angles. Some asked if Hillary Clinton would win 
the elections. Others asked if Donald Trump would win the elections. Consistently, however, 
each analysis has come to the same conclusion i.e. Donald Trump would lose the elections 
and that Hillary Clinton would win. 


Academically, for all of us KP practitioners, the manner in which analysis is conducted, 
especially in using the horary approach, has been questioned by many KP practitioners 
themselves. The main issue revolves around how to analyse the chances of an individual’s 
success when there are multiple contestants. While many stalwarts have concluded that 
when then question relates to the success of a single candidate, all others may be put into 
one group. This reduces the number of contestants, at least notionally, to two. Therefore, 
the contest is considered between two “groups”, where the concerned candidate is treated 
as one of the two “groups”. Others insist that it is not possible to make such an analysis as 
each candidate has to be examined separately. 


I am inclined to the view that among multiple contestants the question really is whether, 
relative to the whole group, the particular individual, about whose victory we wish to know, 
we could still analyse the situation as being a contest between two contestants. That is to 
say, the concerned individual is treated, notionally, as one group and all the others are 
treated as the second group. Then the issue of victory becomes one of a contest between two 
“persons/groups” rather than being one of an individual pitched against a multiple number 
of contestants, each being subject to a separate analysis. 


This approach may be examined by KP practitioners. For the time being, however, the ques- 
tion is academic. We are now watching a contest between only two individuals. It is a criti- 
cal juncture in the race to the White House as only weeks remain for the elections which 
will take place on the 8 of November 2016. We may, therefore, proceed to analyse the 
contest as between these two individuals alone. 


The three national debates that have so far taken place have been interesting in as much as 
the resulting polls have not been very convincing in favour of any candidate. In the nature 
of public polls, dramatic changes may still occur at the last minute. Although, Hillary 
Clinton is shown as leading these polls, the margin is not a big one and, historically, the 
situation has changed at the last minute. Will the same happen now? Or, are the polls 
indicating the true position between the two candidates? 


I have now asked a question: Will Hillary Clinton win the election that is taking 
place on 8 November 2016? 


The horary chart has been prepared for 21 October 2016, at Canberra (Australia); Lat: 
35:17:00S and Lon: 149:08:00E. The time of query was 05:47:14 PM. Ayanamsa (KP) is 24°

The Rule: 


There are many different ways to analyse competitions. Elections are nothing else but a 
contest between people seeking public office. The present analysis uses the approach taken 
by Shri Kanak Bosmia. The rule is as follows: 


If the Sub lord of the 10th signifies 3, 10 or 11, the individual emerges victorious in 
elections. 


Let us, therefore, look at how this horary chart indicates all these links for both candidates. 
As the question is asked in terms of whether Hillary Clinton would win, the Lagna of this 
chart represents her. The 7th house, being opposite to the Lagna, consequently, represents 
Donald Trump. 


For Hillary Clinton: 


The 10th SL is Venus who is placed in 8 and rules 2-7; it is in the Star of Saturn placed in 
8 and rules 10-11. It is in the Sub of Venus. 


Thus, the 10th SL signifies 8, 10 and 11, and is connected with 2, 8, and 7. The main 
negative signification here is that of the 2nd bhava. However, out of the three relevant 
bhavas, the 10th SL signifies 10 and 11. The appearance of the 8th shows that it will be 
very hard and quite disturbing untill the bitter end. 


The 11th SL is Saturn posited in 8 and rules 10-11. It is in the Star of Mercury placed in 6 
and rules 3-6. It is in the Sub of Ketu+ posited in 11. Ketu is not a SL for any of the bhavas. 


Thus, the 11th SL signifies 3 and is connected with 10 and 11. Here, again, the only 
negative connection is that of the 8th bhava, and reinforces the reading of the 10th SL's 
significations. 


Now rotating the chart to the 7th to denote Donald Trump: 


The 10th SL is Venus posited in 2 and rules 1-8. It is in the Star of Saturn in 2 and rules 4 
-5. It is in the Sub of Venus. 


Thus, the 10th SL signifies 2, and also negative houses 4 and 5. It is connected with nega- 
tive houses 2 and 8. 


The signification of the 10th house is, clearly, stronger for Hillary. 


The 11th SL is Mercury placed in 12 and rules 9-12. It is in the Star of Mars posited in 3 
and rules 2-7. It is in the Sub of Saturn posited in 2 and rules 4-5. 


Here, the 11th SL signifies 3 along with 2, and is connected with 2,4,5,9 and 12. While the 
11th SL signifies the 3rd, its own sub lord negates the signification by signifying the 2nd 
bhava. Additionally, the other negative bhavas are 4,5, 9 (which negates the 10th), and 12 
(for general loss). 


The signification of the 11th SL for Hillary is much stronger than that for Trump.

US doubts Russia's claim it killed ISIS spokesman 
By Merieme Arif, Holly Yan and Jim Sciutto, CNN 


(CNN)Russia said one of its airstrikes in Syria killed ISIS spokesman Mohammad al-Adnani 
-- a claim that a US official called preposterous. 

On Wednesday, Russia's Ministry of Defense announced it killed the terror leader on the 
ministry's official Facebook page. It said Adnani was one of up to 40 ISIS militants killed by 
a Russian bomber in Aleppo province. 

But a US defense official slammed Russia's assertion. 

"It would be laughable but for the very real humanitarian suffering Russia has inflicted," 
the defense official said Wednesday. "We stand by the statement we made yesterday. We 
conducted a strike that targeted al-Adnani. We are assessing the results of that strike." 
That attack was carried out by a US drone, two US defense officials told CNN on 
Wednesday. 

On Tuesday, ISIS announced Adnani's death in a rare public statement. His death marks 
the highest-profile killing yet of an ISIS member. 

A key deputy to ISIS leader Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi, he was floated to be his successor 
should anything happen to Baghdadi. 

A statement from ISIS' Amagq news agency on Tuesday said Adnani died while inspecting 
military operations in the area of Aleppo. ISIS has not revealed his cause of death and said 
it was "determined to seek revenge" for the killing. 

"After a journey filled with sacrifice and fight against non-believers, the Syrian Gallant 
knight, Abu Mohammed al-Adnani, joined the convoy of martyr leaders," ISIS said. 

"To the filthy and coward nonbelievers and to the holders of the Christ emblem, we bring 
the good news, which will keep them awake, that a new generation in the Islamic State ... 
that loves death more than life ... this generation will only grow steadfast on the path to 
Jihad, stay determined to seek revenge and be violent toward them."

Question 1: House Grouping for 4th House 
In Astro Secrets, Part-II by Sri K. SUBRAMANIAM, Second Edition 2005 - O6, page no 
44, itis printed as below: 


IV CUSP 
1. Discharge from hospital : - Houses II, IV and XI sub lord of the IVth cusp. 
2. Construction of house : Houses IV, XI and XII sub lord of the IV cusp. 


Sir, I could not understand the above statement. Please help me in this regard. 


Answer 1: 

1. For discharge from hospital: -- The sub lord of the 4th cusp, which indicates ones resi- 
dential area, should be connected with the significators of the 2nd, 4th, and 11th houses. 
One will be discharged from hospital during the dasa -bhukti-and antra of significators of 
the 2nd, 4th | and 11 houses. 


2. For construction of house - - The sub lord of the 4t4 cusp should be the significator of 
the 4th for building a house to live, the 11 to get fulfillment of one’s desire, and the 12th 
for investment. Construction or purchase of a building will happen during the dasa -bhukti 
-and antra of significators of the 4th, 11% and 12 houses. 


Question 2: KP Significators 
I have purchased the book ”" PRASHNA JYOTISH ”., AND GOING THROUGH THE ARTICLES 
OF KPEZINE REGULARLY. 


Significator are mentioned as ” in the star of occupant or owner ” in the book as well as in 
some articles in KPEzine. 


For signification of the event to be promised, most of the time Mr. Kanak Bosmia refers in his 
articles that significator ” in the star of occupant or owner ”. 


This indicates A and D significators only out of A,B, C and D significators. 
Can we consider significators A and D only out of A,B,C,D? 


As I understand that significators A,B,C, D is the list of priority. 
So, preference is given to A and D significators. 


As I understand A is most powerful, then B, then C and lastly D. 
But here preference is given to A and D only, ie. in the star of occupant -- A 
and owner -- D. 


I am totally confused by this. 
I request for your advice on this. 


KP Ezine November 2016 35 


Answer 2: 

All the A,B,C,D significators from the KP significator table are to be considered. 

Preference is given to the A and D significators because of the important role of the planet’s 
star lord. 


Question 3: Choice of Fruitful Significators 
I request you for the clarification of the following: 


Is it necessary to select the dasa, bhukti and antra lords from the common significators be- 
tween ruling planets and significators of the concerned houses? 


Can we select the dasa , bhukti and antra lords other than common significators, if the planet 
and sub lord is signifying the concerned houses? 


Answer 3: 
Finding the common significators with the help of ruling planes is used by many KP astrolo- 
gers. 


Without using the ruling planets, the DBAS lords can be chosen by their signification of any 
of the required houses at any level of planet, its star and sub levels. 


In this regard, here are selection methods of fruitful significators: 

1) Significators of planets with no planets in their stars, which are the strongest significa- 
tors of houses under consideration by sub lordship to them (same as in the Golden Rule: to 
take the planets which are posited in the sub of significators whose constellations are not 
tenanted.); 

2) Significators whose sub lords are the significators of houses under consideration; 

3) Significators which are the cuspal sub lords of houses under consideration; 

4) Significators appearing many times amongst significators. 


Question 4: Promise of Marriage 
I am enclosing a chart, born on July 28, 1987, for your opinion on marriage. 


Here 7CSL Saturn signifies 7 and 11 houses. so marriage is promised. 

But the sub lord of Sa, Venus is not at all signifying any marriage house. 

Then can we say, even though marriage is promised, marriage may not be celebrated, as sub 
lord is final for deciding the event. 


For the promise of marriage, I am of the opinion that 7th csl should signify either 2 or 7 or 11 
house. 


But some are of the opinion that 7th CSL should signify 7th house is a must other than 2 and 
11 houses and also 5 and 8 supporting houses for marriage. 


I request for your kind opinion on this subject. 

Answer 4: 

As long as the 7th cuspal sub lord (CSL) signifies any of marriage houses 2,7, 11 at any lev- 
el of planet, its star and sub lords, marriage is promised. 

In this case 7th CSL Saturn is in house 4, lord of houses 6-7-8, in the star of Mercury in 
house 11, 1/o houses 3-11, and in sub of Venus in housel2, 1/o house 4, the strong 


significator of 8 by cuspal sub lordship having no planet in its stars. 


Since the 7th CSL Saturn signifies 7, 11, marriage is promised. Here the sub Venus' signi- 
fication of negative houses 8,12 indicates possible difficulties in marriage.

Question 5 : Denial of Marriage 
I refer to your articles IN NAVARATNAMALA-2, ” KP FOR BEGINNERS PART-7 ", page:64, 
under sub heading 7.

No planet is in its star. So Venus is the strong significator for which houses it is the cuspal sub 
lord. 

Venus is the cuspal sub lord for 2,5,7, 8 and 11 houses. So Venus is a strong significator for 
those houses. 

That is, Venus is the 7th CSL, signifying 2,5,7 and 11 houses, so marriage is promised. 

As sub lord of Venus, Moon , is not signifying any marriage houses, marriage could not take 
place. 

So, can we say that, marriage is promised by 7CSL, but could not takes place because of sub 
lord is not signifying the marriage houses. 


Aspect of Saturn on 7th house is another in this horoscope. 
So, what is our conclusion? 
Denial of marriage is due to Saturn aspect on 7th house or due to sub lord of 7CSL. 


Answer 5: 

If the 7» CSL does not signify any of marriage houses 2,7,11 at any level of the planet, its 
star and sub, marriage denied as mentioned in the NAVARATNAMALA-2, ” KP FOR BEGIN- 
NERS PART-7 ", page 64, under sub heading 7. .

6 fold significator table 





Here it is to note the double role of the sub as the decider (whether the matter signified by 
the planet and it star will fructify or not) as well as_ significator. If the 6 fold significator 
table is used directly, there will be no deciding role for the sub, especially in choosing the 
fruitful significators without using the ruling planets. That is why the 6 fold signifcator table 
was deleted in the 6 volumes of KP Readers although it was mentioned in the 1965 KP two 
volumes. 


Question 6: Significators of DBAS Lords 

In predicting the time of event, like marriage: 

Some KP astrologers are of the opinion that marriage will take place in the dasa which signi- 
fies 7th house. It is a must. Similarly with bhukti. 


Some are of the opinion that marriage will takes place in the dasa and bhukcti, 
at least one should signify 7th house. 


Another opinion is that all DBAS lords should signify at least one house out of the house 
grouping, say for marriage 2,7, or 11. 


I am totally confused. 
I request for your valuable suggestion/ opinion. 


In KP system, dasa lord is prime minister, bhukti lord is minister, antara lord is deputy minis- 
ter and sukshma lord is state mininter etc. 

Then, for marriage to takes place in a dasa - Is it not necessasary that the DASA lords should 
signify 7th house?. Without prime ministers permission, other ministers cannot act on their 
own. 


Some are of the opinion that either dasa lord or bhukti lord should signigy 7th house for mar- 
riage to take place in that D/B/A/S. 


Some more are of the opinion that in D/B/A/S, any one can signify the house grouping, for 
marriage, 2, 7 and 11, and in total all the 4 lords should signify at least one house for the 
event to take place in that D/B/A/S. 


For example ,if dasa lord signify 11th house and antara lord signify 7th house , bhukti lord 
signify 2nd house and sukshma lord signify 2nd house, then marriage will take place in that 
D/B/A/S. 

Then this will not follow the rule of KP as Dasa lord is Prime minister Etc., 

I request you for your valuable advice on this . 

Answer 6: 

In choice of timing of event, the fruitful DBAS are chosen by using the ruling planets or the 


sub as said in the choice of fruitful significators, and more weight is given to dasa first, 
bhukti second.

Question: Will I be able to get admission in desired program and course in Australia? Or I 
will have to compromise in both. 

Number: 249 (out of 249)

Place of Judgment: Kankariya-Ahmedabad Long/Lat: 23° N 0', 72° E 36’. 

Ayanamsha: 23°.58'.46" Dasa Days: 365.25 


Hints (Higher study): 

If the cuspal sub lord of the 5 (9th is higher study, and going abroad for higher study is 9 
from the 9th which is the 5t4) be the significator of 9, 12 going abroad for higher study is 
promised during the joint period of the significators of 3, 9, 12. 


Cuspal sub lord 


Cusp 5th (Cancer 17°.35’.58”): The sub lord of 5th is Mercury. Mercury is in the star of 
Jupiter and sub of Mars. Mercury is occupant of 12, owner of 4-7. Star lord Jupiter is 
occupant of 5, owner of 1-10. Sub lord Mars is occupant of 1, owner of 8-9. No planet is in 
the stars of Mars, and Mars is CSL of 12. Thus the 5 cusp sub lord, Mercury, signifies 5-1- 
10 and is connected with 4-7-12-1-8-9. Hence, going abroad for higher study is promised. 


Here you have asked about a desired program and college. Thus, checking of the 11 sub 
lord is a must. 


Cusp 11+ (Capricorn 17°.35’.58”): The sub lord of 11 is Saturn. Saturn is in the star of 
Saturn and sub of Sun. Saturn is occupant of 8, owner of 11-12. Sub lord Sun is occupant 
of 12, owner of 6. Thus, the 11 cusp sub lord, Saturn, signifies 8-11-12 and is connected 
with 8-11-12-6. 


My opinion: The 5‘ sub lord indicates higher study abroad. But the 11 (fulfill of desire) 
does not signify 9 (higher study). On the contrary, it indicates the 8. Thus, I don’t think 
you will get admission in a program or college as per your choice. You will have to 
compromise. 


Outcome: She did not get admission this year. After one year, she got admission, meaning 
in the next term and not in the same term that she asked for.

Transfer of job - A developing story (II) 


By: Sumanadasa Namarathna 


(Sunaparantha Kalyan) 
Ex-Accountant, Justice of Peace 
No.22/1, Udugampola Road, Marapola, Veyangoda, 
SRI LANKA Email: sumanal946@gmail.com 











In my previous article on this topic, (Transfer of Job - A developing Story Part I that 
appeared in the November 2016 Issue of KPEzine), I discussed and proved the KP rule for 
separation between husband and wife, by hidden planetary behaviors which came out of a 
KP rule relating to transfer of job. As per the story, the two children, too, have been 
separated from their father, and also the husband had to separate from his wife. Although 
these types of separations are frequent when a job transfer is involved, the family members 
involved in this issue are different from the nature of such general separation owing to a job 
transfer. 


Let's see the chart of the husband. 

Name: Male, Date: Friday, 27/Jul/1973, Time: 08:45:00 PM SID: 17:02:22, Place: 
Ampara, North Eastern, Sri Lanka, Lat: 07:18:00 N, Lon: 81:41:00 E, Ayanamsa: 23° 
23' 52", Lagna: Aquaries , Star: Aridra, Pada 2, Bal. Dasa: Rahu 12 Y, 02 M, 00 D, (SW 
used KPAstro 4.1) 


The sub lord of the 7 cusp is Rahu who is placed in 10, in the star of Kethu in 4, and in the 
sub of Mercury. Rahu is a depositor of cusp 10 ( 12th to 11, loosing the permanent tie of 
friendship with partner), in the sign Sagittarius (A Dual sign) and as per the rules of Nodes, 
Rahu represents its aspecting planets Saturn, Moon and Mercury from the sign Gemini, a 
well known nasty sign for separation. Also, Kalathrakaraka Venus+ aspects from the 6th 
cusp (untying the legal bondage), that is also under the co-rulers of Kethu and Saturn the 
lord of 12 & 1 (separation) in 4 (losing the lovable affairs). Mercury, the Sub lord of Rahu, 
being the sub lord for 3 (away from home/family), 6 (Separation), 9 (being 3rd to 7 - partner 
going away from residence to be separated /second marriage) and 12 (separation), is in the 
star of Jupiter (R), lord of 2 and 11 posited in 11, but associating the 12th cusp by a close 
orbit. Mercury is in the sub of Moon the lord of 6th in 4 as discussed above. Thus, the KP 
rule No. 1 below, for Multi Marriage has been satisfied. 


For the benefit of the newbies of the KP system, I wish to lengthen this story by discussing 
two other tested rules for assessing multi marriage, and for separation or divorce, 
propounded by Sri Kanak Bosmia ji, the editor of this KPEZine, under the guidance of Late 
Sri Raichur ji, a prominent KP Scholar, and Sri Tin Win ji, known as a walking 
Encyclopedia of KP. 


The assumptions are: Gemini (Mithuna), Sagittarius, Pisces (Meena) are Dual signs (for this 
study); MERC, JUP (Budha and Guru) owning these signs are considered as DUAL Planets 
(for these guidelines only). 


Hindu Aspects (Vedic aspects) with no orbs, i.e. Sign to Sign are considered. 
While finding or checking significators of houses within these parameters, the rules are: 
RULE-1: MORE THAN ONE marriage is indicated if BOTH the following conditions are 
satisfied simultaneously: 
(i) The sub-lord of the 7th cusp OR its Star lord is deposited in a dual sign (Gemini, 
Sagittarius, Pisces), OR if the sub-lord of the 7th cusp is Mercury/Jupiter; 

And 
(ii) The sub-lord of the 7th cusp is also a significator of either of the houses 2 or 11 or both.

and Sookshma will be done. We have to see some check points for this. We also need to

Average of age of 7‘ cusp sublord and its star lord planets is the age of marriage of the na- 
tive. By an unknown reference, ages of the planets are as under: 


Sun-25years, Moon-25 years, Mars-24 years, Mercury-32 years (or 18 years according to a 
different opinion), Jupiter-22 years, Venus-28 years to 34 years, Saturn-26 years or 32 
years, Ketu-32 years, and Rahu-26 years. Some references give 28 years for Rahu and Ketu. 
Although I do not use these regularly, they have been useful in finding, instantly, a past 
date of marriage in a birth chart, if 7 cusp is signifying marriage, to check the correctness 
of a birth chart. Again, however, this is a matter for research. Readers are free to use this 
notion and draw their own conclusions in regard to its authenticity and utility. 

In a case where the sublord of the 7“ cusp is Saturn (its age being taken as 26 years), and 
the star lord is sun (its age being taken as 25 years), then the average age of both is 25.5 
years. The native may get married at this age. The age of the native at the time of judgement 
is approx. 24.5year. Approx. one year later, we can see the relevant Bhukti and Antara 
when she attains the age of 25.5 years. As per general rules and principals of astrology, if 
the marriage is late, then some period of 6 months may be added .We do not need not to go 
in to details .This may be used only to gain a rough idea in order to cross check DBA i.e. 
during 2016.

ed because it is already selected and also not a common significator. Next Bhukti is that of 
Mercury from 18-10 -16 to 28-6-19. Marriage is certain during this period because the an- 
ticipated age of marriage, worked out to be 25.5 years, lies in this span of period. But Mer- 
cury is neither a significator nor a common planet. 

I rechecked the next bhukti which is of ketu. Ketu, too, is not a common significator planet. 
So, instead of telling the client that there is no chance of marriage in the coming 3 or 4 
years, I advised her parents to wait till she attains the age of 25 years and 6 months, and 
thereafter, God may shower his grace for materialising the marriage of their daughter.

Selling of lands 
By: VSN. Murthy, (K.P. Astro Consultant) 


#404, Teja Garden Apartments, Prakashnagar,

On 06-03-2014, an old client came to me and asked the following question about selling of her lands 
and she gave a horary number 188/249. Immediately, I worked it out astrologically as follows:- 
Question: - I want to sell my landed property. Whether it will be fulfilled or not? If so, When? 

Horary Number: - 188/249; DOJ: - 06-03-2014; Thursday; TOJ: - 11-48-25 AM; POJ: - Kurnool, 
(AP); 


Hints: - Landed property is indicated by the 4th house counted from Lagna. The 3"4 house is the 12th 
to the 4th house. Lagna indicates the querent. One who purchases the landed property is shown by 
the 7th house. Houses 10 and 5 are, respectively, 4» (Landed Property) and 11+ (fulfillment of his de- 
sire) counted from 7 house. Therefore selling away ones property is shown by the houses 3, 5, & 10 
counted from the Lagna of the consultant. 


Sincerity of the querent can be judged from the position of Moon. In this horary chart, Moon is the 
occupant of 4th having no planets in her stars. So Moon is a strong significator for 4th house (Landed 
property). From this we can understand that Moon clearly reflects the mind of the querent. 


According to Late Sri. Vaikari Ramamurthy ji, the Lagna Cusp sublord also indicates the nature of 
the query in horary chart. In this horary chart, the Lagna cuspal sublord, Rahu, is conjoined with 
Mars (lord of 4 & 11) and Mars aspects the 4th house (Landed Property). 


Whether the sale of Land is promised or not can be seen from the following Krishnamurthy Pad- 
dhathi Rule:- 


You want to sell away your property. Anyone with whom you deal is shown by the 7‘ house. Wheth- 
er he will be able to purchase your property or not is to be seen from the 4th cusp counted from 7‘, 
i.e. 10% cusp counted from Lagna. 

Judge whether the sublord of the 10t* cusp is either retrograde or deposited in the constellation 
whose lord is retrograde. If the sublord is retrograde wait. If the lord of the constellation in which 
sublord is deposited, is retrograde, then you will not be able to sell the property. If they are in direct 
motion and if this sublord is also a significator of either 3™4 or 10th house, then you can and will sell. 


The 10 cusp is Libra 09-41-27 (Vensu/Rahu/Jupiter):- 10 cuspal sublord Jupiter: 


(1) is retrograde. (Jupiter will become direct on 07-03-2014. So the matter will fructify after 07% 
March 2014). 

(2) is deposited in the constellation of Rahu whose lord is not retrograde, and 

(3) is also the significator of 3 and 5. 

10% CSL Jupiter (6-1, 3, and 12) is in the star of Rahu (10) and in the sub of Venus (1-5, 10). 


The matter will fructify during the period of the significators of 3-5-10.

lord. Therefore, the matter will fructify during the period of Venus Dasa/Ketu Bhukthi/Moon Anthra

Question 1: She is into cleaning business and takes contract of store cleaning and washing 
stores, buildings etc. Generally, she keeps experiencing problems in getting payments from

stuck and her customer is delaying on various grounds and she is forced to take loans from 
her friends/card company, and is paying heavy interest....when will she get her payment? 


Date of birth: 18/03/1980, Tuesday; Time of birth: 05:42:12 AM IST 
Place of Birth: Fazilka-Punjab: Lon/Lat: 30° N 24', 74° E 02’. 
Aynamsha 23°.29’.26” Dasa Days: 365.25 


Hint: 

Any money received means your bank position improves, and this is indicated by the 24d 
house. As it is given by another, to that extend it is a loss to him, the giver. As it is due, 
which need not be returned, it is in full a profit.

getting the due amount is promised during the joint period of the significators of 2, 6, 11.

sub of Saturn. Sun is occupant of 1, owner of 7. Star and sub lord Saturn is occupant of 7, 
owner of 1-12. Thus, 8 cusp sub lord Sun is the significator of 1-7-12 and is connected 
with 1-7-12. 8 sub lord does not indicate 2-6-11 at all. Thus, getting dues back is not 
promised.

junctures of the native throughout the analysis, when and if there is any sign of pattern of 
the planets that may help to find out more issues of the particular native.

seven planets. But some sages have allotted certain signs as owned by the Nodes; certain

their relevance to the matter under consideration.

3. Their Star lord 

4. The Planet(s) aspecting them 

5. The Lord of Sign occupied by them

Question 1: What went wrong in predictions of the US presidential election, astrology 
or astrologers? 
Contrary to all our analyses and predictions, Trump has won the US elections. This victory of 
Trump has confounded many political pundits and, for us, it has confounded us KP 
astrologers as well. 


I believe, in keeping with principles of truth and the absolute principles of our founding guruji, 
KSK, we must acknowledge that we went entirely wrong in our predictions. At least I would 


like to put on record the failure of my own analyses (both in October 2015 based _ on Trumps 
natal chart, and the most recent in November 2016 based on the horary method). 


Every prediction that goes wrong deserves a second look. I would like to urge all our KP read- 
ers and contributors, especially those of us who made bold analysis in this case (and which 
was the right thing to do if we claim our guruji’s system to be scientific), to re-examine our 
analyses. From a learning perspective, this will help us all understand as to why we went 
wrong. There are many questions that I can think of: 


1. Did we use the correct principles and rules? 
2. Was the birth time of Trump that we have used correct? 
3. In making our horary analyses, did we suffer from a hidden bias in favour of Hil- 


lary and against Trump that clouded our judgement and obstructed our objectivity? 
4. Or simply, that this is a case which is exceptional in the history of astrological 
analyses? 


I would appreciate if you would publish this email in the next KPEzine for December 2016. 
With this email, I wish to highlight the fact that we as KP practitioners should not hesitate to 
accept failure when, on the other hand, we are so ready to accept our successes. I would urge 
all KP practitioners to undertake a self-reflection and see where our errors lie. 


I hope you will agree with me in this regard. If we want to make the science of KP astrology 
solid, we must not hesitate to acknowledge failure and look for the correct answers.

Question 4: Fruitful significators 

Sir, It is a common practice that, during timing of events, arrive at the significators of required 
houses and the ruling 
planets, and note down the common (fruitful) planets for judging Dasa/Bhutkti etc. At times 
the dasa/bhukti periods are 

considered which are not amongst the common planets. But either they appear in 
significators list and in RPs. Some times 

the running period of planet is operating which is neither in significators or in RPs, but at sub 
level signifies the relevant 

houses. Would you please throw your expertise on the subject. 


Answer 4: 

In the article “Lottery and luck — by Late Prof. K.S.K., K.P. & Astrology 2015, page 62), it is 
mentioned, “As the significators are many, beneficial significators are to be selected, 
rejecting the useless ones. To select the beneficial significators, there are two methods and 


KP Ezine January 2017 39 


both are to be scrutinized. 

A. Note the ruling planets at the time of judgment; 

B. Note the sub lord of signifcators. If the sub lord is one of the significators, then the 
planet deposited in such a sub is beneficial, otherwise not.” 


In practice of using ruling planets the common significators among the concerned 
significators and ruling planets are usually selected. 


Here are selection methods of fruitful significators without using ruling planets: 
1) Significators of planets with no planets in their stars, which are the strongest 
significators of houses under consideration by sub lordship to them (Same as in Golden 
Rule: to take the planets which are posited in the sub of significators whose constellations 
are not tenanted.); 

2) Significators whose sub lords are the significators of houses under consideration; 
3) Significators which are the cuspal sub lords of houses under consideration; 
4) Significators appearing many times amongst significators.

The Only Complete Compendium on KP Astrology 
by Bibhash Choudhary 
Educreation Publishing, New Delhi, 2015 


This is a KP book but the following idea of “determining the Ascendant first’ is not KP 
practice in six KP Readers or Sri CR Bhatt's KP books. 

"The primary responsibility of an astrologer shall be to judge the strength of the Ascendant 
lord at the very beginning of the judgment and then to use the same in knowing the 
quantum of effects/results of the other houses under consideration. 

If the Ascendant lord is weak, then the native/querent will not achieve better results for the 
other houses under consideration, even if the other houses support the matter through sub 
level." 

This is the idea of cuspal interlinks, KB by Baskaran and KCIL by Khullar. 

Any reputable KP astrologer has not yet been found always determining the Lagna first, 
including Sri M.P. Shanmugam who has introduced the strength of Lagna (Astro Secrets & 
Krishnamurti Padhdhati, Part 1, Krishman & Co., 2003)

Part 3: 48 practical example charts dealing with marriage, finance, accident, office elections,

A Case Study - Muhurat for the 
Commissioning of Sri Lanka's first Coal 
Power Plant 


By: Sumanadasa Namarathna (Sunaparantha Kalyan) 
Ex-Accountant, Justice of Peace 
No.22/1, Udugampola Road, Marapola, Veyangoda, 
SRI LANKA Email: sumanal946@gmail.com 


EEE EE RRP RRR 


A news item of https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lakvijaya Power Station//The Lakvijaya Power 


Station (also known as the Norocholai Power Station, after its location) is the largest power 
station in Sri Lanka. The power station is in Norocholai, Puttalam, on the southern end of the Kalpitiya 
Peninsula. Construction of the facility began on 11 May 2006, with the first unit commissioning on 22 
March 2011.The first 300-megawatt phase was completed and _ ceremonially commissioned 
by President Mahinda Rajapaksaon 22 March 2011 at 18:27local time, with the presence 
of Minister of Energy Champika Ranawaka, deputy Minister of Energy Premalal Jayasekara. The 
former minister of Energy John Seneviratne could not attend as he was injured in a traffic accident on 
the way to the ceremony.//This power plant, which was announced as the country's largest profitable 
entity, was beset with many faults and shut downs since its inception. According to the media, a 
large fire broke out on 24 Oct. 2010, while under construction. On 22 July 2012, the power station 
ceased operation due to a leak in one of the thousands of tubes carrying water between the boilers. 
On 08 august 2012, a tripping of the power line from the power station caused the station to cease 
its operations. On 29 Jan. 2013, the generated capacity exceeded its designed level, causing a 
complete shutdown. An Island wide power outage occurred on 13 March 2016, which caused the 
power plant to fail. The latest failure occurred on 15 Oct 2016, which resulted in power cuts for up to 
90 minutes Island wide. Due to these continuous breakdowns of this power station, people, including 
the media, have got used to calling it as "Always break down Norochcholai".If a native gets unwell 
frequently, as Astrologers we analyze his birth chart to see if there are any physical handicaps, owing 
to afflictions of planets, preventing the native from enjoying the life he desires. Likewise, if any 
organization or institute is breaking its service every now and then, there should be some misfortune 
written in its birth. What is BIRTH? In connection with human beings, birth is the starting time of 
his life. But, no one can change or alter the time of birth of a person, even if birth is assisted by 
caesarian operation. The time of birth depends on the previous Karma of the native. But, in the case 
of the starting moment (Birth) of anything under the purview of a person or a nation, like marriage, 
starting studies, housing matters (Vasthu) or starting a business, organization, industry or institute, 
we can manage the time of its birth or starting time to obtain maximum benefits from it. It is called 
"Auspicious Time" or "Shubha Muhurat". Astrologically, the flow of good or evil of the so called 
matters, depend on the starting time or Muhurat. When studying the past issues of this power 
station, a point to ponder is the traffic accident suffered by a guest minister, who was on his way to 
the ceremonial opening of the power station. So, I guessed that there should be some inauspicious 
planetary pattern in the Zodiac on that particular day, and this effort is to see any existing 
inauspicious astrological issues at the time of starting or inauguration or commissioning of 
Norochcholai Power Plant of Sri Lanka. Before going through the muhurat, it is better to understand 
Electricity and its generation through Astrology. Uranus is the chief ruler of Electricity, Generators, 
Steam Engines and Gas Plants, etc. Electricity is the force of the Sun, reflected through Uranus. 
Since this power station uses Coal for boiling water, Saturn is also added to the list as the ruler of 
Coal.Construction of the power station began on the 11th of May, 2006. Since the exact starting time 
(Muhurat) is not available, the paths of planets have been observed as in the chart erected for 
midday, which is attached as "Lakwijaya Starting". 

Observations 

1) On that day, at 12 Noon, the Sun (Energy) was transiting in Aries (Fiery) sign,the lord of which is 
Mars placed in the 12, Gemini (Air) sign. Sun is in the star of Venus in the 8 house (Accident, 
Break, Obstacles) in Pisces (Watery) sign, and in the sub of Kethu (obstructions) in Virgo (Earthy) 
sign, representing Mars (Eruption & 12, 10), Mercury+ (8, 12), Venus (8, 12), and Saturn (7, 8, 12). 
Generally, the planet of energy, Sun, is afflicted with these connections. 








Furthermore, Sun being the planet of energy and combustion, is in the star of Venus, in a Watery 
sign indicating congelation, a depressing element of the energy. Sub lord Kethu is in Gemini, an

It is the experience of many astrologers that next to marriage, a good percentage of queries 
relate to matters of service. In the case of persons who are already in employment their 
main anxiety is to know about the prospects of promotion and when it will occur. 


Everyone who is conversant with Krishnamurthi Padhdharhi is well aware that for ques- 
tions relating to employment/service, the relevant houses to be scrutinized are as follows; 
House No.2 -- Money matters, capacity and quantum one can earn, financial prosperity, 
bank position 

House No.6 -- Job/service/day to day attendance 

House No.10-- Profession/Occupation/Name and fame/Power and prestige 

House No.11—Desires, hopes, ambitions and aspirations and their realization 


It goes to the credit of Late Jothida Mannan Shri .K.S. Krishnamurthy to have formulated a 
set of clear cut rules with which an astrologer can tackle such questions without hesitation 
and with full confidence. 


For finding out when a person will get promotion in his job, we have to analyse the houses 
2,6,10 and 11. The reasons have already been explained in the earlier para. If the sublord of 
the 10t house or 6h house signifies 2,6,10 and 11, the native will surely earn his promotion 
and such promotion will take place when the significators of the above houses operate and 
also when transits agree. 


I am herewith attaching the horoscope of a senior citizen who got a number of promotions 
during his career to illustrate the principles of K.P. 

It may be observed from the chart that the significators for the relevant houses of promotion 
are as under: 

2-Sun, Saturn 

6-Moon, Mars, Jupiter, Venus, Rahu, Kethu 

10-Moon, Mars, Mercury, Kethu 

11-Venus 


Promotions in the career of the native took place on the following dates and in the Dasa- 
Bhukthi mentioned. 


First promotion on 12‘ February, 1975, when he was running Saturn-Mercury-Mercury pe- 
riod. 

Transits on this date: 

Sun: Mars star-Saturn sub (Capricorn)

Saturn: Rahu star-Mars sub (Gemini) 

Mercury Moon star-Venus sub (Capricorn))

Fine arts- Cinema- Playback singing- Music & 
K.P. System 


By: Gunti Nagaraju KP astrologer (M.com CAIIB, Retired Bank officer) 
12-13-668/5/2, Second floor, Nagarjuna Nagar, Tarnaka, 
Secunderabad- 500 017; Tel: 040-27172206; 9490752371; 
Email: gunti.nagaraju@gmail.com 
(‘BEER ERR HRHEHEREREEERE EERE ERER HEHEHE EEHEEEEEEEEE HH 


“Music is a higher revelation than all wisdom and philosophy. Music is the electrical soil in 
which the spirit lives, thinks and invents”. Ludwig Van Beethoven 

Music is an art form whose medium is sound and silence. The common elements of music 
are pitch (which governs melody and harmony), rhythm (and its associated 
concepts tempo, meter, and articulation), dynamics, and the _ sonic qualities 
of timbre and texture. The word derives from Greek word mousike; "art of the Muses". 
Classical music is the foundation for all sorts of light and film music. 

I) WAHT K.P SYSTEM SAYS ON MUSIC (as per KP reader III of Sri K.S .Krishnamurthy) 
Houses to be judged- 5th - indicates Music. / 2nd - indicates Vocal/ 3rd-indicates instru- 
ments and 3rd & 12th indicate such instruments where both the hands and legs are used 
for producing music. 10th- music as a profession, and 11th- accomplishment of one's goal 
as musician. 

FOR SUCCESSFUL FILM CAREER AS A PLAY BACK SINGER: what K.P. rules say -- 








1) If sub lord of the 5th house is deposited in the star of a planet which has connection with 
the significators of houses 5th, 6th (Success and winning over opponents) and 10th (name 
and fame), one can be popular as an actor/ playback singer, and if it has connection with 
the 11th (success and fulfillment of desire) one will be prosperous. If Mars is connected with 
these houses, he or she can be a leader among them as there will be free from inferiority 
complex and stage fear, but success alone. 


2) Cinema is associated with Pisces sign (an emotional sign). 
3) Neptune is karaka for cinema and Venus for fine arts. 


4) Cancer is also an emotional sign and a sensitive sign. Pisces and cancer are watery signs 
producing strong characters that can play upon the feelings and emotions of others.

HI) ANALYSIS OF THE CHART OF --- SRI SP. BALASUBRAMANYAM.- (Playback singer) --- 


Before proceeding with the analysis of the chart on the celebrity I want to mention here few 
lines about the celebrity. Sri Sripathi Pandithaaraadhyula Balasubramanyam, popularly 
known as SPB and Balu in the media, is a prolific Indian singer and actor. 

He was born into an orthodox Telugu Brahmin family in Konetammapeta Neloore, Andhra 
Pradesh. His father Sri S.P. Samabamurthy was a well- known exponent of Harikatha and 
his sister Smt S.P.Sailaja is a former actor — singer in Telugu cinema field. 

His birth details are- DOB- O4JUNE1946/ TOB- 12-04-43/ POB- NELLORE. 

Sri S.P. Balu took singing as hobby during his childhood. He developed interest in music 
notations and learnt to play harmonium and flute on his own. Sri S.P. Balu while studying 
in Madras in 1964- Madras based Telugu Cultural Organization organized a music 
competition for amateur singers. Balu won the first prize and that proved a turning point in 
his life. Sri S.P. Kodandapani the then famous music director took him under his wing and 
Sri S.P. Balu from then on never looked back.

Planetary causes for ADHD 


By: Sumanadasa Namarathna (Sunaparantha Kalyan)

‘HERE ERHRERERHERHERHEEHEEHEEHEHEHEREHEEHEEHEEHEEEEHEEEHEEHEEEEEEE EHH EH 


ADHD stands for Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder. Mainly this is a brain 
disorder. The brain is an organ inside the head that controls thought, memory, feelings, 
and activity and it is the main controlling system of a creature. 








Attention means act of attending, Notice, Care, Courtesy etc. Attention deficit or 
Inattention is lack of persistence, ignore or disregard due to disorganized mentality, but 
not due to defiance or lack of comprehension. In other words, it is called Absent Minded, 
which comes under MIND. Overlook, carelessness, forgetfulness, poor in listening, fail to 
follow instructions are some of the symptoms of inattention due to confusion of mind or 
flightiness. 


Hyperactivity means over or above the normal condition of one's process of doing 
something or a deed or a thing done. In other words it is Over Activity, a physic condition 
pertaining to the MIND. Persons with this abnormal seem to move about constantly, 
including in situations in which it is not appropriate; or excessively fidgets, taps, or talks. 
Mental traits are largely rule over by Neptune. Neptune is said to be enhance these powers 
in its owned sign Pisces owned by Jupiter. The physic constitution and vitality with 
physically benefits are under the rule of Uranus. Hyperactivity is caused by the affliction of 
Neptune (Nervous system, Brain & Motor Nervous) or Uranus (Nervous system, 
Cerebral-spinal fluid, Physic ability, mental disturbances, derangement of brain, Insanity). 
If Neptune is afflicted or opposite to Mercury tends to absent minded. Also confusion of 
mind indicates when Mercury is in a sign of Jupiter (Sagittarius or Pisces) or Mercury 
afflicted by Jupiter or Neptune. 


Since the principle organ of the human body related to this disease is Mind, in examining 

this through the planets, the points to ponder can be listed as below. 

1) This is a disease. Hence the 6th cusp should be scrutinized. 

2) The planet Mercury is the principle ruler of the mind and the brain. If afflicted, Mercury 
tends to disturbances of the Mind, Brain & Nerves disorders. 

3) Although Mercury is the ruler of mind, Mercury alone cannot do any obstructions to the 
mind, since mind is intangible and the brain, controlling organ of the mind must be 
afflicted by its rulers. Jupiter is the planet for Congestion or abnormal accumulation of 
the brain. 

4) The degree on the Ascendant strongly rules and influences the mind. The brain 
substance is ruled by the Moon and Mercury. The relation between these three bodies 
at birth, determine the mentality. 

5) The 3rd and 9th houses are the houses of mind and malefics in these houses tend to 
disturb and unbalance the mind. 

6) The outer planets Neptune rules Cerebral Ventricles while Uranus rules brain coverings, 
the Dura Mater. 


As a trial to look for a planetary combination, in accordance with the Sub Lord Theory 
propounded by Sri KSK ji, for this mind disease, I have selected 12 natal charts of natives 
who were found to be affected with ADHD and analyzed the above said pointers. 

Also please note, to avoid the using of more room in the magazine, only three charts have 
been discussed here in lengthy and a table of summary of analyzing of all charts is attached 
herewith, which are based on the system of analyzing those three charts using KPAstro 4.1

It is in the star of Jupiter, the lord of 7 & 8 in 10. Sub lord of Venus is Rahu that is 
the sub of Lagna in 8, in Aries (Head & Brain).

(Disease). It is in the star of Jupiter and in own sub. Star Jupiter is the lord of 7 
(M&B) and 8 (Chronic) in 10. Mercury+ aspects 10 (Health 7 disease), 12 (Terminal) 1
