deposited in the 6th (Disease) associating Mercury. Lagna sub Rahu is in the 8th, 
representing Mars. Mars is the lord of 4 and 9 (Mind) in 2 (Maraka). This relationship 
determines the ill-mentality. 


4) Lord of House 3 Venus, also having the lordship of 10 is in the 7th (M & B), in con- 
junction with Saturn the lord 5 & 6. Also Venus is the sub of 6 (Disease). It is in the 
star of Jupiter and in the sub of Rahu. Star lord Jupiter in 10 is the lord of 7 & 8. 
Sub Lord Rahu is in 8.

(Maraka). Star Lord is Venus as described above under house 3. Sub Lord Saturn is 
the lord of 5 & 6 in 7 in conjunction with Venus. Saturn is in its own star and sub 
and in addition to 9th cusp. So both 3 and 9 cusps are afflicted causing mental dis- 
order.

Now-a -days Sports and Games are a very big source of earning. All most all the renowned, 
successful, talented professional cricketers are Karodpathis. Let us know the basic rules of 
cricket. They are as follows:- 
Cricket is played with two teams of 11 players on an oval-shaped field. Each team has 
at least one inning to bat. The team that is not batting bowls and fields the ball. Most of the 
action takes place on a 18-meter-long pitch situated in the middle of the oval ground. The 
team that scores the most runs is the winner. 
At any instant, there are two batsmen present on the field of play. The fielding team can use 
all of its players, although there is always one bowler and one wicketkeeper, leaving nine 
players to field the ball. The batting team scores runs when the two batsmen complete one 
length of the pitch. The batsman can run as many times as they like. Runs can also be 
scored if the ball is hit along the ground to the boundary, which counts as four runs, or 
over the boundary on the full, which counts as six runs. 
The main objective of the fielding team is to dismiss 10 of the opposition players. The most 
common way to get a batsman out is to catch the ball in the air, but other methods include 
bowling or running a batsman out. Once a player is out, he is replaced by another player 
from the batting side. The length of batting innings may be fixed.

The ruling planets at the time of query would be the ruling planets at the time of fructifica- 
tion of the event. (See page no.36 of “Stellar astrology” by Sri K Punneswra Rao). 


It is a well known principle in K.P system that “those planets, which are ruling at time of 
query and contribute for the fructification of the event, are called “Ruling Planets”.

cation of the event. (See page no.36 of “Stellar astrology” by Sri K Punneswra rao).

1) If the sub lord himself is retrograde then the event will materialize with delay. But if it is 
posited in the constellation of the retrograde planet since the event will not be material- 
ized reject such planets, and accept the remaining. (See page 131-KP reader 6 and pages 
3-para no.8 and 7-para no.19of the book “ Horary” by Sri Kuppu Ganapathi). 

2) Since the K P system is mainly associated with Sub lord, K P stalwarts and researchers 
at a later period found the importance of sub-lord of both Moon and Lagna, and started 
using the sub lord also as RP, the same principle of retro motion was extended to sub 
lord also.

cury is taken as R .P.

additional RP. Now total Ruling Planets are Venus, Jupiter, Mercury and Mars. 


We have to consider these Four (Mars, Jupiter, Mercury and Venus) planets at the time of 
checking the Lagna Transition for arriving at the correct time of fructification of the event.

On the 3'4 of December 2016, one of my students asked me ‘when will you, sir, receive the 
VPP parcel of book’? (The book has been ordered over phone while this student was present 
with me, with a book-publisher in the neighbouring state of Tamil Nadu on 30t November 
2016). To answer him I took a ‘time horary’ and the findings are given under. 








At this time of analysis, 11:35:01 hrs, and date 03/12/2016, at my place at Palakkad- 
Kerala, the ascendant was rising at 301*-37’-40” and the Moon was transiting at 298*-57’- 
96” , while the day was ruled by Saturn, being a Saturday. 


KP New Ayanamsa: 24*-00’-11”. Thus the planets that were ruling ‘that moment’: 
Lagna: Saturn-Mars-Mercury; 

Moon: Jupiter-Sun-Mars; 

Day lord: Saturn. 


The node Rahu was in Leo, representing Sun by sign occupation, Saturn and Mars by 
aspect and Venus by star occupation, while the other node Ketu represented Saturn by 
occupation in Aquarius and Rahu by constellation. Jupiter the 11 lord and the lagna lord, 
with 11 house signification, are aspecting Mars, lord of 3™, who is the sublord for Saturn ; 
Mars signify 11 through his star lord. This indicates that the day of receipt will be 
influenced by Saturn and Mars. 


Since I have already ordered the books and the publisher has agreed to send it, itis a 
foregone conclusion that the packet will be sent to me at the earliest. Since neither the 11t 
cuspal sublord Mars, nor its star lord where it is deposited, are in retro motion, and also, 
since Mars is signifying houses 3 & 11, receipt is assured. The question is when ? 


The answer I seek, as per principles of K.P, will be when the significators of 3™4 and ]1t 
operate conjointly. 


The cuspal sublord of the house of dispatch of the material , 3, is Saturn . It occupies 
10th and is in the star of Mercury who is in 11. It is in the sub of Mars, who owns 3" , and 
is in Capricorn aspecting the 34. The 11 lord, Jupiter is aspecting the 34 lord, placed in 
12th, Jupiter owns 2" cusp, which denotes ‘possession of any movable article/liquid cash’ 
etc, here in this horary, ‘the parcel which I expect’ . Mercury is the cuspal sublord for the 
2nd house and is placed in 11th . Mercury is in the star of the node Ketu, who represents the 
3d lord . 

Destination for the article is my home, represented by 4‘ cusp . Its sublord is Venus, who 
finds occupation in 11 bhava . Venus being in Capricorn, with Ketu’s occupation in 
Aquarius, as a node, Ketu acquires the 4 house signification of Venus as well . 


Ketu is connected to Saturn, being in Aquarius, representing the owner who signifies 11 . 
Thus the speculum reveals that total significators for 3 &11, besides that of the other 
relevant houses connected to the query, of 24 and 4th, are all the nine planets. 

We have seen that Saturn, Mars, Jupiter and Sun, besides the two nodes are the ruling 
planets ; and these are the common ones as well . 


Currently, the horary dasa of Sun is in operation; it is a strong ruling planet who is 
signifying 11 , both at its star level as well as sub level.

Important key points to be remembered when matching 
the horoscopes for marriage 


By: VSN. Murthy, (K.P. Astro Consultant) 


#404, Teja Garden Apartments, Prakashnagar,

BERR HRHRHRHRHERERHEEHEEREHEEHEEHEEHEEEEHEEEEEEEEEH HE 
Marriage is a life-long association and must be taken seriously. So we should never satisfy 


with Dasa Porutham/Ashtagan kootam, it is better to check the horoscopes of both bride 
and bride-groom individually basing on the following important points. 











If we do not provide a clean and neat wall to an artist/ painter, how can he draw a beautiful 
picture on it? He cannot draw. We being the astrologers should check whether the life span 
is promised to both of them or not. If anyone among them is having short life span, it is a 
foolish thing if we select such a horoscope for marriage. So we must give top most priority to 
Longevity of the individuals. 


(ii) K.P. Rules regarding Longevity is given hereunder:- 

(a):- If the sublord of the Ascendant be the significator(in the star of the occupant or owner) 
of the house 6 or 8 or 12, the life is short (about 33 years). 

(b) If the cuspal sublord of the Ascendant be the significator (in the star of the occupant or 
owner) of the house 1 or 5 or 9 or 10, the life is long (more than 66 years). 

(c) If the sublord of the Ascendant be the significator (in the star of the occupant or owner) 
of the house 6 or 8 or 12 and 1 or 5 or 9 or 10, the life is medium (about 66 years). 

(d) But if the cuspal sublord of the Ascendant be the significator (in the star of the occupant 
or owner) of the Badhaka and Maraka houses with the above mentioned houses, it is not 
good for the life. It is an indication of short life. 

(e) If the cuspal Joint Rulers(the signlord, starlord and sublord) of the Ascendant or the 8 
cusp be the significators (in the star of the occupant or owner) of the Badhaka and Maraka 
houses, their joint period is very critical for life. (In the short life case with in 33 years, in 
the medium life case with in 66 years and in the long life case above 66 years, also check 
the 3 and 8 cusps too). Badhaka bhava is more danger than Maraka bhava. So when we 
are checking about longevity first check the Badhaka bhava and then Maraka bhava. 


(II) Is there any use if we invite a patient who is suffering from severe stomach-ache to a 
feast? No, he cannot enjoy. Similarly if we arrange marriage for a girl to an unhealthy boy is 
not correct on our part. How can they enjoy and lead a pleasant life? It is impossible. So we 
as astrologers should check about the health individually. K.P. Health, Disease and Cure 
rules are given hereunder:- 


HEALTH:- 

If the sublord of the Ascendant be in the star of the occupant or owner of the house 1 or 11, 
health of the native is normal. 

If the sublord of the Ascendant be the significator(in the star of the occupant or owner) of 
the house 6(sickness) or 8(danger to life) or 12(hospitalization), it is not good for health. 

The native may suffer from sickness or disease, during the joint period of the significators of 
1 and 6, or 1 and 8, or 1 and 12. 


DISEASE:- 

If the sublord of the 6 cusp be the significator of 6 or 8 or 12 and connected with 1, the 
native may suffer from disease during the sub period of this cuspal sublord of 6. If the 
sublord of the 6 cusp be connected with Saturn, disease becomes chronic; if with Mars; 
disease is acute, sudden and painful and causes operations; if with Mercury, disease 
becomes complicated; and if with Rahu or Ketu the disease remains undiagnosed. Rahu is 
similar to Saturn and Ketu is similar to Mars in giving effects. If the sublord of the 8 or

12th cusp be the significator of 6 or 8 or 12, then the native suffers from the disease and 
permanent defect, which related to sign and house of 6 cusp sublord and its starlord. 
Similarly, if the sublord of the 8 or 12t be the significator of 6 or 8 or 12 then the native 
suffers from serious illness or chronic disease or the disease which might bring some 
permanent defect, related to sign and house of 6“ cusp sublord and its starlord. Disease is 
cured during the joint period of the significators of 1, 5 or 11. 


CURE:- If the sublord of the 6 or 8thor 12th or 11 cusp be the significator of 1, 5 or 11 
disease is cured or the native is saved from danger. Disease is cured during the joint period 
of the significators of 1, 5 or 11. 


(III) Every one of us knows pretty well that money makes many things. If we have sufficient 
bank balance, we can please and satisfy our partner. It is better to remain unmarried than 
to spoil the life of the partner without minimum income to run a family. Therefore, we as 
astrologers must and should check the income of individual in their birth chart. 


INCOME (Self-acquisition):- If the 254 cusp sublord should signifies 2(income) or 6(Service) 
or 7(business) or 10 (profession) or 11(fulfillment of desire), then the income is promised to 
the native.

(V) Next let us check whether the native is promised second marriage or multiple marriages. 
When does second marriage occur in general? When the spouse dies or divorce then only 
second marriage takes place generally. Second marriage indications should be seen in the 
horoscopes of both. 


K.P.Second marriage Rule:- Second marriage is indicated if the following two conditions are 
satisfied simultaneously:- 

(i) The sublord of the 7‘* cusp is deposited in a dual sign or in the constellation of a planet 
in or owning a dualsign or if the sublord of the 7 cusp is Mercury; and 

(ii) The sublord of the 7 cusp is also a significator of either of the houses 2 or 11. 

If any one of the above two conditions is not satisfied then second marriage is denied. 
Kanak Ji’s Second Marriage Rule:- If the 9* cusp sublord signifies 2 or 9 or 11, second 
marriage is promised. 


(VI) Next let us check whether the happy married life is promised or not. 
K.P. Rule for happy married life:- If the 11t* Cuspal sublord signifies 2, 5, 7 or 11, then 


happy and harmony in married life is promised. 


(VII) Main intention of marriage is expansion of one’s dynasty/family lineage/vamsam. For 
it, we should check whether progeny is promised or not individually. 


K.P.Progeny Rule:- If the 5 cusp sublord signifies 2 or 5 or 11 then progeny is promised.

Question 4: Hindu and Western Aspetcs 
In Western aspects 90 deg, 150, 180 deg. etc are bad aspects and 60 120 etc are good as- 
pects. 


In KP System, we follow the aspects by SIGN wise. 


All planets have 7th house aspect.( 180 deg)- Is it good or bad?. 

Jupiter have aspect of additional on 5 and 9th houses. Which is good and which is bad?. 
Mars have additional on 4 and 8th houses. which is good?. 

Saturn have additional on 3 and 10 th houses. which is bad?. 


Answer 

Hindu Aspects 

The Hindu aspects (Drishtis) are counted ‘from rasi to rasi’, irrespective of the positions of 
the planets in the rasis and the relative distance between the two planets i.e. not ‘from de- 
gree to degree’ like in the Western aspects. Planets aspect the entire rasis with or without 
any planet or cusp there, and the closer an aspect on any located planet or cusp is, the 
stronger the result would be. 

All planets, Sun to Saturn, aspect the 7th (180°) from the rasi occupied by them. 
In addition Mars, Jupiter, and Saturn have’ special aspects as_ below: 


1) Mars aspects the 4th (90°) and 8th (210°) from the rasi occupied by it. 
2) Jupiter aspects the 5th (120°) and 9th (240°) from the rasi occupied by it. 
3) Saturn aspects the 3rd (60°) and 10th (270°) from the rasi occupied by it. 


In KP the shadowy planets Rahu and Ketu (Nodes) do not aspect any planet or any house 
since they are only the sensitive and powerful intersecting points in the pathway of Sun and 
Moon and they are not having any physical body which can be seen through a telescope as 
we can see all the other planets. 


Western Aspects 
The Western aspects are counted ‘from degree to degree’, not from rasi to rasi as in the 
Hindus aspects. 


There are five basic, most important aspects, used already by Ptolemy: 
1) Conjunction, O° 

2) Sextile, 60° 

3) Square, 90° 

4) Trine, 120° 

5) Opposition, 180° 


Main Differences between Hindu and Western Aspects 

1) The Hindu aspects are counted from rasi to rasi but in the Western aspects, the aspect 
is reckoned from degree to degree. 

2) The magnitude of Hindu aspects between two planets is different whereas in the Western 
aspects it is the same. The Western five basic aspects are the same for all planets, e.g. 
sextile (60° / Hindu 34 aspect) is for all planets, not for Saturn only as in the Hindu as- 
pects; square (90° / 4th Hindu aspect) is also for all planets, not for Mars only like in the 
Hindu aspects; trine (120° / 5th Hindu aspect) is also for all planets, not for Jupiter only 
similar to the Hindu aspects. 

3) The Western sextile and trine aspects are clearly marked as beneficial and square and 
opposition as evil. Whereas in the Hindu aspects there is no such classification and they 
are generally based on the signification of aspecting and aspected planets.

Dictionary of Significators in Astrology 

by Umang Taneja & P.K. Sarna 

2015, 245 pages 

(First addition was published in 2000, 235 pages) 





This book is generally a reproduction of “Part One: An Alphabetical Listing”, (out of four 
parts: an alphabetical listing, a listing by planets. a listing by signs, a listing by houses) of 
the following book. 


The Rulership Book - A Directory of Astrological Correspondences 
by Rex E. Bills 

American Federation of Astrologers, 2007, 456 pages 

(First addition was published in 1971) 


This is a reference book for astrologers, for instance, rulers of “accounts, accountants — 
mercury, virgo, gemini, Saturn, 8” in ‘Dictionary of Significators in Astrology” with 
compared to “accounts, accountants — mercury, virgo (gemini, Saturn, 8) by symbols in “The 
Rulership Book”, here ‘mercury, virgo’ are commonly used and ‘gemini, Saturn, 8’ in 
bracket are used by some.

This is the case of a native who is already residing in the UK, and he now wishes to settle in that 
country on a permanent basis (11 house - desire). 

To settle abroad means to consider the present place of his stay as his permanent residence (4 
house). 

1. MOON speaks the querent’s mind- Moon is the owner of 9th (abroad), aspected directly by the lord 
of the 11th house, Mercury. Moon is in the star of Jupiter being the lord of 2 and 5 and posited in 
the 11th (accomplishment of desire). Moon is in the sub of Saturn, lord of 3 and 4 placed in the 1*. 
Thus, Moon signifies all the relevant houses i.e. 3- obtaining visa, PR card; 4- place of residence/ 
stay; and 11- accomplishment of desire. 

2. Whether the event is promised—11t» house speaks of one’s accomplishments and fulfillment of his 
desires. 

As per the chart, the 11 cusp sub lord is Venus. Venus is the lord of 12- stay abroad, 7- visits to 
various places including foreign countries, and is placed in the 2™4 cusp (but within 1 degree orb to 
the 3'4 cusp). 

Venus is in Moon star, lord of 9 posited in the 8, and in the sub of Jupiter, lord of 2 and 5, placed 
in the 11 house. 

Thus, the 11 cusp sub lord, Venus, at its star level signifies houses 9- abroad, 3- visa or PR docu- 
ment, 12- stay abroad, and at its sub lord level it signifies the 11 thereby clearly indicating the ful- 
fillment of his desire to get the PR card. 

3. Ascendant cusp speaks about his efforts towards getting the PR card-- as per the chart, the As- 
cendant cusp sub lord is Jupiter which co-rules the 9 also. Jupiter is in Mars star, lord of 1 and 6 
placed in the 34 house, and in the sub of Rahu placed in the 9 house. Rahu represents Sun - lord 
of 10 in the 1st; Mars lord of 1 and 6 in the 34; and Saturn lord of 3 and 4 in the 1*. 

Thus, the Ascendant cusp sub lord, Jupiter, signifies house 11 at the star level, and 4 at its sub lord 
level during the conjoined period of the significators of houses 3-4-11. This indicates clearly that 
there will be success in the efforts of this native in getting the PR card.

A Re-look on my Horary Analysis 
By: VSN. Murthy, (K.P. Astro Consultant) 


#404, Teja Garden Apartments, Prakashnagar, 
KURNOOL- 4. (AP) Mobile:- 09440220874. 


E-mail:- vsnm_vdl@yahoo.co.in; Vsnm.vdl@gmail.com 








One of my long time clients came to me and asked the following question by giving a horary 
number 196/249. 


Question:- I am badly in need of money. Shall I get help from my close friend? 

Horary No.196/249; DOJ:-28-06-2016; TOJ:-02-54-11 PM; POJ:- Kurnool.(AP). 

MOON indicates the mind of the querent. Moon (3-7) is in the star of Mercury (5-6, 9), and 
in the sub of Venus (6-5, 10). 6 indicates loan. So, the question raised by the querent is a 
genuine one. So, we can proceed to further analyse the horary chart. 

Fulfillment of the desire is indicated by the 11 house. 11 cusp sub lord in this horary 
chart is Mercury. 

Mercury (5-6, 9) is in the star of Mars (10-4, 11), and in the sub of Venus (6-5, 10). Here, 
the 11 CSL Mercury’s star lord, Mars, is in retrogate motion. 


“Planet in direct motion if deposited in the constellation of a retrograde planet, one 
cannot have success”. (Horary Astrology-Reader VI -— Page no. 146). 


Hence I declared that this querent will never get any sort of financial help from his close 
and intimate friend. 

Actual fact:- My client got financial help from his friend on 20-08-2016 and received cash 
Rs.80,000/- 


Re-look of my analysis is as follows:- 
My client received Rs. 80,000/- on 20-08-2016 (during the period of Mercury/Venus/Ketu/ 


Mars which was running from 18-08-2016 to 22-08-2016). 
From this, it clearly reveals that RETROGRESSION SHOULD NOT BE CONSIDERED in 


horary also. 


” Planet is the source, constellation indicates nature of the results, and the SUB is the de- 
ciding factor whether the matter is favourable or not.” 

Based on this rule, it is proved beyond doubt that the sub is a decider even when the star 
lord does not favour the result. 

Here, in this chart, Mars the star lord of the 6 sub lord (Mercury), though it is in retro- 
grade motion, since the sub lord Venus (sub lord of the 6 sub lord Mercury) as a decider 
signified 6th, it has given favourable results. 

I have overlooked one more important point that — 

“even though the star lord is in retrograde motion, if it signifies one of the relevant houses of 
judgment (Mars-11 as sign lord), it will give the positive result when the retrograde motion 
turns in to direct motion and comes on to the original longitude position from where it be- 
came retrograde in motion.” 

Here, in the chart, Mars, the star lord of the 6 cusp sub lord at the time of judgment, was 
in retrograde motion, and became direct on O1 July 2016 (and came to the original retro- 
grade longitude position (14-49 degrees) on ( original retro date18-4-2016) on 22-8-2016. 
So, it has given the positive result on 20/8/2016. 


K.P. Rule for getting financial help:- In horary charts, sub lord of the 11t* cusp should 
not be retrograde and should not be deposited in the constellation of retrograde planets, 
and it should be the significator of houses 2,6 or 11, then one will get financial help from a 
particular person (his friend) during the conjoined dasa period of 2-6-11.

Questions & Answers 
By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 








Question 1: A planet having no planet in its stars 
I request you to clarify the below for my knowledge. 


1. Suppose the CSL of 6, Venus, a planet, is not having not having any planets in its all 
the three stars. So venus become strong significators for 6th house, where it is a sub lord. 
At the same time Venus signifies other houses also under A, B, C and D significators. Un- 
der ABCD significators, 6th house is not there. 


My doubt is whether Venus signification for 6th house is stronger than significators under 
A categery OR where it will stand ?. 


Answer 1 


A planet having no planet in its stars is the strong significator of houses for which it is the 
cuspal sub lord. (KP Reader III, pp 309/316) 


So here Venus’ signification for 6th house is stronger than significators under A category. 
Question 2. Maraka and Bhadhaka houses 


For a Mesha/ aries born people, 2 and 7 are marakas and 11th is Bhadhaka. My doubt 
is, is it 2 , 7 and 11 houses or Rasis?. 


Due to displacement of houses, some Rasis may not have any house. For example, one 
cusp is at 28 deg in Aries and the next house is at 2 deg in Gemini, leaving Taurus without 
any cusp i.e. without owning any house. 


Answer 2 


The Jataka Parijata originated Badhaka and well known 2,7 Maraka concepts are originally 
Rasi-sign based. But in the Placidus unequal bhava applied KP, the Badhaka and Maraka 
are Placidus-Bhava- based, for instance: 

(1) KP Reader VI (any Edition) pp 156-157; 

(2) C.R. Bhatt: Further Light of Nakshatra Chinttamani pp 31, 158;hava 

(3) K. Hariharan: How to Judge Longevity? pp 32, 68, 82; 

(4) K.P. & Astrology 2005 p 16 (Vijay Kumar: Father's Sickness, A KP Appraisal) 


It is to be careful in application of rasi based Hindu aspects in the Placidus unequal bhava 
-based KP chart when two or four rasis are intercepted (any cusp is not falling in two or 
four rasis).

Is Saturn in 8th house good or bad for longevity? 
By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 











There is a general saying by some that Saturn in 8th house indicates long life by being the 
karaka of the 8th house and longevity. But the following empirical study of 21 charts with 
Saturn in 8th houses shows the opposite result. Out of 21 charts under study, only 4 
charts survive over 70 years of age. 


In this study longevity is found generally shortened by the Ascendant cuspal sub lord 
(CSL)’s connection to Badhaka (11th house for moving, 9th for fixed and 7th for common 
sign Ascendants), Maraka (2,7 houses) and 6 (sickness),8 (serious ailment, danger to life),12 
(Moksha) houses, without getting significant help from live saving 1,5,11 signification. 


The Dasa/Bhukti/Antra/Sookshama lords at the time of death are generally satisfied the 
KP death rule of signifying Badhaka, Maraka, Moksha, 6,8,12 houses, along with 4 (end of 
everything), and 10 (retirement from this world). 


Saturn in 8th house in President Donald Trump’s swearing-in chart and its Asc. CSL’s 
signification may not indicate full term of presidency.

Illegitimate Birth 


By: Sumanadasa Namarathna (Sunaparantha Kalyan) 


Ex-Accountant, Justice of Peace 
No.22/1, Udugampola Road, Marapola, Veyangoda, 


SRI LANKA Email: sumanal946@gmail.com 





‘HEE EEEEEEEEREEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE HH & 


The word "Illegitimate" stands for illegal, unlawful, illicit, against the law etc. In case of child 
birth, when the parents are not lawfully married to each other, the child is known as Illegiti- 
mate or a Bastard person. 

There is no argument that each and everything in this universe is under the purview of 
planets and hence there should be Astrological reasons for this type of births. When we go 
through the classical astrological treatises, we can see two comments delivered by great 
sages with some astrological behavior of the planets in a natal chart of so called bastard 
births. 

A) Varaha Mihira, who is highly praised as the father of Hindu Astrology, has said in his 

Brihat Jathaka, Chapter 5, Stanza 4 as below. 


If Jupiter aspects neither the Lagna nor the Moon, or if there is no aspect of Jupiter 
on Sun and Moon located in one sign, the birth should be declared without doubt as 
BASTARD. It is also a bastard birth if Sun and Moon are in the company of the malef- 
ics. (Brihat Jathaka translated by Prof. P.S.Sastri) 

Prof. P.S. Sastri had shared his experience in support of the above mentioned 
sloka in the commentary of his translated Brihat Jatak that a Jupiter under 
heavy affliction could not prevent a bastard birth by giving an example birth 
chart of a boy born from a man other than the legitimate husband of the mother. 
(Ibid page 58) 


B) King Kalyanavarma says in his Saravali, chapter 9, stanza 32 & 33, 

Moon, or Lagna sans Jupiter’s aspect; Luminaries being together without Jupiter’s as- 
pect; Luminaries along with malefics not receiving the aspect of Jupiter; Sun, Moon 
and Jupiter simultaneously in fall, while Saturn is in Lagna, and Lagna, Moon and Ve- 
nus not being in aspect to Jupiter, lead to birth outside wedlock. 

However in 2009, one KP follower from India, has gone through some bastard natal charts, 
using these two rules, to find out the validityof the rules but in vain and posed a conun- 
drum to arrive at a KP rule for illegitimate births. At that time, no rule for bastard births 
was available in KP, and no KP astrologer has undertaken any studies in this regard. Even 
today, according to my knowledge, no KP rule for bastard births has been adopted by any- 
one. 

As a researcher of KP, I hope and trust that the below study of illegitimate birth will fill the 
gap in KP. For this study, I have examined 10 bastard charts. 

Bastard child is born as a result of living together with a male out of wedlock by the mother 
of the native. In other words, it is a love affair that goes beyond ethics to have enjoyment in 
the form of extra-marital sexual relations. Secret or open love and sexuality is under the 
rule of the 5th cusp in KP. 

KP rule for extra marital sex: 

If the sub lord of the 2nd cusp ts connected with the 11 house, one will keep a keep. (KP 
Reader 4, 1984/2002 Edition, page 146) 

All matters of physical pleasure, including Pursuit of pleasure, Rape, Sensuous enjoyments, 
Sex instincts, Sexual involvement, Social intercourse between sexes prior to wedlock, Extra 
marital sex are ruled by the Sth cusp.

5,8,12 houses.” 

At the same time we have to look for the planet Venus, that makes a person crave for the 

opposite sex. Venus’ (pleasure, sex, indulgence, relationships, fun, female energy) connec- 

tion with Mars (sexual energy, drives, lust especially in conjunction with Venus, action, 
male energy). 

Generally, all extra-marital matters of a person are called "licentiousness". (In Sinhalese 

"Anaacharaya", In Hindi "Duraachaar", in Tamil "Kaamavert"), ruled out by the 8th house.

in the DBA of the significators of houses 11 and 2 (without 7). 

5) Keeping a keep: if the 24 cusp sub lord signifies house 11 (without 7), then it occurs in

3) Nodes 

Astrologically, Nodes Rahu and Kethu are not considered as retrograding planets. But, their 
actual transition is backwards, and in most of my studies I have found, and repeatedly dis- 
cussed in this journal about nodes, who act similar to planets in retrogression. Even in this 
study, Rahu or Kethu presents Saturn, the chief indicator of illegitimacy (as in table 1), and 
Venus, in all the charts under study. 


Findings 

1) Saturn presents for 5th house in almost all charts (100%). 

2) Retrograded Saturn presents as the sub lord of the 5th house in 5 charts out of 10 (50%). 
3) Venus signifies cusps 4 or 5 or 8 or 11. 

4) Nodes are representing both Saturn and Venus. 


Conclusion 

If Saturn be the star or sub or any type of significator for the 5t* cusp, and Venus is con- 
nected with cusps 4 or 5 or 8 or 11, and Saturn, and/or Venus, is represented by Rahu or 
Kethu, the native is an illegitimate birth.

Will our cousins get their money 


from their uncle?

My wife and her brother were trying to help their cousins in getting their legitimate share of 
money from their uncle. They were worried about their efforts in settling the matters by me- 
diation process as elders and well-wishers of both the families. This process was going on 
for more than two or three months. When I saw my wife was worried about the outcome of 
her efforts in helping the children, I, too, got curious about it, and suddenly it struck my 
mind that I should know the result with the help of astrology and that too through our fa- 
vorite KP system applying its horary methods. 

On 24d Feb 2017, at 12:18:17 pm, I plotted a time chart for the query “whether our cousins 
will get their money from their uncle? If so, when?” 





What do the KP rules say in this regard? 
If the sub lord of the 8th cusp (sudden monetary gains) signifies houses 2- money income, 


11- accomplishment of the efforts and fulfillment of desire, 8- sudden monetary gains / 
windfall/ unexpected income, then the matter in question will be materialized. 


Analysis as per the chart— 
The sub lord of the 8t cusp is RAHU. Rahu is placed in the 4th. Rahu is in Kethu star who 


is placed in the 10th, and in the sub of Saturn, lord of the 10 and 11 and placed in the 
Sth, 

Rahu represents Sun, lord of the 54 placed in the 10+, and Sun, through its sub lord Mer- 
cury, signifies the 6t* also. 

Kethu, the star lord, represents Saturn who is lord of the 10th and 11t4, placed in the 8th. 
Thus, the sub lord of the 8th cusp, Rahu, signifies houses 4 and 10 at the star level, and 
houses 8 and 11 at its sub lord level. It shows that the event of getting money is promised. 
The 11th cusp indicates my cousin’s uncle (11t is the 3™4 house from the 9t house), and its 
sub lord is Venus +. No planets are placed in Venus stars and, therefore, Venus strongly 
signifies at its star and sub lord levels- Saturn—10, 8, 11. Thus, the 11t cusp promises the 
receipt of money by way of sudden gains from their uncle. 

Since Rahu signifies the 6t* also through Sun (Sun being in Mercury sub), it indicates the 
receipt of money by way of cheque. (If the 8t* cusp sub lord signifies houses 6 & 11, one will 
receive money by cheques, and the opponent loses.) 

Normally, the 7 house indicates with whom the native transacts, and the 6 house indi- 
cates negation of the 7th due to which it causes a loss to the 7, which also consequently, 
indicates profit to the native. 

The sub lord of the 6 cusp, Venus +, influences houses 2 and 11 as a co-ruler and signi- 
fies the 11th and 7» houses. 

The 3rd house indicates appeal by the cousins to their uncle for payment of their share of 
money. 

The sub lord of the 34 cusp is Jupiter+. No planet is placed in Jupiter stars and so Jupiter 
strongly signifies the 3™ house and its representative matters — appeal with their cousin — 
uncle. 

Jupiter is in the star of Mars, who is lord of the 1st and 8th and posited in the 11+}. It is in 
the sub of Saturn who is the lord of the 10+ and 11 and is placed in the 8th. Thus, Jupiter 
+ strongly signifies the 11t* at both levels, and assures success of our appeal and efforts.

Whether BJP will win Uttar Pradesh State elections 2017? 


By: Anil Kumar Sehgal 
(K.P. Astrologer & Civil Engineer) 
N-84, Sector-12, Noida -201301 


09871514848, (Whats app only): Email: astropeace4u@gmail.com 








One of my office friends asked from me whether BJP will win Uttar Pradesh State elec- 
tions. I asked him to give a number between 1 and 249. He gave 249 as the number. So I 
calculated horary chart and did analysis as per the rules of K.P. astrology which is as un- 
der:- 


“As per Kanak Bosmia’s rule, check the third cuspal sub lord. If it signifies houses ten & 
eleven, then the victory is sure.” 


So, based on the above rule, the chart was framed on date: 5.3.2017, Time 4:47 PM, Place 
Delhi and Horary Number 249. The analysis is as under: 


The 3'4 cuspal sub lord is Jupiter(R), which is lord of the1st house & 10th house, posted in 
the 7th house. It is aspecting the 11t* house and the first house. Jupiter is in the star of 
Mars which is posted in the 1st house, and Jupter is in the sub of Saturn, which is lord of 
the eleventh placed in the ninth house. Saturn is in the star of Ketu which is in the 
eleventh house. 


So, the third cuspal sub,lord signifies the houses 1, 10, and 11 which gives the 
indications of victory for the BJP party in the 2017election. 


Now, here I also calculated how many seats BJP will get. For this purpose, I took houses 
(1, 6 &11). First house Lagna (Party BJP), sixth house competition, & eleventh house 
fulfillment of desires or achievements. 


a) Take the cuspal sub lord of the first house which is the planet Saturn. It is in the 
star of Ketu. The positional Degree of Saturn is 2° -53’ in Dhanu Rasi, and star of 
Ketu is up to 139-20’. So, the remaining degree (duration) is 13° -20’ minus 20 —- 53’ 
= 10°- 27’ i.e. 627 minutes. 


b) Take the cuspal sub lord of the sixth house which is Mars. It is in Mesha Rashi, 
and in the star of Ketu. Mars’ positional Degree is 2° — 37’ and Ketu star ends at 13° 
— 20’. So, the remaining (duration) degree is 13° — 20’ minus 2° — 37’ = 10 - 57 Le. 
657 minutes. 


Cc) Take the cuspal sub lord of the 11th house which is again Saturn, as explained 
above, the remaining duration is 627 minutes 


Now total (sum up) the remaining minutes (9) + (b) + (c) = 627 + 657 + 627 minutes = 1911 


And, total minutes are 2400. 

So, total seats are 403 in election. 

The number of seats which BJP will get is 403x1911/2400 = 320.88, say 321 seats. 
This was my opinion that BJP will get more than 320 seats 

Thanks to my Guru ji N.Mohan & K.P. Astrology.

Post analysis: When an event has occurred as per astrological prediction made, more often 
than not I have found a seventy percent, approximately, accuracy in the selection of the 
antara period that is generally based on selection from within the common significator 
planets. 


Selection of sookshkma is still a subject of research. In this case, the common planets have 
been considered in the selection of the dasha, bhukti and antara. The remaining planet was 
Ketu, that could have been considered to find the exact period of the event. But, in this 
case, the bail was actually granted during the sookshama of Rahu . Rahu is not among the 
common planets, but Rahu is a significator of the fourth house. In conclusion, we can say 
that selection of sookhshma is not based on some strictly laid down guidelines. Only 
intuition and logical reasoning on the part of an astrologer works in its selection. That is 
why astrology is considered as a divine science.

and study.

Question 3: 

I have seen so many articles in KPEZine, that birth time ts rectified and predictions are given

original and so the predictions. 


I request for your valuable suggestions on this subject. 


Answer 3: 
It is advisable to do birth time rectification if and only if the birth time rectification is 
doubtful by the native himself or herself. 


Because the rectified birth time may differ from astrologer to astrologer, method to meth- 
od, time to time and so it is rated as “C” rank. 


The bottom line is that no body knows what is the correct birth time and there is no 
agreement even what is the birth time. 


Question 4: Conjunction/ Aspects 
If a planet, say, SUN aspects KETU, ketu gives the result of sun. Sun will not give the re- 
sult of Ketu, as it is a shadow planet. 


If SUN aspects say MOON, can MOON give the results SUN and/or vice versa, by 7th as- 
pect?. 


By Sth aspect, Ju aspects say SUN. Then JU will give the result of SUN or su will give the 
result of JU?. 


If two planets are in co-joined , say mars and venus, in a house. 
Can we say that mars will give the result of venus and venus will give the result of mars? 


Answer 4: 
The KP grade “E” significator by conjunction/ aspects is the planet which is conjoined or 
aspected “by grade “A,B,C,D” significators”. 


It is correct that “If a planet, say, SUN aspects KETU, ketu gives the result of sun. Sun will 
not give the result of Ketu, as it is a shadow planet.” Conjunction/ aspect with Rahu/ 
Ketu is one way effect and two ways effect is generally taken for other planets. Both 7th 
and special aspects re generally taken. Regarding “If two planets are in co-joined , say 
mars and venus, in a house.” Hindu conjunction/ aspect is by Rasi sign not by house.

Answer 7: 

In this book "Jyotish Abhigyan " originally published in 2004, in choosing the BDAS lords 
without using the ruling planets in many solved examples, that example on page 100 solved 
in 2001 seems to show an exceptional possible case that the event happened during the 
Dasa lord which is not “a common significator” among the significators for the event and 
ruling planets. Here it is found that Dasa lord's sub lord played the role of significator in the 
context of the “double role of sub as a decider as well as significator”. It has been found in 
many cases that the event is promised or materialized by the sub's signification alone. 
(“Double Role of Sub as a Decider as well as Event Indicator, KP-Ezine Sept 2014) 


It is a common practice to choose the common significator planets among grade A,B,C,D 
significators and ruling planets in choosing DBAS lords “by using ruling planets.” 

In choosing the DBAS lords “without using ruling planets”, choosing the A,B,C,D significa- 
tors planets in the sub of sigmificators of events (EF significators). So if the 6 fold 
(A,B,C,D,E,F) signfictors table is used, there will be no role of sub as a decider which is the 
corner stone of KP.

Book Review 
Jyotish Abhigyan 
By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 











Jyotish Abhigyan 
by Late C.R.Bhatt (translated by Kanak Bosmia) 
Publisher: Kanak Bosmia www.kpastrologer.com, 2017, 137 pages 





led 


This Uyotish Abhigyan’ is the sixth book in English by Chandrakant R Bhatt, after 
Nakshatra Chintamani, Further Lights on Nakshatra Chintamani, Horoscopes and 
Diseases, Nirayan Horoscopes and Western Aspects and Prashna Jyotish. 


This book clearly explains how to practically apply KP rules in a chart interpretation and 
prediction with support of 35 solved natal charts. It is easy to look up any subject in this 
book that is well organized by topics and cases. 


It is worthy to note that timing of event is fixed in many solved examples without using the 
ruling planets. In one exceptional solved example the event happened during the Dasa lord 
which is not a common significator among the significators for the event and ruling planets. 
(p 100) That Dasa lord's sub lord played the role of significator in the context of the double 
role of sub as a decider as well as significator. It has been found in many cases that the 
event is promised and materialized by the sub's signification alone. 


The usage of cusp and bhava/house is to be cleared here. The 1st bhava is from 1st cusp to 
2nd cusp, 2nd bhava is from 2nd cusp to 3rd cusp and so on. The marriage significators 
are 2,7,11 ‘houses’ but not ‘cusps’. So the significators for any event are for concerned 
'bhavas' like in the significators table on p 118 but not 'cusps' like in the significators tables 
on pages 52, 55, 94 etc. When a planet occupies a house, that planet is said to be in the 
‘house’ but not 'cusp. 


KP Ezine April 2017 39 


The so-called general observation that when any planet is conjoined with or aspected by 
Saturn, it is under control of Saturn and does not give results (p 39-40), and the effects of 
Moon and solar eclipses (p 62) are not relevant in KP practice. 


With these minor observations, this 'Jyotish Abhigyan' is a very helpful KP reference book 
for any KP learner like other three books: Nakshatra Chintamani, Further Lights on 
Nakshatra Chintamaniis and Prashna Jyotish...

Eye Injury - Triggering point of planets 


By: Sumanadasa Namarathna (Sunaparantha Kalyan) 


Ex-Accountant, Justice of Peace 
No.22/1, Udugampola Road, Marapola, Veyangoda, 
SRI LANKA Email: sumanal946@gmail.com 











As most of our KP friends are aware, my eye sight is poor for distance having had retinal 
hemorrhage in the right eye since 2002. According to the eye specialist, this is incurable. 
However, I have not given up any daily activities like using the computer, reading horo- 
scopes, writing articles, and also continue to do all domestic work including gardening with 
sufficient physical and mental strength. 


Nowadays, it is time for removing the branches that have grown excessively in the Albesia 
trees which provide support for pepper creepers to run in my small pepper crop. Last Satur- 
day, the 22nd April, 2017, while I was removing the branches of the trees, suddenly a a 
conical shaped branch with sharp edges cut off from the tree and rushed towards my face 
and knocked me in the right eye. The eye began to bleed and I rushed home and while tell- 
ing the incident to my wife, I asked her to note down the time. She tried with several chan- 
neling centers in the area to contact an eye surgeon, but in vain due to the week-end rush. 
Finally, she brought me to our family doctor, who gave me some eye drops and antibiotics 
and dressed the eye to protect it from dust. After a delay of two days, last evening, 24th 
April, I had a chance to consult an eye surgeon and he found a small cut in the eye ball, 
and slight abrasions on the eye lids. He treated these problems and the eye is still covered 
with plasters. Luckily, according to the doctor, there were no severe bruises to the eye ball, 
and no threats to the optic nerves. 


I was amazed to see the time chart of this accident because, in my experience, KP System is 
the one and only way to identify the most reasonable planetary behavior for such incidents. 
In the morning of the 25th, with one-eyed vision, I plotted the time chart for 3.55 pm, 22 
April, 2017, as noted by my wife. 


In this time chart, the 8 cusp falls in Aries sign, which is sign of my natal Ascendant, the 
lord of which is Mars, the chief Karaka for accidents, and Mars was transiting in the 9, 
(2n¢ of the natal Marakasthana), over the star of Krittika 4t+ Pada which is owned by Sun. 
This is the governing Naksastra over head, eyes, brain and Vision. At the time of accident, 
the Sun, being the lord of the 12t (hospitalization), was transiting over the 8t cusp 
(accidents), which is the natal Lagna cusp (head and athma). This Sun is the Sign, Star, 
and Sub lord, as well as the depositor of the 6 cusp in the natal chart. While in transition, 
it was in conjunction with Mercury, natal significator of the 6 cusp. 


In the time chart, the natal 5 (recovery) cuspal sub lord, Rahu, was transiting in the same 
house as in the natal chart, representing the Sun, Moon and Mars. Among them, Moon is in 
Saturn's sign and indicated Punarphoo, which caused the delay in my ability to consult an 
eye surgeon. 


General rule for accidents 

If the Ascendant and 8tt cuspal sub lords signify houses 6 (injury), 8 (accident) and 
12 (hospitalization), and are connected with Mars, Saturn or Nodes, one may meet 
with an accident during the joint dasa period of the significators of houses 4, 6, 8 
and 12. If Maraka and Badhaka houses are also involved, the accident may prove to 
be fatal.

6th cusp (in Taurus sign 19-09-16) - sub lord is Mercury, lord of houses 7 and 10 placed in the 4‘,

Moon reveals the nature of Query 

Moon, lord of the 3"4, is deposited in the 4‘; and it is in the star and sub of Moon, and the 
sub-sub of Venus who is in the 8t and is lord of houses 1 and 6. Moon aspects the 11 
house. Hence, moon has linkage with houses 4[vehicle], 8 [2"4 to the 7], giving away money 
to the seller, and the 11t* which is fulfillment of desire, and Venus Karaka of vehicle. So, 
the Moon reveals the nature of the query in the mind of the querent. 


KP Rule for Purchase of Vehicle 

As per Horary Astrology Advanced Stellar System, Sixth Reader By Guru ji Sh K S Krishna- 
murti, page 186, purchase of vehicle is to be judged from houses 4,9,10 and 11, because 
the 4th house shows vehicle, houses 9 and 10 show enjoyment in this birth due to meritori- 
ous deeds done in the previous birth, and the 11 house indicates fulfillment of one’s de- 
sires. 


4th Cusp Sub lord 

The 4 sub lord is Mercury placed in the 7‘, and is the lord of houses 2 and 5. And, it is 
again in the star of Mercury. It is in the Sub of Mars placed in the 9, lord of houses 7 and 
12. Mars aspects the 4th house. Further, Mars is in the star of Moon placed in the 4, lord 
of 3™4, Hence, the 4t4 sub lord signifies houses 4, 9 and 12 which fulfill the necessary condi- 
tion for the purchase of a vehicle. 


Fulfillment of desire 

The 11 sub lord is Rahu posited in the 4, and Rahu is aspected by Saturn placed in the 
7h and is the lord of houses 9 and 10. Rahu is in the star and sub of Venus who is in the 
8th, and is the lord of houses 1 and 6. Hence, the 11 sub lord signifies Houses 4, 9 and 
10, which shows that the querent’s desire will be fulfilled.

Youngest French President with 24 Yr. Older Wife 
By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 














Short Background 


The 39 year old Emmanuel Macron is the youngest President in French history and the 
youngest leader since Napoleon. He is certainly a political novice since he was a former 
investment banker and appointed as Minister of Economy, Industry and Digital Affairs in 
2014. His wife Brigitte is 24 yr. and 8 months his senior. His personal life is interesting and 
attracts some criticism for a "torrid love affair" with his then teacher Brigitte. They met in 
1992 when he was a 15 yr. old school student and she was 39 yr. old his drama teacher 
even though she was married at the time with three children, two of whom are older than he 
is. AS a schoolboy, he vowed to marry her one day. He kept his promise, and married 
Brigitte on October 20th, 2007 after her previous marriage ended in divorce in 2006. 


Brigitte played an active role in her husband's campaign for president as a coach and her 
children from previous marriage helped campaign for Macron. 





Planetary Combination for Love Affair and Marriage with 24 yr. Older Woman 


1. His earthy Capricorn Ascendant is ruled by Saturn, indicating an older, more mature 
mate for long term. 


2. His 7th cuspal sub lord (CSL) is Saturn. 
3. Saturn is placed in 7th house (bhava). 


4. His 7th (relationship) lord Moon (emotion) and 11th (long term relationship) lord Mars 
(temper, drive, desire) are in mutual reception called Parivartan by exchange of Moon which 
owns Cancer in Aries (fire sign) and Mars which owns Aries in Cancer. This Moon is in exact 
opposition with Uranus (unconventional energy). More Uranus is aspected by Mars (temper, 
desire) and passionate Leo Saturn from house 7 and expansionary Jupiter from house 5 
(love affair, passion). Such kind of planetary combination suggests no shortage of fireworks 
and his temper and passion in his highly unconventional and emotional relationships, 


which is counter checked by Saturn’s discipline.

this horary chart, Moon is occupant of the 9th (change of profession) and is the lord of the 12th (new 
surroundings). Moon is in the sub of Jupiter who owns the 5th (negation to service) and occupant of 
the 254 (income-bank-balance etc.). Thus, the query is confirmed by the position of Moon.

PHOBIA - Mental Disorder 


By: Sumanadasa Namarathna (Sunaparantha Kalyan) 


Ex-Accountant, Justice of Peace 
No.22/1, Udugampola Road, Marapola, Veyangoda, 


SRI LANKA Email: sumanal946@gmail.com 





(BEER EEE EEE EEE EERE ER EERE EERE EEE EEE EE eee ee 

Once a lady visited me with a horoscope of her daughter and told me thus: "Sir, this is the horoscope 
of my only child. She is a bright case and having got through the 5t* standard competitive exam with 
highest marks, she is attending a leading girl's school in the city. She has been changed in her 
general attitude of life for the last two years with some abnormal manners. She hates her father 
when he wears a sarong in red color. She never sits on a chair that is used by her father. She used to 
wash her hands several times a day and before her visit into the educational room, she used to burn 
incense powder and smoke all over the room and utensils therein. This is an insoluble question for 
us. Can you please read her horoscope and advise us" 


Birth detail 

Name: Piyumi Ishara, Female, Date: Monday, 31/Aug/1998, Time: 10:24:35 AM. SID: 
08:20:43, Place: Castel Hospital, Colombo, Western, Sri Lanka, Lat: 06:54:00 N, Lon: 79:53:00 
W, Ayanamsa: 23° 44' 54", Lagna: Libra, Star: Jyeshta, Pada 3, Bal. Dasa: Mercury 06 Y, 07 M, 
21 D. (KPAstro 4.1) 


Preface 

If a person is having such strange attitudes as stated above, it is a mental disorder. These changes 
indicate that the girl is trying to avoid the irrational fear of specific object or activity or situation 
penetrated into her mind. If a person keeps on washing hands every now and then, that is also 
because of an irrational fear of dirt or germs or something else she dislikes. According to medical 
science, this type of behavior is known as Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD), a type of anxiety 
disorder. When suffering from such mental disorder the native is trying to control recurring and 
distressing thoughts or fear or images. In this type of cases the person believes in rituals and 
remedies or uses any type of cleansing agent to prevent the awakening of obsessive thoughts in the 
mind. 

In brief, this is a mental disorder as a result of a combination of biological and environmental factors 
of life. Biologically, there may be some disorders of the functioning of the mental faculties, which 
directly influence the central nervous system and imbalances the mind. Also, if a person is 
impressed with unusual environmental factors as a result of being abused by a third party, fear, 
changing of day to day living style, illness, separating from a loved one, school related problems, he/ 
she may become prone to suffering from mental imbalance. 

In this issue, what I could do is only to examine the natal chart for any mental disorder and 
environmental factors, if any, that should be obtained from the native. After making my conclusion 
as given below, I asked the mother to bring the daughter to meet me to discuss with her in order to 
discover any environmental reasons for the disorder of the mind. 


KP Rules for the diseases of mind 

1) The Moon governs the mind, intellect and other higher faculties of the central nervous system. If 
Moon is afflicted or adversely placed in a horoscope, the native will suffer from general moodiness 
or some type of mental excitement or depression. (Medical Astrology for All, by K.Subramaniam, 
page 67) 

2) Ifthe sub lord of the 6t cusp is in the 7th house from the Lagna and is connected to houses 3, 5 
and 9, mental aberration is caused. (Ibid, page 68) 

3) The sign Aries, the first house of the Zodiac, exercises control over the head. When in a chart 
Aries is afflicted, one naturally gets diseases of the head. When Sun is disposed adversely one 
gets afflictions of the head and mind. (Ibid, page 69) 

4) If the sub lord of the 6th cusp is afflicted to Aries by the houses 6, 8, & 12, the native will have to 
suffer mental depression. (Ibid, page 69) 

5) Ifthe sub lord of the 6t cusp is either Moon or Mercury or Sun and it is afflicted in Aries, it will 
give rise to this disease. (Ibid, page 69)

On my request the native was brought to me later on and I had a discussion with her to learn of any 
environmental background behind these changes of mind faculties. According to her statement, she 
had been taken to a fane (Devalaya*), a small temple dedicated to some Yakkha or Deity, to know 
about her future by her aunty and travelled by their own wagon driven by her father. The in-charge 
of the temple (Kapu*) wearing red robes had offered the pooja to the deity and started his fortune 
telling in brutalized manner and had told thus. (*Sinhalese) 

" You are an idiot. You are a fool. You cannot complete your education at any level. You have no 
chance to be a scholar.....". and with many more confused and negative thoughts had been 
penetrated into the unripe mind of this girl. 

At once the girl had got angry, began to cry and had run away. From that day she had planted a 
feeling of hate in her mind towards all her family members, especially for her aunty, and she had 
refused all the things in red color. She had refused to use even a chair used by her father. 

According to the facts that I have heard from her parents, there was no acceptable and justifiable 
reason to take this girl to a fortune teller for her educational matters. In her preliminary exam to 
qualify for a high school, she had had an easy win and had the chance to enter into a leading girls

that is a hard fence to jump, and got selected for secondary education. 

However, nobody can erase or cancel or postpone Karma, written in the athma at the time of birth.

was running Venus Dasa, Venus Bukthi and Jupiter Anthar. Being the lord of Lagna and the 8th,

sub lord, Moon, Mars the ruler of the head and mind, Mercury (Intellect & rational mind) and Dasa 
Lord Venus for houses 10, 9, 12, 1, and 8 were aspected by Anthara lord Jupiter. Thus, at the time 
of the incident, the houses for mind and Buddhi were severely afflicted.

Answer 1: Sensitive Point 

The sensitive zone is a point in the zodiac ruled by the fructifying significators of an event- 
especially the combinations of dasa lord and bhukti lord. 

The transit of dasa period lords should be the first consideration. The transit of Jupiter over 
a sensitive point indicates the year of fructification of the event under consideration. The 
transit of luminaries Sun and Moon which are the exciting planets over the sensitive zones 
indicates the month and the day of the fructification of an event respectively. The transit of 
Ascendant over a sensitive point indicates the exact hour and minute of fructification of an 
event. 

For the chosen common significators among the four fold significators of the required hous- 
es for an event to materialize and ruling planets, say conjoined period of dasa lord Sun, 
bhukti lord Venus and antra lord Mercury, then 1) Sun sign, Venus star, Mercury sub; 2) 
Venus sign, Sun star, Mercury sub, and 3) Mercury sign, Sun star, Venus sub are the three 
sensitive and fruitful zones, which will be transited by Ascendant, Luminaries, Jupiter and 
the planets ruling the dasa, bhukti and antra. 


For the attached chart, Male, 01/Jun/1944, 02:58 AM, hr5:30east,16n57,82e15, KP new 
Ayanamsa: 22° 59' 27", Bal. Dasa: Sun 1 Y, 1 M, 26 D, the matter of promotion was judged 
at 10:14:00 AM on 17/Jan/1970, when Ascendant was rising in Saturn star and Jupiter 
sign. Moon was in Sun star, Venus sign, and the day was Saturday. Sun, Moon, Jupiter, 
Venus and Saturn are the ruling planets, and Rahu is also considered by virtue of Jupiter’s 
aspect to Rahu. 

Rahu dasa, Saturn bhukti, Jupita antra joint period was operating from 21/Feb/1970 to 
10/July/1970. These joint dasa period lords Rahu, Saturn and Jupiter are found the com- 
mon fruitful significtors among the four fold significators for houses 2,6,10 and 11 and rul- 
ing planets. In addition they are in the sub of fruitful significators to be the strong fruitful 
significators for promotion. Since Rahu is stronger than the planets the transit of the Sun in 
Arudhra must be chosen i.e. from 18/June to 4/July 1970. That coincides with Rahu dasa, 
Saturn Bhukti, Jupiter Antra and Rahu Sookshma.During that period the transit of the ex- 
citing planet Moon indicates the day. To pin-point the date, consider the transit of Moon 
every day. On Satabhisha star day, the area ruled by the bhukti lord Saturn, dasa lord Ra- 
hu and antra lord Jupiter, i.e. 24/June/1970 at sunrise time.

Question 2: Mean or True Node 
Iam an enthusiast amateur Astrology student of KP from Jamshedpur. 


As per astrological calculations the nodal points Rahu and Ketu (north node and south 
nodejare calculated always at exactly 180 degree apart in zodiac, But in my opinion basis of 
the calculation and 180 degree concept is wrong. As orbit of earth around sun is parabolic

point must be inwards towards Sun (due to concave orbital path). I would like to know the 
scientific fact. If my thought is right then the whole Astrological world has to recalculate the 
nodal points. I was going through one of KPEZINE old issue (KP EZine_111_April_2016 , 
Page No- 41), there is a picture. To understand what I want to say, I have saved the pic from 
the magazine and highlighted the path. Please refer the edited picture I am enclosing here- 
with. I may be wrong. But somewhat I feel the sublord calculation of Rahu or Ketu will be 
different as they used to be earlier. For example - In particular horoscope when Rahu is in 
sub of Moon then Ketu is in sub of Venus ( Pls refer page 30 and 38 of the above mentioned 
magazine). But if the orbit is parabolic then one of the sublord is going to be changed re-

the basis of Rahu and Ketu are always mysterious. 

This evening I have posted the same query to NASA query page. But I did not post the pic- 
ture there. 





Answer 2: 

This is the issue of using the mean nodes or true nodes as explained in the article "A Note 
on Mean Nodes vs True Nodes" in the KP-Ezine July 2008 issue. 

The Nodes (Rahu and Ketu) are not planets. They are mathematical points in space indicat- 
ing the intersection of the orbit of the Earth around the Sun and the orbit of the Moon 
which revolves around the Earth. The planes of these two orbits intersect each other at 5° 8’ 
40". The line of intersection is the Nodal axis formed by the Nodes. 


In reality, the Nodes “wobble” a bit. They do not move at an entirely predictable speed and 
vary from day to day. They frequently turn, station, travel direct, station and return to a ret- 
rograde motion. Although the Nodes move around the Zodiac in a retrograde direction, the 
True Nodes may occasionally be direct and are stationary for several days at a time, as if 
they are wobbling. That's because the True Nodes take the gyroscopic relationship of the 
Sun/Moon into account. The Mean Node is always retrograde as assumed in the scriptures. 


KP Ezine June 2017 34 


Prior to the mid-1970s astrologers only had access to the 'Mean Nodes” which is the average 
position of their wobbling or motions. The calculation of the Mean Nodes is easy by taking 
the average of motions and the True ones is complicated. However, with the advent of com- 
puters and the accuracy of ephemerides and diurnal tables increasing by leaps and bounds, 
astronomers began to plot its course of wobbling or motions and call this position the True 
Node. The American Ephemeris programmed and publicized by Neil Michelsen and pub- 
lished by Astro Computing Services (ACS) has listed both True and Mean Nodes ever since 
then. Most software programs now have the option of Mean or True Nodes whichever one is 
preferred. 


The main reason of using the True Nodes is that they are the actual measurement of the ex- 
act positions of Nodes. However, this is somewhat illusory, since the “True” Nodes are true 
“only twice” a month when the Moon crosses the ecliptic. Other positions provided for the 
times in between those two points are just a hypothesis.That is why Robert Hand point out 
in “Horoscope Symbols” that the wobbling Nodes are no more "True" than the Mean Nodes, 
as they are in their own way just as abstract a concept. They should not be used until re- 
search has indicated which, if either, of the two sets of the Nodes is more valid. 


The Mean Nodes have been used not only by most Vedic and KP astrologers but also by 
Western well known astrologers CA Jayne, Robert Hand, Noel Tyl, Dane Rudhya, Anthony 
Lewis, Don G. Borkowski etc. Vedic astrology uses Mean Nodes since ancient times, thus a 
vast experience and feedback are available on Mean Nodes. 


In the KP-Ezine April 2016 issue, on page 38, for the chart of Horary no. 135/249, 18/ 
March/2016, 12:42:46 PM IST, Ahmedabad, 23n00, 72e36, the Mean Rahu is 27Le031:20 
and the calculated True Rahu is 27Le048:09, higher 16min:49sec. For both the Mean Rahu 
and True Rahu, the star lord Sun and the sub lord Moon are the same. Similarly for Ketu 
Jupiter star and Venus sub are the same for both the Mean and True value. 


In the same KP-Ezine, on page 38, for the chart of Horary no. 135/249, 18/March/2016, 
12:42:46 PM IST, Ahmedabad, 23n00, 72e36, the Mean Rahu is 27Le031:20 and the calcu- 
lated True Rahu is 27Le048:09, higher 16min:49sec. However for both the Mean Rahu and 
True Rahu, the star lord Sun and the sub lord Moon are the same. Similarly for Ketu Jupi- 
ter star and Venus sub are the same for both the Mean and True value. 


The True Nodes can differ from the Mean Nodes by up to 1 % degrees, and the sub of nodes 
may change in border line or exceptional cases only.

For food for thought for readers some noted rules and points in the articles are as follows: 


If Lagna lord or Lagna sub lord is connected to houses 3 or 9 or 12 in any manner, then the native 
will be permanently settling in the foreign country where he is now living. (p 9) This is in line the test- 
ed foreign settlement rule by 100 charts that one will settle abroad if the Lagan cusp and 12th cusp 
sub lords signify houses 3, 9 or 12. It is more sure if the 3,9 and 12 significators are connected to 
each other. 


In prediction of election result, if 6t and 11t* cuspal sub lords’ signification of houses 6 or 11 and 
also 1,2,9,10 (p 27)/ if their signification of houses 1,2,3,6,10 and 11, success is promised during 
the joint period (DBA) of the significators of 1,2,3,6,10 and 11. (p 81) Since power comes from 10th 
house, the 10th cuspal sub lord's signification of more important houses 6 (win over opponent), 10 
(power, name, fame, success) and 11 (gain, desire 

fulfillment) may be more reasonable. 


Retrograde planets in the birth chart reverse the event. (p 93) Retrogression does not matter in natal 
charts as per common KP understanding. 


Jupiter’s connection in any manner with houses 6, 8 and 12 indicates the probability of cancer dis- 
ease. (p 15) 


If the 6th cuspal sub lord signifies houses 2,6,8,10 or 12 and is in connection with inter-related 
Moon, Mercury, Saturn, Ketu or Uranus, a native may be diagnosed for austim disease during the 
joint dasa period of significators of houses 2,6,810 or 12, (p 125) Austin is a complex developmental 
disability for achild. 


Rules for assassination based on 12 assassinated charts of Benazir Bhutto to James A Garfield: 


1) If the Ascendant CSL signifies 2,6,7,8,12, Badhaka, then unnatural death including assassination 
is indicated. (p 141) 


KP Ezine June 2017 37 


2) If the 8th CSL signifies 2,7,8,12, then assassination is indicated. (p 142) 
3) If the 12th cusp sub lord signifies 2,7,8 or 12 and is connected to Badhaka, the native will be as- 
sassinated during the conjoined period of the significators of 2,7,8,12 and Badhaka. (p 143) 


In this regard, a tested rule of assassination (by Kanak Bosmia): 


Rule-1: If 8 or 12th cusp sub lord signifies 8 or 12, one can be assassinated in the DBA of 
8,12 significators 


Rule-2: If 8 or 12th cusp sub lord signifies 1,5,11, one can escaped from fatal attack. 
8th house: Infamy, accidental death, executions, misery. 


12th house: Crimes, assassinations, anxieties, blackmail, cheating, clandestine associates, exiled 
persons, misery misfortune, moksha 


Regarding signification, consideration of planet and its star lord only (p 32) and also up to sub’s star 
level like in K.M. Subramanium’s ‘Sublord Speaks’ (pp 20-22) has been noted. 


6-fold significators table (A,B,C,D,E,F) is used in one article. (p 126) By extending significators from 4 
to 6, almost all planets may become significators for most houses under consideration. More im- 
portantly the sub cannot be used as 'decider' in considering whether a planet is favorable or not for 
the matter under study and in choosing fruitful significators without using the ruling planets.

Email: tw853@yahoo.com 

‘BREE EERERHEERHEEREHEEHEEHEEHEEHEEHEEHEEHEEHEEHEEHEEHEEHEEHEEEHEEEEEEEEE EH & 
Short Background 

On 29 January 2017, U Ko Ni, a prominent lawyer, an expert on constitutional law and top 
legal advisor to the Aung Sun Su Kyi’s ruling party NLD, was shot dead at close range in the 
head by a gunman as he was preparing to leave Yangon International Airport, having just 
returned from a government-organized visit to Indonesia. 





Chart Details 

U Ko Ni, Wednesday, 11/Feb/1953, 04:10 AM MST, Hr 6:30 East, Katha, Myanmar, 24N11, 
96E20, KP Ayanamsa: 23° 6' 44", Star: P.Ashada, Pada 1, Lagna: Sagittarius 16:58:32, Bal. 
Dasa: Venus 17 Y, 1 M, 26 D. 


Rules of Assassination or Unnatural Death 

Cuspal Analysis: 1st cuspal sub lord (CSL) Moon is in house 12, lord of 8 (unnatural or 
violence death), in the star and sub of Venus in house 3, lord of houses 6,10,11. In addition 
Venus is closely conjoined with Mars (karaka for weapon) lord of 12. Further in Jathaka 
Chandrika houses 3,6,8,11 evil for one’s longevity. (KP Reader V, page 125/ new edition 
page 131) 

8th CSL Venus is in house 3, lord of houses 6,10,11, in the star of Saturn in house 10, lord 
of houses 2,3, and in sub of Jupiter+ in house 4, lord of house 1. Venus is closely conjoined 
with Mars lord of 12. 

This indicates unnatural or violence death. 


Rule of unnatural death: 8» house or/and 8 lord are found aspected or conjoined by 
Mars and Rahu in 39 (78%) charts, out of 50 unnatural death charts under study. In this 
chart Rahu is opposite to 8th house. 

In addition 8 lord Moon is very closely conjoined with Ascendant cusp which is in close 
opposition to sudden, unexpected Uranus. Maraka 2" lord Saturn aspects 

Ascendant, its lord Jupiter and Moon.This Saturn is aspected by Mars (violence). 


Rule of assassination by Kanak Bosmia: If 8th or 12‘ CSL signifies house 8 (accidental 
death, execution) or 12 (Moksha, assassination), one can be assassinated during the DBAs 
of significators of houses 8,12. 

12th CSL Moon is in house 12, lord of 8, in the star and sub of Venus in house 3, lord of 


houses 6,10,11. The above tested rule is found working in this case. 


Analysis of Dasa at the Time of Death (29 January 2017) 

Dasa lord Jupiter+ is in house 4, lord of house 1, in the star of Venus in house 3, lord of 
houses 6,10,11, and sub of Rahu+ in 1, conj. with Sun in house 2, lord of 9, CSL of 6 
having no planet in its stars, sign lord Saturn in house 10, lord of houses 2,3, indicating 2 
(Maraka), 6 (injury), 4 (end of everything) and 10 (retirement from this world). In addition 
star lord Venus is closely conjoined with Mars lord of 12 (Moksha, assassination).

Question. : When my run away wife will come back? 

Number; 9 (out of 249). 

Date of Judgment; 25-08-2016, Thursday; Time of Judgment; 11:41:24 AM IST 

Place of Judgment. Kankariya-Ahmedabad Lat/Long; 23° N 00’, 72° E 36’, 

Aynamsha: 23°.59'.57" Dasa days: 365.25 








Short History: A Person, his wife and two brothers went to Katra. They got a room in a 
hotel in the morning at 5 AM and went to sleep. At 7 AM he woke up and found that his wife 
was not in the room. He tried to search the hotel and in nearby places, but she was not to 
be found anywhere. So, he lodged a police complaint about his missing wife. 


Hints 
If the cuspal sub lord of the 11 be the significator of houses 2, 8 or 11(reunion), a person 
returns home during the joint period of the significators of houses 2, 8 and 11. 


Cuspal Sub lord 

1st cusp (Aries 11°.26’.40’’): The cuspal sub lord of the 1st is Mercury. Mercury is in the 
star of Sun and sub of Saturn. Mercury is occupant of house 6, owner of houses 3-6. No 
planet is in the star of Mercury and Mercury is the CSL of the 1st. Star lord, Sun, is 
occupant of the 5th. Sub lord Saturn is occupant of the 8, owner of houses 10-11. So, the 
1st cusp sub lord Mercury is significator of the 5 and is connected with houses 6-3-1-8-10- 
11. Mercury indicates Badhaka with significations of houses 6-8-10 and also 1-5, hence 
danger to life is seen. 


11th cusp (Virgo 05°.15’.45’): The cuspal sub lord of the 11+ is Saturn. Saturn is in its own 
star and sub of Jupiter. Saturn is occupant of the 8, owner of houses 10-11. Sub lord, 
Jupiter, is occupant of the 6, owner of houses 9-12. No planet is in the star of Jupiter and 
Jupiter is CSL of houses 6-10. So, the 11 cusp sub lord Saturn signifies houses 8-10-11 
and is connected with 8-10-11-6-9-12. The 11 sub lord indicates 8-11, so in my opinion, 
she will come back for sure.

Rahu is conjoined with Sun, hence represents Sun. Thus, the ruling planets are Jupiter, 
Venus, Sun and Rahu. 
Note: Moon is aspected by Saturn, hence there is Punarphoo yoga. 


Joint Period 
At the time of judgment, Balance dasa is Sun up to 19-09-2016. At that time, the joint 
period running is that of Sun-Venus-Mercury up to 28-08-2016. 


Dasa lord Sun, and Bhukti lord Venus, is in the RPs. But Antra lord Mercury is not in the 
RPs. Next Antra will be of Ketu who is also not in the RPs. This is the last antra in Venus

By: Sumanadasa Namarathna (Sunaparantha Kalyan)

(‘Coie 
The Natal chart or the Map of Birth is the figure of the heavens for the actual moment of the 


first cry of a baby. It is the stamp, which is put upon the native, and the temperament he 
will be apt to follow during his lifetime. This figure is like a flashlight picture or photograph 
of the Universe for that moment as seen from the place of birth. By studying this map of 
birth, and signs, houses and planets at birth, forecasts can be made about the health, the 
mind, and the diseases liable to, the temperament, the prospects of life and many more 
events up to the last breath. 


In summing up, what we can see through a horoscope is limited from the time of birth to 
time of death. Astrologically, a fetus (of a person/native), lying in its mother’s womb for 
about 270 days, is not considered as a BORN native. During this period, if any defect has 
happened to this fetus, it will not be focused in his natal chart, since the chart is calculated 
for the date, time and place of the birth. 


The blindness by birth is such an incident occurred during its stay in the womb due to 
many medical reasons and as the results of his previous Karma. According to Medical 
Astrology, the actual planetary causes of this condition are not generally shown in the natal 
map. But in the parental conditions, the Lunar epoch and chart of descent indicate such 
type of causes for the deformation. Affliction to the Moon at each Lunar return during 
pregnancy, corresponding to the monthly period often shows the causes of congenital 
deformations, afflictions, blindness and malformations which exists at the birth. 


In such a case, it is not so easy to collect all information of the parental epoch to examine 
the behavior of Moon during the time of pregnancy. However, I believe, living with total 
blindness, is a karmic effect of the native and hence astrological reasons for such karmic 
result should be indicated at least. In one of my researches in KP, I have observed the 
planetary pattern and their effects in the birth chart of a native born with a critical physical 
disorder, called IMPERFORATE ANUS, an Anorectal Malformation, where baby has no 
anal opening and it is totally closed and no outlet for stool. The planetary causes for this 
deformation were clearly indicated in his birth chart. 


With this experienced practices in KP, since this study is of a baby born with blindness, my 
effort is to see the relevant planetary setup for the blindness with the birth chart.

significator of houses 6, 8, 12 & 1 and the native may suffer from a critical illness. Since (a)

Significations and connections of the planets for Vision 

The Sun controls the Right eye and Moon controls the left eye, and Venus gives eyesight. 
Mercury governs the nervous system. Let's see how these four planets behave in the natal 
chart. 


Sun : The Sun+ (R/E) is directly connected with Rahu (Dark Planet), the sub of the Lagna. 
Sun is the lord of the 6th (diseases) and deposited in the 7 (Maraka & Badhaka), in the star 
of Mars lord of the 24 (Maraka) and 9 (Fate/Karama) and in the 10 (Paraloka Sadhana/ 
Treatment not effective /Retirement from this world). It is the sign Sagittarius owned by Lagna 
Lord Jupiter located in the 6th (diseases). Sun is in the Sub of Saturn, the lord of houses 
11 & 12 placed in the 9th, Although Saturn is the lord of the 11 for recovery, it has no 
power to do so since it is in the star of Mercury located in the 7th, Maraka and Badhaka 
house, and connected with Venus, a significator of houses 8 & 12. The sub of Saturn is 
Kethu in the 12th, in the sign of Aquarius (Sense of sight). It is in the star of Rahu (Dark 
Planet) in the 6 (diseases) and in the sub of the above said Venus. This Kethu is in 
conjunction with Neptune(R), a significator of houses 6 & 12. Accordingly, the Sun+, being a

by various means resulting in the deformation of the Optic Nerve. 


According to Rex E. Bills, in his "The Rulership Book", 
1) The causative planets for the blindness are Moon, Saturn and Uranus. 
2) Sense of sight is ruled by Mars (Sun, Moon, Aquarius) 


As we have already discussed about Moon and Saturn, let's look at Uranus. 

(a) " Uranus rules the ether which is the medium by which the light rays are 
transmitted, hence he has considerable influence over the eyes and is 
responsible, when afflicting the Sun or Moon, for various diseases of the eyes,

(b) 1. Uranus rules Eyes 

2. The diseases and complaints of Uranus are somewhat similar to the combined

of Medical Astrology - pg 892, by Dr. H.L.Cornell) 


(c) Eyes are under the external rulership of the Aries sign. The eyes are also 
ruled by the Sun, Moon, Uranus and Neptune and the Aquarius sign, as Uranus 

and Aquarius rule the Ether thru which light is transmitted. (Ibid pg 219)

We may never know what it was that transformed the man once known as Shivaji Rao 
Gaekwad from his humble beginning as a bus conductor in Bangalore into the 
phenomenon that is Rajinikanth a Super star. 

What accounts for the man’s incredible presence across geographical boundaries? And 
whata journey it has been to superstardom. 

That trademark walk. That flick of the hair. Those dialogues which have been reverentially 
copied by generations of fans. The tricks with the cigarettes and sunglasses. Many other 
actors, both in the North and the South, have tried to emulate him. All have failed. It is a 
charisma that has utterly charmed the South and inspired the rather puerile (trivial or im- 
mature) memes that most in the North seem to enjoy, but not truly understand. 

It is a kind of celebrity that is almost unthinkable in this era, defined as it is by a cultural 
dependence on the next viral trend, and the next controversy. It is a cult status, the likes of 
which have never been seen before, and arguably, unlikely to be seen again. 

With these few lines of introduction about the super star Mr Rajanikanth, I present the as- 
trological details of the native.
