The following “What eclipsed planets can do in its period and sub-period (as per KP)” is 
different from KP where eclipse generally doesn’t matter: 


Sub lord of 1st cusp: If a planet is deposited in the constellation of an eclipsed one and if it 
is the sub lord of the lagna cusp, the sub lord shows that the native will be imprisoned; he 
will lead the life incognito; will suffer from fear, disease and anxiety; will participate funer- 
al rites; incur loss and may lose position too; will be unfortunate etc. (p 44) 

Sub lord of 24 cusp: spend heavily .. . 

Sub lord of 3™ cusp: demise of brother... 

Sub lord of 4th cusp: distress to mother... 

Sub lord of 5th cusp: loss of a child... 


The sub lord of the lagna cusp is scrutinized for longevity of the native by using the con- 
cept of Badhaka, Maraka. (p 45) The constellation in which the sub lord of the lagna cusp 
is deposited is mainly analyzed but not the sub of the lagna cusp sub lord, although KP is 
the sub lord theory. 


The original five ruling planets at the moment of judgment are used (p 60), and they are 
recommended to never omit to confirm the timing of events.

Will I be able to get married to a girl with whom I am 
having a love affair? 


| By: Tin Win 
C Email: tw853@yahoo.com 
BREE HRHeRHRHeRHRHeRHRHeRHeRHeRHeRHeRHRHRHRHRHRHRHRHRHeRHeRHRHEEEEEH HH 








Horary Data 

Question: Will I be able to get married to a girl with whom I am having a love affair? 
Horary number: 27 (1 — 249) 

Date & time of judgment: O7/Nov/2017, 08:26:16 AM, GMT -5 

Place of judgment: Maryland, USA, 39N05, 77W0O9 

Ayanamsa: 24° 0' 58" (New KP) 


Cuspal Sub Lords to be Considered 

For query "Will my Love Affair Materialize?, the 5t house is considered. (KP Reader VI, p 
191) 

The house which one has to take for judgment depends on the query. If it is for marriage, 
one has to take 7‘ house. (ibid, p 168) 

If one wants to know whether he or she could marry another one in mind, it is to consider 
the 11 house, which shows fulfillment of one's desire. (Ibid pp 146, 171, 214) 

Thus for his query to marry this particular girl, the 5th, 7th and 11th cuspal sub lords (CSL) 
are to be considered. 


Analysis of CSLs 

The 5th, 7th and 11 cuspal sub lord.is the same Mercury. This Mercury is in house 7, lord 
of houses 2-3-6, in the star of Saturn in houses 7, and in sub of Venus+ in house 6, lord of 
house 1, the CSL of houses 6,8 having no planet in its stars. 


Mercury signifies marriage houses 2,7 in the planet level and 7,11 in the star level, indicat- 
ing possible marriage without taking into consideration of the sub level indication. 

But the decider sub Venus signifies negative house 6 (12) to 7») fully and also another neg- 
ative house 1 (12‘ to 2) and undesirable house 8 (dejection). 

So it is concluded that he would not be able to marry this girl despite good matching 
for marriage. 


The KPDP matching and matching of the ruling planets of the boy and girls at their births 
are generally favorable, as shown by the charts attached. 

For a boy to marry a particular girl, matching of their ruling planets at their births is given 
importance in “Krishnamurthi Padhdhathi Dasavida Porutham (KPDP) for Matching Horo- 
scopes for Marriage, by K.P. Kuppu Ganapathi, in “KP & Astrology Year Book 1997”, pp 32- 
44, specifically KPDP No. 8: Likelihood of marriage with this boy and girl: The ruling planets 
of the boy at the time of birth should be the significators for 2.7.11 for the girl and vice- 
versa; and “He Married Her- Why” by Sri Keshab R. Kar, published in “Astrology & 
Athrishta”, December 1980 issue, pp 1- 10. 

Good luck to the Native!

(KP analysis on receiving the Fountain pen by Post Parcel by using only RPs) 

On 6 October 2017 I placed an order for a “fountain pen” with a reputed pens company at 
Chennai. I was informed by the company people that I may expect the pen within a few days 
from the date of the order. 

On 9 October 2017, I thought of knowing the arrival of the post parcel of my newly ordered 
pen and immediatlely I arrived at Horary chart for my random number 88 (chart is at- 
tached) along with the ruling planets at 16-38-39 hours at my residence —Secundrabad. 
Though I could have arrived at the event with the help of the horary chart, somehow I pref- 
ered to tackle the issue with the help of only Ruling planets as applied by Sri C.B.Narnauli, 
Director of Civil Aviation, New Delhi, vide his article on “Only ruling planets tell the year, 
month, date and time , and no need for D/B/A.” (See KP Year book -2011). 

Following are the ruling planets for the time of judgment— 

ASC=SAT-JUP-VENUS// RASI=VENUS-MOON-MARS// DAY LORD= MOON. 

Following are the effective ruling planets at the TOJ---SAT-JUP-VENUS-MOON-MARS. 
Before proceeding with the analysis of the issue, I will deal with it in two parts. 


PART A---I should first make sure whether there is promise of the event by aplying the fol- 

lowing rules— 

The number lagna sub lord should appear in the ruling planets as lagna star lord or 

moon star lord or with the lagna sub sub lord. Then the answer is “YES”. 

As per the chart—the number lagna sub lord is Mars and Mars is in ruling planets as 

Moon sub lord and Lagna sub sub lord. So, YES. 

Or, Number lagna sub sub lord should be in relation with aspect or in conjunction with 

the Lagna star lord or Moon star lord in ruling planets. Then the answer is “YES”. 

As per the chart---No. 

Or, if the lagna sub sub lord is same as Moon star lord. Then the answer is “YES”. 

As per the chart---NO. 

Or, if the number lagna sub sub lord is in relation with, or conjunction with the Moon 

star lord. Then the answer is “YES”. 

As per the chart — NO. 

So, from the above four rules if any one gives a positive answer, we can proceed further with 
analysis of Part B of our.

PART B—applying ruling planets to arrive at the answer “when”------ 


After checking the promise of the event, we should calculate year/month/date and _ time of 
the event with the help of Saturn (broad period), Jupiter (year) , Sun (month) , Moon (date), 


and lagna (for the time) with the help of ruling planets. 


> Whether Saturn will give the event in Scorpio or not? Since Saturn in transit is in Mars 
sign, it should appear in our ruling planets to give positive answer. As per the ruling 
planets Mars is the sub lord of Moon, and it is confirmed that Saturn’s transit in Scorpio 
should give the event before it ends in the Sign, that is before 27 october 2017. ( Saturn 
will transit in Dhanur rasi on the said date). 

> Next comes Jupiter which gives the year. Jupiter in transit is in Libra - Venus Sign, and 
Venus is in our ruling planets as lagna sub lord and Moon sign lord. Here also it is con- 
firmed that Jupiter in transit in Libra will frucitfy the event.

Q 1: KP AYANAMSA 

There are three ayanamsas in KP: 
1. KP AYANAMSA 

2. KP STRAIGHT LINE 

3. KP STRAIGHT LINE (ADJUSTED) 


Which Ayanamsa is to be used, while preparing the chart as per KPAstro 4.1. 


Al: 
The KP ayanamsa, i.e. KP new ayanamsa in KPAstro 4.1 is to be used, as explained by 
the evolution of KP ayanamsa below: 


KP Ayanamsa: Evolution 
KP Original Ayanamsa (KPOA) 


This ayanamsa is based on 291 A.D. chosen by Sri K.S. Krishnamurti as the year of coinci- 
dence of both Sayana and Nirayana zodiacs or the year of zero ayanamsa, and the annual 
precession rate of Newcomb’s 50.2388475 sec per year. The ayanamsa values for the year 
1840 to 2001 are given in deg. and min. only. (KP Reader I p 58) The formula was not given, 
and for years beyond 2001 the Newcomb’s annual precession rate, 50.2388475 sec, is to be 
added per year to the ayanamsa value for 2001. (ibid p 59) 


KP Straight Line Ayanamsa (KP St Ln) 

While there was a lot of discussion on the KP original ayanamsa in the K.P. & Astrology 
magazine, the KP Straight Line Ayanamsa was introduced by using 2 figures as given by 
Shri K.S. Krishnamurti, i.e. year 291 A.D. of zero ayanamsa and Newcomb’s annual preces- 
sion rate of 50.2388475 sec.: 


KP St Ln = T*P/3600 

where 

T = Y- 291 (Year of zero ayanamsa) 

Y= Calendar year for which ayanamsa is required 

P = 50.2388475 sec per year (Newcomb’s annual precession rate) 
Source: MC Khare in the Astrology & Arthrishta Oct. 1978 issue pp 6-8. 


KP Straight Line (Adjusted) Ayanamsa 

KPSTLA = T*P/3600 

where 

T = Year for calculation - 291 (zero ayanamsa year for KP Ayanamsa) 

P = Newcomb’s annual precession rate = 50.2388475 sec (for KP Ayanamsa) 

Note: For T as a fractional/decimal year taking days between required date and 15th April, 
it gives up to date ayanamsa value. 

http: //groups.yahoo.com/group/k p system/message/30575 


The KP Straight Line (Adjusted) Ayanamsa values are different from the KP Original Aya- 
namsa by 4-5 mins but very close to the Lahiri Ayanamsa with 30-40 sec. difference. 


KP Ezine January 2018 33 


KP New Ayanamsa (KPNA) 

KPNA = B + [T* P + (T*T * A)]/ 3600 

where 

B = 22+1350/3600 = 22-22-30 @ 15 Apr 1900 

P = 50.2388475 (Newcomb’s annual precession rate) 

A = 0.000111 sec per year (Annual precession rate adjustment) 
Note: 23 March, 291 A.D. is assumed as date of zero ayanamsa 


Ref: KPNA by Prof. K. Balachandran in “KP & Astrology” Year Book 2003, pp 88-89 based on 
the article of M.G. G. Nair who had questioned the Newcomb’s rate and desired a correction 
for this. 

http: //groups.yahoo.com/group/k_ p_ system/message/1530?threaded=1 


The KPNA was published in the KP & Astrology Year Book 2008, pp 92-93, together with Sri 
KSK’s second son and magazine editor K. Subramanium’s declaration that the values of 
ayanamsa published supersedes all the previous Tables of ayanamsa published in K. P. 
Reader I and all ephemeris (Krishman & Co.), K.P.T.O.H. and H.T.O.H. etc. 


There is not any significant difference between the KP original ayanamsa and new aya- 
namsa. The KP new ayanamsa gives a formula for calculating the ayanamsa correct to the 
value of seconds and for any date in the calendar year. 


Q 2: SUB LORD AND CUSPAL INTERLINK THEORY OF MR SP KHULLAR 

Sub lord theory was the discovery of Sri KSK. 

Sub lord and cuspal inter link theory of Mr SP Khullar is the extention of sub lord theory , 
with addition of SS Lord and with a different kind of significations of his own way. 

When KP sub lord theory works as per KP Ayamansa up to sub lord, why it will not work 
up to SS lord?. 


Mr SP Khullar has taken new Ayanamsa to calculate the chart. It is only + 4 minutes and 
44 seconds to the KP Ayamansa. With this Ayanamsa, only SS lord will change and up to 
sub lord both the charts will be same. 

I do not understand the logic behind it. 


Again, for marriage he has taken 5,7 and 11 houses instead of 2,7 and 11. 

He has given his own reasons for not considering 2nd house. I am sure that Sri KSK was 
well aware of the reasons mentioned by him. 

I wanted to contact him, but I understand that he is no more. 


I request you for your comments/remarks. 


Answer 2: 

In the K. Baskaran’s book:” Principles of Cuspal Interlinks”, Sagar Publication, First edi- 
tion, 2000 and S.P. Khullar’s book: “True Astrology: Kalamsa & Cuspal Interlinks Theo- 
ry”, Sagar Publication, First edition, 2004, the basic astrological rules are generally the 
same , and the major difference is that the cuspal interlinks of "sub" lord is applied in the 
first book and "sub-sub" lord in the second book. 


In their cuspal interlinks theory, the houses 5,7,11 (not 2,7,11 in KP) are considered for 
marriage. In KP house 2 is taken for increase in family members by marriage or for forming 
a family by marriage, and house 5 is considered for love affair or love for fun which may be 
enjoyed without marriage. 


In the calculated example charts of the book “Your True Horoscope: Birth Time Rectifi- 
cation — by S.P. Khullar, 2005”, the KP Straight Line (Adjusted) ayanamsa was used by 


KP Ezine January 2018 34 


mentioning as KP (New) ayanamsa . 

Later the above mentioned the KP straight line (Adjusted) ayanamsa originally introduced 
by MC Khare is named as the Khullar Ayanamsa giving the following formula which gives 
the same value of the origin: 


AyanKP = (50.2388475/3600)*((YR-292)+(261 /365)+(((MN-1)*30+DY)/365)) 

YR stands for year 

MN stands for Month 

DY stands for Day 

Source: SP Khullar: Kalamsa & Cuspal Interlinks Theory (revised), Sagar Publications, 
2008, p 34

“Astrology for overcoming Caner? is ua research work bLeasecl uri 27 well researched articles 
written by eminent astrologers in the September 1982 special issue of “The Astrological 
Magazine” of Dr. B.V. Raman which was dedicated to an astrological approach to Cancer 
disease and the study of 250 birth charts of cancer patients. 


Regarding the planetary configuration of the suffering by cancer, there are remarkable dif- 
ferences in the observations among various astrologers. Research work should be continued 
for perfection and authenticity which may be applicable to all the cases of cancer patients. 
Many astrologers have taken Moon chart instead of the birth chart of the Cancer patients 
for their study because the time of birth was not known. The authors opine that correct out- 
come is not possible by considering Moon chart only. 


The authors have found that apart from the planetary position in the birth chart of the na- 
tive, constellation position, navamsa signs etc. must be considered carefully before reaching 
any conclusion. Rahu is the most poisonous planet with regard to suffering through cancer 
provided it has a negative effect on Mars, Saturn, Jupiter and Mercury. A few survived and 
others expired after the diagnosis. They have also tried to find out whether the native will 
survive under such circumstances. What planetary configuration will save the native and 
which will not? 


In the face of near incurability of cancer, medical science today underlines the importance

Kala Sarpa, Yoga, Don’t be afraid! 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 








Kala Sarpa or Kaal Sarpa Yoga (KSY) is said to be formed if All the planets are situated between Ra- 
hu and Kethu. KSY has become a favorite of many astrologers and is catching up very fast with the 
others. Many people are being told that all the failures, setbacks, delays, mental agony and so many 
other bad things are happening due to the presence of KSY in the horoscope or transit of planets. 


Now it looks like a scary KS Dosha (rather than KS Yoga) for a lot of remedies to make money. 
So don’t be afraid at all if someone tells you that there is KSP in your horoscope because of the fol- 
lowing reasons: 


1. If everything is to be decided only by two shadow planets namely Rahu and Ketu, then what are 
the other Seven planets doing in your horoscope. So it does not mean the end of the world. 
2. There is no mention of this yoga in any of astrological classics from Parashar to 
Varahamihir. Ask them to give a single quote from any of the standard classics like BPHS. 


3. So called KSY stays there for 14-15 days in a stretch. Do you feel that all natives born during the 
same period will share the same ill luck due to this single yoga since fate of even twins born with a 
few minutes is different. Remember, subtleties are important in astrology. It is your lagna, star 
lords , sub lords of cusps and planets, Navamsa lagna and lagnas of other divisionals that are im- 
portant. 


The natives born during the under noted period are subjected to Kala SYoga Dosha during 2000: 
From February 14, 2000 to February 19, 2000 

From March 2, 2000 to March 13, 2000 

From March 30, to April 13, 2000 

From April 26, 2000 to May 11, 2000 

From May 23, 2000 to June 7, 2000 

From July 17, 2000 to July 30, 2000 


4. So called KSY is there in the famous and horoscopes of religious leaders Lord Jesus Christ, 
Pope Paul VI, Pope John Paul II, Saint Gemma Galgani, Saint Joseph Damien, Maria Beltrame, Shree 
Mahaprabhu Chaitanyadev, Srila Puri Maharaja, Srila Puri Maharaja, saint Murari Bapu, Maharishi 
Mahesh, Sirdhi Sai Baba, Sunlun Sayadaw, national leaders Chengiz Khan, King Charles I, King 
Edward VII, PM Harold Wilson, Margaret Thacher, President George W. Bush, Donald Trump, Robert 
Kennedy, Martin Luther King, Nelson Mandela, Pakistan President ZA Bhutto, Ayub Khan, Sri 
Lankan PM SWRD Bandarnaike, PM Ariel Sharon, General Moshe Dayan, PM Lee Kuan Yew, Saddam 
Hussein, PM Jawahar Lal Nehru, Delhi chief minister Arvind Kejriwal, sports people cricketer 
Sachin Tendulkar, Ravi Shastri, tennis player Serena Williams, swimmer Ian Thorpe, Noble laure- 
ates Marie Curie, C.V. Raman, John Steinbeck, notable ladies First lady Nancy Reagan, Mrs. Par- 
ker Camilla Bowel, astrologers and astronomers N.C. Lahiri, R. Santhanam, Carl Sagan , Charles 
Jayne, Basil Fearington, film stars Sophia Loren, Sylvester Stallone, Fredrick March, Harrison Ford, 
Gregory Pack, Alfred Hitchcock, Kareena Kapoor , Waheeda Rehman, Ashok Kumar, singers Britney

5. According to the most respected Vedic astrologer of the last century Dr. B.V. Raman: 
"Kala-sarpa Yoga has its bright shades. It [is said to] makes one industrious, hardworking, aware of 
one's own ability- despite mental restlessness. It raises the natives to top positions in their respective 


KP Ezine February 2018 6 


fields provided of course other Raja Yogas are present. Rahu-Ketu axis favors rise in mundane life 
while Ketu-Rahu axis indicates elevation in spiritual matters. It is also found that Kala-sarpa Yoga 
natives get betrayed by trusted friends and even relatives. Suffering due to developments in life 
strengthens the mind and mellows one's outlook. This is a blessing of Kala-sarpa Yoga." 
"It occurs to me that undue importance need not be given to Kala-sarpa Yoga. The view held by 
some astrologers that Kala-sarpa Yoga affects longevity and adversely affects the operation of other 
yogas favoring a rise in life, achievement, and accomplishment is not tenable. The overall assess- 
ment of the horoscope is important. No single yoga, including Kala-sarpa Yoga, is capable of 
marring or making a horoscope. In our view, Kala-sarpa Yoga plays an important role in mundane 
astrology [assessment of world events] and is not of much importance in _ individual 
charts." (Appendix of "Three Hundred Important Combinations") 

6. According to another well known Vedic astrologer Shri K.N. Rao: 
“Kaal-Sarpa Dosha is one of the biggest frauds in astrology. First of all nobody knows from where 
this kal-sarpa yoga has originated. No reference can be found in any of the classical texts like Brihat 
Parashar Hora Shastra, Brihat Jatak, Saravali etc. Secondly and most importantly, I always men- 
tioned that the birth chart should be analysed in totality. Every horoscope has hundreds of good 
and bad yogas and all these yogas should be synthesized before drawing any conclusion. A single 
Rajyoga cannot make anybody king, similarly a kal-sarpa yoga alone cannot create death like 
situation.” (Journal of Astrology) 

In his book "Kaal Sarpa Yoga - Why such fright?" published in 2004, Shri K.N. Rao has very well 
shown through the horoscopes of fifty three people, who have been doing extremely well in their lives 
without doing any Karma-Kand Pooja /Upaya Shanti for this so-called Purna or Anshik Kaal Sarpa

Can you be a Diver - KP Appraisals 


By: Sumanadasa Namarathna (Sunaparantha Kalyan) 
Ex-Accountant, Justice of Peace 
No.22/1, Udugampola Road, Marapola, Veyangoda, 


SRI LANKA Email: sumanal946@gmail.com 








—‘~EREREEBEEBREEBEEBE EEE EEE EEE EEEREEREEREEREE EERE REESE EE EE 


Generally diving is under the category of sports. A sufficient level of body fitness and health 
is required to practice this terrific sport. Additionally boldness, confidence and martial like 
adventurous mind should be main qualifications for this game. Astrologically the planet, 
which involuntarily comes to the scene in connection with these martial matters, is Mars. 
Mars generally signifies courage and bravery, energy, ability to organize, aggressiveness, 
ambition, determination, competition, love for game, muscles, strength and self confidence. 
Hence Mars should be played a vital role in the horoscope of a Diver by connecting anyway 
with the 5th cusp, the house of game. 


Additionally one should have an ability, courage, energy, mental strength and intelligence, 

to engage in adventurous act like diving. Therefore the 3rd cusp of the natal chart should be 

well established by connecting positive elements, to entertain in such adventures ability and 

to be bold enough to make a venture, as illustrated in KP by Sri Tin Win ji. 

Furthermore, the following facts are also to be considered for a birth of a diver. 

1) The ground for this sport of diving is Sea or Water. Water is under the rule of Moon and 
Neptune. (Encyclopedia of Medical Astrology by Dr. H.L. Cornell). 

2) Sign Pisces, the 12th sign of the natural Zodiac rules the Ocean, Sea, and standing and 
stagnant pools of water. (Ibid). 

3) The planet for swimming is Moon. (Matters controlled by grahas Part - 2 - Moon - by Sri 
Kanak Bosmia). 

4) Divers / Deep Sea Divers are ruled by Neptune and Pisces (Rulership Book by Rex E. 
Bills).

2017 September O9 was a Saturday and I was conducting a K.P. Astrology practical class at Sri 
Lannka Vidyala Pirivena, Maradana, Colombo. Exactly at 01.05 p.m. a student of mine who was a 
staff nurse attached to a nearby government hospital wanted to know whether she will get pregnant 
for a child. 


She gave number 137 to prepare the K.P. horary horoscope. 


All most all the student in my class did the necessary calculations manually. The relevant horo- 
scope is attached here with for your perusal. Sub lord of the fifth cusp was Venus. Venus being 
the owner of first & eighth houses was deposited in tenth with Rahu. Please keep in mind that the 
eighth and first houses were vacant . Venus was in the star of Mercury and the latter was the own- 
er of the ninth and twelfth houses and tenanted in the tenth house. 


To get conceived the sub lord of the fifth house must be deposited in a star whose lord signifies sec- 
ond, fifth or eleventh house. The students who solely relied on the above principle predicted the 
student nurse who made the question will not have a chance to deliver a child in the future. 


A few students contested that logic and said the sub lord of venues is deposited in sub of Moon 
and the same Moon is the sub lord of the eleventh house thus qualifying the querent to get a posi- 
tive answer as Moon did not harbor any planet in it’s own stars. Those who told this line of argu- 
ment said as Moon is in Ketu star who being a node represents Saturn and as Ketu is in Makera 
rasi and Saturn is the one and only significator of the fifth house main house for pregnancy. 


Another student said the querent will get pregnant because Mercury is in conjunction with Sun 
who is an ardent significator of the eleventh house. 


In support of the said answer another group of students said the question number 137 had Moon 
as its sub lord and as said earlier Moon was in Ketu star and Ketu has dominated the scene as 
Moon’s and Lagna’s star lord among the ruling plants at the time of judgment. 


The ruling plants for the time of judgment were as follows. Day lord Saturn ; Moon rasi lord Mars ; 
Moon star lord Ketu ; Lagna rasi lord Jupiter Lagna star lord Ketu ; Lagna sub lord Mars and 
Moon sub lord Venus. Mercury and Sun also became ruling plants as they were in conjunction 
with Mars. 


Now let us see when she will be able to deliver ? 
Ketu being a very strong R.P it was unanimously concluded that the delivery is sure to happen 


before the end of current Ketu dasa which runs up 2024.03.23. 


Then what will be the sub dasaP The current sub dasa of Venus should be left out as it did 
not signify second , fifth or eleventh houses. 


The next sub is of Sun and it is a strong significator of the eleventh house. Thus it was select- 
ed as the sub dasa. 


The one and only significator of the fifth house is Saturn and we were compelled to choose 
Saturn’s sub sub dasa which will do operate from 2018.12.20 to 2019.01.19.

My wife asked me ‘Will she recover?’ Without any further delay or thought process, I asked Horary 
number to her as usual. She gave me number 110 out of 249. 


Data for Horary Chart: 
Horary Number: 110/249; Date: 04-01-2018, Time: 09:04 AM, Sughad, Gandhinagar.

sub. Mercury owns 1st house, Sun is in 4th house and Ketu strongly signifying 5th house. These all

The scope of the natal chart of a native is unlimited and boundless. It is the map of the 
route of the native from the birth to death and also beyond the death. While examining a 
horoscope various elements have to be considered, analyzed in detail and combine togeth- 
er with logical judgment. If one use the fundamental namely the characteristics of the 
Planets, the nature of the 12 Zodiacal signs, the matters govern by the cusps (Bhawas) 
and planets and their qualities, there won't be any difficulty in accurate predicting the life 
of a native. KP is the one and only tool in proper discovering the invisible truth of a life. 
This attempt is to discover the astrological reasons for giving up the husband of a lady 
and separation of the father of their children, using the KP rules propounded by late Sri 
K.S.Krishnamurti Maha Guruji.

nus+ with no planets in its stars, being the sub lord of the 3 and 9, is a strong significator

of 10 from 6. 


The star and the sub of 7th, Moon being the lord 9 is located in the 7 in its own star and 
in the sub of Mercury+. Moon aspects 9 & 1 and is aspected by Saturn, the lord of 3, 4 
from the Sth cusp. Moon's sub lord Mercury+, the well known planet for duality and nota- 
ble marriage breaker, being the lord of 8 and 11 is posited in the 6th, in conjunction with 
the Sun, the lord of 10 and also in association with Rahu that signifies 12 & 6. Mercury is 
in the star and sub of above said Sun connected with 6 and 10 and also with no planets in 
its stars, being the sub lord for 6 and 12, is a strong significator 6 and 12 , the houses of 
explosion of the marriage.

Planets in the 6th Cusp 

Sun, Mercury and Rahu are located in the 6th house. Sun, being the Lagna Sub lord with 
its significations for 6 & 10 is aspecting 8th, 12th and lord of 7 Venus & Kethu in 12 and 
strongly conjoined with above said Mercury. Rahu in the star of mitigating and loosen plan- 
et Kethu in 12 and in the above said Mercury is a significator 6 and 12. As per the rules of 
nodes Rahu represents Mars+, Mercury and Sun. Mars by being the lord of 1 and 6, detri- 
mental places for two prime cusps of marriage 2 & 7, is in the 11th in the star of Moon and 
in the sub of Sun as already described. 

Accordingly all the planets connected with marriage matters had done their best to erase 
the agreement of marriage of this native as illustrated in the KP Readers. 

“The 12th house to the houses 2,7 and 11 are all detrimental for smooth, pleasant family life 
with wife(husband). 

If the significators of 2,7 or 11 happen to be the significators of 1,6 and 10, then separation 
wil surely happen and then it may lead to divorce... 

3. If separation is caused by wife running away ... , then in one’s horoscope, the signifiator 
of 7 will also be the significator of 6 and Q9. If the person does not like the wife and goes away, 
then we have to judge the houses 3 and 12. “ 

- KP Reader IV: Marriage, Married Life and Children, p 192

How psoriasis develops 

Psoriasis is a common skin condition that speeds up the life cycle of skin cells. It causes 
cells to build up rapidly on the surface of the skin. The extra skin cells form scales and 
red patches that are itchy and sometimes painful. 


KP Ezine February 2018 57 


Psoriasis is a chronic disease that often comes and goes. The main goal of treatment is to 
stop the skin cells from growing so quickly. There is no cure for psoriasis, but you can man- 
age symptoms. Lifestyle measures, such as moisturizing, quitting smoking and managing 
stress, may help. 


Symptoms of the disease— 





Psoriasis will be different forms such as-Guttate psoriasis, Scalp psoriasis, Inverse 
psoriasis, Nail Psoriasis, Pustular psoriasis, and Erythrodermic psoriasis 

Psoriasis signs and symptoms are different for everyone. Common signs and symptoms in- 
clude: 

e Red patches of skin covered with thick, silvery scales 

e Small scaling spots (commonly seen in children) 

e Dry, cracked skin that may bleed 

e Itching, burning or soreness 

e Thickened, pitted or ridged nails 

e Swollen and stiff joints 

Psoriasis patches can range from a few spots of dandruff-like scaling to major eruptions 
that cover large areas. 

Most types of psoriasis go through cycles, flaring for a few weeks or months, then subsiding 
for a time or even going into complete remission. 


Psoriatic arthritis. In addition to inflamed, scaly skin, psoriatic arthritis causes swollen, 
painful joints that are typical of arthritis. Sometimes the joint symptoms are the first or only 
manifestation of psoriasis or at times only nail changes are seen. Symptoms range from 
mild to severe, and psoriatic arthritis can affect any joint. Although the disease usually isn't 
as crippling as other forms of arthritis, it can cause stiffness and progressive joint damage 
that in the most serious cases may lead to permanent deformity. 

It can be construed that - Mercury, Saturn, Jupiter and Rahu play their vital part for an oc- 
currence of the disease.

Q 1: The book "NEW DIMENSIONS OF KP ASTROLOGY" 

I request for your opinion on the book of 

" NEW DIMENSIONS OF KP ASTROLOGY" BY DR ARASTU PRABHAKAR. 

He claims that he has over come all the drawbacks of KP system- invented by Sri KSK, in 
this book.He describes That this is based on kp only, but eliminated all the drawbacks. 

This purely horary only. He claims that he has done a research on about 2000 horoscopes 
and came to this conclusions. 


I REQUEST FOR YOUR VALUABLE REMARKS/COMMENTS ON THIS BOOK. 


A 1: 

The book “New Dimensions of K. P. Astrology” by Dr. Arastu Prabhakar is the old book “The 
Times Horary Astrology” by the new name (old bottle with new label) which is the English 
translation of the Times Prasna Jyotish (Hindi). This is just a horary book which is based on 
the KP horary of KP Reader VI. However in some cases there are different views from the 
common practice of KP, and some principles of traditional astrology have been incorporated, 
as mentioned in the book reviews of the KPE-zine June 2012 issue and May 2013 issue.

Q 3: MARRIED LIFE 

From the birth chart, we can predict the married life and diverse and second marriage. 

If the second marriage also is in trouble, how we can predict that there will be diverse from 
this second marriage also. 

The birth chart has already shown diverse and second marriage and happened. 


A 3: 

In KP 7th house is for first spouse, 2nd house (8th from 7th) for second spouse, 9th house 
(8th from 2nd) for third wife, and so on. 

Happiness in married life (by 2,5,7,11) is to be studied from the 11th cusp (KP Reader V, p 
152: LIFE WITH WIFE) and also from the cusp of concerned spouse. 
There is no happy married life for Albert Einstein with both two wives, and for Hugh Hefner 
with all three wives. 


QO 4: ASPECTS IN KP 

We follow vedic aspects in KP. 

Rahu/Ketu does not aspects any planets. Any planets other than rahu/ketu, aspects rahu/ 
ketu, then we are considering that rahu/ketu represents that planets. 

But,in the book, ASPECTS IN VEDIC ASTROLOGY by Pandit Gopesh Kumar Ojha in page 
11, it is mentioned that BUT THE NODES ARE MERELY SENSITIVE POINTS, THEY HAVE 
NO BODY, NO MASS, NO WEIGHT. THEY DO NOT ASPECT NOR 

THEY ARE ASPECTED. 

This is against what we are following. We follow that planets aspect the nodes. 

This is for your comments/remarks. 


I have enclosed a chart. 

Here Saturn is in Sagittarius and moon is in Virgo. So, by 10th aspect Saturn is aspecting 
moon. 

saturn is in 4th house, and not 5th house. 

can we say, that saturn is aspecting 7,11 and 2 houses. 


A 4: 
What we are following is the Vedic practice of shadow planets Rahu and Ketu giving the re- 
sults of aspecting planets on them. 


Rahu or Ketu will act as a strong agent to the planets to which they are conjoined. If they 
are not conjoined with any planet, then they give the results of the planet which aspects 
them. Only when they are neither conjoined with, nor aspected by any planet, they repre- 
sent the lord of the house. (Uthrakalamrita -- Khanda VI Sloka 14 onwards) (KP Reader II, 
1983, page 315 ) 


If nodes do not aspect nor they are aspected, what will be their signification other than the 
result of the lord of sign where they are located? 


In KP Hindu aspects of rasi by rasi (sign by sign) are used. So Saturn in Sagittarius is as- 
pecting Aquarius where Rahu and 7 cusp are located by 3 aspect; Gemini where 
11th cusp is located by 7t opposite aspect; and Virgo where Moon, Venus and 24 cusp are 
located by 10th aspect . So Saturn is aspecting, Rahu, Moon ,Venus & 7th, 11th, 2nd cusps 
or houses.

Deafness and, Dumbness 


_ — en 


By: Gunti Nagaraju KP astrologer (M.com CAIIB, Retired Bank officer)

Following questions are raised by the parents of this baby boy while furnishing his birth details for 
me— 


1. Does the natal chart of this baby indicate any hearing problems? 

2. Any speech problems? 

3. Any surgery is indicated from the chart? 

The chart is erected and following analysis is made on the above questions --- 

What K.P Rules say in this regard - 

1) In case of defective speech and sense of hearing or deafness and dumbness, the Ascendant cusp 
sub lord or the cuspal sub lord of 6,8,12 is the significator of 6,8,12, and connected with Mercury 
(speech and hearing), the 2nd cusp (speech), the 3rd cusp (hearing) and mute signs Cancer, Scorpio 
and Pisces (dumbness). When it is connected to 8th it would be congenital, otherwise, it would impair 
during D B A of the planets signifying 6, 8, &12 and badhaka sthana. 


2) House(s) to be analyzed for Deafness-- 


Ears and the entire nervous system comes under the jurisdiction of third bhava (house) as well as 
the third sign of natural Zodiac Gemini. Therefore Gemini, its ruler Mercury and Virgo (the other sign 
owned by Mercury) will naturally get the jurisdiction on hearing.

A, Horary analysis 
By: Ananada Senevirathna 


Jotheer Vidhya Vibooshana —- Sri Lanka- Ministry of Cultural affairs 
Jyothish Maha Mahopadya & Jyothish Acharya 
317, Kelanimulla, Angoda, Sri Lanka

EERE E EERE RRR ERR RRR ERE ER EERE ERE Ree eee eee 2 2 








12th of February 2018 was a fine Monday. In the evening one of my friends working as lawyer had 
gone shopping. On his way back to home, he had visited to a friend’s house also. By about 07.30 
p.m. having returned to home, he wanted to study the brief of an appeal case for which he had to 
appear in court of appeal on the following day. Then only my friend had realized that his pair of 
spectacles had gone missing. He had searched in and out of his house, but in vein and gave me 
the number 170 to find out whether the lost item could be found and if so when? 


On the same day with the aid of my computer software I prepared the relevant chart at 08.56p.m. 
5.S.T. for Angoda, Western Province, Sri Lanka (06 N 55 , 79 E 54 ). The Sub lord for the number 
170 was Moon and Moon had become as the star lord of the Ascendant for the ruling plants. Fur- 
thermore moon was deposited in the star of Venus and Venus was the star lord of Moon of ruling 
plants. Ruling planets are as follows. Day lord=moon. Moon Rasi lord=Jupiter. Moon star lord 
=Venus. Lagna lord = Mercury. Lagna star = Moon. 


Jupiter the sub lord of the second cusp, being in it’s own star was a strong significator for 11th 
house. Vide the above findings without any doubt I concluded that my friend is going to recover the 
lost item. At that stage it became pertinent to find out when he was going to recover the same? It 
showed a delay of some nature as Moon was in conjunction with Saturn . It was Punarphoo. 


Anyhow the frustration could not be so grave as the lagna for the number 170 was a dual sign 
(Sagittarius). Furthermore when I began judging the chart on 12.02.2018 at 08.56 p.m., the rising 
lagna was Virgo and that too was a dual sign thus ruling out any drastic delay. 


The above said findings made by me to decide to move the rising ascendant in concluding the time 
of recovery and I had proceed from 10 dig: Virgo 10sec: onwards . I left out Libra and Sagittarius 
as a delay was anticipated. Scorpio , Capricorn and Aquarius were not considered as Mars and 
Saturn were not ruling plants respectively. 


I thought the recovery would happen on or before the end of 23dig: Pisces 20secs: ( Rasi lord Jupi- 
ter , Star lord Mercury and sub lord Moon) and when this was converted into time it was 09.38.a.m. 
of 13.02.2018. 


So by about 09.30 p.m. on 12.02.2018 I informed my friend that he will recover the lost item on 
13.02.2018 on or before 09.30 a.m. 


On 13.02.2018 , at 08.20 a.m. my friend gave me a call and told that he received the lost item exact- 
ly at 08.18 a.m. 
I had misfired ! 


At 08.18 a.m. ascendant was OOdigs: Pieces 14 secs: ruled by Jupiter , Jupiter and Moon. Alas! All 
of them were ruling plants. But I had overlooked. 


Now what about the delay that I foretold ? 

My friend had given a call and inquired from his friend whom he visited few hours ago on 12.02.2018 
to find out if he had found the pair of glasses in his visitors room and had received an answer in the 
negative . 


But on the following day a maid servant at his friend’s place had found the glasses underneath a so- 
fa. So the friend of my friend had sent the same to my friend on 13.02.2018 at 08.18 a.m. through

KP Ezine March 2018 34 









Astrological combination, for one to become a 
spiritual Leader 
By: Ravikrishna Yallapragada 


Plot No 25, Santosh Nagar Colony, Mehdipatnam, Hyderabad - 500028 
Email: learningravi77@gmail.com Mobile: +91- 73311 28700 








Abstract 


Any person born on this earth has a purpose to achieve. It is revealed by the birth chart of the person. 
Each person takes one or more professions in their life time. This article shares the astrological combi- 
nation for one to become a spiritual leader. 


House Significations for a Spiritual Leader 

34 House: It denotes mental inclination, mental capability of a native to gain spiritual knowledge, 
courage and will power to practice it regularly. 

5th House: It denotes General Intelligence; capacity for grasp of what is taught. It denotes ‘mantra 
siddhi’. It also represents inner urge to impart knowledge to others. Also, Grasp and accumulation of 
knowledge of ‘Mantra/Yantra/Tantra’ including practical experience. It represents pleasure and en- 
tertainment. In the context of spirituality, it represents inner pleasure. It indicates spiritual mind, 
initiation of mantras, and chanting of mantras. In addition, grasp or knowledge of Yoga-marg and 
bhakti-marg. 

9th House: It denotes karmic influence. It denotes religion. It also represents upadesam to a native 
like brahmopadesam etc. 

10th House: It is the Karmasthana. It shows what a native will take as profession to perform the du- 
ties in this material world. In the spirituality context, it denotes practice(sadhana) of spiritual activi- 
ties. It also denotes fame and rewards. 

11th House: It denotes fulfillment of desire of native. Anything that a native desire will be succeeded 
or failed. 11th house indicates success or failure of native’s desire. It also denotes siddhi. 

12th House: It denotes moksha or salvation. It is also house for Spiritual awakening. It is the house 
of loss. In the spiritual context, the person will lose worldly pleasure, possessions, and attachments 
and lead on the path of spirituality. 


Planet Significations for Spiritual Leader 

Though each planet signifies lot of things, the focus is primarily on spiritual aspect here. Hence, all 
significations related to spirituality only mentioned below. 

Saturn: Saturn is the karaka planet for sanyasa and renunciation. Saturn enforce discipline, and 
dharmic practices. It’s a planet of secrecy, planet of seclusion, planet of concentration, and detach- 
ment. It’s also karaka for 12th house matters. It’s a natural separative planet. Since it is a planet of 
concentration, it also includes meditation in its karakatwas. In the context of spiritual life, it creates 
dispassion in a native’s life so that the native can lead into spiritual activities. 

Ketu: Ketu is all about “letting it go” or detachment. It’s letting it go of material world, materialistic 
pleasures. It is a natural separative planet that tries to separate a native from material world and 
drive towards spiritual path. Ketu is known for spiritual awareness — what will bring you happiness 
and what will not bring you happiness. Ketu is the planet to give moksha — freedom from the birth 
and rebirth cycle. Ketu is always put priority on soul and guide our true-self. While Rahu gives 
things, and makes us attached to them, Ketu pulls us from that attachment. Ketu shows us that all 
worldly gains are merely temporary and therefore permanent happiness must be sought elsewhere. 
This is the reason Ketu is the primary planet for Moksha. 

Jupiter: Jupiter is the most spiritual planet as per Vedic astrology. It is considered as Guru/Teacher 
in astrology. It symbolizes dharma and divine knowledge. It is denoted as ‘Lord of Dharma.’ Jupiter 
denotes our higher intelligence. 

Sun: Sun is considered as natural Atmakaraka in Vedic astrology. Atma means Soul and Karaka 
means significator. In Vedic astrology, there is a strong belief that the soul will take rebirth to fulfill 
all unfinished desires of the past lives. It denotes the purpose of this life and the destiny. Sun influ- 
ences center of our personality. 

Moon: Moon is considered as natural Amatyakaraka in Vedic astrology. It denotes mind, and intel- 
lect. There will be complete harmony and happiness when Mind is tuned or aligned with what the 
soul desires. 


KP Ezine March 2018 35 


Hypothesis 

1) The research work started with the basic KP rule from C. R. Bhatt. If the sublord of the Ascend- 
ant is the significator (in the star of the occupant or owner) of the 3rd (mental tendencies), the 
10th (aims) and the 12th (renunciation), or connected with the 3rd, 10th or 12th and Saturn, the 
native leans towards renunciation. (C.R. Bhatt). 
After looking at the signification / karakatwas of planets and houses, additional planets and 
houses added to the initial rule. 
la. The updated hypothesis was: If the sublord of the Ascendant & 11th sublord is the significator 
of the 3rd, 5th, Oth, 10th, 11th, and 12th bhavas. 
1b. The Ascendant & 11th sublord should be connected with Saturn, or Ketu, or Jupiter. 


2) A new hypothesis formed looking at the connection between Moon and Ketu & Moon and Saturn. 
Moon represents Mind and Saturn represents dispassion, and deep concentration. In KP, if Moon 
and Saturn are connected somehow, it is called Punarphoo dosha. Punarphoo dosha creates delay, 
dejection and impediments every stage of life. By giving impediments, Saturn creates dispassion on 
the material things. Ketu denotes detachment, spiritual awareness, and Moksha. Since Saturn cre-

A). If 12th cusp sub lord signifies 3,9,12,6 (service) or 7 (business) or 10 (profession), one can go 
foreign for job or business or assignment during the DBA signifying 3,9,12,6 or 7 or 10 when trans- 
it agrees. (KP Reader VI p 301) 

B). If 9th, 6t4/7th and 11th cusp sub lords signify 6,/7,9,12, then one can go abroad for business 
during the DBA signifying 6,/7,9,12. (K.P. Muhurat p 123).(refer KP E Zine July 2009)

My brother-in-law had to go to Bangalore on 15 Feb 2018 on an urgent work and we had no 
prior information on his coming back home. We were worried about his long stay as there 
was no information on the specific date of his arrival. 


On 22 /02/2018 suddenly I thought of arriving at the date of his arrival back to his home @ 
Secundrabad. Immediately horary number 205 struck in my mind and I erected a horary 
chart @ 14-23-55 hours at Secundrabad @ my residence. The chart is attached. 


Hints for arrival of a person/relative/ friend 

Note the sub lord of the 11th cusp. 11t* house indicates brother-in-law also. If the sub lord 
of the 11 cusp is in retrograde or deposited in a star which is in retrograde motion, 
friend’s /relative’s arrival is not promised. As per the chart, 11tt cusp sub lord is Saturn+. 
No planets are placed in Saturn stars and so Saturn strongly signifies 11t® cusp. It is not in 
retro motion. Saturn is Ketu star which is not in retro motion as it is node. So his arrival is 
promised. This also shows that there is a fulfillment of my desire. 


Note: The hoary question ts raised by me and so I have not rotated the chart for anybody. 


K P rule: Lagna shows the place of the native’s permanent residence and the 7th house 
shows (opposite to lagna) the change of one’s residence /place of stay. (see page 296 of 
reader no.2) 7th is the person expected or other person expected by us who receive. 

So if 7 cusp sub lord signifies 3™4-shot travel, 9th- long travel, 5th- one’s desire to move from 
his place of stay and 11 one’s fulfillment of desire to move. 

If it signifies 4or 8 or 10 or 12 -the person who is expected will not come. 


As per the horary chart 

7*h cusp falls in Cancer sign with MOON_MERC_RAHU as co-rulers. The sub lord Rahu is 
placed in Mercury star lord of 6 and 8 in 1st and in the sub lord of Venus lord of 4,5,9 in 1*t 
cusp. Rahu represents Moon lord of 7 in 3 cusp. Thus the 7 cusp sub lord Rahu 
signifies 1,6,8 at its star lord level and 1,4,5,9 at its sub lord level. It is also connected to 
3rd, So as per the above rule 7+ cusp sub lord Rahu signifies the relevant houses-3,5,and 9 
assures the arrival of the person in question.

oth=Rahu, Venus.

Astrological Analysis of Indian Affairs (1947-2050) 

by Dhruva 

Readworthy Publications (P) Ltd. (D. K. Printworld Pvt. Ltd.) 
2008, 284 pages 


Bice hr 








This book attempts to trace the histery of post Independent India astrologically. It presents the key 
events chronologically along with the important indicators of these events grouped under the 
Vimshottari Dasa Antara Dasa segments. Each event has been analysed in the context of prevail- 
ing Dasa periods, the transits and, wherever possible, in terms of the Chart cast for the time of the 
event. 


The Chart cast for the time of India attaining freedom on the midnight of 15th August, 1947 is the 
primary source, clearly explaining the chain of significant events concurrent with the planetary di- 
rections and transits. 


The analysis of Indian affairs is made sectorwise- polity, economy, industry, agriculture, science and 
technology, natural and national disasters to take a holistic view of the the astral influence. Also, it 
examines the defining role of gochara or transits of major planets such as Saturn, Rahu, Jupiter and 
Mars in triggering significant events. Finally, an attempt is made to work out the future trends of 
mundane affairs in the India's march ahead, covering the period up to 2050.

Mudhami (or) Moudhyami period is a bad time during which Subhakaryams should not be per- 
formed. In Navagrahams Jupiter and Venus are known as Brahmana Grahams. When planet sun 
passes from one sign to another sign, for particular periods Sun conjugates either with Jupiter or 
Venus. Due to this conjugation these Brahmana grahams become powerless and they won’t give pos- 
itive results. This period is called as MUDHAMI. If Jupiter conjugates with Sun that particular period 
is called as Guru Mudhami. If Venus conjugates with Sun that particular period is called as Sukra 
Mudhami. Every Subhakaryam should be avoided during this Mudhami period. 

For 2017-2018 Sri Hemalamba nama telugu year Mudhami Periods are :- 

Sukra Mudhami:- from 28-03-2017 to 31-03-2017 & from 28-11-2017 to 20-02-2018. 

Guru Mudhami:- from 10-10-2017 to 12-11-2017.

THIRD METHOD:- Kalapurusha Method:- The given date of birth is to be divided into three 
parts. (1) 00-00-00 hrs to 08-00-00 hrs. (2) 08-00-00 hrs to 16-00-00 hrs. (3) 16-00-00 hrs to 
24-00-00 hrs. In the Ruling Planets Chart which is erected at the time of judgment, first find 
the Lagna cuspal sublord’s Star lord. Next find in which sign the Star lord of the Lagna cusp 
Sublord is placed whether it is Movable (Chara) sign or Fixed(sthira) sign or Dual (Common) 
sign. If the RP Lagna Sublord’s starlord is placed in Movable sign- then the native were born in 
Kala purusha timing between 00-00-00 hrs to 08-00-00 hrs. If it is placed in a Fixed Sign- 
then the native were born in Kalapurusha timing between 08-00-00 hrs to 16-00-00 hrs. If it is 
placed in Dual Sign-then the native were born in Kala Purusha timing between 16-00-00 hrs to 
24-00-00 hrs.

Question 1: Choice of sequence of dasa period lords 

I have taken liberty to address you as my brother because I consider you as my brother. I 
may be pardoned if it hurts you. I am 75 yrs old. Retired as Director (Finance) from a Govt 
of India enterprise. I am a staunch believer in astrology. I learnt fundamentals of KP 
astrology as a hobby. I don't have practical knowledge as I do not have practice. Homeopa- 
thy and KP astrology are my hobbies. 

I failed to understand the following in KP astrology. I request your kind help please to en- 
lighten me. 


1. An event happens during the period of DBAS lords which are the significators of relevant 
houses of the event, when transit agrees. My doubt is how to select DBAS lords from the list 
of significators of the event under consideration. which planet as Dasa lord, which planet as 
Bhukti lord etc. This is confusing to me. I observed in past events, sometimes one planet 
acted more than one role i.e., say Dasa lord and bhukti lord are same. In practice is it pos- 
sible one planet as Dasa and Bhukti lords or Dasa and antara lords etc. what is the basis 
for this selection ? 


2. what is sensitive zone or sensitive points ? what is its role in the above selection of DBAS 
lords ? 
Iam anxiously waiting for your kind help pl. 


Answer 1: 

In choosing the effective DBAS lords by using the ruling planets or sub lords, it is used to 
start with the current running Dasa lord and then the expectedly most effective Bhakti lord, 
which is different from the chosen Dasa lord, and so on. The same planet is rarely chosen 
for both effective DB or DA etc. In practice a planet is found to be the same for more than 
one of DBAS. If the transit is very relevant or a planet is a very strong significator, that 
planet can be repeatedly chosen as the same planet for DB etc. In fact it is not easy to do 
SO. 


sensitive Point 

The sensitive zone is a point in the zodiac ruled by the fructifying significators of an 
event- especially the combinations of dasa lord and bhukti lord. 

The transit of dasa period lords should be the first consideration. The transit of Jupiter over 
a sensitive point indicates the year of fructification of the event under consideration. The 
transit of luminaries Sun and Moon which are the exciting planets over the sensitive zones 
indicates the month and the day of the fructification of an event respectively. The transit of 
Ascendant over a sensitive point indicates the exact hour and minute of fructification of an 
event. 

For the chosen common significators among the four fold significators of the required 
houses for an event to materialize and ruling planets, say conjoined period of dasa lord Sun, 
bhukti lord Venus and antra lord Mercury, then 1) Sun sign, Venus star, Mercury sub; 2) 
Venus sign, Sun star, Mercury sub, and 3) Mercury sign, Sun star, Venus sub are the three 
sensitive and fruitful zones, which will be transited by Ascendant, Luminaries, Jupiter and 
the planets ruling the dasa, bhukti and antra. 


Question 2: Married life in second marriage 
Suppose, From birth chart we will predict first marriage and married life of the native. we 


KP Ezine May 2018 45 


have predicted that the marriage life is not good and there will be diverse. 

Accordingly, there was a diverse from the first marriage. 

The birth chart indicates second marriage. 

OK. The second marriage was celebrated. 

For predicting the second marriage life, we are using the same birth chart. 

Then obviously the same birth chart which was used to predict the marriage life of first 
marriage is used to predict the marriage life of second marriage also. Then the results will 
be same, as per the first marriage, as the chart is same. 

Does it mean that the second marriage life also is not good and lead to diverse? 

How to deal this?. 

OR 

Is it necessary to take HORARY NUMBER for predicting the second marriage life. 

I request for your advice on this subject. 


Answer 2 : 

For happiness in married life (by signification of 2,5,7,11), it is to consider the 7th and 11t 
(KP Reader V, p 152: LIFE WITH WIFE) cuspal sub lords for first marriage, and the 2nd 
(8th house from 7th) and 6th (8th form 11th) for second marriage. 


There is no happy married life for Albert Einstein with both two wives, and for Hugh Hefner 
with all three wives. 


Question 3: 11th house being Badhaka 

In the Book Horoscope and diseases of Sri Bhatt ji, page No. 82, under 12. Cure says, 

"If the sub lord of the 6th or 8th or 12th or 11th cusp be the significator of 1, 5, or 11, disease 
In a natal chart, when the 11th is Badhakasthana, it is not supported for cure as per KP. 

If so, what is the alternative for 11th? 

Is it correct to take 9th cusp together with 1 & 5? 

or 

Consider only 1 & 5 for cure? 

Sir, Please put me light on this. 


Answer: 
Consider only 1 and 5 for cure. 


Question 4: Effective Significators in KPAstro 4.1 

Iam using KP Astro 4.1, as suggested by Kp ezine, for a good personal software.

does not signify these houses.

Rangarajan: 
Assume that in a chart, Sun signifies 7th house. Suppose its sublord is Jupiter and if Jupi- 


KP Ezine May 2018 46 


ter signifies 6th house (12th to 7th house), then experts say that Sun cannot give 7th house 
results because its sublord opposes it. Houses 6, 8 and 12 from a given house are consid- 
ered bad fro that house. So if the sublord signifies a house that is 6th, 8th or 12th from a 
house then it is not considered good.

Sorry I can’t answer that one. You should consult a good KP astrologer. 


Answer 4 : 
Since house 6 in sub negates house 7 in significators but 7 in sub confirms 7 in significa- 
tors, the result would be positive house 7.

As per the KP rules, if the Sub lord of the 7th cusp is a significator for 2 or 7 or 11, the native is 
lucky to have a marriage. In the chart attached the 7th CSL Rahu is tenanted in the 8th house in the 
star of Sun, the lord of 11 tenanted in 5. These signification for Rahu are only basic level showing its 
positional house, house occupied and owned by its star lord only. In addition Rahu as a node, its sig- 
nifications by aspecting, conjoined planets, and the sign lord by its location are also to be considered. 
Practically in KP particularly as per the KP Readers generally in common practice, the Rahu/Ketu 
signifies the house occupied by them, planets in conjunction and aspect with them, their star lord, 
and sign lord are found considered depending on relevance to the matter under consideration with- 
out giving much attention to the order of priority — first to fourth. Accordingly, Rahu is to give the 
results of the house 8 for matter under consideration, here it is marriage and cusp 8 stands for De- 
lay, Dejection or Disappointment. Even today the native is facing the disappointment.

A, KP system, analysis on famous violinist 
Sri Dwaram, Venkata Swami Naidu. 











By: Gunti Nagaraju KP astrologer (M.com CAIIB, Retired Bank officer) 
12-13-668/5/2, Second floor, Nagarjuna Nagar, Tarnaka, 
Secunderabad- 500 017; Tel: 040-27172206; 9490752371;

“Music should strike fire from the heart of man, and bring tears from the eyes of a woman”. Ludwig 
van Beethoven. 

“Music expresses that which cannot be said and on which it is impossible to be silent.” Victor Hugo. 
“Music is the movement of sound to reach the soul for the education of its virtue”. Plato. 


This article is written on the eminent Violinist in Carnatic classical music late Sri Dwarm Venakata 
Swamy Naidu and is dedicated to all astrology and music lovers. 

The birth details are -DOB-08-NOV1893/ CORRECTEDTOB- 11:54-O0P.M/ 
POB-BANGALORE-KARNATAKA STATE, INDIA. 

(The natal chart is attached along with the correction of birth time document.) 


Creative artists, especially musicians have always been extremely charming, attractive and magnetic 
to their fellow humans. I am attempting to make an effort to take a look at how to understand the 
nature and extent of artistic talent in an astrological birth chart. For my study, I have taken the birth 
chart of late Sri Dwaram Venkataswamy Naidu a famous violinist of 20 century, who hailed from 
Karnataka state. 

Before proceeding further on the subject let me give a brief note on the hints given by conventional / 
Vedic astrology texts like- Kalyana Varma’s Saravali, Varahamihira in his Brihat Jataka. 


While discussing some of the astrological combinations for a successful musician, some of the im- 
portant houses which are responsible for becoming musicians are discussed. 

The two houses which juxtapose the 4th house are the anchor points of our creative talent. Why is 
the 4th house so important for artists and musicians? It is because that is the core of our emotional 
self. Think carefully about what it is, which we find attractive and compelling about artists and musi- 
cians — it is the way that they ventilate their inner selves emotionally accessible to us. 


Therefore the 4th House - the inner, private core of a person — is the main focal point of artistic po- 
tential. And the two juxtaposed houses (the 3rd and 5th houses) are crucially important to artists 
because it is these houses which express or give an outlet to the emotions in the 4th house. 

The 3rd House stands to the east of the 4th house. The east is where everything rises into the visible 
sky and becomes “born”, tangible, and real. So the 3rd house- holds our ability to take our deep emo- 
tions and express them in tangible form. 

The 5th House resides to the west of the 4th. The west represents the terminus and other people be- 
sides our own self. So the 5th House holds the genius and intellect required. 


Additionally, the 3rd house pertains physically to the hands of the native —- which are used to play 
musical instruments, etc. The 5th House pertains to creativity and the creative intelligence and im- 
pulse. 

Of slightly less importance, but still significant, is the 11th House - which indicates our ability 
to enjoy art and our opportunities to perform it for the public. 


Historical evidences reveal that the ancient musicians were able to create a healing effect with spir- 
itual music. Chakra activation maneuver for our study used the vocal technique as follows: A single 
maneuver consisted of 6 cycles. Each cycle consisted of singing ascending notes “S”, “R”, “G”, “M”, 
“Pp”, “D”, “N”, “S” (higher) followed by descending notes “N”, “D”, “P”, “M”, “G”, “R”, “S”(lower). The sub- 
jects were allowed to pause for inhalation in between. The notes were with microtones relating 
to raga Mayamadlavagaula. Last 3 cycles consisted of singing “Om” (a traditional devotional chant) 
instead of the notes in the same ascending and descending order. The maneuver lasts for approxi- 
mately 12 minutes. The maneuver required that every subject would sing comfortably without any 
strain or extra effort.

different sources of astrology books)

In Egypt, the seven planets were given separate keynotes while in Greece; the seven vowels of Greek 
were used for this purpose. The Persians celebrated the entry of the Sun into each sign with music 
stressing the keynotes of the presiding deity. It was strongly believed that with the use of the music 
of specific signs and planets, one derived great benefit. 


Planetary Significations 


Venus, being the Karaka for music and fine arts, is the key planet that decides one’s proficiency in 
music and other art forms. The association of Mercury also adds to this fact. While Venus infuses 
artistic aesthetic fineness, Mercury provides versatile skill and wit, the Sun a dignified and polished 
approach, the Moon sensitivity and imagination, Mars a bold sharp and courageous tint and pragma- 
tism, Jupiter a profoundness of thought and expression and Saturn, realism, depth and mass ap- 
peal. The voice is governed by Mercury, laya (rhythm) by Venus and nada (sound) by Jupiter. If Mer- 
cury, Venus and Jupiter are placed in good places and Venus in exaltation, the native shines as an 
artist. One may become a famous musician and instrumentalist. 


In terms of artistic creativity, these are the houses we generally begin with: 
e The 2nd house governs both visual arts and music 
e The 3rd House resonates with all forms of writing 
e The 5th House has affinities with the performing arts 
¢ The 7th House speaks of decorative arts as well as collaborations 
Additionally, some would also lump the 12th House (in) with the creative houses, for that is a sector 
that governs spiritual expressions which often take imaginative forms. 


12th House placements are actually wonderful for all sorts of artists. These placements can plug into 
a creative vision in the field of fine arts, seems to be God-given. Uranus here might actually discover 
some interesting ways to use technology to increase spiritual goals and ideas. If Uranus is in Virgo, 
then that could be something that is surprisingly practical as well. 


WATERY SIGNS--"Water signs — Pisces, Cancer, Scorpio and Aquarius - are very artistic, romantic 
and creative. Water signs give themselves so fully to music that they can end up losing themselves 
within it. 


Pisces in particular love any kind of music. Cancers are the ones who might get the job at the club 
or be a part of the industry. Scorpios are very romantic, sensual, deep, dark and intense.

Early life and background 

1) Dwaram Venkataswamy Naidu was born on 08 November 1893, (Deepavali day), in Bangalore, In- 
dia and was raised in Visakhapatnam. He was appointed Professor of violin in the Maharaja’s Music 
College in Vizianagaram (A.P), at the young age of 26, and became its principal in 1936. 

--the period running at the time of appointment as a Principal was- 

Mercury dasa (up to 1937) significator of 3 and 12 signifies 3 and 1 at its star level and 3,6,9,10 and

lord level and 3,4&12 at its sub lord level gave him covetable position away from his place of stay. 

2) Naidu was the first one to start the violin solo concerts. His first solo concert was given in Vellore 
in 1938. Naidu’s technique is renowned. But certain words crop up often when discussing his tech- 
nique: “simple,” “deceptively simple” and even “minimal.” He was known for his extremely well devel- 
oped soft bowing technique combined with a firm fingering technique. He was known to be a listener 
of Western and Hindustani music and would imbue his solos with occasional flourishes from outside 
influences — without disturbing his own music’s tradition. 


He wrote several articles on music, like an essay on the “Peculiar characteristics of the Tambura”. He 
cautioned his disciples against missing practice even for a day. “If you don’t practice for one day, you 
will notice your mistakes, if you don’t practice for two days the audience would notice your mis- 
takes!!” He often used to say, “Music is audible tapas.” 


Yehudi Menuhin, a world renowned violinist, was greatly impressed when he heard Dwaram play at 
Justice P.V. Rajamannar’s house. The famous playback singer Ghantasala Venkateswara Rao 
learned Carnatic music under Naidu. Kalaimamani Smt.Radha Narayanan was also a disciple of (V.) 
Naidu.

> Madras Music Academy presented him with Sangeetha Kalanidhi in 1941.( Ketu dasa x Rahu 
bhukthi- 1940-1941 july).

He received Sangeet Natak Academi Award in Fine Arts in 1953. 

Padma Shree Award was conferred on him in 1957. 

Indian Postal Department has released a commemorative stamp on his birth centenary in 1993. 


Raja-Lakshmi Award for the year 1992 by Sri Raja-Lakshmi Foundation, Chennai was awarded to 
waram Venkataswamy Naidu Memorial Trust.

Generally the word ABORTION defines miscarriage or premature expulsion of a fetus. In medicine it 
is a cessation of pregnancy or fetal development. In biology abortion is an early stop to the develop- 
ment of an organ. If someone is purposely doing an abortion it is a deliberate termination of pregnan- 
cy. In this case my personal point of view is if someone deliberately terminates the growing of a fetus 
in the womb by way of medicine intake, by a surgery or using any other method, it is a murder. It is 
a killing and it is an assassination. In Buddhism the first precept is refraining from killing until the 
end of their lives (Praana Ghaatha Akusal Kamma). Hence I use the word MURDER for this wright 
up.

Question 1: Step parents 

I have a doubt in KP Astrology. 

My doubt - 

How to check whether a girl (child) gets a stepfather? 
Which house to look for step father and 

What connections / significations to be studied ? 
Sir, Kindly, clarify my doubt 


Answer 1: 
A child can get a step-father if her mother is promised to get married 2™4 time. 


Some astrologers are using 12‘ house (3"4 from 9th house) for step-father and 6th house 
(3td from 4th house) for stepmother because in ancient times the step parent was often the 
sibling of the mother or father. That type of rule can’t really apply in modern times. It would 
be more reasonable to suggest that the second husband of the mother would relate to the 
10% house (7 from 4th house) for stepfather and the second wife of the father would relate 
to the 3™ house (7 from 9 house) for stepmother. To judge such a relationship, we 
need to look at 5th house in parent’s horoscope and 9th (for father) or 4th house (for mother 
and emotions) in the child’s horoscope.

What is death? Death is the cessation of all biological functions that sustain a living organism. There 
are several reasons such as aging, predation, malnutrition, disease, suicide, homicide, starvation, 
dehydration, and accidents or trauma resulting in terminal injury for the death. 

In general Astrology the 8th house is known as the house of death and the death dealing forc- 
es act the stronger through the 8th house. The 4th, 8th and 12th houses are called the terminal 
houses and have to do with the close and end of life and the physical body. 


Death Rules 

1) In KP "Death is indicated only by the significators of Marakasthana and Badhakasthana." (KP 
READER VI,1978 or 2002 p 155; also repeated in K. Hariharan: LONGEVITY, 1986 pp 36/50). 

2) Sri Tin Win ji has condescended the death rule as " Death comes primarily during the conjoined 
period of significtors of Badhaka (11 or 9 or 7), Maraka (2,7), Moksha (12) (and in some cases, 8 = 
Accident, 4 = End of everything including life, 10 = Retirement from this world or life; 4,8,12 trig- 
onal houses of serious accidents or unnatural death; also 6 = Injury in accident)" , by producing 
various KP literatures which have discussed practical examples in depth. 

3) Also as appeared in the House Grouping Part I(Free KPEZine Oct 2007) compiled by Sri Tin Win 
ji. under Lagna cusp says, If the lagna sub lord signifiy (4),8,12, Danger to life/Unnatural / Acci- 
dental death, during the DBAS of (4), 8, 12 and Maraka and Badhaka. 

4) Since the case under study is of Death Sentence, attributed by the court of law or prevailing or- 
ders of the penal code, it is reasonable to categorize this as an unnatural death. However this 
type of unnatural death should not be similar to that of other types of unnatural death like star- 
vation, aging or accident etc. because the sentence of death is to be given by a third party, the 
ruler of the country. 


In this connection Dr. H.L.Cornell MD., says in his Encyclopedia of Medical Astrology, 

"Judicial Execution is strongly denoted by the 17D of Gemini and Sagittarius and planets which may 
occupy these degrees or degrees also in square (90 D) to them. 

Death by Law is denoted when Saturn is involved in configuration otherwise indicating a violent 
death, as Saturn is said to rule Judges and the Law. 

The mutable signs and especially Gemini and Sagittarius indicate the homicidal tendency, or Judicial 
Execution. 

Fixed signs also indicate such a death and especially Saturn is in a fixed sign such as Taurus. 


More testimonies 

i. The Sun is Sq. or Opp. to Mars. 

ii. The Moon to the Ill-aspects 

iii. Me. by direction and Me or Mo afflicted by malefics at birth. 

iv. The Mo increasing or at full, separation from Me and applying to Ma. 
v. Uranus conjunction with Ma in Aries 

vi. Ma in a human sign and afflicting Sa 

vll. Ma opp. to Asc. 

viii. Ma Sq. or opp. to Mo 

ix. Me Sq. to Ma - death by a public Executioner. 

x. Mo is in the 10th house 

xi. Lord of the 8th house a malefic and in the 10th. 

xii. If the Lord of the 8th or 10th, afflict the Lord of the Asc. from the fixed signs. 
xiii. Lord of the 10th is in the 12th

(Anaretic = Karmic Degrees of a Zodiacal sign) 
(Promitters = Planet that promises in the root of a nativity something to be fulfilled when the time of 
direction shall be accomplished.)

A RELOOK AT THE FAILURE OF MY ANAYLSIS-- 

When I made a relook at the case for the reason “why and how I have failed in my analysis, I 
have observed that I have erred miserably at the very selection of ruling planets at the time 
of judgment”. 

Here I furnish (for the benefit f the readers) the established KP rules on the selection of rul- 
ing planets here under which I forgot to follow— 

“Ruling planets are the planets which rule the moment at the time of judgment of any ques- 
tion. The original ruling planets as enunciated by Sri KSK are listed bellow in the order of 
preference(original KP vol2, Sagar publications,1965, pp273-4; 412; KP Reader VI p 123, 
RPs & KP pp ix, xvii, 32; Dr Satyaprakash Chowdary; Ruling Planets in KP): 

1.ASC. Star Lord/ 2. ASC. Sign Lord/ 3.Moon Star Lord/4. Moon Sign Lord/ and 5. Day 
lord. 

Note- A)If Rahu or Ketu is conjoined or aspected by a ruling planet, or if Rahu or Ketu is 
posited in a sign owned by one of the ruling planets, then Rahu or Ketu should be included 
in the effective ruling planets. If Rahu or Ketu appears to be a ruling planet, it’s sign lord is 
replaced by it. In case the sign lord is the strong significator, it can be taken along with Ra- 
hu or Ketu. 

B) Of late many astrologers also consider the sub lord of the Ascendant and Moon as ruling 
planets and they are using 7 ruing planets.(RP & KP PP65,79, 108) 

C) Planets in conjunction or aspect to the ruling planets can also be considered as ruling 
planets, especially if the planet is strong and located in the ruling Ascendant itself. 

D) The ruling planets in retro motion do not prevent the event to take place but will give the 
result when they become direct in motion. Reject the ruling planets which are posited in the 
star or sub of retrograde planets.(KP Reader 6 pp167,171,176,187, 202,224,274) 

E) It is a common practice to work out the ruling planets at the time of casting the chart or 
the time of judgment of a query even though the question is solved with the help of a horary 
number. 

It is best method of choosing the common fruitful significators which are common with the 
significators of the relevant houses.(KP Reader 6 pp274, 138,141,200) 

F) Another opinion is that the ruling planets of Horary Ascendant as per the chosen number 
help to reach at the right conclusion.( Dr. Prabhakar-New dimensions of Kp astrology 
(Horary page 64) reason being the Ascendant cusp derives the fate of the querent and the 
fate cannot be changed.(Dr. Kar in KPA 2001 p 22). 

In view of the above and in relevance to my analysis of the above query, on a relook 
at the issue it is observed that “ I have not followed the rule C)” Planets in conjunction or 
aspect to the ruling planets can also be considered as ruling planets, especially if the plan- 
et is strong and located in the ruling Ascendant itself.” 

On the basis of the above rule C the revised effective ruling planets are — 
RPS AT TOJ—(taken by me originally) are - MARS-SAT-(3)MERC-MOON-KETU. 
After considering the above rule “C” it is observed that following omissions are made — 
1) In the ruling planets chart- Venus is aspecting the ruling planet SATURN directly by 
its 7th aspect. So I should take VENUS as RP. 
2) Sun, Mars and Mercury are conjoined in Gemini and here since Mercury and Mars are 
ruing planets, SUN which is conjoined is to be taken as RP. 
3) Moon is the ruling planet which is conjoined with Jupiter in Virgo sign and hence JU- 
PITER is to be taken as RP. 
4) So the effective Ruling planets are—

Analysis

In this horary chart:- (a) for the sake of BJP, the signification of 1st, 6, and 11th

vourable and 3 unfavourable) 

(iii) Sublord of 11th is Moon, Lord of 4 in 9; in the constellation of Venus, lord of 2 and 7 in 2. (2 fa- 
vourable and 3 unfavourable.) 

Total favourable for BJP is 6 and Unfavourable is 9. So there is no chance for BJP to form the 
Government in Karnataka. 

In this horary chart:- (b) for the sake of Congress party, the signification of 74, 12th, and 5th houses

and 2 unfavourable.) 

Total favourable for Opposition Party (Congress) is 8 and Unfavourable is 6. So there are plenty

Question: Difference between Promise of Marriage and Real Marriage 

While going through your article on "will my love affair materialise" in EZine Jan 2018, 

predicting no marriage with the particular girl , on the basis of cuspal sub lord signifying 

negative house 1-6-8 at sub level despite the fact that the 5th, 7th and 11th CSL Mercury signify- 
ing 2, 7 and 11 houses at planet and star level. 


But, you have always emphasised that the promise of event will be there if any one of the event re- 
quired houses is signified by the cuspal sub lord at any level. 


In the above case, would it not be correct to say that the marriage with the particular girl is prom- 
ised but with delay, dejection because of signification of non improving houses. 


Will you kindly enlighten on this. 


Answer: 
It is a very relevant question to explain the difference between ‘judging promise of marriage’ and 
‘considering real marriage.’ 


In judging promise of marriage, marriage is promised as long as any of marriage houses 2,7,11 is 
siginified by the 7 cuspal sub lord at any level of planet, star lord and sub lord, regardless of signi- 
fication of negative houses 1,6,10,8,12 which may indicate separation or divorce. Here the sub lord 
signification does not play a deciding role. 

However in considering real marriage the sub lord plays a deciding role especially if it clearly signifies 
negative houses, i.e. marriage cannot materialize during a dasa period whose sub lord clearly negates 
marriage. 

Here the consultant was asking whether marriage would take place, and the sub lord clearly negates 
marriage by signification of houses 1,6,8. So it was concluded that he would not be able to marry the 
girl despite good matching for marriage by KPDP matching and matching of ruling planets of boy and 
girl. The actual outcome was no marriage. 


Note: The case is shown below: 

QUOTE 

Horary Data 

Question: Will I be able to get married to a girl with whom I am having a love affair? 
Horary number: 27 (1 — 249) 

Date & time of judgment: 07/Nov/2017, 08:26:16 AM, GMT -5 

Place of judgment: Maryland, USA, 39N05, 77W09 

Ayanamsa: 24° 0' 58" (New KP) 


Cuspal Sub Lords to be Considered 

For query "Will my Love Affair Materialize?, the 5th house is considered. (KP Reader VI, p 191) 

The house which one has to take for judgment depends on the query. If it is for marriage, one has to 
take 7th house. (ibid, p 168) 

If one wants to know whether he or she could marry another one in mind, it is to consider the 11th 
house, which shows fulfillment of one's desire. (Ibid pp 146, 171, 214) 

Thus for his query to marry this particular girl, the 5th, 7th and 11th cuspal sub lords (CSL) are to 
be considered. 


Analysis of CSLs 

The 5th, 7th and 11th cuspal sub lord.is the same Mercury. This Mercury is in house 7, lord of hous- 
es 2-3-6, in the star of Saturn in houses 7, and in sub of Venus+ in house 6, lord of house 1, the CSL 
of houses 6,8 having no planet in its stars. 


KP Ezine July 2018 39 


Mercury signifies marriage houses 2,7 in the planet level and 7,11 in the star level, indicating possi- 
ble marriage without taking into consideration of the sub level indication. 


But the decider sub Venus signifies negative house 6 (12th to 7th) fully and also another negative 
house 1 (12th to 2) and undesirable house 8 (dejection). 


So it is concluded that he would not be able to marry this girl despite good matching for mar- 
riage.

One-day Fall of 19% ($119 billion) 

Facebook’s shares fell 19% to $176.26 on Thursday, July 26, 2018, wiping out $119 billion in market 
value, the biggest one-day stock market loss of any public trading company in US stock-market his- 
tory, after the social media giant firm reported slowing growth in user numbers following a string of 
recent scandals. 

For founder Mark Zuckerberg, the loss came to $15.4 billion, according to Forbes, which tracks bil- 
lionaire wealth in real time, dropping his net worth to $67.1 billion. That dropped him from fourth to 
sixth on the list of richest people in the world. 

Facebook Chief Financial Officer David Wehner said on a conference call with investors that Face- 
book is “putting privacy first” after the Cambridge Analytica sacndal triggered a wave of horrible 
press, customer angst and regulatory scrutiny around the world. 

There has been a cascading series of scandals and mishaps involving customer data and content 
oversight on the platform, leading to harsh criticism. Founder and CEO Mark Zuckerberg went on an 
apology tour and testified before Congress and British Parliament regarding the company’s practices. 


Analysts raised concerns as to whether the Cambridge Analytica scandal would cause advertisers to 
slink away or user growth to slow. While the quarterly results don't provide clear evidence of that, 
neither does it provide convincing evidence that fears are overblown. 


One activist investment firm, Trillium Asset Management, called for Zuckerberg to be replaced as 
board chairman, and replaced with an independent director — a sign of investor interest in greater 
oversight.
