Dementia 


= 


mory vs Nodes 


By: Sumanadasa Namarathna (Sunaparantha Kalyan) 
Ex-Accountant, Justice of Peace 
No.22/1, Udugampola Road, Marapola, Veyangoda, 


SRI LANKA Email: sumanal946@gmail.com 








Dementia is not a specific disease. It is a general term for a decline in mental ability severe enough to 
interfere with daily life. Also it's an overall term that describes a group of symptoms associated with a 
decline in memory or other thinking skills severe enough to reduce a person's ability to perform eve- 
ryday activities. Alzheimer's disease accounts for 60 to 80 percent of cases and it is the most com- 
mon type of dementia. 

Although the early signs vary, common early symptoms of dementia include; memory problems, par- 
ticularly remembering recent events, increasing confusion, reduced concentration, personality or be- 
havior changes, apathy and withdrawal or depression and loss of ability to do everyday tasks. 
Dementia is caused by damage to brain cells. This damage interferes with the ability of brain cells to 
communicate with each other. When brain cells cannot communicate normally, thinking, behavior 
and feelings can be affected. The brain has many distinct regions, each of which is responsible for 
different functions (for example, memory, judgment and movement). When cells in a particular region 
are damaged, that region cannot carry out its functions normally. 

Different types of dementia are associated with particular types of brain cell damage in particular re- 
gions of the brain. For example, in Alzheimer's disease, high levels of certain proteins inside and out- 
side brain cells make it hard for brain cells to stay healthy and to communicate with each other. The 
brain region called the hippocampus is the center of learning and memory in the brain, and the brain 
cells in this region are often the first to be damaged. That's why memory loss is often one of the earli- 
est symptoms of this disease. 

While most changes in the brain that cause dementia are permanent and worsen over time, thinking 
and memory problems caused by the following conditions may improve when the condition is treated 
or addressed: Depression, Medication side effects, Excess use of alcohol, Thyroid problems & Vitamin 
deficiencies. 


Astrological applications 

1) Waste away, become emaciated, wither, shrivel, shrivel up, shrink, become shrunken, dry up, de- 
cay, wilt, decline, deteriorate, degenerate, grow weak, weaken, become debilitated, become enfeebled 
of organs or cells or tissues of the human body is called ATROPHY. This is a disease of Saturn. If 
afflicted Saturn at birth is the ruler or connected planet to any of the part or organ of the body, above 
said results of Atrophy may arise. 

As the topic under study is mainly connected with memory, it is combined with the Head and 

Brain, which is under the rule of Aries sign. According to the Hindu Astrology the first house of 

the natural Zodiac Aries rules the memory. Being the ruler of the Medulla of the brain, Saturn is 

also become as a ruler of memory. Hence planet Saturn should be a remarkable indicator of the 
disease Dementia, if it is anyway connected with the sign Aries or first house. 


2) Memory, the retentive power of the mind is mainly under the rule of Mercury that is called "The 
messenger of the God". It is planet for mind, reason and logic. Also it rules the nervous system in 
general. When Mercury is weak or afflicted at birth various disorders of the mind loss of retentive 
power, poor reasoning powers, madness, insanity develop. 


3) The Moon is another well known ruler of mind and also organic functions and organic decay. It 
rules the brain, especially disorder of the brain substances. 


4) The third house is called the house of mind and it rules the mental capacity and its strength, men- 
tal inclination, ability and memory. When malefic are connected with the third house, tend to dis- 


turb and unbalances of the mind.

Question 1: Fortuna 
Can youu provide me some notes about FORTUNA. 


Answer 1: 

Importance was given to Fortuna at early stage of KP in the original "Krishnamurti Padhdhati Vol 1", 
Sagar Publications, 1966, pp 472-474, in a “separate chapter” but not in the six KP Readers where 
Fortuna is mentioned here and there a little bit only. 


In KP Fortuna is calculated by the following formula. 
Fortuna = Moon + Lagna - Sun (in longitude) (KP Reader I, p 98) 


Fortuna is only a mathematical point in the chart. 

Generally Fortuna is supposed to improve the matters indicated by the house occupied by it. Fortuna 
gives fortune to one in the conjoined period and sub period of the star lord and sub lord in which it is 
posited. (KP Reader III, pp 178, 191/ 1971 edition, practical part, pp 24, 36) 


As per the original Krishnamurti Padhdhati Vol 1, pp 472-474, Sagar Publications, 1966, the results 
of Fortuna in the various houses are as shown below: 


e ist house: gain in enterprises, lead a happy life, come up by own efforts 

e 2nd: gain through property, make profit by business, lead a happy domestic life, enjoy satisfacto- 
ry bank position 

e 3rd: gain through brother, make profitable short journey, enjoy the good relationship with neigh- 
bours. 

e 4th: gain through landed property, some hidden treasure and products of earth, minerals, met- 
als, etc., 

e 5th: gain through fortunate investments and children, young people and ambassadors 

e 6th: helpful, lucky uncle and aunty, gain through servants , small animals and doing banking 
business 

e 7th: gain through partners or other sex, contracts and dealings with others; victory over enemies 

e 8th: gain by inheritance, insurance business, gratuity, bonus etc. 

e 9th: higher studies, long journeys, gain through dealing with foreigners, foreign trade, publication 
CLC: 

e 10th: name, fame, reputation, promotion. 

e 11th: beneficial friends, helpful brother, profitable business, realization of hopes, fulfillment of 
desire 

e 12th: lucky in purchases and sales, fortunate in investments, gains from unknown sources 


Vijay Kumar has used to apply the Fortuna as per its occupied house and signification of its star and 
sub lords in his articles in the KPE-zine old issues and in the K.P. & Astrology Year Books. 


Note: In the horary chart with a KP horary number, since the house occupied by Fortuna itself and 
the houses occupied and owned by the planets are counted from the horary Lagna, it is more reason- 
able to calculate Fortuna from the " horary" chart Lagna. So check whether Fortuna is calculated 
from the "horary" chart Lagna by the software used as some SWs are calculating from the "natal or 
time" chart Lagna. (Pl see details in KPE-zine March 2011 issue, Questions & Answers section)

Question 3: Timing of second marriage 
A forty years old person has asked for his marital life. 
Simply has given his horoscope and did not say any thing. 


First marriage is promised as per chart.. Horoscope clearly showing that there is diverse as well as 
second marriage also. 

Significators 2, 7 and 11 are to be considered for the timing 

of first marriage. 

Significators of 2,7,9 and 11 are to be considered for the 

timing of second marriage. 

In this case, the significators of 9, are already appeared as 

significators in 2,7 and 11 significators. 

In this situation, how to distinguish the time for second marriage as well as from first marriage. 


Answer 3: 
It is true that: 
The first marriage is considered during the joint dasa period DBAS of significators of 2,7,11 houses. 


The second marriage is considered during the joint dasa period DBAS of significators of 2,7,9,11 
houses. 


Question 4: Number of children 
If SCSL signification/connection to 2,5 Or 11, children are indicated to the native. 
It does not indicate the number of children. How to know the number children the native will have? 


Answer 4: 


It is supposed that if the 7‘ cuspal sub lord (sibling 3™4 from the 5t) of first child) signifies 2,11 hous- 
es, more than one children can be expected.

Your Birth Chart And The Sport You Should Play 
by Dr. Prem Kumar Sharma 
UBS Publishers’s Distributors Pvt.Ltd., 2009, 135 pages 


oa a =——*7,

AND ala 





This book is a rare vedic astrology book on sports like “Sports and Astrology” by S.K. Sathyanaraya- 
na Rao, 2004, and Western “Sports Astrology” by John Frawley, 2007. 


The aim of this book is to astrologically define different sports activities and determine the significant 
factors that play a pivotal role in making great sportsmen. A chart can be analyzed in order to access 
the interests, capabilities and potential of a budding sportsperson, so that the person can focus, on 
the development of inborn potential and gain excellence in a particular sports field. 


The book has 11 chapters. The first three chapters describe the role of planets, houses and constella- 
tions in determining the sports potential of a birth chart. 


The fourth chapter titled ‘How to Judge a Chart for Sports Potential’, discusses in detail the strate- 
gies and methods to analyse a birth chart, in order to determine the level of its potential for sports 
activity. 


Chapter five is devoted to the Sun Signs and their indications. The astrological significators of a vari- 
ety of sports, games and track events are listed in the sixth chapter. The next two chapters are devot- 
ed to two popular sports in India viz. Cricket and Hockey. 


Chapter nine carries an analysis of the birth charts of sports personalities. Chapter ten explains the 
concept of ‘Hora’, its determination and its possible utilisation for getting better results in certain 
sports. The last chapter titled ‘Remedial Measures’ enlist techniques to strengthen weak planets and 
make the afflicted planets propitious in a birth chart.

in a fiery sign has given the native success in batting. The 34 lord is placed in the 5th house and as- 
pects the 11t* house. The Gemini sign falls in the main house of profession and its lord Mercury is 
well related. All these factors clearly points out his excellence as a batsman. (pp 44-45)

Background Note: On my visit to Delhi on February 2018; during meeting with one of my 
Astro friend; he asked me to know about his status of mediclaim insurance which were du- 
ly settled & approved and passed for payment; but the claim amount was not yet credited 
to his bank account. The insurance company informed to him that they had tried several 
times towards remittance of claim amount; but eventually it was held-up and as resulted; 
not being credited to his bank account due to the KYC mismatch. However there were no 
issues from his end as because he had successfully updated his KYC records (including his 
bank particulars) with the insurance company; but still claim money not received due to 
the reasons unknown to him. So he wants to know astrologically “when he will get medi- 
claim insurance?” 


Major question taken into consideration — regarding receipt of approved & passed medi- 
claim insurance? 

As the mediclaim insurance duly passed & approve for payment; hence there is no need to 
checking promise as we have no doubt regarding receipt of claim. So I decide to check the 
query of Querent with help on K.P. Numerology to pin-point the event. I immediately casted 
Time chart for which details are as under - 


Name & Sex of Querent: : Mr. J. Kumar, Male. 
Date-Time-Place of Judgment: : 09-02-2018; 11:35:37 Hrs. New Delhi (28N35 —- 7'7E15). 


CHART ANALYSIS 

At the Date-Time-Place of judgment; Lagna falls under Aries 26-28-38 and the co-rulers 
(Sign-Star-Sub) are Mars-Venus-Ketu. None of the joint-ruler planet is retrograde; hence 
considered all of them. Now allocate the number of years as per VMD (Vimshottari Maha- 
Dasha) for Mars 07Y + Venus 20Y + Ketu O7Y = 34Y. 


The last digit of 34 (i.e. 4) and its corresponding sub lord indicate the year of fructification. 
In Chart, 4th CSL is Moon indicating 2 & 10 in K.P. Numerology. So the year will be 2018 
(2+0+1+8 = 11 = 1+1 = 2). 


The total of 34 (i.e. 3+4 = 7) and its corresponding sub lord indicate the month of fructifica- 
tion. In Chart, 7 CSL is Ketu in conjunction with Sun & Mercury and in the star of Moon. 
Ketu represents 7 (July), Sun represents 1 (January), Mercury represents 5 (May) and 
Moon represents 2 (February). Here Ketu, Sun, Mercury is not useful to take as we know 
that mediclaim has already passed & approved for payment. So event will fructify soon. 
Hence 7th CSL Ketu is in star of Moon indicating 2 means February 2018 will be the month 
of fructification of event.

Final Show.

Next 
2) Herefers MA Lord of 6&11(SC and ARis 6 & 11 for Lagna GE ) 
this is very Confusing.

for SIGN-HOUSES or CUSP HOUSES 


Please help me in this regard sir 


Answer 1: 

In KP the house lord is the sign lord where a cusp falls. In the chat on page 88 of PROFES- 
SION book: 

1) 4th cusp falls in Leo sign ruled by Sun. So Sun is lord of 4t8 house, which is correctly 
said there. 

2) 12th cusp falls in Venus sign Taurus and 5t* cusp in Venus sign Libra. Sun Venus is lord 
of 5th and 12th houses. It is wrong in writing there Venus as lord of 6t8 and 11th house. 

3) 6t cusp falls in Mars sign Scorpio and 11t* cusp in Mars sign Aries. So Mars is lord of 6 
and 11th houses as correctly said there.

The above statement was made by Sri KSK.The book on Horary Astrology ie Reader 6 has 
not given any example on how to select a bride among half a dozen girls for the bridegroom 
to surely declare whom he would MARRY only a particular girl in Horary method. My ques- 
tion is can you please suggest how to do it in KP Horary method in detail ? 


Answer 3: 

As said at the end of “WHY HORARY ASTROLOGY IS PREFERRED?” (p 18), it may be pre- 
dicted who will be the bridegroom by giving one number to each of half a dozen girls or 
more, and doing horary analysis for marriage. 


Example: 

Horary Data 

Question: Will I be able to get married to a girl with whom I am having a love affair? 
Horary number: 27 (1 — 249) 

Date & time of judgment: 07 /Nov/2017, 08:26:16 AM, GMT -5 

Place of judgment: Maryland, USA, 39N05, 77W0O9 

Ayanamsa: 24° 0' 58" (New KP) 


Cuspal Sub Lords to be Considered 

For query "Will my Love Affair Materialize?, the 5th house is considered. (KP Reader VI, p 
191) 

The house which one has to take for judgment depends on the query. If it is for marriage, 
one has to take 7th house. (ibid, p 168) 

If one wants to Know whether he or she could marry another one in mind, it is to consider 
the 11th house, which shows fulfillment of one's desire. (Ibid pp 146, 171, 214) 

Thus for his query to marry this particular girl, the 5th, 7th and 11th cuspal sub lords 
(CSL) are to be considered. 


Analysis of CSLs 

The Sth, 7th and 11th cuspal sub lord.is the same Mercury. This Mercury is in house 7, 
lord of houses 2-3-6, in the star of Saturn in houses 7, and in sub of Venus+ in house 6, 
lord of house 1, the CSL of houses 6,8 having no planet in its stars. 

Mercury signifies marriage houses 2,7 in the planet level and 7,11 in the star level, indicat- 
ing possible marriage without taking into consideration of the sub level indication. 


But the decider sub Venus signifies negative house 6 (12th to 7th) fully and also another 
negative house 1 (12th to 2) and undesirable house 8 (dejection). 


So it is concluded that he would not be able to marry this girl despite despite good 
matching for marriage by KPDP matching and matching of ruling planets of boy and 
girl at the time of birth. The actual outcome was no marriage. 

Note: KPDP matching and matching of ruling planets of boy and girl at the time of 
birth are useful in choosing partner. 


Question 4: What happened in the Past? 

I request you to describe the procedure to predict the 
previously happened incidences in any body's life. 
For example, one of my friend asked me to predict the incident happened on 02-05-1980 for 
a lady 

dob: 13-04-1960 

tob: 5-20 pm 

pob: warangal. 

He has given the 3 options; 

1. marriage 

2. adopted by some one 

3. award /prize. 


KP Ezine September 2018 31 


The chart is enclosed. 
I request you to analyse the above chart for my knowledge as well as for the knowledge of 
the readers of KPEzine, for the options given above. 


Answer 4: 

Rules 

1). If the 7th cuspal sub lord (CSL) be the significator of 2,7,11 houses, the native marries 
during the joint dasa periods of significators of 2,7,11 houses. 

2). If the 5th CSL be the significator of 4,8,2,(6,10) houses, the native adopts a child during 
the joint dasa periods of significators of 4,8,2,(6,10) houses. 

3). If the 10th CSL be the significator of 10,11,6 (2), the native gains award/prize during the 
joint dasa period of the significators of 10,11,6 (2) houses. 


Cuspal Analysis 

1). 7h CSL Ju:3,4-7/ Star Ke:6, Met+:6,1-10, Ve:6,2-9, Ju:3,4-7/ Sub Sa:4,5-6, indicates 
promise of marriage. 

2). 11% CSL Ju:9,10-1/ Star Ke:12, Me+:12,7-4, Ve:12,8-3, Ju:9,10-1/ Sub Sa:10,11-12, 
indicates promise of being adopted. 

3). 10t2 CSL Ke:6, Me+:6,1-10, Ve:6,2-9, Ju:3,4-7/ Star Ju:3,4-7/ Sub Mo+:2,11, indicates 
promise of award/ prize 


Dasa Analysis 

On the day of 02 May 1980, the running joint dasa was Sa-Ve-Ve-Ve DBAS: 
Dasa lord Sa:4,5-6/ Star Ve:6,2-9/ Sub Me+:6,1-10 

Bas lord Ve:6,2-9/ Star Sa:4,5-6/ Sub Mot:2,11 


Transit Analysis 

On the day of 02 May 1980, 

Dasa lord Sa was transiting in the star and sub of Su:7,12. 

BAS lord Ve was transiting in the star of Mat+:6,3-8 and sub of Me+t:6,1-10. 

Luminary Su was transiting in the star of Ve:6,2-9 and sub of Ra:12, Mat:6,3-8, Met+:6,1- 
LO: 

Luminary Mo was transiting in the star of Sa: Sa:4,5-6 and sub of Ve: 6,2-9. 


Conclusion: 

1) Marriage may not be possible because of 1,6,10 (12t8 to 2,7,11) significations in dasa 
lords and transit even though Jupiter was aspecting 7‘ lord natal Jupiter. 

2) Getting to be adopted and gaining award/price are very closed to call but gaining award/ 
price is chosen by hit or miss.

“Mr Nimje while solving such questions, took the help of only four basic “RULING PLANETS

He contended that ruling planets which are in the retro star lord will certainly not give the 
results and hence he discarded such ruling planets for consideration.

concerned star lord, rasi lord or day lord which they own. In cases of nodes-Rahu and Ketu

remainder of a single digit. The remainder is the final choice which is indicated by the divine

On 29-08-2018, at 8-OO AM when I switched on my TV set, I heard shocking news that NANDAMURI

M .

Minister of combined Andhra Pradesh State. Mr. Hari Krishna himself was also a cine actor. Even 
though he acted in so many cinemas, he was not as popular as his father was. He was an active 
member in theTELUGU DESAM party. He was an ex- MLA, ex- Minister in combined AP State and

Date of Birth : 02-09-1956

years.

up to 66 years only.

nificators of 6, 8 and 12 houses. If maraka and bhadhaka lords are involved, the accident will be fa- 
tal. 
Here that was what happened exactly.

Answer 3: 

Importance of Fruitful Significators 

1. An event happens during the joint period of DBAS of the significators of houses under 
consideration. Many a time many planets and even all the 9 planets become the significa- 
tors of the relevant house. In cases where the significators of the houses under considera- 
tion exceed more than four, the really beneficial or fruitful significators amongst them are to 
be found out after eliminating the unimportant significators which are only tempters. This 
is really a very difficult task even for an experienced KP astrologer and most failures in pre- 
diction are mainly due to the wrong selection of fruitful significators. The KP analysis starts 
from the cuspal sub lord for a matter that ends as an event with the help of fruitful signifi- 
cators. 


First Method 

2. The first method of selecting fruitful or beneficial significators is to see the cuspal sub 
lord of the concerned houses, and to check which of the significators are posited in their 
stars. Those significators which are in the stars of such cuspal sub lords can be taken 
straightaway as fruitful significators. The rest can be dropped or eliminated by further con- 
sideration. 


3. The sub lord of the significator is the deciding factor regarding the matters of the star lord 
and planet. If the sub lord is harmonious to the matters indicated by the star lord and plan- 
et, the significator gives favorable results. It is to take the planet which is posited in the sub 
of a significator whose star is not tenanted. If the sub lord is detrimental to the matters in- 
dicated by the star lord and 

planet, the significator does not give favorable results. It is to take the planet which is posit- 
ed in the sub of a significator whose star is not tenanted. 


4. It is to find out whether a planet is a strong significator or a weak significator in the order 
in which one makes the selection of the significators. For example of marriage, if a planet is 
not at all connected with houses 2, 7, 11, except that one of the significators aspects it, 
then it is a weak planet. If the sub lord of a planet is a strong significator of the matter un- 
der consideration, then that planet is to be 

selected as a fruitful significator. But if the sub lord is one of the weak ignificators, then it is 
a weak planet. 


Second Method 

5. The second method is to select the fruitful significators with the help of the Ruling Plan- 
ets (RPs) invented by Guruji KSK. According to “The RPs at the time of query would be the 
RPs at the time of 

fructification of the event expected.”, the significators which are in common with the RPs 
are to be selected as the fruitful significators for the event in question to get the correct re- 
sult. 


6. In their order of preference or strength, the following planets are called the RPs of the 
time when 

the chart is cast and judgment undertaken: 

1) Asc star lord 

2) Asc sign lord 

3) Moon star lord 

4) Moon sign lord 

5) Day lord 


KP Ezine October 2018 30 


7. The day is from sunrise to next sunrise. The RPs are to be taken at the time of query or 
judgment. Their help should be sought only when there is an urge to decide the significators 
which can bring out the event under consideration. The RP which is in the star or sub of a 
retrograde planet should be omitted and to take the remaining. 


8. If Rahu or Ketu is in conjunction or aspect with the RP, or if it occupies the sign owned 
by the RP, then Rahu and/or Ketu should be included in the RP. 

9. Some KP followers have added two more RPs of Asc sub lord and Moon sub lord. For the 
purpose of selecting the fruitful significators, the lesser number of RPs, i.e. the original 5 
seems more appropriate. 


10. Even here, it is to select such of those planes which are deposited in such a sub that 
contributes to the matter concerned. It is also to reject such a planet which happens to be 
both the significator of positive and negative houses, for example of marriage, the positive 
houses 2, 7 and 11, and also the significator of the negative houses 12 to 2 or 7 or 11, ie., 
1 or 6 or 10. If the dasa of such significator is running, in a few cases it may not give mar- 
riage; and so the next period alone may give marriage. So that method of selection of fruitful 
significators is always useful. 

Third Method 

11. The third method of selecting fruitful significators is to check each significator whether 
its sub lord is included in the list of the significators. If yes, such a planet can be selected 
as a fruitful significators or else dropped. 


General Rules 

12. Asa general rule, all those significators which signify 12th to the relevant houses under 
consideration should be rejected. The planet whose sub lord is the significator of the house 
negating the house concerned i.e. in the 12th to the house concerned should be rejected as 
an unfruitful significator. The planets which are in 6,8,12 to the concerned house are sup- 
posed not to contribute to 

the matters signified by such houses. Similarly any house which is in 6, 8 and 12 to any 
house are supposed to negate the matters governed by the house concerned. 

13. Preference should be given to Rahu or Ketu, if it represents any significator. A planet 
which appears many times amongst the significators/RPs or connected with various signifi- 
cators as their star or sign or as a sub lord should be selected as the strongest to give the 
result. Conversely a planet which is not in the sub lords of the concerned houses should be 
treated as the weakest in producing the 

result. 


Fixing the timing of event or selection of fruitful Dasa- Bhukti- Antara- Sookshma (DBAS) is 
the most difficult task even for experienced astrologers. In this regard there is no formula. It 
can be done by using the ruling planets or sub lords. 


The dasa is assumed to agree with transit when the joint dasa DBAS lords and luminaries, 
Sun and Moon, are transiting in the star and sub of these dasa lords or planets of significa- 
tors of required houses for the matter under study. 

Whether the DBA lords are favorable or unfavorable for the event under study as per their 
sub lords. 


Checking Transit 

The dasa is assumed to agree with transit when the joint dasa DBAS lords and luminary 
Sun and Moon are transiting in the star and sub of these dasa lords or planets of significa- 
tors of required houses for the matter under study.

US Midterm Elections 2018 


The 2018 United States midterm elections will be held mostly on Tuesday, November 6, 
2018. Americans will elect members for each of the 435 House seats and 35 of the 100 
Senate seats in Congress. Donald Trump and the Republicans are fighting to maintain their 
majority in both houses. The stakes are high because a Democrat victory in either chamber 
would grant powers to open investigations into President Trump. 






















































































“Analysis of the following mundane charts suggests that the Democrats have a good 
chance of taking either the House of Representatives or the Senate.” 

It seems the major theme of the midterm election astrology is change indicated by position 
of Uranus which is the planet of change and rebellion. There is also a strong focus on 
feminism as well as compassion.

oppose its natal position in the lst house. Transit Rahu will be conjunct his 12th (loss) 
cusp and align with Saturn and Venus in his 12th house. None of these hits suggest 
winning bigly. 


Nevertheless Jupiter is transiting over his 4th cusp and aspecting 10th cusp since October 
11, 2018, so that could be a saving grace.

signifies 6,8 connected to 3,4,6,9,11 which denotes that the elder sister of querent is 
suffering from sickness causing danger to life and querent is expecting recovery of her

the significator of 5 or 11 the decease is cured during the joint period of the significators of

RECOVERY FROM SICKNESS: The cuspal sublords of 5,11 cusps will tell the position

What K P Rules say on this issue—(see Reader No. 6 —page 313) 

Imprisonment implies separation from family, restriction on free movements, confinement 
within four walls, leaving one’s own permanent place of stay and life in the new 
environment. 

Separation from family is shown by the affliction of the 2"4 house. 

Restriction on the free movement and confinement in four walls by the 8t house. 

Away from a place of stay (4) by 3™4 house and 

New environment by 12th house. 

So the houses to be judged are 2-3-8 and 12. 

*Rahu is the karaka for jail. So analyze Rahu in relation with 126 house. 


i) K P Rule says 


A)IMPRISONMENT---if the 12 cusp sub lord (Rahu or connected with Rahu) signifies 2or 
Sor 8o0r 12 , one will be imprisoned. 


B)HOUSE DETENTION—12* sub lord connection with 4,8,12. 
C)RELEASE FROM JAIL—12*+ sub lord’s connection with 2-4-11 houses. 


D)GETTING A BAIL—12 th sub lord’s connection with 6,11 or 2-4-11. 
(see Navarathnamala part2-page 90). 


NOTE- Al the above Three conditions (viz:-A)Rahu or connection with Rahu with 12th 
house, B)Rahu’s signification of relevant houses, and C)12 th sub lord should be in the 
retro planet) should be satisfied simultaneously for imprisonment. 


ii) K P Rule and court case—(See KP Ezine OCT 2009) 

The tenth house stands for judgment. If the 10t* cusp sub lord signifies 2, 6,orl11 one 
could expect a fair judgment. 

However it is observed that if the 10 cusp sub lord happens to be Rahu or Ketu ora 
planet in retro motion, 

a fair judgment is out of the question.

if 44h cusp sub lord signifies 2-wins,11-gains 10-success, one would win the court case 


during the conjoined period of the significations of the 2,1O0and 11 houses.

Short Note 

The Soyuz MS-10 a manned spacecraft was launched from the Baikonur Cosmodrome in 
Kazakhstan (45n58; 63e18) to the International Space Station at 4:40 a.m. EDT (08:40 
GMT, 2:40 p.m. in Baikonur), Thursday, Oct. 11, 2018, carrying American NASA 
astronaut Nick Hague and Russian Roscosmos cosmonaut Alexey Ovchinin. MS-10 was 
the 139th flight of a Soyuz spacecraft. It was intended to transport two members of the 
Expedition 57 crew to the International Space Station. 

A few minutes after liftoff, the craft went into contingency abort due to a booster failure 
and had to return to Earth. Search and rescue teams were deployed to the landing site. 
Both Hague and Ovchinin were out of the capsule and were reported to be in good 
condition. They were transported to the Gagarin Cosmonaut Training Center in Star City, 
Russia outside of Moscow. 

The MS-10 flight abort was the first instance of a manned booster accident at high 
altitude in 43 years, since Soyuz 18a similarly failed to achieve orbit in April 1975

Answer 2: 
KP 2nd Marriage Rule 


1. If the sub lord of the 7th cusp or the star lord of the 7th CSL is situated in a dual sign or 
happens to be a dual planet, then 2nd marriage is promised. (KP Reader IV, pages 281-182) 


2. If the sub lord of the 2nd cusp is connected with 7th house, 2nd marriage, if connected 
with 11th house one will keep a keep as 7th house significator shows legal bondage whereas 
11th indicates attachment and friendship . (KP Reader IV, page 146) 


Rationale of 2nd house for 2nd marriage: The 2nd house being 8th from 7th house 
signifying the death' of first spouse (7th house) or the ‘end' of ‘7th house matters (marriage, 
partnership) is referred for the 2nd spouse; 9th house being 8th from 2nd is referred for 3rd 
Spouse and so on - - (to apply in the society of one husband- one wife system. (Kalidasa's 
Utara Kalamrita, translated by Dr. D.S. Sastri, 2001, page 107) 


Priyanka Chopra’s Chart 


Her 7th cuspal sub lord (CSL) Ve:2,1-6 is in the star of Ma:5,7-12, and in sub of Ve:2,1-6. Ve 
is in the dual sign of Gemini, so first rule for 2nd marriage is satisfied. 


Her 2nd CSL Su+t(3,5)/ Star Ju(6,8-9)/ Sub Ra(2), Me+(2,2-3), Ve(2,1-6), Ju(6,8-9), not 
signifying 7th house, so second rule for 2nd marriage is not satisfied, indicating low 
possibility of second marriage. 


Venus’s signification of 6th house 


Ve @ Gemini 03:03:28 is within 3:20 deg:min of 2nd cusp @ Gemini 05:05:59, it is taken as 
a significator of 2nd house according to the orb rule of a planet very closed to the next cusp. 


9th house for second marriage 

In taking 9th house for second marriage, second wife is assumed younger sister of 1st wife 
(3rd house from 7th) by marrying younger sister when elder sister passed away in old 
tradition. 


Question 3: Longevity

to be judged. Here I find a difficulty as to in some cases Ascendant shows good longevity 
and houses 3 & 8 shows maraka/badhaka houses alongwith favourablehouses. And in 
some cases it may be a reverse one. 

Under such circumstances how to arrive at the longevity span of a native. 

Would you kindly clarify the doubt?

tion appears among these three cuspal sub lords

This book review is very late for “K.P. & Astrology Year Book 2018” as I could buy this 
book only in last month when other two books were given priority. 


Among the articles in this book listed in the contents, if the Sub-Sub Theory is step 

ahead of the KP sub theory by further division of sub into sub-sub (page 15), the Sub-Sub 
-Sub theory could be further ahead of the Sub-Sub Theory without bein able to explain 
what is the rationale of sub-sub or sub-sub-sub. In the article “7. No marriage — Why?”, 
some no marriage rules are studied on three cases only. The article “20. KP analysis on 
tennis professional players” is a study of nine tennis players. Regarding gem stone remedy 
so-called based on KP (page 169), there is no remedy in KP astrology. “According to Guruji 
KSK, anyone, putting on the gems of the strongest significators of the beneficial houses is 
lucky. Only when luck is to be enjoyed shortly, he will or she will acquire this color; we 
attribute the luck to the gem. (KSK: How to Judge a Nativity, KP & Astrology Year Book 
1995, page 44-45) Truth is this: Acquisition of any Gem is indicated mostly by a benefic. 
So one acquires when the period of that planet operates. So, when you put the gem, that 
good period operates and so you enjoy and you attribute to the gem. (KP Reader VI, pages 
318-320)” That is, remedy itself is destined in KP. The old article “31. The greatest sage in 
our age — by Prof. K.S. Krishnamurti” is the verification case of the correctness of horo- 
scope of Sri Sankarachariar Swamigal Avargal (b. 20-5-1894) on 16-5-1964 by finding out 
whether “the ruling planets at the time of query are the ruling planets at the time of his 
birth”. In the article “38. Check whether one will be a good astrologer or not?” (pages 193- 
200), the horoscope of astrologer, this magazine editor Kanak Bosmia is checked by some 
KP rules for a successful astrologer.

Jupiter is not taken as anthara lord as Moon is deposited in its star. 
Next Saturn in 5 aspected by the ruling planet Mars in 2 lord of 11 is strong enough as 
anthara lord to conduct the marriage. 


Hence the event has to be fructified during the conjoint period of Jup-Mer-Sat if transit 
agrees. 


The conjoint period of Jup-Mer-Sat runs between 13-11-2015 to 23-3-2016. On 13-11- 
2015 the luminary Sun is in Libra sign visakha star. As Saturn is aspecting the dasa lord 
Jupiter there will be some delay in fructification of event. On 14-3-2016 Sun enters in 
purvabhadra star in Jupiter sign (the sensitive point in Pieces sign) on which date Moon is 
in Rohini star in Taurus sign. Moon should be moved to the area of bhukthi lord Mercury 
i.e. to Gemini sign in which Moon enters on 15-3-2016. 

That is day of fructification of event. I have informed my colleague that his daughter’s love 
affair will not fail and he has to perform their marriage without any escape. My colleague 
requested me on the day of marriage over the telephone to attend, that is, on 15-3-2016. 


Transit: 

The transit of DBA lords are as follows: 

Sun in Jupiter star (dasa lord), Moon in Mercury sign Gemini (bhukthi lord), Jupiter is in 
Venus star (5 significator), Mercury in Jupiter star (dasa lord), Saturn is in Mercury star 
(bhukthi lord). 

Thus the transit agrees. The peculiarity in this case is analysis done without rotation of the 
chart.

“No birth time is correct. It needs correction up to seconds, not minutes. Unless we arrive at 
the correct birth time chart, we will not be in a position to give correct readings on any 
matters”---Says Sri K N Rao, a famous astrologer. 


KN Rao, Editor of Astrology Journal defines Real Birth Time as- 

The real birth time we define here as the exact moment when the newborn's lungs first start 
to fill with air: The first breath. Then this new body starts to interact with our earth’s 
atmosphere, and never really stops breathing as long as it lives. This moment can be 
defined up to 1-second accuracy, and even up to fractions of a second. 


How Inaccurate is Your Birth Time? 
There are several indicators that can tell you how much your Known birth time information 
is off your real birth time. Check for the following indicators: 


Birth Time Information Sources are 

Mothers usually are a better source than fathers. A father, who had to wait so long for the 
blessed event, usually is too nervous to care about the exact birth time when the child 
arrives. 


Mothers with many children may confuse their various birth times. Such a birth time 
information would be completely wrong (up to 24 hours). 


An exception is parents who do care about astrology. Expect their time recording to be 
correct within plus/minus two minutes. Yet, even then faulty clocks have to be accounted 
for (plus/minus 5 minutes). 


Other relatives are usually not so very reliable regarding an exact birth time. 


Birth certificates are fairly accurate (within plus/minus 5 minutes) if the cultural tradition 
of your country at the time of your birth supported precision in such official recordings. 
Only a certified birth certificate or a certified copy of birth certificate is reliable. When you 
request your birth certificate, make sure to ask for your birth time specifically. 


In this context, I invite the kind attention of the readers to our KP Reader No.3 (pages 494 
to 507) wherein Sri KS Krishnamurthi garu has explained about the ways to correct the 
given birth time in detail. 


Mr. Tin Win in his foreword to the latest book on the birth time rectification-of Sri Kanak 
Bosmia-“Easy Way to learn KP Birth Time Rectification”-, has said “under these circum- 
stances (which are explained in earlier para) if only the birth time is doubtful, especially by 
the consultant himself or herself, the birth time rectification is being done with the help of 
the “Ruling Planets “ at the moment when you have an urge to solve the query, then 
mysteriously God will help you to select the astrological correct birth time.” (KP reader III 
page 281). 

Birth time rectification is a challenging task for any astrologer and here is the book by 
Sri Kank Ji, wherein he has systematically explained the rules and procedures to be 
followed for the rectification of birth time with innumerable examples.

Marriage and Punarphoo 
Wlarrlage and runarpnoo 


— =! 


By: Sumanadasa Namarathna (Sunaparantha Kalyan) 
Ex-Accountant, Justice of Peace 
No.22/1, Udugampola Road, Marapola, Veyangoda, 


SRI LANKA Email: sumanal946@gmail.com 














No need to mention more explanation for the meaning of the word "Punaphoo" , since all KP followers 
are aware of the idea of the Guruji Sri KSK, which was written in the 4th Reader as below. 
"Whenever Saturn has got any connection what so ever with Moon, there will be some obsta- 
cle or impediment, nor only during negotiation but also at the time of fixation and even at 
the time of the celebration of the marriage. This connection between Moon and Saturn caus- 
es delay, though ultimately both of them do much more good with a better partner.” 
Accordingly, when there is any connection between Moon and Saturn in a natal chart, most of KP 
Astrologers use to predict a delay marriage for the native. But according to my point of view with an 
experience of a decade, PP doesn't stand only for DELAY and hence predicting so always is not cor- 
rect and true. 

Why? 

I wish to take back you to early period of KPEZ, ie July 2007, and a part of contents of an article 
written by Sri Tin Win ji, is as below. 

"6.4. Some findings of the Punarphoo effects are the postponement of date of marriage, bro- 
ken engagement, marriage not materializing (Shri Raichur), mostly delay in marriage and 
other events like launching of space mission but promise not denied (Kanak), delayed (or ob- 
stacles to) marriage only in 18 (41%) charts out of 44 Punarphoo charts (Dr. Rangarajan 
Krishnamoorthy), affecting not only in marriage aspect, but each and every aspect of a man's 
life (Shri Vaikari Ramamurthy), and the cancellation theory not working in some Punarphoo 
cancelled cases in “Punarphoo” book and some other cases (Kanak and others.)" 

The essence of the above is Punarphoo is not effect only for the marriage. Anything under the PP, the 
matter gets Delay, Deny, Dejection & Disappointment. My article published in KPEZ , July 2011 
"Digging a well and Punarphoo Effect" is an example for DELAY effect. 

In the matter of marriage, I have failed many times by predicting delay marriage owing to Punarphoo, 
because some natives with PP dosha, have got married, while some are still unmarried. So there 
should be a reason for this double sided effects of Punarphoo. In this situation, I wanted to do a re- 
search to find out the exact reason for not having the marriage with the effects of Saturn and Moon. 
While I was collecting such PP charts and and their destine, a KP colleague, V.S.N. Murthy ji from 
India, urged me to this PP study by asking my remarks for the reasons for not having the delay mar- 
riage even in the time of DBAS, who signify the marriage. 

In this study I have used 18 PP charts contributed by my friend Murthy ji and some known cases of 
my country.

I would like to present an interesting article based on my KP research studies. My friend asked me 
about delivery date of his wife. Doctor had already informed the due date of 9 NOV 2018. He wanted 
to confirm the exact date & which date she will be getting admitted to hospital. 


In this horary chart, Moon represents the query about its nature. 
Moon 3 /1. Sign Virgo — Lord Mercury placed in 5‘. It looks like that they are caring about the deliv- 
ery as it’s also represents the 12th house. 5th CSL is also Mercury as query is about wife 


Venus is place in 4th house which says that is related to family planning as both husband and wife 
considered. 


Dasha lords areas follows: 
Moon Dasha is favourable to child birth, not an issue.

Answer- 1:

Question - 2: Use of Transit in KP 
How transit is used in KP? 


Answer -2: 

The cuspal sub lord of a house indicates whether the matter of the house is favorable 
(promised) or not. The significators point the time of event. Both dasa, bhukti and gochara 
(transit) must agree. 


Dasa is supposed to agree with transit when DBAS lords and luminaries Sun, Moon are 
transiting in the star and sub of DBAS lords, Sun and Moon or fruitful significators for the 
matter under consideration. In many cases the Sookshma lord is found transiting in the 
star or sub of Moon. 


In the Rangarajan Krishnamoorthy's computer analysis of 1005 (one thousand & five) TOB 
AA rated marriage charts collected by Kanak Bosmia, transit DBAS lords, Sun, Moon are 
found transiting in the star & sub of DBAS lords by 79% (Dasa lord), 76% (Bhukti lord), 
76% (Antara lord), 76% (Sookshma lord), 79% (Sun), and 80% (Moon) respectively on the 
date of marriage, in line with KP transit.

2. Only one horoscope rectified by Guruji K.S. Krishnamurti 

Perhaps the only article as far as we know is rectification of Smt. Indira Gandhi's chart in 
July 1971 issue of Astrology & Athrishta where he rectified the TOB and dealt at length with 
about a dozen of events in her past life being explained, how those events bore relation to the 
horoscope he had furnished. 


It is learned that rectification was done on 3 May 1971 at 13:08 IST at Delhi but it is not 
clearly known how he arrived at the rectified birth time although the RP-based BTR and 
Prenatal epoch theory were mentioned. 


Smt.m Indira Gandhi, according to the late Guruji KSK's rectified time, was born on the 19th 
November 1917 at Allahabad at 11-39 16 pm. At her birth, 3°-42' in Leo (Simha) was rising 
in the lagna. Moon was placed in Makara @ 5:51. Balance of Sun Dasa balance at birth: 1Y, 
10M, 12D. The calculated chart was provided in details. 


The Ascendant sub-lord and sub-sub-lord, Moon & Mars, do NOT appear as the Moon's star 
lord and sublord, Sun, Mercury, respectively. 


Asc Le 3:42 (Sun-Ket-Moo-Mar) (Sgl-Stl-Sbl- Ssl) 
Moon Cp 5:51 (Sat-Sun-Mer-Moo) 


3. A lady of iron-courage up-to her death 
In her birth chart Mars (courage) and 3rd (courage) house lord Mercury are aspected by 
Jupiter (planet of growth/ expansion). Mars is also aspecting 3rd lord Mercury. 


Moreover one out of three exchange of house relationships ( Parivarthana) is Sun (power)- 
Mars (courage) connection as "importance of courage". (S. Tompkins: Aspects in astrology: A 
Comprehensive Guide To Interpretation: Element Books Ltd., UK, 1989, pp.101-2) Sun (2nd 
lord) and Mars (5th & 10th lord) in relationship also gives rise to wealth and clearly

I have found the technique of composite charts, as mention in this article, to be a more 
reliable new astrological technique in KP system. Generally this system used in western 
system. New astrological methods are constantly being developed and promoted by their 
discoverers, but no other method of relation checking like marriage matching, father-son 
relation, business partner relations, two country's relations etc by composite chart system. 
By using composite charts, we can predict very imaging result about relations, then any 
other system now used by KP community. 


The composite chart gives accurate indication with relationships in a new way. This method 
takes into account the fact that a relationship of any kind like marriage matching, father-son 
relation, business partner relations, and two country's relations is not simply two or more 
people or country or organization together. If two people or countries or organizations, 
involved with each other in some way, we can judge its relations by composite chart. 


When I first try with composite charts I was not satisfied and having many doubts. My main 
doubt is why two chart composite gives result, when there is no much sense to get midpoint 
of two charts. Later when I check many charts with various kind of relations I was wondering 
how this composite chart as per KP System developed by me, gives me accurate and amazing 
result. I have introduced this technique of creating multiple composites, as per KP first time 
to the KP community. The KP relationship method of composite chart is some complex, but I 
will try to introduce it in this article in a simplified way. 


People who are familiar with mathematics will understand what I am mention in this article. 
Before someone start criticism on this article let me say, the only test is to try out a KP 
relationship method of composite chart (KPCC) and then criticize with valid proof of tested 
examples not copy of old pages. 


This article is in two parts. In first part, a complete details of the math's aspects of creating a 
composite horoscope. The second part of the article is how to read the composite chart. 

More experienced KP astrologers will find it very easy to follow KP relationship method of 
composite chart (KPCC). 


Part 1: Casting the Chart 
The composite horoscope is created by calculating the midpoint between pairs of planets and 
twelve bhava of the two natal horoscopes, Sun of one and the Sun of the other, Moon of one 
and the Moon of the other, like this all nine planets and twelve bhavas. The composite Sun is 
the midpoint of the two Suns; the composite Moon is the midpoint of the two Moons; and so 
on for all the other planets. 


In all horoscope, Sun, Venus and Mercury are generally together, and are always in 
approximately the same bhava or one bhava before and after. In the composite chart, we 
found some wonder as a Sun-Mercury opposition or a Venus-Mercury opposition, which are 
clearly impossible in an ordinary chart. 


Part 2: Checking the Chart 


After calculating the midpoints of cusps and planets, find out relevant sub lord and check 
occupants and ownership in individual chart; if it is positive then matching good.

(An analysis of the “accident by a fall” of a native through her natal chart unveils the secrets 
of the destiny of stars by our famous KP SYSTEM OF ASTROLOGY.) 


Every human body is prone to some disease /health problem of various nature. The types of 
health hazards depend upon one’s Karma i.e. one’s past deeds in the previous births. Hindus 
believe in the laws of Karma and its effects are attributed to diseases, from the time imme- 
morial depending on whether the karmic effect is Prarabdha or Sanchitha. 


This is explained very nicely in his “Autobiography of a Yogi “ by Sri Paramhansa Yogananda. 
Sri Paramahansa Yogananda, one of the first Eastern spiritual masters, wrote a beautiful 
and inspiring book entitled “Autobiography of a Yogi” , in which we find the following quota- 
tion: “ Fate, karma, destiny—call it what you will—there is a law of justice which somehow, 
but not by chance, determines our race, our physical structure and some of our mental and 
emotional traits....... ” 


He further comments on astrology and the scope of its relevance and therefore worth consid- 
ering: “A child is born on that day and at that hour when the celestial rays are in mathemati- 
cal harmony with his individual karma. His horoscope is a challenging portrait, revealing his 
unalterable past and its probable future results. But the natal chart can rightly be interpret- 
ed only by men of intuitive wisdom, these are few...... ”And he further discusses his chart and 
some periods in it.” 


From the above lines it becomes evident that as per our Indian philosophy, the laws of Kar- 
ma theory tell us “You get what you want—eventually”. But, of course, we may not under- 
stand the ramifications of our desires until we experience them. 


Here is the chart of a lady who experienced same shades of “cause and effect of her karma” 
in the form of a recent accident due to a simple fall during her walk in her own house. With 
this background, I would be discussing a natal chart of a lady (my own sister) who experi- 
enced a severe accident due to a simple fall and fractured her disc bone. 


WHAT IS A SLIP AND FALL ACCIDENT 

Victims of Slip And Fall Accidents often suffer broken or fractured bones, including hip 
bones. Hip fractures are a serious issue that often requires weeks or months of medical 
treatment and rehabilitation. Many of these slip and falls are a result of hazardous walking 
surfaces, such as wet, slippery walkways; poorly lit walkways; or cluttered walkways. 
(“Common Hazardous Conditions That Cause Slip And Fall Accidents“). When property own- 
ers fail to tend to these dangerous walking conditions, it can lead to slips, trips, and falls 
that end in serious injuries, such as a broken hip. 


Broken or Fractured Hip Caused By A Slip And Fall Accident 

Hip fractures or breaks are serious injuries and can be especially difficult for those over the 
age of 65 to endure. In fact, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention offers some ra- 
ther astounding statistics related to broken hips: 


e More than 95 per cent of broken hips is caused by falls (usually sideways falls). 
e More than 300,000 people over age 65 are hospitalized for hip fractures each year. 
e Three-quarters of all hip fractures occur in women —- who fall more often than men and

The Effects of a Broken Hip 

A broken hip comes with numerous health risks — even for young, healthy adults. The hip 
joint plays a naturally pivotal role in your ability to walk and move, so a break can be 
immobilizing. Such fractures usually require surgical repair and sometimes a partial or full 
hip replacement. A broken hip often comes with several serious complications: 


Decreased independence 
Complications with long-term mobility 
Weakened bones and joints 

Decreased lifespan for older sufferers

Sports Astrology 

The Inclusive Methodology of Game Analysis 
by Dr. Ravi Rao 

Star Publication House, 2017, 213 pages 





Sports Astrology: The inclusive Methodology of Game Analysis is a guide that explains how to 
expand the scope of traditional astrology and how to apply it to the unique requirement of 
sports events. It assimilates the many impacting factors, and the significations that mark 
sports events into the traditional principles of astrology. 


The book analyses the three factors that determine sports predications. It assigns points to 
each parameter and arrives at an astrological score that brings accuracy to predictions. 

. © Game analysis treats the match as the point of action and tells you how to determine the 
starting time, ascendants of each team, and the significations of each house. 

e Nations’ charts take into a count the influence of Moon and ascendant of the nation or 
fraancisee on the match outcome. Nations; charts are available in a Nations Probhecy: 
inclusive Methodology of Mundane Astrology. 

e Planetary influence account for factors like the captains; jersey number and the team’s 
jersey colour in relation to the day and date of match. 


The book offers case studies of three types of cricket matches — World Cup, T20, and IPL — to 
show the methodology at work. The 21 case studies include matches that take place on 
consecutive days because of which there is little or no change of planetary positions in the 
game chart, and yet the methodology helps you predict the outcome with accuracy. 


Sports Astrology would be helpful would be helpful for astrologers to expand their thought 


towards the multiple determining factors that impact an event, guiding them towards 
accuracy in mundane predictions.

Part 1: Casting the Chart 
The composite horoscope is created by calculating the midpoint between pairs of planets and 
twelve bhava of the two natal horoscopes, Sun of one and the Sun of the other, Moon of one 
and the Moon of the other, like this all nine planets and twelve bhavas. The composite Sun is 
the midpoint of the two Suns; the composite Moon is the midpoint of the two Moons; and so 
on for all the other planets. 


In all horoscope, Sun, Venus and Mercury are generally together, and are always in 
approximately the same bhava or one bhava before and after. In the composite chart, we 
found some wonder as a Sun-Mercury opposition or a Venus-Mercury opposition, which are 
clearly impossible in an ordinary chart. 


Part 2: Checking the Chart 


After calculating the midpoints of cusps and planets, find out relevant sub lord and check 
occupants and ownership in individual chart; if it is positive then matching good.

(An analysis of the “accident by a fall” of a native through her natal chart unveils the secrets 
of the destiny of stars by our famous KP SYSTEM OF ASTROLOGY.) 


Every human body is prone to some disease /health problem of various nature. The types of 
health hazards depend upon one’s Karma i.e. one’s past deeds in the previous births. Hindus 
believe in the laws of Karma and its effects are attributed to diseases, from the time imme- 
morial depending on whether the karmic effect is Prarabdha or Sanchitha. 


This is explained very nicely in his “Autobiography of a Yogi “ by Sri Paramhansa Yogananda. 
Sri Paramahansa Yogananda, one of the first Eastern spiritual masters, wrote a beautiful 
and inspiring book entitled “Autobiography of a Yogi” , in which we find the following quota- 
tion: “ Fate, karma, destiny—call it what you will—there is a law of justice which somehow, 
but not by chance, determines our race, our physical structure and some of our mental and 
emotional traits....... ” 


He further comments on astrology and the scope of its relevance and therefore worth consid- 
ering: “A child is born on that day and at that hour when the celestial rays are in mathemati- 
cal harmony with his individual karma. His horoscope is a challenging portrait, revealing his 
unalterable past and its probable future results. But the natal chart can rightly be interpret- 
ed only by men of intuitive wisdom, these are few...... ”And he further discusses his chart and 
some periods in it.” 


From the above lines it becomes evident that as per our Indian philosophy, the laws of Kar- 
ma theory tell us “You get what you want—eventually”. But, of course, we may not under- 
stand the ramifications of our desires until we experience them. 


Here is the chart of a lady who experienced same shades of “cause and effect of her karma” 
in the form of a recent accident due to a simple fall during her walk in her own house. With 
this background, I would be discussing a natal chart of a lady (my own sister) who experi- 
enced a severe accident due to a simple fall and fractured her disc bone. 


WHAT IS A SLIP AND FALL ACCIDENT 

Victims of Slip And Fall Accidents often suffer broken or fractured bones, including hip 
bones. Hip fractures are a serious issue that often requires weeks or months of medical 
treatment and rehabilitation. Many of these slip and falls are a result of hazardous walking 
surfaces, such as wet, slippery walkways; poorly lit walkways; or cluttered walkways. 
(“Common Hazardous Conditions That Cause Slip And Fall Accidents“). When property own- 
ers fail to tend to these dangerous walking conditions, it can lead to slips, trips, and falls 
that end in serious injuries, such as a broken hip. 


Broken or Fractured Hip Caused By A Slip And Fall Accident 

Hip fractures or breaks are serious injuries and can be especially difficult for those over the 
age of 65 to endure. In fact, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention offers some ra- 
ther astounding statistics related to broken hips: 


e More than 95 per cent of broken hips is caused by falls (usually sideways falls). 
e More than 300,000 people over age 65 are hospitalized for hip fractures each year.

Question 2: No Marrige 

In the birth chart of a girl, 18-12-1993, 10-30-07 IST, 19NO6, 72E51, late marriage is indicated ac- 
cording to the 7th cuspal sub lord signification and strong Punarphoo Dosha. 

But the current running Dasa Jupiter(upto 29th April 2030) is not at all signifying either 2 or 7 or 11 
but 10, 9, 6, and 12 are signified by the Dasa lord Jupiter. 


The 7th cuspal sub lord is giving green signal for performing marriage of this native but the concerned 
dasa lord Jupiter is not at all giving green signal to perform the marriage of this girl. 

Moreover all the following rules for aversion to marriage are completely satisfied except the last one 9th 
rule. So it denotes that this native dislikes marriage. 


1) Jupiter is a significator for 10th, 

2) 7th CSL Moon is signifying 10th along with 2-7-11. 

3) 11th CSL Saturn is the occupant and the lord of 1st house. 10t4 is also aspected by Saturn. 

4) Ketu is in the sign of Venus and also in the sub of Venus. 

5) Ketu signifies 4 & 10; Venus signifies 1-4-6-10; (See the effective signification table & 6 fold signifi- 
cation table) 

6) Venus is aspected by Saturn with 10t* special aspect. 

7) 34 Cuspal Sublord Moon is well connected with Saturn. Both of them are placed in Aquarius in 
same degrees.(Moon is in 02-10-02 and Saturn is in 02-06-09; Saturn/Mars/Ketu as corulers. 

8) 12th CSL Mercury is not at all signifying 7 or 8. 

9) Saturn-Moon-Sun are the Lagna cusp co-rulers. Saturn signifies 2 & 11; Moon signifies 11 & 7; 
Sun signifies 11 & 8. (The 9th rule is no connection/ signification/ pac of 2,5,7,8 or 11 to the la- 
ena bhava. 

Please give your view on my analysis.

Sports Astrology: The inclusive Methodology of Game Analysis is a guide that explains how to 
expand the scope of traditional astrology and how to apply it to the unique requirement of 
sports events. It assimilates the many impacting factors, and the significations that mark 
sports events into the traditional principles of astrology.

each parameter and arrives at an astrological score that brings accuracy to predictions. 

. © Game analysis treats the match as the point of action and tells you how to determine the 
starting time, ascendants of each team, and the significations of each house. 

e Nations’ charts take into a count the influence of Moon and ascendant of the nation or 
fraancisee on the match outcome. Nations; charts are available in a Nations Probhecy: 
inclusive Methodology of Mundane Astrology. 

e Planetary influence account for factors like the captains; jersey number and the team’s 
jersey colour in relation to the day and date of match. 


The book offers case studies of three types of cricket matches — World Cup, T20, and IPL — to 
show the methodology at work. The 21 case studies include matches that take place on 
consecutive days because of which there is little or no change of planetary positions in the 
game chart, and yet the methodology helps you predict the outcome with accuracy. 


Sports Astrology would be helpful would be helpful for astrologers to expand their thought 


towards the multiple determining factors that impact an event, guiding them towards 
accuracy in mundane predictions.

The lady under discuss, who is a mother for two kids, went abroad for a job in 2013 
December when Sun MD and Jupiter Bukthi were in operation. Her husband was an 
energetic Mechanical Engineer specialized in Motor Cycle repairing and also a heart patient. 
He had to under go for several surgical operations of the heart and was implanted an 
artificial Heart. He died on 24.09.2018 by heart failure. As the parents of him are not still in 
a good mentality to contact and collect the birth detail and his medical history, I just 
checked his wife's chart and it is marvelous to see the reflection not only the death of the 
husband but every life events of husband in all manners also. I think the better way of 
proceeding the case is to examine her own chart for her life events, before see through her 
chart for her husband. 


Birth Detail 

Name: Nayana, Gender: Male, Date: Tuesday, 17/Apr/1979, Time: 02:45:00 AM SID: 
16:12:40, Place: Gampaha Dist. Gen. Hospital, Western, Sri Lanka, Lat: 07:05:00 N Lon:

(a) Basic Foreign Going Rule 

1. One can go foreign only if the sub lord of the 12th cusp is connected in any manner with 
house 3 (change of residence) or 9 (long distance travel) or 12 (life in an altogether new 
environment and separation from family), preferably house 9 during the DBA signifying 
3,9,12 when transit agrees. 

Reference : "A Planet or House connected with"- Chandrakant R. Bhatt: NAKSHATRA 
CHINTAMANI, pg 21 


Analysis (a) 

The 12th sub lord is Mercury the lord of 5 & 8 in 2, in the star of Saturn the lord of 12 & 1 in 
7. Also this Mercury is connected with the cusps 3, 9 & 12 by being the sub lord of the same 
and aspects 9th cusp. Thus the above rule is satisfied for her to go aboard. 


(b) Getting Passport and Visa Rule 

2. If 3rd and 11th cusp sub lords signify 3, 9, 11, 12, one can get passport, visa, green card 
or permanent resident card to go foreign during the DBA signifying 3,9,11,12. 

Reference: 

1) KP Reader VI pp 320-1; 

2) Chandrakant R. Bhatt: Further Lights on Nakshatra Chintamani pp 86, 95) 


Analysis (b) 

1) The 3rd cuspal Sub lord is Mercury the lord of 5 & 8 in 2 is in the star of Saturn the lord 
of 12 & 1 in 7. Also this Mercury is connected with the cusps 3, 9 & 12 by being the sub 
lord of those cusps and aspects 9th cusp. Mercury is aspected by Jupiter the lord of 11. 

2) The sub lord of 11th cusp is Jupiter. It is the lord of 11 & 2 and in 6 and in the star of 
Kethu in Ascendant. Kethu is aspected by Saturn the lord of 12. Kethu is an agent for 
Venus that is a significator of 9 & 11. 

Thus the above rule is satisfied for her to obtain Passport and Visa.

(d) Separation from the family 
If a person is going aboard or living another place for a long period of time, it is a separation 
from the family. Whether the person is married or not, he has to leave his/her parents and 
family members. If the person is married and having children he has to leave the spouse and 
children, parents and kith and kin. It is called Separation. 
Note: The word "Separation" stands for several definitions as below. 
1. The act or process of separating : the state of being separated 
2.a. A point, line, or means of division 

b. an intervening space : GAP 
3. a. Cessation of cohabitation between a married couple by mutual agreement or judicial 
decree 

b. Termination of a contractual relationship (such as employment or military service) 
As in above 3.b. the rule of Separation is to be applied in this regard.

Birth time of the Apple Company (symbol AAPL) is generally derived from the beginning of the trading 
hours of the New York Stock Exchange (NASDAQ), where the shares were publicly listed, i.e. 10 AM, 5 
hrs west, New York, NY, 40N22, 74WOO. 


But another view is that the time of birth has to be modified for the time zone where the company is 
located, and for the place of birth, one should use the head quarter of company and not the location of 
stock exchange, i.e. 7 AM, 8hrs west, San Francisco, California, 37N48, 122W25. 


Both horoscopes for birth places of New York and San Francisco are studied, and the horoscope for 
birth place of San Francisco, the head quarter of company, seems more appropriate in this case.

General guidelines for Marriage- matching. 

DINA PORUTAM:- Count the constellation of the boy from that of the girl and divide by 9. If 
the remainder is (1) death, (2) Love and affection, (3) distress and difficulties (AAPADALU), (4) 
Happiness (Soukhyam), (5) Peeda (bad), (6) gain of cattles (Pasulabham), (7) diseases(roga 
prapthi), (8) Praja vriddhi(Happiness of the progeny= Santana soukhyam), (0) Severe enimity 
(Satru vriddhi). 

Girl’s constellation is Swaathi-1. Boy’s Constellation is Revathi-2. Swathi to Revathi is 13. If 
we divide it by 9, we will get 4 as remainder. So it indicates Happiness (Soukhyam) = good as 
said above. Marks=01 


Gana porutam:- Girl’s is Deva gana. Boy’s is Deva gana. So it is good.Marks=01. 


Mahendera porutam:- The constellation of the boy counted from that of the girl should be the 
Ath, 7th, 10th, 13th, 16th, 19th, 22nd, 25th, Mahendra porutam will bring harmony and also en- 
hance longevity. 

From Swathi to Revthiis 13. As 13 is seen in the above porutam, there is mahendra porutam 
in this matching is good. Marks=0O1. 


Stree deergha porutam:- If the boys star counted from the girl’s exceeds 15t, there is stree 
deergha porutam between them which is considered highly beneficial. Some authorities hold 
that for a count of 13 and above, there is stree deergha porutam. Some also believe that the 
boy’s star should preferably by beyond the 9 from that of the girl. According to some au- 
thorities, the distance should be more than 7 constellations. 

In this case, the boy’s star counted from the girl’s (from Swathi to Revthi) is 13. It is 
good.Marks=01. 


Yoni porutam:- Yoni means sex. Yonikuta implies SEXUAL COMPATABILITY. The following 
pairs are hostile and in matching yonis they should be avoided. 

Cow and tiger; elephant and lion; horse and buffalo; dog and hare; serpent and mongoose; 
monkey and goat; cat and rat. 

In this case, Swathi is He-buffalo and Revathi is Elephant. He-buffalo and Elephant is not 
given in the above list. In my opinion it will be good. Marks=01) 


Rasi porutam:- For marriage a male born in the 7, 10th, 11%, or 8th, 9th, and 12th signs from 
janma rasi of the girl is considered auspicious. If both male and female are born in one and 
same rasi but have different stars, the alliance is considered auspicious. For example, if the 
girl is born in Pubba star and boy is born in Makha star, they are born in the one and the 
same rasi, namely Leo and marriage between them is considered auspicious. 

If the boy’s rasi is 2"4 from the girl’s, the girl may become a widow or the boy a widower. 

If the boy’s rasi is 3™ from the girl’s, unhappy married life will be the result. 

If the boy’s rasi is 44 form the girl’s, frequent quarrels will result. 

If the boy’s rasi is 5 from the girls, she is likely to become a widow. 

If the boy’s rasi is 6 from the girl’s, diseases and loss of children are the result.

Graha Maitram:- It determines the physical disposition of the couple. 
Boy’s rasyadhipathi is Jupiter. Girl’s rasyadhipathi is Venus. Venus is an enemy for Jupiter 
and Jupiter is neutral for Venus. So it is not so good.(Marks 1/2) 


Rajju Porutam:- It is an important porutham in matching the horoscopes. 

Pada rajju:- Aswani, Aslesha, Makha,Jyestha, Moola, Revathi. 

Kati rajju:- Bharani, Pushyami, Pubba,Anuradha, Purvashadha, Uttarabhadra.

Question 1: Direction and locality of the partner 

1) These lines are of Sri KSK sir. I'm unable to understand the first line of it, i.e. "If the sub 
occupied by the significator owns the house 4 or 10." 

I would be very grateful to you if you enlighten my path. 


If the sub occupied by the significator owns the house 4 or 10, the partner may be a co- 
tenant or live in-one's street. town or district. 

If the lord owns the 3rd house, the partner may be living a short distance. 

If it owns 9, from long distance. 

Reference:KP Reader 4 pg 85 2002 10th Edition 


2) The below is a quoted from KP Reader 4, page 85, 10th Edition 2002. 

//Direction and Locality of the partner: 

If the lord of the sub or the sub occupied by the significator owns the house 4 or 10, the 
partner may be a co-tenant................. // 


It is impossible me to understand the above wordings. Can you kindly explain this rule with 
an example please. 


Answer 1: 

If the 7 cuspal sub lord is related with house 4, the partner may be a co-tenant; house 10 
(opposite to house 4) the partner may be a person who lives in-one's street, town or district 
etc. After marriage it does not involve a journey to reach husband’s place. 


If the 7 CSL is related with house 11, the partner may be from a friend’s family; house 5, it 
may be love marriage; and house 9 the partner may be a stranger, foreigner or someone from 
long distance. 


Question 2: : Fully signify 
What are the conditions to know how a planet FULLY SIGNIFY a House or Houses 
Request your help sir. 


Answer 2 

This term “FULLY SIGNIFY “ usually used by K.M. Subramanium, the author of the Astrose- 
crets & Krishnamurti Padhadhti Part I and Sub Lord Speaks 1,2,3 and articles for KP stu- 
dents only. 


A planet fully signifies 10th house if it is either in 10 in its own star or owning 10th house 
without any planet in the 10% and at the same time having no planet in its stars or situated 
in the star of a planet in 10% house. 

Question 3: 11 Cuspal Sub Lord for fulfillment of desire 

In KPezine Dec 2016, page no. 9, Sir Gunti Nagaraju says..... 

"First let me check whether the event is promised—if the 11th cusp sub lord signifies 11th or 


any one of the relevant houses of the matter in question, the event is promised". 


But on page 4, under the article of Sri Kanak sir says.... 
"My opinion: The 5th sub lord indicates higher study abroad. But the 11th (fulfill of desire) 


KP Ezine February 2019 72 


does not signify 9 (higher study). On the contrary, it indicates the 8th. Thus, I don’t think 
you will get admission in a program or college as per your choice. You will have to compro- 
mise." 


Now my confusion is what is the rule of 11th CSL for fulfillment of desire. Which house 
should be signified by 118 CSL, main house or any supporting house? 
I request you to clarify the above for our knowledge. 


Answer 3: 
Depending on a matter under study, for fulfillment of desire the 11t* CSL should signify 
house 9 for higher study, house 7 for marriage, house 5 for getting a child, etc. 


Question 4: Cuspal Sub Lords and their impact on dasa effects 
ASTROSECRETS Part III , Second Edn 2005 - 06 
Page 32 says: 


“Suppose, again , Jupiter is in the star of a planet in 11th and ........... and 11th cusp is 
found to signify 8th and 12th houses. “ 

1) Iassume 11th cusp sig means = 11th Cusp sub lord sig 8 & 12. 

2) My confusion is for the line 


“in this period of the Jupiter , a 11th house Significator ? “ 
will the period include = 11th H Cu SuL planet’s period 
+ 11th H Significator planets periods 
OR only 11thcsl period. 


I sincerely request your expert advice on this sir. 


Answer 4: 

This query is related to the article by Sri K.M. Subramanium who propagates the role of sub 
lord in “Sub Lord Speaks (articles) 1,2,3”. Since Jupiter is in the star of a planet in house 
11, Jupiter is the 11 significator. But the 11t* cuspal sub lord is found to signify unfavora- 
ble houses 8 and 12. So it is said during Jupiter Dasa, Jupiter is limited power to offer the 
beneficial matters of the 11t because of the 11t CSL’s negative impact on Dasa lord Jupiter. 
This is Sri K.M. Subramanium’s opinion. 


Question 5: 

I was going through the article on longevity of a child, pg. 64 in the book Nakshatra Chin- 
tamani by Sri. C.R. Bhatt, wherein the longevity was assessed to be short for about 3 
months. On arriving at the significators of Asc Cuspal Sub lord i.e. Ketu signifying houses 
as under — 


I) Ketu (9) conjoined with Sat (9,5-6) representing Merc (12,1-10) Star lord Rahu (3) aspected 
by Sat (9,5-6) representing Jup(4,4-7) and Sub Lord Jup (4,4-7) - Hence Ketu signifying 
houses 3,9,5,6,4,7 and connected with 9,5,6,1,10,12,4,7 i.e. 7(m+b) 6,12 along with posi- 
tive houses 1-3-5-9-10 indicating span should be of middle level. indicating 

2) 8th CSL Rahu sigifying9,5,6,12,1,10 and connected with 3,9,5,6,4,7 i.e. 7(m+b),6,12 
alongwith positive houses 3,5,9,10 indicating middle level of longevity. 

Likewise 3rd CSL Venus indicates middle level. 


In the same book under article ‘attempt to commit suicide’ pg 70 the longevity assessed to be 
long but on arriving at the significators of Ascendant sub lord - middle level, 3rd CSL indi- 
cates - short and 8th CSL - short. However the analysis was made and the native survived 
the attempt. 


SO REFERRING TO SUCH ARTICLES AND ANALYSIS, IT BECOMES A TOTAL CONFUSION 
AS TO HOW TO ARRIVE AT THE CORRECT JUDGEMENT ON THE SUBJECT LONGEVITY, 


KP Ezine February 2019 73 


FOR A STUDENT LIKE ME. 
Would you please be kind enough to give your guidance on the issue in detail. 


Answer 5: 
For longevity the Ascendant or 1+t (self) cuspal sub lord is mainly to be considered. 


Longevity may be short by the lst CSL connection to death inflicting Badhaka (11th house 
for moving, 9th for fixed and 7th for common sign Ascendants), Maraka (2,7 houses) and 
6,8,12 houses, without getting help from lifegiver 1,5,11 house signification. With more 
lifegiver houses and less death inflicting houses, longevity may be medium or long. 


If the 1st CSL signification includes Bhadaka, Maraka, house 8 and is connected with Mars 
or Rahu, the 8 CSL should be checked further for possible accidental death. 


Question 6: 4 fold significators table 

For marriage, we take significators of 2,7,11 from the list of 4 fold. 

But many a times a planet, which is not in the list of significators, appears in D/B/A, 

By aspect/conjunction it begins to show significance for marriage. 

My question is should we rely upon on sw made significators or take out manually so that we 
can check aspect/conjunction of a planet. 

Please help me out. 


Answer 6: 

Usually We rely KP SW made significators of rank A,B,C & D for the planet and star levels, 
and the sub level signification is also considered. The weak significators of rank E by aspect/ 
conjunction of a planet can be considered as the last resort only when necessary.

Judgment of this case will come in favoure of

(‘EERE ERERHEEREREREREREEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE EE & 


Question. India moved the ICJ in May in 2017 against the "farcical trial" by the military 
court of Pakistan against 48-year-old Jadhav. I am curious to know judgment of this case 
will come in favoure of Kulbhushan jadhav during summer of 2019? 

Number. 109 (out of 249). 

Time of Judgment: 21-02-2019, Thursday; Date of Judgment: 11:23:59 AM IST 

Place of Judgment. Kankariya-Ahmedabad Long/Lat: 23° N 00', 72° E 36’. 

Aynamsha 24°.02’.03” Dasa days: 365.25 


Note: The International Court of Justice began on Monday a four-day public hearing in the 
case of Indian national Kulbhushan Jadhav sentenced to death by a Pakistani military court 
on charges of espionage. 


India moved the ICJ in May in 2017 against the "farcical trial" by the military court of Paki- 
stan against 48-year-old Jadhav. 


Jadhav, a retired Indian Navy officer, was sentenced to death by a Pakistani military court on 
charges of espionage and terrorism in April 2017. 


India first approached the ICJ on May 8, 2017 for the "egregious violation" of the provisions 
of the Vienna Convention on Consular Relations, 1963 by Pakistan by repeatedly denying it 
consular access to Jadhav. 


A 10-member bench of the ICJ, which was set up after World War II to resolve international 
disputes, on May 18, 2017 had restrained Pakistan from executing Jadhav till adjudication 
of the case. 


The ICJ has set a timetable for the public hearing in the high-profile case from Febraury 18 
to 21 at the Peace Palace in The Hague, the Netherlands. 


While India will argue first on February 18, Pakistan will get its chance to make submissions 
on February 19. Then India will reply on February 20 while Islamabad will make its closing 
submissions on February 21. 


It is expected that the ICJ's decision may be delivered by the summer of 2019. 


While maintaining that India remains committed to make all possible efforts to secure and 
protect the rights of Jadhav, the spokesperson of the Ministry of External Affairs Raveesh 
Kumar did not make public New Delhi would take at The Hague. 


"India will present its case before the court. Since the matter is sub judice it is not appropri- 
ate for me to state our position in public. Whatever we have to do, we will do at the court," 
Kumar said last week in New Delhi in response to a question. 


Pakistan's Attorney General Anwar Mansoor would lead the Pakistani delegation at the ICJ 
while Director General South Asia Mohammad Faisal would lead the Foreign Office side.

Ahead of the hearing, a senior Pakistani official said that his country is committed to imple- 
ment the decision of the ICJ in the Jadhav case. 


"We are fully prepared with our strongest evidence being the valid Indian passport recovered 
from Commander Jadhav with a Muslim name," the official said. 


Both India and Pakistan have already submitted their detailed pleas and responses in the 
world court. 


Pakistan claims that its security forces arrested Jadhav from restive Balochistan province on 
March 3, 2016 after he reportedly entered from Iran. 


However, India maintains that Jadhav was kidnapped from Iran where he had business in- 
terests after retiring from the Navy. Jadhav's sentencing had evoked a sharp reaction in In- 
dia. 


Pakistan had rejected India's plea for consular access to Jadhav at the ICJ, claiming that 
New Delhi wants the access to get the information gathered by its "spy". 


However, Pakistan facilitated a meeting of Jadhav with his mother and wife in Islamabad on 
December 25, 2017. 


The hearings at the ICJ is taking place four days after one of the worst terror attacks in Jam- 
mu and Kashmir that killed 41 CRPF soldiers. The terror attack happened when a suicide 
bomber of Pakistan-backed Jaish-e-Mohammad (JeM) blew up an explosive-laden vehicle 
near a convoy of CRPF buses in Pulwama district on Thursday.
