NOTE- 
1) In the natal or horary charts the occupant or owner (if there be no occupant of the 11t 
house, it indicates early or delayed fulfilment of desire) and 


2) In the “Ruling Planets” methods, the sub lord of the Lagna indicates an early or latest 
event. 


3) If the occupant or the owner of the 11t8 house or the sub lord of the Lagna be a 
fast-moving planet, the event will take place earlier, and if that be a slow-moving planet, then 
the fulfilment of desire will get delayed and it will take a long time. Thus we have to judge. 
(see page 72 of the book-KP & RP by Sri Hariharan).

At the end of the last year my good health was diminished little by little and on the 31 Dec. 
2018 I was badly sick with fever, cough, and head ache. Next morning the New Year Sun was 
to be dawned in the east bringing another prosperous and happy new year for the whole 
world. As a traditional practice most of our countrymen are refraining from taking any medi- 
cine on such an auspicious day and therefore my wife wanted me to take me to the family 
doctor on the 31st evening. I could consult the doctor at about 7.00 pm and he found that I 
had been attacked by a Virus and prescribed to take antibiotic drugs for three days. 

Author Time Chart O1 - (First Consulatation) Moon aspects Saturn. Punarpoo yoga is 
established. 

But even in the 4th day I was not with a good physical condition and felt with Insomnia, mild 
loosing of memory, High Blood Pressure and Depression and again I consulted the same 
doctor and went under treatments for another one week time as his advices. But I was not 
enough lucky to get cure from any of the above feelings with that medicines and was serious- 
ly sick with several sleepless nights and went by my day to day activities too. All my family 
members were afraid of my changes of normal behavior and decided to take me to a special- 
ist. 

On the 16th Jan. at about 7.00 am I consulted a Visiting Physician and there he found that I 
was attacked by a series harmful virus, which causes damages in the brain cells as well as 
nervous system and said that loosing of memory with insomnia is critical and advised to un- 
dergo a MRI scan of the brain. 

Author Time Chart O02 - (Second Consultation) Moon is in the sub of Saturn. Punarpoo 
yoga is established. 

An arrangement and appointment had been made to under go for a MRI Scan at a leading 
private hospital in the area. The appointment was at 8 am on the 22nd Jan. 2019. On pre- 
sent of the Scanning Room at the given time, they needed me to be prepared with fasting for 
4 hours which was not intimated on the date of making the appointment. At that time I had 
taken my breakfast and therefore I had to wait for another 4 hours for the test. Having being 
tested a blood sample for the particular scan process, at about 12.30 pm a doctor prepared 
me for the scan and took me to the scanning room. 

The radiology technician put me into the Scanner and started the processing and about with- 
in 15 minutes, suddenly the scanner got stuck due to power failure to the scanner machine. 
At once two technician rushed me and took me out of the scanner and kept me in the rest 
room till the repair the machine. I was there for more than one hour for a new session but 
anyone there was unable to rectify the fault of the power supply system of the scanner. At 
that time I was badly feeling with hungry and so I decided to cancel the job and asked for the 
return of the fees paid for the service and came back. 

Author Time Chart O03 - (MRI Scan) As per Western aspects Moon and Saturn are Quin- 
cunx (150 Deg.) Further Saturn and Moon are connected by way of both Rahu and Ke- 
thu. 

After that again I met the VP and informed the incident and he advised me that it is a must 
to under go a scan of the brain at least a CT scan and referred me to another laboratory for a 
CT scan. Having taken the CT scan report I met the VP and found that there is no critical 
damage to the brain but there was an age related atrophic changes. Finally doctor advised 
me not to engage in tiresome mental exercises for sometimes.

also to be analysed to access the possibility of defeat of the opponent. Hence primarily the

Analysis of the Chart: Moon is appearing in 6, 11 cusps with positional status indicate the 
desire of victory to the favoured party. Moon’s star lord Ketu also appears in 1, 6 so justifies 
the question with regard to victory. 


Promise of Victory: It is to be judged from the significances of SSbLs of 1, 6 and 7 cusps. 
The sub sub lord of Ascendant is Mercury appearing in 1,6,11 cusps with positional status 
promises victory. The star lord of Mercury is Rahu and its appearance in 12t cusp indicates 
that the victory is not an easy walk and shows the requirement of lot of efforts. As the Mercu- 
ry is appearing in sub-sub of Saturn appearing in 5 and 12 indicate the end result as favour- 
able to the opponent. 


The sub-sub lord of the 6t8 cusp is Venus which is in own star and thus had positional sta- 
tus, and appearing in 2,3,6,7 and 12 cusps. Here also 6th indicates the victory to favoured 
party but indication of 7and 12 hints that victory is not easy. Venus is in its own sub as 
such it does not show the commitment to 11 except involvement to 64, as such Victory is 
doubtful. 


The sub-sub lord of 7t cusp is also Venus. It signifies 7, and 12. As per rule if 7t sub-sub 
lord signifies 5, 12, indicates the ultimate result as it promise only defeat to the favoured 
party. 

All the linkages shown above are more indicative about the defeat to the favoured party. 


Now let us analyse the Dasa periods also. The dasa lords on the day of counting which de- 
cides the fate of elections results should be considered. Presently at the time of judgement 
Venus dasa is running and it will be up to 9-5-2028. Jupiter bhukthi is from 10-7-2018 to 
10-3-2021. In Jupiter bhukthi during the period of elections i.e., April - May 2019 Antaras of 
Saturn and Mercury are running. Saturn Antara is from 16-11-2018 to 20-4-2019. Mercury 
Antara from 20-4-2019 to 5-9-2019. As such on the day of counting of votes Venus dasa, Ju- 
piter bhukthi, Mercury Antara will be in operation. 


For the events which happen with less frequency the dasa lord is to be favourable or neutral 
but should not deny the event to happen. The capability of bhukthi lord to enact the event is 
more important, AT the end other dasa lords namely Antara, Sookshma, and prana lords 
should support the event to happen. Further as per rule “the ruling placements at the time of 
judgement will be the dasa lords at the time of happening of the event” all the dasa lords 
should be connected to the R.P at the time of judgement 


The R.P.s of Ascendant at the time of judgement are: Mars/Ketu/Saturn/Mars. The Dasa 
lord Venus is the star lord of Saturn Bhukthi lord Jupiter is the rasi lord of Saturn an R.P. 
Antara lord Saturn is directly an R.P Antara lord Mercury in Rasi of Saturn an R.P. thus the 
above rules dasa period lords are qualified to enact the event. 


Now the fruitfulness of dasa lords is to be judged, Dasa Lord Venus signifies 6t6 cusp thus 
allows the event to take place during its period. Bhukthi lord Jupiter involves 1,6,11 com- 
mits to 6, 11 through Moon, the agent of its sub lord Rahu. On the day of counting Mercury 
Antara is expected to run. Mercury involves 1,6,11 by positional status. It is in sub of Jupiter 
appearing in 2, and 5.When involvement of 6‘ is there, commitment to 11 is necessary. So 
there is no commitment as such the Mercury does not satisfy the necessary condition to en- 
act the event. Thus favourable results cannot be had. 


From the foregoing discussion it is clear the favoured party could not win the elections of

Question 1: Stellar, KP and 4-step Theory 

| am G. Sadasivan conversant with KP and 4 step theory. 
I am still a student in front of you.I have 1 doubt. 

KP astrology says: 

Planet is the source , star gives the result and sub is the final deciding factor 


KP Astrologer Narnouli Sir says that planet gives hopes about marriage , 
star gives whether marriage takes place or not , sub decides whether the 
marriage will be happy or not. 


Some astrologers like Umang Taneja , Andrew Dutta considers sub > star and star > 
planet even for promise both cuspal and dasa bhukti. 


Some astrologers says that wherever 2 or 7 or 11 comes marriage is promised. 
S a y p l a n e t 
is indicating 2 but star and sub are negating by having 1,10 significations then al- 
SO marriage is promised . 


ie the case with DBA anywhere planet or star or sub indicates 2 or 7 
or 11 event will happen . 


Request you. to’ kindly clarify the above doubt as_ to’ which = astrolo- 
gers are right or wrong, and what’s the correct methodology . 


Looking forward to your reply anxiously 


Answer 1: 

KP FUNDIMENTAL RULE: "The planet is the source, constellation indicates nature of the 
result and the sub is a deciding factor whether the matter is favourable or not." 
--Krishnamurti Padhdhati, Vol. 2, 1966, Sagar Publications, p 41/ KP Reader III, p 136 (New 
Edition)/ p 129 (1971 Edition)/ KP Reader V p 136 (1971 Edition p 129)/KP Reader VI p 91 
Important note: Without considering the signification of sub, it is not a KP analysis, since 
KP is the sub lord theory only, nothing else. 


So in KP as long as the 7t cuspal sub lord signifies any of marriage houses 2,7,11 at any of 
three levels, i.e. planet, its star and its sub, by occupation and ownership. The signification 
of non-marriage houses 1,6,10 and 12 (separation) 

cannot deter promise of marriage but they may indicate difficulties in getting 

marriage or separation after marriage. 


For happy married life, in addition to 7 cuspal sub lord, the 11 (long term relation) 
cuspal sub lord should be considered in terms of signification of positive and negative 


houses of marriage. 


In predicting the timing of marriage , there is a significant difference that the negative 
significators in the sub level should be considered in selecting the fruitful significators. 


In order to know what each planet can contribute always consider its sub _ lord. 
-KP Reader III page 362 (Original Edition, Practical Part page 194) 


KP Ezine March 2019 32 


Considering two steps, i.e. planet and its star is stellar astrology; three steps, i.e. planet, its 
star and its sub is KP; and planet, its star, its sub and its sub’s star is four step theory.

Answer 2: 

1) Rahu (7° 10') and Sun (26°16') are conjoined in Cancer sign according to Hindu aspects 
which are used in KP. Here the Rahu conjunction is one-sided, i .e. Rahu is to give the re- 
sults of Sun, but not Sun to give the results of Rahu. 

2) Referring “Direction and Locality” of the partner from KP Reader 4, page 85, 10th Edition 
2002: 


If the 7th cuspal sub lord is related with house 4, the partner may be a co-tenant; house 5, it 
may be love marriage; house 9 the partner may be a stranger, foreigner or someone from long 
distance; house 10 (opposite to house 4) the partner may be a person who lives in-one's 
street, town or district etc. After marriage it does not involve a journey to reach husband’s 
place; house 11, the partner may be from a friend’s family; and house 12 the partner may be 
from abroad etc . 


3) In KP Reader IV, p 86: 

Characteristics of the partner: Note the lords of the sign, star and sub where the 7 cusp 
has fallen. They indicate the characteristics of the first partner. The lords of the sign, star 
and sub where the cusp of the second house falls indicate the characteristics of the second 
partner, if there are two marriages. 


KP Ezine March 2019 33 


Physical features of the partner: Just like characteristic is judged, so also ascertain the 
partner’s physical features from the lord of sign, the lord of constellation and the lord of the 
sub of the cusp of 7 for first marriage , cusp of 2 for second marriage and so on. 


4) That rule is not reliable with sound rationale.

Question 4: Role of Cuspal Sub Lord 

Sir I have a small question about KP system. 

Kindly clear up my query.. 

The question is 

"Why KP Astrology give more importance to a particular cusp rather than planets while giv- 
ing predictions. ?) 


As for example 

For marriage of male native why in KP system we go through directly 7 CSL and it's signifi- 
cance instead of planet Venus (karaka of marriage in male chart) and their constellation lord 
for looks out the marriage & married life of the said native. 


Waiting for your favourable reply Sir. 


Answer 4: 

The cuspal sub lord of a house indicates whether the matter of the house is favorable 
(promised) or not. The significators (of dasa period lords) point the time of event. Both dasa, 
bhukti and gochara (transit) must agree, 
-KP Reader V page 224 (1971 Edition p 211), KP Reader III pp 226, 362 (1971 Edition, Prac- 
tical Part pp 68, 194) 


So for marriage of male or female, the concerned 7*t* cusp sub lord and its signification is 
considered as explained above. 
Karakas are not so important in KP like in Jyotish. They play just supporting role.

Book review-Roots of Medical Astrology 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 











Roots of Medical Astrology 
by Jatinder Pal Singh Sandhu 
Sagar Publications, 2019, 480 pages 


Roots of 
Medical Astrology 


Jatinder Pal Singh Sapahu 





This book on Medical astrology promises to be the guidebook for seekers and students of 
medical astrology; it offers exhaustive tables depicting body parts from an ayurvedic and 
western perspective. All the tables are created from the significations and information given 
in various books, Western and Indian. Western references are Wikipedia and medical astrolo- 
gy books by EH Hare, MD, Max Heindel/Augusta Foss Heindel, William Lily, William Andrew, 
Raphael and HL Cornell, MD. References from Indian classics are BPHS, Brihat Jataka, 
Prasna Marga, Prasna Tantra, Sarvarth Chintamini, Shambhu Hora Parakasha, Veerasim- 
havalokanam, Saravali, Phal Deepika and Jatak Parijat. Birth chart data are taken from as- 
tro databank, and charts are shown in both Southern and Northern styles. 

There are many topics discussed in the book that have not been covered till date by any of 
authors of Medical astrology unique to the book are few methods and techniques like, locat- 
ing the seat of disease by the application of six methods, Timing of the disease, the difference 
between four humour theory of western astrology and the three doshas of Ayurved Etc. Other 
than that the book covers the entire gamut of known diseases through simple astrological 
combinations and sufficient astrological examples. This is a must-have book for all students, 
scholars, and enthusiasts of astrology.

Rise and Fall of Myanmar 
Lady Chief Minister Dr. Lei Lei Maw 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 











Dr. Lei Lei Maw became Chief Minister and the head of Tanintharyi Region Government on 
30 March 2016. She was arrested on bribery and corruption charges on 11 March 2019, ac- 
cording to the Anti-Corruption Commission, and then removed from her chief minister posi- 
tion. The case against Daw Lei Lei Maw has been filed under the Anti-Corruption Law’s Arti- 
cle 55 which carries a maximum penalty of 15 year’s imprisonment and a fine if found guilty. 
She is the first chief minister to be charged with corruption since the NLD government, led 
by Mrs. Aung San Suu Kyi, took power in 2016. 

https: //en.wikipedia.org /wiki/Lei_Lei_Maw 





Rise to Power on 30 March 2016 

Her 10t* (power) cuspal sub lord Me+(1,2-11), +2,6,8,10 having no planet in its stars/ Star 
Ve(2,3-10)/ Sub Me+(1,2-11 ), +2,6,8,10, indicating promise of power by power gaining 
houses 3 (ability), 6 (win over opponent), 10 (power, success), 11 (desire fulfillment). 


Dasa Analysis

Mother Teresa was considered one of the 20t8 century's greatest humanitarians. She was canonized as 
saint Teresa of Calcutta in 2016. 


Nun and missionary Mother Teresa, known in the Catholic Church as Saint Teresa of Calcutta, 
devoted her life to caring for the sick and poor. Born in Macedonia to parents of Albanian-descent and 
having taught in India for 17 years, Mother Teresa experienced her "call within a call" in 1946. Her 
order established a hospice; centers for the blind, aged and disabled; and a leper colony. In 1979 she 
received the Nobel Peace Prize for her humanitarian work. She died in September 1997 and was 
beatified in October 2003. In December 2015, Pope Francis recognized a second miracle attributed to 
Mother Teresa, clearing the way for her to be canonized on September 4, 2016. Such a great 
humanitarian, personification of spirituality, who inspired the society at large, who sacrificed her 
entire life by foregoing her personal comforts, has inspired me to study her astrological chart and the 
influence of stars on her life.

in barren signs. (Aries, Gemini, Leo and Virgo are Barren Signs).

Book review-KP Relationship Method (KPRM) 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 











Easy Way to learn KP: 

KP Relationship Method (KPRM) 
by Kanakkumar B. Bosmia 

2019, Large size, 128 pages 


| 


4 


Kanakkumar bosmia 


c 
_H 





i 


First of all let me express my pleasure for the author Kanak Bosmia’s dedication of this book 
to me as his KP elder brother. 


This book “Easy Way to learn KP: KP Relationship Method (KPRM)” is author Kanak Bosmia’s 
seventh book, after publishing Easy Way to learn KP: Birth time rectification, Easy Way to 
learn KP: Muhurat (earlier published by the title, KP Muhurat: A new technique in KP), Easy 
Way to learn KP: Theory of short prediction (TSP), Easy Way to learn KP: KP Rules and Bhava 
significations, Krishnamurty Padhdhty: Ek abhinav drashtikon (in Gujarati), and translation 
of Late Chandarkant R. Bhatt’s “Prashana Jyotish”. 


In this book the author has tried to give rules for marriage matching, first and second mar- 
riage, business partnership, mother in law and daughter in law, father and son, Guru- 
shishya and employer- employee relationship, as shown in the contents. In addition prob- 
lems in married life is also explained. All rules and problems are explained by various practi- 
cal examples with chart details and fully calculated charts in order to clearly illustrate the 
KP relationship method (KPRM). 


I’m also delighted to learn that this KP relationship method (KPRM) is supported 
by Dr. Rangarajan Krishnamoorthy’s KPAstro 4.5 software. 


Needles to say this book will be helpful in learning and practicing of KP relationship method.

Will I win 1500 million Kyat (1 million US$) lottery? 
If so, when? 
By: Tin Win 


Email: tw853@yahoo.com 
LBRRERRHRHRHRHRHERHRHRHRHRERHRHRHRHRHRHRHRHRHRHEHERHRHEHEHEREHEEHEEEE HH 





Consultant, Male, 31 May 1951, 02:00 am, East 6:30 hr, 21n49, 95e59, KP New Ayanamsa 23:05:19, 
Balance Dasa 11 Y, 7M, 2 D 

This analysis is an attempt to apply the findings of “A KP Study of Million Dollar Lottery Winners” 
based on 22 AA-rated charts and appeared in the KP-Ezine, February 2011 issue. 


(www.kpastrologer.com) 


Ruling House of Lottery 

There are two different views on the ruling house of lottery, i.e. 3% house (KP Reader VI pp 213) and 
oth house for all games of chance (KP Reader II p 197, KP Reader VI p 117), oth house for 
lotteries (Rex Bills: Rulership Book p 81), as shown by many more references in the above mentioned 
article. 


Cuspal Sub Lord Analysis 

In the above study of 22 million dollar winner charts, the 3™4 cuspal sub lord (CSL)’s signification of 
lottery related 2 (money, wealth), 3 (lottery, ticket), 5 (game of chance), 6 (winning over other players), 
8 (unearned, sudden and unexpected gain), 9 (luck), 10 (status change), 11 (gain, fulfillment of desire) 
houses shows that 10th house is signified by 82% of 22 charts under study, 5 by 73%, 3% by 68%, 
11th by 64% and 274 , 6th and 9th houses by 59% each, i.e. mainly houses 10,5,3 and 11. 


34 CSL Sa(6,11-12) is in the star of Su(3,5), and in sub of Ju(1,1-10), signifying required houses 
3,5,10 and 11 for promise of winning lottery. 


In the above study, the 5th CSL’s signification of lottery related 2, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10 and 11 houses 
shows that 5t and 11th houses are signified by 77% each of 22 charts under study, 10th house by 
73%, 224 and 9th houses by 68% each, 8th house by 59%, 3rd and 6th houses by 55% each., i.e. 
mainly houses 5,11,10, 2 and 9. 


oth CSL Ke+(6) is having no planet in its stars to be a strong 5t significator; Ke is aspected by Ma+(2,2 
-9), +8 having no planet in its stars, and its sign lord is Su(3,5). Ke is in the star of Ve(4,3-8), and in 
sub of Ju(1,1-10), signifying required houses 2,5,9 and 10 for promise of winning lottery. 


Dasa Analysis 

The Dasa, Bhukti and Antra (DBA) lords’ signification of lottery related 2,3,5,6,8,9,10,11 houses 
shows that the 10th house is signified by 95% of 22 charts under study, 5th, 9th and 11th houses by 
91% each, 3rd & 6th houses by 86% each, 8th house by 82% and 2"4 house by 77%, i.e. mainly 
10,5,9 and 11. 

The DBA signification appears better synchronized with the 5th CSL signification other than the 3rd 
CSL. 


Consultant’s current running joint dasa period is Ra-Sa (08 Feb 2018 to 15 Dec 2020). 

Dasa lord Ra+(12), +1,2,12, its sign lord Sa(6,11-12); Ra is in the star and sub of Ju(1,1-10), signifying 
required houses 10 and 11 but not 5 and 9, and indicating possibility of winning lottery. 

Bhukti lord Sa(6,11-12) is in star of Su(3,5), and in sub of Ju(1,1-10), signifying required houses 10 
and 11 but not 5 and 9. 


Next Bhukti is Me (15 Dec 2020 to 04 Jul 2022). 
Bhukti lord Me(2,4-7) is in the star of Ve(4,3-8), and in sub of Sa(6,11-12), signifying required houses 
11 but not 5,9 and 10.

of the signification of required houses 10 and 11 by Dasa lord Ra and the signification of required 
houses 5,9 and 10 by Bhukti lord Ke.

quired house 5,10 only. 

Antra lord Su(3,6) is in the star of Mo(1,5), and sub of Ju(1,1-10), signifying required house 5,10 only. 
Antra lord Mo(1,5) is in the star of Me(2,4-7), and sub of Ve(4,3-8), signifying required house 5 only. 
Antra lord Mat+(2,2-9), +8, is in the star of Mo(1,5), and sub of Ra+(12), +1,2,12, Sa(6,11-12), signify- 
ing required houses 5,9 and 11. 


So the Ra-Ke-Ma joint dasa period (18 Nov 2023 to 10 Dec 2023) is a possible period to win lot- 
tery.

indicates that the 6th house is signified by 86% of 22 charts under study, 2nd and 9th houses by 
82% each, 3rd , 8th and 10th houses by 73% each, 5th and 11th houses by 68% each, i.e. mainly 
houses 6,2 and 9.

Criminal Proceedings 

KP Rule - If the sub lord of the 10th cusp (Status) be the significator (in the star of the 
occupantr owner) of houses 7 (court proceedings), 8 (infamy) or 12 (crimes), the native will be 
involved in court proceedings relating to crimes, will be ill-reputed and will be inflicted with 
punishment, during the joint period of the significators of houses 7, 8 and 12. (Ref: Prashna

Capital Punishment (Death Penalty) by the court of Law:- If a native is to be put to death by a 
third party in any manner, it is an unnatural death. In KP, unnatural death is indicated by 
lst and 8th CSLs’ signification of Badhaka, Maraka, 8 & 12th houses along with connection 
to Mars. 


Death by Law is denoted when Saturn is involved in the configuration otherwise indicating a 
violent death, as Saturn is said to rule Judges and the Law. (Encycl. of Medical Astrology by 
Dr. H.L.Cornell). 


In my view, though this is an unnatural death, it is an execution of sentence to be put to 
death, which comes through the order of the court of law. Hence, the houses 9 (Law suit) and 
11 (Court Order- 3rd from 9th court) are also to be considered to complete the rule.

also connected with Mars. OK.

The relevant houses of marriage are 2,7 and 11. If the 7 cuspal sublord signifies 2 or 7 or 
11 marriage is promised. If the 7t CSL signifies 1,6,10 and 12 in addition to 2,7,11 separa- 
tion follows after marriage. If the 7th CSL happens to be the mercury or any planet in a dual 
sign the native will have more than one marriage. 


My office colleague has furnished the birth details of his son, in connection with his married 
life, as given below: 


DOB: 9-11-1974; TOB:8-53-55 AM; POB: Ramachandrapuram Long:82-1’ Lat: 16-51’ 


The native was borne in Purva phalguni (Leo) with Sagittarius as ascendant. The sublord of 
7th cusp in this chart is Mercury. It is in 10 house, lord of 7, 10 and in the star of Mars in 
11 lord of 5, 12. It is in the sub of Venus in 11 lord of 6, 11. Finally Mercury signifies 11, 5, 
12 connected to 7, 10, 6, 11. By signification of 7, 11 it promises marriage and by 6, 10 it 
indicates separation after marriage. When Mercury is a cuspal sublord it gives more than 
one marriage. The significators for the marriage as well as separation are as follows:

Saturn is having no planets in its stars. Hence it is strong. Occupation of 7th house by 
Saturn indicates delay in marriage but not denial when it is significator of 2, 7, 11. So the 
marriage was delayed. The native attains marriageable age in Mars dasa but Mars has not 
given the result of marriage, though it is a significator, due to its occupation of sub of Kethu 
in 6th house. 


The marriage was took place on 12-8-2012 in the joint period of DBA of Rahu-Jup-Sun-Sun. 
The dasalord Rahu is favourable for conducting marriage event being in the star and sub of 
Mercury 7th lord. As Mercury is having the lordship of 10t house also the dasalord Rahu 
denotes separation. The bhukthi lord Jupiter is in the star of dasalord Rahu gives the result 
of dasalord i.e. favourable for conducting the marriage event as well as separation. The 
period of Rahu-Jupiter commences from 11-01-2011 and ends on O06-6-2013. Both the 
anthara-Sookshma lord Sun (significator of 11, 1) are also for and against the marriage 
event. As all the DBA lords are having double role in this event, the native has got married 
on 12-8-2012 and separated within a week of celebration of marriage as the period of 
sookshma lord Sun ends by 13-8-2012 and the native obtained divorce legally before the end 
of Jupiter bhukthi. 


Transit: The dasalord Rahu transited in the star of Saturn (Anuradha), the bhukthi lord 
Jupiter is transited in the star of Moon (rohini), the anthara lord sun is transited in the star

Moon is transited in its own star Rohini. This shows no body can escape the fate if it decides 
sO.

Question 1: Variations in KP 
Can you please clarify below things as I've been reading a couple of books and got confused: 


1. Can you help me understand some history on how did the variations of KP system came 
into place? Like Sunil ji came with 4-step theory, Khular ji came with cuspal interlinks 
theory, and then there's Gulbarga theory. 

2. I dont see KSK garu has said Rahu/Ketu has aspects in KP Reader 3. But why did people 
modify these and say Rahu/Ketu have aspects 5, 7, 9 and still refer that as KP system? I 
read a book by by SK Kapoor which says this and some other details like when conjunct with 
Rahu, these results will only come to fruition during period/sub periods of Rahu in DBA 

3. I believe in KSK reader books, Sublord indicates the end result while modern books which 
say KP system still go far to consider the star-lord of this sub-lord to indicate the end result. 
Is there a proper book on KP system which strictly refers to the methods laid out by KSK 
garu and not implement their theories? 

Please acknowledge my doubts and excuse if any mistakes, and make me learn :) 

Answer 1: 

1. KP (Krishnamurti Padhdhati) astrology is what is written and consistently applied in 
the “KP Readers I to VI” by Prof. K.S. Krishnamurti after doing empirical research over 30 
years . 


2. As Late Sunil Gondhaleka said, KP is three steps: planet, its star lord and its sub lord as 
final decider and four step theory is four steps: further step up to the star lord of that sub 
lord. 


3. The best narrated KP books which almost strictly refers to six “KP Readers” are Sri 
Chandrakant R. Bhatt’s books, namely: 

1) Nakshatra Chintamani 

2) Further Lights on Nakshatra Chintamani, and 

3) Prashna Jyotish translated by Kanak Bosmia 

4) Jyotish Abhigyan translated by Kanak Bosmia 

4. Further research has been encouraged by Guruji KSK to find new truth and simple 
way. There are more than one hundred KP related astrological books in English, including 
S.K. Kapoor’s “Elements of K. P. Stellar Astrology”, 2017, which has many variations for six 
KP Readers.. 

5. Many KP based methods with variations from KP have been introduced, for instance 
Dr. Kar’s Sub Sub theory including Theory of short prediction (TSP) of modified Gulbarga 
theory, Baskaran’s KB Cuspal Interlinks at sub level & similarly Khullar’s KCIL Cuspal 
Interlinks at sub sub level, Sunil Gondhalekar’s Four Step Theory based on K.M. 
Subramanium’s Sublord- Speaks articles, Dr. Kasinath’s EPS system etc. But any solid and 
simple method has not yet been found. 

6. Rahu or Ketu (whether it is a planet or star lord or sub lord) the following significators are 
taken in the six KP Readers depending on relevance to the event under consideration 
regardless of their sequence of order: 

1) House occupied by Rahu/Ketu, 

2) Planet in conjunction with Rahu/Ketu, 

3) Planet in aspect to Rahu/Ketu, 

4) Star lord of Rahu/Ketu and 

5) Sign lord of (rasi) sign occupied by Rahu/Ketu. 

Note: Conjunction in the same (rasi) sign and Hindu aspects without orb are used.

7. Rahu or Ketu does not aspect any planet or house since it is not a planet having physical 
body but it is only a sensitive intersecting mathematical point in the pathway of Sun and 
Moon. So in case of conjunction or aspect with other planets, Rahu/Ketu will give whatever 
the conjoined or aspecting planet is to give but not that planet to give whatever Rahu/Ketu is 
to give, i.e. only one way effect from conj/aspecting planets to Rahu but not from Rahu to 
those planets. Aspects of Rahu or Ketu iare not mentioned in any of Hindu astrology 
classics. But some astrologers including Prof. Dr. P.S. Sastri, American Vedic astrologer 
James Braha are saying about Rahu’s 5,7,9 and 12 aspect s quoting Sage Parashara without 
giving any particular reference.

Ruling House of Lottery 

There are two different views on the ruling house of lottery, i.e. 3% house (KP Reader VI pp 213) and 
oth house for all games of chance (KP Reader II p 197, KP Reader VI p 117), oth house for 
lotteries (Rex Bills: Rulership Book p 81), as shown by many more references in the above mentioned 
article. 


Cuspal Sub Lord Analysis 

In the above study of 22 million dollar winner charts, the 34 cuspal sub lord (CSL)’s signification of 
lottery related 2 (money, wealth), 3 (lottery, ticket), 5 (game of chance), 6 (winning over other players), 
8 (unearned, sudden and unexpected gain), 9 (luck), 10 (status change), 11 (gain, fulfillment of desire) 
houses shows that 10t house is signified by 82% of 22 charts under study, 5th by 73%, 34 by 68%, 
11th by 64% and 274 , 6th and 9th houses by 59% each, i.e. mainly houses 10,5,3 and 11. 


34 CSL Sa(6,11-12) is in the star of Su(3,5), and in sub of Ju(1,1-10), signifying required houses 
3,5,10 and 11 for promise of winning lottery.

shows that 5t* and 11t* houses are signified by 77% each of 22 charts under study, 10th house by 
73%, 224 and 9th houses by 68% each, 8th house by 59%, 3rd and 6th houses by 55% each., i.e. 
mainly houses 5,11,10, 2 and 9. 


oth CSL Ke+(6) is having no planet in its stars to be a strong 5t) significator; Ke is aspected by Mat(2,2 
-9), +8 having no planet in its stars, and its sign lord is Su(3,5). Ke is in the star of Ve(4,3-8), and in 
sub of Ju(1,1-10), signifying required houses 2,5,9 and 10 for promise of winning lottery. 


Dasa Analysis 

The Dasa, Bhukti and Antra (DBA) lords’ signification of lottery related 2,3,5,6,8,9,10,11 houses 
shows that the 10th house is signified by 95% of 22 charts under study, 5th, 9th and 11t houses by

Question 1: Variations in KP 
Can you please clarify below things as I've been reading a couple of books and got confused: 


1. Can you help me understand some history on how did the variations of KP system came 
into place? Like Sunil ji came with 4-step theory, Khular ji came with cuspal interlinks 
theory, and then there's Gulbarga theory. 

2. I dont see KSK garu has said Rahu/Ketu has aspects in KP Reader 3. But why did people 
modify these and say Rahu/Ketu have aspects 5, 7, 9 and still refer that as KP system? I 
read a book by by SK Kapoor which says this and some other details like when conjunct with 
Rahu, these results will only come to fruition during period/sub periods of Rahu in DBA 

3. I believe in KSK reader books, Sublord indicates the end result while modern books which 
say KP system still go far to consider the star-lord of this sub-lord to indicate the end result. 
Is there a proper book on KP system which strictly refers to the methods laid out by KSK 
garu and not implement their theories? 

Please acknowledge my doubts and excuse if any mistakes, and make me learn :) 

Answer 1: 

1. KP (Krishnamurti Padhdhati) astrology is what is written and consistently applied in 
the “KP Readers I to VI” by Prof. K.S. Krishnamurti after doing empirical research over 30 
years . 


2. As Late Sunil Gondhaleka said, KP is three steps: planet, its star lord and its sub lord as 
final decider and four step theory is four steps: further step up to the star lord of that sub 
lord. 


3. The best narrated KP books which almost strictly refers to six “KP Readers” are Sri 
Chandrakant R. Bhatt’s books, namely: 

1) Nakshatra Chintamani 

2) Further Lights on Nakshatra Chintamani, and 

3) Prashna Jyotish translated by Kanak Bosmia 

4) Jyotish Abhigyan translated by Kanak Bosmia 

4. Further research has been encouraged by Guruji KSK to find new truth and simple 
way. There are more than one hundred KP related astrological books in English, including 
S.K. Kapoor’s “Elements of K. P. Stellar Astrology”, 2017, which has many variations for six 
KP Readers.. 

5. Many KP based methods with variations from KP have been introduced, for instance 
Dr. Kar’s Sub Sub theory including Theory of short prediction (TSP) of modified Gulbarga 
theory, Baskaran’s KB Cuspal Interlinks at sub level & similarly Khullar’s KCIL Cuspal 
Interlinks at sub sub level, Sunil Gondhalekar’s Four Step Theory based on K.M. 
Subramanium’s Sublord- Speaks articles, Dr. Kasinath’s EPS system etc. But any solid and 
simple method has not yet been found. 

6. Rahu or Ketu (whether it is a planet or star lord or sub lord) the following significators are 
taken in the six KP Readers depending on relevance to the event under consideration 
regardless of their sequence of order: 

1) House occupied by Rahu/Ketu, 

2) Planet in conjunction with Rahu/Ketu, 

3) Planet in aspect to Rahu/Ketu, 

4) Star lord of Rahu/Ketu and 

9) Sign lord of (rasi) sign occupied by Rahu/Ketu. 

Note: Conjunction in the same (rasi) sign and Hindu aspects without orb are used.

Ouestions & Answers 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 








Question 1: Variations in KP 
Can you please clarify below things as I've been reading a couple of books and got confused: 


1. Can you help me understand some history on how did the variations of KP system came 
into place? Like Sunil ji came with 4-step theory, Khular ji came with cuspal interlinks 
theory, and then there's Gulbarga theory. 

2. I dont see KSK garu has said Rahu/Ketu has aspects in KP Reader 3. But why did people 
modify these and say Rahu/Ketu have aspects 5, 7, 9 and still refer that as KP system? I 
read a book by by SK Kapoor which says this and some other details like when conjunct with 
Rahu, these results will only come to fruition during period/sub periods of Rahu in DBA 

3. I believe in KSK reader books, Sublord indicates the end result while modern books which 
say KP system still go far to consider the star-lord of this sub-lord to indicate the end result. 
Is there a proper book on KP system which strictly refers to the methods laid out by KSK 
garu and not implement their theories? 

Please acknowledge my doubts and excuse if any mistakes, and make me learn :) 

Answer 1: 

1. KP (Krishnamurti Padhdhati) astrology is what is written and consistently applied in 
the “KP Readers I to VI” by Prof. K.S. Krishnamurti after doing empirical research over 30 
years . 


2. As Late Sunil Gondhaleka said, KP is three steps: planet, its star lord and its sub lord as 
final decider and four step theory is four steps: further step up to the star lord of that sub 
lord. 


3. The best narrated KP books which almost strictly refers to six “KP Readers” are Sri 
Chandrakant R. Bhatt’s books, namely: 

1) Nakshatra Chintamani 

2) Further Lights on Nakshatra Chintamani, and 

3) Prashna Jyotish translated by Kanak Bosmia 

4) Jyotish Abhigyan translated by Kanak Bosmia 

4. Further research has been encouraged by Guruji KSK to find new truth and simple 
way. There are more than one hundred KP related astrological books in English, including 
S.K. Kapoor’s “Elements of K. P. Stellar Astrology”, 2017, which has many variations for six 
KP Readers.. 

5. Many KP based methods with variations from KP have been introduced, for instance 
Dr. Kar’s Sub Sub theory including Theory of short prediction (TSP) of modified Gulbarga 
theory, Baskaran’s KB Cuspal Interlinks at sub level & similarly Khullar’s KCIL Cuspal 
Interlinks at sub sub level, Sunil Gondhalekar’s Four Step Theory based on K.M. 
Subramanium’s Sublord- Speaks articles, Dr. Kasinath’s EPS system etc. But any solid and 
simple method has not yet been found. 

6. Rahu or Ketu (whether it is a planet or star lord or sub lord) the following significators are 
taken in the six KP Readers depending on relevance to the event under consideration 
regardless of their sequence of order: 

1) House occupied by Rahu/Ketu, 

2) Planet in conjunction with Rahu/Ketu, 

3) Planet in aspect to Rahu/Ketu, 

4) Star lord of Rahu/Ketu and 

9) Sign lord of (rasi) sign occupied by Rahu/Ketu. 

Note: Conjunction in the same (rasi) sign and Hindu aspects without orb are used.

native. 
The birth of a child will take place during the conjoined period of the significators of 2,5,11.

Signs are called as Fruitful Signs. Taurus, Libra, Sagittarius and Capricorn are called as Semi- 


fruitful Signs.

Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s Swearing-in Chart 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 








Sri Narendra Modi took oath as Prime Minister for a second term on May 30, 2019 in Rash- 
trapati Bhavan (Presidential Residence) in New Delhi. The scheduled time of taking oath was 
7:00 PM but actually it started at 7:04:20 PM and finished at 7:06:18 PM, and the end was 
at 7:06:50 PM after signing in two books. KP takes the end time of 7:06:50 PM. 





The traditionally chosen muhurat seems mainly based on Vargottama Lagna having Jupiter, 
which is opposing Sun conj. Mercury and aspecting Moon but Jupiter is weak and afflicted 
since retrograde and fallen. The 8th house affliction is most malefic. 


1st (longevity) cuspal sub lord (CSL) Ra(8), conj Ma(8,1-6), aspt by Sat+(2,3-4), sign lord Me 
(7,8-12) is in the star of Ju(1,2-5), and in sub of Me(7,8-12), signifying favorable houses 1,5, 
along with unfavorable houses 2,7,8,12 with negative sub. Rahu is the same CSL for the 
1,5,11 cusps, and so these life saving 1,5,11 houses are assumed to be connected in KP. 
Therefore longevity of the Government is in medium range. 


10th (government, authority, longevity) CSL Me(7,8-12) is in the star of Ma(8,1-6), and in sub 
of Sat+(2,3-4), signifying favorable houses 2,3-6, along with unfavorable houses 8,12. It may 
be a mixed indication for the government’s success, but not good for its longevity. 


Since Modi’s PUB party has won the clear majority seats in the parliament, the survival of the 
government for full five years is 

clear and some signs of weakness in longevity may indicate troubles and requirement for 
changes of the cabinet ministers from time to time. 


2nd (wealth, finance, stock exchange) CSL Ve(6,7-12) is in the star of own Ve(6,7-12), and in 
sub of Me(7,8-12), signifying favorable house 6, along with unfavorable houses 8,12 with 


negative sub as indication of weakness. 


9th (religion) CSL is also Venus, signifying favorable house 6, along with unfavorable houses 
8,12 with negative sub as a signal of problems.

Question 1: 2nd Marriage Rule 
Kindly advise me which is Rule is correct. 


Sir , i have one clarification about the 2nd Marriage Rules. Some says that --- houses 2-7-11 
are to be judged for lst marriage . For 2nd marriage , houses 2 and 11 are to be judged. The 
following 2 conditions are to be simultaneously satisfied. a) Sub Lord of 7th cusp is deposited 
in a dual sign OR in the constellation of a planet in OR owning a dual sign OR if the Sub lord 
of 7th Cusp is Mercury and b) the sub lord of 7th cusp is also a significator of houses 2 or 
11. Few says --- the 2nd Cuspal Sub Lord and its deposition shows the 2nd marriage . How- 
ever, the 1st rule is that the --- a) 7th Cuspal Sub Lord is occupying a dual sign. b) OR is in 
the Star of a palnet owning a dual sign OR c) is in the Star of a Planet occupying a dual sign 
must be fulfilled. Then alone u must go to the issue of 2nd marriage. d) The rules will not 
give the result unless the 2nd Cusp Sub Lord signifies 7th houses at the same time. WHICH 
ONE IS CORRECT? 


Answer 1: 

KP 2nd Marriage Rule 

Second marriage is indicated if the following two conditions are simultaneously satisfied: (KP 
Reader VI p. 165) 


(1) The sub-lord of the 7th cusp is deposited in a dual sign or in the constellation of a 
planet in or owning a dual sign or if the sub-lord of the 7th cusp is Mercury; and 
(2) if the sub-lord of the 7th cusp is also a significator of either of the house 2 or 11. 


In addition, the following condition should be fulfilled for the 2nd legal marriage: 

If the sub lord of the 2nd cusp is connected with 7th house, 2nd marriage is promised; (if 
connected with 11th house one will keep a keep.) 

- KP Reader IV, page 146 


2nd house = addition to family members by marriage and birth of children later 
7th house = legal bondage to share property, possessions, etc 
11th = pleasure, long lasting or permanent tie of friendship 


Rationale of 2nd House for 2nd Marriage 

The 2nd house being 8th from 7th house signifying the “death' of first spouse (7th house) or 
the ‘end' of 7th house matters (marriage, partnership) is referred for the 2nd spouse; 9th 
house being 8th from 2nd is referred for 3rd spouse and so on - - (to apply in the society of 
one husband- one wife system.) 

- Kalidasa's Utara Kalamrita, translated by Dr. D.S. Sastri, 2001, page 107 


More than One Marriage Rule based on research of 100 charts 
Note on Rules/guide Lines for Checking for More than one Marriage in a KP Chart written by 
Late Sri A.R. Raichur ji in November 2012 


Shree Kanak Bosmia, under the guidance of Raichur and Tin Win, did a statistical study on 
the 3 guidelines mentioned below: 


The assumptions ARE: GEMINI (Mithuna), SAGITTARUS (Dhanu), PISCES (Meena) are Dual 
SIGNS (for this study): MERC, JUP (Budha and Guru) owning these signs are considered as 


KP Ezine May 2019 40 


DUAL Planets( for these guidelines only) Hindu Aspects (Vedic aspects) with no orbs, i.e. Sign 
to Sign are considered while finding or checking significators of houses. 
Within these parameters: The rules are: 


RULE-1: MORE THAN ONE marriage is indicated if the BOTH following two conditions are 
ARE simultaneously satisfied: 

(i) The sub-lord of the 7th cusp OR its Starlord is deposited in a dual sign 
(gemini,virgo,pisces) OR if the sub-lord of the 7th cusp is Mercury/JUP; and 

(ii) The sub-lord of the 7th cusp is also a significator of either of the houses 2 or 11 or 
both. 

If any of the above two conditions is not satisfied, then second marriage is denied. 


RULE-2: Second marriage is indicated if the sub-lord of the 2nd cusp is also a significator of 
either of the houses 7 or 11. 


RULE-3: As per Kanak: ON ASSUMPTION 2ND WIFE IS CONSIDERED AS YOUNGER SIS- 
TER OF FIRST. 


Second marriage is indicated if the sub-lord of the 9th cusp is a significator of either of the 
houses 2 or 9 or 11. 


The study was done on 100 charts, where data was reliable. This was supplied from 
ASTRDATA BANK 4.0 and some by shri TIN WIN. 


THE RESULTS OF THE STUDY IS AS UNDER: 


RULE 1: 74 PERCENT AGREE WITH THIS RULE 
RULE 2: 79 PERCENT AGREE WITH THIS RULE 
RULE 3: 93 PERCENT AGREE WITH THIS RULE 


No rule by itself gives a 100 percent co-relationship 
Final Recommendation: 


CHECK BY ALL 3 RULES, and then GIVE the prediction on more than one Marriage. 
end. 


Question 2: Accuracy of Horoscopes in K.P. Readers 

I am regularly reading your Magazine since few months. I have a Query for your "question- 
Answer" column. 

There are many horoscopes in K.P. readers. But when we recast them manually, using the 
K.P. tables of houses, or by software, many times degrees of cusps don't match with K. P. 
Reader's original horoscope's cusp degrees. I want to know where is the problem? Is this is 
because the horoscope used in K.P. Readers were cast using Raphael Table of Houses? 


Answer 2: 

It is true that accuracy of cusps of calculated horoscopes in the KP Readers is poor due to 
using Raphael’s Tables of Houses which shows Lagna cusp up to degree and minute and oth- 
er cusps up to degree only. 


Question 3: 
Sir I have one clarification from u. For the 2nd marriage , one should see the planets in 
BHAVA Chart or Rashi Chart or Both? 


Suppose, 7th cuspal sub lord is Kuja . In Rashi chakra( D-1 Chart ) kuja in Meena. In Bhava 


Chart, kuja in Kumbha. Can we go ahead to see 2nd marriage when kuja in Kumbha in 
Bhava chart? 


KP Ezine May 2019 41 


Or strictly one should see the Bhava Chart even for 2nd marriage also. In that case one can- 
not proceed to see the promise of 2nd marriage because Kuja in kumbha in Bhava chart 
even though Kuja in Meena in Rashi Chart. 


In othe rwords, pl tell me Which Kuja should be taken while seeing the promise of 2nd mar- 
riage in the above case. 


Answer 3: 

A KP chart is a rasi based bhava chart divided by Placidus cusps. Location and lordship are 
to be considered according to the bhava chart as cusp lines. The rasi chart is to be used in 
considering Hindu aspect from rasi to rasi and conjunction in a rasi only. 


Accordingly the rasi chart is to be used in considering whether the 7th cusp sub lord or its 
constellation is located in dual rasi, i.e. Mithuna, Dhanu and Meena.

Book review-Medical Astrology 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 











Medical Astrology 

by Editor: Arun Bansal, Author: Vinay Garg 
All India Federation of Astrologers Societies 
2018, 313 pages 


MEDICAL ASTROLOGY 


Editor : Arun Bansal 
Author : Vinay Garg 





This book is a Vedic medical astrology book presenting the analysis of astrological combina- 
tions in order to know whether the patient can inherit a particular disease or not or whether 
the disease is curable or incurable. In the book, the different aspects of disease have been 
discussed through the eyes of astrology. 


All the diseases have been categorised into congenital diseases and the diseases incurred af- 
ter the birth. There are many diseases which are cured with the change of time, dasha and 
favourable transit and these are called curable diseases. On the other hand, there are several 
other diseases which can't be cured and they are called chronic diseases. At the end of the 
book the causes of the diseases, their characteristics and astrological combination have been 
given.

A Study of Horoscopes with 


Venus-Mars Conjunction 





By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 








Venus-Mars Conjunction as Indicator of Sex Drive in Classical Texts 
1. In the classical texts the Venus (sex)-Mars (energy) conjunction is treated as an indicator 
of excessive sex drive as follows: 


Brihat Jataka by Varahaminira, translated by Bangalore Suryanarain Rao: Mars with Venus 
produces cowherds, wrestler, skillful, fond of other’s women and gambler. 

It may be noted in this connection that in thousands of horoscopes I have had occasion to 
examine, I invariably found the morals of the individual with this combination very loose or 
himself or herself suffering from ventral complaints. 


Brihat Jataka, tran. by Prof. P.S. Sastri: If Mar is with Venus, one is a wrestler, a rarer of 
cows, indulging in other women, a gambler or a thug. 


Phala Deepika by Mantreswara, translated by S.S. Saren: Venus by conjunction with Mars 
makes the native a shepherded, a wrestler, skillful, cohabiting with others’ wives or gambler. 


Maan Sagari, translated by P.K. Vasudev: In conjunction of Mars and Venus, the person will 
be in high status, skilled in astrology, interested in gambling, a liar, a cunning person, will 
indulge in sexual union with the wives of other men, but people will give him respect. 


Jataka Rahasyam: In a female horoscope Mars and Venus are associated within a sign with- 
out the aspect of Jupiter leads to prostitute 


Finding in Study of Venus-Mars Conjunction Charts 

2. The Venus-Mars conjunction is found not only in some over-sexed horoscopes but also in 
many horoscopes of Sages or spiritualists, well known astrologers and film stars, and notable 
horoscopes, as shown by the following example horoscopes. So the excessive sex drive can- 
not be predicted by mere Venus-Mars conjunction in a horoscope, as stated in the classical 
texts. 


3. Another general saying of natives with exalted Venus enjoying illicit sex with people of 
high class, and people with debilitated Venus with people of low class is not supported by the 
horoscopes of Sages or spiritualists like Pope Pius XII, Swami Vidyaranya, Swami Sivananda 
(D), Sri Prabhupada (D), Saint Catherine, Mingun Sayadaw (D), and notable people like 
Chengiz Khan (D), Albert Einstein, Abraham Lincoln, Henry Ford (D), K.S. Krishnamurti (D). 
Amitabh Bachchan with exalted/ debilitated (D) Venus. However it is noted that actress Jen- 
nifer Jones has exalted Venus, and Giacomo Casanova and Bill Clinton have debilitated Ve- 
nus. 


4. Since the Venus-Mars conjunction can last for about 20 days and Venus can stay in a zo- 
diacal sign for about 30 days for exaltation/ debilitation it is not reasonable to assume the 
effect of Venus-Mars conjunction or Venus exaltation/ debilitation to be the same for all the 
natives born during these 20 or 30 days. Therefore the whole horoscope should be thorough- 
ly analyzed in such cases other than relying only on Venus-Mars combination, Venus exalta- 
tion/ debilitation, as said in the classical texts. 


KP Ezine July 2019 4 


Scandalous Sex Affairs 

©. The Venus-Mars conjunction indicates the scandalous sex affairs in the horoscopes of 
President Bill Clinton and Dominique Strauss-Kahn/ DSK (IMF MD and French Presidential 
candidate). 


Serial Womanizers without Venus-Mars Conjunction 

6. However there is no Venus-Mars conjunction in the horoscopes of serial womanizers Gia- 
como Casanova, known as a great lover and Hugh Hefner who once admitted he’d made love 
to over a thousand women. But in both horoscopes conjunction of testosterone-rich Mars 
and fun-loving, party-seeking Jupiter (planet of growth) in the Sth house of fun and love af- 
fairs give them strong sexual drive. 


7. Here it is to note that conjunction of Jupiter with Venus-Mars conjunction will aggravate 
the sex drive but will not control it as some are saying. The same aggravating effect is by con- 
junction of Saturn or Neptune or Uranus with Venus-Mars. 


8. Nevertheless Mars-Jupiter conjunction for sex drive is not valid in the horoscopes of Sages 
like 1) Sri Aurobindo, 2) Pope Paul VI, 3) Saint Bernadette and 4) Sri Jayendra Saraswati. 


Sages or Spiritualists with Venus-Mars Conjunction 

9. This conjunction of Venus (good heart/ smoothness) and Mars (energy) is also found in 
the horoscopes of Sages or spiritualists like 1) Sri Krishna, 2) Sri Gautama Buddha, 3) Sri 
Rajneesh Osho, 4) Kyaukgu Sayadaw, and 5) Pha-Auk Tawya Sayadaw. 


Well Known Astrologers with Venus-Mars Conjunction 

10. The conjunction of Mars (warrior) and Venus (astrological knowledge) points out great 
astrologers like 1) B V Raman, 2) K. S. Krishnamurti, 13) K N Rao, 4) Alan Leo, 5) Charles 
E.O. Carter, and 6) Robert Hand, as mentioned in Maan Sagari classical text . 


Well Known Film Stars with Venus-Mars Conjunction 

11. The conjunction of Mars (capability) and Venus (art, film star) in connection of 5th house 
(art, film star, entertainment) signifies film stars like 1) Amitabh Bachchan, 2) Salam Khan, 
3) Sanjay Dutt, 4) Wai Lu Kyaw, 5) Madonna, 6) Tony Curtis, 7) Sally Field, 8) Jennifer 
Jones, and 9) Tommy Lee Jones. 


12. Here it is noted that some film stars have love affairs and they are doing volunteer works 
by Venus (good heart) connection with 6th (service to others) and 
12th (volunteer) houses. 


Notable Horoscopes with Venus-Mars Conjunction 
13. The Venus-Mars conjunction is also found in the notable horoscopes of 


1) Chengiz Khan, 2) Emperor Nero, 3) Mahatma Gandhi, 4) Dr. Abdul Kalam, 5) Manmohan 
Singh, 6) Ms. Aung San Suu Kyi, and 7) President U Htin Kyaw.

Hints 
If the cuspal sub lord of the 7th be the significator of 2, 7 or 11 marriage takes place during 
the joint period of the significators of 2, 7 and 11. 


For marriage: 

7th Cusp (Capricorn 20°.26’.40”): The sub lord of the 7 cusp is Ketu. Ketu is in the star of 
Sun and sub of Rahu. Ketu is occupant of 10. Ketu is conjoined with Venus. Venus is occu- 
pant of 10, owner of 4-11. Star lord Sun is occupant of 9, owner of 2. Sub lord Rahu is occu- 
pant of 4. Rahu is conjoined with Moon. Moon is occupant of 5, owner of 1. No planet in the 
star of Moon and Moon is CSL of 2-4.Thus 7t* sub lord Ketu signifies 10-4-11-9-2-4-5-1. 
Thus, marriage is sure. 


Joint period: 

At the time of judgment running dasa of Venus up to 13-03-2035. Joint period running is 
Venus-Venus up to 13-07-2018. 

Dasa-Bhukti lord Venus is in the star of Sun and of Venus. Venus is occupant of 10, owner 
of 4-11. Star lord Sun is occupant of 9, owner of 2. Thus, dasa-bhukti lord Venus signifies 4- 
10-11-9-2. Dasa-bhukti lord indicate 2-11. 

My opinion: You will marry before 13-07-2018. 


Outcome: He got married on 6th July 2018.

Meningioma - Brain Tumor 


By: Sumanadasa Namarathna (Sunaparantha Kalyan) 
Ex-Accountant, Justice of Peace 
No.22/1, Udugampola Road, Marapola, Veyangoda, 


SRI LANKA Email: sumanal946@gmail.com 











One of the KP students in Sri Lanka recently lost his beloved wife by a Brain Tumor and this student 
wanted me to analyze the natal chart of his wife to see how it happened according to KP System. The 
natal chart details are given hereunder. 

First of all I wish to Pranam my respected Guru Sri Tin Win ji, who have urged the KPEZ readers to 
investigate more and more on this subject, by giving his valuable and informative findings and evi- 
dences by his study article on Brain Tumor published in the KPEZ, July 2011 issue. 

My effort of today is to add some more information of Brain Tumor on Pathology and Medical Astrology 
for the benefits of my loving readers of KPEZ and KP students, as a mark of respect to my Guru. 


Brain Tumor 

A brain tumor is a mass or growth of abnormal cells in the brain. Many different types of brain tumors 
exist. Some brain tumors are noncancerous (benign), and some brain tumors are cancerous 
(malignant). As at today the medical researchers have identified 15 types of brain Tumor, namely 
Acoustic neuroma, Astrocytoma, Brain metastases, Choroid plexus carcinoma, Craniopharyngioma, 
Embryonal tumors, Ependymoma, Glioblastoma, Glioma, Medulloblastoma, Meningioma, Oligoden- 
droglioma, Pediatric brain tumors, Pineoblastoma and Pituitary tumors. 

Primary brain tumors originate in the brain itself or in tissues close to it, such as in the brain-covering 
membranes (meninges), cranial nerves, pituitary gland or pineal gland. 

Primary brain tumors begin when normal cells acquire errors (mutations) in their DNA. These muta- 
tions allow cells to grow and divide at increased rates and to continue living when healthy cells would 
die. The result is a mass of abnormal cells, which forms a tumor. 


Common signs and symptoms of Brain Tumor 

Changes in vision, such as seeing double or blurriness, Headaches like Migraine that worsen with 
time, Hearing loss or ringing in the ears, Memory loss, Loss of smell, Seizures (A seizure is a sudden, 
uncontrolled electrical disturbance in the brain. It can cause changes in the behavior, movements or feel- 
ings, and in levels of consciousness) Weakness in the arms or legs. 


Meningioma 

A meningioma is a tumor that forms on membranes that cover the brain and spinal cord just inside 
the skull. Specifically, the tumor forms on the three layers of membranes that are called meninges. 
These tumors are often slow-growing. As many as 90% are benign (not cancerous). Most meningiomas 
occur in the brain 


Brain Rulers in Medical Astrology 
The Brain is under the internal ruler ship of the Aries sign. The Cerebellum and base of the brain are 
ruled by Taurus sign. The degree on the Ascendant also strongly rules and influences the brain. The 
planet Mercury is the strong ruler of the brain. The Sun has special affinity with the brain. The brain 
substance is ruled by the Moon and Mercury. The meninges or brain coverings are ruled by the sign 
Cancer and Uranus. The right cerebral hemispheres are ruled by Mercury and the left cerebral hemi- 
spheres is under the rule of Mars. Brain balance is maintained by the secretions of the Thyroid Gland 
ruled by Mercury. 
e Meninges or the membranes (Brain Covering) of the brain is under the rule of Uranus and sign Can- 
cer. 
e Cerebral Meningitis (Inflammation) : The Sun or Uranus afflicted in Aries/ Moon in the 6th house 
and afflicted 

Accordingly the signs Aries, Taurus & Cancer and planets Sun, Moon, Mercury, Mars & Ura- 
nus and Ascendant rulers are responsible for the all matters pertaining to the brain. Any growth or 
abscess is under the rule of Jupiter.

Analysis - 

A) Ascendant 
The co-rulers of Lagna are Venus, Sun and Rahu. Venus is the lord of 1 (Lagana) and 2 

(Maraka) located in the 8th (Chronic illness/Surgery/Terminal), in its own star and in the sub 
of Sun, the lord of 5 in 10. The sign where Venus is, Sagittarius the 9th cusp, badhakasthana 
for Taurus Lagna, the lord of which Jupiter by being the sub lord of 6th, is in 4th(End of life/ 
Termination) cusp. Furthermore, No cusp commences in the sign Libra owned by Venus, due 
to intercepting and Libra is fully covered by the 6th, the house of disease. Venus aspects Aries 
sign by its 5th aspect (House to House Hindu aspect), that is filled with the effects of 12th 
cusp. Venus is opposite to 3rd cusp and also aspects Sth cusp. Venus is aspected by Jupiter 
(R), Bdhakasthanadipathi and Saturn. Hence Venus is a significator for 8-8-1,2-1,2 by star lev- 
el and 5, 10 by sub level and connected with 9, 12, 4, Sign Aries and planets Saturn(Planet of 
Sorrow/Termination) and Jupiter(R) (Karaka planet for tumors). 
Lagna Star Lord is Sun as discussed above. 

The sub lord of Lagna is Rahu. It is deposited in the 12th cusp in a star of Mercury the 
lord of 3(Away from Home) & 6(House of sickness), Rahu is in the sub of Saturn (Planet of Ter- 
mination), the lord of 10 & 11, in its own star and sub of Jupiter(R) and aspects 8th cusp. By 
being a Node, Rahu represents Moon, Jupiter and Saturn. The Moon is a significator for 11, 
10, 4, 6, 9, 12. As said above Badhakasthanadhipati Jupiter siagnifies 6, 4, 9, 12, 10, 11, 8 
and Saturn signifies 10, 11, 8. Being a malignant disease indicator, Rahu plays a vital role in 
this chart to push the native to the death. All the co-rulers are not auspicious for the native by 
signifying 6, 8, 12, Maraka, Bahdhaka and also dreaded planet Rahu and Saturn. 

Note : I wish to draw the attention of readers to my article, "Retrograded Planets and dis- 
eases", appeared in KPEZ, Feb. 2016. 


B) Aries Sign - (The ruling station of the brain) No cusp starts in this sign and it is hemmed by 
12th and Lagna. As a result of this interception, the sign Aries has become as a most detri- 
mental indicator in this chart by threatening not only to the head and brain, but the longevity 
of the native. Mars the owner of Aries sign and also 8th is dwelling in 11th cusp in the star of 
Jupiter(R) and in the sub of Kethu. Jupiter(R) is the lord of 9 (Badhaka) & 12(Hospitalization / 
Moksha /Renunciation /Terminal) deposited in 4th (End of Life/Terminal) cusp with an as- 
pect to the 8th cusp. Sub Lord Kethu is stationed in the 6th (House of Disease). It is in the star 
of above said Mars and in the sub of Saturn in its own star by repeatedly signifying 11th hosue 
for recovery from the ill-health, but badly connected with Jupiter(R), partaking the outcome of 
9 (Badhaka) and 12 (Moksha). Kethu, by being a node, is representing Moon, Mars, Mercury 
and Saturn. In addition to the ownership for 4th cusp, Moon is similar to the above discussed 
Saturn. Mercury the lord of 3(Away from home) & 6 (Disease) is in the star and sub of Rahu in 
12, which represents Moon, Jupiter and Saturn. 


C) Cancer Sign/Moon - The 4th cusp is located in this sign, the lord of which Moon is the sub 
lord also of the 4th cusp and situated in 11th, in the star of Saturn for 10, 11, 8 and in con- 
junction with same Saturn. The sub of Moon is Jupiter (R) a significator of 6, 9 & 12 in 4. 


D) Mercury - As discussed above Mercury is a significator for 12, 10, 3, 6 by star and sub level by 
connecting with Rahu, a distinguished indicator of this type of diseases including Cancer. Also 
Mercury is aspected by Jupiter(R) for 6, 4, 9, 12, 8. 


E) Sun+ - By being the lord of 5th (Immunity), Sun is in the 10th, in a star of Moon and in the sub 
of Kethu. Both of these planets have already been discussed and found guilty with their posi- 
tive signification for brain tumor. Also this Sun is a powerful significator for 10th, (Treatment 
not effective/Retirement from this world), being the sub lord for the same 10th with no planets 
in its stars. Lagna Lord and lord of 2 (Maraka) Venus, a significator for 1, 2, 8 is under the 
sub ruling of this Sun+. Hence the Sun+ is a significator for 11, 10, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 and connected 
with Moon, Mars, Mercury, Saturn by way of Kethu. 

F) Jupiter (R) - (Manuring planet of Tumor) As discussed above Jupiter is a significator for 6, 8, 
12 together with 9 (Badhaka) and 4, 10, 11. 


G) Uranus - Uranus is posited in the 5th house in the star of Sun for 5, 10 and in the sub of Mer-

cury the lord of 3 & 6 (Disease) in 10 (Medical treatments not effected). Uranus is said to be a 
co-ruler of Aquarius with Saturn.(Medical Astrology by Judith Hill). Saturn being a serious dis- 
ease indicator is opposite to Uranus. 

Max Heindel says in his "Message of the Star", "this Uranus-Saturn combination gives an unscrupu- 
lous nature with an extremely violent temper. The outbursts are as sudden as a bolt from the 
blue and exhaust the person completely. These aspects also indicate chronic or incurable diseas- 
es according to the signs wherein they are placed." 


Saturn is tenanted in the 11th cusp, Pisces owned by Jupiter(R) and the sub division too is under 
the rule of Jupiter(R). With these connections Saturn is a significator for 9(Badhaka), 12 and 4. 
In addition Uranus is aspected by Moon the lord and sub lord of 4 and 7 (Maraka) and Mars 
the lord of 7 (Maraka) & 8 ( critical illness/ surgery/death) in 11. Under these circumstances 
Uranus has become as a critical disease indicator by signifying 6, 8, 12, 7 (Maraka), 9 
(Badhaka), 4 (End of Life) together with 11, 5. Thus Uranus can be identified as a series dis- 
ease indicator especially for the imbalance of brain chemistry. 


H) 6th House- The house of disease is situated in the Virgo sign, the lord of which Mercury also 
the lord of 3 is posited in the 10th cusp (Paraloka Sadhana/Treatment not effective). In this 
chart Mercury bears the sub lord ship for houses 3, 5, 9 & 11. Except 3 & 9, other two houses 
are places of recovery from the illness. However it is to be noted that his Mercury is the sub 
lord for Badhaksthana and 3rd cusp for longevity and also badly connected with Rahu and 
Saturn (Malignant Disease Indicators) 

The star lord of 6th is Mars the lord of 7(Maraka) and 8 (Critical Illness/ Surgery/Death) is in 
11th. The sub lord of the 6th is Jupiter (R). It is the lord of 9 (Badhaka) and 12 
(Hospitalization/ Directed towards Moksha/Untreatable) and in the star of Kethu and in the 
sub of Saturn. Star lord Kethu is in 6th and Saturn the sub is the lord of 10 & 11 in 11. 

As per the above analysis of the house of disease, all the three co-rulers are in the life threatening 
stages. Especially the role of tumor ruling planet Jupiter(R) is worst.

By: Mahendrakumar K. Gajjar 
B/2/161, Madhuvrund Society, Swee Park, 
Ghatlodia, Ahmedabad — 380061; Email: mkgajjar53@gmail.com; 
Mobile: + 91 7878484993 











My friends Mr.& Mrs. Soni informed me on my cellphone that their son Mr. Parth Soni has 
applied for admission in three colleges of USA for further study of PhD and he is selected in 
all three colleges. He has applied for study of PhD in Indian Institute of Management Ahmed- 
abad and he has got offer of IIM for study of PhD also. 


Now they are confused which is good for their son, USA or India, for study of PhD; whether 
son will go for study of PhD to USA or he will select IIM for study of PhD? 


As per given birth details of Mr. Parth Soni, I cast horoscope for Mr. Parth Soni to check 
whether he will go for higher study of PhD to USA or not? 


Name: Parth Soni 

Birth Time: 8: 36: OO AM 

Birth Date: 3 February 1991 

Birth Place: Gandhinagar (Gujarat) 

Question: Will I be able to go abroad for higher study or not? 


Hint: If cuspal sub lord of 5th be significator of 9 then during DBA of 3, 9 & 12 then there is 
assurance of the event? 


Cuspal sub lord 

Sth cusp (Gemini 14°: 08’: 36”): The Sth cuspal sub lord Mercury is in star of Sun and in 
sub of Jupiter. Mercury is an occupant of 1land owner of 5 & 8. There is no planet in stars 
of Mercury, and Mercury is the cuspal sub lord of 1 , 5, & 7. Star lord Sun is an occupant of 
12 and owner of 7. Sub lord Jupiter is an occupant of 6 and owner of 2 & 11. There is no 
planet in stars of Jupiter but Jupiter is not sub of any other house cusp. Thus Mercury is 
the significator of 1, 2, 5, 6, 7, 8,11 and 12. 5t sub lord does not signify 9, thus there is no 
chance for going abroad for further study. 


My judgment and opinion: It is good for you, Mr. Parth Soni, to do PhD in India in IIM.USA 


is not suitable for study of PhD for you. You will not able to go USA for higher study of PhD. 
Thanks to my Guru Shri Kanak kumar Bosmia.

K.P. Rules for recovery of lost property---(see page 175-Reader-06 of Sri K . Subramanyam) 

1- the matter lost is shown by the lord of 24 cusp. 

2- recovery is indicated by the 11 cusp. 

3- the time of recovery is indicated by the significations of 2-6-11 house. 

4- the 8th house shows the possession of the thief / criminal. 

o- the 4th house indicates his profession and 5th house shows his gains owing to his crimes 
committed.

7- property lost will be judged from the hoses 2-6-11 from the house indicating the criminal. 
8- for the stolen property, if the RP’s at the time of judgment are strongly connected to 2,6,11 
houses, then the stolen property will be recovered; if the RPs are connected to 5,8,12 houses 
then, the stolen property will not be recovered. (also see KP Reader 6, page 235) 

--similarly check the Dasa lord/ Bhukthi lord/ Antra lord also. 

9- the 7th cusp sub lord shows the age of the criminal and its connection to the other houses 
indicates the relation of the criminal /thief. 


K.P. Rule-1: 

If the cuspal sub lord of 2 or 11 be the significator of 2 (movable article which is 
lost or stolen), 6 (article) or 11 (regaining), movable property will be regained during 
the joint period of the significations of 2, 6 and 11.

Recovery or regaining of stolen jewellery items

stolen. 6 house indicate loss to the thief, being 12‘ to the 7 (Thief) and 12t house indicate 
loss of native. 11th house stands for fulfillment of desires, success, profits & gains etc and

loss or expense) or 11 (recovery of losses, fulfillment of desire, success, profits & gains); re- 
covery of losses (lost money) is assured during the joint period of Significators (DBA) of 2, 6 
or 11.

12th to 6, opponent’s profits or gains), 8 (hindrances, obstacles, difficulties), 10 (being 12th 
to 11, negating recovery of losses, fulfillment of desire, success, profits & gains) or 12 (loss of 
native or Querent) recovery of losses or lost/stolen items) is not assured. 


Note: In case of any confusion we can cross-verified above said rules with 2nd CSL (Cuspal 
Sublord) to judge the final opinion.

4) node type: mean

KP CHART SETTINGS 
(by Tin Win in KP-Ezine August 2008 issue) 


KP Settings 
1. The SW settings for a KP chart are: 


(a) Geocentric positions 

(b) True positions for planets 
(c) Mean nodes 

(d) New KP Ayanamsa 

(e) Placidus house system 

(f) 365 D/Y Vimshottari dasa 


Geographic and Geocentric 

2. The geocentric latitudes calculated to the true center of the spheroid earth is commonly used to 
ensure much more accuracy and precision. The geographic latitudes assuming as if the earth is a per- 
fect sphere, which is not so, are automatically converted into the geocentric latitudes in astrological 
SWs, and it is usually a default setting. 


3. In order to properly use the tables of houses, which generally furnished geocentric latitudes, the 
conversion formulas and tables from geographic to geocentric latitudes are available in Astrosecrets & 
KP, Part 2, 2003, page 304-320 and Shri K. Hariharan: How to Cast and Read Your Horoscope, page 
78-87. Guruji KSK has mentioned the "tan" formula for conversion of the Geographic latitude into Ge- 
ocentric one in Astrology and Athrista, 1978 May. (Mrs. Kousalya Sattainathan says in her KP Astrolo- 
gy & Prime Ministers, page 3 that geographic latitude has been used and not geocentric because 
Gurujui KSK had used geographic latitude.) 


True Positions for Planets 
4. The true positions for planets (Sun to Saturn) are taken in all systems of astrology. 


True and Mean Nodes 

5. The Nodes are the points of ecliptic where the plane of Moon’s orbit intersects the plane of the 
Sun’s orbit. True is the exact position of the Nodes at any given time, while Mean is the presumed po- 
sition based on the average speed. The Mean Node assumes that the nodes are always moving in ret- 


KP Ezine July 2019 53 


rograde motion, whilst the True Node are occasionally moving direct too as if it's wobbling due to the 
wobble of the earth and the moon orbits. 


6. Sages Parasara and Jaimini's teaching is the constant Rahu retrogression which is also confirmed 
in Prasna Marga Rahu-Sun-Moon chakra and Jataka Parijatha. (Shri Sanjay Rath) Rahu and Kethu 
are ever retrograde. Never direct. (Sri M.P. Shanmugam: Astrosecrets & KP, 2003, page 27) 


7. The advantage of the True Nodes against the Mean ones is that when the Moon is in exact conjunc- 
tion with them, it has indeed a zero latitude. This is not true with the Mean Nodes. However, this 
seems somewhat illusory because the True Nodes are true only twice a month when the Moon crosses 
the ecliptic. Positions given for the times in between those two points are just a hypothesis. They are 
founded on the idea that celestial orbits can be approximated by elliptical elements. This works well 
with the planets, but not with the Moon, because its orbit is strongly perturbed by the Sun. True 
Nodes are applied by Shri V. K. Choudhry’s System Analysis followers and Westerners. 


New KP Ayanamsa 
8. It has been found in Mr. Kanak’s research that the New KP Ayanamsa (KP & Astrology Year Book 
2003) is working better than Lahiri Ayeanamsa especially in the Sookshma dasa level. 


Placidus House System 
9 The Placidus house system is one of three pillars of KP, together with Hindu zodiac and Vimshottari 
dasa. 


360 D/Y vs 365.25 D/Y Vimshottari dasa 

10. Only 365.25 days (interval of time taken by Sun to leave any one position in the Zodiac and again 
reach the same position) must be taken for a year and 360 D/Y is taken for convenience and for cal- 
culation of sub sub (DBAS) periods. (KP Reader I, page 97) 

The common application of 360 D/Y-based sub sub dasa tables does not mean using a 360 D/Y as 
long as 356 D/Y is applied in the Mahadasa calculation. 


11. Almost all East and West vedic astrologers have used 365 D/Y Vimshottari dasa without giving 
attention to the arguments of a few 360 D/Y advocates. 


Observation 

12. The settings of Geocentric positions, true positions for planets, Mean nodes and 365 D/Y 
Vimshottari dasa are in line with most Vedic astrologers, and however, KP Ayanamsa and Placidus 
house system are the particular features of KP.

" An event occurs during the period of significators of the houses concerning the event, when the 
Transit agrees." 


The KP rule is very simple but in practice it is MOST difficult in fixing the time of occurrence. I studied 
KP as hobby. 


Selection of DBAS lords from the effective significators is not an easy task. I have made exercise to 
predict marriage of my grandson. His natal chart and my analysis are attached for your kind perusal. 


DBAS lords I selected are RA - JU - ME - MO. (30-3-2022 to 9-4-2022). Sun and Moon transit in Pi- 
sces Jup sign, Merc star. 


Mer and Moon are fruitful and strong significators. But Rahu and Jup are semi fruitful significators 
only. Present Dasa running is Rahu and is up to 12-9-2036. If Rahu is left, next Jup is also semifruit- 
ful, next Sat is negative significator, next comes Merc the fruitful significator. By the end of Rahu dasa 
he completes 44yrs of age. So taking his age into consideration I take Rahu as Dasa lord. Similarly 
Jupi though semifruitful, is selected as Bhukti lord due to age factor of the native. 


I request your kind guidance in this matter.

UK’s new Prime Minister Boris Johnson 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 











Boris Johnson was born was on 19 June 1964, in New York, at about 2pm. to English 
parents, and educated in Europe. He began his career in journalism; and became Major of 
London (4 May 2008 - 9 May 2016), then Secretary of State for Foreign and Commonwealth 
Affairs (13 July 2016 - 9 July 2018). Johnson had dual citizenship in the United Kingdom 
and the United States, and renounced his US citizenship in 2016 to demonstrate his loyalty 
to the UK.

shown by the following signification of 5th, 7th and 11th CSLs. 


oth (love affairs) cuspal sub lord Sun is in house 9, lord of house 12, in the star of Mars in

Subsequent upon the bifurcation of the erstwhile united Andhra Pradesh into two separate states, 
there has been a general hue and cry by the past and present state governments and the public for 
the past few years. A lot of discussions and arguments were going on in the press and T.V channels. 
No day is passed without any news item on this issue. Since I am also a resident of AP state, I became 
curious about this issue, and as an astrologer, I thought of knowing the outcome of this long pending 
one with the help of astrology especially by way of our KP Horary method. And the outcome is the 
above horary question. 


Query:- About the Special Status of A.P. (Self-Questioned as an astrologer). 
Time Chart Particulars:- 

Date & Day:- 01-07-2019; 

Monday; Time:-02-24-13 PM; 

Place:-Kurnool. AP. 


After erecting the Time Chart, let us check Moon & Lagna as they indicate the nature of the mind of 
the querent & the nature of the query of the querent respectively. 

In this Time Chart, Moon (8-10) is in the star of Mars (9-2,7) and in the sub of Jupiter(2-3,6). Moon is 
the lord of 10th house and there is no occupant. So Moon is a strong significator for 10th house. 
Lagan CSL Ketu(3) is in the star of Venus(8-1,8) and in the sub of Saturn(3-4,5). Ketu is the occupant 
of 3rd house. No planets in Ketu stars. So Ketu is a strong significator for the 3rd house. 

NOTE:-The question is regarding the Special Status of A.P. So 3 or 10 or 11 should be signified by 
Moon and Lagna CSL. Then only we can say the querent is genuine and we can continue for judgment 
of the Query. 


Co-ordinates for our judgment --- 

--3rd house indicates a letter of communication by way of an ordinance issued by the Central 
Government stating that Special Status is given to AP and so on. 

--10th house denotes the Central Government; name and fame; power and status; Success and 
status; respect and reputation; ambition and authority; 

--11th house shows hopes, wishes and aspirations and their realization; Success in all undertakings; 
Profits and incoming wealth to A.P. State; 

From the above-mentioned analysis, it is learnt that the query is a genuine one. So we can proceed 
further analyze the Time Chart. 


K.P. Rule for Special Status of A.P.:- If the 10th Cuspal Sublord signifies 3 or 10 or 11 then only we 
will get the Special Status for our A.P. during the conjoined period of the significators of 3-10-11. 


In this Time Chart, the 10th Cuspal Sublord Rahu(9) is in the star of Jupiter(2-3,6) and in the sub of 
Mercury(9-9,12). Rahu is conjoined with Sun(9-11). Sun is the lord of the 11th house and no planets 
are placed in 11th. So Sun is a strong significator for 11th house. Thus Rahu signifies 3 and 11. 

From this above K.P. Rule, it is very clear that the Special Status will be given to A.P. by the Central 
Government. But it is highly impossible because see the following lines which are enunciated by our 
late Shri. K.S.K. Ji, in Horary Astrology, VI Reader-Page No. 146:- 


“Planets in direct motion if deposited in the constellation of a retrograde planet, one cannot 
have success. (For retrograde motion take only Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn. 
Rahu and Ketu should not be considered as retrograde, as these two nodes never appear to 
retrace the path travelled by them. When all planets, in direct motion moves in one direction 
Rahu and Ketu move in the opposite direction. But they do not take such a direction by which 
the Sun or Moon ever travel.) 


In this Time Chart, the 10th Cuspal Sublord Rahu is in the star of Jupiter and in the sub of Mercury.
