Getting tender of wine shop 
(A KP Numerology Analysis) 


Background Note: On 2: January 2019, one of my Astro friend Mr. Surendra Sharma from 
Rajasthan has asked query over facebook messenger about getting of tender of wine shop; for which 
necessary formalities had been successfully completed; and he was much affirmative of getting tender 
in terms of Vedic Astrology; but want to know further in terms of Stellar Astrology; and hence he 
approached me to check. At the time of query at 12:35 PM; I am not in a position to check the query in 
terms of K.P. Stellar Astrology; as I was travelling in a local train; and hence, I decided to check this 
with the help of K.P. Numerology; and told them this time you will not get the tender; but future scope 
of getting it is good and you have to make several attempts to get it in future. 


Major question taken — Will I get success to get tender of wine shop? 


Name of the Querent : Mr. Surendra Sharma 
Date-Time-Place of query : 02-01-2019, 12:35 PM, Sikar, Rajasthan 
ANALYSIS 


Time of Prashna (Query) is 12:35 PM.

Answer 1: 

KP Reader III, pp 197-8 — Planets in houses 1,2,3,6,10 and 11 indicates gain to you, i.e. victory 
over enemies; success in litigation; win in competition and gain in lottery, games etc. , but 
planets in 4,5,7,8,9 and 12 will cause loss to you. 


The planets transiting in the star and sub of in houses 1,2,3,6,10 and 11 indicates gain to you, 


KP Ezine August 2019 33 


and the planets transiting in the star and sub of in houses 1,2,3,6,10 and 11 indicates loss to 
you. 


This is for the transit analysis and the same for dasa analysis. 


Question 2: Badhaka houses 
It is mentioned that "XI, IX and VII are the badhaka houses for people born in movable, fixed 


and common signs respectively." 
Pl clarify: 
1. Here sign is which sign? Lagna Sign or moon sign ir 
2. House is traditional house system or KP Cusp system 


I shall be thankful if you could pl make it more comprehensive if possible. 


Answer 2: 
1. Regarding birth, movable, fixed and common signs, Lagna sign is to be considered. 


2. Regarding house system, the KP Placidus house chart is to be used. In KP, the badhaka, 
maraka are Placidus-Bhava- based, for instance, KP Reader VI pp 156-157. 


3. 1. If the Lagna cusp sub lord signifies live supporting houses 1,5, 11 (not badhaka) (12+t to 
houses 2,6,12) and do not signify the maraka and badhaka houses, then long life is expected. 
If the Lagna cusp sub lord signifies the maraka and badhaka houses only and not the life sup- 


porting houses, then short life is expected. 
If the Lagna cusp sub lord signifies maraka and badhaka houses along with the life supporting 
houses, then medium life is expected. 


Question 3: 

I used to read your valuable articles in kp ezine. I want to know the astrology for age old per- 
sons, above 60yrs who are not having enough money to survive. For some people it happens 
that their service or business life come to an end early in life. I just want to know about their 
support systems through kp astrology means the combinations and cuspal sub lords for that. As 
I have observed some are having earning wife in early life, then the children. Some have proper- 
ty and rented income. Some are supported by parents pension for some time, and then some 
are supported by charity organizations. 


Sir, hope i will get the answer or the copy of article earlier written. 
Answer 3: 
Fate of a native should be analyzed by own birth chart for events in life and dasa analysis for 


timing of these events. 


1. The KP Badhaka, Maraka are (Asc. and) Bhava- based, not (Moon and) rasi- based. 
2. In KP, the Badhaka, Maraka, Moksha are Placidus-Bhava- based, for instance: 


(1) KP Reader VI (any Edition) pp 156-157; 
(2) C.R. Bhatt: Further Light of Nakshatra Chinttamani pp 31, 158; 
(3) K. Hariharan: How to Judge Longevity? pp 32, 68, 82; 


(4) K.P. & Astrology 2005 p 16 (Vijay Kumar: Father's Sickness, A KP Appraisal) 
3. The KP significators (grade A to D) of the houses 2,7 and 11 by any KP SW are the same ac- 
cording to Placidus house system, whether the signifcators are for marriage or Badhaka, Ma- 
rarka, in the same way of bhava-based. 
3. For longevity it's to judge 1st (mainly), 3rd and 8th cuspal sub lords but not to take that lst 
cuspal sub lord's signification of houses 1,3,8 for long life.

As usual this is the annual KP magazine for 2019 of 43 articles contributed by 36 authors, 
as shown in the contents. 


It needs to be careful in reading some articles. For examples, in judging longevity , it may not 
be reasonable that the signification of houses 1,3,5,8, 9 (not Badhaka and 11 (not Badhaka) 
by the sub lords of 1, 3 and 8 cusps indicates long life. Because only houses 1, 5 and 11 (not 
Badhaka) have rationale for long life and life saving as they are 12th to Maraka house 2, dis- 
ease house 6 and Moksha death house 12. House 8 is danger for life, serious incident and 
house 3, 8th form house 8. may not be favorable for long life. Rationale of house 9 for long life 
is not Known, and it is not taken for long life in the six KP Readers. 


It may not be reasonable to conclude that the Punarphoo may disturb all events in life by 
mere connection of Moon and Saturn. 


The whole idea of Punarphoo is condensed by Guruji KSK in one paragraph below. 
"Whenever Saturn has got any connection what-so-ever with Moon, there will be some 
obstacle or impediment, not only during negotiation but also at the time of fixation and even 
at the time of celebration of the marriage. This connection between Moon and Saturn causes 
delay, though ultimately both of them do much more good with a better partner." (KP Reader 


KP Ezine August 2019 35 


IV page 74) 

Saturn-Moon connection is only part of the equation which can give very different results 
depending on their significations and relation with other planets. This connection is not be- 
nefic or malefic by itself and inferring the conclusion other than delay effect by just relying 
on the mere Saturn-Moon connection would be baseless. Such conclusions are not yet prov- 
en by systematic approach or research and so it is not to worry about Punarphoo. 

It isn’t true to say that KP horary never fails because horary can’t give what is not promised 
in the birth chart which reflects a native’s past karma. Horary is not a substitute for birth 
chart. 


One interesting marriage case is in the article, “Marriage and Divorce- Saturn’s Supremacy’, 
where divorce took place on 4th day of marriage because the boy was impotent. 


In the article of KP astrological analysis on glaucoma, it is said that in short, planets Sun, 
Moon and Venus as malefic one suffers from problems or diseases related to eye-sight. 
Moreover , check the sub lords of bhavas 6 and 8 also. 


Regarding Sade-Sati, Saturn is not always malefic, depending its position and signification 
as per KP astrology. According to Meenakshi Raut’s study on Benefic and Malefic Effects of 
Saturn’s Sade-Sati, a gloomy view of Sade-Sati should not be taken unless the entire horo- 
scope is analyzed properly. (Empirical Insights in Vedic Astrology, Sane Publications, 1999, 
pp 201-217) So there is nothing to worry about Saturn in the period of Sade-Sati.

2020 Democratic Presidential Candidates 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 











The 2020 US presidential election is in full swing, and as the country wonders aloud who will 
be the official Democratic candidate challenging President Donald Trump on November 3, 
2020, it's only natural to start looking ahead. But between today and Election Day, there are 
dozens of important events to keep in mind: Democratic presidential primary debates, the 
voter registration, the primary elections, the Republican and Democratic conventions. 





In order to choose the party's nominees for President and Vice President of the United States 
in the 2020 U.S. presidential election, the 2020 Democratic National Convention is sched- 
uled to be held from July 13-16, 2020 in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. 


While there are many Democratic presidential candidates, by all realistic measures such as 
polling and fundraising, former Vice President and Delaware Senator Joe Biden, Vermont 
Senator Bernie Sanders, Massachusetts Senator Elizabeth Warren, California Senator Kama- 
la Harris and South Bend, Indiana Mayor Pete Buttigieg have consistently stayed at the top 
of the competitive race for the 2020 nomination. 


The horoscopes of these five Democratic presidential candidates have been analyzed from the 
following perspectives: 


Table 1: 10t8 Cuspal Sub Lord’s Significators for gaining power; 

Table 2: 1st Cuspal Sub Lord’s Significators for Ascendant’s strength for higher 
status; 

Table 3: Dasa Lord’s Significators for timing of the Democratic National 
Convention from July 13-16, 2020; 

Table 4: Bhukti Lord’s Significators for July 13-16, 2020; 

Table 5: Antra Lord’s Significators for July 13-16, 2020; and 

Table 6: Transiting Dasa Period Lords’ Star & Sub Significators for July 14, 2020. 


Based on this analysis, in my opinion Joe Biden has the best chance to be nominated for the 
Democratic presidential candidate, followed by Elizabeth 

Warren since Bernie Sanders’s 10t cuspal sub lord does not signify 10tt house and 

his Dasa lord’s signification is not strong enough.

A client has asked me to predict when he will enter into service and acquir a residential plot.

DOB: 6-12-1979; Time: 6-40 AM; POB: Vijayawada (Long: 80-39’ E Latt: 16-31’ N) 


Entry into job or service: 

The relevant houses of job or service are 2, 6, 10. If the sublord of the cusp of 6th or 10th be 
the significators of 2, 6, 10, the native will earn money by service or profession during the 
joint period of significators of 2, 6, 10. 


In the horoscope of the native, the sublord of the 6t* and 10t8 cusp is Moon. Moon, having 
no planet in its stars, is in 7 lord of 9. It is in the star of Rahu and sub of Sun. Rahu 
represents Sun, lord of 10t# house being in the sign of Leo. Rahu also conjoined with Mars 
the lord of 6 house and Jupiter lord of 2"4 house. Moon finally signifies 2,6,10 and con- 
nected to 10th. Hence the native is promised with earnings through job or service.

above.

agrees. The joint period of Sat-Ven-Jup runs from 30-12-2006 to 2-6-2007 for the native to 
enter into the service. Actually the native joined the job on 19-2-2007.

KP Rule: 
2nd house denotes increase in the number of members of family due to birth of child. 5th 
house is considered for child birth. It indicates first child or conception or progeny. 


8th house signifies sexual urge. 10th house indicates achievement of any undertakings. Being 
106 from 8th is 5th house which indicates result of sex. Thus 5th house stands 1st child birth. 
7th house stands 2nd child birth or second conception. 11 is the 5th from 7. The 5th for 
female and 11th for male are important. 


Analysis: 

Sun, Mars and Jupiter are male planets. Moon, Venus and Rahu are female planets. Mercury 
and Ketu are neutral gender. Odd number signs (1/3/5/7/9/11) indicates male child. Even 
number signs (2/4/6/8/10/12) indicates female child. However it is most difficult to predict 
about Gender of Child. 


7th Cusp (Libra 26°.40'.00”): 7 cusp Sublord is Venus. Venus is in the star of Rahu and in 
the sub of Venus. Venus is the occupant of 6 and owns 2 and 7. In Venus star no planet is 
there. Venus is CSL of 6-7-11 houses. Star lord Rahu is the occupant of 3. Rahu is agent of 
Moon. Moon is occupant of 8 and owns 4. Sublord Venus is already discussed. Hence Venus 
signifies 2-7-11. So Second issue is promised. 


Joint rulers of 7 cusp ( Libra 26°.40'.00" ) Venus ( Sign lord ) Jupiter ( Star lord ) Venus 
(Sublord ) are responsible for the determination of second child birth. 


7th cusp rises in male sign in female arc. So the sex of the child is female. 

7th cusp sign lord and sublord are Venus. Venus is posited in male sign but degrees are in 
Moon arc. So the sex of child is female. 

Star lord Jupiter which is in own star posited in female sign and in female arc. So star lord 
also indicates sex of child as female. 


Hence joint rulers of 7t cusp sign, star and sub indicate the sex of child as female.

1) Ascendant sublord should signify 1-5-9-11 for long life of event. (if you select sthira

Rule:- If the cuspal sub lord of the Asc. be the significator (in the star of the occupant or 
owner) of the Badhaka and Maraka houses, then the life is short. Badhaka bhava is more 
danger than Maraka bhava. If the cuspal joint rulers (the sign lord, star lord and sub lord) of 
the Asc. or the 8th cusp be the significators (in the star of the occupant or owner) of the 
Badhaka and Maraka houses, then their joint period is very critical for life.

lord of 4,5 in star of Ketu which is occupant of 12 in sign of Jup which is occupant of 4 and 
lord of 9,12. Further Moon is in sub of Jupiter which is occupant of 4 and lord of 9,12. Here

lord of 1st cusp (health) and 4th cusp (chest). Ketu is occupant of 4t* cusp (chest) in sign of

ka, end of life. Rahu is already discussed above. So the cuspal joint rulers of Ascendant are 
the significators of Maraka /Bhadhaka and ghataka houses. 


8th cusp sublord is Mars which is lord of 12th house in the star of Jupiter, occupant of 8 
ghataka and lord of 1st cusp (health) and 4th house (chest), further Mars is in sub of Saturn 
lord of 2nd house Maraka. 


Now the joint rulers of ascendent (the sign lord, star lord and sublord) are significators of 
maraka, bhadhaka and ghataka houses, so their joint period is very critical for life. At the

By: M.V Guptha - Kavali

Andhra Pradesh, India

One of my friends asked me about Mr. Siddartha cafe coffee day founder is alive or not? 
He asked me at 3.38P.M. on 30.07.2019. 


Now I'm going to analyse the nature of Mr. Siddartha's death using Time Chart. 


Date of Judgement: 30.07.2019 

Time of Judgement: 15.38.00 

Place of Judgement: Kavali 14.57.00 N, 80.02 E 
Ayanamsha: 249.02'.25" 


KP Rule: 

The 8th house is called House of Death. Mostly Hindus consider this house as the end of 
one's life in this world. This house also conveys whether it is natural death or unnatural one 
such as drowning, fire accident, or suicide or due to chronic disease and whether it is slow or 
sudden and violent death. 


Analysis: 
1) To commit suicide, sublord of the 8th cusp should be in the constellation of a planet 
which is the significator of Maraka or Badhaka and also 1 and 8 houses. 


2) The sublord of the 8th cusp should have some kind of connection with Mars and Ketu. 


3) Moon should also be afflicted with Airy sign connection with Saturn, and Mars aspect or 
conjunction as this combination produce negative thoughts to the native. 


4) If there is any kind of relationship or connection between / among the co-rulers of the as- 
cendant and 8th cusp, then the native only will be cause of his/her own end, 


5) The assasin is represented by the 7th house of the native. It is well known fact to all of us 
that the 7th house represents all the persons who have dealing with the native. When the 
sublord of the 7th cusp is deposited in the constellation of planet signifying maraka or 
bhadhakasthana and also 8th house of the native, then the native will be assassinated in the 
hands of assasin. 


6) An event generally happens during the joint chiefs dasa period of the relevant significators 
when the transit agrees. 


7) Place of death of the individual can be Known by the placement of either the 8th cusp sub- 
lord or its star lord in which sign it is posited. 


Let us apply the above mentioned rules one by one. 


8th cusp sub lord is Moon and is in the star of Rahu and in the sub of Mars. Moon is occu- 
pant of 7th house. Moon is in positional status. Moon is the CSL of 8. Star lord Rahu is occu- 
pant of 7 and agent of Mercury. Mercury owns 8 and 10 houses.- Sub lord Mars is also in 
positional status. Mars occupant of 8 and owns 1-5-12..-So 8th cusp sublord Moon signifies 
7-8-10-1-5-12.

Questions and Answers 

Question 1: Favorable and Unfavorable Houses 

I shall be ever so grateful to you if you can enlighten me on the following and oblige: 

1)In the August number pp33, Sri Tin Win was answering to question on good and bad 
planets as explained in the KP Reader 111 PP 197-8. It surely must be a typo that on page 
34 also the same 1,2,3,6,10,11 are mentioned. It should read 4,5,7,8,9,12 instead I believe. 


2) The question that was raised was whether these houses are static or dynamic. By static I 
mean if the good and bad houses do not change and are reckoned from the Ascendant for all 
the 12 houses while they are dynamic if they are reckoned in relation to the house under 
study like, for 2nd. house good houses are: 2,3,4,7,11,12 and bad houses are 5,6,8,9,10 and 
1; for 3rd. house the good houses are 3,4,5,8,12,1 and bad houses are 6,7,9,10,11,2. 


3) Now here is the clincher. Consider analysis for Proneness to disease. 1st. CSL becomes the 
Prime and 6,8,12 supporting the issue. In this case the confusion is that of house 6. It isa 
good house favoring the progress and or wellbeing of 1 as per para (1) above and at the same 
time bad because its very connection to lst. house establishes sickness. Another example 
based on belief that the houses are evaluated dynamically. In the case of defect in speech or 
vision 2nd. CSL becomes the Prime and 12,8 become supportive cusps. Here 12 is a well- 
wishing house. How then can one take it to support’ vision defects? 
Wishing you and all the members of KPEzine a happy _ Krishnashtami. 


Answer 1: 

The cuspal sub lord of a house indicates whether the matter of the house is favorable 
(promised) or not. The significators point the time of event. Both dasa, bhukti and gochara 
(transit) must agree. 

-KP Reader V page 224 (1971 Edition p 211), KP Reader III pp 226, 362 (1971 Edition, Prac- 
tical Part pp 68, 194) 


For a native’s richness, if his or her second cuspal sub lord signifies houses 2,6,11, one can 
be rich; 5,8,12, one can be poor. 


It isn’t correct to say that for 2nd.house good houses are: 2,3,4,7,11,12 and bad houses are 
5,6,8,9,10 and 1; for 3rd.house the good houses are 3,4,5,8,12,1 and bad houses are 
6,7,9,10,11,2. 


For any kind of competition, 1,2,3,6,10 & 11 houses are desirable or winning or good hous- 
es; 4,5,7,8,9 & 12 are undesirable or loosing or bad houses. (Pl see KP Reader III & V) 

If the DBAS lords signify desirable houses, one can win in any competition during that joint 
dasa period; undesirable houses, one can loose. 

In KP there is no static or dynamic houses; only main house and supporting houses; for ex- 
ample for marriage 7th house is main house and 2, 11 are supporting houses.

Impeachment Inquiry against 


President Donald Trump 





| | By: Tin Win 
am 4. 07). 4 Email: tw853@yahoo.com 





On Sept. 24, 2019, House Speaker Nancy Pelosi announced the beginning of an official 
impeachment inquiry against President Trump, saying "I'm directing our six committees to 
proceed with their investigations under that umbrella of impeachment inquiry. The president 
must be held accountable. No one is above the law." 

Calls for an inquiry had grown after Trump acknowledged asking the Ukrainian president to 
investigate potential Democratic presidential candidate Joe Biden, a Key political rival, for his 
own political gain. This information is contained in a now-public whistleblower report that 
laid out the actions of Trump; his personal lawyer, Rudolph W. Giuliani, attorney general 
William Barr; and other officials in the United States and Ukraine. The report includes the 
allegation that White House officials used a classified computer system to hide documents 
that could be politically damaging, including a transcript of a call with Ukrainian President 
Volodymyr Zelensky. 





Who's who in the whistleblower complaint 


If the evidence is strong enough, the committee crafts articles of impeachment — criminal 
charges — and sends them to the full House. The House can impeach with a simple majority 
of 218 out of 435 seats and the Democrats currently control 235 seats. The articles then go 
to the Senate, where a trial takes place, with representatives from the House acting as 
prosecutors and the president and his attorneys presenting his defense. The chief justice of 
the Supreme Court presides over the trial in the Senate. While formal impeachment 
proceedings looks quite possible, it is important to remember that it is unlikely to remove 
Trump from office due to the Republican control of the Senate. For the House impeachment 
vote to be confirmed, 67 out of 100 votes in the Senate are required. That would mean that 
at least 20 GOP senators would have to vote to impeach. 

Unless there are some new revelations against Trump -- and his polls numbers start to 
decline sharply -- the Senate will not convict Trump on impeachment charges. If the 
president is convicted, the vice president would then take over the White House. 


For Trump the running joint dasa periods are: Ju-Ju dasa from 7 Oct 2016 to 25 Nov 2018, 
and Ju-Sa dasa from 26 Nov 2018 to 08 June 2021.

KP Muhurat analysis for Chandrayaan-2 
lunar exploration mission 


By: VSN. Murthy, (K.P. Astro Consultant) 
#404, Teja Garden Apartments, Prakashnagar, 
KURNOOL- 4. (AP) Mobile:- 09440220874. E-mail:- vsnm_vdl@yahoo.co.in; 








Chandrayaan-2 is the second lunar exploration mission developed by the Indian Space 
Research Organisation (ISRO), after Chandrayaan-1. It consists of a lunar orbiter, 
the Vikram lander, and the Pragyan lunar rover, all of which were developed in India. The 
main scientific objective is to map the location and abundance of lunar water via Pragyan, 
and ongoing analysis from the orbiter circling at a lunar polar orbit of 100 x 100 km. 


The mission was launched to the Moon from the second launch pad at Satish Dhawan Space 
Centre on 22 July 2019 at 2-43-12 PM IST by a Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle 
Mark III (GSLV Mk II). The craft reached the Moon's orbit on 20 August 2019 and began 
orbital positioning manoeuvres for the landing of Vikram lander. Vikram and the rover were 
scheduled to land on the near side of the Moon, in the south polar region at a latitude of 
about 70° south at approximately 1:50 am on 7 September 2019 and conduct scientific 
experiments for one lunar day, lasting two Earth weeks. However, at about 1:52 am IST, the 
lander deviated from its intended trajectory at around 2.1 kilometres (1.3 mi) from landing, 
communication was lost and apparently crashed. The orbiter, part of the mission with 8 
scientific instruments, remains operational and will continue its year-long mission to study 
the Moon. Scientists have extended the mission period to a possible seven and a half years 
citing "conservative use of fuel". 


From the above information, it is learnt that (1) Chandrayan-2 was launched on Monday, 
22-07-2019, at 14hrs-43mts-12sec. at Satis Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota; and (2) The 
lander deviated from its intended trajectory at around 2.1 K.M. from landing, communication 
was lost and apparently crashed.---Why it is happened so? Let us check the muhurtha as 
per K.P. Muhurtha rules laid down by Sri. Kanakkkumar B. Bosmia ji in his book named 
“Easy Way to learn KP Muhurat” 


K.P. Rules for launching Chandrayan are shown respectively hereunder:- 

1. Ascendant Cuspal Sublord should signify houses 1-5-9-11 for long life of event.(If you 
select sthira (fixed) lagna, do not consider 9th), 

2. 31d/9th/ 12th Cuspal Sublord should signify houses 3-9-12. 

3. 8 Cuspal Sublord should not signify houses 8 & 12. 

4. Do not select chara (Movable) lagna. (Aries, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn lagnas are known as 
movable lagnas). 

9. Dasa-Bhukthi should signify houses 3-9-12. 


In this Muhurat Chart:- 

1) Ascendant cuspal sublord Sun(8-10) is in the star of Saturn(2-3,4) and in the sub of Sat- 
urn(2-3,4). As the lagna is in a fixed sign, the 9th house lord (Moon) will become a badhaka 
lord. The signification of houses 1-5-11 is not at all reflected to give the long life in this issue. 
2) 34 CSL Moon(4-9) is in the star of Saturn(2-3,4) and in the sub of Mercury(8-8,11). Here 
house 3 is signified at stellar level and 9 is signified at planet level. 12th signification is not 
reflected here. 

9th CSL Venus(8-7,12) is in the star of Jupiter(1-2,5) and in the sub of Sun(8-10). Only 12 is 
signified at planet level. No signification of 9 & 12 in any level. 

12th CSL Mercury(8-8,11) is in the star and sub of Saturn(2-3,4). Here only 34 signification is 
reflected at star and sublevel. No signification of 9 & 12. 

3) 8th CSL Jupiter(1-2,5) is in the star of Mercury(8-8,11) and in the sub of Venus(8-7,12). 
Here both houses 8 & 12 are signified by the 8th CSL Jupiter. This rule is fully satisfied 
negatively.

Progeny vs Barrens in Barrens 


By: Sumanadasa Namarathna (Sunaparantha Kalyan) 
Ex-Accountant, Justice of Peace 
No.22/1, Udugampola Road, Marapola, Veyangoda, 


SRI LANKA Email: sumanal946@gmail.com 








‘EERE EREREEREEREREEREEEEEEEEEEEEREEREEEEEEEEEE HH 


Birth of a child is considered to be a great blessing and content of parents, as well as their 
living elders like Dad & Mum and all other family members. If a couple is not fortunate to get 
any issue, their sorrowful feelings are indescribable. It is considered that childlessness as a 
great sin or misfortune in view of devotional factors and also it motivates to undergo many 
types of medical treatments as well as to follow various methods of oblations. 


At present the childlessness is a major problem in the society and same is an unsolvable 
question for the Astrologers too. At the time of matching (Porutham) the very first question of 
the parents of the boy and girl is whether they are lucky to have children. In love marriages 
they need not to have such a prediction for child birth at the time of fulfilling their desire of 
co-habitation, but after sometimes with no progeny they too rush to astrologers and physi- 
cians. The Physician cannot see the chances of progeny by means of any type of medical in- 
vestigations and what he can do is to use trial and error method only. But Astrologer can 
forecast whether they are lucky or not to have a child by investigating the natal charts. 


At the time of the matching of the charts of a couple, when an astrologer sees the chance of 
progeny, it has to be declared to the parties concerned for their happiness. But in some such 
cases, having confirmed the fertility by using KP or any astrological rules, the astrologer is 
failed and blamed by the parties due to not having the children for the couple. 


As an astrologer, looking for the end result of a matter to see, HOW? and WHY?, and as an 
old man, who has not yet fortunate to be a grandfather, this author is still in search of a 
planetary influences for negative results of the progeny, which are not academically availa- 
ble by means of teachings in any astrological school. Also I have come across several progeny 
cases for no child, while the natal chart reflect the positive results with satisfying the rules 
and also positive significations of the Maha Dasa lord for child birth. While I was seriously 
dissatisfied with my finding for the reason of No Child cases, an article appeared in KPEZine 
June 2019 issue, written by my learned Astro friend Sri VSN Murthy ji under the caption of 
Denial of Progeny. In the natal chart he has discussed, the progeny is clearly indicated as 
per the KP rules but no positive results obtained yet. In his article, Sri Murthy ji has lucidly 
discussed all available and known rules for Positive and Negative results of progeny matters 
for the particular native. After reading the said article I was forced by myself to investigate 
again to pick a common rule or pattern for no progeny in a chart, which indicates positive 
results for child birth. 


With respect to the child birth matter in Astrology, there are two categories of components 
under BARRENNESS. They are, 

Barren Planets 

Barren Signs 

Barren Planets : The planets classed as barren are the SUN, SATURN, MARS, KETHU and 
URANUS. 

Barren Signs : Aries, Gemini, Leo, Virgo 

(Encyclopedia of Medical Astrology by Dr. H.L.Cornell) 


In case of barren signs, when we go back to our astrological studies, we cannot see a com-

roles in the charts. 


What is Sun? 
The Sun is hot, dry, Fiery and Barren. 


Barrenness by Sun ( Ency. of Medical Astrology) 

The Sun and malefics in barren signs, and dominating the houses of children, the 5th and 
11th houses and also the MC. 

The Sun and the malefics being the rulers of offspring in the map and in barren signs. 

The Sun is in Capricorn and afflicted.

Saturn and Mars 

The Sun, Uranus, Saturn or Mars in the 5th or 11th houses and afflicted. 

The Sun, Saturn and Mars deny children. 


What is Saturn? 

Generally Saturn is labeled as a malefic planet. But as per KP rules it is not so, as illustrated 
in my article "Is Saturn always malefic?" published March 2012 in this reputed magazine. 
With respect to the child birth matter under discussion, Saturn is a barren (KP Reader II, pg 
431), Abortive Tendencies (KP Reader III, pg 128), Being a Barren planets, denies the chil- 
dren (Encyclopedia of Medical Astrology by Dr. H.L.Cornell). Saturn is a restricted planet as 
well as a natural malefic planet for child birth. According to Westerners Saturn is the son of 
Uranus. 


What is Uranus? 
Uranus is a planet of miscarriage (KP Reader II, pg 473) and also stands for sudden turns, 
rebellion, independence, invention, provocateur, surprises, liberation, disruption, awakening. 


What is Mars? 

Mars is generally known as a malefic and is hot, dry and fiery. It is the chief controller of 
menstruation cycle of the women. Mars is significant of energy both constructive and de- 
structive depending upon its position. It is Karaka for unnatural death, weapon, attack, vio- 
lence & massacre. 


Judith Hill says in his Medical Astrology book "the human body doesn't do well with too 
much cold (Saturn), or too much heat (Mars). We can think of Saturn as dark blue col- 
or ray and Mars as Red. The human body doesn't do well under prolonged exposure 
to light of either color!"

If 10th (one’s position in politics) cusp sub lord signifies house 10 (one’s reputation), 3 (one’s 
ability), 11 (one’s reputation as a winner) in the DBA of the significators of 3, 10, 11, then 
success is assured. 


Cuspal Sub lord for Aditya Thackeray: 

10% Cusp (Libra 14°.59’.08”): The sub lord of the 10t* cusp is Ketu. Ketu is in the star of 
Venus and sub of Rahu. Ketu is occupant of 12. No Planet in the star of Ketu and Ketu is 
CSL of 10. Ketu is conjoined with Saturn. Saturn is occupant of 12 owner of 1-2. Star lord 
Venus is occupant of 9, owner of 5-10. Sub lord Rahu is occupant of 6. Rahu is in Gemini 
sign, hence represents Mercury. Mercury is occupant of 9, owner of 6-9. Thus 10th cusp sub 
lord Ketu is the significator of 12-10-1-2-9-5-6. Hence, becoming a Dyp. CM is sure. 


Cuspal Sub lord for opponent: 

10% Cusp (Aries 14°.59’.08”): The sub lord of the 10 cusp is Venus. Venus is in the star of 
Mars and sub of Rahu. Venus is occupant of 3, owner of 4-11. Star lord Mars is occupant of 
2, owner of 5-10. Sub lord Rahu is occupant of 12. Rahu is in Gemini sign, hence represents 
Mercury. Mercury is occupant of 3, owner of 3-12. Thus 10 cusp sub lord Venus is the sig- 
nificator of 3-11-4-2-10-5-12. Hence, becoming a Dyp. CM is sure. 


Joint period for Aditya Thackeray: 
On the day of election, (21-10-2019) the running joint dasa period is Mars-Venus-Sun- 
saturn. 


Dasa lord Mars is in the star of Sun and sub of own. Mars is occupant of 8 owner of 4-11. 
Star lord Sun is occupant of 9 owner of 8. Sub lord Saturn is occupant of 12 owner of 1-2. 
Thus dasa lord Saturn is the significator of 8-4-11-9-8. Hence, becoming a Dyp. CM is sure. 


Bhukti lord Venus is in the star of Mars and sub of Rahu. Venus is occupant of 9 owner of 5- 
10. Star lord Mars is occupant of 8 owner of 4-11. Sub lord Rahu is occupant of 6. Rahu is in 
Gemini sign, hence represents Mercury. Mercury is occupant of 9, owner of 6-9. Thus bhukti 
lord Venus is the significator of 9-5-10-8-4-11-6. Hence, becoming a Dyp. CM is sure. 


Antra lord Sun is in the star of Moon and sub of Rahu. Sun is occupant of 9 owner of 8. Star 
lord Moon is occupant of 9 owner of 7. Sub lord Rahu is occupant of 6. Rahu is in Gemini 
sign, hence represents Mercury. Mercury is occupant of 9, owner of 6-9. Thus Antra lord Sun

"Whenever Saturn has got any connection what-so-ever with Moon, there will be some obsta- 
cle or impediment, not only during negotiation but also at the time of fixation and even at the

page 74) 


The following are the reasons for delays or impediments. 


1. Moon is in Saturn star, or Saturn is in the Moon Star. 

2. Moon and Saturn are in same Star. i.e., Moon is in Moon star, Saturn isin Saturn star. 
3. Moon and Saturn aspect each other (Bhava) 

4. Moon and Saturn are in the same sign. Ascendant in Moon star, 7th house is Saturn star. 
5. The combination of Moon and Saturn in any bhava disturbs and delays the result, or pro- 
posals are cancelled. Example. Moon is in 4th bhava if this is aspected by the Saturn; native 
faces some troubles in his education. 

6. If any person is born in Carp icon or Cancer sign as Lagna or Moon sign, that person will 
face problems in marriage or the couple never come to one understand each other, they live 
in two different places. Sometimes age difference between the couple is high, because oppo- 
site sign lords are Moon and Saturn. 

7. Couples with Moon in Moon star, Saturn in Saturn star do not lead happy life. They 
take divorce. If in business the partners break up. 

8. In the Saturn dasha Moon antardasha, and Moon dasha Saturn antara the Natives face 
some problems in married life or business depending on their age factor. 

9. Ascendant in Moon star and 7th cups in Saturn star or Ascendant in Saturn star 7th cups

Question 1: Double Role of 9th House 


In the article written by Sri Tin Win he goes on like, for becoming PM, ....... signifying desired 
houses 1,3,9,10, against houses 8,12. Future Prospects: Boris Johnson’s 10th 
(power) signifying favorable houses 3, against unfavorable houses 8,9,12. Wouldn't it have 


been clearer to a novice if the author explained why 3 is favorable and 9 unfavorable ? 
Because for becoming PM 9 was favorable but when it comes to enjoying power 9 is 
unfavorable ? I am not questioning the validity of the article. I am just highlighting the 
doubts that would occur in the minds of learners like me. Kindly enlighten. 


Answer: 

The 3'¢ house is for ability, and so it’s favorable for both becoming Prime Minister and 
gaining power. 

The 9th house for fortune or luck is favorable for becoming PM but unfavorable for gaining 
power because it’s 12th (loss) to 10th (power).

Book review-Medical Astrology 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 











Medical Astrology 

by Arun Bansal & Vinay Garg 

All India Federation of Astrologers Societies 
2018, 313 pages 


MEDICAL ASTROLOGY 


/ we 









Fh, 








Editor : Arun Bansal 
Author : Vinay Garg 





This is a Vedic medical astrology book. In the present book the basic concepts have been ex- 
plained. All the diseases have been categorised into congenital diseases and the diseases in- 
curred after the birth. There are many diseases which are cured with the change of time, da- 
sha and favourable transit and these are called curable diseases. On the other hand, there 
are several other diseases which can't be cured and they are called chronic diseases. 

The effort has also been made to describe that in any horoscope if the astrological combina- 
tions are indicating about any particular disease then during which dasha or transit there 
are possibilities of the onset of the disease so that the native could be cautious during that 
period and avoiding certain things and following exercise and disciplined routine he could be 
able to minimize the intensity of that disease to a significant extent and carry forward his life 
with ease. 

The diseases have also been categorised on the basis that some diseases are directly visible 
but some can't be observed directly and these are called indirect diseases. Such indirect dis- 
eases can't be known by others unless the patient himself tells someone about the disease. 
For example, suppose any person is suffering from sexual disease or he has impotency then 
this disease comes under the purview of the indirect disease because it can't be known by 
others unless the person himself discusses about it to others. On the other hand, if anyone 
has mutilated hand or he has some deformity or injury in the feet then the others very clear- 


KP Ezine October 2019 51 


ly can see this. Such diseases come under the purview of direct diseases. Both types of dis- 
eases have been discussed in the book. 

At the end of the book the causes of the diseases, their characteristics and astrological com- 
bination have been given. The benefit of this part is that if a native is not aware whether any 
disease is congenital or incurred later on or if it is curable or incurable then he may be able 
to know about the astrological combinations for such diseases.

native. Sun is karaka for the right eye for male and left eye for female. Moon is the Karaka for

eye and vision is controlled by Venus.

Death due to fatal accident 


By: Siva Prasad Gantha 
HIG 72, Bharatnagar Colony, Hyderabad-500018. 
Mobile: 9440152397; E-mail: siva.gantha@gmail.com 











Saturn, Mars, Rahu and Kethu are karakas for causing accidents. 8t and 12th cusps will de- 
cide whether any accidents will occur during the life time of a person or not. If the sublord of 
the 8th or 12th cusp be the significator of 8 or 12 the native is likely to meet with accident. If 
the cuspal sublord is connected with maraca or badhaka lords or houses, the accident will 
be fatal and death occurs. 


We will study the above aspect in the chart of the native who has died of accident in the early 
hours on 24 May, 2019. The native’s birth particulars are mentioned below. 


DOB: 16-6-1989 Time: 8-35 am Long: 79-17’E Lat: 15-44’N 


The native has born in the star of Visakha with ascendant Cancer. The Ascendant Cancer is 
a movable sign and 11th house from it forms the Badhakasthana ruled by Venus. Sun and 
Saturn are maraca lords. 


The 8t* cuspal sublord is Moon. Moon is in the star of Jupiter and in the sub of Mercury. 
Moon is in 4 lord of lagna. It is in the star of Jupiter in 11 lord of 6, 9 and in the sub of Mer- 
cury in 10 lord of 3, 12. So the CSL Moon signifies badhaka house 11 and is connected to 
12, 4, 1, and also aspected by Mars significator of 7, 8, 12. Further Moon having the posi- 
tional strength rules the 8 and 11) houses. 


The 12th cuspal sublord is Saturn. Saturn is in the star of Venus (badhaka lord) and in the 
sub of Rahu. Saturn is in 6 lord of 7, 8 in the star of Venus in 12 lord of 4, 11 and in the 
sub of Rahu in 8. Rahu in Aquarius sign represents Saturn. Saturn is aspected by Sun 
(maraka) and by Venus (badhaka). So Saturn signifies 8, 12 and connected to badhaka and 
maraka lords 


8th and 12th cuspal sublords Moon and Saturn respectively signify 8, 12 duly connected to 
badhaka and maraca houses and pose danger to the life of the native. Hence the longevity of 
the native is required to be examined in this regard. 


LONGEVITY: The co-rulers of the lagna cusp are Moon, Saturn and Venus. We have already 
discussed about the evil nature of the Moon and Saturn. Now the other co-ruler is Venus. 
Venus is a badhaka lord deposited in 12t* house lord of 4,11. Itis in the star and sub of Ju- 
piter in 11 lord of 6, 9. Venus is associated with maraca lord Sun and aspected by 8t lord 
Saturn. So Venus also becomes evil to the longevity of the native. As all the co-rulers of la- 
ena are connected to badhaka and maraca houses the life of the native is short.

The 8th Presidential Election in Sri Lanka will be held on 16th November, 2019. National 
Election Commission of Sri Lanka has accepted 35 nominations and they have already been 
scheduled in a ballet paper 26 inches in length the longest ballet paper in the political histo- 
ry in Sri Lanka. 

Out of these 35 candidates the battle is among only two candidates according to the social 
media as well as the current political propagandas launch by the candidates. They are Mr. 
Sajith Premadasa and Mr. Gotabhaya Rajapakse. 

Mr Sajith Premadasa is the only son of late Executive President of Sri Lanka Mr. Ranasinghe 
Premadasa and he is the deputy leader of United National Party and cabinet minister for 
Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs and Member of Parliament for the Hambantota 
district. 

Mr. Gotabhaya Rajapakse is the former Secretary of Defense and a brother of former presi- 
dent Mr. Mahinda Rajapakse.

below by giving me a number for horary prediction.

Cuspal Sub Lord for Mr. Sajith Premadasa.

the star of its own and in the sub of Moon. By being a node, sub lord Rahu represents its 
aspecting planet Saturn+ and its sign lord Mercury. Saturn+ is the lord of 2 & 3 and deposit- 
ed in 1. Mercury is the lord of 7 & 10 and occupant of 11. Sub lord Moon is an occupant of 2 
and owner of 8. Thus the 10th cuspal sub lord Rahu of Mr. Sajith Premadasa signifies the 
required houses 3, 10 & 11 and hence winning is sure. 


For Mr. Gotabhaya Rajapaksa 

10th Cusp (Pisces 13° 21' 00") 

10th CSL is Rahu placed in 1, in its own star. Rahu is in the sub of Moon. Moon is the lord 
of 2 and occupant of 8. Being a node, Rahu represents its aspecting planet Saturn+ and sign 
lord Mercury. Saturn+ the lord of 8 & 9 is placed in 7. Mercury is the lord of 1 & 4in 5. Thus 
10th cuspal sub lord of Gotabhya Rajapakse signifies 1, 2, 8, 9, 7, 4, 5. Thus it doesn’t signi- 
fies any of the required houses in this horary map for success in the election.

Ruling planets solve lost and found article 


By: Kaavassery. S. Naaraayanan 
“Sopaanam”, IInd floor, # 7, Sabari Cottages, 
V/630 : Kalchatty St., Kalpathy.P.O.Palakkad-678003.Kerala.

On the 3 of September-2019 evening, I had a phone call from an old friend of mine , from 
Singapore . He had gone to visit his daughter and grandchild a month back and was staying 
with them . His call was from a new number to say that he was trying to contact me multiple 
times today around mid-day, but couldn't get connected to me; he said that he lost his mo- 
bile last evening, (on the 2.4), at about 15:30 hours, when he went to the bus stop to receive 
his grandchild from school. He explained that he was spending some time sitting in a bench 
provided there , in the company of many such people, waiting for the arrival of the school 
bus, which picks-up from and drops back his grandson. Some-how he must have lost the 
mobile-cell there at that time, he mused. Only on return to home he realized that the cell is 
not with him....he went back to the bus stop and searched the area, but could not find...he 
said he had lodged the missing status of the item at the security office in that area and also 
with the police....... He asked, will he get it back? 


This query was analysed as per details provided here-under . 


The ruling planets appeared at the time of analysis were : ascendant transiting in Saturn — 
Mars, while the Moon was in Venus — Rahu, with the day lord being Mars. The lagna sign 
lord was in 11% house casting aspect on lagna, while the ascendant starlord, Mars, was 
casting aspect on the lord of the 2-4 and 11% house . The Moon star lord represents the 2r4 
and 11% lord. The 11 lord ts aspecting the 24 house . This planetary spread and the rul- 
ing planets indicate that he will get back the lost article soon . 


DATE - 03/09/2019 (Tuesday ) 

TIME : 17:50:55 Hrs 

PLACE DETAILS : Lon : 076E42 Lat : 1ON46 (Geographic) T. Zone : +05:30 
ASCENDENT : Kumbha / Aquarius 

STAR : Swati (3) 

KP AYANAMSA © : 024° 02' 29.8" 

DASA BALANCE : Rahu Maha Dasa-08 Years, 07 Months, 24 Days, 02 Hours 


As per ‘Prsnaanushtaana Paddhathi' , vide chapter XIII....NWASHTA PRASNAH , if the as- 
cendant that rises at the time of analysis is on a fixed sign it is to be understood that the article 
which is claimed to be lost is not actually lost at all, but may have got displaced/ removed and 
kept somewhere else by someone known to the owner of the item . 


Also, if the 7" has occupation by a benefic planet, it is assured that the item deemed to be 
lost will be be got back. 


On the same matter in ‘Shalpanchaasika’ , (recovery of lost article) it is given to un- 
derstand that : 


“ Tf the eleventh bhaava has occupation by a strong benefic planet, then , early recovery of 
the article lost is to be inferred “, and also: “when ‘ekaadasabhaava’ gets occupied by any 
strong benefic, then it is an indication to speedy recovery of lost article” . 

Here in this horary chart, Saturn is occupying the 11t* bhaava and as lord of lagna, is to be 
deemed a benefic, and is casting aspect on lagna . 


In the above case involving the mobile set we find the dicta fully applicable . 
On application of Krishnamurthy Paddhathi, it is said that one will be able to recover the lost 


KP Ezine November 2019 23 


item if the significator planets of 274, 6th, and 11t* bhaava appear as ruling planets at the 
time of analysis of the case. 


Here, in the case analysed, the relevant planets happens to be : an untenanted Moon, Jupi- 
ter, untenanted Saturn, the nodes Rahu and untenanted Kethu. The node Rahu has repre- 
sentation for planets Mercury, Saturn and Jupiter while the other node, who is in conjunc- 
tion with Saturn in Saggittarius, represents Venus, Jupiter and Saturn . All the ruling plan- 
ets have become significators for recovery . 


Since the node Rahu is in Gemini, all alone, it picks up representation for the planet who 
owns the sign . In the chart, Mercury who owns Gemini is seen in rapt conjunction with 
Mars, who is ascendant star lord among the ruling planets. 


Planet Mars, having the association of Venus, the Sun and Mercury, is casting his aspect on 
Jupiter. The Moon being in Swathi is connected to the node Rahu who represents Jupiter (by 
stellar position ) as well as Saturn (by aspect) too . 


At the time of judgment the lagna was in Aquarius, in ‘ Dhanishta’ star, while the Moon was 
passing through the star ’ Swathi’ in Libra sign , the day being Tuesday. Thus we have Mars, 
Saturn, Jupiter, Rahu and Kethu appearing as the ruling planets . 


We can notice that these very same planets signified the recovery also . The ‘fortuna point’ too 
gets ruled by these planets . 


Hence I informed my friend that the item would be got back very soon and to stay relaxed, let- 
ting the planets to play their part. 


The very next day, on the 4th, at about 09:30 hours, I received his call to say that the item is 
back in his possession now. The security office received the lost item and at night he was 
called to identity the same , which he did, and took back the mobile, feeling much relieved . 
Hats off to the power of Ruling Planets and pranams to Guruji, late KSK, for revealing the use 
of them .

Natal chart analysis of a lady on the prospects of Progeny. 
The following are the birth details--DOB---10 FEB 1985/ TOB---00-50-00 A.M/ POB

As per the above birth details the natal chart is erected and attached. 
The native states that she had miscarriages and she is worried about the prospects of her 
progeny and wants to know astrologically what exactly her prospects are in this regard. 


Krishnamurthy System of Astrology (KP Astrology) states the following on the progeny and 
its prospects and also on ABORTINS / MISCARRIAGES— 

When counting the number of children, such as the first child being 

represented by the 5th house cusp, the 2nd child is represented by the 7th house cusp, the 
third child is represented by the 9th house cusp, etc., what happens when there has been 
an abortion? Do we count that as a child? 


Mistakes made here will give mistakes in predicting correctly the sex of each child and the 
number of children. When an abortion takes place after 3 months from conception, the 
fetus is counted as a child because, during that abortion, the sex of the child was clearly 
developed, but when abortion takes place before the completion of the 3 months gestational 
period, this pregnancy is not taken as a childbirth because the sex of the child, prior to 
that time, is not clear. So this factor must be clearly known for an astrologer to fix both the 
sex of the child and the correct number of children that the mother will deliver. 


3. The danger to the individual’s life will likely prove fatal if the sub lord is in the star of 
either the occupant or the owner of the 8th, 7th, or 2nd. 


4. The individual will survive the accident of abortion if the sub lord is in the star of either 
the occupant or owner of the 2nd, 7th and 11th. 


5. Adoption: What indicators show adoption in a chart? 

An individual who has been denied children will opt for adopting a child if the 5th cuspal 
sub lord and Jupiter, Saturn, Mercury, Mars, and Moon, are connected to the 4th, 8th, and 
12th houses. 


6. Badhaka Houses: The badhaka houses are houses that are harmful to life, and badhaka 
houses are more harmful to life than maraka houses. The badhaka houses are the 11th for 
those born in Cardinal (moveable) signs, the 9th for those born in Fixed signs, and the 7th 
for those born in Mutable (dual) signs. 

For death, first, consider the badhaka houses, and then the maraka houses as dangerous 
for the native, as there is a danger to life during the joint period (Dasha / Bhukti) of the 
significators of the badhaka and maraka houses. 


7. 1). Barren Signs: Aries, Gemini, Leo, and Virgo are called barren or sterile signs. 

2). Barren signs on the cusps of the 5th and 11th houses (11th being 5th to the partner) 
and the lords of these not posited in fruitful signs, the Moon not in a fruitful sign, the lagna 
not in a fruitful sign, the lord of the lagna not posited in a fruitful sign, and no fruitful 
planet in the 5th or 11th house, are indications of no children. 

3). Semi fruitful signs—Taurus, Libra, Capricorn, and Sagittarius.

period the significations of 2-5-11.

have children. Kethu, Rahu, Saturn in the 5t* cusp or Lagna will never create abortions

considering for long life or life saving or cure or recovery from ailment.

as done by some KP astrologers.

houses for long life or life saving as explained by rationale.

Medical Astrology

fest depends upon the dasha periods and transit of planets. The numbers of diseases which

experiences with her dating boyfriends. Taylor Swift is currently dating English actor Joe

There has been no report of a break-up, so they are still together.

Monteith (April 2010-May 2010); John Mayer (November 2009 - February 2010); Taylor

(July 2008 - October 2008).

The role of an astrologer while predicting any important event of a native — is like standing 
on a “razor’s edge”. He should have a multi-faceted vision and exercise extra care while 
analyzing the chart of a native on any aspect of the native’s major life events lest there 
should be every dangerous possibility of going wrong. 

Here is a chart of a native whose marriage prospects were predicted without going beyond 
the boundaries of her request, which led to the failure of my prediction. 

When I received the news of her last journey, I was shocked to learn the same and wondered 
how I have overlooked such a major happening of her life within a very foreseeable future 
from the date of my reading her chart. 

Though the astrologer is not bound to go beyond what is asked to predict by the native, this 
article of post analysis is only for sharing this aspect of astrologer’s responsibility in 
analyzing the chart and for the benefit of the readers and fellow astrologers. 

Possibilities of marriage as per the natal chart of Miss Marriage— At the request of a 
gentleman (through his mail 09 July 2018) and as per the birth details furnished by him, the 
chart of the native was erected and the possibilities of the marriage of this native were 
analyzed .

placed in 12t* house. Saturn aspecting the 7+ cusp directly is causing delay, and 
Moon is in Saturn sign is also causing a delay due to PP dosha. 

Saturn is placed in the star of Saturn star lord of 3 and 4 placed in 12th, and in the 
sub of Rahu placed in 5t, 

Rahu represents Jupiter lord of 2 and 5 in 34 and Sun lord of 10 placed in 11 house. 
Thus 7 cusp sub lord Saturn signifying @ STL 3,4,12 and @SBL 2,3,5,10 and 11, 
promises marriage for the native. 


WHAT THE CHART of the GIRL SAYS ON LOVE AFFAIR AND LOVE MARRIAGE 


If the 5t cusp sub lord is the strong significator of 7 or 11, then love affair will materialize 
into marriage. 

As per the chart- 5t* cusp sub lord is Rahu co-rules11 signifying @its star-lord level 5 and 11 
and @its SBL level 2 and 5, indicates success in a love affair. 


If 7th cusp sub lord signifies 5 or 11 love affair will be materialized into marriage. 

As per the chart the 7t cusp sub lord Saturn signifies @its SBL-both 5 and 11 along with 
another marriage giving house 24, so promises the love marriage. 

As per chart 7th and 5t8 cusp sub lords are Saturn and Rahu+ which signify 2,5,11, I feel as 
per the above rules, there are more possibilities for love affair to be materialized into mar- 
riage. It may be an inter cast or even inter-religion also.

A telephone call was received stating that a boy, on serious illness, was admitted into the hospital by 
his parents. As the parents were worried about the condition of the boy, somebody on their behalf

cendant was fallen in Libra sign but it was rotated to 9th house treating the native as stranger due to 
non-availability of details. As the sign Gemini is a common sign the 7t house becomes badhaka and 
maraka house and Jupiter as its lord. We will examine the 6th house as it deals with sickness. 


For disease indicator, the 6t* cuspal sub lord Jupiter in 5, lord of 7-9 is in the star of Mercury in 1, 
lord of 1-3, and in sub of Venus in 1, lord of 4-5-12, signifying 3 (8t8 to 8), 4 (end of every thing includ- 
ing life), 7 (badhaka/ maraka) and 12 (moksha/ death), leading to serious illness which poses danger 
to the life of the native. 


For the longevity the lagna cusp sub lord Venus in 1, lord of 4-5-12 is in the star and sub of Mercury 
in 1, lord of 1-3; and Venus and Mercury are aspected by Jupiter lord of 7 (badhaka/ maraka), indi-

native’s life. It is learnt that the boy died on 9th August 2019 when the Moon was transiting in the 
star of Saturn in the sign of Mars. 


Transit: The dasa lord Mars is transiting in the star of Kethu who represents Jupiter (makha). The 
bhukthi lord Mercury and anthara lord Rahu are transiting in the star of Jupiter (punarvasu). The

CHANGE IN JOB OR SERVICE 


For Job or Service, we check for 2 (Money), 6 (Job or Service, Daily Income through hardship 
like Service), 10 (Position, Business & Profession). 12th bhava or cusp indicates Loss of any 
nature. The cusp 1, 5, 9 are negative cusp for 2, 6, 10. In change of job or service, one will 
loose of his present status of job or service by leaving it and join a new activity related to job 
or service based. So, success is always required which is seen from 11 (Gains, Profits, 
Fulfillment of desire) Hence, in change of job or service, both 2-6-10-11 and 1-5-9 cusp will 
operate and 6th cusp is the guide. Houses 2-6-11 are related to money matters and are im- 
portant for financial hike in service employment. 


Hints: 

6th CSL should signifies 2, 6, 10 or 11 to join new job or profession; 

6th CSL should signifies 1, 5 or 9 to leave the present job or service; 
(Note: The above rule can be cross-verified with 10t CSL also, if required)

coalition government.

danger) is also indicating short life and failure of the coalition government.

et in its stars, is in the star of Jupiter in 7, lord of 8-11, and in sub of Saturn in 8, lord of 
9-10, indicating favorable 6 (win over opponent), 10 (success) and 11 (gain), along with

Question 1: Strong Significators 
Sir lama K P system student learning astrology. This ts my sincere doubt and 
Not finding fault in book.. Please help me sir

Pg: 182, It says 


What does each planet Signify ? 

SU ts star of RA and RA in 9 = gives 9th H results. 

SU ts in lagna and No-Planets in SU’s Stars = gives Ist H results. 

SU ts Lord of 11 and No-planet placed in 11th = gwes 11th H results 
So SU give results of Ist , 9th, and 11th Houses 


In Pg 195 / 197 
Under The Golden Rule in KP 


VE ts in sub of MA and MA ts in 10th 
MA ts not having any Planets in its stars and Lord of 6 and 11 and both houses are vacant 
So VE give the results of 10th, 11th, and 6th Houses 


But VE (as per chart in Pg 195 ) =in MA-SU- MA 
So, VE is in Star of SUand SU ts in 9 (but in Rapt Conjn with 10th Cusp) 


VE ts in 10th but KE in Star of VE , so, cannot give result of 10th. 
VE ts lord of 5 & 12, Both houses are vacant . so, giwe results of Hs 5 & 12 


So VE give results of Houses 9, 5, 12 thro’ 5 & 12. 


Sir shall I take both are correct or which one is more preferable 
Eagerly waiting for your reply . Thanking you sir 


Answer 1: 

General practice for signification is as follows: 

Venus in house 10, lord of houses 5-12 is in the star of Sun in house 9, lord of house 3, and 
in sub of Mars+ in house 10, lord of houses 6-10, having no planet in the stars of Mars 
which is not the cuspal sub lord (CSL) of any house. 

Note: The rank E significator rank by conj./aspect by A-B-C-D is very weak and used as a 
last resort. 


If Mars be the CSL of any house, this house will be the strong significator because of having 
no planet in Mars’ stars. But here Mars is not the CSL of any house, so house 10 occupied 
by Mars becomes a strong significator by its positional status even though Venus in house 
10. Houses 5-12 owned by Mars are also strong significators as they are vacant. Thus Mars 
is the strong significator of houses 10-5-12 and the rest houses other than 10-5-12 are 
regular significators. 


Regarding the strong sigbificators, star is stronger than planet and sub is the decider.

Question 2: Moon sign or Lagna 
There ts a lot confusion among learners how to see effect of a planet by Moon sign or Lagna. It 
would be helpful to explain which one is more accurate. 


Answer 2: 
This confusion is only in traditional Vedic astrology. In KP astrology the Lagna alone is 
considered as a major change in six Readers from KP two volumes as follows: 


It is give up what had been following to consider whether Lagna or Moon is strong, in the 
Krishnamurti Padhdhati, Vol. 2 (in pp 82, 89-91, 118, 255, 261-2, 264, 313, 316), printed in 
1966 by Sagar Publications The main reason is that in further research on twin births, only 
the house cusps, including the Lagna, change whereas Moon is in the same degree and 
minute and in the same Bhava, same Navamsa, same Ashtagavarga, having same Shadbala 
and everything remaining the same. It is also found that it is the cusp of 12 houses which 
vary in twin births and therefore it is the cusp which should indicate whether that house 
matter will prosper or that house matter will suffer.

The aim of this book is to astrologically define different sports activities and determine the

The book has 11 chapters which describes the role of planets and zodiac signs in 
determining the sports potential of a birth chart. This book reveals the astrological 
techniques which could be utilized to discover and develop the right persons to become 
efficient sports persons.

judgment, dedication, spontaneity of action and other essential tools for the right diagnosis 
of a birth chart for sports potential. With these is practical analysis of various sports 
persons’ charts by using cusps and constellations.

Prediction of Myanmar Idol Season 4 Winner 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 











Brief Background 

Following the success of American Idol and other IDOL series, Myanmar Idol has become the 
most popular Myanmar singing contest television series that is currently broadcast on TV 
Channel 9. Its first season was launched in 2016. Due to its popularity, it has been extended 
for a fourth season in June 2019 for staging Myanmar’s new generation singers. The 11 top 
finalists of 5 boys and 6 girls were chosen by three judges out of over thirty hundred 
contestants from all over the country. After the eight round of week by week dropping out 
one finalist by votes in Myanmar and from abroad, the three finalists, one boy Benjamin 
Sum and two girls Aye Mya Phyu and Esther Dawt Chin Sung were chosen in the semi 
final result show on December 20. The GRAND FINAL show was aired in Channel 9 T V on 
28 December 2019. Esther Dawt Chin Sung won the Grand Final of Myanmar Idol Season 
4 as the first Lady winner of Myanmar Idol. 





As announced in advance the rewards for the winner Esther Dawt Chin Sung are cash 
reward of Kyat 500 lakhs ($33,333) and releasing a solo album from the organizing Shwe 
Thanlwin Company, another Kyat 200 lakhs ($13,333) from the OPPO smart phone company 
and a two-bedroom unit from City Loft Apartments (estimate value over Kyat 500 lakhs). 
Two runner ups Benjamin Sum and Aye Mya Phyu got cash reward of Kyat 75 lakhs 
($5,000) each from the organizing company. 


Prediction of possible winner ESTHER posted on FB 

Based on three KP horary charts for the above three finalists calculated on 22 December, 
prediction of Myanmar Idol Season 4 possible winner ESTHER was posted FB on 25 
December before the Grand Final show on 28 December 2019.

2nd CSL is analyzed for chance of gaining the cash rewards of K500 lakhs and K200 lakhs. 
The 2nd CSL is for cash and also voice, singing.

KP Ezine January 2020 30 


Study of suicidal Death by Poison 


By: Sumanadasa Namarathna (Sunaparantha Kalyan) 
Ex-Accountant, Justice of Peace 
No.22/1, Udugampola Road, Marapola, Veyangoda, 


SRI LANKA Email: sumanal946@gmail.com 











Preface: A news item from a local News Paper says that 773 suicides have been reported 
during the last three years in my district Gampaha, Sri Lanka. Among them 522 by hanging, 
256 by taking poison, 86 by jumping to the running train, 19 by self firing are reported. Accord- 
ing to the Government Agent of Gampaha, Breaking of Love Affairs, Family Deputes, Alcohol- 
ism, Loneliness, Fail of Exams, Joblessness and Indebtedness have come as the top rank 
reasons for those suicidal death. 
In this article my attempt is to trace the astrological line-up for the suicidal death by poison. 
Before we go through the Astrological reasons for the act of suicide by way of any manner, we 
have to study for the psychological tendencies of the person to take such a decision. Accord- 
ing to the researches the first and foremost reason to take such a bold but coward and fool- 
ish decision is depression. Most of people suffer with depression silently, and think the 
last and final solution for this is to take leave from this birth and reach to a phenomenal free 
world. Secondly the person might be suffering from psychotic state like dementia, which 
commands the person for self destruction by committing suicide. The next reason is 
impulsive mood especially as a result of drugs and alcohol and also family problems. This 
type of persons attempts to end their lives without thinking of their noble soul as well as 
their life partners, parents, siblings and friends. Nowadays most of teenagers use to take 
this horrible decision as a result of their failure in love affairs and some are with their failure 
of achieving the goal like higher educational examinations. As we all know some people who 
suffer from series and incurable disease like Cancer, Piles and Migraine etc; are motivated by 
the presence of inner painful terminal to take decision to die by suicide. 

When we deeply think of the above reasons, what ever is the cause, it is clearly 

understandable that the root comes from the mind since all the reasons are connected with 

the mind. 

Mind is the ultimate cause of everything in this world. The Buddha said, “mano 

pubbangama dhamma, mano setta manomaya...”. “Mind precedes all dhamma, all 

dhamma are mind made...”.(Dhammapada Verse 1 Chakkhupala Thera Vatthu) 

In this the Lord Buddha emphasizes the great part the mind plays in man's life, and then 

explains how deeds become good or evil according to the pure and impure state of the mind. 

Mind precedes all actions and serves as the principal element both in performing and in 

assessing deeds. It is mind that rules and shapes action. Words and deeds are also produced 

by mind. 

‘Things are forerun by mind' -- Mrs. Rhys Davis. 

(The mental) natures are the result of what we have thought' -- Radhakrishnan. 

'All that we are the result of what we have thought’ -- Irving Babbit.

Some Individual indications of planets for the suicidal tendencies. 

G. Moon(Mathi) 

Moon controls our THOUGHTS. If Moon and 3rd cusp are afflicted the stability of the native's 

mind weaken and fail to face life events. 

H. Mercury 

Mercury controls our JUDGMENTS. When Mercury (Reasoning) afflict in a natal chart in any 

manner, it causes us to take a wrong judgment and sometimes provoke towards committing 

suicide. 

I. Saturn 

Saturn is the planet of longevity (Ayushkaraka). If Saturn is connected with 8th cusp, 

lifespan is long. If Saturn is weak, he has no hesitation to kill the native or fell on to the con- 

stant health problems during the entire life time. Also Saturn is karaka for melancholy. 
J. Rahu 
Rahu gives thoughts of suicide, if it is connected with 6, 8, 12 and Lagna. 

K. Mars 
Mars is a planet of Impulsive and Rashness. If Mars is afflicted the native will lose 
temper quickly and will be fool-hardy.

Abstracted KP rules for suicidal death: 

(r) If the sub Lord of the 8th cusp deposited in the constellation of a planet, who is a signifi- 
cator of Maraka or Badhaka and also the 8th house, and further if the lord of the constella- 
tion is connected with Mars, then suicide is indicated. (Astrology and Athrista - Dec 1978 pg 
38 

(s) When the 8th house is occupied by the lord of Lagna, or the planet in 8 happens to be 
posited in the star of the lord of Lagna, OR the lord of 8 is in conjunction with the lord of La- 
ena, the indication is that the native himself will be the cause of his own death. (KP Reader 2 
pg 299, 12th Edition Sept 2009) 

(t) If the sub lord of the Lagna is a significator of Maraka, Badhaka, 8 and Mars, one would 
commit suicide. (KP House Grouping Part I by Sri Tin Win ji) 

(u) If the sub lord of the 8th cusp is deposited in the constellation of a planet who is the sig- 
nificator of Badhakasthana or Marakasthana and also 8th house, one would commit suicide. 
(KP Reader VI, p 258) 

(v) “The sub lord of the 8th cusp should have some kind of connection with Mars and Ketu”. 
(KPEZine 2011 Dec.) 

(w) “Moon should also be afflicted with airy sign connection with Saturn and Mars aspect or 
conjunction as this combination produce negative thoughts to a native.” (Ibid) 

(x) “ If there is any kind of relationship or connection between/among the co-rulers of the As- 
cendant and the 8th cusp, then the native only will be the cause of his/her own end.” (Ibid) 
(y) “The assassin is represented by the 7th house of the native. It is a well-known fact to all 
of us that the 7th house represents all the persons who have dealing with the native. When

Observation 

Basically one should have Karmic effects to end its life by an unnatural death, which is 
shown by the Ascendant (4,8,12). Also he must have a corrupted mentality, which is to be 
judge from the cuspal sub lord of the Ascendant. (6: Mania, 8: Suicide, 12: Self-undoing). To 
embrace the life end by committing suicide one should have impulsive, rash, reckless and 
depressed thoughts denote by adversely disposed Moon and Mars. At the same time judg- 
ment maker Mercury should be afflicted for wrong and rash judgment. During the pro- 
cessing of above back ground in the Ego (Athman), if Ayushkaraka Saturn is weak it makes 
a melancholy mind signifying 3rd house. When all of the above are in progress, afflicted 
Moon and Rahu have no hesitation to give him the cup of poison. 


Notes 

1) As in Astro Secrets Part I, Ra or Moon should not always be the 8th cuspal Sub lord, but 
both of them should be the significators of 8th cusp (Refer Z above) 

2) As in Astrology and Athrista - Dec 1978 pg 38, "Sub Lord of the 8th cusp deposited in the 
constellation of a planet, who is a significator of Maraka or Badhaka and also the 8th house 
and connected to Mars" is not valid always and the significations/connections for Maraka, 
Badhaka, 4,6,8,1,10 are satisfied.(Refer R above)

Question 1: Decentralization 

Could you to advise me "what are the houses to be judged for dealing with a horary question 
on " Decentralisation of power of a state /country by its government?" And what would be 
the KP rule for such a question in mundane astrology." 


Answer 1: 

If the Lagna cuspal sub lord signifies house 6 (division/separation), 12 (separation, new environment) 
and 11 (fulfillment of desire), decentralization of a state can be acomplished during the joint dasa 
period of significators of 6,12 and 11. 


Question 2: Going further after planet's star lord and sub lord 
Have you ever seen any usage of the star lord of star lord other than the star load of sub lord? As per 
your practical experience what do you think about it? 


Answer 2 

In KP the cuspal sub lord of a house indicates whether the matter of the house is promised or not. The 
joint dasa period DBAS lords point the timing of matter when transit agrees with dasa. The cuspal 
sub lord is also a planet like the joint dasa period lord. 


For signification of each planet whether it's the cuspal sub lord or the dasa period lord, three lelels 
are to be considered, i.e. the planet as cause, its star as nature of result and its sub as deciding factor 
whether the matter is favorable or not. 


Sri Jyotidra Hasbe's disciple Suresh Shahasane 
goes further after planrt's star lord by taking star lord of star lord in consideration of planet 
signification. 


Sri Jyotidra Hasbe's another disciple Sunil Gondhalekar goes futhet after planrt's sub lord 
by taking star lord of sub lord in consideration of planet signification for his 4 step theory 
based on K M Subramaniam's Sublord Speaks articles. 

Dr. Adith Kasinath's EPS System of Astrology goes furthet after planet's star lord and sub 
lord by taking star lord of star lord and star lord of sub lord in consideration of planet 


signification. 


I've no practice of going further after the planet's star lord to say it's effectiveness.

Kobe Bryant’s Death in Helicopter Crash 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 











Kobe Bryant, the famous retired American basketball player, aged 41, died on 26 January 
2020 in a helicopter crash at 9:45 AM near Calabasas, California, in which his 13-year-old 
daughter Gianna and seven others also died. Widely regarded as one of the greatest 
basketball players of all time, he led the NBA in scoring during two seasons, ranking fourth 
on the league's all-time regular season scoring, and ranking fourth on the all-time 
postseason scoring list. 

https: //en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kobe Bryant

also shows catastrophes & conditions surrounding one’s death. Planets placed in 8th house 
speed up the cycle of personal evolution and when activated by dasha or transit can create 
intense unpredictable situations in our lives, for good or bad depending on multiple 
individual chart factors. The table of significators shows that all planets from Sun to Ketu 
are significators of 8th house in his horoscope. 


Fatal Accident

closely conjoined with Mars+ (9-4-11-12) which is the CSL of 6-12 having no planet in its 
stars. Star lord Moon is almost exactly opposed to Uranus. Sub lord Sun is closely conjoined 
with Saturn (8-2). The repeated signification of house 8 (accident) in combination of other 
trigonal houses 4 (end of everything/ death) and 12 (Moksha/ death), also 2 (Maraka), 6 
(injury), and connection to Mars and Uranus indicate fatal accident/ sudden death.

The following are the birth details--DOB---10 FEB 1985/ TOB---00-50-00 A.M/ POB— 
Kolkata, WB. 


The native states that she had miscarriages and she is worried about the prospects of her 
progeny and wants to know astrologically what exactly her prospects are in this regard. 


Krishnamurthy System of Astrology (KP Astrology) states the following on the progeny and its 
prospects and also on Abortions / Miscarriages. 


When counting the number of children, such as the first child being represented by the Sth 
house cusp, the 2nd child is represented by the 7th house cusp, the third child is 
represented by the 9th house cusp, etc., what happens when there has been an abortion? Do 
we count that as a child? 


Mistakes made here will give mistakes in predicting correctly the sex of each child and the 
number of children. When an abortion takes place after 3 months from conception, the fetus 
is counted as a child because, during that abortion, the sex of the child was clearly 
developed, but when abortion takes place before the completion of the 3 months gestational 
period, this pregnancy is not taken as a childbirth because the sex of the child, prior to that 
time, is not clear. So this factor must be clearly known for an astrologer to fix both the sex of 
the child and the correct number of children that the mother will deliver. 


The danger to the individual’s life will likely prove fatal if the sub lord is in the star of either 
the occupant or the owner of the 8th, 7th, or 2nd. 


The individual will survive the accident of abortion if the sub lord is in the star of either the 
occupant or owner of the 2nd, 5th and 11th. 


Adoption: What indicators show adoption in a chart? 


An individual who has been denied children will opt for adopting a child if the 5th cuspal sub 
lord and Jupiter, Saturn, Mercury, Mars, and Moon, are connected to the 4th, 8th, and 12th 
houses. 


Badhaka Houses: The badhaka houses are houses that are more harmful to life than maraka 
houses. The badhaka houses are the 11th for those born in Cardinal (moveable) signs, the 
9th for those born in fixed signs, and the 7th for those born in Mutable (dual) signs. 


For death, first, consider the badhaka houses, and then the maraka houses as dangerous 
for the native, as there is a danger to life during the joint period (Dasha / Bhukti) of the 
significators of the badhaka and maraka houses. 


1. Barren Signs: Aries, Gemini, Leo, and Virgo are called barren or sterile signs. 


2. Barren signs on the cusps of the 5th and 11th houses (11th being 5th to the partner) and 
the lords of these not posited in fruitful signs, the Moon not in a fruitful sign, the lagna not 
in a fruitful sign, the lord of the lagna not posited in a fruitful sign, and no fruitful planet in 
the 5th or 11th house, are indications of no children. 


3. Semi fruitful signs—Taurus, Libra, Capricorn, and Sagittarius. 
4. Fruitful signs—Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces. 


Coordinates for the Progeny—5‘ cusp in the chart indicates progeny and its prospects, (11th 
cusp in a male chart indicates progeny,) 24 cusp indicates an addition to the family by the 
newborn ones, 3™ cusp indicates the stomach of the mother, 11t* cusp indicates fulfilment of

y “ 
EE HE 
There has been a lot of discussions and speculations going on in the press and other media, 
which has triggered my mind to go for this horary query on 25 Dec 2019 during afternoon 
hours.

my place. 





Sri Tin Win has given the bellow Rule on the subject "what are the houses to be judged for 
dealing with a horary question on " Decentralisation of power of a state /country by its 
government?" And what would be the KP rule for such a question in mundane astrology." 


KP RULE--- 

“If the Lagna cuspal sub lord signifies house 6 (division/separation), 12 (separation, new 
environment) and 11 (fulfilment of desire), decentralization of a state can be accomplished 
during the joint dasa period of significators of 6, 12 and 11.” 


As per the Time chart--- the lagna sub lord is Moon lord of 5 placed in 9th. Moon is in the 
star of Mercury lord of 4 and 7 in 9t8 , and inthe sub lord of Jupiter lord of 1 and 10 in 9th, 
Thus the Ascendant cusp sub lord Moon signifies @STL—4-5-7-9 and @SBL 1-10 clearly 
negates the possibilities for decentralization of the capital of the AP state. 


--11th cusp sub lord Mercury is the lord of 4 and 7, in 9th and in the star of Mercury and in 
the sub of Saturn lord 11 and 12 in 10th. Thus 11th cusp sub lord Mercury also signifies 
@STL 4-7-9 and @SBL 10-11-12, but not the main house 6t to give separation / 
decentralization of the state capital. 


From the above analysis, I strongly feel that there cannot be any possibility for the 
decentralization of the AP state capital- AMARAVATHI.

Sub lords explains common and different life 
patterns of two similar horoscopes 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 











This article is to show how the sub lords of two Myanmar celebrities’ horoscopes, born with 
only 12 minutes apart, explain their common and different life patterns. 


Birth Details 

So Academy Awards Winner actress May Than Nu, 27/Jan/1961, 1:30:00 PM, TZ: +06:30, 
Myeik, Myanmar, 12N27, 98E38, KP Ayanamsa: 23° 13' 24", Bal. Dasa: Mars 6 Y, O M, 24 D 
Famous comedian, satirist and all-round artist Zarganar, 27/Jan/1961, 01:42:00 PM, TZ: 
+06:30, Yangon, Myanmar, 16N47, 96E08, KP Ayanamsa: 23° 13' 24", Bal. Dasa: Mars 6 Y, O 
M,5D 


May Than Nu Zarganar 








Same Rasi & Navamsa Charts and D-60 Chart 

Both of their rasi and navamsa charts are the same, and the only way to differentiate the two 
chats is to use the D-60 (Shashtyamsa) charts which have different Lagnas, Leo for May 
Than Nu and Sagittarius for Zarganar but the same positions of planets. 


KP Sub Lords 
Only three (3,6 & 11t*) cuspal sub lords (CSL) are the same and others are different. Not only 
same CLS but some different CSL indicate the same patterns of life for both natives. 


KP Significators 

The planetary positions and stars and subs of all planets are the same, and so the basic sig- 
nificators are the same. But the additional strong significators for planets having no planet in 
their stars are different for the natives: Mercury is significator for houses 3,5,9,11 for May 
Than Nu and 3,8,11,12 for Zarganar; Saturn for 6,8,12 for May Than Nu and 1,2,6 for Zarga- 
nar; and Ketu for 8 for May Than Nu and 5,9 for Zarganar. 


Longevity 

The indicated better longevity for May Than Nu than Zarganar is to wait and see. 
1st (longevity) CSL: Ra for May Than Nu & Sa for Zarganar (9th is Badhaka) 
Ra(4),Su(9,4),Ju(8-8-11)/Star Ve(10-1-6)/Sub Ve(10-1-6) a 6-8 (1-11) 
Sat(8-9-10),+1-2-6/Star Su(9-4)/Sub Ra(4), Su(9-4),Ju(8-8-11) a 2,6-8-9 (1-11)
