@O08-11-07 A.M. for the above query. 

Mrs Chilakama our maidservant had a fall in her daughter’s house and came back to her 
home with an injured shoulder very recently. When she was taken to hospital for doctor’s

full cure and to remove the bandage. 





What are the general reasons for such occurrences of shoulder fractures among the aged 
people? 

As per the medical research of doctors and their reports following reasons are attributed for 
such mishaps-- 

Osteoporosis is the leading cause of bones fracture. Age is also a major risk factor. Other 
possible risk factors for bones (shoulder) fracture may include, but are not limited to, the fol- 
lowing: 

OOexcessive alcohol and caffeine consumption 

OOlack of physical activity 


O Olow body weight 
OOtall stature 


UOvision problems

Potency vs Impotency = Family Dispute 


By: Sumanadasa Namarathna (Sunaparantha Kalyan) 
Ex-Accountant, Justice of Peace 
No.22/1, Udugampola Road, Marapola, Veyangoda, 


SRI LANKA Email: sumanal946@gmail.com 





Once a retired lady principle came to me seeking my guidance for a family dispute among her 
daughter and her husband and said "My daughter is an English teacher in a government 
school and got married to a person in an executive grade by a proposal after matching the 
horoscope. From the day of the marriage my daughter is not in a good mood and seems to be 
some unpleasant reasons are there in their lives. Still they don't have children. Now my 
daughter says that it is better to divorce than to living together with her husband. Can you 
please check their natal charts and advice me? 


There may be several reasons for such unhappiness and dispute among the husband and 
wife, and according to the mother, the situation is too critical as they are looking for a 
separation or divorce. Since both of them are in respectable carriers with a considerable 
monthly remuneration, they should not have any monetary problem in the family. They have 
their own house to live and a vehicle too for personal use. Also it is informed that the 
husband is non-alcoholic person. Hence the inner matter in their lives for bickering in 
marriage life is unseen. Keeping these matters in mind, first I check the horoscope of wife. 


Generally in Sri Lanka, where the traditional astrology is in top rank for centuries, the way of 
investigating such question by the traditional astrologers is only to check the qualities of 
Maha Dasa lord at the time of question and if it is ill-posited, they instruct to do some 
remedies like offering Poojas to Lord Buddha, Bodhi Tree, Gods like Shri Vishnu, Shiva etc. 
and exorcism activities (Bhoothapasaranaya), wearing Yantra (Talisman) and Sacred threads 
to discard the evil effects of planets. But according to my personal view, the astrology is not 
a science only to prescribe the remedies, but the role of astrology emerges to give the 
guidance or margdarshan to direct people to live a certain way. The original purpose of 
astrology was to inform the people of the course of their life on the basis of the positions of 
the planets in the twelve astrology signs at the moment of their birth or conception.

KP rules for multi marriage and divorce. 

(a) MORE THAN ONE marriage is indicated if the BOTH following two conditions are 
simultaneously satisfied: 

(i) The sub-lord of the 7th cusp OR its Star lord is deposited in a dual sign (Gemini, 
Sagittarius and Pisces) 

OR 

if the sub-lord of the 7th cusp is Mercury/Ju and 

(ii) The sub-lord of the 7th cusp is also a significator of either of the houses 2 or 11 or both. 
If any of the above two conditions is not satisfied, then second marriage is denied. 


(b) Second marriage is indicated if the sub-lord of the 2nd cusp is also a significator of either 
of the houses 7 or 11. 


(c) AS per Kanak: ON ASSUMPTION 2ND WIFE IS CONSIDERED AS YOUNGER SISTER OF 
FIRST -Second marriage is indicated if the sub-lord of the 9th cusp is a significator of either 
of the houses 2 or 9 or 11.

Question: Relocation chart in KP 

Good evening sir, in KP astrology Cuspal Sub Lord is the deciding factor. If I relocate myself 
to one another place, where most of the CSLs would change, and Lagna, all sign lords and 
star lords remain same. Can I expect the relocation chart's results?? If yes how much time it 
will take to get the results? Please clarify the doubt sir. 


Answer: 

The idea of relocation chart in KP was introduced by Shri K.P. Kuppu Ganapathi with 
article "A Research Study on 

Relocation Astorlogy and KP" in KP & Astrology Year Book 2006, page 14-19, quoting-- 


"One should not always calculate the ascendant for the place of 
birth unless the native is permanent in his birth place." (KP 
Reader V, page 162/ original edition page 155) 


Two foreign relocated example charts in his article give more accurate indications of 
the future which is lacking in the charts prepared for birth places. 


Smt Sonia Gandhi's foreign relocated chart for New Delhi gives more accurate justification 
than the original chart for birth place Lusiana, Italy, for her success in the 2004 and 2009 
Indian general elections. 

But relocated charts (within same country) of Tony Blair and Indira Gandhi, whose excep- 
tional original birth charts cannot explain their political success, do not give any significant 


justification of changes in results. 


Hindu astrology is based on Karma and reincarnation, and the birth chart is the indication of 
past karma. 


So the relocation chart may not play an important role in one's destiny for major event. 


For reliability of this relocation theory more research is needed for foreign settlement charts 
for at least two-three decades.

Book review-ABC of Retrograde Planets 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 











ABC of Retrograde Planets 
by K.K. Pathak 
Alpha Publications, 2019, 102 pages 


RETROGRADE 
PLANETS 





Retrogression of Planets is one of the controversial topics of discussion in Astrology. Grace 
Inglis made an attempt Grace Inglis in her book “Retrograde Planets” (1976) to enlighten 
readers on this subject matter for the first time in an exhaustive manner. 


This book differs with Grace’s book in some respects and comprises of seven chapters. 
Chapter One deals with technical aspects of Retrogression of planets. 


Chapter Two deals with views of 14 classical works such as Vridha Yavana Jatka, Brihat 
Samhita of Varaha Mihira, Hora Sara of Prithuyasa, Saravali of Kalyan Verma, Bhavartha 
Ramakara, Sanketu Nidhi, Shambhu Hora, Uttara, Kalamrita, Phala Deepika, Sarvartha 
Chintamani, Bhava Manjari, Phalita Martanda and Jyotish Martanda. 


Chapter Three deals with views of 20 Modem Astrologers with B.S. Rao (1); B.V. Raman; 
R. Lakshman; S. Kanan; J.T. Singham; U.K. Singh; B.D. Hugins; P.S. Shastri; Bepin Bihari; 
B.S. Rao (2); Agastiya; S.K. Kappor; Ajanta Jim; S. Jagganatha Rao; R. Chowdhary; Grace 
Inglish; R. Santhanam, S. S. Chatterjee, Krishna Kumar and U.K. Jha. 


Chapter Four deals with possible effects of Retrograde planets with a critical eye. Chapter 
Five deals with Retrograde planets vis-a-vis Vimshottari Dasa. Chapter Six deals with 
practical examples of as many as 64 in number taken from Select Horoscope published by 
NishKaam Peeth Prakashan. The author has carefully examined all these cases and found 
that much hue and cry made about Retrograde planets has no legs to stand upon. 


Chapter Seven deals with his conclusions. In his view it is foolish to treat a retrograde planet 
as a carrier of BOLT FROM BLUE or a cause for Wind fall Gains. 


KP Ezine March 2020 26 


Grace Inglis has concluded in her Retrograde Planets (1976) in line with Buell D. Huggins 
and Garth Allen that a retrograde planet is not much different in natal chart.

Regarding Covid-19 outbreak in US, it was mentioned in my post in the FB on March 21 
that the 1st case was reported on January 21, and then it increased to 4,372 cases (75 death) 
on March 16, 25,493 cases (259 death) on March 21. Within 5 days cases accelerated to 
about six time, deaths per day about four time. The US position was in third place in cases 
and sixth place in death over the world. 


The current coronavirus pandemic in the US has been found reflected in the horoscope of 
President Trump as head of the country through bad planetary transits. Transit Saturn 
moved closer to his 6th cusp (disease); transit Pluto (destruction) was exactly opposing natal 
Saturn (6t lord) in house 12 (loss, death); and the 10t* lord natal Venus was also opposed by 
transit Saturn and transit Pluto which was in line with the worsening situation of corona- 
virus pandemic. 


If it were reflected so, next day on March 22 transit Mars was moving into Capricorn sign 6th 
bhava to give 6th — 12th bad results with combination of transit Saturn and transit Pluto. So 
in the coming days coronavirus cases would be escalating to the worse level. President

aspect on his conj Lagna and natal Mars.

Is Sachin Pilot next? Twitter abuzz with memes after Jyotiraditya Scindia's exit 


New Delhi, Mar 10: The Madhya Pradesh Congress ts facing its worst crisis as 20 MLA's loy- 
al to Jyotiraditya Scindia have resigned, pushing the 15-month-old Kamal Nath government 
into deep crisis. 

Scindia's exit can be seen as a turning point in the tussle between the party's young lot of lead- 
ers and veterans. It also exposes the grand old parties leadership's inability to take quick dect- 
sions. 

All eyes will now be on Rajasthan, where a Madhya Pradesh like situation prevails as Chief 
Minister Ashok Gehlot and deputy Chief Minister Sachin Pilot are not on good terms. 

Recently, Sachin pilot had opposed the move to send Rajiv Arora, a diamond merchant, to the 
Rajya Sabha as Gehlot proposed his name to the Congress leadership.

on several occasions.

the party lost all 25 seats - and more for the loss of his son, Vaibhav Gehlot, in Jodhpur. 

Sachin Pilot also criticised the government after the death of children in Kota government hospt- 
tal. Not only this, Pilot has differed with the Chief Minister on several other issues. 

The Gehlot government in Rajasthan ts also surviving on a razor thin majority with the support 
of rebel BSP MLAs who have joined the Congress and have been accepted by the Speaker. 
Writing was on the wall: Why Scindia decided to quit the Congress 

In the 200 member assembly, the Congress has the support of 112 MLAs including 3 from the 
CPM, and one from the RLD, who are supporting the government. The BJP has 80 MLAs and 
support of 20 MLAs could change the game in BJP's favour.

A Lady gives a Horary Number 12 by mail on 04-Jan 2020 night stating that “she had lost 
her cash which was kept in a small steel box in her bedroom three days back and could not 
find in spite of her best search. She asks will it be traced and if so when? 

I could see the mail only in the morning hours of 5t8 Feb 2020 @07-32-00 AM and 
immediately I erected a horary chart for its No. 12 @07-32-16 AM which is attached 
herewith. 


Hints for the query 

25d house indicates liquid assets (cash) and movable articles (cash box) which are lost or 
stolen. 

6th house indicates loss to the thief (negative to 7th-thief) and 12th house indicates loss of the 
native. 


Moon speaks of the mind of the querent. 

Moon is the lord of 4 placed in 24 house Taurus sign on 23:32;14 degrees. It is placed in the 
star of Mars lord of 1 and 8 in 8th, and in the sub of Jupiter lord of 9 and 12 in 9th, 

2 indicates liquid asset-cash, 4 indicates house where it is lost, 12- indicates loss of cash of 
the native, and 8 indicates hindrances, problems and difficulties in tracing the lost cash. 
Since all the houses which are indicated pertain to the query which is quite relevant and so 
it is genuine. 


KP RULE for recovery of lost or stolen property 

If the 11th cusp (recovery any losses of any nature ) sub lord signifies 2-liquid assets-cash, 
6- opponent’s loss or 11t -regaining of liquid assets or movable articles, and fulfilment of 
one desire and not connected to 5-negative to 6th-opponent's gain or profit, 8-hindrances, 
obstacles, breaks or 12th loss to the querent, then it indicates recovery of lost articles or cash 
is possible during the conjoined dasa period of the significators of 2,6,11 houses; and if it 
signifies 5-8-12, there may be mixed chances towards regaining the lost article or cash. 

Note- in case of any confusion, the above rule must be cross-checked by the significations of 
the 274 cusp. 


As per the horary chart 

11th cusp sub lord is Moon which I have already discussed above. 

So Moon signifies Wits star-lord level (Mars) 1,2,4,8 and @its sub lord (JUP) level- 9 and 12. 
Here 2 is positive and 1-8-12 are negative to indicate that there are only mixed chances of 
recovery of lost cash. 


Cross verification of 24 cusp 

As per the chart—2™ cusp sub lord is Jupiter lord of 9 and 12 in 9th, It is placed in the star 
of Venus lord of 2 and 7 in 11*® and in the sub of Jupiter lord of and 9 and 12 in 9th, Jupiter 
co-rules 8th cusp also as sub lord. 

Thus Jupiter the 24 cusp sub lord signifies @PLT&STL 2,7,9,11,12 and @SBL 9 and 12. 
Here 2 and 11 are positive houses and 7 and 12 are negative houses at the star-lord level. 

12 is negative at sub lord level. Since both positive and negative houses are signified it 
clearly indicates that there are mixed chances for recovery of lost cash. 

Note-1) Recovery of Lost property /cash—KP Rule says if the significators of 2-6-11 agree with 
the Ruling Planets of the time of judgment, the property /cash lost will be recovered. (see 
page no. 235 of KP Reader No. 6). And if connected with 5-8-12 houses it is lost once for all.

Astrological Analysis on Coronavirus or COVID-19 


By: VSN. Moorthiji, 
# 404, Teja Garden Apartments, 
i Prakashnagar, KURNOOL- 4. (AP) 
| Mobile:- 09440220874. E-mail:- vsnm.vdl@gmail.com; 











What is Coronavirus? 


Coronavirus is an epidemic disease which comes from a large family of rapidly spreading 
virus. It has been never detected before. It affects the body directly. It is also detected in 
animals along with human-beings. Recently it began in December 2019 in Wuhan City of 
China. So far no effective vaccine has been invented for preventing Coronavirus. 


What are the symptoms of Coronavirus? 
Fever, cold and cough, sore-throat and difficulty in breathing are the main symptoms of it. 


What to do if the symptoms are found? 
If the symptoms of Coronavirus are found immediately a through medical examination 
should be conducted by the qualified medical doctors for detecting it. 


What are the preventive measures for Coronavirus? 

A few Coronavirus preventive measures which are suggested by the Medical Officers and 
Health Officers are given hereunder:- 

1) This disease spreads very easily and quickly through hands. So please do not give 
shake-hands to anybody. 

2) Non-Veg(egg & meat) should be avoided. Take only hot vegetarian food. 

3) Proper distance should be maintained from the Coronavirus patients. 

4) Wash your hands with sanitizer or with a good medicated soap at least 5 or 6 times a day. 
5) While washing hands, clean the nails also. 

6) You must and should cover your mouth and nose with the mask. If the masks are not 
available, please cover your mouth and nose with either tissue paper or at least with a 
cleaned handkerchief while coughing and sneezing. 

7) Be away from animals and birds like dogs, pigs, hens and doves. 

8) Do not keep a dry throat and Keep drinking water whenever it is needed. 

9) Please do not travel abroad as well as to cold areas. 

10) Do not touch/rub your eyes, nose and mouth with your hands. 


Before going to analyze Coronavirus disease astrologically, let us know which planets, 
houses and signs are related to this disease:- 


1) MOON governs the Ooean and sea related products; it denotes the diseases which are re- 
lated to cold, difficulty in breathing, breast diseases as well as the diseases related to depres- 
sion. Vata and Kapha. It governs the fluid of the body, quality of blood and lymph, glands, 
tonsils, breast, face, lungs and chest. 


2) RAHU & KETU are the chief karakas for viral diseases. 


3) If MERCURY is afflicted by Saturn and Mars, it creates viral diseases. Mercury rules 
tridoshas (vata, Pitta & Kapha). It gives psychic disease, nervous breakdown, insom- 
nia, skin diseases, impotency, epilepsy, lecoderma, vertigo, loss of memory or speech, asth- 
ma, diseases of the respiratory system, deafness, a disorder of intestines, dyspepsia etc. 


4) SUN governs vitality, sound health, strong immunity and healing power. If the SUN is ill 


placed in transit, then plenty of chances are there for causing the viral diseases such as 
heart troubles, erratic blood circulation, bone fractures, weak immune system, typhoid,

KP Marriage Matching is Not Reliable for 
Multi-marriage Horoscopes 


By: Tin Win

Split after just 12 days of marriage 

The former “Baywatch” actress Pamela Anderson, 52, surprised fans by marrying movie 
producer a 30 year friend Jon Peters, 74, in a private ceremony in Malibu, California, on 
Monday, January 20, 2020. Pamela Anderson and Jon Peters split on February 02, after 
tying the knot just 12 days. The duo dated more than 30 years ago before reuniting last 
year. Both were previously married four times. Pamela asked for a break saying “Life is a 
journey and love is a process. With that universal truth in mind, we have mutually decided 
to put off the formalization of our marriage certificate and put our faith in the process.”, left 


for Canada. : 
MS 









. a, 


Multi-marriage Horoscopes 

Multi-marriage is indicated in both horoscopes of Pamela Anderson and Jon Peters. This 
marriage is 5th marriage for both of them, and fourth husband for Pamela Anderson as she 
married a husband twice. 


Results of KP Matching 

As per K. P. Dasavida Porutham (K.P.D.P.) marriage matching, developed by K.P. Kuppu 
Ganapathi, on the day of marriage overall matching percentage is 71.67% - Above Average 
Match, and K.P.D.P criterion No. 10 is 75% - above average, so marriage is recommendable. 


According to K. P. Relationship Method (K.P.R.M.), developed by Kanak Bosmia, all in 
average, it is 87.50%, and K.P.R.M. criterion No. 6 is more than 51%, thus matching is 
acceptable. 

However the marriage lasted for 12 days only. As found in other multi-marriage horoscopes, 
the marriage matching is not applicable for these 

two multi-marriage horoscopes. 


Indicators of Short Married Life 

Firstly marriage-marriage is found in both horoscopes. 

Secondly separation or divorce significators strongly appear along with marriage significators 
in the analysis of the concerned cuspal sub lords .

permanent tie of friendship) 

The 7th cuspal sub lord’s signification of house 1.6 and 10, which are negative houses to 2, 
7 and 11 marriage and 12 houses without 2,7,11, would indicate no marriage. (12th 
indicates separation)

KP Ezine April 2020 31 


Cancellation of Marriage 


By: Siva Prasad Gantha 


HIG 72, Bharatnagar Colony, Hyderabad-500018. 
Mobile: 9440152397; E-mail: siva.gantha@gmail.com 











One of my distant relatives had faced the situation of breakage of marriage in his life and it 
came to my notice. This article is written in that regard for the benefit of readers. The birth 
particulars of a girl are as follows: 

DOB: 26-8-1986; Time: 5.00 am; Ramachandrapuram (Hyd); Long:78-17’E; Lat:17-30N 

In K.P. the houses 2 , 7 and 11 deal with the matter of marriage. If the 7th cuspal sublord 
signifies 2 or 7 or 11, marriage is promised. 

In the horoscope of the native the 7th cuspal sublord is Rahu. Rahu represents Mercury 
being in the sign of Virgo. Mercury is in 2 lord of 3,12. Rahu is in 2 in the star of Moon in 6 
lord of 1. Rahu is in the sub of Saturn in 8 lord of 7,8. As Rahu signifies 2,7 marriage is 
promised. At the same time Rahu signifies 1,6,8,12 also, which signifies separation. The 
significators for the marriage are as under: 


Cusp A B C D 
2 wne=H Mer,Rah Mer, Mon sun 
rr sat, Ket sat 
11 Jup Ven Jup Ven 


The native is born in Uttarashada star with Ascendant Cancer with a balance of Sun dasa of 
4 years 4 months and 20 days. The native attained marriageable age during Mars dasa but 
mars is not a significator of marriage. Hence the native could not get married during the 
period of Mars. Rahu dasa followed subsequently. 

TIMING OF THE EVENT: At the time of analysis the native was running the DBA of Rah-Rah- 
Ven. 


Dasa lord Rahu, having no planets in its stars, is in 2 in the star of Moon in 6 lord of 1. The 
sublord Saturn is in 8 lord of 7,8. Rahu signifies 2,7 favourable for giving marriage and also 
1,6,8 . Further Rahu is also the cuspal sublord of 1,5,7,11 houses. As Rahu is having 
positional status it can be considered as bhukthi lord also. 


The anthara lord Venus is in 11 lord of 4,11. Venus is in the star of Jupitor and sub of 
Saturn. The starlord Jupiter is in 5 lord of 6,9 and the sublord Saturn is in 8 lord of 7,8. 
Venus signifies 5,7,11,9 and also 6,8. It is favourable for giving marriage. 


Further Venus is indicating for negotiations during its period because of its ruling the sub of 
3rd cusp and signification of 11t house. Jupiter signifying the houses 9,11 brought the 
native up to engagement during its sookshma period though the other DBA lords are 
negatively strong to the marriage celebration. It was learnt that betrothal ceremony was 
held on 9th January 2020 during the period of sookshma lord Jupitor. 


Saturn is a lord of 7,8 deposited in 8th house in its own star and sub of Mars. The sublord 
ars having positional status is in 12 lord of 5,10. Thus Saturn signifies 5,7 and also 8,10,12. 
When the sookshma period of Saturn was commenced from 24th January,2020 all the DBA 
lords have become strongly negative to the marriage event. It is also noticed that all the 
planets are connected to either 6 or 8 or 12. So on the very next day of commencement of 
Saturn sookshma the native has expressed her unwillingness to the marriage with the boy 
engaged and cancelled the marriage during the joint dasa period of Rah-Rah-Ven-Sat. Hence 
the marriage event could not take place.

How Suicide Is Destined?

lst (longevity) & 8th (suicide house) CSL’s signification of 1 (self effort), 2,7,9 Marka- Badha- 
ka,12 Moksha (suicide house) & 6 (injury), 8 (suicide house) and connection with Mars 
(suicide karaka) indicates suicide.

A client has expressed difficulty, before one of my friends, in performing his sister’s marriage 
in spite of best efforts. Then my friend asked me to look into her horoscope as to when she 
will get married. The birth particulars are as follows: 


DOB: 2-9-1989 Time: 11-23 am Place: Bombay 


I have casted her horoscope on 26-1-2019 at my residence in Hyderabad. She is born in Sun 
star in Virgo sign with Libra as Ascendant. 


The houses 2,7,11 deal with the matter of marriage. If the 7th cuspal sublord signifies 2 or 7 
or 11, marriage is promised. If the 5t* cuspal sublord signifies 5,11 the native will fall in 
love. If the 5 CSL signifies 7 also then love marriage is promised. If the 7 CSL connected

Question 1: Effective Significators 

In “Key to Learn - K.P. cuspal system.pdf “ E-Book , in PDF file pg 60 , under lesson 6 , 
it says sub lord of the house under ref will favour or not if it is 4,or,7, 

or 8, or 12 from that house under Ref.- As mentioned below 


First Criterion: ( Pg 60 of PDF file ) 

This is based on the concept of Rule 1 that Star proposes and 

Sub disposes. If the position of Sub lord is 4 or 7 or 8 or 12 with 

respect to the position of the houses of which the Planet has to 

offer the results as per its PS or Stellar Status then the Planet is 
believed to offer unfavourable result. 


Sir , in KP-Ezine DEC. 2013, pg 81 
It says as below: 

3. “In order to know what each planet can contribute always consider its sub lord”. (KP 
Reader III page 362/ 1971 edition, practical part p194) 
Generally if the sub lord occupies or owns houses 6, 8, 12 from a house occupied or owned 
by a planet or its star, the sub lord may not favor the house matters. However out of houses 
6,8,12, only the 12th position to any house is clearly negative or detrimental for that house. 


For example, Female born on 4 November 1983, at 2:04 p.m., hr 5 west, in Brunswick, GA 
(US), 81w30, 31n09, KP New Ayanamsa 23° 32' 27”, the 5th cuspal sub lord is Jupiter. 


My confusion is, shall I take Houses 4 & 7 also with houses 6,8,& 12 to know whether - The 
Sub-Lord favours or not the house results. 
Request Your advice to clarify my confusion. 


Answer 1: 

For example, Female born on 4 November 1983, at 2:04 p.m., hr 5 west, in Brunswick, GA 
(US), 81w30, 31n09, KP New Ayanamsa 23° 32' 27”, the 5th cuspal sub lord is Jupiter. 
Jupiter is in 10, lord of 2,11, in the star of Mercury in 9, lord of 5,8 and sub of Venus in 7, 
lord of 4,9. 


7,4,9 houses indicated by the sub can be taken as signifcators in addition to houses 10,2,11- 
9,5,8 indicated by the planet and the star or as decider in choosing effective significators of 
houses 10,2,11- 9,5,8. 


“Planet is the source, constellation indicates nature of the result and the SUB is a de- 
ciding factor whether the matter is favorable or not.” 


The 12th houses from 7,4,9 are 8,5,10, and so these 8,5,10 houses become the ineffective sig- 
nificators, i.e. 2,5+,8+,9,10+,11. 
'+' means that the sublord does not favour the house matters, i.e. ineffective significators. 


By considering not only 12th but also 6,8th houses from 8,5,10, the effective significators are 


2+, 5+, 8+, 9, 10+, 11, i.e. 9 & 11 only, as shown in the effective significators table supported 
by KPAstro 4.5. (attached).

Question 2: Above/ Below Horizon 

This is a query for your Question-Answer column. In KP reader-3rd page-174 there is a par- 
agraph:- "As Dashanath and Bhuktinath are in 10th and 11th house respectively and above 
the horizon, you fell on the left side. As Jupiter was Aspecting the Dasalord and was below 
the horizon, the providential help came from right side. That's why the truck went on the 
right side and you there by escape. If Jupiter have been in the 9th house and above the hori- 
zon the truck would have come on the left and would have gone at a distance. If Jupiter 
would have been in Lagna the truck would have stopped just in front of you. " 


Please clear two points from above paragraph. 1. what is above and below horizon? 2. How 
one can decide, left or right side from horoscope? 


Answer 2: 
The above horizon is comprised of Houses 7 through 12—the upper half of the horoscope. 
The below horizon is comprised of Houses 1 through 6—the lower half of the horoscope. 


If the relevent planet is in the above horizon, the event will happen on your left side. 
If the relevent planet is in the below horizon, the event will happen on your right side.

‘K.P. Krishman's Nirayana Ephemeris by Sri. K. Subramaniam is the latest Ephemeris in the series of 
K.P. Ephemeris for the year 2021-2030. 


We have this Ephemeris 2021-2030 containing the day to day positions of various planets for a set of 
10 years. As in the previous Volumes the day today planetary positions of SUN. MOON. MARS. MER- 
CURY. JUPITER. SATURN AND RAHU Including the trans-saturnine planets Uranus. Neptune are fur- 
nished here for every day at 5.30 a.m. 1ST, and for corresponding standard Time of any country or 
Zone equivalent to 5.30 a.m. 157. The SID Time Expressed in hours, mts & seconds is computed for 
every day 5.30 a.m. LMT at 82.30 East longitude of the Centre Meridian of India. The SID-TIME can be 
adjusted to the Standard Time of Meridian of any country or zone in two ways. If this time between the 
local Standard Time Meridian & 1ST Meridian is added to long, of Eat of 82.30E or subtracted from 
the (for longitude of West. SID Time in their Ephemeris, the resulting figures is the SID Time at the 
local Standard Meridian at he Standard Time equivalent of 5.30 a.m 1ST. Another way is to add (for 
Ecist) or subtract (for west, the Sidereal time correction for longitude difference between 1ST and 1ST 
Meridians, the result figure being the SID Time at the local Standard Time at 5.30 a.m. LMT (Table X) 


It has also felt necessary to include in this volume 4 few useful Tables with the aid of which it may be 
possible for even an amateur to correctly cast the horoscope of a person in any part of the world and 
not necessarily in India. 


Table IV gives the Timings of Sun Rise in LMT for the various places lying for the north of Equator 
(North lat).and Table V similarly for South lat Table VilA shows the amount of correction for Sidereal 
Time to be applied for every hour and parts of an hours and for every hour and parts of an hour and 
for every degree of longitude. Table X indicates the Standard Time followed in each country or Zone 
with in the same country and how for it is ahead or behind, the GMT and also the local standard Time 
equivalent when it is Noon at GMT & 5.30 p.m. 1ST. 

Yet another Table -XI Furnished the LAT/long of Prominent places In and outside India. An important 
Table of logarithms -Table I has been added and how to use the table also been explained in detail

he continued improving his education by learning at Cheung Kong Graduate Business 
School at Beijing in 2006.. Now one of the richest men alive, it took him 4 years to get into 
college and upon graduating he applied for 30 different jobs and was rejected by all of them.

applied ten times to Harvard Business School and got rejected each time. He and Amazon

e-commerce business with a great amount of hope even if he was going through a lot of 
struggles as shown by the Viparita combination of the 6t8 lord Mars and 12t® lord Venus.

On 29 March 2020 during morning hours ie: at 07-17-11 A.M, a question arose in my mind 
regarding the arrival of my brother-in-law. 
“When will Mr Murali, who has gone to his daughter’s house (at Ameerpet) due to 
government’s lockdown on account of CORONAVIRUS, will be back to his place of stay at 
Tarnaka Secundrabad with us?”. 














Immediately I erected a ruling planets chart as I wish to solve this query with the help of 
ruling planets that too only with the help of SUN’s transit. 


1) Whether my desire is promised? 

As per the RPs chart, 11t* cusp sub lord is Mars+ which co-rules 5th also. No planets are 
placed in the stars of Mars. Mars is the lord of the 1 and 8 in 10 in conjunction with Saturn 
(lord of 11 &12 in 10). Mars is placed in the star of Sun lord of 6 in 12th and the sub of 
Saturn lord of 11 and 12 in 10. Thus Mars+ 11 cusp sub lord signifies @STL 12 and @SBL 
11 promises the event. 


2) Since I would be dealing the query with the help of following ruling planets @TOUJ, I have 
to analyze the strength of the same before proceeding further with the help of only SUN’s 
transit. 


RULING PLANETS @ TOJ-(29/03 /2020@07-17-11 A.M @SECUNDRABD-TARNAKA)— 


Ruling Planets at TOJ— 29-03-2020 @07-17-11 A.M.---

MOON RASI— VENUS-SUN-MERC. 

DAY LORD- SUN. 

We have RPs as- SUN(3)-KETHU-MARS+-MERC+-VENUS+.

SGL)

planets are regarded as the ruling planets. 

Asc. or Lagna Star- lord./ Asc. Sign- lord. 

3)Moon Star-lord./ 4) Moon Sign- lord. 

5) Daylord.

have revealed that the ASC. sub-lord and Moon sub-lord should also be included as ruling 
planets. This is quite an in consonance with the sub theory of our Great GURUJI and 
thousands of astrologers and great scholars in K.P. by taking Sub-lords as ruling planets 
have given innumerable accurate predictions. Therefore when we include these two sub lords 
ie: Asc. sub-lord and Moon sub-lords, they take precedence over the Ascendant star-lord and 
Moon star-lord in the meriting. He also adds that, if need be sub-sub-lord also can be taken 
as RPs. This is left to individual astrologers based on their experience. Apart from the above

By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 








First time 2 corona virus cases were found in Myanmar when transit Mars (6t lord for 
sudden fever raising and infectious disease) enters into the 3™ house Capricorn sign for 
lungs of Myanmar Independence chart and combined with transiting Saturn and Pluto 
(dangerous disease) over natal Venus (12 lord for hospitalization/ death). Conjunction of 
transiting Mars, Saturn & Pluto are opposing natal Saturn (34 lord lungs disease) and Pluto. 
At the same time transit Mars is aspecting natal Rahu (dangerous viral disease) in 6t house 
and natal Mars and Fortuna in 10 house. Transit Saturn is also aspecting Ketu (dangerous 
disease) in 12t» house (hospitalization/ death). Transit Mars in its strongest sign and Saturn 
in its own sign Capricorn are strong to give bad results for corona virus disease by lordship 
of 6t and 3"4 respectively in combination of transit Pluto. 


Even though transit Jupiter is aspecting 6, 8 and 10 houses up to Mrach 28, strong Mars 
caused the start of corona virus earlier than expected but not much spread of disease till 
transit Jupiter moves to Capricorn sign on March 29 to join Capricorn sign it will make the 
bad results of conjoined Mars, Saturn and Pluto worse and restrictive nature of sign open by 
Jupiter’s nature of expansion, i.e. spread of disease. 


On 11 April the number of infected cases is 38 with 3 dead. The situation can be worse 
around April 12-13 when transit Mars exactly aspects natal Mars in the Independence chart 
and then around April 26-27 when transit Mars exactly aspects the 6 cusp. As of 26 April 
the number of infected cases is 146 with 5 dead. 


The relief can be expected after Mars, the only one planet covered with blood color, leaves the 
Capricorn sign on 5 May 2010. Transit Saturn will be retrograding from 12 May 2020. 
Transit Jupiter will be retrograding from May 15 and entering back into Sagittarius sign from 
1 July 2020.

negative 2,3,6,7,8,9 Badhaka and 12, along with positive 1,11.

KP Rule: Is the report true or false? 

One has to judge the third house for any information or correspondence or communication or 
report. 

We have to find out the sub-lord of the 3rd cusp; note in which constellation the sub-lord is 
deposited. 

If the lord of constellation in which the sub-lord is deposited happens to be Saturn, the 
report is false; and the lord happens to be any planet connected with Saturn in any manner, 
the report is false; if itis Mars, then it is mischievous and false. 

If it is Jupiter, it is true; and if it is connected with Jupiter the report will be correct. 

This is the way to find out whether rumour is believable or not. (KP Reader VI, Horary 
Astrology, pp 171-172)

Answer 1: 


The article on Sensitive Point' in "Astrosecrets & KP, Part II, 2003, pp 141-146 is a compila- 
tion of references, like KP Reader V pp 161-163 (Old Edition 154-156), 189-192 (Old Edition 
180-182), RP & KP, 1985, pp 85-89, Astrosecrets & KP, Part II, 2003, pp 86-105 etc. 


Sensitive Points 


The sensitive zone is a point in the zodiac ruled by the fructifying significators of an event- 
especially the combinations of dasa lord and bhukti lord. 


The transit of dasa period lords should be the first consideration. The transit of Jupiter over 
a sensitive point indicates the year of fructification of the event under consideration. The 
transit of luminaries Sun and Moon which are the exciting planets over the sensitive zones 
indicates the month and the day of the fructification of an event respectively. The transit of 


Ascendant over a sensitive point indicates the exact hour and minute of fructification of an 
event.

Uncover the Mystery! True Crime Astrology looks at these questions: What was at the root of 
Ted Bundy's addiction to killing? What are the similarities between the murders of John 
Lennon and John F. Kennedy? Marilyn Monroe: Suicide or Murder? Did Jeffrey MacDonald 
kill his wife and daughters? What motivated Richard Speck to murder eight student nurses? 
What are the dark inner worlds of Diane Downs, who shot her three children , Larry 
Singleton, who raped a 15-year-old hitchhiker, then chopped off her arms ... poet Sylvia 
Plath, who took her own life at age 30? What are the astrological indications of suicide? True 
Crime Astrology sheds light on these and other compelling mysteries by examining each 
homicide or suicide from an astrological point of view. You'll gain penetrating insight into 
each case and examine the hidden, psychological motivations that may help to explain these 
atrocious crimes. Also included in this book are the midpoints associated with violence and 
suicide, and seven special-interest Arabic Parts. Each of these can be used when analyzing 
charts for murder and suicide. 


An example of the writing, from the first chapter on Diane Downs: 

Diane Downs was accused of murdering one of her three children and attempting to murder 
the other two, on May 19, 1983, and sent to prison. She says she's innocent. Rowland 
accepts the judgment of the court and reads the chart as if Downs was guilty. I would much 
rather Rowland attempted to establish guilt. Rowland establishes that on the date in 
question, Downs was having extraordinary transits, which would be true whether or not she 
was guilty, since the death of a child is always most strongly marked in a parent's chart. 
Rowland does not connect the mother's alleged act directly to any of the children, she does 
not show that the mother was capable of harming a specific child in a specific way. In the 
natal chart (August 7, 1955, 7:35 pm MST, Phoenix, AZ), the 5th house of children is Gemini 
and empty, the ruler, Mercury, is conjunct Mars in Leo late in the 6th. Is this violence to 
children? Perhaps. The degree on the cusp of the Sth is 27 Gemini, which means the house 
is ruled largely by the Moon, which we find in Aries in the 2nd, of money. Which would be 
money for breeding children who Downs had little emotional connection with (lack of water in 
the chart as a whole). While the Moon is itself disposed by Mars, it makes no sense to 
murder your source of income. On the other hand, Leo is on the cusp of the 7th and just 
inside it is Pluto in Leo. The Sun, which rules Leo, is 12 houses away from it. If an estranged 
boyfriend murdered the children (Pluto in Leo in the 7th, with the Sun in Leo in the 6th 
behind it, triggering Mars to act directly upon Mercury, the ruler of the Sth and indirectly 
upon the Moon, which Mars rules), Diane Downs's chart backs her story, with one critical 
change: She knew the attacker, but chose to remain silent. Seventh house ruled from the 6th 
(12 houses away from the 7th) means the identity of a 7th house individual will be very hard 
to determine. We have no confidence in detectives to do anything other than follow their 
noses, so a guilty verdict must be proved. Astrologically speaking, We don't think Rowland 
did. 


Since one will ask, Rowland sort of, kind of, think Marilyn was murdered. We wish the _ as- 
trology was better.

US Democratic Vice Presidential Candidate for 2020 


As predicted in KP-Ezine September 2019 issue, under “US Democratic Presidential Candidates for 
2020”, former Vice President Joe Biden has become the presumptive US Democratic Vice Presidential 
Nominee for 2020, out of analyzed five front runners, former Vice President and Delaware Senator Joe 
Biden, Vermont Senator Bernie Sanders, Massachusetts Senator Elizabeth Warren, California Senator 
Kamala Harris and Indiana Mayor Pete Buttigieg. 


The Democratic party's nominees for President and Vice President of the United States for the 2020 
U.S. presidential election will be officially confirmed at the 2020 Democratic National Convention , 
which is to be held from July 13-16, 2020 in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. 


Joe Biden will be challenging President Donald Trump in the US presidential election to be held on 
November 3, 2020. Biden, now 77, has promised to elect a woman as the vice president, and Joe 
Biden is likely to be chosen based on whether his vice-president is qualified to run the country and is 
a candidate for the Democratic Party. 


The short list of possible woman candidates includes Minnesota Senator Amy Klobuchar, Massachu- 
setts Senator Elizabeth Warren, Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer, California Senator Kamala 
Harris. Other names include Stacey Abrams, who nearly won the Georgia governor’s race in 2018, New 
Mexico Governor Michelle Lujan Grisham, Nevada senator Catherine Cortez Masto whose horoscopes 
are not available to study. 

So the horoscopes of the top four women have been analyzed from the following astrological 
perspectives, 10th cuspal sub lord signifying 3,6,10, 11 houses against unfavorable 4,5,8,12 for 
getting power, 1st CSL for status, the DBAS lords and transit at the time of the Democratic National 
Convention on coming June 14, as shown in Tables 1 to 7. And the final ranking is summarized in 
Table 8 showing Michigan Governor Gretchem Whitmer as the most possible choice closely followed by 
Massachusetts Senator Elizabeth Warren. 





Good luck!

Sonia Gandhi sets stage for Rahul’s return, sidelines Patel, Antony and other veterans 
Interim Congress president Sonia Gandhi constitutes a key party committee headed by 
Dr Manmohan Singh and including Rahul Gandhi and his close aides, leaving out party 
veterans. 

New Delhi: Signalling Rahul Gandhi’s return to the helm of affairs in the Congress, interim 
president Sonia Gandhi on Saturday constituted an 11-member consultative committee. 

The committee predominantly comprises members of Rahul’s team and excludes veterans 
such as A. K. Antony, Ahmed Patel, and Ghulam Nabi Azad who never missed out a place in 
any important committee in the past two decades. 

The new committee will meet ‘Virtually’ every day to deliberate on “matters of current concern 
and formulate the views of the party on various issues,” the principal opposition party said in 
a press communique. Apart from the Congress Working Committee (CWC), it’s the only other 
AICC committee in place. 

Though former Prime Minister Manmohan Singh has been appointed chairman of the 
committee, with Rahul’s name coming after him on the list, Congress leaders didn’t miss the 
message — that Rahul has virtually taken direct control of the party affairs after sidelining 
veterans who were close to Sonia Gandhi since her entry in politics in 1998. 

The consultative committee comprises party veterans former finance minister 
P. Chidambaram and Jairam Ramesh, but party leaders concede that’s for “window 
dressing.” 

The party’s decision to not sideline veterans such as Patel was said to be the main reason for 
Rahul’s refusal to return as Congress president — a post he had resigned from after the last 
Lok Sabha elections. 

Sonia Gandhi was said to be disinclined but relented, finally. Rahul’s video interaction with 
reporters on Thursday was the first sign of the things to come in the Congress. 

He is likely to address more such press conferences in the coming few days to buttress the 
message that he is in control now. During his media interaction, Rahul had pointed out how 
he was in touch with the chief ministers of Congress governed states and was giving them 
regular advice too. 

The Consultative group is full of members from Rahul Gandhi’s team, including Randeep 
Singh Surjewala, K. C. Venugopal, Jairam Ramesh, Manish Tewari, Praveen Chakravarty, 
Gaurav Vallabh, Supriya Shrinate and Rohan Gupta. 

Ahead of the Lok Sabha election in 2019, the then Congress president Rahul Gandhi had 
formed a nine-member committee include senior leaders A. K. Antony, Ghulam Nabi Azad, P 
Chidambaram, Ashok Gehlot, Mallikarjun Kharge, Ahmed Patel, Jairam Ramesh, Randeep

Balarishta doshas as per Vedic astrology are as follows:- 


1) Chandrastamancha :-If Moon is placed in 8 from Lagna, 
2) Dharaneesuta saptamancha:- If Mars is placed in 7*®, 

3) Rahurnavancha:- If Rahu is placed in 9,

9) Keturvyayasthu:- If Ketu is placed in 12th 


In this natal chart of this boy, none is placed as said above. So there is no balarishta dosham 
in this birth chart. 


Some other important rules regarding longevity in Vedic astrology are as follow:- 

1) More over this boy is born in Dhanishta nakshatra 3" quarter. No dosha. (No harm).It is 
good.

oun.

nullified. It is also a good one.

aspecting the 7th lord Venus (kendra lord) with his 5t special aspect. 


K.P. Rules for Longevity is as follows:- 


(1) If the Ascendant cusp sublord signifies 1, 5, 9,10 along with 3, 8 then it indicates Long 
Life(over 66 Years).

New research in longevity for KP astrology 


By: Sandro Basilioli ( astrodivediko) 


email ; vediko@libero. it 











Introduction 


I have publish a research article for a new theory for longevity with Krishnamurty Paddhati . 
I have explane that in some cases using KP traditional and natal horoscopes the longevity 
was not right. So i developed a new way in looking in one’s chart for calculating the span of 
life dividing the analysis in sign level, star level & sub level of the ascendent sub lord. For 
signification i have used the Nadi astrology of Umang Taneja system, similar to KP with the 
only difference for the nodes signification and not including the cuspal lords cups, so it was 
not completely fully kp astrology. 

Here i am presenting a new approach using the same rules but instead looking only in the 
ascendent sub lord, we look into the ascendent sign lord, star -lord and sub-lord kp 
traditional signification, combine together whitch will give a certon code that will indicate 
the first block of longevity range . 

It was tested on 50 random charts and it gave good results so i am presenting this theory for 
the benefit of readers and astrologers. Many astrologers ask me for longevity readings for 
there clients and i am glad to help becouse i consider them my friends . Four cases will be 
presented here and a table of all horoscope examined . Some more testing is needed at least 
other 50 charts to have 100 cases to accepted it as a new rule. For my esperience, | 
personally advise to calculate the longevity of a person after his 33dr year of life, this becouse 
the short life depends on our parents karma. Another reason is, with any system we use 
included KP traditional, the rules work quite well for medium life and long life in natal 
charts ,so it’s better to not calculate the longevity before 33 years of life . In horary KP, itis 
different becouse you will have the exact time of event, the exact longitude of the ascendent 
and the exact sub lord of the ascendent to predict correctly . 


Rules for advanced Krishnamurti Paddhati astrology. 

1):1,3,5,9,10,11 are good (bhadaka planet is not counted) 

2):6,8,12,4 are neutral 

3):Maraka, bhadhaka are bad. 

Combination of 1 and 2 gives long life, of 1 and 3 gives medium life, combination of 2 and 3 
gives short life. Combination of 2 alone gives medium life. 


Look into the ascendent sign-lord, star-lord & sub-lord full signification of sign-star & sub. 
Aspect of planets upto orb 3°20” only . 


The combine code of every planet will give the longevity code. 


The longevity codes. 

Short life 

S-S-S = 12 to 32, M-S-S or S-M-S or S-S-M = 12 to 36,L-S-S, or S-L-S or S-S-L = from 12 to 
42 and L-M-S or M-L-S= from 12 to 44y. 


Medium life 
S-M-M or M-M-S or M-S-M= from 32 to 67, M-M-M = from 34 to 72, L-M-M or M-M-L or M-L- 
M = from 39 to 82, L-S-M or S-L-M = from 33 to 70. 


Long life 


S-L-L or L-S-L or L-L-S = from 62 to 93, S.M-L or M-S-L = from 60 to 91, M-L-L or L-L-M or L 
-M-L = from 65 to 100, L-L-L = from 73 to 100 + years.

Conclusions 


With 47 AA rated charts and 3 rated A by astrodatabank with a total of 50 charts, the new 
method holds good in 43 cases with 86% .It means, with more charts the accuracy could 
increase to 90% or it could decrease to 80% that is good . Be able to predict 80% of people 
life span out of 100 people is not bad in this difficult subject. 

In the next article i will show how to select the second block that will reduce the longevity 
range like a Russian doll. 

To select the second block, different formula will be needed . Every longevity range will have 
3 different formula named A-B-C-D & E , A-B-C for short life, B-C-D for medium and C-D-E 
for long life. After selecting the second block, it will be more easy to choose the right dasha , 
Bhukti and antara with more accuracy. 

I believe using data of 100 charts of people that had a medium or a long life, the rule could 
have an accuracy of 90% . By the way, in some cases a short orb aspect upto 3°20” could be 
needed to select the right code. If any astrologer would like to make research and test my 
new method, I will be glad to have any advice to improve it.

As predicted in KP-Ezine September 2019 issue, under “US Democratic Presidential

Massachusetts Senator Elizabeth Warren, California Senator Kamala Harris and Indiana 
Mayor Pete Buttigieg. 





The Democratic party's nominees for President and Vice President of the United States for 
the 2020 U.S. presidential election will be officially confirmed at the 2020 Democratic 
National Convention , which is to be held from July 13-16, 2020 in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. 


Joe Biden will be challenging President Donald Trump in the US presidential election to be 
held on November 3, 2020. Biden, now 77, has promised to elect a woman as the vice 
president, and Joe Biden is likely to be chosen based on whether his vice-president is 
qualified to run the country and is a candidate for the Democratic Party. 


The short list of possible woman candidates includes Minnesota Senator Amy Klobuchar, 
Massachusetts Senator Elizabeth Warren, Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer, California 
Senator Kamala Harris. Other names include Stacey Abrams, who nearly won the Georgia 
governor’s race in 2018, New Mexico Governor Michelle Lujan Grisham, Nevada senator 
Catherine Cortez Masto whose horoscopes are not available to study.

Is the rumor or news report of lockdown extension being correct? 


Hints: One has to judge the third house for any rumor, information, correspondence, 
communication, news or report. According to the Krishnamurti Padhdhati, Sublord of the 
3rd cusp indicates the correctness of news. We have to find out the sub-lord of the third 
cusp; note in which constellation the sub-lord is deposited. If the lord of the constellation in 
which the sub-lord is deposited happens to be Ketu or Mars; the rumor or news report is to 
be decided as untrue and mischievous one. If it is Saturn of Rahu; the rumor or news report 
contains some hiding facts and is a false one. If it is Sun; rumor or news report will never a 
false or lie and being a noble fact. If it is Jupiter or Venus or Moon - who all is benifics, the 
rumor or news report thrown in the market is true. If it is Mercury, it can be half true and 
half doubtful. If Mercury be in one of his own houses or in a dual sign, or in his own star and 
afflicted by malefics, the rumor or news report is to be decided as doubtful one. This is the 
way to find out whether a rumor of news report is believable or not?

III Cusp (Capricorn 26-38-48: Saturn-Mars-Jupiter) Sublord Jupiter is in star of Sun and 
sub of Rahu. 


34 CSL Jupiter in the star of Sun; clearly indicate that extension of lockdown will surely 
happen. And the rumor or news report about that is correct (true).

The general conclusion of KP/ KB/ KCIL/ 4 Step/ EPS system analysis 

Is as follows: 

1. Daw Aung Sun Suu Kyi’s NLD party will win the coming Myanmar general elections in November 
2020 but not landslide win like in 2015 general elections. 

2. There will be many hurdles, setbacks and struggles for her to win the elections. 

3. Her health is to be concerned but not life threatening. 


1. KP Analysis 
Daw Aung Sun Suu Kyi’s current running joint dasa Mercury/ Saturn/ Jupiter is up to 15/Dec/ 
2020 covering the Myanmar general elections due in November 2020. 


Dasa lord Mercury+(6-7-10),+8 for which Mercury is the CSL having no planet in its stars. Mercury is 
in the star of Rahu(7) conj. Sun+(6-9), Mercury+(6-7-10),+8, Saturn+(7-2-3),+2-5-11, and in sub of 
Jupiter+(9-1-4)+3-9. (+ means planet having no planet in its stars) - -> 3 (ability)-6 (win over oppo- 
nent)- 10 (success/ fame)-11 (gain/ desire fulfillment) for political success, along with 4 (10 for oppo- 
nent)- 5 (loss to opponent)- 8 (hurdles/ disappointment) for failure. 


Bhukti lord Saturn+(7-2-3),+2-5-11 is in the star of Rahu(7) conj. Sun+(6-9), Mercury+(6-7-10),+8, 
Saturn+(7-2-3),+2-5-11, and in sub of Moon+ (10-8) - -> 3-6-10-11 for political success , along with 5- 
8 for failure. 


Antra lord Jupiter+(9-1-4)+3-9 is in the star of Venus(4-6-11), and in sub of Ketu(1) in Sagittarius rep- 
resenting Jupiter+(9-1-4)+3-9 - -> 3-6-11 for political success, along with 4 for failure. 


Next Ketu/ Ketu joint dasa will be running from 15/December/2020 to 13/May/2021. 
Dasa and Bhukti lord Ketu(1)is in Sagittarius representing Jupiter+(9-1-4)+3-9. Ketu is in the star of 
Venus(4-6-11), and in sub of Moon+ (10-8) - -> 3-6-10-11 for political success against 4-8 for failure. 


Conclusion 

1. Significtors of houses 3-6-10-11 indicate sure success in the coming i 2020 general elections. The 
2015 general elections were held on 8/Nov/ 2020 during Mer/Rahu/Moon DBA, and that Bhukti lord 
Rahu is stronger than the current Bhukti lord Saturn. That is why scale of success may be less than 
2015 landslide. One good thing is that significator 12 (general loss/ hospitalization) does not show up 
at all. Another interesting thing is appearance significator 9 (political fortune) for possible higher suc- 
cess.

KB Rules for Political Fortune 

(1) To a particular Bhava (questioned Bhava), the bhavas 1,2,3,5,9,11 will give good results. Even in

pute with the husband. After about one month of that meeting another lady beautician came to me for

These three cases brought me an idea to peep in to some more beauticians chart to see similarity that 
of family troubles. Venus is the Planet who makes beauticians and also it is the planet for all secular 
activities of a human such as conjugal bliss, attractions to opposite sex & love affairs, attraction to all

ments, romance and physical pleasure. Additionally Venus should be a significator for 2,6,10 for the 
profession in the field of beauty industry.

for dissolving the unity of family.

pects: Both Vedic and Western considered. 
Summary of above table. 


1)Venus is connected with 5th cusp (Artistic talent/Creative Ability) and 2, 6, 10 for profession in al- 
most all charts. (100%) 
2)It signifies the marriage. 


In addition to the above, when checking these charts individually, I found some more considerable 
connections of Venus such as, 


1)Saturn and Kethu are anyway connected with Venus, with their significations for the houses of mar- 
riage 2,7,11. 
2)Mars, Jupiter, Uranus, Neptune, and Kethu are always connected with Venus. 


Now let's see the general qualities of above planets. 
Mars: Outcome - Almost all charts (100%) 


As said above Venus while controlling the all secular matters of the person, if connected with Mars, 
the sex driver, the native make the road to hell of the family and the native over do the natural pleas- 
ure. Also Mars with sexual energy especially with men, sex force, lust & pleasure are strongly empha- 
sized as natural significators of sexuality. When Mars aspects Venus, there may be strong tendency 
for the sexuality, and stimulating the sexual needs of a person. If Venus and Mars in mutual aspects 
it gives a tendency to excessive sexual activities. If these two planets are in trine or sextile, it will be an 
initiative step into erotic pleasure and conjunction, quadrate & opposition gives great propensity for

sex matters with carelessness in such relations. Ptolemy says “In the case of female... should Venus be 
conjoined or configurated with Mars alone, she will render women licentious and lustful”. 


Ex: Venus-Mars connection in the natal chart had played its role in the cases of Bill Clinton and Tiger 
Wood, who were unable to resist their strong sex drive. 


Uranus & Neptune: Outcome - In most charts Uranus is in the star or sub of Venus and it is anyway 
connected with Venus in the rest charts. Neptune connected with Venus and Mars almost all charts. 
(100%) 


When there is any connection between Venus and Uranus, the native get excitation in sex like pouring 
highly inflammable gasoline into the fire, because Uranus is a planet of diversity, individuality and 
overcome any boundaries and prohibitions. Vivian Robson in his "An Astrology Guide to Your Sex 
Life" says that Uranus and Neptune are the main cause of intensifications of sexual desire. ----- Nep- 
tune afflicting Venus is indicative of what Robson calls "illicit and unnatural appetites... lascivious 
habits." According to Noe Tyl, Mars-Neptune contacts promise charisma and allure. 


Ex: Venus is conjoined with Mars-Neptune in the natal chart of Bill Clinton indicated his scandalous love 
affair. 
Jupiter: Outcome - Anyway connected with Venus almost all charts. (100%) 


According to Barbara Watters, Jupiter dominated charts (in particular those with Mars opposition Ju- 
piter) show people who take action against the accepted moral code or traditional beliefs. In other 
words, Jupiter, being a planet of expansion, enhances the general qualities inherited by Venus. 


Kethu: Outcome - Almost all charts (100%) 


Rahu and Kethu, when connected with Venus, take a prominent part for individual attractions, sensu- 
al behavior and addictions. Here the affinity of addiction goes with several ways in the life like drugs, 
gambling, sexual activities etc. So Kethu when connected with Venus, the native tends to seek more 
and more sexual happiness. 


Saturn: Outcome - Almost all charts (100%) 


Generally Saturn is known as most dreadful and malefic planet in the zodiac. It is not true always but 
Saturn acts for the native's rising up and falling down. As per Ptolemy's view, promiscuous behavior is 
also associated with Venus/Saturn aspects. But in this study I have found that Saturn/Venus con- 
nection through Kethu indicates sexual excess. Furthermore it is a planet of obstruction especially in 
the marriage. 


Conclusion: 


If Venus is a significator for 5, 2,6 & 10 one can be a beautician. At the same time if Venus is any way 
connected with Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Naptune and Kethu, together with houses of Marriage 
(2 or 7 or 11)the native have to face a troublesome marriage life. Connection of Saturn and Kethu is 
worst.

Question: KP Ayanamsa and Pushya-Paksha Ayanamsa 

KP astrology recommends using KP ayanamsha for accurate results. 

However, Pushya Paksha Ayanamsha is being advocated by renowned Shri Narasimha Rao 
as per his Jaimini astrology software. Using this value, what would be the impact in KP as- 
trology? Thanks for your valued opinion and guideline. 


Answer 
In his article "Introducing Pushya-Paksha Ayanamsa" Narasimha Rao has defined ”Pushya 
Paksha Ayanamsa” as follows: 


1) Take the tropical longitude of Delta Cancri star at the desired date/time. 


(1) 

( 2 ) Subtract 106 deg (16CnO0) from it. 
(3) The result is the ayanamsa of the date/time. 
Modern ephemeris (e.g. Swiss ephemeris) can calculate the longitudes of fixed stars. 


This is not a linear formula and can be calculated by computer program only using Swiss 
ephemeris. 

But as shown in the following table, Pushya Paksha Ayanamsa values are in the pattern of 
linear Raman Ayanamsa for the period 1700 to 2100 with constant higher value of about 18 
-35 M-S. 

Since Pushya Paksha Ayanamsa values are less than the KP new Ayanamsa around 
about 1-2-40 D-M-S as shown in the following table this PP Ayanamsa is not recom- 
mendable to use in KP analysis. 

As of 1st January of year: 


Paksha minus KP minus 
(PP) Raman PP

man is perhaps the most successful among the famous astrologers of the last century or two 
by using the simple linear ayanamsa; we know that all linear formulas are wrong, for the 
precession of equinoxes is not linear. So it seems he has introduced non- linear Pushya- 
Paksha Ayanamsa which has close values to Raman Ayanamsa.

Book review-Medical Astrology In Action 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 











Medical Astrology In Action - by Judith Hill 
Stellium Press, May 8, 2019, 400 pages 





Medical Astrology in Action, by internationally recognized author Judith Hill, is the only book 
in print exclusively devoted to the distinctly physical and medical impacts of the transiting 
Sun, Moon, planets and Lunar Nodes upon the natal chart. This is a practical repertory, 
useful for both natal and transit charts. Hill's liberal inclusion of Field Notes, Herbal Tips, 
and Surgical Notes makes for delectable reading. All major aspects are discussed, with an 
emphasis on conjunctions. Illuminating entry chapters explain and demonstrate "aspect 
mechanics" and other fine details of chart interpretation. 


In this book, Judith goes beyond previously published works to bring forth new insights on 
how the planets and the natal chart play out in the human frame. Hill displays an 
understanding of medical astrology and its application that obviously comes from decades of 
study, direct experience, and awareness of the human body and its workings. The 
information on each planet's transits and the havoc they can play with one's health has 
been written clearly or thoroughly. This new book is an invaluable companion to Hill's 
Medical Astrology: A Guide to Planetary Pathology.

Natal Chart and Horary Chart 

The natal or birth chart reflects the effects of past karma. The concerned cuspal sub lord 
(CSL) of the birth chart should be checked whether the matter under study is promised or 
not. The promise does not guarantee for the matter to be materialized, and it would happen 
during the joint dasa of fruitful significators when dasa agrees with transit. 


One time use horary chart for a particular query is not a substitute for birth chart which is 
for the whole life of native. Horary chart cannot give a matter which is not promised in the 
natal chart. 


Natal Chart Analysis 
Natal chart should be checked first before horary chart. The 10ts CSL of the native is to be 
studied for the promise of political fortune. 


Political Fortune 

10 (political fortune) CSL Mecury is in house 8, lord of houses 3,6, in the star of Ketu in 
house 3, aspected by Jupiter in 7. Lord of 9,12, Saturn in house 1, lord of 10,11, and Ketu is 
in Cancer representing Moon in house 4, lord of 4.The CSL Mercury is in the sub of Venus 
in house 8, lord of houses 2,7. 

10 CSL’s signification of favorable houses 6,10,11 indicates possible political fortune. But it 
is not supported by any of houses 6,10,11 at the sub level, and so political fortune is not 
strong enough for native. 


Dasa Analysis 

On the election day of 8t+ November 2020, the joint dasa of Rahu/Jupiter/Saturn/Venus will 
be running. 

Dasa lord Rahu+(9) is the CSL of 1,5,6,12 having no planet in its star; Rahu is in the sign of 
Capricorn representing Saturn (1,10-11). Rahu is in the star of Moon (4,4) , and in sub of 
Jupiter (7,9-12). Rahu’s signification of 6,10,11 is god for political fortune but 4,5,12 is for 
failure. In the sub level only 12‘ signification for loss is effective. 


Bhukti lord Jupiter (7,9-12) is in the star of Mercury (8,3-6), and sub of Mars+ (11,1-8), +11. 
The 3,6,11 significators are for success, along with 8,12 significators for loss. In the sub lev- 
el 8,11 significators are for both ways of loss and success. 


Antra lord Saturn (1,10-11) is in the star of Sun (7,5) , and sub of Venus (8,2-7). The 10, 11 
significators are at the planet level but 5,8 significators of loss are at the star and sub level. 


Sookshma lord Venus (8,2-7) is in the star of own Venus (8,2-7), and sub of Rahu 
(9,1,5,6,12,10,11). The 6,10,11 significators are good for success, along with 5,8,12 
significators for loss. 

Although there is a chance for success but it is not for sure. 


Transit Analysis

simple becouse the first age or date or running calender year starts from aswini 1, for example aswini

The whole World is still juddering by the pandemic disease of Corona (Covid 19) and the 
death toll is increasing day by day. Everybody is witnessing terrifying and life threatening 
posture on this deadly pandemic. Generally this type of situations, effecting to the whole 
world are to be examined in accordance with mundane rules such as Lunar eclipse and 
many consequential effects therein. As well, there should be astrological rules for 
investigation on the individual chart, which lost the life by this pandemic. 

Although there were thousands of such death cases in the world, it is difficult to do a 
study, since birth details of such death cases are not to be found. While in searching of 
such a case to be studied, I could find an AA rated chart of a Corona deceased native from 
Astro Data Bank, now known as www.astro.com.

Astrological causes for Diseases 

In this regards I would like to emphasize some explanations in connection with health 
matters of a native. 

(a) If the sixth sub lord is connected to houses 1 and 6 OR Lagna Sub lord is connected 
house 6 and 1, sure and certain native will have sickness or develop some disease. (Astro 
Secret I, Pg 153) 

The Lagna sub lord of this chart is Venus, the lord of 3 & 8 and stationed in 9. It is in the 
star of Mercury and in the sub of Saturn. Venus is opposite to the Moon, the lord of 6 and 
Venus aspects Lagna, and hence the rule is satisfied. 

(b) "If the sub lord of the ascendant be in the star of the occupant of the house 1 or 11 
health is normal" ("Horoscope and diseases" by Sri C.R.Bhatt, Pg 81) 

In this chart Lagna sub lord Venus is in the star of Mercury in 10. Lagna is occupied by 
Rahu. Hence the health is abnormal. 

(c) "If the sub lord of the ascendant be the significator of the house 6 (sickness) or 8 
(danger to life) or 12 (hospitalization), it is not good for health.(Ibid Pg 81) 

Lagna sub lord is a significator for all the above ie; 6, 8, 12 and the sickness is confirmed. 

(d) If the sub lord of the 6th cusp be the significator of 6 or 8 or 12 and connected with 1, 
the native may suffer from disease or otherwise, during the sub period of this cuspal sub lord 
of 6. (Ibid Pg. 81) 

The 6th cuspal sub lord Rahu is in 1, a sign owned by Jupiter+ and aspected by Venus by its 
5th aspect (house to house). The Sun is in the sub of Jupiter+ and hence Sun is responsible 
for the effects of Jupiter+. Sun is in the start of Moon the lord of 6. The aspecting planet 
Venus is the lord of 8 and thus rule is fulfilled. 

(e) If the sub lord of the 6th cusp be connected with Saturn disease become chronic; If 
with Mars disease is acute; If with Mercury disease get complicated. If with Rahu or Kethu 
disease remains undiagnosed. Rahu is similar to Saturn and Kethu is similar to Mars. (Ibid 
Pg. 81) 


Sub Lord of 6th (disease) house 

Rahu_ the sub lord of 6th, which represent Jupiter(R) and Venus. As mentioned above Venus 
is connected with Mars, Mercury and Saturn which are the co-rulers of Venus. Mars is the 
lord of 2 (Maraka) in the star of Saturn the lord of 12 (Moksha/Hospitalization, in 10, 
(Treatment not effective/Retirement from this world), and is a significator for 3 (away from 
Home) & 8 (Chronic illness). Here Mercury is Maraka and Badhka planet. Next to that Rahu 
gives what Jupiter is to give, because Rahu is in the sign of Jupiter and also it is the star 
lord of Jupiter. It is the lord of 1, 10 & 11 and stationed in the 4th cusp. Jupiter is in the 
sub of Mars, the lord 9 & 2 (Maraka) in 5th cusp in Cancer, which is its debilitation sign and 
on the other hand Mars is in the sub of Rahu. Although Jupiter looks to be a benevolent 
planet with its signification for 1, 5, 11, it has to give what Rahu denotes. Hence the health 
condition of this native is worst with infliction of death. 


Astrological reasons for Pneumonia the primary indication of Corona. 

(a) A Saturn disease, Saturn afflicted in Sagittarius. A Jupiter disease and due to surfeits 
caused by Jupiter. Congested blood vessels, corrupt and impure blood results from the 
affliction of Jupiter. The 3rd house and Mercury are often involved with the affliction which 
causes Pneumonia. The main symptom of Pneumonia is inflammation of the lungs. 
(Encyclopedia of Medical Astrology by Dr. H.L.Cornell (MD, DA) 

(b) The ruling sign of Pneumonia is Gemini and the planets are Mercury, Saturn and Jupiter. 
(The Rulrtship Book by Rex e. Bills) 


Applications of above factors 

The ruler of Lungs Jupiter (retrograded), the planet of inflammation is placed in Gemini, the 
ruling sign of Lungs and also afflicted by Star Lord Rahu (10-1-4,5,7), that is a significator of 
lungs diseases and Sub Lord Mars (10-5-12-2,9) and opposite to 12.

Cause of Death 

As stated above this native died by the Covid-19 (Corona) disease followed by Pneumonia. So 
the approximate cause for this death is Covid (Corona-19). What does COVD-19 stands for? 
'CO' stands for corona, 'VI' for virus, and 'D' for disease. Formerly, this disease was referred 
to as '2019 novel coronavirus’ or '2019-nCoV.' The COVID-19 virus is a new virus linked to 
the same family of viruses as Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) and some types of 
common cold. 


What are the symptoms of this disease? 

The virus can cause a range of symptoms, ranging from mild illness to pneumonia. Symp- 
toms of the disease are fever, cough, sore throat and headaches. In severe cases difficulty in 
breathing and deaths can occur. In addition aches and pains, sore throat, diarrhea, conjunc- 
tivitis, headache, loss of taste or smell, a rash on skin, or discoloration of fingers or toes ap- 
pear. The new coronavirus is a respiratory virus which spreads primarily through droplets 
generated when an infected person coughs or sneezes, or through droplets of saliva or dis- 
charge from the nose. 

Now let's go through the Astrological dimensions of above symptoms. As we know Corona is 
a Pandemic, in other words wide spread Epidemic lead by a Virus. All people who were at- 
tacked by Corona 19 Virus, were not victims to death. 

Virus: This is a Pathogenic Microbe. According to Rex E. Bills, in his "The Rulership Book", 
Virus is under the rule of Pluto. 

According to the general rules of Astrology Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto have a long revolu- 
tion so it affects only the global events and doesn't have significance in an individual’s chart. 
In Vedic 12th lord is known as the ruler of "hidden enemy", which can be interpreted as Vi- 
rus. 

Some Pundits say any Virus is born from conjunction of Rahu or Kethu. 

However a unanimous opinion of Virus ruler and Pluto, is not to be seen in any astrological 
literature according to my little knowledge. 

Since there are different opinions with regards to the Virus and Pluto, we have to study the 
real facts of Pluto to determine whether it is the sole ruler of Virus. As we know Pluto is de- 
moted in 2006 and now considered as a 'dwarf planet’. But astrologers still reckon it to be a 
powerful force on a collective and individual level. 

A quote from Encyclopedia of Medical Astrology (H.L.Cornell, MD, DA) in connection with 
Pluto is as below. 

"At present Pluto is considered by many authorities to be a hypothetical planet. It is also doubt- 
ed by some writers as being a part of our Solar System and is said to be outsisde of the Earth's 
Zodiac in the greater part of its orbit. 

Mr. E.H.Beily editor of the British Journal of Astrology writes in the October 1931 issue of his 
journal, and says - "I have no belief whatever in the alleged influence of this planet. It is a very 
great question whether it is a member of our solar System. 

In 1932 November issue of the British Journal, Mr. Beily further says- ” .... A number of Horo- 
scopes have been sent to me from readers, in which they allege that certain events have been 
shown by this planet, but in all the cases sent, I have been able to detect the real cause with- 
out incorporating Pluto or any other hypothetical planets.”

convertible planet Mercury, it is a difficult sign to fully understand, being half disposed

would highly observant and generally thoughtful, and is always fond of the arts. She would 
be generally restless, often goes to extremes, for she is generally suspicious, rarely trusting 
others.

II) Primary education— 

KP Rules on Primary education— 

1) If the 4t cusp sub lord is connected with 4 and 11 only but not with 9th, it indicates 
successful completion of general education. 

2) If the 4 cusp sub lord is the significator of 8-12, the native takes a break from education 
during the conjoined period of the significations of 8-12 houses. 

3) If the sub lord of the 4t cusp signifies 3-8-12, the native completes her primary 
education/or suffer in education during the conjoined period of the significations of 3-8-12 
houses. 

4) If the 4th cusp sub lord signifies 4-9-11, the native succeeds in examinations during the 
conjoined period of the significations of 4-9-11 houses.

sign).

2nd house and also Jupiter lord of 7 and 10 placed in 6 house.

to 6,2,11,8,9,and 7.

due to family conditions.

Who Will Settle in Foreign? 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 








A native has already tried to settle abroad for the past ten years but not yet suc- 
ceeded, and asks me whether there is a promise in his birth chart for foreign settle- 
ment. 


Foreign Settlement Rule 

1. If the 12 cuspal sub lord (CSL) is the significator of house 3,9 or 12, one is 
promised to go abroad during the joint dasa of significators of house 3,9 or 12; 

2. In addition if the 1st (one self) CSL is also the significator of house 3,9 or 12, one 
is promised for foreign settlement; and 

3. Again if the significators of house 3,9 or 12 are related to each other, it is more 
sure for foreign settlement. 

(N. Pandu: Who Will Settle in Foreign? In K.P. & Astrology Year Book 2002, pp 39- 
41) 


Study of 100 Charts 
In my study of 100 foreign settlement charts, first rule is found fulfilled for 99 
charts, and first and second rules are found simultaneously fulfilled for 72 charts. 


Chart Under Study 

12th CSL Mercury is in 10, lord of 2,5, in the star of Jupiter in 9, lord of 8,11, and 
in sub of Mars+ in 11, lord 7,12. No planet is in the stars of Mars, and Mars is the 
CSL of 4 house. Thus Mercury is the significator of foreign going houses 9,12, and 
the first rule is satisfied, i.e. foreign going is promised. 

The 1st CSL Saturn is the significator of 9, in the star and sub of own Saturn, and 
so the second rule is satisfied. 


The 9th lord Saturn aspects Jupiter in 9, and so 9th significators are related to each 
other. Thus the third rule is satisfied. 


Therefore foreign settlement is promised for the native under study, and further 
study is needed for the timing of foreign settlement.

Question 1: Guruji KSK Getting Job Not Married 

Sir, Guruji KSK on 14/07/1927 got a job. But on that DBAS lords Rah, Guru, Sat, Sat sig- 
nify 7, 1 houses only. But he got a job instead of marriage. Both job and marriage are 
equally indicated on that day. Transit and DBAS support both the events. Will you pl clarify 
why the event job occurred instead of marriage. 


Answer 1: 

Dasa Analysis 

As per the attached Guruji KSK’s chart: 

Dasa lord Rahu (5) is in the sign of Gemini representing Mercury+ (9,6-9), Mercury is also a 
strong significator of 2-3-6-9-11, sublord-ship having no planet in its stars. Rahu is in the 
star of Mars (9,4-11, and sub of Mo(1.7). 

Bhukti lord Jupiter (8,3-12) is in the star of Venus (8,5-10), and sub of Moon (1,7). 

Antra lord Saturn (2,1-2) is in the star of own Saturn (2,1-2), and sub of Mo (1,7). 


Getting job (2-6-10) seems better justified than marriage (2,7,11) as not only 1-6-10 but 
akso 8-10 are negative to marriage. 


Transit Analysis 
Transit on 14/07/1927 as per attached chart: 


Dasa lord Rahu in star Mars (9-11), and sub Venus (8-5-10) 
Bhukti lord Jupiter Saturn (2-1), and sub Sun (9-8) 

Antra lord Saturn in star Saturn (2-1), and sub Venus (8-5- 10) 
Luminary Sun in star Jupiter (8-12), and sub Venus (8-5- 10) 
Luminary Moon in star Venus (8-5-10), and sub Jupiter (8-12)

Answer 3:

“WILL our beloved P.M Sri Narendra Modi Ji seek renunciation and turn towards the path of 
spirituality?” 

An in-depth analysis of his natal chart through our KP system of astrology. 

I prostrate before the Lotus feet of my beloved GURUUI, before venturing to write an article 
on this august personality of 21st century, on his wonderful and sacred astrological chart of 
our beloved leader of our country Sri Narendra Modi ji. 

The ultimate goal of every human being is to realize the “Real-self” or to merge his soul with 
the universal soul. Realizing the “Real-self”’ means to get free from the shackles of worldly 
bondages. Given this, every endeavour of ours to acquire the true -knowledge should be 
directed towards achieving this sacred aim of our life. And astrology as a branch of Vedas is 
no exception to this. 

I this context I recollect the famous words of Dr Kenneth Negus (quote)” Astrology at its best 
does not concern itself merely with the material and energy that are the primary concern of the 
sciences. Only a higher philosophical approach can properly deal with the supreme formative 
forces that make our world and its environs into cosmos- that is one of the highest astrological 
truths and a nonscientific one.” He also stresses a vital point saying that we need to recognize 
a hierarchy of knowledge within astrology itself. (From Astrology now-vol-O1, no.11, page 18) 











Renunciation is not merely giving up things. It is the taking up of things that are more 
important in life. It is a process of growth. 

To turn spiritual, we need to move beyond self-imposed boundaries that we have placed 
before ourselves. Meaningful relationships, engaging our minds in something constructive 
and committing ourselves to self-improvement. 

Another aspect of renunciation that is often spoken of is the renunciation of the fruit of 
action. In the first verse of Chapter 6 of the Bhagavad-Gita, Lord Krishna says ‘One who 
does what one ought to do independent of the fruit of action is a sannyasi (relinquished) and 
a yogi (ascetic)’. Lord Krishna urges us to give up desires but not the objects of desire. What 
comes between us and the Divinity that lies within each one of us is the enormous number 
of desires that we have accumulated throughout our lives. These desires cannot be wished 
away. Spiritual growth can occur only when one attaches oneself to a higher desire and as a 
result, renounces the lower desires. Thus renunciation in its true sense does not take away 
from our lives but enriches our lives. It helps us live as we should. 

With this small introduction, I would like to dwell on the astrological chart of our beloved Sri 
Narendra Modi Ji from the angle of prospects of spiritual progress in his life.
