Background Note: I am jobless since last one year and this is the major issue. I have 
consulted few astrologer and most provided remedies; but still no result. 


Major Question taken into consideration: Getting a job -when? 


Name & Sex of the Querent : Mr. XYZ, Male 

Horary / Divine / Seed No. : 78 (out of 249) 

Date of judgment : 30 April 2020 

Time of judgment : 08:15:04 PM (IST) 

Place of judgment : Hind Motor (22N41/88E20), Hooghly, W.B., India. 


Hints: Getting or Joining a Job/Service 

If the Cuspal Sublord (CSL) of 6 or 10 be the significator of 2 (Money), 6 (Job or Service), 
10 (Position, Business & Profession) or 11 (Success, fulfillment of desire) and/or in 
connection with 2, 6, 10, or 11; job/service or earning is promised during the joint period of 
the significators of 2, 6, 10 or 11. 


MOON REVEALS THE NATURE OF QUERY 

Moon (Cancer 13-34-34) is in star of Saturn (Pushya-4) and sub of Rahu. Planet Moon, 
being untenanted (no planet in stars of Moon), is the occupant of 12, owner of 1, Starlord 
Saturn is the occupant of 6, owner of 7-8. Sublord Rahuis the occupant of 11. Rahu acts an 
agent of Mercury, being untenanted (no planet in stars of Mercury) in 9, lord of 3-12, CSL of 
9. Moon signifies and/or in connection with the relevant houses (2, 6, 10, 11); hence query is 
genuine. 


Note: In horary chart, Moon is aspected by Saturn (karaka of delay) as well as in star of 
Saturn (Pushya-4); indicating a delay towards fructification of the event (getting job). 


CUSPAL ANALYSIS 

VI Cusp: Sagittarius 22-18-30 (Jupiter-Venus-Saturn): The 6 CSL Saturn is in star of 
Sun (UttaraAshadha-4) and sub of Venus. Planet Saturn is the occupant of 6, owner of 7-8. 
Starlord Sun is the occupant of 9, close to 10t*cusp, owner of 2. Sun conjoined with 
Mercury, being untenanted (no planet in stars of Mercury) in 9, lord of 3-12, CSL of 9. 
Sublord Venus is the occupant of 11, owner of 4-11. Here 6t8 CSL signifies and/or in 
connection with 2-6-10 & Saturn (Karaka of employment) along with 8 (hindrances, 
difficulties, obstacles, misfortune); indicating that getting a job is assured with delay & 
difficulties. 


10th CSL Rahu (being in star of Mars and sub of Moon) signifies and/or in connection with 
10, 11; also confirms that getting a job is assured.

Hints: 
Rule: 1 


Health (15*) 
If the sub lord of the Asc. be in the star of the occupant of the house 1 or 11, health is 
normal. 


If the sub lord of the Asc. be the significator (i.e. in the star of the occupant or owner) of the 
house 6 (sickness) or 8 (danger to life) or 12 (hospitalization),, it is not good for health. 


The native may suffer from sickness or disease, during the joint period of the significators of 
1 and 6, or 1 and 8, or 1 and 12. 
Rule: 2 


Disease (6t*) 
If the sub lord of the 6th cusp be the significator of 6 or 8 or 12 and connected with 1, the 
native may suffer from disease during the sub period of this cuspal sublord of 6. 


If the sub lord of the 6th cusp be connected with Saturn, disease becomes chronic; if with 
Mars disease is acute, sudden and painful, and causes operations; if with Mercury disease 
gets complicated; and if with Rahu or Ketu disease remains undiagnosed. Rahu is similar to 
Saturn and Ketu is similar to Mars in effects. 


if the sub lord of the 8th or 12th cusp be the significator of 6 or 8 or 12 then native suffers 
from the disease and permanent defect. Which related to Sign and House of 6t8 cusp sub lord 
and its starlord. 


Similarly, if the sub lord of the 8th or 12th cusp be the significator of 6 or 8 or 12 then native 
suffers from serious illness or chro-nic disease or the disease which might bring some 
permanent defect related to Sign and House of 6t cusp sub lord and its starlord. 


During the joint period of the significators of 1, 5 or 11 disease is cured

Cure (1-5-11)

otherwise. 

During the joint period of the significators of 1-5-11. Disease is cured or the native is saved 
from any danger or otherwise. 

Astrologer need to select from sublord of Asc. 6th or 8th or 12th as per his experience, it is 
advisable that first examine all the cusp sub lord and then come to any conclusion.

By: Gunti Nagaraju 
KP astrologer (M.com CAIIB, Retired Bank officer)

Addiction in any manner is the most dreadful menace that is eating away the very roots of 
mankind on this earth. To say it in a simple terms addiction can belong to the state of being 
where the consumption or gulping of a substance in a person’s life becomes a pushing force. 
Libation has been spreading very fastly like a Libaranthine seed and is becoming highly 
difficult to stop its fulmination. Today, it is legal for anybody to purchase and consume any 
amount of liquor they wish for. The on growing ‘pub-culture’ is another adding fuel factor for 
its spreading. Also, you wouldn’t be surprised if people smoke, weed, hash, and meth on 
road today. Similar to any, alcohol addiction is also slow and very long. 

It consumes whosoever consumes it. The life of an addict is disturbed both physically and 
mentally. With time, the habit starts eating on their original behaviour. Often, alcohol 
addicts think they will quit drinking. However, by then the dreadful impact of their 
alcoholism has ruined their possibility of going back to CLEAN. 

Not only on their body and mind but they draw a terrible impact of their addiction on 
their Horoscope. According to Astrology, there are a few selective planets that are 
responsible for alcohol abuse. 

With this short introduction on the subject, I would like to deal with our topic astrologically 
to help the readers whoever maybe to get themselves informed how one can get benefited by 
knowing what is stored in future with this astrological information provided bellow. 

I would be analyzing the bellow given fifteen astrological charts of celebrities with the help of 
our KP rules. The data of the bellow given charts of celebrities is collected from the 
astrological web site called ”Astro-data bank” with AA ratings. 

Planetary Position with alcohol addiction in conventional astrology— 

--- Rahu, Saturn, and Mars are the real perpetrator of alcohol addiction and drug abuse in a 
native’s life. Also, due to the malefic effect of these planets, a person may suffer from a 
continuous will to join a rehabilitation centre and not being able to overcome the obsession 
for the drug. Also, negative connections with the lst house, 2nd house, Sth house, 6th 
house, and the 11th house of any of these three pushes the person into alcoholism. 

In an astrological chart, when Mercury has the malefic position and is giving a malefic effect, 
it also generates the craving for Alcohol because it influences the thinking pattern and the 
mind as a whole, which makes the native develop a craving for intoxication. Scorpio sign 
stands for intoxicants. The same goes for Venus or Saturn, too. 

If Scorpio is placed in the 8th house or the 3rd house and Venus or Saturn occupies an 
afflicted place, the native will become addicted to poisonous substances. 

Before describing the signs of alcoholism in a birth chart, it is necessary to determine 
whether there is a general formula of disease in the examined horoscope. As per the 
conventional astrology, the general formula of the disease consists of negative interactions 
between 6th, 8th and 12th “vicious” houses of the horoscope. 

When we look at this subject of addiction, from our KP system of astrology as propounded by 
Sri K.S Krishnamurthy’s angle, we find a little deviation from the above houses and the rule 
says---

drug/chewing addiction.

Questions & Answers 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 





Question: True Node in KP 
I noticed Guru ji KSK’s suggestion to use the True Node in one of KP Readers. Could you 
help me to find the reference. 


Answer: 
It is not found no where in the KP Readers. It is impossible to manually calculate the True 
Node at that time and the Mean Node is used in the KP Readers.. 


Prior to the mid-1970s astrologers only had access to the 'Mean Nodes” which is the average 
position of their wobbling or motions. The calculation of the Mean Nodes is easy by taking 
the average of motions and the True ones is complicated. However, with the advent of com- 
puters and the accuracy of ephemerides and diurnal tables increasing by leaps and bounds, 
astronomers began to plot its course of wobbling or motions and call this position the True 
Node. The American Ephemeris programmed by Neil Michelsen and published by Astro 
Computing Services (ACS) has listed both True and Mean Nodes ever since then. Most 
software programs now have the option of Mean or True Nodes whichever one is preferred. 


The main reason of using the True Nodes is that they are the actual measurement of the 
exact positions of Nodes. However this is somewhat illusory, since the “True” Nodes are true 
“only twice” a month when the Moon crosses the ecliptic. Other positions provided for the 
times in between those two points are just a hypothesis. That is why Robert Hand point out 
in “Horoscope Symbols” that the wobbling Nodes are no more "True" than the Mean Nodes, 
as they are in their own way just as abstract a concept. They should not be used until 
research has indicated which, if either, of the two sets of the Nodes is more valid. Vedic 
astrology uses Mean Nodes since ancient times, thus a vast experience and feed back are 
available on Mean Nodes 

Sanjay Rath says that he still cannot understand why some people use true nodes ignoring 
Parasara and Jaimini's teaching of constant Rahu retrogression which is also confirmed in 
Prasna Marga Rahu-Sun-Moon chakra and Jataka Parijatha.

Donald Trump vs Joe Biden: Who will win? 






By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 








The DBAS lords’ signification for Donald Trump and Joe Biden on the presidential election 
day of November 3" 2020 is shown in the table 1. 

The signification of the star and sub in which the DBAS lords and luminaries are going 
transiting on the election day is shown in the table 2. 


The winning significators are 3" (ability), 6 (win over opponent), 9t (good luck), 10% 
(Success) and 11t (gain, desire fulfillment). The losing houses are 4th (10% for opponent 7+), 
5th (defeat by opponent), 8t (troubles) and 12t® (loss). 


For each dasa lord who is better is considered based on winning and losing significators and 
also the positive or negative nature of the sub. 

Trump’s running dasa lord Jupiter indicates winning significators 6,9,10,11, along with 
losing significators 4,5,12 with mixed (positive 6,9,10,11 and negative 5,12) sub indication. 
Biden’s running dasa lord Jupiter indicates winning significators 9,10, along with losing 
significators 5,8,12 with mixed (positive 9,10 and negative 12) sub indication. So Trump has 
better chance to win at the Dasa level. By the same way of consideration Biden is supposed 
to have better chance at the Bhukti, Antra and Sookshma dasa levels. 


Regarding the transit of the DBAS lords and luminaries, Trump is supposed to have better 
chance at the Bhukti, Sookshma and Sun levels, and Biden at the Dasa and Antra levels. 


Although it is closed to call who will be the winner, in my opinion Joe Biden would come out 


as the winner in the coming US presidential election thanks to good luck indicated by 9t 
significators at almost all his dasa levels and transits.

Transit on the presidential election day (8 Nov 2020) is supposed to be a little more 
promising for Biden than Trump as shown below:

good, Conjunction of Sun with Lagna is not good but Mercury’s conjunction with Lagna is 
good. 

For opponent Biden, Jupiter’s aspect on 7H is good. Venus’ aspect on 7L Mars is also good. 
Saturn’s aspect on 7L Mars is not good. 


For Trump Saturn’s aspect on 10H is not good. 10L Moon’s conjunction 
with Rahu is not good. 
For Biden Saturn in 4H is not good. 4L Saturn in 4H is good. 


Some transit points on the election day (3 Nov 2020) 

In Trump’s horoscope: 

1) Transit Saturn is in 6H, own sign Capricorn, aspecting Trump’s natal Saturn, 10L Venus 
and Uranus in 12H (loss). This is not a good sign for Trump; 

2) Rahu/Ketu is back at Trump’s 4/10 natal axis — natal Sun (LL) and Uranus are in 10H 
conjunct Rahu and transit Moon (12L) is also conjunct Rahu; natal Moon is in his 4H and 
conjunct Ketu. The double effect of nodes on natal and transit Moon (mind) could prompt 
him to make some inappropriate statements and actions alienating public support. 
Trump's bad time begins after Rahu/Ketu return on September 24th 2020; 

3) 4L (seat) Mars is retrograde in 8H (chronic diseases and problems, scandal and 
humiliation) aspecting 8L natal Jupiter; Mars is also his 9L of dignity taking a shake; 

4) Jup (5/8L) is transiting on his 5H aspecting Lagna and 8th lord Mars; 

5) 1OL Venus is in weak sign of Scorpio over his natal 8L Jupiter) aspecting 8H; 

6) LL Sun is sitting in 3H (courage and efforts) but in weak sign of Libra; 

7) Opponent Biden is 7H, Aquarius; Saturn (7L) is strong in own sign, in 6H of fight, giving 
him a tough fight.

What do the K.P rules say in this regard? 

1. If the sub lord of the 4th cusp is the significator of 4, 9 and 11, then success in examina- 
tions is promised. 

2. Sub lord of the 11th cusp, when connected with the houses under consideration — 4th 

and 9th houses - the results will be positive. 

3. Mars, Mercury and Jupiter promise success when they are connected with 4, 9 and 11 
houses. 

4. For failure in examinations —connections of 4th / 11th with negative houses 3rd and 8th 
are to be considered.

education- posited in 8th.

Mercury lord of 5 and 6 placed in 7th.

at its 

sub lord level. This assures success. But, since the star lord of the sub lord- Venus is also 
connected with the 3,8 & 12th, it indicates failure too. 

Since VENUS is connected with Mercury through Rahu sub, it indicates duality. Therefore, 
the loss of papers may be restricted to two in number.

K.P.Rule: Houses 2,7,11 deals with the matters of marriage. If the 7 CSL signifies 2 or 7 or 
11 marriage is promised. If it signifies 1,6,10,12 separation is indicated. 5th indicates love 
affair. 4th denotes failure of love. 

A client has asked me to find out the period in which marriage has taken place. He has 
borne on 4th May, 1985 in Sirsilla (long: 78-48-30 E and Lat: 18-23-22N) at 7-30-3 pm in the 
star of Rahu (Swathi) with Ascendant Scorpio. 

First of all, we have to find out whether the native has got the promise of marriage or 
not. The 7th cuspal sub lord is Saturn. Saturn is in 12 (Near to 1) lord of 3, 4 in the star of 
Jupiter in 3 lord of 2, 5 and in the sub of Rahu in 6. Rahu represents Mars in 7. As Saturn 
signifies 2, 7 marriage is promised. Saturn signifies 6, 12 also which indicates less compati- 
bility in married life. 

At the time of birth the client was running Rahu dasa balance of 4 years O months 15 
days. He got marriageable age during the period of Saturn. The significators of marriage are 
as follows: 


Cusp A B C D 
2 — — Sat, Kethu Jup 
7 — Mars Sun, Rahu Ven 
11 — — Mer Mer 


The native attains marriageable age during the period of Saturn. So Dasa lord Saturn is as- 
pected by Mars from 7th house. Saturn in 12 lord of 3, 4in the star of Jupiter in 3 lord of 
2, 5 and in the sub of Rahu in 6. Rahu is the agent of Mars deposited in 7. As Saturn sig- 
nifies 2, 7 it is favourable for conducting marriage. 


Venus in the star of dasa lord Saturn is selected as bhukti lord. Venus is in 5, lord of 7 and 
12 in the star of dasa lord Saturn and in the sub of Rahu represents Mars in 7. Venus is 
conjunct with 114 lord mercury. As venus signifies 7,11 it is favourable for conducting 
matriage. 

Sun is signifies 7 besides 6 , 10 and 12 houses and it is rejected as anthara Lord. 


7th significator sun conjunct with Rahu aspects moon. Moon is in 12 lord of 9 in the star of 
rahu and in the sub of venus lord of 7. Venus conjunct with mercury, 11 lord. As moon 
signifies 7,11 it is favourable for conducting marriage. 


As Saturn is a lord of 3 and the moon lord of 9 the settlement of marriage would have taken 
place during the joint period of Saturn-venus-moon. As Dasalord Saturn is aspecting jupiter 
it is selected as sookshma lord. The marriage would have been held in the conjoint period of 
Saturn-venus-moon-jup if transit agrees. 


The conjoint period of sat-ven-mon-jup runs from 14-12-2012 to 27-12-2012. So the mar- 
riage event might have taken place during this period. It is learnt that marriage celebrated 
actually on 26-12-2012. 


TRANSIT: Dasa Lord Saturn is transiting in the star of rahu (swathi) 76 significator, bhukthi 
lord venus is transiting in the star of dasa lord Saturn (Anuradha); anthara lord moon is 
transiting in the star of mars (Mrigasira) 7‘ significator; the luminary sun is transiting in 
the star of kethu (Moola) 7‘ significator. Thus the transit agrees.

Progeny - Vedic Astrology Vs KP Astrology 


By: Sumanadasa Namarathna (Sunaparantha Kalyan) 
Ex-Accountant, Justice of Peace 
No.22/1, Udugampola Road, Marapola, Veyangoda, 
SRI LANKA Email: sumanal946@gmail.com

In my country 50% of marriages are done by proposals and the rest is love marriages. For 
proposed marriages most of parents are looking for a best matching (Porutham) of the couple 
and their important question is about the fortune of having children. Since most of Sri 
Lankan is still following the traditional system of astrology, the popular system of matching 
the horoscope here is to follow the result of 20 Porutham (Visi Porondam), which based only 
on the Moon's star (Janma Nakshastra) at the time of birth. Among the 20 items of so called 
porutham, Ruksha Porutham (Tree Matching) is for child issues. If it is matched according to 
the ancient Vedic rules the Astrologer decides that the couple is with sufficient physical 
strength to bear good offspring. 


In addition to 20 porutham, some well versed Vedic Astrologers use to follow the rules given 
in ancient classical writings of the sages and determine the progeny. Accordingly Jupiter the 
Naisargika Putrakaraka is the key planet for child birth. The 5th house rules over children. 
Also the lord of 5th, planets in 5th, planets connected with 5th by aspects, Venus for male 
sperm and seminal liquid in the body of female, 9th house of the female horoscope and 
Sapthamsa are to be scrutinized. If no any affliction to these factors, the couple is destined to 
have children and if not so it would be considered as detrimental for the child birth. 


Also in Vedic system there are three mathematical tests for judging the fertility of a natal 
chart such as (1) Kshetra Sputa of female chart (2) Beeja Sputa of male chart and (3) 
Santhana Thithi. In addition some beneficial and detrimental Yogas for child birth have been 
largely followed by the Vedic Astrologers. Some of them are Puthra Yoga, Bahuputra Yoga & 
Aputhra Yoga. 


Dr. B.V.Raman in his book "Three Hundred Combinations" explains some Aputra Yogas 
alias Suthakshaya Yogas (Sutha = Children, Kshaya = Decline/Null) such as Anapathya 
Yoga, Sarpa Shapa Yoga, Maatru Shapa Suthakashaya Yoga, Pithru Shapa Suthakshya Yoga 
and Aputhra Yoga. 


In essence in Vedic system the chance of child birth depends on the 5th house and 11th 
house from Lagna, Nawamsa, Moon, Jupiter, Venus and ruling Dasa. 


This is a story of a couple, who are said to be married with considerable matching of 
horoscope as per Vedic System. They are still waiting for a lucky time to coddle a baby ina 
cradle, by following many remedies and medical advices. After ten years of marriage, this 
fatigued couple was advised by a Vedic Astrologer to do some more remedies for child birth 
and the male native sought my assistance to solve this problem and to know whether he is 
able to be a father. On checking the natal chart I said "No, don't do any more remedies 
because you are not lucky to be a father". My simple analysis is as below. 


First let us read the horoscope of male attached for the child birth as per the Vedic rules.

The connection between Saturn and Moon is known as Punarphoo Dosha._ Shri K.S. 
Krishnamurthi deals Punarphoo from only marriage perspective. 


When Saturn has got any connection with Moon, there will be an obstacle during negotia- 
tion, fixation or celebration of marriage. There can be broken engagement, postponement of 
marriage date, delay in fixation of ,marriage etc. 

The following combination in the chart causes Punarphoo dosha : - 

1) Saturn in the star of Moon and sub of Saturn 

2) Moon in the star of Saturn and sub of Moon 

3) Saturn and Moon in the same sign. 


I am discussing below a chart of one of my studentS who has Punarphoo dosha in her chart. 
Native : Female 


DOB > Q4th June 1972 
TOB © 19.55 
Place : Indore, MP 


In the above chart Saturn is in the star of Moon and sub of Saturn causing Punarphoo 
dosha. 


The marriage was finalized on 24.11.1993 when the native was having MD and AD of Saturn 
and PD of Venus from 22.07.1993 to 21.01.1994. 
Satum 6/2,3 Moon 3/8 Saturn 6/2,3 
Venus 7/6,11 Rahu2/- Sun 6/9 _ (1) 
Rashilord Saturn 6/2,3 Moon3/8 


Saturn and Venus are connected with the houses 2, 7 and 11. The native fell severely ill and 
the marriage had to be postponed. The date of marriage was finalized on 25.02.1994. The 
native was having MD and AD of Saturn and PD of Sun from 21.01.1994 to 17.03.1994. 
Sun6/9 #$#Moon3/8 


Here we see that Sun is not a significator of either 2, 7 or 11. Sun / Mercury and Saturn are 
in conjunction in Taurus. Mercury is in the 6 house and its rashi ‘s in 7+ and 10 house 
respectively. So Sun signifies 6t, 7» and 10t houses. 


We see that there is no planet in the 11 house. The rashi is Libra and rashi lord being 
Venus. There is no planet in the star of Venus, but Sun and Moon are in the sub of Venus. 
Thus Sun and Moon become a strong significators of 11t* house. Saturn signifying 24 
house, Sun and Moon signifying 11t* house because they are in the sub of Venus and Sun 
signifying 7‘ house because of conjunction with Mercury. Saturn and Sun are significators 
of 2, 7 and 11 respectively. The marriage was celebrated on 25.02.1994. 


One more important point was that the native’s husband met with an accident just 15 days 


before the marriage (i.e. before 25.02.1994) and got his leg fractured but the marriage finally 
took place on 25.02.1994.

A brief history on Raja Ravi Varma 











Raja Ravi Varma (29 April 1848 —- 2 October 1906) was a celebrated Indian painter and art- 
ist. He is considered among the greatest painters in the history of Indian art for some aes- 
thetic and broader social reasons. Firstly, his works are held to be among the best examples 
of the fusion of European techniques with a purely Indian sensibility. While continuing the 
tradition and aesthetics of Indian art, his paintings employed the latest European academic 
art techniques of the day. Secondly, he was notable for making affordable lithographs of his 
paintings available to the public, which greatly enhanced his reach and influence as a paint- 
er and public figure. Indeed, his lithographs increased the involvement of common people 
with fine arts and defined artistic tastes among common people for several decades. In par- 
ticular, his depictions of Hindu deities and episodes from the epics and _ Scrip- 
tures (Puranas) have received profound acceptance from the public and are found, often as 
objects of worship, across the length and breadth of India.

Question: Role of 8s house to become astrologer 
Could you explain how can the 8 house be a significator of 9t cuspal sub lord to become 
astrologer since 8 is 12th to 9th (astrology and higher mind). 


Answer: 
KP Reader II: Fundamental Principles of Astrology, p 207 


Quote: 

The eighth house denotes surgeons, medical officers, health inspectors, slaughter houses, 
butchers, coroners and so on. 

Jupiter or Saturn, the two philosophical planets, occupying the eighth house, arouse in the na- 
tive a deep interest for occultism and mystical subjects. Mercury, the planet of pure intellect in 
this position, denotes an enquiring mind concerning occult matters. One may be inclined to 
study hidden and metaphysical problems. 

Unquote 


According to the study of one hundred astrologers’ charts, the signified astro-related houses 

by the 9th CSL in order of percentage frequency of appearance are as follows: 

> Firstly 9th house (astrology in general, higher learning and luck) with frequency 79%, i.e. 
appearing 79 times out of 100 charts ; 


> Secondly 3rd house (mental inclination, skills, talent, capability and communication) with 
frequency 74% ; 

> Thirdly 8th house (occult and secret knowledge and research) with frequency 68%.; 

> Fourthly 2nd house (speaking and mathematical skills, vision and power of observation 
and prediction) and 10th house (profession for counseling, livelihood, karma and social 
status) with frequency 66% each; 

> Fifthly 7th house (publicity and astrology*) with frequency 65%; 

> Sixthly 5th house (speculation, planning, intelligence and past life merit) and 11th house 
(gain, intuition, magical capability and astrology**) with frequency 64% each; 

> Seventhly 12th house (hidden occult knowledge, spiritual bliss and intuition) with fre- 
quency 63%; and 

> Finally 1st house (native himself) with frequency 54%. 

> “Rex E. Bills: The Rulership Book, 1971, p 9 

> *“*Michael Munkasey: The Astrological Thesaurus, 1993, p 196

| Book review- 
)Principles and Practices of Mundane Astrology 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 


BERR RRR RHR EERE EERE ERE EERE ERE HEE EERE EEE EEE HH 


Principles and Practices of Mundane Astrology 
by K.K. Pathak 





+ Tee 


oa f 





This is a collection of essays with some interesting new techniques. Much of this book is a 
running commentary on Indian history from the 1980’s to 2005. From an essay published in 
1991, he considers that New Delhi may not always be the capital of India, an interesting 
idea. Reacting to B.V. Raman’s prediction of a major world war in 2000, Pathak says that Ra- 
man is wrong. For the mundane astrologer, this book may be some interesting reading. 


Contents: 
Preface; 

1. Mundane astrology; 

2. Astrology’s role in national affairs; 

3. Traffic accidents: in astrological study; 

4. Rail accidents: an astrological study; 

5. Impact of eclipses; 

6. Saturn-Jupiter nexus in mundane astrology; 

7. A peep through the cyclic scope; 

8. Future of New Delhi: 

9. Does Saturn in Leo destroy fortresses in Delhi?; 
10. Future of Kashmir; 

11. Will India disintegrate?; 

12. Natural zodiacal sign for India; 

13. No world war in 2000 AD; 

14. Astro-meteorology in folklore; 

15. On earthquakes.
